```md
# UNDMA V2 Agent Context

## 产品文档归属（2026-11-05）

V2 产品文档统一放在 `../docs/un-dma-v2/`，跨产品共用的文档放在 `../docs/`。V2 产品目录内禁止存放产品文档。

## 用户指定保留的直接 CD 读取研究（2026-11-05）

`include/Game/DirectCooldownResearch.hpp` 是用户明确要求长期保留、便于分享的完整注释代码档案，记录已跑通的 CN154905N 非本地技能 CD 读取实现、映射及证据。正式版采用 active 状态计时器；该档案不参与编译或运行。禁止 AI 以死代码、实验已退役、清理或精简为由自行删除、缩写或迁出。只有用户明确要求删除此研究成果时才能删除；维护工具或后续重构必须保留注释正文与溯源说明。

2026-11-02 目录边界：V1/V2 已拆成独立 Git 仓库，各自提交，不再共用 Git 数据库。研究材料在 `../../02_RESEARCH/un-dma-research/v2-product-research`，自测、验证和预览工具在 `../../04_SCENARIO/un-dma-v2`。产品目录不得重新添加 research、测试源码或测试构建。正式程序保留 `build/Release`；`./build-release.ps1 -Tests` 的输出位于 Scenario 的 `build/selftests`。以下旧路径和 worktree 说明仅为历史记录，以本条为准。


2026-10-30：当前主线已接入实验 C，统一采集固定 300Hz，无 240Hz 或频率切换入口。B/C 已归档至 ../../06_ARCHIVE/un-v2-experiments-20261030/；继续维护本目录。当前 Release 构建通过，本次 45 秒 CN 短跑启动被自动审批拒绝，现场未验；详见 ../docs/un-dma-v2/V2_PROGRESS.zh-CN.md。

本目录为独立演进工作区 `D:\Desktop\SenseZen\ECS_O\01_PRODUCTS\un-dma-v2`，分支 `v2/framework`，从 V1 `00abf5b` 继承。先读 `../docs/un-dma-v2/V2.md`、ECS_O 的 `00_META/UN_UNIFIED_REFACTOR_20261028.md` 和唯一进度 `UN_UNIFIED_PROGRESS_20261028.md`。

此前“只建立工作区和验证隔离”的迁移阶段已经结束。后续 V2 实施以 `../docs/un-dma-v2/V2_REFACTOR_PLAN.zh-CN.md` 为现行总纲、`../../02_RESEARCH/un-dma-research/v2-product-research/V2_RESEARCH_NOTES.zh-CN.md` 为研究索引，按用户在执行线程中确定的目标推进；当前已进入实现与现场核验，实际状态见 ../docs/un-dma-v2/V2_PROGRESS.zh-CN.md。本工作区不承担 V1 日常维护；V1 独立位于 `../un-dma-v1`，其分支 `v1/cn` 和现有可用程序不能被覆盖、切换或 reset。

当前地区命名 CN=国服/NetEase、World=普通国际服、Nexon=韩服。

保留 UN 自有算法、Behavior 定义、参数关系和 Slot 业务语义，Pure 主要作为运行组织参考；UI 按 UN 业务重设计，使用用户新安装的 jakubkrehel/skills 套件，旧 make-interfaces-feel-better 不再是活动入口。V2 初期允许成体系重构，暂停 Ponytail 的最小改动取向。目标模式中局部未解决项不阻断独立工作；全部完成则结束，全局阻塞或仅剩必须用户介入的事项时暂停并报告，不把待验写成已通过。

最终目标是能实际运行和使用的正式 V2：CN 真实采集、显示、UN 算法/Behavior、当前设备输出和新 UI/配置形成完整链路。直接实施、构建、运行并修复；模拟、回放和离线预览仅为可选调试工具，不是交付终点，不要求先造一套模拟框架或逐阶段等待确认。Slot 新增规则已获用户确认：复制参数、清空绑定、默认停用。

构建 `./build-release.ps1`，程序 `build/Release/UNDMA_V2.exe`，入口 `./start-v2.ps1`，显式 TestServer 端口 19560。build/config/logs/产物必须工作区自有，禁止链接到 V1；不能并发竞争硬件。Scenario 仅继承现有代码，不承诺后续兼容。离线编译和配置检查不证明现场运行。

后续按模块实际需要沿用自测，不要求搬运整套旧测试框架。不得删除 V1 测试或把不可用能力标成已验收。offset/大证据归 03_DOWNP，遥测和视觉归 04_SCENARIO；Pure 等其他进行中的研究保持独立。
```

```txt
# ============================================================================
# Post-build: copy DMA runtime DLLs
# ============================================================================

function(copy_leechcore_runtime target_name)
    # Supplier/SDK components are optional; selecting their source still requires them at runtime.
    foreach(optional_dll FTD2XX.dll vmsavedstatedumpprovider.dll)
        if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/${optional_dll}")
            add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
                COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/${optional_dll}"
                    "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/info.db"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/leechcore.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/vmm.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/FTD3XX.dll"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/leechcore/FTD3XXWU.dll"
```

```md
# [OW2] Unleashed DMA V2

20261106已更新2.25.1.0.155284版本。
老unleashed粉丝在un死后悲痛欲绝，公益为爱发电复活un，不接受任何赞助。
由GPT维护。
```

`build-launcher.ps1`:

```ps1
param([switch]$SkipNative)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
if (-not $SkipNative) { & (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'build-release.ps1'); if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }
$env:CARGO_HOME='D:\DevCache\unleashed-cargo'
$env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR='D:\DevCache\unleashed-cargo-target'
$env:npm_config_cache='D:\DevCache\npm-unleashed'
Push-Location (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'launcher')
try {
    & npm.cmd ci --no-audit --no-fund
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Launcher dependency installation failed' }
    & npm.cmd run tauri -- build --no-bundle
    if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'Launcher build failed' }
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR 'release\unleashed-launcher.exe') -Destination (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'build\Release\unleashed-launcher.exe')
} finally { Pop-Location }

```

`build-release.ps1`:

```ps1
param([switch]$Tests)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$cmake = Join-Path $env:ProgramFiles 'Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cmake)) {
    throw "Visual Studio Community 2026 CMake was not found at: $cmake"
}

Push-Location $PSScriptRoot
try {
    $configurePreset = if ($Tests) { 'selftests' } else { 'vs2026' }
    $buildPreset = if ($Tests) { 'selftests' } else { 'release' }
    & $cmake --preset $configurePreset
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        exit $LASTEXITCODE
    }

    & $cmake --build --preset $buildPreset
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        exit $LASTEXITCODE
    }
}
finally {
    Pop-Location
}

```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Alerts {
inline constexpr uint64_t kAnaHeroId = 0x02E000000000013Bull;
inline constexpr const char* kAnaSleepId = "ana.sleep_dart";
inline constexpr const char* kAnaGrenadeId = "ana.biotic_grenade";
inline constexpr uint64_t kEchoHeroId = 0x02E0000000000206ull;
inline constexpr const char* kEchoFlightId = "echo.flight";
inline constexpr size_t kMaxMessageBytes = 240;
struct Definition {
    const char* id;
    uint64_t hero;
    uint8_t slot;
    const char* skillName;
    const char* skillNameZh;
    const char* defaultMessage;
    bool enabledByDefault = false;
};
inline constexpr std::array kDefinitions{
    Definition{kAnaSleepId, kAnaHeroId, 0, "Sleep Dart / Shift", "睡眠针 · Shift", "安娜没睡针", true},
    Definition{kEchoFlightId, kEchoHeroId, 0, "Flight / Shift", "飞行 · Shift", "echo没飞", true},
    Definition{kAnaGrenadeId, kAnaHeroId, 1, "Biotic Grenade / E", "生化手雷 · E", "安娜没瓶"},
    Definition{"echo.focusing_beam", kEchoHeroId, 1, "Focusing Beam / E", "聚焦光线 · E", "回声没光线"}
};
inline const Definition* SkillForHero(uint64_t hero, uint8_t slot = 0) {
    for (const auto& definition : kDefinitions)
        if (definition.hero == hero && definition.slot == slot) return &definition;
    return nullptr;
}
struct RuleSettings {
    std::string id = kAnaSleepId;
    bool enabled = false;
    std::string message = "安娜没睡针";
    bool operator==(const RuleSettings&) const = default;
};
inline constexpr const char* kDefaultUltimateMessage = "敌方大招就绪";
struct UltimateRule {
    uint64_t hero = 0;
    int mode = -1; // -1 follows the global setting, 0 off, 1 on.
    std::string message; // Empty follows the global announcement.
    bool operator==(const UltimateRule&) const = default;
};
struct Settings {
    bool skillEnabled = false;
    bool ultimateEnabled = false;
    bool ultimateAll = true;
    int voice = 0; // Kokoro v1.1-zh: 0 = zf_001 (sid 3), 1 = zm_009 (sid 58).
    int volume = 80;
    std::string outputDevice; // Empty selects the system playback default.
    std::vector<RuleSettings> rules = [] {
        std::vector<RuleSettings> result;
        for (const auto& item : kDefinitions)
            result.push_back({item.id, item.enabledByDefault, item.defaultMessage});
        return result;
    }();
    std::string ultimateMessage = kDefaultUltimateMessage;
    std::vector<UltimateRule> ultimates;
    bool operator==(const Settings&) const = default;
};
bool UltimateHeroSupported(uint64_t hero);
inline const UltimateRule* UltimateForHero(const Settings& settings, uint64_t hero) {
    for (const auto& rule : settings.ultimates)
        if (rule.hero == hero) return &rule;
    return nullptr;
}
inline bool UltimateHeroEnabled(const Settings& settings, uint64_t hero) {
    const auto* rule = UltimateForHero(settings, hero);
    return rule && rule->mode >= 0 ? rule->mode == 1 : settings.ultimateAll;
}
inline const std::string& UltimateMessage(const Settings& settings, uint64_t hero) {
    const auto* rule = UltimateForHero(settings, hero);
    return rule && !rule->message.empty() ? rule->message : settings.ultimateMessage;
}
Settings Normalize(Settings settings);
Settings GetSettings();
Settings GetRuntimeSettings();
Settings SetRuntimeHero(uint64_t hero);
void SetSettings(Settings settings);
bool ObserveSkillHero(uint64_t hero);
bool ObserveUltimateHero(uint64_t hero);
}
```

`include/Alerts/SkillDetector.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Alerts/Settings.hpp"
#include <span>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace V2::Alerts {
inline constexpr uint8_t kUltimateSlot = 2;
struct SkillObservation {
    uint64_t body = 0, actor = 0, hero = 0, epoch = 0, scene = 0;
    uint32_t tick = 0;
    bool active = false;
    bool eligible = false;
    uint8_t slot = 0;
};
struct SkillEvent {
    const char* ruleId = nullptr;
    SkillObservation source;
};
class SkillDetector {
    struct Track { SkillObservation last; uint32_t lastCast = 0; uint64_t seen = 0; };
    std::array<std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Track>, 3> tracks_;
    uint64_t sequence_ = 0;
public:
    void Reset() { for (auto& tracks : tracks_) tracks.clear(); }
    std::vector<SkillEvent> Observe(std::span<const SkillObservation> observations, uint32_t now) {
        std::vector<SkillEvent> events;
        ++sequence_;
        for (const auto& sample : observations) {
            if (sample.slot > kUltimateSlot) continue;
            const auto* definition = SkillForHero(sample.hero, sample.slot);
            if (!sample.eligible || (!definition && sample.slot != kUltimateSlot) || !sample.body || !sample.actor ||
                !sample.epoch || !sample.scene || !sample.tick || uint32_t(now-sample.tick) > 450) continue;
            auto& track = tracks_[sample.slot][sample.body];
            const auto previous = track.last;
            const bool sameActor = previous.actor == sample.actor && previous.hero == sample.hero &&
                previous.epoch == sample.epoch && previous.scene == sample.scene;
            if (sameActor && previous.tick && int32_t(sample.tick-previous.tick) < 0) {
                track.seen = sequence_;
                continue;
            }
            const bool continuous = previous.tick && sameActor &&
                uint32_t(sample.tick-previous.tick) <= 450;
            if (!continuous) track.lastCast = 0;
            // Initial active=true is a baseline, never an inferred cast. Ignore repeated cached samples.
            if (continuous && sample.tick != previous.tick && !previous.active && sample.active &&
                (!track.lastCast || uint32_t(sample.tick-track.lastCast) >= 800)) {
                events.push_back({definition ? definition->id : nullptr, sample});
                track.lastCast = sample.tick;
            }
            track.last = sample;
            track.seen = sequence_;
        }
        for (auto& tracks : tracks_)
            std::erase_if(tracks, [&](const auto& item) { return item.second.seen != sequence_; });
        return events;
    }
};
}
```

```hpp
// Returns stable literals for known fixed vocabulary and preserves the caller's
// pointer for every other string. Existing UiText translations should be looked
// up first by the UI.cpp adapter, so there is only one owner for each label.
inline constexpr const char* UiLabel(const char* text, bool chinese) noexcept {
    if (!text)
        return "";
    if (!chinese)
        return text;
    const std::string_view key(text);
    if (key.find("##") != std::string_view::npos)
        return text;
    for (const UiLabelPair& entry : kUiLabels) {
        if (key == entry.en)
            return entry.zh;
    }
    return text;
}

// "All" edits the current runtime values rather than a separate global store.
// Rename only that hero-selection sentinel, never team/bone/scope values.
inline constexpr const char* UiHeroScopeLabel(const char* text, bool chinese) noexcept {
    if (text && std::string_view(text) == "All")
        return UiLabel("Current settings", chinese);
    return UiLabel(text, chinese);
}

} // namespace UI
```

`include/Features/UiValueFormat.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>

namespace UI::ValueFormat {

// Display conversion is explicit. This never changes the stored slider value.
struct Spec {
    int decimals = 0;
    const char* suffix = "";
    double scale = 1.0;
    const char* prefix = "";
    const char* lowerLabel = nullptr;
    double lowerThreshold = 0.0;
    const char* upperLabel = nullptr;
    double upperThreshold = 0.0;
};

constexpr Spec Number(int decimals, const char* suffix = "",
                      double scale = 1.0, const char* prefix = "")
{
    return { decimals, suffix, scale, prefix };
}

constexpr Spec AtOrBelow(const char* label, double threshold, Spec number)
{
    number.lowerLabel = label;
    number.lowerThreshold = threshold;
    return number;
}

constexpr Spec AtOrAbove(const char* label, double threshold, Spec number)
{
    number.upperLabel = label;
    number.upperThreshold = threshold;
    return number;
}

inline const char* Format(char* buffer, std::size_t size,
                          double value, const Spec& spec)
{
    if (spec.lowerLabel && value <= spec.lowerThreshold)
        return spec.lowerLabel;
    if (spec.upperLabel && value >= spec.upperThreshold)
        return spec.upperLabel;
    if (!buffer || size == 0)
        return "";

    const int decimals = spec.decimals < 0 ? 0 : (spec.decimals > 6 ? 6 : spec.decimals);
    std::snprintf(buffer, size, "%s%.*f%s",
                  spec.prefix ? spec.prefix : "",
                  decimals, value * spec.scale,
                  spec.suffix ? spec.suffix : "");
    return buffer;
}

} // namespace UI::ValueFormat
```

```hpp
    const std::string slug = HeroDisplayNameToSlug(slugOrDisplayName);
    if (slug.empty())
        return nullptr;

    for (const HeroAbilityIcons& icons : kHeroAbilityIcons) {
        if (slug == icons.heroSlug)
            return &icons;
    }
    return nullptr;
```

```hpp
enum class PredictionOverrideMode : int {
    Auto = 0,
    ForceOn = 1,
    ForceOff = 2,
};

// All prediction paths share projectile data. Relative-motion variants use
// target velocity minus local-actor velocity for the target model. Local
// velocity never becomes part of projectile muzzle velocity.
enum class PredictionAlgorithm : int {
    LegacyLinear = 0,
    BallisticIntercept = 1,
    LegacyLinearRelativeMotion = 2,
    BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion = 3,
};

inline constexpr int ClampPredictionAlgorithm(int value) {
    return value >= static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinear) &&
        value <= static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion)
        ? value : static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinear);
}

inline constexpr bool IsBallisticPredictionAlgorithm(int value) {
    const int normalized = ClampPredictionAlgorithm(value);
    return normalized == static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticIntercept) ||
        normalized == static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion);
}

inline constexpr bool IsRelativeMotionPredictionAlgorithm(int value) {
    const int normalized = ClampPredictionAlgorithm(value);
    return normalized == static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinearRelativeMotion) ||
        normalized == static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion);
}

inline const char* PredictionAlgorithmId(int value) {
    switch (ClampPredictionAlgorithm(value)) {
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinearRelativeMotion):
        return "legacy_linear_relative_motion";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticIntercept):
        return "ballistic_intercept";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion):
        return "ballistic_intercept_relative_motion";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinear):
    default:
        return "legacy_linear";
    }
}

inline const char* PredictionAlgorithmName(int value) {
    switch (ClampPredictionAlgorithm(value)) {
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinearRelativeMotion):
        return "Legacy Linear Relative Motion";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticIntercept):
        return "Ballistic Intercept";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::BallisticInterceptRelativeMotion):
        return "Ballistic Intercept Relative Motion";
    case static_cast<int>(PredictionAlgorithm::LegacyLinear):
    default:
        return "Legacy Linear";
    }
}
```

```hpp
inline void NormalizeBehaviorTuning(AimBehaviorTuning& t) {
    using AimPlan::Finite;
    t.smooth=Finite(t.smooth,20,0,100); t.baseSpeed=Finite(t.baseSpeed,100,0,100);
    t.firePolicy=(std::clamp)(t.firePolicy,0,6);
    t.pitchScale=Finite(t.pitchScale,1,.1f,3); t.maxAimTime=Finite(t.maxAimTime,100,0,100);
    t.minCharge=Finite(t.minCharge,5,0,100); t.maxCharge=Finite(t.maxCharge,100,t.minCharge,100);
    t.chargeFallbackMs=Finite(t.chargeFallbackMs,720,0,10000);
    t.releaseExecution=(std::clamp)(t.releaseExecution,0,1);
    t.releaseAimTimeoutMs=Finite(t.releaseAimTimeoutMs,1000,50,5000);
    t.trackingDeadzone=Finite(t.trackingDeadzone,0,0,250);
    t.flickShotClampMs=Finite(t.flickShotClampMs,0,0,1000);
    t.flickPostFireDelayMs=Finite(t.flickPostFireDelayMs,0,0,500);
    t.magneticShotIntervalMs=Finite(t.magneticShotIntervalMs,0,0,5000);
    t.magneticPostFirePauseMs=Finite(t.magneticPostFirePauseMs,35,0,500);
    t.magneticRecoveryMs=Finite(t.magneticRecoveryMs,90,0,1000);
    t.magneticPostFireYawScale=Finite(t.magneticPostFireYawScale,.35f,0,1);
    t.magneticPostFirePitchScale=Finite(t.magneticPostFirePitchScale,0,0,1);
    t.magneticPreFireBoostWindowMs=Finite(t.magneticPreFireBoostWindowMs,45,0,250);
    t.magneticPreFireBoostScale=Finite(t.magneticPreFireBoostScale,1.35f,1,3);
    t.flickTrajectoryWaitMs=Finite(t.flickTrajectoryWaitMs,120,0,3000);
    t.flickTrajectoryApexWindowMs=Finite(t.flickTrajectoryApexWindowMs,60,0,1000);
```

`include/Game/AimFirePhase.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace OW::AimFirePhase {

struct Tuning {
    float shotIntervalMs = 250.0f;
    float pauseMs = 35.0f;
    float recoveryMs = 90.0f;
    float pauseYawScale = 0.35f;
    float pausePitchScale = 0.0f;
    float preFireBoostWindowMs = 45.0f;
    float preFireBoostScale = 1.35f;
};

struct Phase {
    float trackingScale = 1.0f;
    float yawScale = 1.0f;
    float pitchScale = 1.0f;
    bool paused = false;
    bool recovering = false;
    bool preFireBoost = false;
    bool readyToFire = true;
};

inline float Finite(float value, float fallback)
{
    return std::isfinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}

inline Phase Resolve(float elapsedSinceShotMs, bool shotLatched, const Tuning& raw)
{
    Phase phase{};
    if (!shotLatched)
        return phase;

    const float interval = std::clamp(Finite(raw.shotIntervalMs, 250.0f), 1.0f, 5000.0f);
    const float pause = std::clamp(Finite(raw.pauseMs, 35.0f), 0.0f, interval);
    const float recovery = std::clamp(Finite(raw.recoveryMs, 90.0f), 0.0f, 1000.0f);
    const float yawFloor = std::clamp(Finite(raw.pauseYawScale, 0.35f), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    const float pitchFloor = std::clamp(Finite(raw.pausePitchScale, 0.0f), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    const float elapsed = (std::max)(0.0f, Finite(elapsedSinceShotMs, 0.0f));
    phase.readyToFire = elapsed >= interval;

    if (elapsed < pause) {
        phase.paused = true;
        phase.yawScale = yawFloor;
        phase.pitchScale = pitchFloor;
    } else if (recovery > 0.0f && elapsed < pause + recovery) {
        phase.recovering = true;
        const float t = std::clamp((elapsed - pause) / recovery, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        const float smooth = t * t * (3.0f - 2.0f * t);
        phase.yawScale = yawFloor + (1.0f - yawFloor) * smooth;
        phase.pitchScale = pitchFloor + (1.0f - pitchFloor) * smooth;
    }

    const float boostWindow = std::clamp(
        Finite(raw.preFireBoostWindowMs, 45.0f), 0.0f, interval);
    const float remaining = interval - elapsed;
    if (!phase.readyToFire && boostWindow > 0.0f && remaining <= boostWindow) {
        const float progress = std::clamp(1.0f - remaining / boostWindow, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        phase.preFireBoost = true;
        phase.trackingScale = 1.0f +
            (std::clamp(Finite(raw.preFireBoostScale, 1.35f), 1.0f, 3.0f) - 1.0f) * progress;
    }

    return phase;
}

// Resolve the same post-fire pause/recovery and pre-fire boost for an
// irregular sequence. The caller supplies the measured time on both sides of
// the current point, so a mixed hip/scoped cadence does not have to pretend it
// is a fixed-rate weapon.
inline Phase ResolveTimeline(float elapsedSinceShotMs,
                             float timeUntilNextShotMs,
                             bool shotObserved,
                             const Tuning& raw)
{
    const float elapsed = (std::max)(0.0f, Finite(elapsedSinceShotMs, 0.0f));
    const float remaining = (std::max)(0.0f, Finite(timeUntilNextShotMs, 0.0f));
    if (!shotObserved) {
        Phase phase{};
        phase.readyToFire = remaining <= 0.0f;
        const float boostWindow = std::clamp(
            Finite(raw.preFireBoostWindowMs, 45.0f), 0.0f, 2000.0f);
        if (boostWindow > 0.0f && remaining > 0.0f && remaining <= boostWindow) {
            const float progress = std::clamp(1.0f - remaining / boostWindow, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            phase.preFireBoost = true;
            phase.trackingScale = 1.0f +
                (std::clamp(Finite(raw.preFireBoostScale, 1.35f), 1.0f, 3.0f) - 1.0f) * progress;
        }
        return phase;
    }

    Tuning tuning = raw;
    tuning.shotIntervalMs = (std::max)(1.0f, elapsed + remaining);
    Phase phase = Resolve(elapsed, true, tuning);
    phase.readyToFire = remaining <= 0.0f;
    return phase;
}

} // namespace OW::AimFirePhase
```

`include/Game/AimHoldWindow.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::AimHoldWindow {

struct State {
    bool active = false;
    bool timedOut = false;
    std::uint32_t startedAt = 0;
    std::uint32_t timeoutMs = 0;
};

inline void Observe(State& state, bool sampleAvailable, bool held,
                    std::uint32_t now, std::uint32_t timeoutMs, bool canStart) {
    // Missing input evidence must never rearm a held key.
    if (!sampleAvailable)
        return;
    if (!held) {
        state = {};
    } else if (!state.active && canStart) {
        state = {true, false, now, timeoutMs};
    }
}

inline bool Expired(State& state, std::uint32_t now) {
    if (state.active && state.timeoutMs != 0 &&
        now - state.startedAt >= state.timeoutMs)
        state.timedOut = true;
    return state.timedOut;
}

} // namespace OW::AimHoldWindow
```

`include/Game/AimHybridController.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW::AimHybrid {

inline constexpr float kDegToRad = M_PI_F / 180.0f;
inline constexpr float kRadToDeg = 180.0f / M_PI_F;

struct Tuning {
    float p = 0.45f;
    float i = 0.01f;
    float d = 0.04f;
    float maxIntegral = 10.0f;
    float deadzoneDeg = 0.10f;
    float constantSpeedDegPerSec = 45.0f;
    float maxSpeedDegPerSec = 720.0f;
    float accelerationDegPerSec2 = 1800.0f;
    float decelerationDegPerSec2 = 2600.0f;
    float nearRadiusDeg = 3.0f;
    float targetMotionGain = 0.35f;
    float suddenMotionBoost = 2.5f;
    float retargetResetDeg = 12.0f;
};

struct State {
    Vector3 integral{};
    Vector3 previousError{};
    Vector3 lastTarget{};
    Vector3 targetVelocity{};
    Vector3 outputVelocity{};
    bool initialized = false;
};

struct StepResult {
    Vector3 value{};
    float outputSpeedDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    float targetSpeedDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    float targetAccelerationDegPerSec2 = 0.0f;
    float accelerationLimitDegPerSec2 = 0.0f;
    bool reset = false;
};

inline float ClampFinite(float value, float low, float high, float fallback)
{
    return std::clamp(std::isfinite(value) ? value : fallback, low, high);
}

inline Vector3 ClampMagnitude(const Vector3& value, float limit)
{
    const float magnitude = value.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(magnitude) || magnitude <= 0.000001f || limit <= 0.0f)
        return Vector3{};
    if (magnitude <= limit)
        return value;
    return value * (limit / magnitude);
}

inline Vector3 ClampIntegral(const Vector3& value, float maxIntegral)
{
    return Vector3(
        std::clamp(value.X, -maxIntegral, maxIntegral),
        std::clamp(value.Y, -maxIntegral, maxIntegral),
        std::clamp(value.Z, -maxIntegral, maxIntegral));
}

inline float ClampStepComponent(float step, float error)
{
    if (error > 0.0f)
        return std::clamp(step, 0.0f, error);
    if (error < 0.0f)
        return std::clamp(step, error, 0.0f);
    return 0.0f;
}

inline Tuning Sanitize(Tuning tuning)
{
    tuning.p = ClampFinite(tuning.p, 0.0f, 2.0f, 0.45f);
    tuning.i = ClampFinite(tuning.i, 0.0f, 0.5f, 0.01f);
    tuning.d = ClampFinite(tuning.d, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.04f);
    tuning.maxIntegral = ClampFinite(tuning.maxIntegral, 0.0f, 50.0f, 10.0f);
    tuning.deadzoneDeg = ClampFinite(tuning.deadzoneDeg, 0.0f, 10.0f, 0.10f);
    tuning.constantSpeedDegPerSec = ClampFinite(
        tuning.constantSpeedDegPerSec, 0.0f, 3600.0f, 45.0f);
    tuning.maxSpeedDegPerSec = ClampFinite(
        tuning.maxSpeedDegPerSec, 1.0f, 3600.0f, 720.0f);
    tuning.accelerationDegPerSec2 = ClampFinite(
        tuning.accelerationDegPerSec2, 1.0f, 100000.0f, 1800.0f);
    tuning.decelerationDegPerSec2 = ClampFinite(
        tuning.decelerationDegPerSec2, 1.0f, 100000.0f, 2600.0f);
    tuning.nearRadiusDeg = ClampFinite(tuning.nearRadiusDeg, 0.05f, 30.0f, 3.0f);
    tuning.targetMotionGain = ClampFinite(tuning.targetMotionGain, 0.0f, 2.0f, 0.35f);
    tuning.suddenMotionBoost = ClampFinite(tuning.suddenMotionBoost, 1.0f, 8.0f, 2.5f);
    tuning.retargetResetDeg = ClampFinite(tuning.retargetResetDeg, 1.0f, 90.0f, 12.0f);
    return tuning;
}

inline StepResult Advance(Vector3 current,
                          Vector3 target,
                          float deltaTime,
                          const Tuning& rawTuning,
                          State& state)
{
    const Tuning tuning = Sanitize(rawTuning);
    const float dt = ClampFinite(deltaTime, 0.001f, 0.050f, 1.0f / 144.0f);
    const Vector3 error = target - current;
    const float errorMagnitude = error.Size();

    StepResult result{};
    result.value = current;
    if (!std::isfinite(errorMagnitude) || errorMagnitude <= 0.000001f) {
        state.outputVelocity = Vector3{};
        return result;
    }

    const bool retarget = state.initialized &&
        state.lastTarget.DistTo(target) * kRadToDeg > tuning.retargetResetDeg;
    if (!state.initialized || retarget) {
        state = State{};
        state.initialized = true;
        state.previousError = error;
        state.lastTarget = target;
        result.reset = true;
    }

    const float deadzone = tuning.deadzoneDeg * kDegToRad;
    if (errorMagnitude <= deadzone) {
        state.integral = Vector3{};
        state.previousError = error;
        state.lastTarget = target;
        state.outputVelocity = Vector3{};
        return result;
    }

    const Vector3 previousTargetVelocity = state.targetVelocity;
    state.targetVelocity = (target - state.lastTarget) / dt;
    const Vector3 targetAcceleration = (state.targetVelocity - previousTargetVelocity) / dt;
    result.targetSpeedDegPerSec = state.targetVelocity.Size() * kRadToDeg;
    result.targetAccelerationDegPerSec2 = targetAcceleration.Size() * kRadToDeg;

    state.integral = ClampIntegral(
        state.integral + error * dt,
        tuning.maxIntegral);
    const Vector3 derivative = (error - state.previousError) / dt;
    const Vector3 pidCommand =
        error * tuning.p +
        state.integral * tuning.i +
        derivative * tuning.d;

    const Vector3 direction = error / errorMagnitude;
    const float nearScale = std::clamp(
        errorMagnitude * kRadToDeg / tuning.nearRadiusDeg,
        0.0f,
        1.0f);
    const Vector3 constantVelocity = direction *
        (tuning.constantSpeedDegPerSec * nearScale * kDegToRad);
    Vector3 desiredVelocity =
        pidCommand / dt +
        constantVelocity +
        state.targetVelocity * tuning.targetMotionGain;

    const float maxSpeed = tuning.maxSpeedDegPerSec * kDegToRad;
    const float deceleration = tuning.decelerationDegPerSec2 * kDegToRad;
    const float targetFeedSpeed = state.targetVelocity.Size() * tuning.targetMotionGain;
    const float brakingSpeed = std::sqrt((std::max)(0.0f, 2.0f * deceleration * errorMagnitude));
    desiredVelocity = ClampMagnitude(
        desiredVelocity,
        (std::min)(maxSpeed, brakingSpeed + targetFeedSpeed));

    const float suddenScale = std::clamp(
        result.targetAccelerationDegPerSec2 / 720.0f,
        0.0f,
        1.0f);
    const float accelerationBoost =
        1.0f + (tuning.suddenMotionBoost - 1.0f) * suddenScale;
    const bool speedingUp = desiredVelocity.Size() > state.outputVelocity.Size() &&
        (desiredVelocity | state.outputVelocity) >= 0.0f;
    const float rateLimit = (speedingUp
        ? tuning.accelerationDegPerSec2 * accelerationBoost
        : tuning.decelerationDegPerSec2) * kDegToRad;
    result.accelerationLimitDegPerSec2 = rateLimit * kRadToDeg;

    const Vector3 velocityDelta = ClampMagnitude(
        desiredVelocity - state.outputVelocity,
        rateLimit * dt);
    state.outputVelocity = ClampMagnitude(state.outputVelocity + velocityDelta, maxSpeed);

    const Vector3 rawStep = ClampMagnitude(state.outputVelocity * dt, errorMagnitude);
    const Vector3 step(
        ClampStepComponent(rawStep.X, error.X),
        ClampStepComponent(rawStep.Y, error.Y),
        ClampStepComponent(rawStep.Z, error.Z));
    // Keep the state aligned with what was actually emitted. In particular,
    // a sudden target reversal must not retain a hidden velocity that moves
    // away from the new error on the next tick.
    state.outputVelocity = step / dt;
    result.value = current + step;
    result.outputSpeedDegPerSec = state.outputVelocity.Size() * kRadToDeg;

    state.previousError = error;
    state.lastTarget = target;
    return result;
}

} // namespace OW::AimHybrid
```

`include/Game/AimKoi.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "Game/AimSmoothingTiming.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::AimKoi {

// Adapted from KOI's primary proportional controller, whose recovered integral
// weight is zero and previous-error field is not consumed. This is angular UN
// motion, not a replay of KOI's pixel coordinates or original thread timing.
// At speed 100%, remove 10% of the error per UN reference step (1/144 second).
// Do not import KOI's duplicate centre subtraction, shared-axis overwrite or
// unbounded random gain walk. The existing speed control scales this gain.
inline constexpr double kBaseGain = 0.10;
inline constexpr double kReferenceSeconds = AimSmoothingTiming::kReferenceDeltaTimeSeconds;
inline constexpr double kMaximumGapSeconds = 0.10;

struct State {
    std::uint64_t lastSample = 0;
};

struct Move {
    double pitch = 0;
    double yaw = 0;
};

inline Move Advance(State& state, double pitchError, double yawError,
                    double deltaSeconds, double speed, std::uint64_t sample)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(pitchError) || !std::isfinite(yawError) ||
        !std::isfinite(deltaSeconds) || deltaSeconds <= 0.0 ||
        !std::isfinite(speed) || speed <= 0.0) {
        state = {};
        return {};
    }

    // Target freshness is checked by the targeting consumer. Here a timestamp
    // may be consumed only once; delayed/reordered samples must not replay moves.
    if (sample && state.lastSample) {
        if (sample <= state.lastSample)
            return {};
        deltaSeconds = static_cast<double>(sample - state.lastSample) / 1e6;
    }
    state.lastSample = sample;
    // A resumed stream starts gently instead of spending its whole missing
    // interval on one command. With no timestamp, use the caller's elapsed time.
    if (deltaSeconds > kMaximumGapSeconds)
        deltaSeconds = kReferenceSeconds;

    const double gain = std::clamp(kBaseGain * speed, 0.0, 1.0);
    const double factor = gain >= 1.0 ? 1.0 :
        -std::expm1(std::log1p(-gain) * deltaSeconds / kReferenceSeconds);
    yawError = std::remainder(yawError, 6.2831853071795864769);
    // There is no retained velocity/integral or predicted command to commit:
    // every new sample corrects only the current measured error. Common output
    // scaling, quantization and device acceptance remain owned by UN.
    return {pitchError * factor, yawError * factor};
}

} // namespace OW::AimKoi

```

`include/Game/AimPlan.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <limits>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include "Game/ShuwuCore.hpp"
#include "Game/AimResponseCurve.hpp"

namespace OW::AimPlan {
inline constexpr int kMotionMethodCount = 10;
inline constexpr int kMaxGroups = 12;
inline constexpr int kMaxHeroes = 64;
inline float Finite(float v, float fallback, float lo, float hi) {
    return (std::clamp)(std::isfinite(v) ? v : fallback, lo, hi);
}
struct Motion {
        int method = 0;
        float angularSpeedScale = 100.0f;
        float pidP = 0.5f;
        float pidI = 0.01f;
        float pidD = 0.1f;
        float pidMaxIntegral = 10.0f;
        float pidDeadzone = 1.0f;
        int bezierControlPoints = 2;
        float bezierCurvature = 0.5f;
        float bezierSpeed = 50.0f;
        float piecewiseNearDegrees = 2.0f;
        float piecewiseMidDegrees = 6.0f;
        float piecewiseFarDegrees = 12.0f;
        float piecewiseNearScale = 0.20f;
        float piecewiseMidScale = 0.45f;
        float piecewiseFarScale = 0.75f;
        float accelLimitedAcceleration = 0.1f;
        float constantAngularSpeedDeg = 30.0f;
        float hybridConstantSpeedDeg = 45.0f;
        float hybridMaxSpeedDeg = 720.0f;
        float hybridAccelerationDeg = 1800.0f;
        float hybridDecelerationDeg = 2600.0f;
        float hybridNearRadiusDeg = 3.0f;
        float hybridTargetMotionGain = 0.35f;
        float hybridSuddenMotionBoost = 2.5f;
        float hybridDeadzoneDeg = 0.10f;
    AimResponseCurve::Points responseCurve{};
    koi::ShuwuConfig shuwu{};
    bool operator==(const Motion&) const = default;
};
struct Selection {
    // mode: Any / Prefer / Only. Predicate: hero set / full HP / visible.
    int mode = 0, predicate = 0;
    std::vector<uint64_t> heroes;
    float angleWeight = 1, distanceWeight = 0, healthWeight = 0;
    // HP is absolute effective HP. An upper bound of zero is unlimited.
    float minHealth = 0, maxHealth = 0;
    bool operator==(const Selection&) const = default;
};
struct Limits {
    float minDistance = 0, maxDistance = 100, fov = 15;
    float minHealth = 0, maxHealth = 0;
    bool operator==(const Limits&) const = default;
};
struct AimPoint {
    uint16_t boneMask = 1;
    int predictionMode = 0;
    bool operator==(const AimPoint&) const = default;
};
struct Group {
    uint64_t id = 0;
    std::string name = "Hero exception";
    std::vector<uint64_t> heroes;
    bool overrideLimits = false, overrideAimPoint = false, overrideMotion = false;
    Limits limits{};
    AimPoint point{};
    Motion motion{};
    bool operator==(const Group&) const = default;
};
struct Plan {
    Selection selection{};
    bool overrideMotion = false;
    Motion motion{};
    std::vector<Group> groups;
    bool operator==(const Plan&) const = default;
};
struct Effective {
    uint64_t ruleId = 0;
    bool overrideLimits = false, overrideAimPoint = false, overrideMotion = false;
    Limits limits{};
    AimPoint point{};
    Motion motion{};
    bool operator==(const Effective&) const = default;
};
inline bool Contains(const std::vector<uint64_t>& ids, uint64_t id) {
    return id && std::find(ids.begin(),ids.end(),id)!=ids.end();
}
inline Effective Resolve(const Plan& p, uint64_t hero) {
    Effective e; e.overrideMotion=p.overrideMotion; e.motion=p.motion;
    for (const auto& g:p.groups) if (Contains(g.heroes,hero)) {
        e.ruleId=g.id; e.overrideLimits=g.overrideLimits; e.limits=g.limits;
        e.overrideAimPoint=g.overrideAimPoint; e.point=g.point;
        if(g.overrideMotion) { e.overrideMotion=true; e.motion=g.motion; }
        break;
    }
    return e;
}
inline bool PredicateMatches(const Selection& p, uint64_t hero, float hp, float maxHp, bool visible) {
    switch(p.predicate) {
    case 1: return std::isfinite(hp) && std::isfinite(maxHp) && maxHp>0 && hp>=maxHp-0.01f;
    case 2: return visible;
    default: return Contains(p.heroes,hero);
    }
}
inline bool HealthPasses(float hp,float lo,float hi) {
    return std::isfinite(hp) && hp>=lo && (hi<=0 || hp<=hi);
}
inline bool Eligible(const Selection& p,const Effective& e,uint64_t hero,float hp,float maxHp,bool visible) {
    return HealthPasses(hp,e.overrideLimits?e.limits.minHealth:p.minHealth,e.overrideLimits?e.limits.maxHealth:p.maxHealth) &&
        (p.mode!=2 || PredicateMatches(p,hero,hp,maxHp,visible));
}
inline float Score(int priority,const Selection& p,float angle,float distance,float hp,
                   float maxHp,float commonFov,float commonDistance) {
    if(!std::isfinite(angle)||!std::isfinite(distance)||!std::isfinite(hp))
        return (std::numeric_limits<float>::infinity)();
    if(priority==0) return angle;
    if(priority==1) return hp;
    if(priority==2) return distance;
    const float a=Finite(p.angleWeight,1,0,100), d=Finite(p.distanceWeight,0,0,100),
                h=Finite(p.healthWeight,0,0,100), sum=a+d+h;
    if(sum<=0) return angle/(std::max)(commonFov,0.001f);
    const float hpFraction=std::isfinite(maxHp)&&maxHp>0 ? (std::clamp)(hp/maxHp,0.0f,1.0f) : 1.0f;
    return (a*(std::clamp)(angle/(std::max)(commonFov,0.001f),0.0f,1.0f)+
            d*(std::clamp)(distance/(std::max)(commonDistance,0.001f),0.0f,1.0f)+h*hpFraction)/sum;
}
// Stable IDs settle equal scores independently of entity traversal order.
inline bool Better(bool preferred,float score,uint64_t key,bool bestPreferred,float bestScore,uint64_t bestKey) {
    if(!std::isfinite(score)) return false;
    return preferred!=bestPreferred ? preferred : score<bestScore || (score==bestScore && key<bestKey);
}
inline void NormalizeMotion(Motion& m) {
    const Motion d;
    AimResponseCurve::Normalize(m.responseCurve);
    m.method=(std::clamp)(m.method,0,kMotionMethodCount-1);
    m.angularSpeedScale=Finite(m.angularSpeedScale,100,0,200);
    m.pidP=Finite(m.pidP,d.pidP,0,10); m.pidI=Finite(m.pidI,d.pidI,0,10);
    m.pidD=Finite(m.pidD,d.pidD,0,10); m.pidMaxIntegral=Finite(m.pidMaxIntegral,10,0,1000);
    m.pidDeadzone=Finite(m.pidDeadzone,1,0,100);
    m.bezierControlPoints=(std::clamp)(m.bezierControlPoints,2,6);
    m.bezierCurvature=Finite(m.bezierCurvature,0.5f,0,1); m.bezierSpeed=Finite(m.bezierSpeed,50,0,200);
    m.piecewiseNearDegrees=Finite(m.piecewiseNearDegrees,2,0,180);
    m.piecewiseMidDegrees=Finite(m.piecewiseMidDegrees,6,m.piecewiseNearDegrees,180);
    m.piecewiseFarDegrees=Finite(m.piecewiseFarDegrees,12,m.piecewiseMidDegrees,180);
    m.piecewiseNearScale=Finite(m.piecewiseNearScale,.2f,0,1);
    m.piecewiseMidScale=Finite(m.piecewiseMidScale,.45f,0,1);
    m.piecewiseFarScale=Finite(m.piecewiseFarScale,.75f,0,1);
    m.accelLimitedAcceleration=Finite(m.accelLimitedAcceleration,.1f,0,20);
    m.constantAngularSpeedDeg=Finite(m.constantAngularSpeedDeg,30,0,7200);
    m.hybridConstantSpeedDeg=Finite(m.hybridConstantSpeedDeg,45,0,7200);
    m.hybridMaxSpeedDeg=Finite(m.hybridMaxSpeedDeg,720,0,7200);
    m.hybridAccelerationDeg=Finite(m.hybridAccelerationDeg,1800,0,100000);
    m.hybridDecelerationDeg=Finite(m.hybridDecelerationDeg,2600,0,100000);
    m.hybridNearRadiusDeg=Finite(m.hybridNearRadiusDeg,3,.001f,180);
    m.hybridTargetMotionGain=Finite(m.hybridTargetMotionGain,.35f,0,10);
    m.hybridSuddenMotionBoost=Finite(m.hybridSuddenMotionBoost,2.5f,0,10);
    m.hybridDeadzoneDeg=Finite(m.hybridDeadzoneDeg,.1f,0,180);
    // Core normalizes every parameter before use. Persist the same finite ranges.
    auto sane=[](double& v,double def,double lo,double hi) { v=(std::clamp)(std::isfinite(v)?v:def,lo,hi); };
    auto& s=m.shuwu; const koi::ShuwuConfig q;
    sane(s.kp,q.kp,0,2); sane(s.kd,q.kd,0,1);
    sane(s.predict_x,q.predict_x,-2,3); sane(s.predict_y,q.predict_y,-2,3);
    sane(s.rate,q.rate,.01,1); sane(s.smooth,q.smooth,0,1);
    sane(s.deadzone,q.deadzone,0,10); sane(s.reset_jump,q.reset_jump,5,160);
    sane(s.integral_threshold,q.integral_threshold,1,320); sane(s.integral_rate,q.integral_rate,.001,1);
    sane(s.kp_threshold,q.kp_threshold,1,10000); sane(s.gain_decay,q.gain_decay,.001,1);
    sane(s.velocity_q,q.velocity_q,.0001,10); sane(s.velocity_r,q.velocity_r,.0001,10);
    sane(s.integral_q,q.integral_q,.0001,10); sane(s.integral_r,q.integral_r,.0001,10);
    sane(s.micro_error,q.micro_error,0,10); sane(s.micro_diff,q.micro_diff,0,5);
    sane(s.ki_deadband,q.ki_deadband,0,10); sane(s.soft_a,q.soft_a,0,2); sane(s.soft_b,q.soft_b,0,2);
    sane(s.ki_scale,q.ki_scale,10,100000); sane(s.max_move_per_frame,q.max_move_per_frame,1,100);
    sane(s.suppression_x,q.suppression_x,0,3); sane(s.suppression_y,q.suppression_y,0,3);
    sane(s.soft_lock_x,q.soft_lock_x,0,3); sane(s.soft_lock_y,q.soft_lock_y,0,3);
    sane(s.soft_lock_delay_ms,q.soft_lock_delay_ms,0,5000);
    // Soft lock has no separate activation binding in UN. Do not invent one.
    s.soft_lock_enabled=false;
}
inline void NormalizeIds(std::vector<uint64_t>& ids) {
    if(ids.size()>kMaxHeroes) ids.resize(kMaxHeroes);
    ids.erase(std::remove(ids.begin(),ids.end(),0),ids.end());
    std::sort(ids.begin(),ids.end()); ids.erase(std::unique(ids.begin(),ids.end()),ids.end());
}
inline void Normalize(Plan& p) {
    auto& s=p.selection; s.mode=(std::clamp)(s.mode,0,2); s.predicate=(std::clamp)(s.predicate,0,2);
    NormalizeIds(s.heroes); s.angleWeight=Finite(s.angleWeight,1,0,100);
    s.distanceWeight=Finite(s.distanceWeight,0,0,100); s.healthWeight=Finite(s.healthWeight,0,0,100);
    s.minHealth=Finite(s.minHealth,0,0,100000); s.maxHealth=Finite(s.maxHealth,0,0,100000);
    if(s.maxHealth>0) s.maxHealth=(std::max)(s.minHealth,s.maxHealth);
    NormalizeMotion(p.motion);
    if(p.groups.size()>kMaxGroups) p.groups.resize(kMaxGroups);
    std::vector<uint64_t> seen, ids;
    for(auto& g:p.groups) {
        if(!g.id || Contains(ids,g.id)) { g.id=1; while(Contains(ids,g.id)) ++g.id; }
        ids.push_back(g.id);
        if(g.name.empty()) g.name="Hero exception";
        if(g.name.size()>96) g.name.resize(96);
        NormalizeIds(g.heroes);
        // First persisted group wins; later duplicates fall back to inheritance.
        std::erase_if(g.heroes,[&](uint64_t id) { return Contains(seen,id); });
        seen.insert(seen.end(),g.heroes.begin(),g.heroes.end());
        auto& l=g.limits;
        l.minDistance=Finite(l.minDistance,0,0,500); l.maxDistance=Finite(l.maxDistance,100,0,500);
        if(l.maxDistance>0) l.maxDistance=(std::max)(l.minDistance,l.maxDistance);
        l.fov=Finite(l.fov,15,0,180); l.minHealth=Finite(l.minHealth,0,0,100000);
        l.maxHealth=Finite(l.maxHealth,0,0,100000);
        if(l.maxHealth>0) l.maxHealth=(std::max)(l.minHealth,l.maxHealth);
        g.point.boneMask &= 0x3ff; if(!g.point.boneMask) g.point.boneMask=1;
        g.point.predictionMode=(std::clamp)(g.point.predictionMode,0,2);
        NormalizeMotion(g.motion);
    }
}
} // namespace OW::AimPlan
```

```hpp
    }

};
inline bool ChargeReady(float percent,float minimum,std::uint32_t elapsed,float fallbackMs) {
    if(std::isfinite(percent)&&percent>=0&&percent<=100) return percent>=minimum;
    return std::isfinite(fallbackMs)&&fallbackMs>=0&&elapsed>=fallbackMs;
}
```

`include/Game/AimResponseCurve.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include "Game/AimSmoothingTiming.hpp"

namespace OW::AimResponseCurve {
struct Points {
    float x1 = .333f, y1 = .333f, x2 = .667f, y2 = .667f;
    bool operator==(const Points&) const = default;
};
inline Points Preset(int index) {
    if (index == 1) return {.42f, 0.f, .58f, 1.f};
    if (index == 2) return {.10f, .85f, .40f, 1.f};
    return {};
}
inline void Normalize(Points& p) {
    const Points d;
    auto sane=[](float v,float fallback) { return std::isfinite(v) ? (std::clamp)(v,0.f,1.f) : fallback; };
    p={sane(p.x1,d.x1),sane(p.y1,d.y1),sane(p.x2,d.x2),sane(p.y2,d.y2)};
}
inline float Cubic(float t,float a,float b) {
    const float u=1-t;
    return 3*u*u*t*a+3*u*t*t*b+t*t*t;
}
// The graph and controller both query y at x; t is not the horizontal input.
inline float Evaluate(Points p,float x) {
    Normalize(p);
    if (!std::isfinite(x) || x<=0) return 0;
    if (x>=1) return 1;
    float t=x;
    for(int i=0;i<8;++i) {
        const float residual=Cubic(t,p.x1,p.x2)-x;
        if(std::abs(residual)<1e-6f) return Cubic(t,p.y1,p.y2);
        const float u=1-t;
        const float derivative=3*u*u*p.x1+6*u*t*(p.x2-p.x1)+3*t*t*(1-p.x2);
        if(std::abs(derivative)<1e-6f) break;
        const float next=t-residual/derivative;
        if(next<0||next>1) break;
        t=next;
    }
    float lo=0,hi=1;
    for(int i=0;i<24;++i) {
        t=(lo+hi)*.5f;
        if(Cubic(t,p.x1,p.x2)<x) lo=t; else hi=t;
    }
    return (std::clamp)(Cubic(t,p.y1,p.y2),0.f,1.f);
}
inline float StepFactor(float error,float fov,float strength,float dt,const Points& p) {
    if(!std::isfinite(error)||!std::isfinite(fov)||!std::isfinite(strength)||
       error<=1e-7f||fov<=1e-7f||strength<=0) return 0;
    const float r=error/fov;
    const float factor=(std::clamp)(strength*Evaluate(p,(std::min)(r,1.f))/r,0.f,1.f);
    return AimSmoothingTiming::NormalizePerTickFactor(factor,dt);
}
}
```

`include/Game/AimShuwu.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/ShuwuCore.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::AimShuwu {
// Engineering units: 16 virtual error units per degree, never device counts or
// viewport pixels. Output stays angular; the existing output layer owns counts.
inline constexpr double kUnitsPerRadian = 16.0 * 180.0 / 3.14159265358979323846;
inline constexpr double kReferenceSeconds = 1.0 / 240.0;
struct State {
    koi::ShuwuState core{};
    uint64_t lastSample = 0;
    double lastStepRatio = 1;
    bool awaitingCommand = false;
};
struct Move { double pitch = 0, yaw = 0; };
inline Move Advance(State& state, double pitchError, double yawError, double dt,
                    double speed, uint64_t sample, koi::ShuwuConfig config) {
    if (!std::isfinite(pitchError) || !std::isfinite(yawError) ||
        !std::isfinite(dt) || dt <= 0 || !std::isfinite(speed)) {
        state = {}; return {};
    }
    state.awaitingCommand = false;
    if (sample && state.lastSample && sample == state.lastSample) return {};
    if (sample && state.lastSample) {
        if (sample < state.lastSample) state = {};
        else dt = double(sample - state.lastSample) / 1e6;
    }
    if (dt > .1) { state = {}; dt = kReferenceSeconds; }
    state.lastSample = sample;
    dt = (std::clamp)(dt, kReferenceSeconds * .25, kReferenceSeconds * 4);
    state.lastStepRatio = dt / kReferenceSeconds;
    yawError = std::remainder(yawError, 6.2831853071795864769);
    config.soft_lock_enabled = false; // no invented key binding
    koi::ShuwuInput input;
    input.error_x = yawError * kUnitsPerRadian;
    input.error_y = pitchError * kUnitsPerRadian;
    input.delta_ms = dt * 1000;
    input.speed_x = input.speed_y = .1 * (std::clamp)(speed, 0.0, 2.0);
    const auto raw = koi::calculateShuwuMove(state.core, input, config);
    const double limit = (std::clamp)(std::isfinite(config.max_move_per_frame)
        ? config.max_move_per_frame : 30.0, 1.0, 100.0);
    auto bounded = [&](double value, double error) {
        const double step = (std::clamp)(value, -limit, limit) * state.lastStepRatio / kUnitsPerRadian;
        return error >= 0 ? (std::clamp)(step, 0.0, error) : (std::clamp)(step, error, 0.0);
    };
    // Only accepted commands restore history, after all common scaling/limits.
    state.core.x.last_u = state.core.y.last_u = 0;
    state.awaitingCommand = true;
    return { bounded(raw.y, pitchError), bounded(raw.x, yawError) };
}
inline void CommitCommand(State& state, double pitch, double yaw) {
    if (!state.awaitingCommand) return;
    state.awaitingCommand = false;
    const double scale = kUnitsPerRadian / state.lastStepRatio;
    state.core.x.last_u = std::isfinite(yaw) ? yaw * scale : 0;
    state.core.y.last_u = std::isfinite(pitch) ? pitch * scale : 0;
}
} // namespace OW::AimShuwu
```

`include/Game/AimSmoothingTiming.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace OW::AimSmoothingTiming {

inline constexpr float kReferenceDeltaTimeSeconds = 1.0f / 144.0f;

inline float NormalizePerTickFactor(float factor,
                                    float deltaTimeSeconds,
                                    float referenceDeltaTimeSeconds = kReferenceDeltaTimeSeconds) noexcept
{
    const float clampedFactor = std::isfinite(factor)
        ? std::clamp(factor, 0.0f, 1.0f)
        : 0.0f;
    if (clampedFactor <= 0.0f || clampedFactor >= 1.0f)
        return clampedFactor;

    const float referenceDelta =
        std::isfinite(referenceDeltaTimeSeconds) && referenceDeltaTimeSeconds > 0.0f
            ? referenceDeltaTimeSeconds
            : kReferenceDeltaTimeSeconds;
    const float delta = std::isfinite(deltaTimeSeconds) && deltaTimeSeconds > 0.0f
        ? deltaTimeSeconds
        : referenceDelta;
    const float referenceSteps = delta / referenceDelta;
    return std::clamp(
        1.0f - std::pow(1.0f - clampedFactor, referenceSteps),
        0.0f,
        1.0f);
}

} // namespace OW::AimSmoothingTiming
```

`include/Game/AimStartLimiter.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW {

inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterDefaultInitialCapDegPerSec = 60.0f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterDefaultCapRiseDegPerSec2 = 1200.0f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterMaxCapDegPerSec = 3600.0f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterMaxCapRiseDegPerSec2 = 100000.0f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterDefaultDeltaTimeSeconds = 1.0f / 144.0f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterMinDeltaTimeSeconds = 0.001f;
inline constexpr float kAimStartLimiterMaxDeltaTimeSeconds = 0.050f;

struct AimStartLimiterProfile {
    bool enabled = false;
    float initialCapDegPerSec = kAimStartLimiterDefaultInitialCapDegPerSec;
    float capRiseDegPerSec2 = kAimStartLimiterDefaultCapRiseDegPerSec2;
    bool restartOnTargetChange = true;
    bool operator==(const AimStartLimiterProfile&) const = default;
};

struct AimStartLimiterState {
    bool started = false;
    std::uint64_t sessionGeneration = 0;
    std::uint64_t connectionEpoch = 0;
    std::uint64_t targetKey = 0;
    float currentCapDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastLoopAt{};
};

enum class AimStartLimiterResetReason : std::uint8_t {
    None = 0,
    SessionStarted,
    SessionChanged,
    ConnectionChanged,
    TargetChanged,
    Disabled,
};

struct AimStartLimiterResult {
    Vector3 outputAngle{};
    float requestedSpeedDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    float appliedSpeedDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    float capDegPerSec = 0.0f;
    bool limited = false;
    AimStartLimiterResetReason resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::None;
};

inline AimStartLimiterProfile ValidateAimStartLimiterProfile(
    AimStartLimiterProfile profile)
{
    profile.initialCapDegPerSec = std::isfinite(profile.initialCapDegPerSec)
        ? std::clamp(profile.initialCapDegPerSec, 0.0f, kAimStartLimiterMaxCapDegPerSec)
        : kAimStartLimiterDefaultInitialCapDegPerSec;
    profile.capRiseDegPerSec2 = std::isfinite(profile.capRiseDegPerSec2)
        ? std::clamp(profile.capRiseDegPerSec2, 0.0f, kAimStartLimiterMaxCapRiseDegPerSec2)
        : kAimStartLimiterDefaultCapRiseDegPerSec2;
    return profile;
}

inline float ClampAimStartLimiterDeltaTime(float deltaTimeSeconds)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(deltaTimeSeconds) || deltaTimeSeconds <= 0.0f)
        return kAimStartLimiterDefaultDeltaTimeSeconds;
    return std::clamp(
        deltaTimeSeconds,
        kAimStartLimiterMinDeltaTimeSeconds,
        kAimStartLimiterMaxDeltaTimeSeconds);
}

inline void ResetAimStartLimiter(AimStartLimiterState& state)
{
    state = AimStartLimiterState{};
}

inline float ObserveAimStartLimiterLoop(
    AimStartLimiterState& state,
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now())
{
    float deltaTimeSeconds = kAimStartLimiterDefaultDeltaTimeSeconds;
    if (state.lastLoopAt.time_since_epoch().count() != 0 && now > state.lastLoopAt) {
        deltaTimeSeconds = std::chrono::duration<float>(now - state.lastLoopAt).count();
    }
    state.lastLoopAt = now;
    return ClampAimStartLimiterDeltaTime(deltaTimeSeconds);
}

inline const char* AimStartLimiterResetReasonName(AimStartLimiterResetReason reason)
{
    switch (reason) {
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::SessionStarted: return "session_started";
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::SessionChanged: return "session_changed";
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::ConnectionChanged: return "connection_changed";
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::TargetChanged: return "target_changed";
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::Disabled: return "disabled";
    case AimStartLimiterResetReason::None:
    default:
        return "none";
    }
}

inline AimStartLimiterResult ApplyAimStartLimiter(
    const AimStartLimiterProfile& rawProfile,
    AimStartLimiterState& state,
    std::uint64_t sessionGeneration,
    std::uint64_t connectionEpoch,
    std::uint64_t targetKey,
    const Vector3& currentAngle,
    const Vector3& requestedAngle,
    float deltaTimeSeconds)
{
    const AimStartLimiterProfile profile = ValidateAimStartLimiterProfile(rawProfile);
    AimStartLimiterResult result{};
    result.outputAngle = requestedAngle;
    result.capDegPerSec = profile.initialCapDegPerSec;

    const bool finiteAngles =
        std::isfinite(currentAngle.X) && std::isfinite(currentAngle.Y) &&
        std::isfinite(requestedAngle.X) && std::isfinite(requestedAngle.Y);
    const float deltaTime = ClampAimStartLimiterDeltaTime(deltaTimeSeconds);
    const float pitchDelta = finiteAngles ? requestedAngle.X - currentAngle.X : 0.0f;
    const float yawDelta = finiteAngles ? requestedAngle.Y - currentAngle.Y : 0.0f;
    const float requestedRadians = finiteAngles
        ? std::sqrt(pitchDelta * pitchDelta + yawDelta * yawDelta)
        : 0.0f;

    if (!profile.enabled) {
        const bool wasStarted = state.started;
        ResetAimStartLimiter(state);
        if (wasStarted)
            result.resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::Disabled;
        if (std::isfinite(requestedRadians) && requestedRadians > 0.000001f) {
            result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec = RAD2DEG(requestedRadians) / deltaTime;
            result.appliedSpeedDegPerSec = result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec;
        }
        return result;
    }

    if (!finiteAngles)
        return result;

    if (!std::isfinite(requestedRadians) || requestedRadians <= 0.000001f)
        return result;

    AimStartLimiterResetReason resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::None;
    if (!state.started) {
        resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::SessionStarted;
    } else if (state.sessionGeneration != sessionGeneration) {
        resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::SessionChanged;
    } else if (state.connectionEpoch != connectionEpoch) {
        resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::ConnectionChanged;
    } else if (profile.restartOnTargetChange &&
               targetKey != 0 && state.targetKey != 0 &&
               state.targetKey != targetKey) {
        resetReason = AimStartLimiterResetReason::TargetChanged;
    }

    if (resetReason != AimStartLimiterResetReason::None) {
        state.started = true;
        state.currentCapDegPerSec = profile.initialCapDegPerSec;
    }
    state.sessionGeneration = sessionGeneration;
    state.connectionEpoch = connectionEpoch;
    if (targetKey != 0)
        state.targetKey = targetKey;

    state.currentCapDegPerSec = std::isfinite(state.currentCapDegPerSec)
        ? std::clamp(state.currentCapDegPerSec, 0.0f, kAimStartLimiterMaxCapDegPerSec)
        : profile.initialCapDegPerSec;
    result.capDegPerSec = state.currentCapDegPerSec;
    result.resetReason = resetReason;

    result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec = RAD2DEG(requestedRadians) / deltaTime;
    float scale = 1.0f;
    if (result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec > result.capDegPerSec) {
        scale = result.capDegPerSec > 0.0f
            ? result.capDegPerSec / result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec
            : 0.0f;
        result.limited = true;
    }
    result.outputAngle = Vector3(
        currentAngle.X + pitchDelta * scale,
        currentAngle.Y + yawDelta * scale,
        requestedAngle.Z);
    result.appliedSpeedDegPerSec = result.requestedSpeedDegPerSec * scale;

    state.currentCapDegPerSec = std::clamp(
        state.currentCapDegPerSec + profile.capRiseDegPerSec2 * deltaTime,
        0.0f,
        kAimStartLimiterMaxCapDegPerSec);
    return result;
}

} // namespace OW
```

`include/Game/AsheCombo.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::AsheCombo {

// KOI's recovered five-shot control flow, adapted to an immediately armed UN
// session and hold-to-scope output. Device click time is deliberately outside
// the 210/50/240 ms waits: Complete() receives the actual action completion.
inline constexpr int kScopeWaitMs = 210;
inline constexpr int kRecoveryWaitMs = 50;
inline constexpr int kFollowupWaitMs = 240;
inline constexpr int kLoopWaitMs = 1;
inline constexpr int kClickHoldMs = 12; // Current KOI V3 adapter pulse, not DLL evidence.
inline constexpr int kPostShotPitchPauseMs = 35;

enum class Stage : std::uint8_t {
    Idle, Hip, ScopeEnter, ScopedShot, ScopeExit, Followup, Wait
};
enum class Action : std::uint8_t { None, Click, ScopeDown, ScopeUp };
struct Decision {
    Action action = Action::None;
    Stage stage = Stage::Idle;
    int shot = 0;
    std::int64_t deadlineUs = 0;
    bool finished = false;
};

enum class ShotPermit : std::uint8_t { WaitForAmmo, Allow, ReserveReached };

struct AmmoGate {
    std::uint64_t submittedSequence = 0;
    std::uint64_t submittedEpoch = 0;

    ShotPermit Check(bool enabled, bool known, int remaining, int reserve,
                     std::uint64_t sequence, std::uint64_t epoch) const {
        if (!enabled) return ShotPermit::Allow;
        if (!known || remaining < 0 || remaining > 12 || !sequence || !epoch)
            return ShotPermit::WaitForAmmo;
        if (remaining <= reserve) return ShotPermit::ReserveReached;
        if (epoch == submittedEpoch && sequence <= submittedSequence)
            return ShotPermit::WaitForAmmo;
        return ShotPermit::Allow;
    }

    void Submitted(std::uint64_t sequence, std::uint64_t epoch) {
        // A click is not ammunition consumption. Keep only the image identity
        // so the next shot must consult new HUD evidence, including a same-value
        // observation when the game did not accept the previous click.
        submittedSequence = sequence;
        submittedEpoch = epoch;
    }
};

class Runner {
public:
    void Start() { *this = Runner{}; step_ = Step::Hip; stage_ = Stage::Hip; }
    void Cancel() { *this = Runner{}; }
    Stage stage() const { return stage_; }
    int shot() const { return shot_; }
    std::int64_t deadlineUs() const { return deadline_; }

    Decision Advance(std::int64_t nowUs, bool activationHeld) {
        if (pending_ != Action::None) return {Action::None, stage_, shot_, deadline_, false};
        for (;;) {
            switch (step_) {
            case Step::Idle: return {Action::None, Stage::Idle, 0, 0, true};
            case Step::Hip: return Offer(Action::Click, Stage::Hip, 1);
            case Step::EnterScope: return Offer(Action::ScopeDown, Stage::ScopeEnter, 2);
            case Step::ScopedShot: return Offer(Action::Click, Stage::ScopedShot, 2);
            case Step::ExitScope: return Offer(Action::ScopeUp, Stage::ScopeExit, 2);
            case Step::BeforeFollowup:
                // These are KOI's explicit key checkpoints. A release during a
                // committed wait does not retract its click; re-pressing before
                // this checkpoint therefore continues the same sequence.
                if (!activationHeld) { Cancel(); continue; }
                Wait(nowUs, kFollowupWaitMs, Step::FollowupShot);
                break;
            case Step::FollowupShot: return Offer(Action::Click, Stage::Followup, shot_);
            case Step::CycleTail:
                if (!activationHeld) { Cancel(); continue; }
                Wait(nowUs, kLoopWaitMs, Step::LoopTop);
                break;
            case Step::LoopTop:
                if (!activationHeld) { Cancel(); continue; }
                step_ = Step::Hip;
                break;
            case Step::Waiting:
                if (nowUs < deadline_) return {Action::None, stage_, shot_, deadline_, false};
                step_ = afterWait_;
                deadline_ = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    // Call only after the complete action succeeded. A Click is one complete
    // down/up pair; its completion is a submitted-shot proxy, not a claim that
    // the game accepted or hit the shot. Tracking consumes this submission;
    // ammunition remains owned by separately observed HUD evidence.
    void Complete(std::int64_t nowUs) {
        if (pending_ == Action::None) return;
        pending_ = Action::None;
        switch (step_) {
        case Step::Hip: step_ = Step::EnterScope; break;
        case Step::EnterScope: Wait(nowUs, kScopeWaitMs, Step::ScopedShot, Stage::ScopeEnter); break;
        case Step::ScopedShot: Wait(nowUs, kRecoveryWaitMs, Step::ExitScope, Stage::ScopedShot); break;
        case Step::ExitScope: shot_ = 3; step_ = Step::BeforeFollowup; break;
        case Step::FollowupShot:
            if (shot_ < 5) { ++shot_; step_ = Step::BeforeFollowup; }
            else Wait(nowUs, kRecoveryWaitMs, Step::CycleTail);
            break;
        default: break;
        }
    }

private:
    enum class Step : std::uint8_t {
        Idle, Hip, EnterScope, ScopedShot, ExitScope, BeforeFollowup,
        FollowupShot, CycleTail, LoopTop, Waiting
    };
    Decision Offer(Action action, Stage stage, int shot) {
        pending_ = action; stage_ = stage; shot_ = shot;
        return {action, stage_, shot_, 0, false};
    }
    void Wait(std::int64_t nowUs, int durationMs, Step next, Stage stage = Stage::Wait) {
        deadline_ = nowUs + static_cast<std::int64_t>(durationMs) * 1000; afterWait_ = next;
        step_ = Step::Waiting; stage_ = stage;
    }
    Step step_ = Step::Idle, afterWait_ = Step::Idle;
    Action pending_ = Action::None;
    Stage stage_ = Stage::Idle;
    int shot_ = 0;
    std::int64_t deadline_ = 0;
};

} // namespace OW::AsheCombo
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "Game/FovGeometry.hpp"
#include "Game/SkillConditions.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"

namespace OW::AutoMelee {

inline bool HealthEligible(float current, float maximum, const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(current) || current <= 0.0f)
        return false;
    switch (settings.meleeHealthMode) {
    case Config::kMeleeAnyHealth:
        return true;
    case Config::kMeleeHealthPercent:
        return SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(current, maximum, settings.meleeHealthPercent, false);
    case Config::kMeleeHealthAbsolute:
        return SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(current, maximum, settings.enemyHealthThreshold, true);
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

// Test the view ray directly so crossing the yaw seam cannot reject a hit.
inline bool InWindow(const FovGeometry::RuntimeContext& view,
                     const Vector3& point, float radius, float maxDistance)
{
    if (!view.valid || !FovGeometry::IsFiniteVector(view.camera) ||
        !FovGeometry::IsFiniteVector(point) || !std::isfinite(radius) ||
        !std::isfinite(maxDistance) || radius <= 0.0f || maxDistance <= 0.0f)
        return false;
    const Vector3 forward = FovGeometry::NormalizeVector(view.forward);
    const Vector3 offset = point - view.camera;
    const float distance = offset.Size();
    const float along = offset | forward;
    if (forward == Vector3{} || !std::isfinite(distance) ||
        distance <= 0.0001f || distance > maxDistance || along <= 0.0f)
        return false;
    const Vector3 perpendicular = offset - forward * along;
    return perpendicular.Size() <= radius;
}

} // namespace OW::AutoMelee
```

`include/Game/BallisticSolver.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW {
namespace BallisticDetail {

using Polynomial = std::array<double, 5>;

inline double Evaluate(const Polynomial& coefficients, int degree, double time)
{
    double value = coefficients[degree];
    while (degree > 0)
        value = value * time + coefficients[--degree];
    return value;
}

// Derivative roots partition the polynomial into monotone intervals, including tangent roots.
inline int RootsInInterval(const Polynomial& coefficients, int degree, double lower, double upper,
                           std::array<double, 4>& roots)
{
    if (degree == 1) {
        const double root = -coefficients[0] / coefficients[1];
        if (std::isfinite(root) && root >= lower && root <= upper) {
            roots[0] = root;
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    Polynomial derivative{};
    for (int i = 1; i <= degree; ++i)
        derivative[i - 1] = i * coefficients[i];
    std::array<double, 4> extrema{};
    const int count = RootsInInterval(derivative, degree - 1, lower, upper, extrema);
    int found = 0;
    const auto add = [&](double root) {
        if (found < degree && (found == 0 || root - roots[found - 1] > 1e-9 * (1.0 + root)))
            roots[found++] = root;
    };
    const auto isZero = [&](double time, double value) {
        double scale = std::abs(coefficients[degree]);
        for (int i = degree - 1; i >= 0; --i)
            scale = scale * time + std::abs(coefficients[i]);
        return std::abs(value) <= 1e-12 * (std::max)(1.0, scale);
    };
    double left = lower;
    double leftValue = Evaluate(coefficients, degree, left);
    if (isZero(left, leftValue))
        add(left);
    for (int i = 0; i <= count; ++i) {
        const double right = i < count ? extrema[i] : upper;
        const double rightValue = Evaluate(coefficients, degree, right);
        if (!isZero(left, leftValue) && !isZero(right, rightValue) &&
            std::signbit(leftValue) != std::signbit(rightValue)) {
            double lo = left, hi = right;
            for (int step = 0; step < 64; ++step) {
                const double middle = (lo + hi) * 0.5;
                if (std::signbit(Evaluate(coefficients, degree, middle)) == std::signbit(leftValue))
                    lo = middle;
                else
                    hi = middle;
            }
            add((lo + hi) * 0.5);
        }
        if (isZero(right, rightValue))
            add(right);
        left = right;
        leftValue = rightValue;
    }
    return found;
}

} // namespace BallisticDetail

struct BallisticIntercept {
    Vector3 aimPoint{};
    float flightSeconds = 0.0f;
    bool solved = false;
};

inline BallisticIntercept SolveBallisticIntercept(const Vector3& camera, const Vector3& target,
                                                 const Vector3& velocity, float speed, float gravity)
{
    BallisticIntercept result{ target };
    const auto finite = [](const Vector3& v) {
        return std::isfinite(v.X) && std::isfinite(v.Y) && std::isfinite(v.Z);
    };
    if (!finite(camera) || !finite(target) || !finite(velocity) ||
        !std::isfinite(speed) || speed <= 0.0f || !std::isfinite(gravity) || gravity < 0.0f)
        return result;
    const double x = double(target.X) - camera.X, y = double(target.Y) - camera.Y, z = double(target.Z) - camera.Z;
    const double vx = velocity.X, vy = velocity.Y, vz = velocity.Z, s = speed, g = gravity;
    const double distance2 = x*x + y*y + z*z, velocity2 = vx*vx + vy*vy + vz*vz;
    if (distance2 <= 1e-12)
        return result;
    const double a = velocity2 - s*s, b = 2.0 * (x*vx + y*vy + z*vz);
    double time = (std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity)();
    const auto accept = [&](double root) {
        if (std::isfinite(root) && root > 0.0)
            time = (std::min)(time, root);
    };
    if (g == 0.0) {
        if (std::abs(a) <= 1e-12 * (std::max)(1.0, velocity2 + s*s)) {
            if (b != 0.0)
                accept(-distance2 / b);
        } else {
            const double discriminant = b*b - 4.0*a*distance2;
            if (discriminant >= 0.0) {
                const double q = -0.5 * (b + std::copysign(std::sqrt(discriminant), b));
                accept(q / a);
                if (q != 0.0)
                    accept(distance2 / q);
            }
        }
    } else {
        const BallisticDetail::Polynomial coefficients{ distance2, b, a + g*y, g*vy, 0.25*g*g };
        const double speedBound = s + std::sqrt(velocity2);
        const double upper = (speedBound + std::sqrt(speedBound*speedBound + 2.0*g*std::sqrt(distance2))) / g;
        std::array<double, 4> roots{};
        const int count = BallisticDetail::RootsInInterval(coefficients, 4, 0.0, upper, roots);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
            accept(roots[i]);
    }
    if (!std::isfinite(time))
        return result;
    const Vector3 point(float(target.X + vx*time), float(target.Y + vy*time + 0.5*g*time*time),
                        float(target.Z + vz*time));
    const double requiredSpeed = (point - camera).Size() / time;
    if (!finite(point) || std::abs(requiredSpeed - s) > s * 0.0001)
        return result;
    result.aimPoint = point;
    result.flightSeconds = static_cast<float>(time);
    result.solved = true;
    return result;
}

} // namespace OW
```

`include/Game/CalibrationPolicy.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <atomic>

namespace OW {

inline thread_local bool calibrationOutputOwner = false;

inline bool CalibrationBlocksNormalOutput(bool inProgress) noexcept
{
    return inProgress && !calibrationOutputOwner;
}

// A batch owns the entire interval; its individual measurements borrow it.
class CalibrationRunGuard {
public:
    explicit CalibrationRunGuard(std::atomic<bool>& inProgress) : inProgress_(inProgress)
    {
        if (calibrationOutputOwner) {
            valid_ = true;
            return;
        }
        bool expected = false;
        acquired_ = inProgress_.compare_exchange_strong(expected, true, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        valid_ = acquired_;
        if (acquired_)
            calibrationOutputOwner = true;
    }
    CalibrationRunGuard(const CalibrationRunGuard&) = delete;
    CalibrationRunGuard& operator=(const CalibrationRunGuard&) = delete;
    ~CalibrationRunGuard()
    {
        if (acquired_) {
            calibrationOutputOwner = false;
            inProgress_.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        }
    }
    explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return valid_; }
    bool IsRoot() const noexcept { return acquired_; }
private:
    std::atomic<bool>& inProgress_;
    bool valid_ = false;
    bool acquired_ = false;
};

struct CalibrationMeasurement {
    float yaw = 0.0f;
    float pitch = 0.0f;
    float referenceSensitivity = 0.0f;
};

inline float CalibrationCountsPerRadian(int counts, float before, float after) noexcept
{
    if (counts <= 0 || !std::isfinite(before) || !std::isfinite(after))
        return 0.0f;
    constexpr float twoPi = 6.2831853071795864769f;
    const float delta = std::fabs(std::remainder(after - before, twoPi));
    if (!std::isfinite(delta) || delta <= 0.0001f)
        return 0.0f;
    const float ratio = static_cast<float>(counts) / delta;
    return std::isfinite(ratio) && ratio > 0.0f ? ratio : 0.0f;
}

inline bool CalibrationAxesReady(float yaw, float pitch, bool bothAxes) noexcept
{
    return std::isfinite(yaw) && yaw > 0.0f &&
        (!bothAxes || (std::isfinite(pitch) && pitch > 0.0f));
}

inline CalibrationMeasurement CalibrationMean(double yawTotal, double pitchTotal, int samples,
                                               float referenceSensitivity) noexcept
{
    if (samples <= 0 || !std::isfinite(referenceSensitivity) || referenceSensitivity <= 0.0f)
        return {};
    const float yaw = static_cast<float>(yawTotal / samples);
    const float pitch = static_cast<float>(pitchTotal / samples);
    return CalibrationAxesReady(yaw, pitch, true)
        ? CalibrationMeasurement{yaw, pitch, referenceSensitivity} : CalibrationMeasurement{};
}

} // namespace OW
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace OW {

    inline Matrix MultiplyMatrices(const Matrix& a, const Matrix& b)
    {
        Matrix result{};
        result.m11 = a.m11 * b.m11 + a.m12 * b.m21 + a.m13 * b.m31 + a.m14 * b.m41;
        result.m12 = a.m11 * b.m12 + a.m12 * b.m22 + a.m13 * b.m32 + a.m14 * b.m42;
        result.m13 = a.m11 * b.m13 + a.m12 * b.m23 + a.m13 * b.m33 + a.m14 * b.m43;
        result.m14 = a.m11 * b.m14 + a.m12 * b.m24 + a.m13 * b.m34 + a.m14 * b.m44;
        result.m21 = a.m21 * b.m11 + a.m22 * b.m21 + a.m23 * b.m31 + a.m24 * b.m41;
        result.m22 = a.m21 * b.m12 + a.m22 * b.m22 + a.m23 * b.m32 + a.m24 * b.m42;
        result.m23 = a.m21 * b.m13 + a.m22 * b.m23 + a.m23 * b.m33 + a.m24 * b.m43;
        result.m24 = a.m21 * b.m14 + a.m22 * b.m24 + a.m23 * b.m34 + a.m24 * b.m44;
        result.m31 = a.m31 * b.m11 + a.m32 * b.m21 + a.m33 * b.m31 + a.m34 * b.m41;
        result.m32 = a.m31 * b.m12 + a.m32 * b.m22 + a.m33 * b.m32 + a.m34 * b.m42;
        result.m33 = a.m31 * b.m13 + a.m32 * b.m23 + a.m33 * b.m33 + a.m34 * b.m43;
        result.m34 = a.m31 * b.m14 + a.m32 * b.m24 + a.m33 * b.m34 + a.m34 * b.m44;
        result.m41 = a.m41 * b.m11 + a.m42 * b.m21 + a.m43 * b.m31 + a.m44 * b.m41;
        result.m42 = a.m41 * b.m12 + a.m42 * b.m22 + a.m43 * b.m32 + a.m44 * b.m42;
        result.m43 = a.m41 * b.m13 + a.m42 * b.m23 + a.m43 * b.m33 + a.m44 * b.m43;
        result.m44 = a.m41 * b.m14 + a.m42 * b.m24 + a.m43 * b.m34 + a.m44 * b.m44;
        return result;
    }

    inline bool ProjectionMatrixNeedsCompositionM14Zero(const Matrix& projection)
    {
        return std::isfinite(projection.m11) && std::isfinite(projection.m22) &&
            std::isfinite(projection.m14) && std::isfinite(projection.m24) &&
            std::isfinite(projection.m34) && std::isfinite(projection.m43) &&
            std::isfinite(projection.m44) &&
            std::fabs(projection.m11) > 0.01f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m22) > 0.01f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m14) > 0.5f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m24) < 0.01f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m34 - 1.0f) < 0.05f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m43) > 0.001f &&
            std::fabs(projection.m44) < 0.01f;
    }

    inline Matrix NormalizeProjectionMatrixForComposition(const Matrix& projection)
    {
        Matrix normalized = projection;
        if (ProjectionMatrixNeedsCompositionM14Zero(normalized))
            normalized.m14 = 0.0f;
        return normalized;
    }

    inline Matrix ComposeCameraProjection(const Matrix& cameraView, const Matrix& projection)
    {
        return MultiplyMatrices(cameraView, NormalizeProjectionMatrixForComposition(projection));
    }

} // namespace OW
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <bit>
#include <cstdint>

// CN 155284N RVAs from 03_DOWNP/202611060630. The transforms also occur in 155284KB.
namespace OW::Cn155284 {
inline constexpr uint32_t timestamp = 0x6AEBE914, imageSize = 0x5A98000;
inline constexpr uint64_t keyByteA = 0x4A9D525, keyByteB = 0x4A9DA31;
inline constexpr uint64_t entityRoot = 0x4C71748, entityState = 0x4C71730;
inline constexpr uint64_t entityLock = 0x53BB920;
// 0x800 slots is the initial allocation, not a permanent scan bound.
inline constexpr uint64_t entityInitialBytes = 0x8000;
inline constexpr uint64_t viewRoot = 0x4C08E78, globalAdmin = 0x4DD70A0;
inline constexpr uint64_t mouseScaleX = 0x4AA456C, mouseScaleY = 0x4AA4584;
inline constexpr uint64_t pointerXor = 0xD9B0DF0D8532B5A0ULL;
inline constexpr uint64_t pointerAdd = 0x488A1F0DC13B6040ULL;

constexpr uint64_t Substitute(uint64_t value) {
    constexpr uint8_t lut[]{6,12,10,3,14,0,15,9,7,4,8,5,13,11,1,2};
    uint64_t result = 0;
    for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 64; bit += 4)
        result |= uint64_t(lut[(value >> bit) & 15]) << bit;
    return result;
}

// 155284N scalar starts at 0x547C96. The known-answer samples below are from 154905N.
constexpr uint64_t Component(uint64_t value, uint8_t a, uint8_t b) {
    value = std::rotr((value + 0x0D030666FEB038CEULL) ^ a, 40) ^ 0x357B5A44DBADDD24ULL;
    value = std::rotr(Substitute(value) + 0x33696B953606C040ULL, 26) ^ b ^ 0x2CEFECC4CAD54C5EULL;
    value = std::rotr(Substitute(value) - 0x3BCDDB630BBCF625ULL, 25);
    value = (value + 0x3DACABA536F3D07DULL) ^ 0xBCBEF01775642D15ULL;
    return std::rotr(value, 11) ^ 0x8EC103A196A8E59EULL;
}
constexpr uint64_t Pointer(uint64_t value) { return (value ^ pointerXor) + pointerAdd; }
constexpr uint64_t Parent(uint64_t value) {
    return std::rotr((value ^ 0x340A56FA93DA6F7BULL) - 0x1CF6B5C337C2DCC1ULL, 46);
}
// Native UID-map getter 0xF0F420: parent+0x28 and owner+0x18 are encoded.
// Evidence: 03_DOWNP/202611060630/context-map-audit-20261116/static/.
constexpr uint64_t MapOwner(uint64_t value) {
    return ((value - 0x3E03CA7FF8566774ULL) ^ 0x453CDFB9F6015D41ULL) +
           0x190984468FA46B64ULL;
}
constexpr uint64_t MapBuckets(uint64_t value) {
    return std::rotr(((value - 0x6ADD326E3B5F25A6ULL) ^ 0x0A2C96E5BFF01AE5ULL) -
                     0x1AB82793B73D81BFULL, 25);
}
constexpr uint64_t Singleton(uint64_t value) {
    return (std::rotr(std::rotr(value, 1) + 0xE4A74035D2D1853DULL, 36) ^
            0x9ACE05FA7D7CF0CBULL) + 0x57A241D065E55B43ULL;
}
constexpr uint64_t Visibility(uint64_t value) {
    return std::rotr((std::rotr(value, 58) ^ 0x848ABAEDB38F2271ULL) + 0x7ED149BB3953EA7BULL, 42);
}
constexpr bool HeroId(uint64_t value) {
    return (value & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF0000ULL) == 0x02E0000000000000ULL && (value & 0xFFFF) != 0;
}
```
