```hpp
        static bool IsFiniteBoneValue(const XMFLOAT3& value) {
            return std::isfinite(value.x) && std::isfinite(value.y) && std::isfinite(value.z);
        }

        static bool IsNonZeroBoneValue(const XMFLOAT3& value) {
            return value.x != 0.0f || value.y != 0.0f || value.z != 0.0f;
        }

        static bool IsFiniteVectorValue(const Vector3& value) {
            return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
        }

        static bool IsPlausibleSpatialAnchor(const Vector3& value) {
            return IsFiniteVectorValue(value) &&
                   std::fabs(value.X) < 5000.0f &&
                   std::fabs(value.Y) < 5000.0f &&
                   std::fabs(value.Z) < 5000.0f &&
                   value.DistTo(Vector3(0, 0, 0)) > 1.0f;
        }

        // A valid actor position is still useful when a partial skeleton read
        // misses one or more core bones. Keep real bone-derived anchors and
        // synthesize only the missing aliases used by ESP and target selection.
        bool FillMissingCoreAnchorsFromPosition() {
            if (!Alive || !IsPlausibleSpatialAnchor(pos))
                return false;

            bool filled = false;
            auto fillMissing = [&](Vector3& anchor, float height, size_t slot) {
                if (IsPlausibleSpatialAnchor(anchor)) {
                    if (core_anchor_source[slot] == SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::Unavailable)
                        core_anchor_source[slot] = SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::PositionEstimate;
                    return;
                }
                anchor = pos + Vector3(0.0f, height, 0.0f);
                core_anchor_source[slot] = SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::PositionEstimate;
                filled = true;
            };

            std::array<float, 3> heights{1.65f, 1.35f, 1.05f};
            // The established synthetic bot type owns its geometry in both
            // cold and hot samples; changing health must not change its anchors.
            if (offset::UsesProtectedEntityLayout() && !HeroBase) {
                if (HeroID == eHero::HERO_TRAININGBOT4)
                    heights = {1.45f, 1.10f, 0.75f};
                else if (HeroID == eHero::HERO_TRAININGBOT5)
                    heights = {2.00f, 1.55f, 1.05f};
            }
            fillMissing(head_pos, heights[0], 0);
            fillMissing(neck_pos, heights[1], 1);
            fillMissing(chest_pos, heights[2], 2);
            return filled;
        }

        int get_bone_id(uint64_t bonedata, int bone_id) {
            const bool debugHead = bone_id == OW::BONE_HEAD;
            if (debugHead) {
                debugHeadLookupAttempted = true;
                debugHeadLookupResolved = false;
                debugHeadIdFound = false;
                debugHeadLookupException = false;
                debugHeadBoneData = bonedata;
                debugHeadBonesBase = 0;
                debugHeadBonePtr = 0;
                debugHeadBoneIdTable = 0;
                debugHeadBoneCount = 0;
                debugHeadMappedIndex = -1;
                debugHeadLocalAddress = 0;
                debugHeadLocal = {};
                debugHeadWorld = {};
                debugHeadLocalFinite = false;
                debugHeadLocalNonZero = false;
                debugHeadWorldNonZero = false;
            }
            __try {
                uint64_t bonePtr = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(bonedata);
                if (debugHead)
                    debugHeadBonePtr = bonePtr;
                if (!bonePtr)
                    return -1;

                uint64_t boneIdTable = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(bonePtr + 0x38);
                if (debugHead)
                    debugHeadBoneIdTable = boneIdTable;
                if (!boneIdTable)
                    return -1;

                uint16_t count = SDK->RPM<uint16_t>(bonePtr + Skeleton::BoneCountOffset());
                if (debugHead)
                    debugHeadBoneCount = count;
                if (count == 0 || count > kMaxBoneIdCount)
                    return -1;

                if (debugHead)
                    debugHeadLookupResolved = true;

                std::array<uint32_t, kMaxBoneIdCount> boneIds{};
                if (!SDK->read_range(boneIdTable, boneIds.data(), sizeof(uint32_t) * count))
                    return -1;

                for (uint16_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                    if (static_cast<uint16_t>(boneIds[i]) == bone_id) {
                        if (debugHead) {
                            debugHeadIdFound = true;
                            debugHeadMappedIndex = static_cast<int>(i);
                        }
                        return i;
                    }
                }
            } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
                if (debugHead)
                    debugHeadLookupException = true;
            }
            return -1;
        }

        bool ResolveBoneDataCandidate(uint64_t pBoneData, BoneResolveInfo& info) {
            info = {};
            if (!pBoneData)
                return false;

            info.boneData = pBoneData;
            info.bonesBase = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(pBoneData + 0x20);
            if (!info.bonesBase)
                return false;

            info.bonePtr = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(pBoneData);
            if (!info.bonePtr)
                return false;

            info.boneIdTable = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(info.bonePtr + 0x38);
            if (!info.boneIdTable)
                return false;

            info.boneCount = SDK->RPM<uint16_t>(info.bonePtr + Skeleton::BoneCountOffset());
            return info.boneCount > 0 && info.boneCount <= kMaxBoneIdCount;
        }

        bool ResolveBoneDataCandidate(uint64_t pBoneData, uint64_t& bonesBase) {
            BoneResolveInfo info{};
            const bool resolved = ResolveBoneDataCandidate(pBoneData, info);
            bonesBase = info.bonesBase;
            return resolved;
        }

        BoneResolveInfo ResolveBoneDataInfo(uint64_t knownVelocityBoneData = 0) {
            BoneResolveInfo info{};
            if (this->VelocityBase) {
                const uint64_t pBoneData = knownVelocityBoneData
                    ? knownVelocityBoneData
                    : SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(this->VelocityBase + 0x8B0);
                if (ResolveBoneDataCandidate(pBoneData, info))
                    return info;
            }

            if (!this->BoneBase)
                return {};

            constexpr std::array<uint64_t, 3> entryOffsets = { 0x20, 0x0, 0x10 };
            for (const uint64_t entryOffset : entryOffsets) {
                const uint64_t pBoneData = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(this->BoneBase + entryOffset);
                if (!ResolveBoneDataCandidate(pBoneData, info))
                    continue;

                if (this->bone_fallback_logged_offset != entryOffset) {
                    Diagnostics::Info(
                        "[BONE] BoneBase fallback resolved entry=0x%llX bone_base=0x%llX bonedata=0x%llX bones_base=0x%llX.",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(entryOffset),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(this->BoneBase),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(info.boneData),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(info.bonesBase));
                    this->bone_fallback_logged_offset = entryOffset;
                }
                return info;
            }

            return {};
        }

        uint64_t ResolveBoneData(uint64_t& bonesBase) {
            const BoneResolveInfo info = ResolveBoneDataInfo();
            bonesBase = info.bonesBase;
            return info.boneData;
        }

        BoneDebugProbe ProbeBone(int boneId) {
            BoneDebugProbe probe{};
            probe.requestedBoneId = boneId;
            __try {
                probe.preconditions = this->pos != Vector3(0, 0, 0) && this->PlayerHealth > 0;
                if (!probe.preconditions)
                    return probe;

                probe.boneData = ResolveBoneData(probe.bonesBase);
                if (!probe.boneData || !probe.bonesBase)
                    return probe;

                probe.bonePtr = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(probe.boneData);
                if (!probe.bonePtr)
                    return probe;

                probe.boneIdTable = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(probe.bonePtr + 0x38);
                if (!probe.boneIdTable)
                    return probe;

                probe.boneCount = SDK->RPM<uint16_t>(probe.bonePtr + Skeleton::BoneCountOffset());
                if (probe.boneCount == 0 || probe.boneCount > kMaxBoneIdCount)
                    return probe;

                probe.resolved = true;
                std::array<uint32_t, kMaxBoneIdCount> boneIds{};
                if (!SDK->read_range(probe.boneIdTable, boneIds.data(), sizeof(uint32_t) * probe.boneCount))
                    return probe;

                for (uint16_t i = 0; i < probe.boneCount; ++i) {
                    if (static_cast<uint16_t>(boneIds[i]) == boneId) {
                        probe.idFound = true;
                        probe.mappedIndex = static_cast<int>(i);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!probe.idFound)
                    return probe;

                probe.localAddress = probe.bonesBase + (0x30 * static_cast<uint64_t>(probe.mappedIndex)) + 0x20;
                probe.local = SDK->RPM<XMFLOAT3>(probe.localAddress);
                probe.localFinite = IsFiniteBoneValue(probe.local);
                probe.localNonZero = probe.localFinite && IsNonZeroBoneValue(probe.local);
                if (!probe.localFinite)
                    return probe;

                if (!TransformBoneWorld(probe.local, probe.world)) return probe;
                probe.worldNonZero = IsFiniteVectorValue(probe.world) && probe.world != Vector3(0, 0, 0);
                return probe;
            } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
                probe.exception = true;
                return probe;
            }
        }

        // Consumers read the published snapshot. Raw address diagnostics use ProbeBone.
        Vector3 GetBonePos(int boneId) const {
            if (offset::IsCnProfile() && !HasCurrentModelWorldTransform()) return {};
            if (boneId == 83 && cached_bot_chest_bone_valid)
                return cached_bot_chest_bone;
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < skeleton_requested_ids.size(); ++slot) {
                if (skeleton_requested_ids[slot] == boneId && skeleton_bone_valid[slot])
                    return skeleton_bones[slot];
            }
            return {};
        }

        std::array<int, 18> GetSkel() const { return GetRenderSkel(); }
        std::array<int, 18> GetRenderSkel() const { return skeleton_requested_ids; }

        bool TrySkeletonPoint(size_t slot, Vector3& point) const {
            point = {};
            if (!(offset::IsCnProfile() ? HasCurrentModelWorldTransform() : rotation_valid) ||
                skeleton_form == SkeletonSemantics::Form::Unknown || !skeleton_revision ||
                slot >= skeleton_bones.size() || !skeleton_bone_valid[slot] ||
                skeleton_requested_ids[slot] < 0 || !IsFiniteVectorValue(skeleton_bones[slot]) ||
                skeleton_bones[slot] == Vector3{}) return false;
            point = skeleton_bones[slot];
            return true;
        }

        Skeleton::BodyIdentity SkeletonIdentity() const {
            return {address, LinkParent, HeroID, actor_generation, connection_epoch,
                scene_generation, body_absence_revision, VelocityBase, BoneBase, LinkBase,
                match_id, Alive && std::isfinite(PlayerHealth) && PlayerHealth > 0.f};
        }

        void ClearModelWorldTransform() {
            model_world = {};
            model_world_identity = {};
        }

        bool SetModelWorldTransform(uint64_t modelBase, const ModelWorld::QstRecord& record) {
            const ModelWorld::QstRecord captured = record;
            ClearModelWorldTransform();
            const auto identity = SkeletonIdentity();
            if (!offset::IsCnProfile() || !identity.alive || modelBase != VelocityBase ||
                !model_world.Set(modelBase, captured)) return false;
            model_world.sampleAnchor = pos;
            model_world_identity = identity;
            return true;
        }

        bool HasCurrentModelWorldTransform() const {
            return model_world.valid && model_world.modelBase == VelocityBase &&
                model_world_identity == SkeletonIdentity();
        }

        bool HasBoneWorldTransform() const {
            return offset::IsCnProfile() ? HasCurrentModelWorldTransform() :
                rotation_valid && IsPlausibleSpatialAnchor(pos) && IsFiniteVectorValue(Rot);
        }

        bool TransformBoneWorld(const XMFLOAT3& local, Vector3& point, bool legacyBallBias = true) const {
            point = {};
            if (!IsFiniteBoneValue(local) || !HasBoneWorldTransform()) return false;
            if (offset::IsCnProfile()) {
                point = model_world.TransformPoint({local.x, local.y, local.z}) + (pos - model_world.sampleAnchor);
            } else {
                XMFLOAT3 rotated{};
                XMStoreFloat3(&rotated, XMVector3Transform(XMLoadFloat3(&local), XMMatrixRotationY(Rot.X)));
                const float bias = legacyBallBias && HeroID == eHero::HERO_WRECKINGBALL ? -.7f : 0.f;
                point = Vector3(rotated.x, rotated.y + bias, rotated.z) + pos;
            }
            return IsFiniteVectorValue(point) && point != Vector3{};
        }

        static Skeleton::ReadSource ProductionSkeletonSource(Skeleton::ReadMetrics* metrics = nullptr) {
            return {nullptr, [](void*, uint64_t address, void* buffer, size_t size) {
                return mem.ReadFreshExact(address, buffer, size);
            }, metrics};
        }

        bool ReadSkeletonRotation(uint64_t& leaf, const Skeleton::ReadSource* supplied = nullptr) {
            const auto source = supplied ? *supplied : ProductionSkeletonSource();
            rotation_valid = false;
            leaf = 0;
            uint64_t after = 0;
            Vector3 observed{};
            const uint64_t pointerAddress = Skeleton::AddressOffset(RotationBase, offset::RotationBase_Sub1);
            if (!source.Value(pointerAddress, leaf) || !leaf ||
                !source.Value(Skeleton::AddressOffset(leaf, offset::RotationBase_Sub2), observed) ||
                !source.Value(pointerAddress, after) || after != leaf || !IsFiniteVectorValue(observed)) {
                leaf = 0;
                return false;
            }
            Rot = observed;
            rotation_valid = true;
            return true;
        }

        void ClearSkeletonObservation(bool preserveModelWorld = false) {
            // Only an in-progress same-body commit may retain the current read.
            if (!preserveModelWorld || !HasCurrentModelWorldTransform()) ClearModelWorldTransform();
            skeleton_bone_valid.fill(false);
            skeleton_bones.fill(Vector3{});
            cached_bot_chest_bone = {};
            cached_bot_chest_bone_valid = false;
            model_shapes = {};
            native_hitboxes = {};
            skeleton_sample_tick_ms = 0;
            skeleton_form = SkeletonSemantics::Form::Unknown;
            skeleton_requested_ids = SkeletonSemantics::kUnavailableMap;
            head_pos = {}; neck_pos = {}; chest_pos = {};
            core_anchor_source.fill(SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::Unavailable);
            debugHeadLookupAttempted = debugHeadLookupResolved = debugHeadIdFound = false;
            debugHeadLocalFinite = debugHeadLocalNonZero = debugHeadWorldNonZero = false;
            debugHeadLookupException = false;
            debugHeadBoneData = debugHeadBonesBase = debugHeadBonePtr = debugHeadBoneIdTable = 0;
            debugHeadLocalAddress = 0; debugHeadBoneCount = 0; debugHeadMappedIndex = -1;
            debugHeadLocal = {}; debugHeadWorld = {};
        }

        void ApplySkeletonMapping(const SkeletonBoneCache& cache) {
            skeleton_form = cache.form;
            skeleton_requested_ids = cache.requestedBoneIds;
            skeleton_revision = cache.revision;
            skeleton_status = cache.status;
        }

        void ApplySkeletonCoreAnchors() {
            Vector3* anchors[] = {&head_pos, &neck_pos, &chest_pos};
            const bool observedTransformValid = !offset::IsCnProfile() || HasCurrentModelWorldTransform();
            if (!observedTransformValid) {
                for (size_t slot = 0; slot < 3; ++slot) {
                    if (core_anchor_source[slot] == SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::ObservedBone) {
                        *anchors[slot] = {};
                        core_anchor_source[slot] = SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::Unavailable;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < 3; ++slot) {
                if (observedTransformValid && skeleton_bone_valid[slot]) {
                    *anchors[slot] = skeleton_bones[slot];
                    core_anchor_source[slot] = SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::ObservedBone;
                }
            }
            if (observedTransformValid && GameData::IsTrainingBotHeroId(HeroID) && cached_bot_chest_bone_valid) {
                chest_pos = cached_bot_chest_bone;
                core_anchor_source[2] = SkeletonSemantics::CoreAnchorSource::ObservedBone;
            }
            FillMissingCoreAnchorsFromPosition();
        }

        bool ConfirmSkeletonLayout(SkeletonBoneCache& cache, uint64_t expectedBoneData = 0,
                                   const Skeleton::ReadSource* supplied = nullptr) {
            auto source = supplied ? *supplied : ProductionSkeletonSource();
            source.metrics = &cache.metrics;
            Skeleton::Layout observed{};
            const auto identity = SkeletonIdentity();
            if (!Skeleton::ObserveLayout(source, identity, HeroID == eHero::HERO_DVA, observed, cache.status) ||
                (expectedBoneData && observed.sourceAddress == Skeleton::AddressOffset(VelocityBase, 0x8B0) &&
                 expectedBoneData != observed.boneData)) {
                if (cache.status == Skeleton::ReadStatus::Ready) cache.status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::LayoutChanged;
                cache.valid = false;
                return false;
            }
            const auto form = SkeletonSemantics::ResolveForm(HeroID, observed.formKnown, observed.linkD4, observed.linkD8);
            cache.guardFailures.Reset();
            const auto ids = SkeletonSemantics::RequestedIds(HeroID, form);
            if (cache.valid && cache.identity == identity && cache.layout == observed && cache.requestedBoneIds == ids) {
                ++cache.hits;
                return true;
            }
            ++cache.misses;
            cache.revision = Skeleton::RevisionSequence.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
            cache.valid = false;
            cache.identity = identity;
            cache.layout = observed;
            cache.form = form;
            cache.heroId = HeroID;
            cache.boneData = observed.boneData;
            cache.velocityBoneData = observed.boneData;
            cache.bonesBase = observed.bonesBase;
            cache.bonePtr = observed.bonePtr;
            cache.boneIdTable = observed.idTable;
            cache.boneCount = observed.count;
            cache.requestedBoneIds = ids;
            cache.mappedIndices.fill(-1);
            cache.maxMappedIndex = -1;
            cache.botChestMappedIndex = -1;
            cache.hasBotChest = GameData::IsTrainingBotHeroId(HeroID);
            const auto find = [&](int id) {
                if (id < 0) return -1;
                for (uint16_t index = 0; index < observed.count; ++index)
                    if (uint16_t(observed.ids[index]) == uint16_t(id)) return int(index);
                return -1;
            };
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < ids.size(); ++slot) {
                cache.mappedIndices[slot] = find(ids[slot]);
                cache.maxMappedIndex = (std::max)(cache.maxMappedIndex, cache.mappedIndices[slot]);
            }
            if (cache.hasBotChest) {
                cache.botChestMappedIndex = find(83);
                cache.maxMappedIndex = (std::max)(cache.maxMappedIndex, cache.botChestMappedIndex);
            }
            cache.shapeMapped.clear();
            cache.shapeMaxIndex = -1;
            cache.shapeModelIndex = ModelShapes::ResolveModel(HeroID, observed.ids.data(), observed.count);
            if (cache.shapeModelIndex >= 0) {
                for (const auto& shape : ModelShapes::kModels[cache.shapeModelIndex].shapes) {
                    const int mapped = ModelShapes::FindBone(observed.ids.data(), observed.count, shape.boneId);
                    cache.shapeMapped.push_back(mapped);
                    cache.shapeMaxIndex = (std::max)(cache.shapeMaxIndex, mapped);
                }
            }
            cache.valid = cache.maxMappedIndex >= 0 && form != SkeletonSemantics::Form::Unknown;
            if (form == SkeletonSemantics::Form::Unknown) cache.status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::UnknownForm;
            else if (cache.maxMappedIndex < 0) cache.status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::NoMappedBones;
            return cache.valid;
        }

        bool ReconfirmSkeletonLayout(SkeletonBoneCache& cache, const Skeleton::ReadSource* supplied = nullptr) {
            auto source = supplied ? *supplied : ProductionSkeletonSource();
            source.metrics = &cache.metrics;
            Skeleton::Layout observed{};
            const bool same = cache.valid && cache.identity == SkeletonIdentity() &&
                Skeleton::ObserveLayout(source, cache.identity, HeroID == eHero::HERO_DVA, observed, cache.status) &&
                observed == cache.layout;
            if (!same) {
                if (cache.status == Skeleton::ReadStatus::Ready) cache.status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::LayoutChanged;
                cache.valid = false;
            }
            return same;
        }

        void CacheSkeletonBones(uint64_t knownVelocityBoneData = 0) {
            CacheSkeletonBonesCached(nullptr, knownVelocityBoneData);
        }

        void CacheSkeletonBones(SkeletonBoneCache& cache, uint64_t knownVelocityBoneData = 0, bool allowSlowFallback = true) {
            CacheSkeletonBonesCached(&cache, knownVelocityBoneData, allowSlowFallback);
        }

        bool CommitSkeletonPoses(SkeletonBoneCache& mapping,
                                 std::span<const Skeleton::PoseRange> ranges,
                                 std::span<const uint8_t> poses,
                                 const std::array<bool, 18>& requested, bool botRequested,
                                 const Skeleton::ReadSource* supplied = nullptr) {
            ClearSkeletonObservation(true);
            if (!HasBoneWorldTransform()) {
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::InvalidTransform;
                return false;
            }
            if (!ReconfirmSkeletonLayout(mapping, supplied)) {
                skeleton_status = mapping.status;
                return false;
            }
            return ApplyVerifiedSkeletonPoses(mapping, ranges, poses, requested, botRequested);
        }

        bool CommitSkeletonPosesGuarded(SkeletonBoneCache& mapping,
                                       const Skeleton::LayoutGuard& before, const Skeleton::LayoutGuard& after,
                                       uint64_t revision, std::span<const Skeleton::PoseRange> ranges,
                                       std::span<const uint8_t> poses,
                                       const std::array<bool, 18>& requested, bool botRequested,
                                       uint32_t sampleTick = 0) {
            ClearSkeletonObservation(true);
            const bool current = mapping.valid && revision == mapping.revision && mapping.identity == SkeletonIdentity();
            const auto first=before.Compare(mapping.layout),last=after.Compare(mapping.layout);
            if (!current || first==Skeleton::GuardResult::Changed || last==Skeleton::GuardResult::Changed) {
                mapping.valid = false;
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::LayoutChanged;
                return false;
            }
            if(first!=Skeleton::GuardResult::Same || last!=Skeleton::GuardResult::Same) {
                if(mapping.guardFailures.Expired(sampleTick,PresentationTiming::kAnchorFreshMs))mapping.valid=false;
                mapping.status=skeleton_status=Skeleton::ReadStatus::DescriptorReadFailed;
                return false;
            }
            mapping.guardFailures.Reset();
            mapping.status=Skeleton::ReadStatus::Ready;
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < requested.size(); ++slot) {
                const int index = mapping.mappedIndices[slot];
                if (requested[slot] && index >= 0 && (!before.Covers(index) || !after.Covers(index))) {
                    mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::PoseReadFailed;
                    return false;
                }
            }
            if (botRequested && mapping.hasBotChest && mapping.botChestMappedIndex >= 0 &&
                (!before.Covers(mapping.botChestMappedIndex) || !after.Covers(mapping.botChestMappedIndex))) {
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::PoseReadFailed;
                return false;
            }
            if (!HasBoneWorldTransform()) {
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::InvalidTransform;
                return false;
            }
            ++mapping.hits;
            return ApplyVerifiedSkeletonPoses(mapping, ranges, poses, requested, botRequested);
        }

        bool ApplyVerifiedSkeletonPoses(SkeletonBoneCache& mapping,
                                       std::span<const Skeleton::PoseRange> ranges,
                                       std::span<const uint8_t> poses,
                                       const std::array<bool, 18>& requested, bool botRequested) {
            ApplySkeletonMapping(mapping);
            // CN uses the model transform sampled beside these poses; no
            // velocity-origin or Wrecking Ball height correction is added.
            const bool useModelWorld = offset::IsCnProfile();
            const auto rotation = useModelWorld ? XMMatrixIdentity() : XMMatrixRotationY(Rot.X);
            const auto world = [&](int index, Vector3& point) {
                if (index < 0 || index >= mapping.boneCount) return false;
                for (const auto& range : ranges) {
                    if (!range.prepared || index < range.first || index > range.last || range.bytes != range.size ||
                        range.offset > poses.size() || range.size > poses.size() - range.offset) continue;
                    const size_t localOffset = 0x30 * size_t(index - range.first);
                    if (localOffset > range.size || sizeof(XMFLOAT3) > range.size - localOffset) continue;
                    XMFLOAT3 local{};
                    std::memcpy(&local, poses.data() + range.offset + localOffset, sizeof(local));
                    if (index == mapping.mappedIndices[0]) {
                        debugHeadLocal = local;
                        debugHeadLocalAddress = mapping.bonesBase + 0x20 + 0x30 * uint64_t(index);
                        debugHeadLocalFinite = IsFiniteBoneValue(local);
                        debugHeadLocalNonZero = debugHeadLocalFinite && IsNonZeroBoneValue(local);
                    }
                    if (!IsFiniteBoneValue(local)) return false;
                    if (useModelWorld) {
                        point = model_world.TransformPoint({local.x, local.y, local.z});
                    } else {
                        XMFLOAT3 rotated{};
                        XMStoreFloat3(&rotated, XMVector3Transform(XMLoadFloat3(&local), rotation));
                        const float bias = HeroID == eHero::HERO_WRECKINGBALL ? -.7f : 0.f;
                        point = Vector3(rotated.x, rotated.y + bias, rotated.z) + pos;
                    }
                    return IsFiniteVectorValue(point) && point != Vector3{};
                }
                return false;
            };
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < skeleton_bones.size(); ++slot)
                if (requested[slot]) skeleton_bone_valid[slot] = world(mapping.mappedIndices[slot], skeleton_bones[slot]);
            if (botRequested && mapping.hasBotChest)
                cached_bot_chest_bone_valid = world(mapping.botChestMappedIndex, cached_bot_chest_bone);
            debugHeadLookupAttempted = true;
            debugHeadLookupResolved = mapping.valid;
            debugHeadBoneData = mapping.boneData;
            debugHeadBonesBase = mapping.bonesBase;
            debugHeadBonePtr = mapping.bonePtr;
            debugHeadBoneIdTable = mapping.boneIdTable;
            debugHeadBoneCount = mapping.boneCount;
            debugHeadMappedIndex = mapping.mappedIndices[0];
            debugHeadIdFound = debugHeadMappedIndex >= 0;
            debugHeadWorld = skeleton_bones[0];
            debugHeadWorldNonZero = skeleton_bone_valid[0];
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < requested.size(); ++slot)
                if (requested[slot] && mapping.requestedBoneIds[slot] >= 0 && !skeleton_bone_valid[slot])
                    skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::PartialPose;
            ApplySkeletonCoreAnchors();
            return true;
        }

        void CacheSkeletonBonesCached(SkeletonBoneCache* cache, uint64_t knownVelocityBoneData,
                                      bool allowSlowFallback = true, const Skeleton::ReadSource* supplied = nullptr) {
            // Keep the legacy argument for callers. Failed observations cannot expand
            // into unconfirmed per-bone reads with a different identity.
            (void)allowSlowFallback;
            ClearSkeletonObservation(true);
            SkeletonBoneCache temporary{};
            auto& mapping = cache ? *cache : temporary;
            if (!HasBoneWorldTransform()) {
                mapping.valid = false;
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::InvalidTransform;
                return;
            }
            if (!ConfirmSkeletonLayout(mapping, knownVelocityBoneData, supplied)) {
                mapping.valid = false;
                skeleton_status = mapping.status;
                return;
            }
            auto source = supplied ? *supplied : ProductionSkeletonSource();
            source.metrics = &mapping.metrics;
            constexpr size_t stride = 0x30;
            const size_t bytes = stride * size_t(mapping.maxMappedIndex) + sizeof(XMFLOAT3);
            std::array<uint8_t, stride * kMaxBoneIdCount> poses{};
            if (!source.Exact(mapping.bonesBase + 0x20, poses.data(), bytes)) {
                // The complete mapping was just observed. A dynamic-pose
                // failure does not require another full ID-table discovery;
                // the next hot frame must still pass both layout guards.
                mapping.status = skeleton_status = Skeleton::ReadStatus::PoseReadFailed;
                return;
            }
            const Skeleton::PoseRange range{0, mapping.maxMappedIndex, 0, bytes, uint32_t(bytes)};
            std::array<bool, 18> requested{};
            requested.fill(true);
            CommitSkeletonPoses(mapping, std::span(&range, 1), poses, requested, mapping.hasBotChest, supplied);
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // 3D box corners
        // =====================================================================
        void Get3DBoxPos(Vector3& veca, Vector3& vecb, Vector3& vecc, Vector3& vecd,
                         Vector3& vece, Vector3& vecf, Vector3& vecg, Vector3& vech) {
            __try {
                if (this->pos != Vector3(0, 0, 0) && this->PlayerHealth > 0) {
                    uint64_t bonesBase = 0;
                    uint64_t pBoneData = ResolveBoneData(bonesBase);
                    if (pBoneData) {
                        if (bonesBase) {
                            const int boneIdx17 = get_bone_id(pBoneData, 17);
                            if (boneIdx17 < 0)
                                return;
                            XMFLOAT3 currentBone = SDK->RPM<XMFLOAT3>(
                                bonesBase + (0x30 * boneIdx17) + 0x20
                            );
                            currentBone.y += 0.3f;
                            XMFLOAT3 a = {currentBone.x - 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z - 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 b = {currentBone.x - 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z + 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 c = {currentBone.x + 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z - 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 d = {currentBone.x + 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z + 0.5f};
                            currentBone.y -= 1.5f;
                            XMFLOAT3 e = {currentBone.x - 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z - 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 f = {currentBone.x - 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z + 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 g = {currentBone.x + 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z - 0.5f};
                            XMFLOAT3 h = {currentBone.x + 0.5f, currentBone.y, currentBone.z + 0.5f};

                            TransformBoneWorld(a, veca); TransformBoneWorld(b, vecb);
                            TransformBoneWorld(c, vecc); TransformBoneWorld(d, vecd);
                            TransformBoneWorld(e, vece); TransformBoneWorld(f, vecf);
                            TransformBoneWorld(g, vecg); TransformBoneWorld(h, vech);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {}
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // Eye ray (head-sight direction)
        // =====================================================================
        void GetEyeRayPoint(Vector3& veceye, Vector3& arrow1, Vector3& arrow2,
                            Vector3& arrow3, Vector3& arrow4) {
            __try {
                if (this->pos != Vector3(0, 0, 0) && this->PlayerHealth > 0) {
                    uint64_t bonesBase = 0;
                    uint64_t pBoneData = ResolveBoneData(bonesBase);
                    if (pBoneData) {
                        if (bonesBase) {
                            const int boneIdx17 = get_bone_id(pBoneData, 17);
                            if (boneIdx17 < 0)
                                return;
                            XMFLOAT3 b = SDK->RPM<XMFLOAT3>(
                                bonesBase + (0x30 * boneIdx17) + 0x20
                            );
                            b = XMFLOAT3(b.x, b.y, b.z + 0.8f);
                            XMFLOAT3 b1 = {b.x + 0.2f, b.y,     b.z - 0.3f};
                            XMFLOAT3 b2 = {b.x - 0.2f, b.y,     b.z - 0.3f};
                            XMFLOAT3 b3 = {b.x,       b.y + 0.2f, b.z - 0.3f};
                            XMFLOAT3 b4 = {b.x,       b.y - 0.2f, b.z - 0.3f};

                            // Legacy eye rays never used the skeleton Ball bias.
                            TransformBoneWorld(b, veceye, false);
                            TransformBoneWorld(b1, arrow1, false);
                            TransformBoneWorld(b2, arrow2, false);
                            TransformBoneWorld(b3, arrow3, false);
                            TransformBoneWorld(b4, arrow4, false);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {}
        }

        // =====================================================================
        // ESP bone list (projects to screen)
        // =====================================================================
        espBone getBoneList(std::array<int, 18> index) {
            __try {
                espBone a{};
                Vector2 pmin{}, pmax{}, w2s{};
                Vector3 root = this->pos;

                bool isBot = GameData::IsTrainingBotHeroId(HeroID);

                // For W2S we need the global viewMatrix, WX, WY.
                // These are accessed via the global variables declared in Overwatch.hpp.
                // We rely on the caller to have set up the extern viewMatrix and WX/WY.
                extern Matrix viewMatrix;
                extern float WX, WY;
                extern std::mutex g_viewMatrixMutex;
                Matrix view{};
                g_viewMatrixMutex.lock();
                view = viewMatrix;
                g_viewMatrixMutex.unlock();

                if (isBot) {
                    if (!view.WorldToScreen(root, &w2s, Vector2(WX, WY))) {
                        a.boneerror = true;
                        return a;
                    }
                    pmin = pmax = w2s;
                    int botIndices[] = { 17, 16, 3, 13, 54 };
                    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                        Vector3 bone = GetBonePos(botIndices[i]);
                        Vector2 ws{};
                        if (view.WorldToScreen(bone, &ws, Vector2(WX, WY))) {
                            if (i == 0) { a.head = ws; a.head.Y += 4.f; }
                            else if (i == 1) a.neck = ws;
                            else if (i == 2) a.body_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 3) a.l_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 4) a.r_1 = ws;
                            if (ws.X < pmin.X) pmin.X = ws.X;
                            if (ws.Y < pmin.Y) pmin.Y = ws.Y;
                            if (ws.X > pmax.X) pmax.X = ws.X;
                            if (ws.Y > pmax.Y) pmax.Y = ws.Y;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if (!view.WorldToScreen(root, &w2s, Vector2(WX, WY))) {
                        a.boneerror = true;
                        return a;
                    }
                    pmin = pmax = w2s;
                    for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
                        Vector3 bone = GetBonePos(index[i]);
                        Vector2 ws{};
                        if (view.WorldToScreen(bone, &ws, Vector2(WX, WY))) {
                            if      (i == 0)  a.head = ws;
                            else if (i == 1)  a.neck = ws;
                            else if (i == 2)  a.body_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 3)  a.body_2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 4)  a.l_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 5)  a.r_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 6)  a.l_d_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 7)  a.r_d_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 8)  a.l_a_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 9)  a.r_a_1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 10) a.l_a_2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 11) a.r_a_2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 12) a.l_d_2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 13) a.r_d_2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 14) a.sex = ws;
                            else if (i == 15) a.sex1 = ws;
                            else if (i == 16) a.sex2 = ws;
                            else if (i == 17) a.sex3 = ws;
                            if (ws.X < pmin.X) pmin.X = ws.X;
                            if (ws.Y < pmin.Y) pmin.Y = ws.Y;
                            if (ws.X > pmax.X) pmax.X = ws.X;
                            if (ws.Y > pmax.Y) pmax.Y = ws.Y;
                        }
                    }
                }

                a.upL   = pmin;
                a.upR   = Vector2(pmax.X, pmin.Y);
                a.downL = Vector2(pmin.X, pmax.Y);
                a.downR = pmax;
                return a;
            } __except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
                return espBone{};
            }
        }
    };

} // namespace OW
```

```inl
                        if (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                            OW::EntitySceneGeneration()==scanScene &&
                            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == scanConnectionEpoch &&
                            OW::offset::ActiveProfile() == scanRuntimeProfile && OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(registry)) {
                            // A newer topology observation makes this an older
                            // partial audit; it cannot retire or overwrite new discoveries.
                            if(!OW::EntityRosterPolicy::ScanCanRetire(snapshot.complete,scanTopologyRevision,OW::observed_topology_revision)) {
                                snapshot.complete=false;
                            }
                            OW::MergeRecentRawDiscovery(snapshot);
                            snapshot.generation=++OW::raw_scan_publication_sequence;
                            if (OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.valid &&
                                OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.generation !=
                                    OW::last_consumed_raw_scan_generation) {
                                ++scanOverwrittenCount;
                            }
                            OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot = std::move(snapshot);
                            published = true;
                            scanCommitted=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.complete;
                        }
```

`include/Game/EntityDiscovery/PositiveCandidates.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <deque>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

namespace OW::EntityDiscovery {
// Address additions get first service. A rolling fingerprint read also catches
// an allocation reused without a visible table-address transition.
struct PositiveCandidates {
    struct Fingerprint {
        std::array<uint64_t,4> types{};
        uint32_t match=0;
        bool operator==(const Fingerprint&) const = default;
        bool Has(uint32_t type) const { return type/64<types.size() && (types[type/64]&(uint64_t{1}<<(type%64))); }
    };
    struct Entry { Fingerprint value{}; uint32_t attempted=0; bool known=false,accepted=false; uint32_t observed=0; };
    std::vector<uint64_t> members;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t,Entry> entries;
    std::deque<uint64_t> urgent, probes;
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> urgentSet, probeSet;
    size_t cursor=0;
    void ObserveAdditionalMembers(std::vector<uint64_t> current) {
        // Exact blocks can contribute additions immediately. They are never
        // evidence of absence; only the completed table replaces the baseline.
        current.insert(current.end(),members.begin(),members.end());
        ObserveMembers(std::move(current));
    }
    void ObserveMembers(std::vector<uint64_t> current) {
        std::sort(current.begin(),current.end());
        current.erase(std::unique(current.begin(),current.end()),current.end());
        for(auto address:current)
            if(!std::binary_search(members.begin(),members.end(),address) && urgentSet.insert(address).second)
                urgent.push_back(address);
        members=std::move(current);
        std::erase_if(entries,[&](const auto& p){return !Contains(p.first);});
        if(cursor>=members.size())cursor=0;
    }
    bool Contains(uint64_t address) const { return std::binary_search(members.begin(),members.end(),address); }
    std::vector<uint64_t> NextHeaders(size_t limit) {
        std::vector<uint64_t> result;
        while(!urgent.empty() && result.size()<limit) {
            const auto address=urgent.front();urgent.pop_front();urgentSet.erase(address);
            if(Contains(address))result.push_back(address);
        }
        for(size_t visited=0;visited<members.size() && result.size()<limit;++visited) {
            const auto address=members[cursor++%members.size()];
            if(std::find(result.begin(),result.end(),address)==result.end())result.push_back(address);
        }
        return result;
    }
    void ObserveHeader(uint64_t address,const Fingerprint& value,bool exact,uint32_t now,uint32_t linkType,uint32_t heroType) {
        if(!Contains(address))return;
        if(!exact) {
            if(auto found=entries.find(address);found!=entries.end())found->second.observed=0;
            return;
        }
        auto& entry=entries[address];
        if(!entry.known || entry.value!=value) {
            entry={value,0,true,false};
        }
        entry.observed=now;
        if(value.match && (value.Has(linkType)||value.Has(heroType)) && !entry.accepted &&
            (!entry.attempted || uint32_t(now-entry.attempted)>=250) && probeSet.insert(address).second)
            probes.push_back(address);
    }
    bool FreshMemberIds(uint32_t now,std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t,uint32_t>>& ids) const {
        ids.clear();ids.reserve(members.size());
        for(auto address:members) {
            const auto entry=entries.find(address);
            if(entry==entries.end() || !entry->second.known || !entry->second.observed ||
                uint32_t(now-entry->second.observed)>500) {ids.clear();return false;}
            ids.emplace_back(address,entry->second.value.match);
        }
        return !members.empty();
    }
    uint64_t NextProbe() {
        while(!probes.empty()) {
            const auto address=probes.front();probes.pop_front();probeSet.erase(address);
            if(Contains(address))return address;
        }
        return 0;
    }
    void FinishProbe(uint64_t address,bool accepted,uint32_t now) {
        if(auto found=entries.find(address);found!=entries.end()) {
            found->second.attempted=now;found->second.accepted=accepted;
        }
    }
};
}
```

```inl
    auto scanPairKey = [](const std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>& pair) {
        const uint64_t first = pair.first >> 4;
        const uint64_t second = pair.second >> 4;
        return first ^ (second << 17) ^ (second >> 13);
    };

    auto appendScanPairUnique = [&](std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>>& pairs,
                                    const std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>& pair) {
        if (!pair.first || !pair.second)
            return false;
        if (std::find(pairs.begin(), pairs.end(), pair) != pairs.end())
            return false;
        pairs.push_back(pair);
        return true;
    };

        bool pending = false;
        uint64_t pendingGeneration = 0;
        if (scanLatestWinsEnabled) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);

                OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.generation !=

            pending = OW::abletotread != 0;
            pendingGeneration = pending ? scanGeneration : 0;
        }

            if (scanPendingSinceTick == 0 || scanPendingGeneration != pendingGeneration) {
                scanPendingSinceTick = observedNow;
                scanPendingGeneration = pendingGeneration;
            }
        } else {
            scanPendingSinceTick = 0;
            scanPendingGeneration = 0;
        }
    };
```

```inl
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(scanConnectionEpoch));
                publishScanPipelineStats();
                continue;
            }
            ++scanGeneration;
            if (scanGetOwEntitiesMs > scanMaxGetOwEntitiesMs) {
                scanMaxGetOwEntitiesMs = scanGetOwEntitiesMs;
                scanMaxGetOwEntitiesGeneration = scanGeneration;
                scanMaxGetOwEntitiesDetail = Diagnostics::SnapshotEntityScanDetailStats();
            }
            bool scanComplete=OW::entityScanComplete;
            const auto registry=OW::entityScanRegistry;
            std::vector<OW::EntityRosterPolicy::Discovery> scanDiscoveries;
            if(OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(registry)) {
                const auto topology=OW::ProbeEntityTopologyMembers(true);
                scanComplete=scanComplete && topology.complete && topology.member_ids_complete;
                const auto audit=OW::AuditEntityScene(topology);
                OW::RecordEntitySceneAudit(scanConnectionEpoch,topology.registry.generation,scanScene,
                    OW::entityScanReadComplete ? audit : OW::EntityRosterPolicy::SceneAudit::Unknown,static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs()));
                std::unordered_set<uint64_t> verifiedLinks;
                std::vector<uint64_t> links;
                for(const auto& pair:scanned)if(verifiedLinks.insert(pair.second).second)links.push_back(pair.second);
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);
                    for(const auto& [address,proof]:OW::entity_discoveries.actors)
                        if(verifiedLinks.insert(proof.link).second)links.push_back(proof.link);
                }
                for(auto link:links) {
                    std::vector<OW::EntityRosterPolicy::Discovery> discoveries;
                    if(!OW::ProbePriorityActor(link,topology,true,nullptr,nullptr,&discoveries).empty())
                        scanDiscoveries.insert(scanDiscoveries.end(),discoveries.begin(),discoveries.end());
                }
                for(const auto& proof:scanDiscoveries) {
                    const auto pair=std::make_pair(proof.address,proof.link);
                    if(std::find(scanned.begin(),scanned.end(),pair)==scanned.end())scanned.push_back(pair);
                }
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);
                    for(const auto& [address,proof]:OW::entity_discoveries.actors) {
                        const bool stillInTable=std::binary_search(topology.members.begin(),topology.members.end(),address) ||
                            std::binary_search(topology.members.begin(),topology.members.end(),proof.link);
                        const bool verified=std::any_of(scanDiscoveries.begin(),scanDiscoveries.end(),[&](const auto& current) {
                            return current.address==address && current.link==proof.link;
                        });
                        const bool replaced=std::any_of(scanDiscoveries.begin(),scanDiscoveries.end(),[&](const auto& current) {
                            return current.link==proof.link && current.address!=address;
                        });
                        if(stillInTable && !verified && !replaced)scanComplete=false;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                OW::RecordEntitySceneAudit(scanConnectionEpoch,registry.generation,scanScene,OW::EntityRosterPolicy::SceneAudit::Unknown,static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs()));
            }
            if(OW::entityScanStatus==OW::EntityRegistry::ScanStatus::Invalidated ||
                OW::entityScanStatus==OW::EntityRegistry::ScanStatus::Unavailable) {
                ++scanFailedCount;publishScanPipelineStats();OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(50);continue;
            }
            REGISTRY_RELOCATION_EVENT("scanner_before_commit");
            OW::RefreshEntityRegistry(true);
            if(!OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(registry)) {
                ++scanFailedCount;publishScanPipelineStats();OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(50);continue;
            }
            RuntimeTrace::Emit(RuntimeTrace::Scan,scanGeneration,scanned.size(),scanComplete,scanConnectionEpoch);
            scanResultRawCount = scanned.size();
            if (scanned.empty() && !scanComplete)
                ++scanFailedCount;
            Diagnostics::RecordEntityScanCycle(scanned.size(), entityScanHz);
            Diagnostics::Trace("Entity scan cycle found %zu raw entities.", scanned.size());
            if (OW::PipelineDebugEnabled()) {
                const DWORD logNow = static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs());
                if (lastLoggedScanCount != scanned.size() || lastScanLogTick == 0 ||
                    logNow - lastScanLogTick >= 1000) {
                    Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 3 entity scan raw=%zu scan_hz=%.1f interval_ms=%lu",
                        scanned.size(),
                        entityScanHz,
                        static_cast<unsigned long>(scanInterval));
                    lastLoggedScanCount = scanned.size();
                    lastScanLogTick = logNow;
                }
            }
            ++scanPublishAttemptCount;
            bool scanCommitted=false;
            if (scanLatestWinsEnabled) {
                if (scanComplete || !scanned.empty()) {
                    OW::RawEntityScanSnapshot snapshot{};
                    snapshot.scene_generation=scanScene;snapshot.discoveries=scanDiscoveries;
                    snapshot.registry=registry;
                    snapshot.raw_entities = std::move(scanned);
                    for(const auto& pair:snapshot.raw_entities)snapshot.actual_members.push_back(pair.first);
                    snapshot.connection_epoch=scanConnectionEpoch;
                    snapshot.complete = scanComplete;
                    snapshot.scan_started_at = getOwEntitiesStartedAt;
                    snapshot.scan_finished_at = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                    snapshot.valid = true;
                    bool published = false;
                    {
#include "Game/EntityDiscovery/CommitFullScan.inl"
                    }
                    if (published) {
                        ++scanPublishSuccessCount;
                        lastScanSuccessTick = static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs());
                    } else {
                        Diagnostics::Trace(
                            "Discarded entity scan at stale latest-wins commit epoch=%llu.",
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(scanConnectionEpoch));
                    }
                }
            } else {
                std::scoped_lock lock(g_mutex,OW::raw_scan_mutex);
                if (OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                    OW::EntitySceneGeneration()==scanScene &&
                    OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == scanConnectionEpoch &&
                    OW::offset::ActiveProfile() == scanRuntimeProfile &&
                    OW::abletotread == 0 && OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(registry)) {
                    OW::RawEntityScanSnapshot evidence{};
                    evidence.scene_generation=scanScene;evidence.connection_epoch=scanConnectionEpoch;
                    evidence.registry=registry;evidence.complete=scanComplete;evidence.raw_entities=scanned;
                    evidence.discoveries=scanDiscoveries;OW::MergeRecentRawDiscovery(evidence);
                    OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot=std::move(evidence);
                    OW::EntityRosterPolicy::MergePartialScan(scanned,OW::ow_entities,
                        scanComplete || OW::ow_entities_registry.generation!=registry.generation);
                    OW::ow_entities_scan = std::move(scanned);
                    OW::ow_entities_scan_registry=registry;
                    OW::ow_entities_scan_complete=scanComplete;
                    OW::ow_entities_scene=scanScene;
                    OW::abletotread = 1;
                    scanCommitted=scanComplete;
                    ++scanPublishSuccessCount;
                    lastScanSuccessTick = static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs());
                }
            }
            if(scanCommitted)scanCommitted=OW::AcknowledgeEntityRegistry(registry,OW::EntityRegistry::ScanStatus::Complete);
            if (coldTopologyScanEnabled && fast_rescan && scanCommitted) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
                OW::entity_topology_rescan_completed_request_count =
                    (std::max)(
                        OW::entity_topology_rescan_completed_request_count,
                        topologyRescanRequestCountSnapshot);
                if (OW::entity_topology_rescan_request_count ==
                    OW::entity_topology_rescan_completed_request_count) {
                    OW::entity_fast_scan_until_tick = 0;
                }
            }
        } else if (pending_scan && scanDue) {
            ++scanSkipPendingCount;
        }
        updateScanPendingAge(static_cast<DWORD>(OW::EntityRegistryNowMs()));
        publishScanPipelineStats();
        OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(OW::kEntityScannerIdleSleepMs);
```

`include/Game/EntityDiscovery/WorkSchedule.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace OW::EntityDiscovery {
enum class Work : uint8_t { LocalBinding, KnownBinding, Scan, PositiveBinding, None };

// A due fast lane must not consume every owner visit when acquisition slows.
// Each continuously eligible lane gets a turn within four discovery visits;
// lanes that are not due donate their turn without adding any work to a visit.
struct WorkSchedule {
    uint8_t cursor = 0;
    Work Select(bool localDue, bool knownDue, bool scanDue, bool positiveDue=false) {
        const std::array<bool, 4> due{localDue, knownDue, scanDue, positiveDue};
        for (uint8_t offset = 0; offset < due.size(); ++offset) {
            const auto index = uint8_t((cursor + offset) % due.size());
            if (!due[index]) continue;
            cursor = uint8_t((index + 1) % due.size());
            return static_cast<Work>(index);
        }
        return Work::None;
    }
};

// A dead/missing body must not wait behind every healthy controller. Alternate
// recovery and ordinary renewal so neither group can starve the other.
struct BindingSchedule {
    size_t recoveryCursor=0, regularCursor=0;
    bool recoveryTurn=true;
    size_t Select(const std::vector<uint8_t>& recovery) {
        for(unsigned pass=0;pass<2;++pass) {
            const bool wanted=pass==0?recoveryTurn:!recoveryTurn;
            auto& cursor=wanted?recoveryCursor:regularCursor;
            for(size_t n=0;n<recovery.size();++n) {
                const auto i=(cursor+n)%recovery.size();
                if(bool(recovery[i])!=wanted)continue;
                cursor=(i+1)%recovery.size();recoveryTurn=!wanted;
                return i;
            }
        }
        return recovery.size();
    }
};
}
```

```inl
// All actors advance one initialization stage in one shared I/O execution.
// This does not admit a body; normal life/team/identity publication still runs.
        auto runBootstrapBatch = [&] {
            namespace M = OW::EntityMaintenance;
            if(offset::Active().componentTransform!=offset::ComponentTransformMode::Cn155284 ||
               !maintenanceBudget.CanStart(RuntimeTrace::NowUs()) || !OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(processRegistry))return;
            struct Work {
                uint64_t address=0,link=0;
                std::shared_ptr<RosterEntry> record;
                M::RefreshIdentity identity;
                M::RefreshHeader bodyHeader{},linkHeader{};
                uint32_t bodyBytes=0,linkBytes=0;
                bool headers=false;
            };
            // Bound request storage; rotate additional actors through later visits.
            constexpr size_t maxActors=32;
            std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Work>> work;
            std::vector<M::ComponentRefresh*> pending;
            std::vector<M::RefreshRequest> headerReads;
            auto identityFor=[&](const Work& item) {
                uint64_t revision=0,absence=0;
                { std::lock_guard lock(OW::entityBodyValidityMutex);
                  if(auto it=OW::entityBodyAuthorities.find(item.address);it!=OW::entityBodyAuthorities.end())revision=it->second.revision;
                  if(auto it=OW::entityBodyAbsenceRevisions.find(item.address);it!=OW::entityBodyAbsenceRevisions.end())absence=it->second; }
                return M::RefreshIdentity{{item.address,item.link,OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch(),
                    OW::EntitySceneGeneration(),processRegistry.generation,uint64_t(offset::ActiveProfile()),
                    SDK->dwGameBase.load(),item.record->entity.actor_generation,revision,absence}};
            };
            const size_t start=raw_entities.empty()?0:bootstrapCursor%raw_entities.size();
            for(size_t n=0;n<raw_entities.size() && work.size()<maxActors;++n) {
                const size_t index=(start+n)%raw_entities.size();
                const auto [address,link]=raw_entities[index];
                if(!address || !link || !cycleDiscoveries.Find(address,link,GetTickCount()) || dynamicEntityCache.contains(address))continue;
                auto found=componentBaseCache.find(address);
                if(found!=componentBaseCache.end() && found->second->baseUpdateTick)continue;
                if(found==componentBaseCache.end())found=componentBaseCache.emplace(address,std::make_shared<RosterEntry>()).first;
                auto item=std::make_unique<Work>();item->address=address;item->link=link;item->record=found->second;
                auto& refresh=item->record->componentRefresh;
                item->identity=identityFor(*item);
                if((refresh.Active() || refresh.stage==M::ComponentRefresh::Stage::Ready) &&
                   (!(refresh.identity==item->identity) || uint32_t(GetTickCount()-refresh.startedTick)>5000))refresh={};
                if(refresh.ReadyFresh(GetTickCount(),OW::kEntityDeadComponentRefreshMs))continue;
                item->headers=!refresh.Active();
                if(item->headers) {
                    headerReads.push_back({address+M::RefreshHeader::offset,item->bodyHeader.bytes.data(),M::RefreshHeader::size,&item->bodyBytes});
                    if(address!=link)headerReads.push_back({link+M::RefreshHeader::offset,item->linkHeader.bytes.data(),M::RefreshHeader::size,&item->linkBytes});
                }
                pending.push_back(item->headers?nullptr:&refresh);
                work.push_back(std::move(item));
                bootstrapCursor=(index+1)%raw_entities.size();
            }
            if(work.empty())return;
            const uint64_t batchStartedUs=RuntimeTrace::NowUs();
            size_t requestsRead=0,bytesRead=0;
            bool executed=false;
            const auto tick=GetTickCount();
            M::AdvanceRefreshBatch(pending,[&](size_t i){return identityFor(*work[i]);},[] {return GetTickCount();},
                [&](const std::vector<M::RefreshRequest>& requests) {
                    requestsRead=requests.size();for(const auto& request:requests)bytesRead+=request.size;
                    executed=M::ReadRefreshBatch(mem,requests);return executed;
                },[](uint64_t value,uint8_t a,uint8_t b){return OW::Cn155284::Component(value,a,b);},headerReads);
            const auto& profile=offset::Active();
            const std::array<uint32_t,13> types{profile.typeHealth,profile.typeLink,profile.typeTeam,
                OW::TYPE_TRANSFORM,OW::TYPE_VELOCITY,profile.typeHeroId,OW::TYPE_BONE,profile.typeRotation,
                profile.typeSkill,OW::TYPE_P_VISIBILITY,profile.typePlayerController,OW::TYPE_ANGLE,OW::TYPE_STAT};
            const bool contextCurrent=OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch()==connectionEpoch && OW::EntitySceneGeneration()==processSceneGeneration &&
                offset::ActiveProfile()==runtimeProfile && OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(processRegistry);
            for(auto& item:work) {
                auto& refresh=item->record->componentRefresh;
                if(!contextCurrent || !(identityFor(*item)==item->identity) ||
                   !cycleDiscoveries.Find(item->address,item->link,GetTickCount())) {refresh={};continue;}
                if(!item->headers)continue;
                if(!executed || item->bodyBytes!=M::RefreshHeader::size ||
                   (item->address!=item->link && item->linkBytes!=M::RefreshHeader::size))continue;
                if(item->address==item->link)item->linkHeader=item->bodyHeader;
                refresh.Begin(item->identity,item->bodyHeader,item->linkHeader,types,
                    SDK->dwGameBase+profile.componentKeyByteRva,SDK->dwGameBase+profile.componentKeySecondByteRva,
                    offset::Entity_MatchId,tick);
            }
            const size_t ready=std::count_if(work.begin(),work.end(),[](const auto& item){
                return item->record->componentRefresh.stage==M::ComponentRefresh::Stage::Ready;});
            static DWORD lastReport=0;
            if(ready || !lastReport || uint32_t(GetTickCount()-lastReport)>=1000) {
                lastReport=GetTickCount();
                Diagnostics::Info("[V2-INITIALIZE] actors=%zu ready=%zu requests=%zu bytes=%zu batch_ok=%d elapsed_us=%llu",
                    work.size(),ready,requestsRead,bytesRead,executed?1:0,
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(RuntimeTrace::NowUs()-batchStartedUs));
            }
        };
```

```inl
                cache.transform  = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::TYPE_TRANSFORM, componentSnapshot);
                cache.velocity   = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::TYPE_VELOCITY, componentSnapshot);
                cache.hero       = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typeHeroId, linkSnapshot);
                cache.bone       = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::TYPE_BONE, componentSnapshot);
                cache.rotation   = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::offset::Active().typeRotation, componentSnapshot);
                cache.skill      = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::offset::Active().typeSkill, componentSnapshot);
                cache.visibility = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_P_VISIBILITY, linkSnapshot);
                cache.angle      = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typePlayerController, linkSnapshot);
                cache.enemyAngle = decryptBase(ComponentParent, OW::TYPE_ANGLE, componentSnapshot);
                cache.stat       = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_STAT, linkSnapshot);
                if (LinkParent != ComponentParent) {
                    if (!cache.health)
                        cache.health = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typeHealth, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.team)
                        cache.team = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typeTeam, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.transform)
                        cache.transform = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_TRANSFORM, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.velocity)
                        cache.velocity = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_VELOCITY, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.bone)
                        cache.bone = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_BONE, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.rotation)
                        cache.rotation = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typeRotation, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.skill)
                        cache.skill = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::offset::Active().typeSkill, linkSnapshot, true);
                    if (!cache.enemyAngle)
                        cache.enemyAngle = decryptBase(LinkParent, OW::TYPE_ANGLE, linkSnapshot, true);
                }
                if (criticalBatchFusionActive && cache.rotation) {
                    cache.rotationLeaf = SDK->RPM<uint64_t>(
                        cache.rotation + offset::RotationBase_Sub1);
                }
                }
                auto& record=componentBaseCache[ComponentParent];
                if(!record)record=std::make_shared<RosterEntry>();
                cache.matchIdValid = componentSnapshot &&
                    componentSnapshot->ReadParentOffset(OW::offset::Entity_MatchId, cache.matchId);
                if(resumedCn) {
                    cache.matchId=record->componentRefresh.component.At<uint32_t>(OW::offset::Entity_MatchId);
                    cache.matchIdValid=cache.matchId!=0;
                }
                const auto bases = [](const ComponentBaseCache& value) {
                    return std::array{value.health, value.link, value.team, value.transform,
                        value.velocity, value.hero, value.bone, value.rotation, value.rotationLeaf,
                        value.skill, value.visibility, value.angle, value.enemyAngle, value.stat};
                };
                const bool sameComponents = cache.layoutsKnown && record->layoutsKnown &&
                    cache.linkParent == record->linkParent && cache.matchIdValid && record->matchIdValid &&
                    cache.matchId == record->matchId && bases(cache) == bases(*record);
                if (sameComponents) {
                    // Renew addresses without discarding accepted samples or advancing their timestamps.
                    record->componentLayout = cache.componentLayout;
                    record->linkLayout = cache.linkLayout;
                    record->baseUpdateTick = cache.baseUpdateTick;
                    record->layoutCheckTick = cache.layoutCheckTick;
                } else {
                    // Keep the pair-bound team lock through moved or unreadable components.
                    // A validated paired body may reuse it; a new pair needs an exact team read.
                    cache.confirmedTeam = record->confirmedTeam;
                    cache.confirmedTeam.known = false;
                    if (record->entity.body_valid && (cache.health != record->health || cache.velocity != record->velocity ||
                        cache.hero != record->hero || cache.team != record->team || cache.linkParent != record->linkParent)) {
                        OW::RevokeEntityBodyObservation(record->entity.address, record->entity.actor_generation,
                            record->entity.body_authority_revision);
                        record->entity.body_valid = false;
                    }
                    static_cast<ComponentBaseCache&>(*record)=std::move(cache);
                }
                cacheIt=componentBaseCache.find(ComponentParent);
                record->componentRefresh={};
```

```inl
            uint64_t mixed = key.parent;
            mixed ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(key.type) +
                0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull +
```
