`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/ComponentRefresh.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace OW::EntityMaintenance {
// Runtime-independent transaction core. Production supplies the existing CN
// decoder and exact scatter adapter; tests supply a deterministic memory image.
struct RefreshHeader {
    static constexpr size_t offset = 0x30, size = 0x120;
    std::array<uint8_t, size> bytes{};
    template<class T> T At(size_t parentOffset) const {
        T value{};
        if (parentOffset >= offset && parentOffset - offset + sizeof(T) <= bytes.size())
            std::memcpy(&value, bytes.data() + parentOffset - offset, sizeof(T));
        return value;
    }
    std::array<uint64_t, 6> Layout() const {
        return {At<uint64_t>(0x80), At<uint64_t>(0x110), At<uint64_t>(0x118),
            At<uint64_t>(0x120), At<uint64_t>(0x128), At<uint32_t>(0x130)};
    }
    bool SameAllocation(const RefreshHeader& other, size_t matchOffset) const {
        return Layout() == other.Layout() && At<uint32_t>(matchOffset) == other.At<uint32_t>(matchOffset);
    }
};
struct RefreshRequest { uint64_t address; void* output; size_t size; uint32_t* actual; };
struct RefreshIdentity {
    // component/link, connection, scene, registry, profile, module, body
    // generation, per-body authority revision and absence revision. Unrelated
    // actors advancing the global observation fence must not restart this owner.
    std::array<uint64_t, 10> values{};
    bool operator==(const RefreshIdentity&) const = default;
};
struct ComponentRefresh {
    enum class Stage : uint8_t { Empty, Slots, Types, Verify, Ready, Failed };
    struct Slot {
        uint64_t address = 0, encoded = 0, decoded = 0;
        uint32_t type = 0;
        uint8_t observedType = 0;
    };
    Stage stage = Stage::Empty;
    RefreshIdentity identity{};
    RefreshHeader component{}, link{};
    std::array<Slot, 21> slots{};
    std::array<uint64_t, 13> values{};
    uint64_t keyAddressA = 0, keyAddressB = 0;
    uint32_t startedTick = 0;
    uint32_t verifiedTick = 0;
    size_t matchOffset = 0;
    uint8_t keyA = 0, keyB = 0;
    bool Active() const { return stage == Stage::Slots || stage == Stage::Types || stage == Stage::Verify; }
    bool ReadyFresh(uint32_t tick,uint32_t maxAge) {
        if(stage!=Stage::Ready)return false;
        if(uint32_t(tick-verifiedTick)<maxAge)return true;
        // Queue the existing final validation again; waiting never renews it.
        stage=Stage::Verify;verifiedTick=0;values={};return false;
    }
    bool Begin(const RefreshIdentity& owner, const RefreshHeader& body, const RefreshHeader& controller,
               const std::array<uint32_t, 13>& types, uint64_t keyAtA, uint64_t keyAtB,
               size_t matchAt, uint32_t tick) {
        *this = {};
        identity = owner; component = body; link = controller;
        keyAddressA = keyAtA; keyAddressB = keyAtB; matchOffset = matchAt; startedTick = tick;
        if (!component.At<uint32_t>(matchAt) || !link.At<uint32_t>(matchAt)) {
            stage = Stage::Failed; return false;
        }
        constexpr std::array<bool, 13> linked{false,true,false,false,false,true,false,false,false,true,true,false,true};
        constexpr std::array<size_t, 8> fallback{0,2,3,4,6,7,8,11};
        auto plan = [&](Slot& slot, uint32_t type, const RefreshHeader& header) {
            slot.type = type;
            const auto layout = header.Layout();
            const auto bucket = type >> 6, bit = type & 63;
            if (!layout[0] || bucket >= 4 || !(layout[1 + bucket] & (uint64_t{1} << bit))) return;
            const auto lower = layout[1 + bucket] & ((uint64_t{1} << bit) - 1);
            const auto index = ((layout[5] >> (bucket * 8)) & 255) + std::popcount(lower);
            slot.address = layout[0] + index * 8;
        };
        for (size_t i = 0; i < types.size(); ++i) plan(slots[i], types[i], linked[i] ? link : component);
        if (owner.values[0] != owner.values[1])
            for (size_t i = 0; i < fallback.size(); ++i) plan(slots[13 + i], types[fallback[i]], link);
        stage = Stage::Slots;
        return true;
    }
    // A plan owns the byte counts and verification payload until the shared
    // scatter completes. Do not move a prepared plan or its ComponentRefresh.
    struct StepPlan {
        Stage stage=Stage::Empty;
        RefreshIdentity identity{};
        std::vector<RefreshRequest> requests;
        std::array<uint32_t,48> actual{};
        std::array<size_t,21> indexes{};
        std::array<size_t,13> chosen{};
        std::array<bool,21> selected{};
        RefreshHeader currentBody{},currentLink{};
        std::array<uint64_t,21> encoded{};
        std::array<uint8_t,21> types{};
        uint8_t a=0,b=0;
        void Read(uint64_t address,void* output,size_t size) {
            const auto index=requests.size();
            requests.push_back({address,output,size,&actual[index]});
        }
    };
    bool PrepareStep(const RefreshIdentity& current,uint32_t tick,StepPlan& plan) {
        plan=StepPlan{};
        if(!(current==identity) || uint32_t(tick-startedTick)>5000) {
            stage=Stage::Failed;return false;
        }
        if(!Active())return false;
        plan.stage=stage;plan.identity=identity;plan.requests.reserve(48);
        if(stage==Stage::Slots) {
            plan.Read(keyAddressA,&keyA,1);plan.Read(keyAddressB,&keyB,1);
            for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)if(slots[i].address) {
                plan.indexes[i]=plan.requests.size();
                plan.Read(slots[i].address,&slots[i].encoded,sizeof(slots[i].encoded));
            }
            return true;
        }
        if(stage==Stage::Types) {
            for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)if(slots[i].decoded) {
                plan.indexes[i]=plan.requests.size();
                plan.Read(slots[i].decoded+0x10,&slots[i].observedType,1);
            }
            return true;
        }
        constexpr std::array<size_t,8> fallback{0,2,3,4,6,7,8,11};
        for(size_t i=0;i<plan.chosen.size();++i)plan.chosen[i]=i;
        for(size_t i=0;i<fallback.size();++i)
            if(!slots[fallback[i]].decoded && slots[13+i].decoded)plan.chosen[fallback[i]]=13+i;
        for(const size_t field:std::array<size_t,5>{0,1,2,4,5}) {
            bool declared=slots[field].address!=0;
            for(size_t i=0;i<fallback.size();++i)if(fallback[i]==field)declared=declared || slots[13+i].address!=0;
            if(declared && !slots[plan.chosen[field]].decoded) {stage=Stage::Failed;return false;}
        }
        for(const auto index:plan.chosen)if(slots[index].decoded)plan.selected[index]=true;
        plan.Read(identity.values[0]+RefreshHeader::offset,plan.currentBody.bytes.data(),RefreshHeader::size);
        if(identity.values[0]!=identity.values[1])
            plan.Read(identity.values[1]+RefreshHeader::offset,plan.currentLink.bytes.data(),RefreshHeader::size);
        plan.Read(keyAddressA,&plan.a,1);plan.Read(keyAddressB,&plan.b,1);
        for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)if(plan.selected[i]) {
            plan.Read(slots[i].address,&plan.encoded[i],8);
            plan.Read(slots[i].decoded+0x10,&plan.types[i],1);
        }
        return true;
    }
    template<class Decode>
    Stage FinishStep(const RefreshIdentity& current,uint32_t tick,const StepPlan& plan,bool executed,Decode&& decode) {
        if(!(current==identity) || !(plan.identity==identity) || stage!=plan.stage ||
           uint32_t(tick-startedTick)>5000 || !executed)return stage=Stage::Failed;
        if(stage==Stage::Slots) {
            if(plan.actual[0]!=1 || plan.actual[1]!=1)return stage=Stage::Failed;
            for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)
                if(slots[i].address && plan.actual[plan.indexes[i]]!=8)slots[i].encoded=0;
            for(auto& slot:slots)if(slot.address && slot.encoded) {
                const auto value=decode(slot.encoded,keyA,keyB);
                if(value>=0x10000 && value<0x0000800000000000ULL)slot.decoded=value;
            }
            return stage=Stage::Types;
        }
        if(stage==Stage::Types) {
            for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)
                if(slots[i].decoded && (plan.actual[plan.indexes[i]]!=1 || slots[i].observedType!=slots[i].type))slots[i].decoded=0;
            return stage=Stage::Verify;
        }
        if(stage!=Stage::Verify)return stage=Stage::Failed;
        for(const auto& read:plan.requests)if(*read.actual!=read.size)return stage=Stage::Failed;
        const auto& finalLink=identity.values[0]==identity.values[1]?plan.currentBody:plan.currentLink;
        if(!component.SameAllocation(plan.currentBody,matchOffset) || !link.SameAllocation(finalLink,matchOffset) ||
           plan.a!=keyA || plan.b!=keyB)return stage=Stage::Failed;
        for(size_t i=0;i<slots.size();++i)
            if(plan.selected[i] && (plan.encoded[i]!=slots[i].encoded || plan.types[i]!=slots[i].type))return stage=Stage::Failed;
        for(size_t i=0;i<values.size();++i)values[i]=slots[plan.chosen[i]].decoded;
        verifiedTick=tick;
        return stage=Stage::Ready;
    }
    template<class Batch,class Decode>
    Stage Step(const RefreshIdentity& current,uint32_t tick,Batch&& batch,Decode&& decode) {
        StepPlan plan;
        if(!PrepareStep(current,tick,plan))return stage;
        const bool executed=plan.requests.empty() || batch(plan.requests);
        return FinishStep(current,tick,plan,executed,decode);
    }
};
}
```

```inl
                    auto exactBatch=[&](const std::vector<OW::EntityMaintenance::RefreshRequest>& requests) {
                        struct ScatterOwner {
                            VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE handle=mem.CreateScatterHandle();
                            ~ScatterOwner(){if(handle)mem.CloseScatterHandle(handle);}
                        } owner;
                        if(!owner.handle)return false;
                        // DWORD and uint32_t can be different C++ types on Windows.
                        std::vector<DWORD> counts(requests.size(),0);
                        std::vector<bool> prepared(requests.size(),false);
                        for(size_t n=0;n<requests.size();++n) {
                            const auto& request=requests[n];
                            prepared[n]=mem.AddScatterReadRequest(owner.handle,request.address,request.output,request.size,&counts[n]);
                        }
                        const bool executed=mem.ExecuteReadScatter(owner.handle);
                        for(size_t n=0;n<requests.size();++n)*requests[n].actual=prepared[n]?counts[n]:0;
                        // Close while PrepareEx's byte-count destinations still exist,
                        // including an Execute failure before its normal Clear.
                        mem.CloseScatterHandle(owner.handle);owner.handle=nullptr;
                        return executed;
                    };
                    const auto stage=pending.stage==OW::EntityMaintenance::ComponentRefresh::Stage::Ready
                        ? pending.stage : pending.Step(currentIdentity(),GetTickCount(),exactBatch,
                            [](uint64_t encoded,uint8_t a,uint8_t b){return OW::Cn155284::Component(encoded,a,b);});
                    if(!OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(processRegistry) || !(currentIdentity()==pending.identity)) {
                        pending={};continue;
                    }
                    if(stage!=OW::EntityMaintenance::ComponentRefresh::Stage::Ready)continue;
                }
```

```inl
                    OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.connection_epoch==connectionEpoch &&
                    OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.registry) &&
                    OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.generation !=
                        OW::last_consumed_raw_scan_generation) {
                    consumedLatestRawEntities = OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.raw_entities;
                    processRegistry=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.registry;
                    consumedActualMembers=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.actual_members;
                    consumedScanSource=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.source;
                    completeActorMembershipKnown=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_known;
                    cycleMemberPairs=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities;
                    latestCompleteActorMembers.clear();
                    for(const auto& pair:OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities)
                        latestCompleteActorMembers.insert(pair.first);
                    OW::last_consumed_raw_scan_generation =
                        OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.generation;
                    consumedLatestRawScan = true;
                    consumedRawScanThisCycle = true;
                    consumedCompleteScan = OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.complete;
                }
            } else {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
                if (OW::abletotread) {
                    if(OW::ow_entities_scene==processSceneGeneration && OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(OW::ow_entities_scan_registry)) {
                        OW::ow_entities = OW::ow_entities_scan;
                        OW::ow_entities_registry=OW::ow_entities_scan_registry;
                        consumedCompleteScan=OW::ow_entities_scan_complete;
                        consumedRawScanThisCycle = true;
                    }
                    OW::abletotread = 0;
                }
            }
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/FieldDeadline.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW {
struct FieldDeadline {
    uint32_t next = 0, attemptedAt = 0;
    bool attempted = false;
    bool Due(uint32_t now, uint32_t interval) const {
        // Enabling a faster consumer must not wait for the previous slow deadline.
        return !attempted || int32_t(now - next) >= 0 || uint32_t(now - attemptedAt) >= interval;
    }
    void Schedule(uint32_t now, uint32_t interval) {
        attempted = true; attemptedAt = now; next = now + interval;
    }
};
}
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/HealthCacheRecovery.inl`:

```inl
    auto refreshHealthBaseAfterTransportFailure = [&](OW::c_entity& failed, DWORD now) {
        const auto cached=componentBaseCache.find(failed.address);
        if(cached==componentBaseCache.end())return false;
        const auto* discovery=cycleDiscoveries.Find(failed.address,failed.LinkParent,now);
        if(!discovery || discovery->match!=failed.match_id)return false;
        OW::EntityHeaderSnapshot header;
        if(!header.Read(failed.address))return false;
        const auto health=OW::DecryptComponent(failed.address,OW::offset::Active().typeHealth,&header,true);
        if(!health)return false;
        std::array<uint64_t,6> layout{};
        // A moved health component can accompany moved team/position components.
        // Rebuild that whole cache instead of mixing addresses from two layouts.
        if (health != cached->second->health || !cached->second->layoutsKnown ||
            !header.ReadComponentLayout(layout) || layout != cached->second->componentLayout) {
            auto& previous=cached->second->entity;
            OW::RevokeEntityBodyObservation(previous.address,previous.actor_generation,previous.body_authority_revision);
            previous.body_valid=false;
            return false;
        }
        cached->second->health=health;cached->second->healthValid=false;
        failed.HealthBase=health;return true;
    };
```

```inl
            }
```

```hpp
namespace OW {
    struct EntityHotFieldReads {
        OW::velocity_fields_t velocity{};
        OW::ModelWorld::QstRecord modelWorld{};
        DWORD modelWorldBytes=0;
        bool modelWorldRequested=false;
        OW::health_fields_t health{};
        struct { uint64_t heroid=0; } hero;
        uint64_t visibilityRaw=0;

        std::array<DWORD,4> healthBytes{};
        DWORD heroBytes=0, visibilityBytes=0;
        DWORD deathBytes=0;
        bool deathRequested=false;
        bool velocityRequested=false, healthRequested=false, heroRequested=false, visibilityRequested=false;
        bool scatterExecuted=false, scatterOk=false;
        bool VelocityRead() const { return scatterOk && velocityRequested && velocityBytes[0]==12 && velocityBytes[1]==12; }
        bool DeathRead() const { return scatterOk && deathRequested && deathBytes==1 && health.death<=1; }
        bool HealthRead() const {
            const bool pooled = offset::Active().pooledHealth;
            const std::array<DWORD,4> expected = pooled
                ? std::array<DWORD,4>{kCnHealthPoolBytes,kCnHealthPoolBytes,kCnHealthPoolBytes,2}
                : std::array<DWORD,4>{32,8,8,2};
            return DeathRead() && healthRequested && healthBytes == expected;
        }
        bool HeroRead() const { return scatterOk && heroRequested && heroBytes==8; }
        bool VisibilityRead() const { return scatterOk && visibilityRequested && visibilityBytes==8; }
    };
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/HotLifeTransition.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/Entity.hpp"

namespace OW::HotLifeTransition {

inline bool NeedsCurrentLifeRead(const c_entity& previous) noexcept {
    return previous.roster_state != EntityRosterState::Fresh ||
        !previous.Alive || !previous.body_valid;
}

// Missing hides a sample; only an observed death ends the body's lifetime.
// This selects the hot recovery route, not admission: the caller must still
// validate discovery/membership, the observation window and AdmitEntityBodyObservation.
inline bool CanResumeMissingBody(const c_entity& previous, const c_entity& current,
    bool completeCurrentHealth, EntityBodyObservation observation,
    uint64_t epoch, uint64_t scene, uint32_t now) {
    if (previous.roster_state != EntityRosterState::Missing || previous.Alive ||
        !previous.death_known || previous.is_dead || !previous.death_sample_tick_ms ||
        !completeCurrentHealth || !current.Alive || !current.HasFreshLifeState(now) ||
        !std::isfinite(current.PlayerHealth) || current.PlayerHealth <= 0 ||
        !previous.address || !previous.LinkParent || !previous.match_id || !previous.HeroID ||
        !previous.actor_generation || previous.address != current.address ||
        previous.LinkParent != current.LinkParent || previous.match_id != current.match_id ||
        previous.HeroID != current.HeroID || previous.actor_generation != current.actor_generation ||
        !epoch || previous.connection_epoch != epoch || current.connection_epoch != epoch ||
        !scene || previous.scene_generation != scene || current.scene_generation != scene ||
        previous.body_absence_revision != current.body_absence_revision ||
        previous.body_absence_revision != observation.absence)
        return false;

    // Only visibility invalidation is recoverable here. A real revocation,
    // death or replacement still needs full reconciliation. Admission repeats
    // the fence/context checks atomically before publication.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(entityBodyValidityMutex);
    const auto found = entityBodyAuthorities.find(previous.address);
    if (found == entityBodyAuthorities.end()) return false;
    const auto& authority = found->second;
    return authority.admitted && authority.alive &&
        authority.revision == previous.body_authority_revision &&
        authority.generation == previous.actor_generation &&
        authority.epoch == epoch && authority.scene == scene &&
        authority.absence == observation.absence && authority.revision <= observation.fence &&
        authority.identity.link == previous.LinkParent && authority.identity.match == previous.match_id &&
        authority.identity.hero == previous.HeroID;
}

inline bool RequiresFullReconciliation(const c_entity& previous, const c_entity& current,
    bool completeCurrentHealth, EntityBodyObservation observation,
    uint64_t epoch, uint64_t scene, uint32_t now, bool heroRead, uint64_t observedHero,
    bool heroRequired = false) {
    if (NeedsCurrentLifeRead(previous) && heroRequired && (!heroRead || !observedHero)) return true;
    if (heroRead && observedHero != 0 && observedHero != current.HeroID) return true;
    return current.Alive && !previous.Alive &&
        !CanResumeMissingBody(previous, current, completeCurrentHealth, observation, epoch, scene, now);
}

}
```

```inl
// Requests point into owner-thread buffers until ExecuteReadScatter clears them.
        auto recordHotScatterPrepare = [&](uint64_t address, size_t size, bool prepared) {
            ++pipelineStats.hotScatterPrepareRequestedCount;
            pipelineStats.hotScatterBytesRequested += size;
            if (prepared) ++pipelineStats.hotScatterPrepareSuccessCount;
            else ++pipelineStats.hotScatterPrepareFailCount;
            if(size) {
                const auto last=(address+size-1)&kScatterPageMask;
                for(auto page=address&kScatterPageMask;;page+=0x1000) {
                    hotScatterPages.insert(page);
                    if(page==last)break;
                }
            }
            pipelineStats.hotScatterEstimatedUniquePages = hotScatterPages.size();
        };
        auto prepareHotFields = [&](VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE handle, EntityHotFieldReads& reads,
                uint64_t velocityBase, bool readVelocity, uint64_t healthBase, bool readHealth,
                uint64_t heroBase, bool readHero, uint64_t visibilityAddress, bool readVisibility) {
            if (!handle) return false;
            auto request = [&](uint64_t at, void* destination, size_t size, DWORD& bytes) {
                ++pipelineStats.hotScatterRequestedCount;
                const bool ok = mem.AddScatterReadRequest(handle, at, destination, size, &bytes);
                recordHotScatterPrepare(at, size, ok);
            };
            if (readVelocity && velocityBase) {
                reads.velocityRequested = true;
                request(velocityBase + 0x50, &reads.velocity.velocity, 12, reads.velocityBytes[0]);
                request(velocityBase + 0x200, &reads.velocity.location, 12, reads.velocityBytes[1]);
                request(velocityBase + 0x8B0, &reads.velocity.bonedata, 8, reads.velocityBytes[2]);
                if(offset::ActiveProfile()==offset::RuntimeProfile::Cn) {
                    reads.modelWorldRequested=true;
                    request(velocityBase+0x3B0,&reads.modelWorld,sizeof(reads.modelWorld),reads.modelWorldBytes);
                }
            }
            if (healthBase) {
                reads.deathRequested = true;
                request(healthBase + OW::kHealthDeathOffset, &reads.health.death, 1, reads.deathBytes);
            }
            if (readHealth && healthBase) {
                reads.healthRequested = true;
                const bool pooled = offset::Active().pooledHealth;
                if (pooled) {
                    for (size_t pool = 0; pool < 3; ++pool)
                        request(healthBase + 0xD8 + pool * OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes,
                            reads.health.cnPools[pool].data(), OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes, reads.healthBytes[pool]);
                } else {
                    request(healthBase + 0xDC, reads.health.vital.data(), 32, reads.healthBytes[0]);
                    request(healthBase + 0x21C, &reads.health.armor, 8, reads.healthBytes[1]);
                    request(healthBase + 0x35C, &reads.health.barrier, 8, reads.healthBytes[2]);
                }
                request(healthBase + (pooled ? 0x568 : 0x4A8), reads.health.flags.data(), 2, reads.healthBytes[3]);
            }
            if (readHero && heroBase) {
                reads.heroRequested = true;
                request(heroBase + 0xD0, &reads.hero.heroid, 8, reads.heroBytes);
            }
            if (readVisibility && visibilityAddress) {
                reads.visibilityRequested = true;
                request(visibilityAddress, &reads.visibilityRaw, 8, reads.visibilityBytes);
            }
            return reads.velocityRequested || reads.deathRequested || reads.healthRequested || reads.heroRequested || reads.visibilityRequested;
        };
        auto countHotFieldRequests = [](const EntityHotFieldReads& reads) {
            return size_t(reads.velocityRequested) * 3 + size_t(reads.modelWorldRequested) + size_t(reads.healthRequested) * 4 +
                size_t(reads.deathRequested) + size_t(reads.heroRequested) + size_t(reads.visibilityRequested);
        };
        auto recordHotScatterReadResults = [&](const EntityHotFieldReads& reads) {
            auto field = [&](DWORD actual, DWORD expected) {
                pipelineStats.hotScatterBytesRead += actual;
                if (actual != expected) ++pipelineStats.hotScatterShortReadCount;
            };
            if (reads.velocityRequested) { field(reads.velocityBytes[0],12); field(reads.velocityBytes[1],12); field(reads.velocityBytes[2],8); }
            if (reads.modelWorldRequested) field(reads.modelWorldBytes,sizeof(reads.modelWorld));
            if (reads.healthRequested) {
                const bool pooled = offset::Active().pooledHealth;
                field(reads.healthBytes[0],pooled ? OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes : 32);
                field(reads.healthBytes[1],pooled ? OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes : 8);
                field(reads.healthBytes[2],pooled ? OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes : 8);
                field(reads.healthBytes[3],2);
            }
            if (reads.deathRequested) field(reads.deathBytes,1);
            if (reads.heroRequested) field(reads.heroBytes,8);
            if (reads.visibilityRequested) field(reads.visibilityBytes,8);
        };
        auto readHotFields = [&](VMMDLL_SCATTER_HANDLE handle, uint64_t velocityBase, bool readVelocity,
                uint64_t healthBase, bool readHealth, uint64_t heroBase, bool readHero,
                uint64_t visibilityAddress, bool readVisibility) {
            EntityHotFieldReads reads{};
            if (!prepareHotFields(handle, reads, velocityBase, readVelocity, healthBase, readHealth,
                    heroBase, readHero, visibilityAddress, readVisibility)) return reads;
            reads.scatterExecuted = true;
            {
                ScopedPipelinePhaseTimer timer(pipelineStats.phase.hotScatterExecuteMs);
                reads.scatterOk = mem.ExecuteReadScatter(handle);
            }
            ++pipelineStats.hotScatterExecuteCount;
            if (!reads.scatterOk) ++pipelineStats.hotScatterExecuteFailCount;
            recordHotScatterReadResults(reads);
            return reads;
        };
        auto readHealthFields = [&](uint64_t base, OW::health_fields_t& health) {
            const bool pooled = offset::Active().pooledHealth;
            const bool poolsRead = pooled
                ? SDK->read_range(base+0xD8,health.cnPools[0].data(),OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes) &&
                  SDK->read_range(base+0x258,health.cnPools[1].data(),OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes) &&
                  SDK->read_range(base+0x3D8,health.cnPools[2].data(),OW::kCnHealthPoolBytes)
                : SDK->read_range(base+0xDC,health.vital.data(),32) &&
                  SDK->read_range(base+0x21C,&health.armor,8) &&
                  SDK->read_range(base+0x35C,&health.barrier,8);
            return poolsRead &&
                SDK->read_range(base+(pooled?0x568:0x4A8),health.flags.data(),2) &&
                SDK->read_range(base+OW::kHealthDeathOffset,&health.death,1) && health.death<=1;
        };
```

```inl
// Owner-thread local handoff: current controller evidence does not wait for a full roster.
        auto verifyCurrentLocalBinding = [&](const OW::c_entity& candidate, uint32_t controllerUid,
                const char*& failure,uint64_t* observedHero=nullptr) {
            const auto fail=[&](const char* reason){failure=reason;return false;};
            failure=nullptr;
            if(observedHero)*observedHero=0;
            if(!offset::UsesProtectedEntityLayout() || !candidate.AngleBase)return fail("local_controller_missing");
            OW::EntityHeaderSnapshot actorHeader{},controllerHeader{};
            if(!actorHeader.Read(candidate.address) || !controllerHeader.Read(candidate.LinkParent))
                return fail("live_header_read_failed");
            uint32_t actorMatch=0,parentMatch=0;
            if(!actorHeader.ReadParentOffset(offset::Entity_MatchId,actorMatch) ||
               !controllerHeader.ReadParentOffset(offset::Entity_MatchId,parentMatch))return fail("live_identity_read_failed");
            if(actorMatch!=candidate.match_id || !actorMatch)return fail("live_actor_changed");
            if(parentMatch!=controllerUid || !parentMatch)return fail("live_controller_changed");
            const auto link=OW::DecryptComponent(candidate.LinkParent,offset::Active().typeLink,&controllerHeader,true);
            const auto angle=OW::DecryptComponent(candidate.LinkParent,offset::Active().typePlayerController,&controllerHeader,true);
            if(!link || link!=candidate.LinkBase || !angle || angle!=candidate.AngleBase)
                return fail("live_components_changed");
            std::array<uint32_t,2> ids{};
            if(!SDK->read_range(link+offset::Link_TargetId,ids.data(),sizeof(ids)))return fail("live_pair_read_failed");
            if(ids[1]!=actorMatch)return fail("live_pair_mismatch");
            const auto mapped=OW::ResolveCnLinkTargetMapBase(link,offset::Link_UniqueId);
            if(mapped && mapped!=candidate.address)return fail("live_pair_other_context");
            if(!mapped) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);
                const auto& topology=OW::observed_entity_topology;
                if(std::count_if(topology.member_ids.begin(),topology.member_ids.end(),
                    [&](const auto& member){return member.second==actorMatch;})>1)
                    return fail("live_pair_ambiguous");
            }
            auto hero=OW::DecryptComponent(candidate.LinkParent,offset::Active().typeHeroId,&controllerHeader,true);
            if(!hero)hero=OW::DecryptComponent(candidate.address,offset::Active().typeHeroId,&actorHeader,true);
            uint64_t heroId=0;
            if(!hero || hero!=candidate.HeroBase || !SDK->read_range(hero+0xD0,&heroId,sizeof(heroId)))
                return fail("live_hero_read_failed");
            if(observedHero)*observedHero=heroId;
            if(!OW::GameData::IsKnownHeroId(heroId))return fail("live_hero_unknown");
            if(heroId!=candidate.HeroID)return fail("live_hero_changed");
            std::array<uint32_t,2> finalIds{};
            uint32_t finalActor=0,finalParent=0;
            if(!SDK->read_range(link+offset::Link_TargetId,finalIds.data(),sizeof(finalIds)) ||
               !SDK->read_range(candidate.address+offset::Entity_MatchId,&finalActor,sizeof(finalActor)) ||
               !SDK->read_range(candidate.LinkParent+offset::Entity_MatchId,&finalParent,sizeof(finalParent)))
                return fail("live_recheck_read_failed");
            if(finalIds!=ids || finalActor!=actorMatch || finalParent!=parentMatch)return fail("live_binding_changed");
            return true;
        };
        auto publishCurrentLocalBinding = [&](const OW::EntityRosterPolicy::Discovery& proof) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);
            if(!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
               OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch()!=connectionEpoch ||
               OW::EntitySceneGeneration()!=processSceneGeneration || !OW::AcceptEntityRegistry(processRegistry))return false;
            OW::RawEntityScanSnapshot sample{};
            sample.connection_epoch=connectionEpoch;sample.scene_generation=processSceneGeneration;sample.registry=processRegistry;
            sample.raw_entities={{proof.address,proof.link}};sample.actual_members={proof.address};sample.discoveries={proof};
            sample.binding_entities=sample.raw_entities;sample.binding_complete=true;sample.source=2;sample.valid=true;
            auto previous=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities;
            OW::MergeRecentRawDiscovery(sample);
            auto current=sample.membership_entities;
            std::sort(previous.begin(),previous.end());std::sort(current.begin(),current.end());
            if(previous!=current)++OW::observed_topology_revision;
            sample.generation=++OW::raw_scan_publication_sequence;
            OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot=std::move(sample);
            cycleDiscoveries=OW::entity_discoveries;
            cycleMemberPairs=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities;
            completeActorMembershipKnown=OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_known;
            latestCompleteActorMembers.clear();
            for(const auto& pair:cycleMemberPairs)latestCompleteActorMembers.insert(pair.first);
            return true;
        };
```

```inl
// Runs once on the acquisition owner before actor discovery/early exits.
// Scene transitions and the optional colored-outline switch do not own this setting.
#ifndef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
        {
            namespace Brightness = OW::OutlineBrightness;
            const auto requested = Brightness::Snapshot();
            const auto shutdownRestore = Brightness::ShutdownRestoreRequest.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const bool restoreForShutdown = shutdownRestore !=
                Brightness::ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const bool enabled = requested.enabled && !restoreForShutdown;
            auto& state = nativeBrightnessState;
            const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            if (restoreForShutdown && !state.owned) {
                Brightness::ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged.store(shutdownRestore, std::memory_order_release);
            }
            if ((restoreForShutdown && state.owned) || state.Due(now, enabled, requested.revision)) {
                const auto previousResult = state.result;
                const auto previousRevision = state.appliedRevision;
                state.nextAttempt = now + 500;
                state.triedRevision = requested.revision;
                const uint64_t base = SDK->dwGameBase;
                auto read = [](uint64_t at, void* data, size_t size) { return mem.ReadFreshExact(at, data, size); };
                auto write = [](uint64_t at, const void* data, size_t size) { return mem.Write(at, data, size); };
                Brightness::Target target{};
                Brightness::Result failure = Brightness::Result::ReadFailed;
                if (Brightness::Resolve(base, runtimeProfile, read, target, &failure)) {
                    auto current = [&] {
                        Brightness::Target checked{};
                        return OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
                            offset::ActiveProfile() == runtimeProfile && SDK->dwGameBase == base &&
                            Brightness::Resolve(base, runtimeProfile, read, checked) && checked == target;
                    };
                    if (enabled) {
                        state.Apply(target, requested.value, requested.revision, read, write, current);
                    } else if (state.target == target) {
                        state.Restore(read, write, current);
                    } else {
                        // A new array/profile no longer owns the old allocation.
                        state.Abandon();
                        state.result = Brightness::Result::Changed;
                    }
                } else state.result = failure;
                Brightness::AppliedCount = enabled && state.appliedRevision == requested.revision &&
                    state.result == Brightness::Result::Applied ? 1 : 0;
                Brightness::FailureCount = Brightness::IsFailure(state.result) ? 1 : 0;
                Brightness::RestoreCount = !enabled && state.owned ? 1 : 0;
                Brightness::LastResult = state.result;
                if (restoreForShutdown && !state.owned)
                    Brightness::ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged.store(shutdownRestore, std::memory_order_release);
                if (state.result != previousResult || state.appliedRevision != previousRevision)
                    Diagnostics::Info("Native outline brightness: profile=%s address=0x%llX percent=%.9g revision=%llu original=%.9g written=%.9g result=%s.",
                        offset::Active().name, static_cast<unsigned long long>(target.value), double(requested.value),
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(requested.revision), double(std::bit_cast<float>(state.original)),
                        double(std::bit_cast<float>(state.written)), Brightness::ResultText(state.result));
            }
        }
#endif
```

```inl
                        held.scan_seen_gap_ms = entity.scan_seen_gap_ms;
                        held.hot_read_gap_ms = entity.hot_read_gap_ms;
                        held.consecutive_scan_miss_count = rosterEntry.consecutiveScanMissCount;
                        // Preserve positions and their original observation clocks.
                        rosterEntry.entity = held;
                        rosterEntry.seenThisCycle = true;
                        rosterEntry.skippedJumpObservations++;
                        tmp_entities.push_back(held);
                        if (detailedProcessLog) {
                            Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 4 observation_gate skip_jump idx=%zu roster=0x%llX skipped=%d.",
                                i,
                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(entity.roster_key),
                                rosterEntry.skippedJumpObservations);
                        }
                        continue;
                    }

                    resetRenderHistory(entity, entity.anchor_sample_tick_ms);
                    if (detailedProcessLog) {
                        Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 4 observation_gate accept_jump_reset idx=%zu roster=0x%llX skipped=%d.",
                            i,
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(entity.roster_key),
                            rosterEntry.skippedJumpObservations);
                    }
                } else {
                    // Compare successive *observations*, not the last filtered
                    // output, so a persistent valid pose is accepted next time.
                    const OW::c_entity rawObservation = entity;
                    const size_t suppressedPoints = stabilizeObservationPointOutliers(
                        entity,
                        rosterEntry.entity,
                        rosterEntry.lastRawObservation.address ? rosterEntry.lastRawObservation : rosterEntry.entity,
                        entity.anchor_sample_tick_ms);
                    rosterEntry.lastRawObservation = rawObservation;
                    if (suppressedPoints > 0 && detailedProcessLog) {
                        Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 4 observation_gate suppress_points idx=%zu roster=0x%llX count=%zu.",
                            i,
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(entity.roster_key),
                            suppressedPoints);
                    }
                    attachPreviousRenderSample(entity);
                }

                entity.last_seen_tick_ms = entity.anchor_sample_tick_ms;
                rosterEntry.entity = entity;
                if(localStats.selectedAddress==entity.address) {
                    if(OW::TryCommitLocalEntity(entity,entityAdmissionNow()))localCycleSnapshot=entity;
                }
                rosterEntry.seenThisCycle = true;
                rosterEntry.skippedJumpObservations = 0;
                tmp_entities.push_back(entity);
            } else {
                if (name == "Unknown") {
                    processStats.nameUnknown++;
                    recordNameUnknownSample(entity, ComponentParent, LinkParent, name);
                }
                Diagnostics::RecordInvalidEntity();
            }

            }
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/ParticipantReplacement.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/Overwatch.hpp"
#include "Game/ParticipantIdentity.hpp"

namespace OW::EntityMaintenance {
struct ParticipantReplacementVerifier {
    using Context=EntityRosterPolicy::ParticipantBindingContext;
    using Proof=EntityRosterPolicy::VerifiedDeadParticipantReplacement;

    static bool Matches(const Context& saved,const c_entity& body,uint32_t controllerUid,
            std::string_view label,const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene) {
        return saved.address==body.address && saved.link==body.LinkParent && saved.linkBase==body.LinkBase &&
            saved.match==body.match_id && saved.hero==body.HeroID && saved.generation==body.actor_generation &&
            saved.epoch==registry.epoch && saved.scene==scene && saved.registry==registry.generation &&
            saved.controllerUid==controllerUid && saved.label==label;
    }

    template<class Record,class Clock>
    static void Maintain(Record& record,const c_entity& body,const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,
            uint64_t scene,Clock&& clock) {
        if(offset::Active().componentTransform!=offset::ComponentTransformMode::Cn155284 ||
            !body.actor_generation || !record.participantKey || !record.participantIdentityValid)return;
        const bool same=Matches(record.participantBindingContext,body,record.participantControllerUid,
            record.participantLabel,registry,scene);
        const auto now=clock();
        if(same && (record.participantBindingContext.context || (record.participantBindingContextAttemptTick &&
            uint32_t(now-record.participantBindingContextAttemptTick)<250)))return;
        // Identity can arrive after the hot body was applied. Only a new capture
        // needs a body copy with the newly obtained participant key and stat.
        auto identified=body;identified.participant_key=record.participantKey;identified.statcombase=record.stat;
        if(!AuthorityCurrent(identified,registry,scene,false))return;
        record.participantBindingContextAttemptTick=now;
        record.participantBindingContext=Capture(identified,record.participantControllerUid,record.participantLabel,registry,scene,clock);
        if(!AuthorityCurrent(identified,registry,scene,false))record.participantBindingContext.context=0;
    }

    template<class Clock>
    static Proof Verify(const c_entity& previous,uint32_t previousControllerUid,std::string_view previousLabel,
            const Context& saved,const c_entity& incoming,uint32_t incomingControllerUid,std::string_view incomingLabel,
            const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene,Clock&& clock,const char** failure=nullptr) {
        if(failure)*failure=nullptr;
        const auto fail=[&](const char* reason){if(failure)*failure=reason;return Proof{};};
        if(previous.address==incoming.address || previous.roster_state!=EntityRosterState::Dead || previous.Alive ||
            !previous.death_known || !previous.is_dead || !previous.death_sample_tick_ms || !previous.actor_generation)
            return fail("previous_death_unconfirmed");
        if(!incoming.Alive || !incoming.HasFreshLifeState(clock()) || !incoming.participant_key ||
            previous.participant_key!=incoming.participant_key || previousLabel!=incomingLabel ||
            !EntityRosterPolicy::ReliableParticipantId(incomingLabel) ||
            EntityRosterPolicy::ParticipantRosterKey(incomingLabel)!=incoming.participant_key)
            return fail("replacement_participant_unconfirmed");
        if(!saved.context || !Matches(saved,previous,previousControllerUid,previousLabel,registry,scene))
            return fail("previous_context_unconfirmed");
        if(!AuthorityCurrent(previous,registry,scene,true))return fail("previous_death_superseded");
        CnLinkTargetMapIdentity map;
        if(!ReadCurrent(incoming,incomingControllerUid,incomingLabel,registry,scene,true,clock,map,failure))return {};
        // The map context is the current controller parent. A respawn or
        // component relocation can legitimately give the successor a new
        // controller, so it must not equal the predecessor's saved context.
        // ReadCurrent already proves that the successor's map resolves to its
        // own controller and actor pair.
        if(map.context!=saved.context && map.context!=incoming.LinkParent)
            return fail("replacement_context_changed");
        if(!AuthorityCurrent(previous,registry,scene,true))return fail("previous_death_superseded");
        return Proof{true};
    }

private:
    static bool Current(const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene) {
        return offset::Active().componentTransform==offset::ComponentTransformMode::Cn155284 &&
            RuntimeWorkersRunning() && ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
            ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch()==registry.epoch && EntitySceneGeneration()==scene && AcceptEntityRegistry(registry);
    }
    static bool AuthorityCurrent(const c_entity& previous,const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene,bool requireDead) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> registryLock(entityRegistryMonitor.mutex);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> bodyLock(entityBodyValidityMutex);
        const EntityRosterPolicy::Discovery identity{previous.address,previous.LinkParent,previous.HeroID,previous.match_id,0};
        if(!RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
            ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch()!=registry.epoch || EntitySceneGeneration()!=scene ||
            !entityRegistryMonitor.state.Accept(registry) || previous.connection_epoch!=registry.epoch ||
            previous.scene_generation!=scene || !EntityBodyAuthorityMatchesLocked(identity,previous.actor_generation,
                previous.body_authority_revision,registry.epoch,scene,previous.body_absence_revision))return false;
        const auto& authority=entityBodyAuthorities.at(previous.address);
        return authority.registry==registry.generation && (!requireDead || !authority.alive);
    }
    template<class Clock>
    static Context Capture(const c_entity& body,uint32_t controllerUid,std::string_view label,
            const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene,Clock&& clock) {
        Context saved{body.address,body.LinkParent,body.LinkBase,body.HeroID,body.actor_generation,
            registry.epoch,scene,registry.generation,0,0,0,body.match_id,controllerUid,std::string(label)};
        CnLinkTargetMapIdentity map;
        if(ReadCurrent(body,controllerUid,label,registry,scene,false,clock,map,nullptr)) {
            saved.context=map.context;saved.owner=map.owner;saved.buckets=map.buckets;
        }
        return saved;
    }
    template<class Clock>
    static bool ReadCurrent(const c_entity& body,uint32_t controllerUid,std::string_view label,
            const EntityRegistry::Snapshot& registry,uint64_t scene,bool requireHealth,Clock&& clock,
            CnLinkTargetMapIdentity& map,const char** failure) {
        const auto fail=[&](const char* reason){if(failure)*failure=reason;return false;};
        const auto started=clock();
        if(!Current(registry,scene) || !body.address || !body.LinkParent || !body.match_id || !controllerUid ||
            !body.participant_key || !EntityRosterPolicy::ReliableParticipantId(label) ||
            EntityRosterPolicy::ParticipantRosterKey(label)!=body.participant_key)return fail("replacement_context_changed");
        // Re-resolve current components: cached participant strings and HP cannot prove a successor.
        const auto readHeaders=[&](EntityHeaderSnapshot& actor,EntityHeaderSnapshot& controller) {
            uint32_t actorId=0,parentId=0;
            if(!actor.Read(body.address) || !controller.Read(body.LinkParent) ||
                !actor.ReadParentOffset(offset::Entity_MatchId,actorId) || actorId!=body.match_id ||
                !controller.ReadParentOffset(offset::Entity_MatchId,parentId) || parentId!=controllerUid)return false;
            const auto link=DecryptComponent(body.LinkParent,offset::Active().typeLink,&controller,true);
            const auto stat=DecryptComponent(body.LinkParent,TYPE_STAT,&controller,true);
            const auto health=DecryptComponent(body.address,offset::Active().typeHealth,&actor,true);
            auto hero=DecryptComponent(body.LinkParent,offset::Active().typeHeroId,&controller,true);
            if(!hero)hero=DecryptComponent(body.address,offset::Active().typeHeroId,&actor,true);
            return link && link==body.LinkBase && stat && stat==body.statcombase &&
                health && health==body.HealthBase && hero && hero==body.HeroBase;
        };
        EntityHeaderSnapshot actor,controller;
        if(!readHeaders(actor,controller))return fail("replacement_header_changed");
        std::array<uint32_t,2> ids{};
        if(!SDK->read_range(body.LinkBase+offset::Link_TargetId,ids.data(),sizeof(ids)))return fail("replacement_pair_read_failed");
        const auto idOffset=ids[1]==body.match_id?offset::Link_UniqueId:offset::Link_TargetId;
        if(ids[idOffset==offset::Link_UniqueId?1:0]!=body.match_id)return fail("replacement_pair_mismatch");
        uint32_t mappedId=0;
        if(ResolveCnLinkTargetMapBase(body.LinkBase,idOffset,&mappedId,&map)!=body.address || mappedId!=body.match_id)
            return fail("replacement_map_unconfirmed");
        std::string liveLabel;
        if(!ReadParticipantLabel(body.statcombase,[](uint64_t at,void* out,size_t size){return SDK->read_range(at,out,size);},liveLabel) ||
            liveLabel!=label)return fail("replacement_live_participant_changed");
        uint64_t hero=0;
        if(!SDK->read_range(body.HeroBase+0xD0,&hero,sizeof(hero)) || hero!=body.HeroID || !GameData::IsKnownHeroId(hero))
            return fail("replacement_hero_changed");
        if(requireHealth) {
            health_compo_t raw{};HealthPayloadSummary health;
            if(!SDK->read_range(body.HealthBase,&raw,sizeof(raw)) || !TryParseHealthPayload(raw,health) ||
                health.isDead || health.total<=0)return fail("replacement_health_unconfirmed");
        }
        EntityHeaderSnapshot finalActor,finalController;
        std::array<uint64_t,6> actorLayout{},controllerLayout{},finalActorLayout{},finalControllerLayout{};
        if(!readHeaders(finalActor,finalController) || !actor.ReadComponentLayout(actorLayout) ||
            !controller.ReadComponentLayout(controllerLayout) || !finalActor.ReadComponentLayout(finalActorLayout) ||
            !finalController.ReadComponentLayout(finalControllerLayout) || actorLayout!=finalActorLayout || controllerLayout!=finalControllerLayout)
            return fail("replacement_header_changed");
        CnLinkTargetMapIdentity finalMap;
        std::array<uint32_t,2> finalIds{};
        if(!SDK->read_range(body.LinkBase+offset::Link_TargetId,finalIds.data(),sizeof(finalIds)) || finalIds!=ids ||
            ResolveCnLinkTargetMapBase(body.LinkBase,idOffset,&mappedId,&finalMap)!=body.address ||
            mappedId!=body.match_id || finalMap!=map)return fail("replacement_map_changed");
        const auto finished=clock();
        if(!Current(registry,scene) || uint32_t(finished-started)>100 ||
            (requireHealth && !body.HasFreshLifeState(finished)))return fail("replacement_sample_expired");
        return true;
    }
};
}
```

```inl
        auto attachPreviousRenderSample = [&](OW::c_entity& entity) {
            const DWORD sampleTick = entity.anchor_sample_tick_ms;
            entity.render_sample_tick_ms = sampleTick;

            const OW::c_entity* previousEntity = nullptr;
            const auto previousIt = previousEntityByAddress.find(entity.address);
            if (previousIt != previousEntityByAddress.end())
                previousEntity = previousIt->second;
            if (!previousEntity && entity.roster_key != 0) {
                const auto rosterPreviousIt = previousEntityByRosterKey.find(entity.roster_key);

                previousEntity->PresentationIdentity(),entity.PresentationIdentity())) previousEntity=nullptr;
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/RefreshBatch.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "ComponentRefresh.hpp"
#include <memory>
#include <span>

namespace OW::EntityMaintenance {
// Each actor keeps its own transaction, failures and identity. Only the I/O
// execution is shared; a short optional field cannot invalidate another actor.
template<class Identity,class Clock,class Batch,class Decode>
size_t AdvanceRefreshBatch(std::span<ComponentRefresh*> owners,Identity&& identity,Clock&& clock,
                          Batch&& batch,Decode&& decode,std::span<const RefreshRequest> extra={}) {
    std::vector<std::unique_ptr<ComponentRefresh::StepPlan>> plans(owners.size());
    std::vector<RefreshRequest> reads;
    reads.reserve(owners.size()*32);
    reads.insert(reads.end(),extra.begin(),extra.end());
    for(size_t i=0;i<owners.size();++i) {
        if(!owners[i] || !owners[i]->Active())continue;
        auto plan=std::make_unique<ComponentRefresh::StepPlan>();
        if(!owners[i]->PrepareStep(identity(i),clock(),*plan))continue;
        reads.insert(reads.end(),plan->requests.begin(),plan->requests.end());
        plans[i]=std::move(plan);
    }
    const bool executed=reads.empty() || batch(reads);
    size_t advanced=0;
    for(size_t i=0;i<owners.size();++i)if(plans[i]) {
        owners[i]->FinishStep(identity(i),clock(),*plans[i],executed,decode);
        ++advanced;
    }
    return advanced;
}

// Exact byte counts are per request even if PrepareEx queued a payload before
// returning failure. Close before destroying the destination/count storage.
template<class MemoryBackend>
bool ReadRefreshBatch(MemoryBackend& memory,const std::vector<RefreshRequest>& requests) {
    auto handle=memory.CreateScatterHandle();
    if(!handle)return false;
    struct Owner {
        MemoryBackend& memory;decltype(handle)& handleRef;
        ~Owner(){if(handleRef)memory.CloseScatterHandle(handleRef);}
    } owner{memory,handle};
    std::vector<unsigned long> counts(requests.size(),0);
    std::vector<bool> prepared(requests.size(),false);
    for(size_t i=0;i<requests.size();++i) {
        const auto& request=requests[i];
        prepared[i]=memory.AddScatterReadRequest(handle,request.address,request.output,request.size,&counts[i]);
    }
    const bool executed=memory.ExecuteReadScatter(handle);
    for(size_t i=0;i<requests.size();++i)*requests[i].actual=prepared[i]?counts[i]:0;
    memory.CloseScatterHandle(handle);handle=nullptr;
    return executed;
}
```

```inl
// Shared lexical step of entity_thread.
    DWORD lastTopologyRescanRequestTick = 0;
    DWORD lastRespawnTopologyRescanRequestTick = 0;
    auto requestTopologyRescan = [&](DWORD requestTick,
                                     bool bypassCooldown = false) -> bool {
        if (!coldTopologyScanEnabled)
            return false;
        if (!bypassCooldown && lastTopologyRescanRequestTick != 0 &&
            requestTick - lastTopologyRescanRequestTick <
                OW::kEntityTopologyRescanCooldownMs) {
            return false;
        }

        uint64_t requestCount = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
            if (OW::entity_topology_rescan_request_count !=
                    OW::entity_topology_rescan_completed_request_count ||
                (OW::entity_fast_scan_until_tick != 0 &&
                 requestTick < OW::entity_fast_scan_until_tick)) {
                return false;
            }
            requestCount = ++OW::entity_topology_rescan_request_count;
            OW::entity_fast_scan_until_tick =
                requestTick + OW::kEntityFastRescanWindowMs;
        }
        lastTopologyRescanRequestTick = requestTick;
        Diagnostics::Trace(
            "Entity topology rescan requested by processor: bypass_cooldown=%d request=%llu.",
            bypassCooldown ? 1 : 0,
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(requestCount));
        return true;
    };
```

```inl
// Shared lexical step of entity_thread; requires its surrounding cycle state.
#include "Game/EntityMaintenance/SanitizeRoster.inl"

    constexpr float kObservationTeleportBaseMeters = 8.0f;
    constexpr float kObservationMaxSpeedMetersPerSecond = 120.0f;
    constexpr DWORD kObservationPreviousMaxAgeMs = 250;
    constexpr int kObservationMaxSkippedJumpFrames = 2;
    constexpr float kObservationPointJumpBaseMeters = 3.0f;
    constexpr float kObservationPointJumpAnchorSlackMeters = 2.0f;

    auto isFiniteVector = [](const Vector3& value) {
        return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
    };

    auto isUsableVector = [&](const Vector3& value) {
        return isFiniteVector(value) && value != Vector3(0, 0, 0);
    };

    auto observationAnchor = [&](const OW::c_entity& entity) {
        if (isUsableVector(entity.pos))
            return entity.pos;
        if (isUsableVector(entity.chest_pos))
            return entity.chest_pos;
        if (isUsableVector(entity.neck_pos))
            return entity.neck_pos;
        return entity.head_pos;
    };

    auto hasRenderableAnchor = [&](const OW::c_entity& entity) {
        if (isUsableVector(entity.pos) ||
            isUsableVector(entity.head_pos) ||
            isUsableVector(entity.neck_pos) ||
            isUsableVector(entity.chest_pos) ||
            (entity.cached_bot_chest_bone_valid && isUsableVector(entity.cached_bot_chest_bone))) {
            return true;
        }

        for (size_t boneIndex = 0; boneIndex < entity.skeleton_bones.size(); ++boneIndex) {
            if (entity.skeleton_bone_valid[boneIndex] &&
                isUsableVector(entity.skeleton_bones[boneIndex])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };

    auto observationSampleSeconds = [](DWORD now, DWORD previousTick) {
        if (previousTick == 0 || now <= previousTick)
            return OW::kEntityProcessIntervalMs / 1000.0f;
        return std::clamp((now - previousTick) / 1000.0f, 0.004f, 0.250f);
    };

    auto maxObservationMovement = [&](DWORD now, const OW::c_entity& previous) {
        const float sampleSeconds = observationSampleSeconds(now, previous.last_seen_tick_ms);
        return (std::max)(
            kObservationTeleportBaseMeters,
            kObservationMaxSpeedMetersPerSecond * sampleSeconds);
    };

    auto resetRenderHistory = [](OW::c_entity& entity, DWORD now) {
        entity.render_sample_tick_ms = now;
        entity.previous_render_sample_tick_ms = now;
        entity.position_sample_tick_ms = now;
        entity.has_previous_render_sample = false;
        entity.previous_head_pos = entity.head_pos;
        entity.previous_velocity = entity.velocity;
        entity.previous_pos = entity.pos;
        entity.previous_neck_pos = entity.neck_pos;
        entity.previous_chest_pos = entity.chest_pos;
        entity.previous_skeleton_bones = entity.skeleton_bones;
        entity.previous_skeleton_bone_valid = entity.skeleton_bone_valid;
        entity.previous_cached_bot_chest_bone = entity.cached_bot_chest_bone;
        entity.previous_cached_bot_chest_bone_valid = entity.cached_bot_chest_bone_valid;
    };

    auto shouldSkipTeleportObservation = [&](const OW::c_entity& current,
                                             const RosterEntry& rosterEntry,
                                             DWORD now) {
        const OW::c_entity& previous = rosterEntry.entity;
        if (!previous.address || !previous.Alive ||
            previous.roster_state != OW::EntityRosterState::Fresh) {
            return false;
        }
        if (previous.HeroID != 0 && current.HeroID != 0 && previous.HeroID != current.HeroID)
            return false;
        if (previous.last_seen_tick_ms == 0 || now - previous.last_seen_tick_ms > kObservationPreviousMaxAgeMs)
            return false;

        const Vector3 previousAnchor = observationAnchor(previous);
        const Vector3 currentAnchor = observationAnchor(current);
        if (!isUsableVector(previousAnchor) || !isUsableVector(currentAnchor))
            return false;

        const float movement = previousAnchor.DistTo(currentAnchor);
        return std::isfinite(movement) && movement > maxObservationMovement(now, previous);
    };

    auto stabilizeObservationPointOutliers = [&](OW::c_entity& current,
                                                 const OW::c_entity& previous,
                                                 const OW::c_entity& previousObservation,
                                                 DWORD now) {
        if (!previous.address || previous.last_seen_tick_ms == 0 ||
            now - previous.last_seen_tick_ms > kObservationPreviousMaxAgeMs) {
            return static_cast<size_t>(0);
        }
        if (previous.SkeletonIdentity() != current.SkeletonIdentity() ||
            !OW::SkeletonSemantics::CanReuseHistory(
            previous.skeleton_form, previous.skeleton_revision, previous.skeleton_requested_ids,
            current.skeleton_form, current.skeleton_revision, current.skeleton_requested_ids))
            return static_cast<size_t>(0);

        const Vector3 previousAnchor = observationAnchor(previous);
        const Vector3 currentAnchor = observationAnchor(current);
        if (!isUsableVector(previousAnchor) || !isUsableVector(currentAnchor))
            return static_cast<size_t>(0);

        const float anchorMovement = previousAnchor.DistTo(currentAnchor);
        if (!std::isfinite(anchorMovement) || anchorMovement > maxObservationMovement(now, previous))
            return static_cast<size_t>(0);

        const float maxPointMovement = (std::max)(
            kObservationPointJumpBaseMeters,
            anchorMovement + kObservationPointJumpAnchorSlackMeters);
        size_t suppressed = 0;

        auto suppressPoint = [&](Vector3& point, const Vector3& previousPoint, const Vector3& observedPoint) {
            if (!isUsableVector(point) || !isUsableVector(previousPoint))
                return;
            const float movement = previousPoint.DistTo(point);
            const bool repeatedObservation = isUsableVector(observedPoint) &&
                point.DistTo(observedPoint) <= maxPointMovement;
            if (std::isfinite(movement) && movement > maxPointMovement && !repeatedObservation) {
                point = previousPoint;
                ++suppressed;
            }
        };

        for (size_t boneIndex = 0; boneIndex < current.skeleton_bones.size(); ++boneIndex) {
            if (!current.skeleton_bone_valid[boneIndex] ||
                !previous.skeleton_bone_valid[boneIndex]) {
                continue;
            }
            suppressPoint(current.skeleton_bones[boneIndex], previous.skeleton_bones[boneIndex],
                previousObservation.skeleton_bone_valid[boneIndex] ? previousObservation.skeleton_bones[boneIndex] : Vector3{});
        }

        if (current.skeleton_bone_valid[0]) current.head_pos = current.skeleton_bones[0];
        if (current.skeleton_bone_valid[1]) current.neck_pos = current.skeleton_bones[1];
        if (current.skeleton_bone_valid[2]) current.chest_pos = current.skeleton_bones[2];

        // Position has its own bounded teleport confirmation. Applying a second
        // point gate here can permanently pin a valid new anchor to the old one.
        suppressPoint(current.head_pos, previous.head_pos, previousObservation.head_pos);
        suppressPoint(current.neck_pos, previous.neck_pos, previousObservation.neck_pos);
        suppressPoint(current.chest_pos, previous.chest_pos, previousObservation.chest_pos);
        if (current.cached_bot_chest_bone_valid && previous.cached_bot_chest_bone_valid)
            suppressPoint(current.cached_bot_chest_bone, previous.cached_bot_chest_bone, previousObservation.cached_bot_chest_bone);

        return suppressed;
    };

    auto publishRosterSnapshot = [&](DWORD now,
                                     size_t heroChanged,
                                     std::vector<OW::c_entity>& published,
                                     Diagnostics::EntityLifecycleStats* lifecycleStats = nullptr) {
        Diagnostics::RosterStats rosterStats{};

        published.clear();

        for (auto it = entityRoster.begin(); it != entityRoster.end();) {

                discovery && discovery->match==rosterEntity.match_id && discovery->hero==rosterEntity.HeroID) {

                std::scoped_lock lock(g_mutex,OW::raw_scan_mutex);

                } else {

                    std::erase_if(OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities,matches);
                    std::erase_if(OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.binding_entities,matches);
                    std::erase(OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot.actual_members,address);

                discoveryAttemptTicks.erase(address);

                std::find(cycleMemberPairs.begin(),cycleMemberPairs.end(),std::make_pair(rosterEntity.address,rosterEntity.LinkParent))!=cycleMemberPairs.end();

                OW::DynamicEntityRegistryEnabled() &&

                OW::PresentationTiming::Fresh(rosterEntity.anchor_sample_tick_ms, now);

                rosterEntity.roster_state != OW::EntityRosterState::Dead) {
                if (rosterEntity.roster_state != OW::EntityRosterState::Missing &&
                    lifecycleStats) {
                    ++lifecycleStats->entityRecordMarkMissingCount;

                    rosterEntity.missing_since_tick_ms = now;
                    rosterEntry.respawnWatchStartedTick=now;
                    rosterEntry.respawnLastScanRequestTick=0;rosterEntry.respawnFirstScanRequested=false;
                    RuntimeTrace::Emit(RuntimeTrace::EntityMissing,rosterEntity.address,rosterEntity.actor_generation,rosterEntity.anchor_sample_tick_ms,now);
                    Diagnostics::Info("[V2-MISSING] actor=0x%llX hero=0x%llX member=%d body=%d alive=%d death_known=%d dead=%d anchor_age_ms=%u death_age_ms=%u cache_age_ms=%u",
                        rosterEntity.address,rosterEntity.HeroID,int(actualMember),int(rosterEntity.body_valid),
                        int(rosterEntity.Alive),int(rosterEntity.death_known),int(rosterEntity.is_dead),
                        uint32_t(now-rosterEntity.anchor_sample_tick_ms),uint32_t(now-rosterEntity.death_sample_tick_ms),
                        uint32_t(now-rosterEntry.baseUpdateTick));
                }
                rosterEntity.roster_state = OW::EntityRosterState::Missing;
            }

            if (rosterEntity.roster_state == OW::EntityRosterState::Missing ||
                rosterEntity.roster_state == OW::EntityRosterState::Dead) {
                sanitizeStaleRosterEntity(rosterEntity);
            }

            if (OW::offset::UsesProtectedEntityLayout() &&
                rosterEntity.roster_state == OW::EntityRosterState::Fresh &&
                !hasRenderableAnchor(rosterEntity)) {
                it = entityRoster.erase(it);
                rosterStats.expired++;
                if (lifecycleStats)
                    ++lifecycleStats->entityRecordExpiredCount;
                continue;
            }

            switch (rosterEntity.roster_state) {
            case OW::EntityRosterState::Fresh:
                rosterStats.fresh++;
                break;
            case OW::EntityRosterState::Dead:
                rosterStats.dead++;
                break;
            case OW::EntityRosterState::Missing:
                rosterStats.missing++;
                break;
            }

            rosterEntity.published_tick_ms = now;
            rosterEntity.publish_sequence=entityPublishSequence;
            const float traceEntity[]={rosterEntity.pos.X,rosterEntity.pos.Y,rosterEntity.pos.Z,
                float(rosterEntity.roster_state),float(rosterEntity.Alive),
                float(rosterEntity.read_completed_tick_ms-rosterEntity.read_started_tick_ms)};
            RuntimeTrace::Emit(RuntimeTrace::EntityPublish,rosterEntity.address,rosterEntity.actor_generation,
                rosterEntity.anchor_sample_tick_ms,entityPublishSequence,traceEntity,6);
            published.push_back(rosterEntity);
            ++it;
        }

        std::sort(published.begin(), published.end(),
            [](const OW::c_entity& lhs, const OW::c_entity& rhs) {
                return lhs.roster_key < rhs.roster_key;
            });

        return rosterStats;
    };
```

```inl
    constexpr uint64_t kRosterMatchPrefix = 0x1000000000000000ull;
    constexpr uint64_t kRosterLinkPrefix = 0x2000000000000000ull;
    constexpr uint64_t kRosterComponentPrefix = 0x3000000000000000ull;
    constexpr uint64_t kRosterParticipantPrefix =
        OW::EntityRosterPolicy::kParticipantRosterPrefix;

    auto makeRosterKey = [&](uint32_t matchId, uint64_t linkParent, uint64_t componentParent) -> uint64_t {
        if (matchId != 0)
            return kRosterMatchPrefix | static_cast<uint64_t>(matchId);
        if (linkParent != 0)
            return kRosterLinkPrefix ^ linkParent;
        return kRosterComponentPrefix ^ componentParent;
    };

    enum class RosterKeyKind {
        Unknown,
        Match,
        Link,
        Component,
        Participant,
    };

    auto rosterKeyKind = [&](uint64_t rosterKey) {
        constexpr uint64_t kRosterPrefixMask = 0xF000000000000000ull;
        switch (rosterKey & kRosterPrefixMask) {
        case kRosterMatchPrefix:
            return RosterKeyKind::Match;
        case kRosterLinkPrefix:
            return RosterKeyKind::Link;
        case kRosterComponentPrefix:
            return RosterKeyKind::Component;
        case kRosterParticipantPrefix:
            return RosterKeyKind::Participant;
        default:
            return RosterKeyKind::Unknown;
        }
    };
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/VisibilitySample.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW {
// ED's independent field deadlines, with a shorter interval for UN targeting.
struct VisibilitySample {
    static constexpr uint32_t intervalMs = 16, maxAgeMs = 50;
    uint32_t nextDue = 0, sampledAt = 0;
    bool attempted = false, valid = false, visible = false;
    bool Due(uint32_t now) const { return !attempted || int32_t(now - nextDue) >= 0; }
    void Commit(uint64_t decoded, bool readable, uint32_t started, uint32_t completed) {
        attempted = true;
        nextDue = completed + intervalMs;
        sampledAt = started;
        valid = readable && uint32_t(completed - started) <= maxAgeMs;
        visible = valid && decoded != 0;
    }
    bool Known(uint32_t now) const { return valid && uint32_t(now - sampledAt) <= maxAgeMs; }
    bool Visible(uint32_t now) const { return Known(now) && visible; }
};
}
```

`include/Game/EntityMaintenance/WorkSchedule.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

namespace OW::EntityMaintenance {
// Cooperative deadline: a started SDK operation is not preemptible.
struct Budget {
    uint64_t started = 0, duration = 1000;
    bool CanStart(uint64_t now) const { return now >= started && now - started < duration; }
};

inline std::vector<size_t> MaintenanceOrder(const std::vector<uint8_t>& recovery,size_t recoveryCursor,size_t regularCursor,bool preferRecovery) {
    std::vector<size_t> urgent,regular,order;
    if(recovery.empty())return order;
    for(size_t n=0;n<recovery.size();++n) {
        const auto u=(recoveryCursor+n)%recovery.size(),r=(regularCursor+n)%recovery.size();
        if(recovery[u])urgent.push_back(u);
        if(!recovery[r])regular.push_back(r);
    }
    size_t u=0,r=0;order.reserve(recovery.size());
    while(u<urgent.size() || r<regular.size()) {
        if((preferRecovery && u<urgent.size()) || r==regular.size()) {order.push_back(urgent[u++]);preferRecovery=false;}
        else {order.push_back(regular[r++]);preferRecovery=true;}
    }
    return order;
}

enum class ColdStage : uint8_t { Identity, Skeleton, TeamName, Skill, LocalSkill, HeroSignal, Stealth, Count, None };
constexpr uint32_t StageBit(ColdStage stage) { return 1u << static_cast<uint8_t>(stage); }
constexpr bool CanObserveHeroSignals(bool controller,bool requested,uint64_t requestedHero,
    uint64_t actorHero,bool alive,bool needsLink,bool link,bool skill) {
    return controller && requested && requestedHero==actorHero && alive && (needsLink?link:skill);
}
constexpr bool CanObserveStealth(bool sombra,bool enemy,bool skill) { return sombra && enemy && skill; }
struct ColdSchedule {
    uint8_t cursor = 0;
    ColdStage Select(uint32_t due) const {
        constexpr auto count = static_cast<uint8_t>(ColdStage::Count);
        for (uint8_t offset = 0; offset < count; ++offset) {
            const auto stage = static_cast<ColdStage>((cursor + offset) % count);
            if (due & StageBit(stage)) return stage;
        }
        return ColdStage::None;
    }
    bool Start(ColdStage selected, ColdStage requested, const Budget& budget, uint64_t now) {
        if (selected != requested || selected == ColdStage::None || !budget.CanStart(now)) return false;
        cursor = (static_cast<uint8_t>(selected) + 1) % static_cast<uint8_t>(ColdStage::Count);
        return true;
    }
};
}
```

`include/Game/EntityRegistry.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include "Game/Cn155284.hpp"

namespace OW::EntityRegistry {
inline constexpr uint64_t stateRva=Cn155284::entityState, lockRva=Cn155284::entityLock;
inline constexpr uint32_t maxSlots=0x200000, slotBytes=16;
inline constexpr uint64_t pollMs=250, retryMs=50;
enum class Error : uint8_t { None, ReadFailed, Busy, Unstable, Invalid, Changed, Disconnected };
enum class ScanStatus : uint8_t { Complete, Partial, Invalidated, Unavailable };
struct Snapshot {
    uint64_t epoch=0, module=0, root=0, generation=0, sampledMs=0;
    uint32_t state=0, capacity=0;
    uint64_t Bytes() const { return uint64_t(capacity)*slotBytes; }
    bool SameTable(const Snapshot& b) const {
        return epoch==b.epoch && module==b.module && root==b.root && state==b.state && capacity==b.capacity;
    }
};
inline bool Valid(const Snapshot& s, uint32_t imageSize=Cn155284::imageSize) {
    return s.epoch && s.module && s.capacity && s.capacity<=maxSlots && s.root>=0x10000 &&
        !(s.root&7) && s.root<0x800000000000ull && s.Bytes()<=0x800000000000ull-s.root &&
        (s.root<s.module || s.root>=s.module+imageSize);
}
template<class Read>
Error ReadSnapshotAt(uint64_t epoch,uint64_t module,uint64_t stateLocation,uint64_t lockLocation,Read&& read,Snapshot& out,
                     uint32_t imageSize=Cn155284::imageSize) {
    uint32_t before=0,after=0;
    std::array<uint8_t,32> a{},b{};
    if(!read(module+lockLocation,&before,sizeof(before)))return Error::ReadFailed;
    if(before)return Error::Busy;
    if(!read(module+stateLocation,a.data(),a.size()) || !read(module+stateLocation,b.data(),b.size()) ||
       !read(module+lockLocation,&after,sizeof(after)))return Error::ReadFailed;
    if(after)return Error::Busy;
    Snapshot first{},second{};
    auto decode=[&](const auto& bytes,Snapshot& s) {
        s.epoch=epoch;s.module=module;
        std::memcpy(&s.state,bytes.data(),4);std::memcpy(&s.capacity,bytes.data()+4,4);
        std::memcpy(&s.root,bytes.data()+24,8);
    };
    decode(a,first);decode(b,second);
    // Used/free counters change normally; only table identity must be stable.
    if(!first.SameTable(second))return Error::Unstable;
    if(!Valid(second,imageSize))return Error::Invalid;
    out=second;return Error::None;
}
template<class Read>
Error ReadSnapshot(uint64_t epoch,uint64_t module,Read&& read,Snapshot& out) {
    return ReadSnapshotAt(epoch,module,stateRva,lockRva,read,out);
}
template<class Read,class Pause>
Error ReadSnapshotRetryBusy(uint64_t epoch,uint64_t module,Read&& read,Pause&& pause,Snapshot& out,
                            uint64_t stateLocation=stateRva,uint64_t lockLocation=lockRva,
                            uint32_t imageSize=Cn155284::imageSize) {
    for(unsigned attempt=0;;++attempt) {
        const auto error=ReadSnapshotAt(epoch,module,stateLocation,lockLocation,read,out,imageSize);
        if(error!=Error::Busy || attempt==2)return error;
        if(!pause())return Error::Disconnected;
    }
}
inline size_t ChunkBytes(const Snapshot& s,uint64_t offset,size_t requested) {
    return offset<s.Bytes()?static_cast<size_t>((std::min)(s.Bytes()-offset,uint64_t((std::min)(requested,size_t{0x10000})))):0;
}
struct State {
    Snapshot snapshot{};
    uint64_t lastAttemptMs=0,lastIntervalMs=0,changes=0,reads=0,failures=0,readUs=0;
    uint64_t attemptedEpoch=0,attemptedModule=0;
    Error error=Error::Disconnected;
    bool available=false,rescanPending=false,observedEmpty=false;
    bool Due(uint64_t now) const { return !reads || now-lastAttemptMs>=(error==Error::None?pollMs:retryMs); }
    bool ShouldRead(uint64_t epoch,uint64_t module,uint64_t now,bool force) const {
        return force || attemptedEpoch!=epoch || attemptedModule!=module || Due(now);
    }
    void Observe(Error next,Snapshot incoming,uint64_t now) {
        lastIntervalMs=reads?now-lastAttemptMs:0;lastAttemptMs=now;++reads;error=next;
        if(next!=Error::None) { available=false;++failures;if(next==Error::Invalid)observedEmpty=true;return; }
        attemptedEpoch=incoming.epoch;attemptedModule=incoming.module;
        if(!snapshot.generation || !snapshot.SameTable(incoming) || observedEmpty) {
            incoming.generation=snapshot.generation+1;++changes;rescanPending=true;
        } else incoming.generation=snapshot.generation;
        incoming.sampledMs=now;snapshot=incoming;available=true;observedEmpty=false;
    }
    bool Accept(const Snapshot& s) const {
        return available && s.generation && s.generation==snapshot.generation && s.SameTable(snapshot);
    }
    bool Acknowledge(const Snapshot& s,ScanStatus status) {
        if(status!=ScanStatus::Complete || !Accept(s))return false;
        rescanPending=false;return true;
    }
};
struct Monitor {
    std::mutex readMutex;
    std::mutex mutex;
    State state;
};
} // namespace OW::EntityRegistry
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
```
