```hpp
namespace OW::EntityRosterPolicy {

inline constexpr uint32_t kRetentionMs = 13000;

inline void PrioritizeDiscoveryLinks(std::vector<uint64_t>& pending,
    const std::unordered_set<uint64_t>& knownLinks) {
    for(auto parent:knownLinks)
        if(std::find(pending.begin(),pending.end(),parent)==pending.end())pending.push_back(parent);
    // Preserve rotation among waiting players while new ordinary entities arrive.
    std::stable_partition(pending.begin(),pending.end(),[&](auto parent){return knownLinks.contains(parent);});
}

struct Discovery {
    uint64_t address = 0, link = 0, hero = 0;
    uint32_t match = 0, tick = 0;
    bool current_map = false;
};

inline bool ValidTeamKey(uint32_t key) noexcept {
    constexpr uint32_t mask = 0x0F800000;
    return key && !(key & ~mask) && !(key & (key - 1));
}

struct TeamConfirmation {
    uint32_t key = 0;
    uint64_t linkParent = 0;
    uint32_t matchId = 0;
    bool known = false;
    bool ConfirmIdentity(uint64_t link, uint32_t match) noexcept {
        known = ValidTeamKey(key) && link && match && linkParent==link && matchId==match;
        return known;
    }
    bool Observe(uint32_t observed, uint64_t link, uint32_t match) noexcept {
        known = false;
        if (!link || !match) return false;
        // A rescan or component relocation does not create a new player pair.
        if (linkParent != link || matchId != match) {
            key=0; linkParent=link; matchId=match;
        }
        // Failed or contradictory live bytes cannot erase this pair's confirmed team.
        ConfirmIdentity(link,match);
        if (!ValidTeamKey(observed) || (key && key != observed)) return false;
        key=observed;
        known=true;
        return known;
    }
};

inline bool AuthoritativeRoster(bool readComplete, bool bindingsComplete,
    const std::vector<Discovery>& proofs) noexcept {
    return readComplete && bindingsComplete && !proofs.empty();
}

inline bool Expired(uint32_t observed, uint32_t now) noexcept {
    // A producer may finish an observation after the consumer captured now.
    return int32_t(now - observed) >= int32_t(kRetentionMs);
}

// Owned by the scan exchange mutex; observations survive latest-wins replacement.
struct DiscoveryBook {
    uint64_t connection = 0, registry = 0, scene = 0;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Discovery> actors;
    void SetContext(uint64_t c, uint64_t r, uint64_t s) {
        if (connection != c || registry != r || scene != s) actors.clear();
        connection = c; registry = r; scene = s;
    }
    void Observe(const Discovery& value) {
        auto found = actors.find(value.address);
        if (found == actors.end() || int32_t(value.tick - found->second.tick) > 0)
            actors[value.address] = value;
    }
    const Discovery* Find(uint64_t address, uint64_t link, uint32_t now) const {
        const auto found = actors.find(address);
        return found != actors.end() && found->second.link == link && !Expired(found->second.tick, now)
            ? &found->second : nullptr;
    }
    void Prune(uint32_t now) {
        std::erase_if(actors, [&](const auto& item) { return Expired(item.second.tick, now); });
    }
};

inline const char* DiscoveryAdmissionFailure(const DiscoveryBook& book, const Discovery& current,
    bool membershipKnown, bool member, uint32_t now) {
    const auto found=book.actors.find(current.address);
    if(found==book.actors.end())return "discovery_missing";
    const auto& proof=found->second;
    if(proof.link!=current.link)return "discovery_link_mismatch";
    if(Expired(proof.tick,now))return "discovery_expired";
    if(proof.match!=current.match)return "discovery_match_mismatch";
    if(proof.hero!=current.hero)return "discovery_hero_mismatch";
    if(membershipKnown && !member)return "membership_pending";
    return nullptr;
}

enum class SceneAudit : uint8_t { Unknown, Present, Empty };
inline SceneAudit ClassifySceneMember(bool headerRead,bool heroComponent,bool knownHero,
    bool actorComponents,bool knownDynamic) {
    if(!headerRead)return SceneAudit::Unknown;
    if(knownDynamic)return SceneAudit::Empty;
    if(heroComponent)return knownHero?SceneAudit::Present:SceneAudit::Unknown;
    return actorComponents && !knownDynamic?SceneAudit::Unknown:SceneAudit::Empty;
}
struct EmptySceneWatch {
    uint64_t connection = 0, registry = 0, scene = 0;
    uint32_t since = 0, latestTick = 0;
    bool pending = false, ready = false, cleared = false, hasSample = false;
    void Observe(uint64_t c, uint64_t r, uint64_t s, SceneAudit audit, uint32_t tick) {
        if (connection != c || registry != r || scene != s) {
            *this = {}; connection = c; registry = r; scene = s;
        }
        if (hasSample && int32_t(tick - latestTick) <= 0) return;
        latestTick = tick; hasSample = true;
        if (audit != SceneAudit::Empty) {
            pending = false; ready = false;
            if (audit == SceneAudit::Present) cleared = false;
            return;
        }
        if (cleared) return;
        if (!pending) { since = tick; pending = true; }
        ready = Expired(since, tick);
    }
    void MarkCleared(uint64_t nextScene) {
        scene = nextScene; pending = ready = false; cleared = true;
    }
};

inline bool BodyUsable(bool valid, bool alive, bool freshState, uint32_t sample,
                       uint32_t now, uint64_t scene, uint64_t currentScene) noexcept {
    return valid && alive && freshState && scene == currentScene && sample != 0 && uint32_t(now - sample) <= 100;
}

inline constexpr uint64_t kParticipantRosterPrefix = 0x4000000000000000ull;
inline constexpr uint64_t kRosterPayloadMask = 0x0FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull;

inline uint64_t ParticipantRosterKey(std::string_view participantId) noexcept
{
    if (participantId.size() < 2 || participantId.size() > 63)
        return 0;

    bool hasVisibleByte = false;
    uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (const unsigned char value : participantId) {
        if (value == 0 || value < 0x20 || value == 0x7F)
            return 0;
        hasVisibleByte = true;
        hash ^= static_cast<uint64_t>(value);
        hash *= 1099511628211ull;
    }

    if (!hasVisibleByte)
        return 0;
    return kParticipantRosterPrefix | (hash & kRosterPayloadMask);
}

    ReplaceExisting,
    KeepExisting,
};

// Retained context belongs to one admitted generation; its controller may be
// freed before the successor is discovered.

    uint64_t epoch=0, scene=0, registry=0, context=0, owner=0, buckets=0;
    uint32_t match=0, controllerUid=0;
    std::string label;
};

public:
    VerifiedDeadParticipantReplacement() = default;

inline bool CanReturnRetiredActor(bool sameSignature,bool absenceObserved,bool actualMember) noexcept {
    return !sameSignature || (absenceObserved && actualMember);
}

inline bool ScanCanRetire(bool complete,uint64_t startedRevision,uint64_t currentRevision) noexcept {
    return complete && startedRevision==currentRevision;
}

inline std::vector<uint64_t> AddedTopologyMembers(const std::vector<uint64_t>& previous,
    const std::vector<uint64_t>& current,bool sameRoot) {
    if(!sameRoot)return current;
    std::vector<uint64_t> added;
    std::set_difference(current.begin(),current.end(),previous.begin(),previous.end(),std::back_inserter(added));
    return added;
}

inline bool ReliableParticipantId(std::string_view id) noexcept {
    const auto separator=id.rfind('#');
    if(separator==std::string_view::npos || separator==0 || id.size()-separator<3)return false;
    for(size_t i=separator+1;i<id.size();++i)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return false;
    return ParticipantRosterKey(id)!=0;
}

inline void MergePartialScan(std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t,uint64_t>>& incoming,
    const std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t,uint64_t>>& previous,bool complete) {
    if(complete)return;
    for(const auto& pair:previous)if(std::find(incoming.begin(),incoming.end(),pair)==incoming.end())incoming.push_back(pair);
}

enum class UltimateRosterFilter : uint8_t {
    All = 0,
    Enemy = 1,
    Ally = 2,
};

enum class RespawnRescanDue : uint8_t {
    None = 0,
    First,
    Retry,
};

inline SameParticipantObservationAction ResolveSameParticipantObservation(
    bool existingSeenThisCycle,
    bool sameActor,
    bool existingFresh,
    bool incomingFresh,
    bool membershipKnown = false,
    bool existingMember = true,
    bool incomingMember = true,
    bool sameController = false,
    bool incomingPaired = false,
    bool currentMapProof = false,
    const VerifiedDeadParticipantReplacement& deadReplacement = {}) noexcept
{
    (void)existingSeenThisCycle;
    if(sameActor)return SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting;
    if(!incomingFresh)return SameParticipantObservationAction::KeepExisting;
    if (membershipKnown && !sameActor && !existingMember && incomingMember && incomingFresh)
        return SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting;
    // A current controller map can supersede a stale missing/dead body even
    // when the last complete membership snapshot still contains that address.
    if (currentMapProof && !existingFresh && incomingFresh && membershipKnown && existingMember)
        return SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting;
    if(sameController)return incomingPaired ? SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting : SameParticipantObservationAction::KeepExisting;
    if(deadReplacement.Verified())return SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting;
    if (membershipKnown && existingMember && incomingMember)
        return SameParticipantObservationAction::KeepExisting;
    if (incomingFresh && !existingFresh)
        return SameParticipantObservationAction::ReplaceExisting;
    // Ambiguous simultaneous bodies cannot create another seat for a confirmed player.
    return SameParticipantObservationAction::KeepExisting;
}

inline constexpr bool ShouldRenderWorldHeroAvatar(bool isEnemy) noexcept
{
    return isEnemy;
}

inline constexpr RespawnRescanDue ResolveRespawnRescanDue(
    bool dead,
    uint32_t watchStartedTick,
    bool firstScanRequested,
    uint32_t lastScanRequestTick,
    uint32_t nowTick,
    uint32_t firstDelayMs,
    uint32_t retryMs,
    uint32_t watchMs) noexcept
{
    if (!dead || watchStartedTick == 0)
        return RespawnRescanDue::None;
    const uint32_t deadAge = nowTick - watchStartedTick;
    if (deadAge < firstDelayMs)
        return RespawnRescanDue::None;
    if (!firstScanRequested)
        return RespawnRescanDue::First;
    if (lastScanRequestTick == 0 ||
        nowTick - lastScanRequestTick >= (deadAge <= watchMs ? retryMs : 1000)) {
        return RespawnRescanDue::Retry;
    }
    return RespawnRescanDue::None;
}

inline constexpr bool ShouldRenderUltimateRosterEntry(int filter,
                                                       bool isEnemy) noexcept
{
    switch (static_cast<UltimateRosterFilter>(filter)) {
    case UltimateRosterFilter::All:
        return true;
    case UltimateRosterFilter::Ally:
        return !isEnemy;
    case UltimateRosterFilter::Enemy:
    default:
        return isEnemy;
    }
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include "Game/AimFirePhase.hpp"
#include "Game/AimSmoothingTiming.hpp"
#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW::FlickRepeat {

inline float WindowMs(float value) {
    return std::clamp(AimFirePhase::Finite(value, 120.0f), 1.0f, 1000.0f);
}

inline float MaxSpeedDegPerSec(float value) {
    return std::clamp(AimFirePhase::Finite(value, 180.0f), 1.0f, 3600.0f);
}

// This timeline records software fire submissions, never observed game shots.
struct Timeline {
    bool submitted = false;
    std::uint32_t submittedAt = 0;
    std::uint32_t intervalMs = 0;
};

struct SessionIdentity {
    std::uint64_t heroId = 0;
    int action = -1;
    int slotIndex = -1;
    int aimKey = 0;
    std::uint64_t configGeneration = 0;
    std::uint64_t connectionEpoch = 0;
    std::uint64_t outputEpoch = 0;
    std::uint64_t slotId = 0;
    bool operator==(const SessionIdentity&) const = default;
};

struct State {
    Timeline timeline{};
    SessionIdentity identity{};
    bool identified = false;
    bool shotLatched = false;
    bool moving = false;
    std::uint64_t targetKey = 0;
    std::uint64_t movementSample = 0;
};

inline bool ConsumeMovementSample(State& state, std::uint64_t sample) {
    // View angles in the consumption frame are sampled, not a synchronous
    // acknowledgement of the previous mouse command. Replaying that frame
    // spends the same angular error more than once, especially near a repeat
    // deadline where Step is allowed to close the whole remaining error.
    if (!sample || (state.movementSample && sample <= state.movementSample))
        return false;
    state.movementSample = sample;
    return true;
}

inline void PauseMovement(State& state) {
    state.moving = false;
    state.targetKey = 0;
}

inline void EndActivation(State& state) {
    state.shotLatched = false;
    state.movementSample = 0;
    PauseMovement(state);
}

inline bool PrepareSession(State& state, const SessionIdentity& identity) {
    if (state.identified && state.identity == identity)
        return false;
    // Slot/profile/action changes restart movement, not the weapon's cooldown.
    if (state.identified && state.identity.connectionEpoch != identity.connectionEpoch)
        state.timeline = {};
    EndActivation(state);
    state.identity = identity;
    state.identified = true;
    return true;
}

inline bool PrepareTarget(State& state, std::uint64_t targetKey) {
    const bool reset = !state.moving || state.targetKey != targetKey;
    state.moving = true;
    state.targetKey = targetKey;
    return reset;
}

inline bool RecordSubmission(State& state, bool accepted, std::uint32_t submittedAt,
                             std::uint32_t intervalMs) {
    if (!accepted || (state.timeline.submitted &&
        (state.timeline.intervalMs == 0 ||
         submittedAt - state.timeline.submittedAt < state.timeline.intervalMs)))
        return false;
    state.timeline = { true, submittedAt, intervalMs };
    state.shotLatched = true;
    PauseMovement(state);
    return true;
}

struct Phase {
    bool repeat = false;
    bool movementAllowed = true;
    bool timeAllowsFire = true;
    bool cadenceMissing = false;
    float remainingMs = 0.0f;
};

inline Phase Resolve(const Timeline& timeline, std::uint32_t now,
                     bool keepFiring, float windowMs, float postFireDelayMs,
                     bool repeat = true) {
    Phase phase{};
    if (!timeline.submitted)
        return phase;
    phase.repeat = repeat;
    phase.cadenceMissing = timeline.intervalMs == 0;
    const float elapsed = static_cast<float>(now - timeline.submittedAt);
    const float postDelay = (std::max)(0.0f, AimFirePhase::Finite(postFireDelayMs, 0.0f));
    phase.remainingMs = (std::max)(0.0f, static_cast<float>(timeline.intervalMs) - elapsed);
    phase.timeAllowsFire = !phase.cadenceMissing && phase.remainingMs <= 0.0f && elapsed >= postDelay;
    const float window = (std::min)(WindowMs(windowMs), timeline.intervalMs * 0.5f);
    phase.movementAllowed = !repeat || (keepFiring && !phase.cadenceMissing &&
        phase.remainingMs <= window &&
        elapsed >= postDelay);
    return phase;
}

enum class FireStateEvidence { Missing, KnownProhibited };

enum class FirePath { HitWindow, DelayedTimeout, ForcedMiss };

inline bool AllowsFirePath(bool ordinaryFlick, FirePath path) {
    return !ordinaryFlick || path == FirePath::HitWindow;
}

inline bool AllowsFire(const Phase& phase, FireStateEvidence evidence,
                       bool safetyAllowsFire, bool currentCrosshairHits,
                       FirePath path = FirePath::HitWindow) {
    // shortcut: CN has no validated positive fire-ready reader; use time plus
    // existing negative restrictions until a version-specific reader is proven.
    return AllowsFirePath(true, path) && phase.movementAllowed && phase.timeAllowsFire &&
        evidence != FireStateEvidence::KnownProhibited &&
        safetyAllowsFire && currentCrosshairHits;
}

inline Vector3 Step(Vector3 current, Vector3 latestTarget, float remainingMs,
                    float deltaSeconds, float maxSpeedDegPerSec,
                    bool currentCrosshairHits = false) {
    if (currentCrosshairHits || !std::isfinite(current.X) || !std::isfinite(current.Y) ||
        !std::isfinite(latestTarget.X) || !std::isfinite(latestTarget.Y))
        return current;
    const float dt = std::clamp(AimFirePhase::Finite(deltaSeconds, 0.0f), 0.0f, 0.020f);
    Vector3 error = latestTarget - current;
    error.Z = 0.0f;
    error.Y = std::remainder(error.Y, 2.0f * 3.14159265358979323846f);
    const float distance = error.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.000001f || dt <= 0.0f)
        return current;
    const float remaining = (std::max)(dt, AimFirePhase::Finite(remainingMs, 0.0f) * 0.001f);
    const float cap = MaxSpeedDegPerSec(maxSpeedDegPerSec) * (3.14159265358979323846f / 180.0f);
    const float speed = (std::min)(distance / remaining, cap);
    return current + error * ((std::min)(distance, speed * dt) / distance);
}

} // namespace OW::FlickRepeat
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW::FovGeometry {

inline constexpr float kMaxFovAngleDeg = 180.0f;
inline constexpr float kFovComparisonEpsilon = 0.0001f;
inline constexpr float kRayForwardAlignmentEpsilon = 0.000001f;

struct RuntimeContext {
    Vector3 camera{};
    Vector3 forward{};
    bool valid = false;
};

inline bool IsFiniteVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    return std::isfinite(value.X) &&
           std::isfinite(value.Y) &&
           std::isfinite(value.Z);
}

inline Vector3 NormalizeVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    const float length = value.Size();
    if (!IsFiniteVector(value) || !std::isfinite(length) || length <= 0.0001f)
        return Vector3{};
    return value / length;
}

inline bool IsProjectionInverseUsable(float determinant, bool inverseFinite)
{
    return std::isfinite(determinant) && determinant != 0.0f && inverseFinite;
}

struct HomogeneousPoint {
    Vector3 xyz{};
    float w = (std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN)();
};

inline bool IsFiniteHomogeneousPoint(const HomogeneousPoint& value)
{
    return IsFiniteVector(value.xyz) && std::isfinite(value.w);
}

inline bool TryHomogeneousPoint(float x,
                                float y,
                                float z,
                                float w,
                                Vector3& outPoint)
{
    outPoint = Vector3{};
    if (!std::isfinite(x) ||
        !std::isfinite(y) ||
        !std::isfinite(z) ||
        !std::isfinite(w) ||
        w == 0.0f) {
        return false;
    }

    const Vector3 point(x / w, y / w, z / w);
    if (!IsFiniteVector(point))
        return false;

    outPoint = point;
    return true;
}

inline bool OrientDirectionToForward(const Vector3& rawDirection,
                                     const Vector3& expectedForward,
                                     Vector3& outDirection)
{
    outDirection = Vector3{};
    const Vector3 forward = NormalizeVector(expectedForward);
    Vector3 direction = NormalizeVector(rawDirection);
    if (forward == Vector3{} || direction == Vector3{})
        return false;

    const float alignment = direction | forward;
    if (!std::isfinite(alignment) || std::fabs(alignment) <= kRayForwardAlignmentEpsilon)
        return false;

    if (alignment < 0.0f)
        direction = direction * -1.0f;
    if (!IsFiniteVector(direction) || (direction | forward) <= kRayForwardAlignmentEpsilon)
        return false;

    outDirection = direction;
    return true;
}

inline bool OrientProjectionRay(const Vector3& depthZeroPoint,
                                const Vector3& depthOnePoint,
                                const Vector3& expectedForward,
                                Vector3& outDirection)
{
    return OrientDirectionToForward(
        depthOnePoint - depthZeroPoint,
        expectedForward,
        outDirection);
}

inline bool ResolveProjectionRay(const HomogeneousPoint& depthZero,
                                 const HomogeneousPoint& depthOne,
                                 const Vector3& expectedForward,
                                 Vector3& outDirection)
{
    outDirection = Vector3{};
    if (!IsFiniteHomogeneousPoint(depthZero) || !IsFiniteHomogeneousPoint(depthOne))
        return false;

    const bool depthZeroFinite = depthZero.w != 0.0f;
    const bool depthOneFinite = depthOne.w != 0.0f;
    if (depthZeroFinite && depthOneFinite) {
        Vector3 depthZeroPoint{};
        Vector3 depthOnePoint{};
        if (!TryHomogeneousPoint(
                depthZero.xyz.X,
                depthZero.xyz.Y,
                depthZero.xyz.Z,
                depthZero.w,
                depthZeroPoint) ||
            !TryHomogeneousPoint(
                depthOne.xyz.X,
                depthOne.xyz.Y,
                depthOne.xyz.Z,
                depthOne.w,
                depthOnePoint)) {
            return false;
        }
        return OrientProjectionRay(
            depthZeroPoint,
            depthOnePoint,
            expectedForward,
            outDirection);
    }

    // An infinite-far perspective projection legitimately produces one endpoint
    // with w=0. Its xyz components are the world-space direction at infinity.
    if (depthZeroFinite == depthOneFinite)
        return false;
    const HomogeneousPoint& directionAtInfinity = depthZeroFinite ? depthOne : depthZero;
    return OrientDirectionToForward(
        directionAtInfinity.xyz,
        expectedForward,
        outDirection);
}

inline float AngularSeparationDegFromCamera(const Vector3& camera,
                                            const Vector3& a,
                                            const Vector3& b)
{
    const Vector3 dirA = NormalizeVector(a - camera);
    const Vector3 dirB = NormalizeVector(b - camera);
    if (dirA == Vector3{} || dirB == Vector3{})
        return (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();

    const float dot = std::clamp(dirA | dirB, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    return RAD2DEG(std::acos(dot));
}

inline float FovScoreDeg(const RuntimeContext& context, const Vector3& position)
{
    if (!context.valid)
        return (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();

    const Vector3 targetDirection = NormalizeVector(position - context.camera);
    if (targetDirection == Vector3{})
        return (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();

    const float dot = std::clamp(context.forward | targetDirection, -1.0f, 1.0f);
    return RAD2DEG(std::acos(dot));
}

inline bool IsWithinFovDeg(const RuntimeContext& context,
                           const Vector3& position,
                           float fovDeg,
                           float* outScoreDeg = nullptr)
{
    const float scoreDeg = FovScoreDeg(context, position);
    if (outScoreDeg)
        *outScoreDeg = scoreDeg;

    if (!std::isfinite(scoreDeg) || !std::isfinite(fovDeg))
        return false;
    const float limitDeg = std::clamp(fovDeg, 0.0f, kMaxFovAngleDeg);
    return scoreDeg <= limitDeg + kFovComparisonEpsilon;
}

struct CandidateFovEvaluation {
    float distance = 0.0f;
    float effectiveFovDeg = 0.0f;
    float scoreDeg = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
};

struct PredictedEntryEvaluation {
    float distance = 0.0f;
    float effectiveFovDeg = 0.0f;
    float currentScoreDeg = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
    float projectedScoreDeg = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
    Vector3 acceptedAimPoint{};
    bool currentlyInside = false;
    bool acceptedByPrediction = false;
};

using ResolveFovForDistanceFn = float (*)(float fixedFovDeg, float distance);

inline bool EvaluateCandidateFov(const RuntimeContext& context,
                                 const Vector3& rawAimPoint,
                                 const Vector3& finalAimPoint,
                                 float fixedFovDeg,
                                 ResolveFovForDistanceFn resolveFov,
                                 CandidateFovEvaluation& outEvaluation)
{
    outEvaluation = CandidateFovEvaluation{};
    if (!context.valid ||
        !IsFiniteVector(rawAimPoint) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(finalAimPoint)) {
        return false;
    }

    outEvaluation.distance = context.camera.DistTo(rawAimPoint);
    if (!std::isfinite(outEvaluation.distance) || outEvaluation.distance <= 0.0001f)
        return false;

    outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg = resolveFov
        ? resolveFov(fixedFovDeg, outEvaluation.distance)
        : std::clamp(fixedFovDeg, 0.0f, kMaxFovAngleDeg);
    return IsWithinFovDeg(
        context,
        finalAimPoint,
        outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg,
        &outEvaluation.scoreDeg);
}

inline bool EvaluateCandidateFovWithPredictedEntry(
    const RuntimeContext& context,
    const Vector3& rawAimPoint,
    const Vector3& currentAimPoint,
    const Vector3& projectedAimPoint,
    float fixedFovDeg,
    ResolveFovForDistanceFn resolveFov,
    bool predictionEnabled,
    float maxOutsideDeg,
    PredictedEntryEvaluation& outEvaluation)
{
    outEvaluation = PredictedEntryEvaluation{};
    if (!context.valid ||
        !IsFiniteVector(rawAimPoint) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(currentAimPoint) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(projectedAimPoint)) {
        return false;
    }

    outEvaluation.distance = context.camera.DistTo(rawAimPoint);
    if (!std::isfinite(outEvaluation.distance) || outEvaluation.distance <= 0.0001f)
        return false;

    outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg = resolveFov
        ? resolveFov(fixedFovDeg, outEvaluation.distance)
        : std::clamp(fixedFovDeg, 0.0f, kMaxFovAngleDeg);
    outEvaluation.currentlyInside = IsWithinFovDeg(
        context,
        currentAimPoint,
        outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg,
        &outEvaluation.currentScoreDeg);
    if (outEvaluation.currentlyInside) {
        outEvaluation.projectedScoreDeg = outEvaluation.currentScoreDeg;
        outEvaluation.acceptedAimPoint = currentAimPoint;
        return true;
    }

    if (!predictionEnabled)
        return false;

    const float outsideMargin = std::clamp(
        std::isfinite(maxOutsideDeg) ? maxOutsideDeg : 0.0f,
        0.0f,
        30.0f);
    if (outEvaluation.currentScoreDeg >
        outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg + outsideMargin + kFovComparisonEpsilon) {
        return false;
    }

    const bool projectedInside = IsWithinFovDeg(
        context,
        projectedAimPoint,
        outEvaluation.effectiveFovDeg,
        &outEvaluation.projectedScoreDeg);
    if (!projectedInside ||
        outEvaluation.projectedScoreDeg >= outEvaluation.currentScoreDeg - kFovComparisonEpsilon) {
        return false;
    }

    outEvaluation.acceptedAimPoint = projectedAimPoint;
    outEvaluation.acceptedByPrediction = true;
    return true;
}

enum class RingProjectionStatus {
    Drawable,
    OutsideViewport,
    Unavailable,
};

struct RingProjectionResult {
    RingProjectionStatus status = RingProjectionStatus::Unavailable;
    float radius = 0.0f;
    float centerAngleDeg = (std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN)();
    float edgeAngleDeg = (std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN)();

    bool IsDrawable() const
    {
        return status == RingProjectionStatus::Drawable &&
               std::isfinite(radius) &&
               radius > 0.0f;
    }
};

template <typename AngleSampler>
RingProjectionResult ResolveRingProjection(float targetAngleDeg,
                                           float maxRadius,
                                           AngleSampler&& sampleAngleDeg)
{
    RingProjectionResult result{};
    if (!std::isfinite(targetAngleDeg) ||
        !std::isfinite(maxRadius) ||
        targetAngleDeg <= 0.0f ||
        maxRadius <= 0.0f) {
        return result;
    }

    float lowAngleDeg = 0.0f;
    float highAngleDeg = 0.0f;
    if (!sampleAngleDeg(0.0f, lowAngleDeg) || !std::isfinite(lowAngleDeg))
        return result;
    result.centerAngleDeg = lowAngleDeg;

    if (!sampleAngleDeg(maxRadius, highAngleDeg) || !std::isfinite(highAngleDeg))
        return result;
    result.edgeAngleDeg = highAngleDeg;

    if (highAngleDeg <= lowAngleDeg + kFovComparisonEpsilon)
        return result;

    if (targetAngleDeg <= lowAngleDeg + kFovComparisonEpsilon)
        return result;
    if (targetAngleDeg >= highAngleDeg - kFovComparisonEpsilon) {
        result.status = RingProjectionStatus::OutsideViewport;
        return result;
    }

    float lowRadius = 0.0f;
    float highRadius = maxRadius;
    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 24; ++iteration) {
        const float midRadius = (lowRadius + highRadius) * 0.5f;
        float midAngleDeg = 0.0f;
        if (!sampleAngleDeg(midRadius, midAngleDeg) ||
            !std::isfinite(midAngleDeg) ||
            midAngleDeg < lowAngleDeg - kFovComparisonEpsilon ||
            midAngleDeg > highAngleDeg + kFovComparisonEpsilon) {
            return result;
        }

        if (midAngleDeg < targetAngleDeg) {
            lowRadius = midRadius;
            lowAngleDeg = midAngleDeg;
        } else {
            highRadius = midRadius;
            highAngleDeg = midAngleDeg;
        }
    }

    result.status = RingProjectionStatus::Drawable;
    result.radius = highRadius;
    return result;
}

} // namespace OW::FovGeometry
```

```hpp
template <std::size_t N>
constexpr const char* FindName(const NamedU64 (&items)[N], uint64_t value) noexcept {
    for (const NamedU64& item : items) {
        if (item.value == value)
            return item.name;
    }
    return "";
}

template <std::size_t N>
constexpr bool Contains(const NamedU64 (&items)[N], uint64_t value) noexcept {
    for (const NamedU64& item : items) {
        if (item.value == value)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

constexpr const char* HeroName(uint64_t heroId) noexcept {
    return FindName(kHeroIds, heroId);
}

        static_cast<unsigned long long>(heroId & 0xFFFFull));

}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::GenjiAssist {
inline constexpr uint64_t kDrawMs = 1000;
inline constexpr uint64_t kWindowMs = 7000;
inline constexpr uint64_t kDashRetryMs = 500;
inline constexpr uint64_t kSwingMs = 650;
inline constexpr float kSwingRange = 5.f;

// shortcut: blade-active is unverified; use Rigel's bounded Q window plus
// charge consumption until live mapping can detect early cancellation.
struct BladeWindow {
    bool armed = false, held = false, active = false, consumed = false;
    uint64_t started = 0;
    bool Advance(bool down, bool available, float charge, uint64_t now) {
        if (!available || !std::isfinite(charge)) { Cancel(); return false; }
        const bool pressed = down && !held;
        held = down;
        if (!down) armed = true;
        if (!active && pressed && armed && charge >= 100.f) {
            active = true; consumed = false; started = now; armed = false;
        }
        if (!active) return false;
        const auto elapsed = now - started;
        consumed |= charge < 100.f;
        if (elapsed >= kWindowMs || (!consumed && elapsed > 1500)) {
            active = false;
            return false;
        }
        return consumed && elapsed >= kDrawMs;
    }
    void Cancel() { *this = {}; }
};

// The production reader has no verified Genji recharge/reset value. A fresh
// inactive sample permits a bounded retry, never a claim that dash is ready.
inline bool MayTryDash(bool active, uint32_t sample, uint32_t now,
                       uint64_t lastTry, uint64_t clock) {
    return sample && uint32_t(now - sample) <= 250 && !active &&
        (!lastTry || clock - lastTry >= kDashRetryMs);
}
}
```

`include/Game/GeometryPosePlan.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstring>
#include <span>
#include <vector>
#include "Game/ModelShapes.hpp"
#include "Game/SkeletonRead.hpp"

namespace OW::NativeHitboxes {
// One current scatter payload serves semantic translations and native poses.
// Plans retain capacity, never read completion or a pose from the previous batch.
struct PosePlan {
    std::vector<Skeleton::PoseRange> ranges;
    std::vector<uint8_t> data;
    void Clear() { ranges.clear(); data.clear(); }
    bool Build(std::span<const int> semantic, std::span<const uint16_t> native, size_t boneCount, uint64_t bonesBase) {
        Clear();
        if (!boneCount || boneCount > Skeleton::MaxBones) return false;
        std::array<bool, Skeleton::MaxBones> selected{};
        for (int index : semantic) {
            if (index < 0 || size_t(index) >= boneCount) return false;
            selected[index] = true;
        }
        for (auto index : native) {
            if (index >= boneCount) return false;
            selected[index] = true;
        }
        size_t bytes = 0;
        for (size_t first = 0; first < boneCount;) {
            if (!selected[first]) { ++first; continue; }
            size_t last = first;
            // Scatter operates on pages. Merge holes only within a page already
            // needed by a selected pose, avoiding both redundant requests and
            // new pages. A 48-byte pose crossing a page remains one exact read.
            while (last + 1 < boneCount) {
                size_t next=last+1;
                while(next<boneCount && !selected[next])++next;
                if(next==boneCount || (bonesBase+next*48)/4096 > (bonesBase+(last+1)*48-1)/4096)break;
                last=next;
            }
            const size_t size = (last - first + 1) * sizeof(ModelShapes::Pose);
            ranges.push_back({int(first), int(last), bytes, size, 0});
            bytes += size;
            first = last + 1;
        }
        data.resize(bytes);
        return !ranges.empty();
    }
    const Skeleton::PoseRange* CompleteRange(int index) const {
        for (const auto& range : ranges)
            if (range.prepared && index >= range.first && index <= range.last && range.bytes == range.size &&
                range.offset <= data.size() && range.size <= data.size() - range.offset)
                return &range;
        return nullptr;
    }
    bool Read(int index, ModelShapes::Pose& pose) const {
        const auto* range = CompleteRange(index);
        if (!range) return false;
        std::memcpy(&pose, data.data() + range->offset + size_t(index-range->first)*48, sizeof(pose));
        return true;
    }
    Skeleton::PoseRange TranslationView(int index) const {
        const auto* range = CompleteRange(index);
        if (!range) return {index,index,0,12,0,false};
        return {index,index,range->offset + size_t(index-range->first)*48 + 32,12,12,true};
    }
};
```

```hpp
inline const char* TierName(Tier tier)
{
    switch (tier) {
    case Tier::Ordered: return "ordered";
    case Tier::Cluster: return "cluster";
    case Tier::UniqueNo338: return "hero_e44_e78_unique_no338";
    case Tier::Multiset: return "hero_e44_e78_multiset";
    default: return "unknown";
    }
}
```

```hpp
    {

    uint16_t component22_0202 = 0;
    bool component22_0203Read = false;
    uint8_t component22_0203 = 0;
    bool component22_0350Read = false;
    uint16_t component22_0350 = 0;
    uint64_t component7fBase = 0;
    bool component7fD4Read = false;
    uint64_t component7fD4 = 0;
    bool component7fD8Read = false;
    uint32_t component7fD8 = 0;

    uint64_t component7fD8Qword = 0;
    uint64_t component7fScanHash = 0;
    size_t component7fScanReadCount = 0;
    size_t component7fScanNonzeroCount = 0;
    std::array<bool, kAnaComponent7fScanQwordCount> component7fScanRead{};

    bool component7fRawSlotBitsetRead = false;

    bool component7fRawSlotIndexRead = false;

    bool component7fRawSlotTablePlausible = false;

    uint8_t component7fRawSlotIndexBase = 0;
    uint64_t component7fRawSlotComponentIndex = 0;
    uint64_t component7fRawSlotTable = 0;
    uint64_t component7fRawSlotBase = 0;
    bool component7fRawSlotD8Read = false;
    uint32_t component7fRawSlotD8 = 0;
    bool component7fRawSlotD8QwordRead = false;

    std::array<bool, kAnaComponent7fRawSlotScanQwordCount> component7fRawSlotScanRead{};
    std::array<uint64_t, kAnaComponent7fRawSlotScanQwordCount> component7fRawSlotScanQword{};
};
```
