```hpp
constexpr bool SequenceWorkerExitRequiresRelease(SequenceWorkerExitReason reason)
{
    return reason == SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged ||
        reason == SequenceWorkerExitReason::AmmoBudget ||
        reason == SequenceWorkerExitReason::OutputFailure;
}

// Returns true only when a sequence may enter its normal start/update path.
// A blocked sequence consumes one observed release tick before it can rearm.
constexpr bool AdvanceSequenceRearmGate(bool& blockedUntilRelease, bool held)
{
    if (!blockedUntilRelease)
        return true;
    if (!held)
        blockedUntilRelease = false;
    return false;
}

constexpr bool SequenceWorkerRuntimeMatches(std::uint64_t startGeneration,
                                            std::uint64_t currentGeneration,
                                            bool outputGateOpen)
{
    return outputGateOpen && startGeneration != 0 &&
        startGeneration == currentGeneration;
}

// A running sequence owns all lower-priority aim/fire producers. Merely
// holding an enabled sequence hotkey also reserves Trigger so an Always slot
// cannot inject shots while the sequence is waiting on an ammo/cooldown gate.
constexpr bool SequenceClaimsExecution(bool sequenceActive,
                                       bool activationHeld,
                                       ExecutionSource requester)
{
    return sequenceActive ||
        (activationHeld && requester == ExecutionSource::Trigger);
}

// Hero-skill tracking still exposes the legacy single-bone selector. Convert
// it explicitly so a temporary tracking overlay cannot inherit a multi-bone
// mask from the currently selected Aim Slot.
constexpr SkeletonBoneMask TrackingBoneMaskForSelection(int aimBone)
{
    switch (aimBone) {
    case Config::kAimBoneChest:
        return kSkeletonBoneChest;
    case Config::kAimBoneNeck:
        return kSkeletonBoneNeck;
    case Config::kAimBoneClosest:
        return kSkeletonBoneHead | kSkeletonBoneNeck | kSkeletonBoneChest;
    case Config::kAimBoneHead:
    default:
        return kSkeletonBoneHead;
    }
}

    // Keep this visible in the UI so we can tune the timing after range tests.
    settings.sequenceSteps = {
        { 0x01,  45 },
        { 0x00, 110 },
        { 0x01,  45 },
        { 0x00, 110 },
        { 0x02, 180 },
        { 0x00, 180 },
    };
    return settings;
}

    settings.cooldownGuard = false;
    settings.prediction = false;
    settings.minTargets = 1;
    settings.radius = 0.0f;

    settings.pitchDownTargetAngle = 90.0f;
    settings.pitchUpOffsetJitter = 1.5f;
    settings.fireDelayMs = 50;
    settings.jumpKeyCode = VK_SPACE;
    return settings;
}

    settings.mode = 0;
    settings.cooldown = cooldown;

    settings.radius = 0.0f;

        0.0f,

    };
    settings.projectileSpeed = projectileSpeed;

    settings.preFireDelayMs = preFireDelayMs;

                definition.controls |= HeroSkillControls::DefensiveConditions;
        }

        for (const HeroSkillHeroEntry& hero : kHeroSkillAutoMeleeHeroes) {
            result.push_back({
                hero.heroId,

                "auto-melee",
                "Auto Melee",

    return definitions;
}

inline size_t HeroSkillDefinitionCount()
{
    return AllHeroSkillDefinitions().size();
}

inline bool IsHeroSkillVariantRequirementSatisfied(const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                                   uint64_t heroId)
{
    switch (definition.variantRequirement) {
    case RuntimeVariantRequirement::PerkOn:
        return HeroPerkRuntime::IsEffectivePerkOn(heroId);
    case RuntimeVariantRequirement::None:
    default:
        return true;
    }
}

inline bool IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                                  uint64_t heroId)
{
    if (definition.heroId != heroId)
        return false;
    if (!IsHeroSkillVariantRequirementSatisfied(definition, heroId))
        return false;

    if (definition.variantRequirement == RuntimeVariantRequirement::None) {
        const char* skillId = definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "";
        for (const HeroSkillDefinition& candidate : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
            if (candidate.heroId != heroId ||
                candidate.variantRequirement == RuntimeVariantRequirement::None ||
                !candidate.replacesSkillId ||
                std::string(candidate.replacesSkillId) != skillId) {
                continue;
            }

            if (IsHeroSkillVariantRequirementSatisfied(candidate, heroId))
                return false;
        }
    }

    return true;
}

inline int CountHeroSkillDefinitions(uint64_t heroId)
{
    int count = 0;
    for (const HeroSkillDefinition& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, heroId))
            ++count;
    }
    return count;
}

} // namespace OW
```

`include/Game/HostInteractionState.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
namespace V2::HostInteraction {
enum class Source { Unavailable, VerifiedHost };
struct Sample {
    Source source=Source::Unavailable;
    uint64_t connectionEpoch=0;
    uint32_t tick=0;
    bool chatKnown=false, chatOpen=false, focusKnown=false, gameFocused=false;
};
inline std::atomic<std::shared_ptr<const Sample>> published{std::make_shared<Sample>()};
inline std::atomic<bool> paused{false};
inline void Publish(Sample value){published.store(std::make_shared<Sample>(value),std::memory_order_release);}
inline bool Fresh(const Sample& s,uint64_t epoch,uint32_t now){return s.source==Source::VerifiedHost&&s.connectionEpoch==epoch&&s.tick&&uint32_t(now-s.tick)<=250;}
inline bool ShouldPause(const Sample& s,bool onChat,bool onFocusLoss,uint64_t epoch,uint32_t now){
    if(!onChat&&!onFocusLoss)return false;
    // Enabled policies fail closed if a formerly available host sample becomes stale.
    if(!Fresh(s,epoch,now))return true;
    return (onChat&&(!s.chatKnown||s.chatOpen))||(onFocusLoss&&(!s.focusKnown||!s.gameFocused));
}
}
```

```hpp
#include <algorithm>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW {

struct ProjectileRuntimeSpec {

    bool directHitOnly = true;
};

struct LeadTimingEstimate {
    float estimatedSettleMs = 0.0f;
    int inputDelayMs = 0;
    float preFireDelayMs = 0.0f;
};

struct AimSettleEstimateInput {
    Vector3 localAngle{};
    Vector3 targetAngle{};
    int method = 0;
    float slotSpeedScale = 1.0f;
    float methodSpeedScale = 1.0f;
    float constantAngularSpeedDeg = 30.0f;
    float frameSeconds = 1.0f / 144.0f;
};

struct LeadPredictionResult {
    bool predictionEnabled = false;
    bool secondary = false;
    Vector3 rawAimPoint{};
    Vector3 preFireAimPoint{};
    Vector3 finalAimPoint{};
    Vector3 targetVelocity{};
    Vector3 localVelocity{};
    bool relativeMotion = false;
    ProjectileRuntimeSpec projectile{};
    LeadTimingEstimate timing{};
    float distance = 0.0f;
};

inline NativeHitWindowInput MakeNativeHitWindowInput(const LeadPredictionResult& lead, AimClass aimClass,
                                                     float hitboxScalePercent)
{
    const auto& projectile = lead.projectile;
    const bool instantHit = projectile.projectileSpeed <= 0.0f &&
        (aimClass == AimClass::HitscanSingle || aimClass == AimClass::HitscanAuto || aimClass == AimClass::HitscanBurst);
    const bool straightProjectile = lead.predictionEnabled && projectile.directHitOnly &&
        projectile.projectileSpeed > 0.0f &&
        (aimClass == AimClass::ProjectileSingle || aimClass == AimClass::ProjectileAuto || aimClass == AimClass::ProjectileExplosive);
    if (!instantHit && !straightProjectile)
        return {};

    NativeHitWindowInput input{};
    input.projectileRadius = projectile.projectileRadius;
    input.hitboxScalePercent = hitboxScalePercent;
    input.projectileSpeed = projectile.projectileSpeed;
    input.gravity = projectile.gravity;
    input.gravityAcceleration = projectile.gravityAcceleration;
    if (straightProjectile) {
        // A moving target reduces to a stationary capsule in the projectile's
        // relative frame after advancing the target through the pre-fire delay.
        input.displacement = lead.targetVelocity * (lead.timing.preFireDelayMs / 1000.0f);
        input.targetVelocity = lead.targetVelocity;
        input.launchUpBias = projectile.launchDirectionUpBias;
    } else {
        input.displacement = lead.finalAimPoint - lead.rawAimPoint;
    }
    return input;
}

inline constexpr float kLeadDefaultFrameSeconds = 1.0f / 144.0f;
inline constexpr float kLeadMinFrameSeconds = 1.0f / 1000.0f;
inline constexpr float kLeadMaxFrameSeconds = 0.1f;
inline constexpr float kLeadSettleEpsilonRad = 0.0005f;
inline constexpr float kLeadMaxSettleMs = 250.0f;
inline constexpr float kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs = 300.0f;
inline constexpr float kLeadMaxTargetSpeed = 250.0f;
inline constexpr float kLeadRadToDeg = 57.29577951308232f;

inline bool IsFiniteLeadVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
}

inline Vector3 ApplyPredictionMotionModel(const Vector3& targetVelocity,
                                           const Vector3& localVelocity,
                                           int algorithm)
{
    const Vector3 effective = IsRelativeMotionPredictionAlgorithm(algorithm)
        ? targetVelocity - localVelocity : targetVelocity;
    const float length = effective.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(length) || length <= kLeadMaxTargetSpeed)
        return IsFiniteLeadVector(effective) ? effective : Vector3{};
    return effective * (kLeadMaxTargetSpeed / length);
}



inline Vector3 CompensateProjectileLaunchBias(const Vector3& camera,
                                             const Vector3& ballisticAimPoint,
                                             float upBias)
{
    if (upBias == 0.0f || !std::isfinite(upBias) || std::fabs(upBias) >= 1.0f ||
        !IsFiniteLeadVector(camera) || !IsFiniteLeadVector(ballisticAimPoint))
        return ballisticAimPoint;

    const Vector3 offset = ballisticAimPoint - camera;
    const float distance = offset.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.000001f)
        return ballisticAimPoint;

    const Vector3 launchDirection = offset / distance;
    // Invert launch = normalize(view + upBias * worldUp), preserving aim distance.
    const float scale = upBias * launchDirection.Y + std::sqrt(
        1.0f - upBias * upBias * (1.0f - launchDirection.Y * launchDirection.Y));
    const Vector3 viewDirection = launchDirection * scale - Vector3(0.0f, upBias, 0.0f);
    return camera + viewDirection * distance;
}

inline Vector3 ClampVectorMagnitude(const Vector3& value, float maxLength)
{
    if (!IsFiniteLeadVector(value))
        return Vector3{};

    const float length = value.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(length) || length <= maxLength || length <= 0.000001f)
        return value;

    return value * (maxLength / length);
}

inline float ClampLeadDelayMs(float value, float maxMs = kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(value) || value <= 0.0f)
        return 0.0f;
    return std::clamp(value, 0.0f, maxMs);
}

inline float ClampLeadFrameSeconds(float value)
{
    if (!std::isfinite(value) || value <= 0.0f)
        return kLeadDefaultFrameSeconds;
    return std::clamp(value, kLeadMinFrameSeconds, kLeadMaxFrameSeconds);
}

inline float EstimateAimSettleTimeMs(const AimSettleEstimateInput& input)
{
    const Vector3 error = input.targetAngle - input.localAngle;
    const float errorRad = error.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(errorRad) || errorRad <= kLeadSettleEpsilonRad)
        return 0.0f;

    const int method = std::clamp(input.method, 0, 5);
    const float slotScale = std::isfinite(input.slotSpeedScale)
        ? std::clamp(input.slotSpeedScale, 0.0f, 2.0f)
        : 0.0f;
    const float methodScale = std::isfinite(input.methodSpeedScale)
        ? std::clamp(input.methodSpeedScale, 0.0f, 2.0f)
        : 0.0f;
    const float frameMs = ClampLeadFrameSeconds(input.frameSeconds) * 1000.0f;

    if (method == 5) {
        constexpr float kLeadMaxConstantAngularSpeedDeg = 3600.0f;
        const float baseDegPerSecond = std::isfinite(input.constantAngularSpeedDeg)
            ? std::clamp(input.constantAngularSpeedDeg, 0.0f, kLeadMaxConstantAngularSpeedDeg)
            : 30.0f;
        const float effectiveDegPerSecond = baseDegPerSecond * slotScale * methodScale;
        if (effectiveDegPerSecond <= 0.0001f)
            return kLeadMaxSettleMs;

        const float estimateMs = (errorRad * kLeadRadToDeg / effectiveDegPerSecond) * 1000.0f;
        return ClampLeadDelayMs(estimateMs, kLeadMaxSettleMs);
    }

    const float effectiveStep = std::clamp(slotScale * methodScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    if (effectiveStep <= 0.0001f)
        return kLeadMaxSettleMs;
    if (effectiveStep >= 0.9999f)
        return ClampLeadDelayMs(frameMs, kLeadMaxSettleMs);

    const float ratio = kLeadSettleEpsilonRad / errorRad;
    const float ticks = std::ceil(std::log(ratio) / std::log(1.0f - effectiveStep));
    const float estimateMs = (std::max)(1.0f, ticks) * frameMs;
    return ClampLeadDelayMs(estimateMs, kLeadMaxSettleMs);
}

inline LeadTimingEstimate BuildLeadTiming(float estimatedSettleMs, int inputDelayMs)
{
    LeadTimingEstimate timing{};
    timing.estimatedSettleMs = ClampLeadDelayMs(estimatedSettleMs, kLeadMaxSettleMs);
    timing.inputDelayMs = std::clamp(inputDelayMs, 0, 20);
    timing.preFireDelayMs = ClampLeadDelayMs(
        timing.estimatedSettleMs + static_cast<float>(timing.inputDelayMs),
        kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs);
    return timing;
}

inline Vector3 ApplyTargetMotionPreFireDelay(const Vector3& rawAimPoint,
                                             const Vector3& targetVelocity,
                                             float preFireDelayMs,
                                             float maxPreFireDelayMs = kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs)
{
    if (!IsFiniteLeadVector(rawAimPoint))
        return rawAimPoint;

    const float delaySeconds = ClampLeadDelayMs(preFireDelayMs, maxPreFireDelayMs) / 1000.0f;
    if (delaySeconds <= 0.0f)
        return rawAimPoint;

    const Vector3 safeVelocity = ClampVectorMagnitude(targetVelocity, kLeadMaxTargetSpeed);
    return rawAimPoint + safeVelocity * delaySeconds;
}

inline Vector3 ApplyLegacyLinearPrediction(const Vector3& rawAimPoint,
                                           const Vector3& targetVelocity,
                                           const ProjectileRuntimeSpec& projectile,
                                           float preFireDelayMs)
{
    // Keep the low-dimensional path deliberately small and deterministic. It
    // uses the observed velocity and total shot delay only. It does not infer
    // acceleration or solve a ballistic intercept.
    const float delay = ClampLeadDelayMs(preFireDelayMs, kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs);
    if (delay <= 0.0f || !IsFiniteLeadVector(rawAimPoint))
        return rawAimPoint;
    const Vector3 velocity = ClampVectorMagnitude(targetVelocity, kLeadMaxTargetSpeed);
    return ApplyTargetMotionPreFireDelay(rawAimPoint, velocity, delay);
}

} // namespace OW
```

```hpp
struct Snapshot {
    uint64_t id = 0;
    uint64_t connection = 0;
    uint64_t scene = 0;
    uint64_t sampledAtMs = 0;

    bool Fresh(uint64_t now, uint64_t expectedConnection, uint64_t expectedScene) const {
        return ValidId(id) && sampledAtMs != 0 && now >= sampledAtMs &&
            now - sampledAtMs <= 1500 && connection == expectedConnection && scene == expectedScene;
    }
};

constexpr bool UserPointer(uint64_t value) {
    return value >= 0x10000 && value < 0x800000000000ULL && (value & 7) == 0;
}

// Re-read the owner, encrypted table, slot and ID so a map load cannot mix generations.
template <typename Read, typename Decode>
bool TryRead(Read&& read, Decode&& decode, uint64_t module, uint64_t adminRva, uint64_t& id) {
    id = 0;
    if (!UserPointer(module) || !adminRva) return false;
    uint64_t admin = 0, encrypted = 0, record = 0, candidate = 0;
    if (!read(module + adminRva, &admin, sizeof(admin)) || !UserPointer(admin) ||
        !read(admin + 0x160, &encrypted, sizeof(encrypted)) || !encrypted) return false;
    const uint64_t table = decode(encrypted);
    if (!UserPointer(table) || !read(table + singletonIndex * 8, &record, sizeof(record)) ||
        !UserPointer(record) || !read(record + idOffset, &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) ||
        !ValidId(candidate)) return false;
    uint64_t adminAgain = 0, encryptedAgain = 0, recordAgain = 0, idAgain = 0;
    if (!read(module + adminRva, &adminAgain, sizeof(adminAgain)) || adminAgain != admin ||
        !read(admin + 0x160, &encryptedAgain, sizeof(encryptedAgain)) || encryptedAgain != encrypted ||
        !read(table + singletonIndex * 8, &recordAgain, sizeof(recordAgain)) || recordAgain != record ||
        !read(record + idOffset, &idAgain, sizeof(idAgain)) || idAgain != candidate) return false;
    id = candidate;
    return true;
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Utils/Types.hpp"
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

namespace OW::ModelShapes {
struct Shape { int boneId; Vector3 a, b; float radius; };
#include "Game/TracerModelShapes.inl"
struct Model { uint64_t heroId, modelId; std::span<const Shape> shapes; std::span<const uint32_t> boneIds; };
#include "Game/HeroModelShapes.inl"
inline bool Supported(uint64_t hero) {
    for(const auto& m:kModels)if(m.heroId==hero)return true;
    return false;
}
inline int ResolveModel(uint64_t hero,const uint32_t* ids,size_t count) {
    int match=-1; size_t best=0;
    for(size_t i=0;i<std::size(kModels);++i) {
        const auto& m=kModels[i];
        if(m.heroId!=hero)continue;
        auto present=[&](uint32_t id) {
            for(size_t j=0;j<count;++j)if(static_cast<uint16_t>(ids[j])==id)return true;
            return false;
        };
        size_t bindings=0;
        for(const auto& shape:m.shapes)if(present(shape.boneId))++bindings;
        if(bindings==0)continue;
        size_t shared=0;
        for(auto id:m.boneIds)if(present(id))++shared;
        // Cosmetic bones vary by skin. Missing bindings are skipped; prefer
        // the body skeleton with the largest ID overlap, never a small prop.
        if(shared<best || m.boneIds.size()<16)continue;
        if(shared==best){match=-1;continue;}
        best=shared;match=static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return match;
}

// Candidate runtime SQT record: orientation +0, scale +0x10, translation +0x20.
// shortcut: layout/space needs live calibration before claiming model alignment.
struct Pose {
    float q[4]{};
    float scale[4]{};
    float translation[4]{};
    bool Valid() const {
        float norm=0;
        for(float x:q) { if(!std::isfinite(x))return false; norm+=x*x; }
        if(std::fabs(norm-1.f)>.03f)return false;
        for(int i=0;i<3;++i)
            if(!std::isfinite(scale[i]) || scale[i]<=0 || scale[i]>10 ||
               !std::isfinite(translation[i]) || std::fabs(translation[i])>20)return false;
        return true;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(Pose)==0x30);
struct Sample {
    std::vector<Pose> poses;
    std::vector<uint8_t> valid;
    int modelIndex=-1;
    uint32_t tick=0;
    uint64_t boneData=0;
    uint64_t skeletonRevision=0;
    bool MatchesSkeleton(uint64_t revision) const {
        return revision != 0 && skeletonRevision == revision;
    }
};
inline int FindBone(const uint32_t* ids,size_t count,int id) {
    for(size_t i=0;i<count;++i)
        if(static_cast<uint16_t>(ids[i])==id)return static_cast<int>(i);
    return -1;
}
inline Vector3 Cross(const Vector3& a,const Vector3& b) {
    return {a.Y*b.Z-a.Z*b.Y,a.Z*b.X-a.X*b.Z,a.X*b.Y-a.Y*b.X};
}
inline Vector3 Transform(Vector3 p,const Pose& pose) {
    p={p.X*pose.scale[0],p.Y*pose.scale[1],p.Z*pose.scale[2]};
    Vector3 q{pose.q[0],pose.q[1],pose.q[2]};
    p=p+Cross(q,p)*(2*pose.q[3])+Cross(q,Cross(q,p))*2;
    return p+Vector3(pose.translation[0],pose.translation[1],pose.translation[2]);
}

// Emits local 3D segments; the caller transforms each vertex before projection.
template<class Line> void Wire(const Shape& s,Line line) {
    constexpr int sides=12, capSteps=4;
    constexpr float pi=3.14159265358979323846f;
    Vector3 d=s.b-s.a;
    const float length=d.Size();
    const bool sphere=length<1.e-6f;
    Vector3 axis=sphere?Vector3(0,1,0):d*(1.f/length);
    Vector3 u=Cross(axis,std::fabs(axis.Y)<.9f?Vector3(0,1,0):Vector3(1,0,0));
    u=u*(1.f/u.Size());
    const Vector3 w=Cross(axis,u);
    auto radial=[&](float phi){return u*std::cos(phi)+w*std::sin(phi);};
    auto ring=[&](Vector3 c,float r){
        for(int i=0;i<sides;++i)line(c+radial(2*pi*i/sides)*r,c+radial(2*pi*(i+1)/sides)*r);
    };
    ring(s.a,s.radius);
    if(!sphere)ring(s.b,s.radius);
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i) {
        Vector3 radialAxis=radial(pi*i/2);
        if(!sphere)line(s.a+radialAxis*s.radius,s.b+radialAxis*s.radius);
        for(int end=0;end<2;++end) {
            Vector3 c=end?s.b:s.a;
            const float sign=end?1.f:-1.f;
            for(int j=0;j<capSteps;++j) {
                auto point=[&](int k){float t=pi*.5f*k/capSteps;return c+(radialAxis*std::cos(t)+axis*(sign*std::sin(t)))*s.radius;};
                line(point(j),point(j+1));
            }
        }
    }
}
}
```

`include/Game/ModelWireMesh.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <unordered_map>
#include "Game/ModelShapes.hpp"

namespace OW::ModelShapes {
struct WireMesh {
    std::vector<Vector3> vertices;
    std::vector<std::array<uint16_t,2>> edges;
};
inline WireMesh BuildWireMesh(const Shape& shape) {
    WireMesh mesh;
    mesh.vertices.reserve(120);mesh.edges.reserve(60);
    const auto index=[&](Vector3 point) {
        // Exact equality preserves the previous wire's endpoints and segments.
        for(size_t i=0;i<mesh.vertices.size();++i)
            if(mesh.vertices[i]==point)return uint16_t(i);
        mesh.vertices.push_back(point);
        return uint16_t(mesh.vertices.size()-1);
    };
    Wire(shape,[&](Vector3 a,Vector3 b){mesh.edges.push_back({index(a),index(b)});});
    return mesh;
}
struct WireKey {
    std::array<uint32_t,7> values{};
    explicit WireKey(const Shape& shape):values{
        std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.a.X),std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.a.Y),std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.a.Z),
        std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.b.X),std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.b.Y),std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.b.Z),
        std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(shape.radius)} {}
    bool operator==(const WireKey&) const = default;
};
struct WireKeyHash {
    size_t operator()(const WireKey& key) const {
        size_t hash=1469598103934665603ull;
        for(auto value:key.values) { hash^=value;hash*=1099511628211ull; }
        return hash;
    }
};
class WireCache {
    struct Entry { WireMesh mesh; uint64_t used; };
    std::unordered_map<WireKey,Entry,WireKeyHash> entries;
    uint64_t sequence=0;
public:
    static constexpr size_t Limit=512;
    uint64_t hits=0,misses=0;
    const WireMesh& Get(const Shape& shape) {
        const WireKey key(shape);
        auto found=entries.find(key);
        if(found!=entries.end()) { ++hits;found->second.used=++sequence;return found->second.mesh; }
        ++misses;
        if(entries.size()>=Limit) {
            auto oldest=entries.begin();
            for(auto it=entries.begin();it!=entries.end();++it)
                if(it->second.used<oldest->second.used)oldest=it;
            entries.erase(oldest);
        }
        return entries.emplace(key,Entry{BuildWireMesh(shape),++sequence}).first->second.mesh;
    }
    size_t Size() const { return entries.size(); }
};
// Totals are diagnostics only. Cache and per-frame coordinates belong to the
// calling render thread; the test server observes only relaxed atomic counters.
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> WireCacheHits{0},WireCacheMisses{0},WireProjectedVertices{0},WireCandidateSegments{0};
template<class World,class Project,class Line>
bool ProjectWireMesh(const WireMesh& mesh,World&& world,Project&& project,Line&& line) {
    std::array<Vector2,120> screen{};
    std::array<bool,120> visible{};
    if(mesh.vertices.size()>screen.size())return false;
    for(size_t v=0;v<mesh.vertices.size();++v)
        visible[v]=project(world(mesh.vertices[v]),screen[v]) && std::isfinite(screen[v].X) && std::isfinite(screen[v].Y);
    bool drew=false;
    for(const auto& edge:mesh.edges)
        if(visible[edge[0]] && visible[edge[1]]) { line(screen[edge[0]],screen[edge[1]]);drew=true; }
    return drew;
}
inline WireCache& RenderWireCache() { static thread_local WireCache cache;return cache; }
template<class World,class Project,class Line>
bool DrawCachedWire(const Shape& shape,World&& world,Project&& project,Line&& line) {
    auto& cache=RenderWireCache();
    const auto misses=cache.misses;
    const auto& mesh=cache.Get(shape);
    (cache.misses==misses?WireCacheHits:WireCacheMisses).fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed);
    WireProjectedVertices.fetch_add(mesh.vertices.size(),std::memory_order_relaxed);
    WireCandidateSegments.fetch_add(mesh.edges.size(),std::memory_order_relaxed);
    return ProjectWireMesh(mesh,world,project,line);
}
}
```

`include/Game/ModelWorldTransform.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW::ModelWorld {

// CN trial input at model +0x3B0. Keep all 48 captured bytes; the fourth scale
// and translation floats are padding and may contain NaN.
struct QstRecord {
    float q[4]{};
    float scale[4]{};
    float translation[4]{};

    bool Valid() const {
        float norm = 0.f;
        for (float x : q) {
            if (!std::isfinite(x)) return false;
            norm += x * x;
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(norm) || std::fabs(norm - 1.f) > .03f) return false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            if (!std::isfinite(scale[i]) || scale[i] <= 0.f || scale[i] > 10.f ||
                !std::isfinite(translation[i]) || std::fabs(translation[i]) >= 5000.f)
                return false;
        }
        // Translation is a world origin: ModelShapes::Pose's local +/-20
        // bound is deliberately inapplicable. 5000 matches spatial anchors.
        return true;
    }
};
static_assert(sizeof(QstRecord) == 0x30);
static_assert(offsetof(QstRecord, scale) == 0x10);
static_assert(offsetof(QstRecord, translation) == 0x20);

// Copied with the entity snapshot. Rows implement scale -> quaternion ->
// translation, without silently normalizing the captured quaternion.
struct Sample {
    QstRecord record{};
    float matrix[3][4]{};
    Vector3 sampleAnchor{};
    uint64_t modelBase = 0;
    bool valid = false;

    bool Set(uint64_t model, const QstRecord& value) {
        const QstRecord captured = value; // Set may rebind this sample's own record.
        *this = {};
        if (!model || !captured.Valid()) return false;
        record = captured;
        modelBase = model;
        const float x=captured.q[0], y=captured.q[1], z=captured.q[2], w=captured.q[3];
        const float sx=captured.scale[0], sy=captured.scale[1], sz=captured.scale[2];
        matrix[0][0]=(1.f-2.f*(y*y+z*z))*sx;
        matrix[0][1]=2.f*(x*y-w*z)*sy;
        matrix[0][2]=2.f*(x*z+w*y)*sz;
        matrix[1][0]=2.f*(x*y+w*z)*sx;
        matrix[1][1]=(1.f-2.f*(x*x+z*z))*sy;
        matrix[1][2]=2.f*(y*z-w*x)*sz;
        matrix[2][0]=2.f*(x*z-w*y)*sx;
        matrix[2][1]=2.f*(y*z+w*x)*sy;
        matrix[2][2]=(1.f-2.f*(x*x+y*y))*sz;
        for (size_t i=0; i<3; ++i) matrix[i][3]=captured.translation[i];
        valid = true;
        return true;
    }

    Vector3 TransformVector(const Vector3& p) const {
        if (!valid) return {};
        return {matrix[0][0]*p.X+matrix[0][1]*p.Y+matrix[0][2]*p.Z,
                matrix[1][0]*p.X+matrix[1][1]*p.Y+matrix[1][2]*p.Z,
                matrix[2][0]*p.X+matrix[2][1]*p.Y+matrix[2][2]*p.Z};
    }

    Vector3 TransformPoint(const Vector3& p) const {
        if (!valid) return {};
        const Vector3 v = TransformVector(p);
        return {v.X+matrix[0][3], v.Y+matrix[1][3], v.Z+matrix[2][3]};
    }
};

} // namespace OW::ModelWorld
```

`include/Game/Motion.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

#include "Utils/Types.hpp"

namespace OW::Motion {

enum class VelocitySource : int {
    None,
    Reported,
    WorldDeltaFallback,
};

struct EntityMotionEstimate {
    Vector3 reportedVelocity{};
    Vector3 worldDeltaVelocity{};
    Vector3 effectiveVelocity{};
    Vector3 reportedAcceleration{};
    float sampleSeconds = 0.0f;
    float reportedSpeed = 0.0f;
    float worldDeltaSpeed = 0.0f;
    float effectiveSpeed = 0.0f;
    float confidence = 0.0f;
    VelocitySource velocitySource = VelocitySource::None;
    bool hasReportedVelocity = false;
    bool hasWorldDeltaVelocity = false;
    bool usedWorldDeltaFallback = false;
    bool valid = false;
};

inline constexpr float kMinSampleSeconds = 0.004f;
inline constexpr float kMaxSampleSeconds = 0.250f;
inline constexpr float kMaxReasonableSpeed = 250.0f;
inline constexpr float kReportedStillSpeed = 0.75f;
inline constexpr float kWorldDeltaFallbackMinSpeed = 1.0f;

inline bool IsFiniteVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
}

inline bool IsNonZeroVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    return value != Vector3(0, 0, 0);
}

inline float VectorLength(const Vector3& value)
{
    return std::sqrt(value.X * value.X + value.Y * value.Y + value.Z * value.Z);
}

inline bool IsReasonableVelocity(const Vector3& velocity, float* speedOut = nullptr)
{
    if (!IsFiniteVector(velocity)) {
        if (speedOut) *speedOut = 0.0f;
        return false;
    }

    const float speed = VectorLength(velocity);
    if (speedOut) *speedOut = speed;
    return std::isfinite(speed) && speed <= kMaxReasonableSpeed;
}

template <typename EntityLike>
inline float SampleSeconds(const EntityLike& entity)
{
    if constexpr(requires { entity.sample_time_us; entity.previous_sample_time_us; }) {
        if(entity.previous_sample_time_us && entity.sample_time_us>entity.previous_sample_time_us) {
            const float dt=float(entity.sample_time_us-entity.previous_sample_time_us)/1000000.f;
            return dt>=kMinSampleSeconds && dt<=kMaxSampleSeconds?dt:0.f;
        }
    }
    if (!entity.has_previous_render_sample ||
        entity.previous_render_sample_tick_ms == 0 ||
        entity.render_sample_tick_ms == 0 ||
        entity.render_sample_tick_ms <= entity.previous_render_sample_tick_ms) {
        return 0.0f;
    }

    const float dt = static_cast<float>(
        entity.render_sample_tick_ms - entity.previous_render_sample_tick_ms) / 1000.0f;
    if (dt < kMinSampleSeconds || dt > kMaxSampleSeconds)
        return 0.0f;

    return dt;
}

template <typename EntityLike>
inline EntityMotionEstimate EstimateEntityMotion(const EntityLike& entity)
{
    EntityMotionEstimate estimate{};
    estimate.reportedVelocity = entity.velocity;
    estimate.sampleSeconds = SampleSeconds(entity);
    estimate.hasReportedVelocity =
        IsReasonableVelocity(estimate.reportedVelocity, &estimate.reportedSpeed);

    if (estimate.sampleSeconds > 0.0f &&
        IsFiniteVector(entity.pos) &&
        IsFiniteVector(entity.previous_pos) &&
        IsNonZeroVector(entity.pos) &&
        IsNonZeroVector(entity.previous_pos)) {
        estimate.worldDeltaVelocity = (entity.pos - entity.previous_pos) / estimate.sampleSeconds;
        estimate.hasWorldDeltaVelocity =
            IsReasonableVelocity(estimate.worldDeltaVelocity, &estimate.worldDeltaSpeed);

        float previousReportedSpeed = 0.0f;
        if (estimate.hasReportedVelocity &&
            IsReasonableVelocity(entity.previous_velocity, &previousReportedSpeed)) {
            estimate.reportedAcceleration =
                (estimate.reportedVelocity - entity.previous_velocity) / estimate.sampleSeconds;
        }
    }

    if (estimate.hasWorldDeltaVelocity &&
        (!estimate.hasReportedVelocity ||
         (estimate.reportedSpeed <= kReportedStillSpeed &&
          estimate.worldDeltaSpeed >= kWorldDeltaFallbackMinSpeed))) {
        estimate.effectiveVelocity = estimate.worldDeltaVelocity;
        estimate.effectiveSpeed = estimate.worldDeltaSpeed;
        estimate.velocitySource = VelocitySource::WorldDeltaFallback;
        estimate.usedWorldDeltaFallback = true;
        estimate.confidence = estimate.hasReportedVelocity ? 0.60f : 0.50f;
        estimate.valid = true;
        return estimate;
    }

    if (estimate.hasReportedVelocity) {
        estimate.effectiveVelocity = estimate.reportedVelocity;
        estimate.effectiveSpeed = estimate.reportedSpeed;
        estimate.velocitySource = VelocitySource::Reported;
        estimate.confidence = 0.70f;
        estimate.valid = true;
        return estimate;
    }

    estimate.confidence = 0.10f;
    return estimate;
}

} // namespace OW::Motion
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <Windows.h>
#include <array>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include "Game/ModelShapes.hpp"
#include "Game/ModelWorldTransform.hpp"
#include "Game/SkeletonRead.hpp"
#include "Game/GeometryPosePlan.hpp"

namespace OW::NativeHitboxes {
inline bool Pointer(uint64_t p) { return p>=0x10000 && p<0x800000000000 && !(p&7); }
template<class T> T Field(const void* p,size_t at) { T v{};std::memcpy(&v,static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p)+at,sizeof(v));return v; }
struct Layout {
    uint64_t modelBase=0,revision=0,root=0,spheres=0,capsules=0;
    uint32_t sphereCount=0,capsuleCount=0;
    std::array<uint8_t,48> header{};
    // A read plan only. Current content is reread and its binding is resolved
    // against current, complete pose ranges before publishing each sample.
    std::vector<uint16_t> boneIndices;
    bool valid=false;
    bool Matches(uint64_t model,uint64_t rev) const { return valid && model==modelBase && rev && rev==revision; }
};
inline bool CollectBindings(std::vector<uint16_t>& out, std::span<const uint8_t> spheres,
                            std::span<const uint8_t> capsules, size_t boneCount) {
    out.clear();
    if (!boneCount || boneCount > Skeleton::MaxBones || spheres.size()%64 || capsules.size()%80) return false;
    const auto collect=[&](std::span<const uint8_t> bytes,size_t stride,size_t at) {
        for(size_t offset=0;offset<bytes.size();offset+=stride) {
            const auto index=Field<uint16_t>(bytes.data()+offset,at);
            if(index>=boneCount)return false;
            out.push_back(index);
        }
        return true;
    };
    if(!collect(spheres,64,48) || !collect(capsules,80,64)) { out.clear(); return false; }
    std::sort(out.begin(),out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(),out.end()),out.end());
    return true;
}
template<class Read> bool LoadLayout(Layout& out,uint64_t model,uint64_t revision,size_t boneCount,Read&& read) {
    out={};out.modelBase=model;out.revision=revision;
    if(!model || !revision || !read(model+0xC8,&out.root,8) || !Pointer(out.root) ||
       !read(out.root,out.header.data(),out.header.size()))return false;
    out.spheres=Field<uint64_t>(out.header.data(),8);out.capsules=Field<uint64_t>(out.header.data(),16);
    out.sphereCount=Field<uint32_t>(out.header.data(),40);out.capsuleCount=Field<uint32_t>(out.header.data(),44);
    out.valid=out.sphereCount<=128 && out.capsuleCount<=128 &&
        (!out.sphereCount || Pointer(out.spheres)) && (!out.capsuleCount || Pointer(out.capsules));
    if(!out.valid)return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> spheres(size_t(out.sphereCount)*64),capsules(size_t(out.capsuleCount)*80);
    out.valid=(!spheres.size() || read(out.spheres,spheres.data(),spheres.size())) &&
        (!capsules.size() || read(out.capsules,capsules.data(),capsules.size())) &&
        CollectBindings(out.boneIndices,spheres,capsules,boneCount);
    return out.valid;
}
struct Sample {
    uint64_t modelBase=0,root=0,skeletonRevision=0;
    uint32_t tick=0;
    ModelWorld::Sample world{};
    std::vector<ModelShapes::Shape> shapes;
    std::vector<ModelShapes::Pose> poses;
    bool Matches(uint64_t model,uint64_t revision) const {
        return tick && world.valid && model==modelBase && revision && revision==skeletonRevision && !shapes.empty() && shapes.size()==poses.size();
    }
};
struct Capture {
    Layout layout{};
    uint64_t observedRoot=0;
    std::array<uint8_t,48> observedHeader{};
    std::vector<uint8_t> spheres,capsules;
    DWORD rootBytes=0,headerBytes=0,sphereBytes=0,capsuleBytes=0;
    bool prepared=false;
    void Reset(const Layout& value) {
        layout=value;observedRoot=0;observedHeader={};
        rootBytes=headerBytes=sphereBytes=capsuleBytes=0;prepared=false;
        spheres.clear();capsules.clear();
        if(!value.valid)return;
        spheres.resize(size_t(value.sphereCount)*64);capsules.resize(size_t(value.capsuleCount)*80);prepared=true;
    }
    bool Complete() const {
        return prepared && rootBytes==8 && headerBytes==48 && observedRoot==layout.root && observedHeader==layout.header &&
            sphereBytes==spheres.size() && capsuleBytes==capsules.size();
    }
    bool RefreshBindings(Layout& target,size_t boneCount) const {
        if(!Complete() || !target.Matches(layout.modelBase,layout.revision) || target.root!=layout.root)return false;
        return CollectBindings(target.boneIndices,spheres,capsules,boneCount);
    }
    Sample Commit(uint64_t revision,uint32_t tick,const ModelWorld::Sample& world,
                  const PosePlan& plan, const ModelShapes::Model* model = nullptr,
                  std::span<const int> shapeMapped = {}) const {
        Sample out{};
        if(!Complete() || revision!=layout.revision || !world.valid || world.modelBase!=layout.modelBase)return out;
        out.modelBase=layout.modelBase;out.root=layout.root;out.skeletonRevision=revision;out.tick=tick;
        out.world=world;
        out.shapes.reserve(layout.sphereCount+layout.capsuleCount);
        out.poses.reserve(layout.sphereCount+layout.capsuleCount);
        std::vector<bool> modelShapeUsed(model ? model->shapes.size() : 0, false);
        const auto append=[&](const std::vector<uint8_t>& data,size_t stride,size_t indexAt,size_t radiusAt,bool sphere) {
            for(size_t at=0;at<data.size();at+=stride) {
                const auto index=Field<uint16_t>(data.data()+at,indexAt);
                ModelShapes::Pose pose{};
                if(!plan.Read(index,pose) || !pose.Valid())return false;
                ModelShapes::Shape shape{};
                shape.boneId = -1;
                if (model) {
                    // Bind by the observed native bone index captured during
                    // skeleton layout resolution.  Collection order is not a
                    // stable contract between capsule and sphere arrays.
                    for (size_t candidate = 0; candidate < model->shapes.size(); ++candidate) {
                        if (candidate >= shapeMapped.size() || modelShapeUsed[candidate] ||
                            shapeMapped[candidate] != static_cast<int>(index))
                            continue;
                        shape.boneId = model->shapes[candidate].boneId;
                        modelShapeUsed[candidate] = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                shape.a=Field<Vector3>(data.data()+at,0);shape.b=sphere?shape.a:Field<Vector3>(data.data()+at,16);
                shape.radius=Field<float>(data.data()+at,radiusAt);
                if(!std::isfinite(shape.radius) || shape.radius<=0 || shape.radius>10)return false;
                for(auto p:{shape.a,shape.b})if(!std::isfinite(p.X)||!std::isfinite(p.Y)||!std::isfinite(p.Z)||p.Size()>20)return false;
                out.shapes.push_back(shape);out.poses.push_back(pose);
            }
            return true;
        };
        // Native collections can contain several damage/activation classes; preserve
        // the decoded set for this display trial without inventing activation flags.
        if(!append(capsules,80,64,32,false) || !append(spheres,64,48,16,true))return {};
        return out;
    }
};
}
```

```hpp
inline constexpr std::string_view ProtectedSignature =
    "B9 AA 65 E0 00 4C 03 C2 0F B6 10 48 B8 ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? "
    "49 C1 C8 ?? 4C 33 C0 48 B8 ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? ?? 49 03 C0 "

    "66 0F 6E C8 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? B0 01 48 83 C4 20 5B C3";
inline constexpr std::string_view WorldSignature =
    "B9 AA 65 E0 00 48 8B 14 D0 48 81 C2 ?? ?? ?? ?? E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? "
    "48 8B 4C 24 50 66 0F 6E C8 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? B0 01 48 83 C4 20 5B C3";
struct Build {
    uint32_t timestamp, imageSize, root, getter, selector, lookup;
    bool world;
    std::span<const uint8_t> getterCode, lookupCode;
};
inline const Build* ForProfile(offset::RuntimeProfile profile) {
    static const Build cn{0x6AEBE914, 0x5A98000, 0x4DD70A0, 0xDDAF20,
        0x8A60A0, 0x337AF40, false, CnGetter, CnLookup};
    static const Build world{0x6AEBEABB, 0x4876000, 0x3BB7E10, 0xB8F090,
        0x7A8520, 0x2D5B8D0, true, WorldGetter, WorldLookup};
    static const Build nexon{0x6AEBEA26, 0x4D6B000, 0x409D740, 0xDC5280,
        0x89CC80, 0x33663A0, false, NexonGetter, NexonLookup};
    switch (profile) {
    case offset::RuntimeProfile::Cn: return &cn;
    case offset::RuntimeProfile::World155284: return &world;
    case offset::RuntimeProfile::Nexon155284: return &nexon;
    default: return nullptr;
    }
}
inline uint64_t DecodeSlots(uint64_t encoded, bool world) {
    if (world)
        return std::rotr((std::rotr(encoded, 3) ^ 0x6B8F56BF98CC7D09ULL) -
                         0x347A21D46B3B2903ULL, 63) + 0x130305262FA1386AULL;
    return (std::rotr(std::rotr(encoded, 1) + 0xE4A74035D2D1853DULL, 36) ^
            0x9ACE05FA7D7CF0CBULL) + 0x57A241D065E55B43ULL;
}
template<class T> T Load(const uint8_t* data) {
    T value{}; std::memcpy(&value, data, sizeof(value)); return value;
}
inline int Hex(char c) {
    return c >= '0' && c <= '9' ? c - '0' : c >= 'A' && c <= 'F' ? c - 'A' + 10 : -1;
}
inline bool MatchAob(std::span<const uint8_t> bytes, std::string_view pattern) {
    size_t index = 0;
    for (size_t p = 0; p < pattern.size();) {
        if (pattern[p] == ' ') { ++p; continue; }
        if (p + 1 >= pattern.size() || index >= bytes.size()) return false;
        if (pattern[p] != '?' || pattern[p + 1] != '?') {
            const int hi = Hex(pattern[p]), lo = Hex(pattern[p + 1]);
            if (hi < 0 || lo < 0 || bytes[index] != uint8_t(hi * 16 + lo)) return false;
        }
        ++index; p += 2;
    }
    return index == bytes.size();
}
template<class Read>
Status ValidateCode(uint64_t base, const Build& build, Read read) {
    if (!Pointer(base) || !Pointer(base + build.imageSize)) return Status::InvalidTarget;
    std::array<uint8_t, 64> dos{};
    if (!read(base, dos.data(), dos.size())) return Status::ReadFailed;
    const auto ntOffset = Load<uint32_t>(dos.data() + 0x3C);
    if (Load<uint16_t>(dos.data()) != 0x5A4D || ntOffset < 64 || ntOffset > 0x100000)
        return Status::IdentityMismatch;
    std::array<uint8_t, 0x58> nt{};
    if (!read(base + ntOffset, nt.data(), nt.size())) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (Load<uint32_t>(nt.data()) != 0x4550 || Load<uint16_t>(nt.data() + 4) != 0x8664 ||
        Load<uint16_t>(nt.data() + 0x14) < 0xF0 || Load<uint16_t>(nt.data() + 0x18) != 0x20B ||
        Load<uint32_t>(nt.data() + 8) != build.timestamp ||
        Load<uint32_t>(nt.data() + 0x50) != build.imageSize) return Status::IdentityMismatch;
    std::array<uint8_t, 512> code{};
    if (build.getterCode.size() > code.size() || build.lookupCode.size() > code.size())
        return Status::SignatureMismatch;
    if (!read(base + build.getter, code.data(), build.getterCode.size())) return Status::ReadFailed;
    const auto getter = std::span<const uint8_t>(code.data(), build.getterCode.size());
    const size_t keyOffset = build.world ? 0x7A : 0x55;
    if (getter.size() <= keyOffset || !MatchAob(getter.subspan(keyOffset),
            build.world ? WorldSignature : ProtectedSignature) ||
        std::memcmp(code.data(), build.getterCode.data(), build.getterCode.size()) != 0)
        return Status::SignatureMismatch;
    // Getter+30: mov rbx,[rip+disp32]. The AOB match is an instruction, not a root.
    const auto root = int64_t(build.getter) + 0x37 + Load<int32_t>(code.data() + 0x33);
    if (root != build.root) return Status::SignatureMismatch;
    constexpr std::array<uint8_t, 7> selector{0xC6, 0x01, 0x0A, 0x48, 0x8B, 0xC1, 0xC3};
    if (!read(base + build.selector, code.data(), selector.size())) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (std::memcmp(code.data(), selector.data(), selector.size())) return Status::SignatureMismatch;
    if (!read(base + build.lookup, code.data(), build.lookupCode.size())) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (std::memcmp(code.data(), build.lookupCode.data(), build.lookupCode.size()))
        return Status::SignatureMismatch;
    return Status::Ready;
}
struct Target {
    uint64_t base = 0, owner = 0, encoded = 0, slots = 0, profileObject = 0, entries = 0, value = 0;
    int32_t count = 0;
    offset::RuntimeProfile runtimeProfile = offset::RuntimeProfile::Cn;
    bool operator==(const Target&) const = default;
};
struct Descriptor { uint64_t entries; int32_t count; };
template<class Read>
Status ReadChain(uint64_t base, offset::RuntimeProfile profile, const Build& build, Read read, Target& target) {
    target = {}; target.base = base; target.runtimeProfile = profile;
    if (!read(base + build.root, &target.owner, 8)) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (!Pointer(target.owner)) return Status::InvalidTarget;
    if (!read(target.owner + 0x160, &target.encoded, 8)) return Status::ReadFailed;
    target.slots = DecodeSlots(target.encoded, build.world);
    if (!Pointer(target.slots)) return Status::InvalidTarget;
    if (!read(target.slots + 0x50, &target.profileObject, 8)) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (!Pointer(target.profileObject)) return Status::InvalidTarget;
    Descriptor descriptor{};
    if (!read(target.profileObject + 0x420, &descriptor, 12)) return Status::ReadFailed;
    target.entries = descriptor.entries; target.count = descriptor.count;
    if (!Pointer(target.entries) || target.entries % 8 || target.count <= 0 || target.count > 4096 ||
        !Pointer(target.entries + uint64_t(target.count) * 16)) return Status::InvalidTarget;
    return Status::Ready;
}
template<class Read>
Status Resolve(uint64_t base, offset::RuntimeProfile profile, Read read, Target& target) {
    target = {};
    const auto* build = NativeOutlineSetting::ForProfile(profile);
    if (!build) return Status::UnsupportedProfile;
    auto status = ValidateCode(base, *build, read);
    if (status != Status::Ready) return status;
    Target before{}, after{};
    status = ReadChain(base, profile, *build, read, before);
    if (status != Status::Ready) return status;
    struct Entry { uint64_t key, payload; };
    std::array<Entry, 64> chunk{};
    uint64_t found = 0;
    for (int32_t index = 0; index < before.count;) {
        const auto remaining = before.count - index;
        const int32_t n = remaining < int32_t(chunk.size()) ? remaining : int32_t(chunk.size());
        if (!read(before.entries + uint64_t(index) * 16, chunk.data(), size_t(n) * 16))
            return Status::ReadFailed;
        for (int32_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) if (chunk[j].key == SettingKey) {
            if (found) return Status::AmbiguousSetting;
            found = before.entries + uint64_t(index + j) * 16 + 8;
        }
        index += n;
    }
    status = ReadChain(base, profile, *build, read, after);
    if (status != Status::Ready) return status;
    if (before != after) return Status::TargetChanged;
    if (!found) return Status::SettingMissing;
    uint64_t key = 0;
    if (!read(found - 8, &key, 8)) return Status::ReadFailed;
    if (key != SettingKey) return Status::TargetChanged;
    before.value = found; target = before;
    return Status::Ready;
}
} // namespace OW::NativeOutlineSetting
```

```hpp
        constexpr const RuntimeOffsetProfile& ForProfile(RuntimeProfile profile)
        {
            switch (profile) {
            case RuntimeProfile::Cn: return kCnRuntimeProfile;
            case RuntimeProfile::World155284: return kWorld155284RuntimeProfile;
            case RuntimeProfile::Nexon155284: return kNexon155284RuntimeProfile;
            case RuntimeProfile::World151722: return kWorld151722RuntimeProfile;
            }

        constexpr uint64_t DecodeCameraRoot(const RuntimeOffsetProfile& offsets, uint64_t root)
        {
            switch (offsets.viewMatrixMode) {
            case ViewMatrixMode::DirectChain: return root;
            case ViewMatrixMode::EncryptedChainXorAdd:
                return (root ^ offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key) + offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key2;
            case ViewMatrixMode::EncryptedChainSubXorSub:
                return ((root - offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key) ^ offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key2) -
                    offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key3;
            default:
                return (root + offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key) ^ offsets.offset_viewmatrix_xor_key2;
            }
        }

        inline std::atomic<RuntimeProfile>& ActiveProfileStorage()
        {
            static std::atomic<RuntimeProfile> profile{ kProductRuntimeProfile };
            return profile;
        }

        inline void SetActiveProfile(RuntimeProfile profile)
        {
            ActiveProfileStorage().store(profile, std::memory_order_release);
        }

        inline RuntimeProfile ActiveProfile()
        {
            return ActiveProfileStorage().load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        }

        inline const RuntimeOffsetProfile& Active()
        {
            return ForProfile(ActiveProfile());
        }

        inline const char* ActiveProfileName()
        {
            return Active().name;
        }

        inline bool IsCnProfile()
        {
            return ActiveProfile() == RuntimeProfile::Cn;
        }

        inline bool UsesProtectedEntityLayout()
        {
            return Active().componentTransform == ComponentTransformMode::Cn155284;
        }

        inline uint32_t TeamRawComparisonKeyFromFlags(uint32_t flags)
        {
            return UsesProtectedEntityLayout()
                ? (flags & Team_CnComparisonMask)
                : (flags & Team_LegacyMask);
        }

        inline uint32_t TeamRelationCodeFromFlags(uint32_t flags)
        {
            return flags & Team_CnRelationMask;
        }

        inline uint32_t TeamComparisonKeyFromFlags(uint32_t flags)
        {
            // The low byte contains relation detail, not the stable team key.
            // Live data shows same-team actors can differ there, so compare
            // only the legacy team bits for active World 151722 / CN 153480.
            return flags & Team_LegacyMask;
        }
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/NativeOutlineSetting.hpp"
#include <atomic>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <mutex>

namespace OW::OutlineBrightness {
// Commands are percentages; native storage is float32 percent / 100.
// Values above 100 are intentional; 8888% affects newly created outlines.
inline bool Valid(float percent) {
    return std::isfinite(percent) && percent >= 0.f && std::isfinite(percent / 100.f);
}
struct Command { float value = 100.f; uint64_t revision = 0; bool enabled = false; };
inline std::mutex commandMutex;
inline Command command;
inline Command Snapshot() { std::lock_guard lock(commandMutex); return command; }
inline bool Submit(float percent) {
    if (!Valid(percent)) return false;
    std::lock_guard lock(commandMutex);
    command.value = percent;
    if (++command.revision == 0) ++command.revision;
    command.enabled = true;
    return true;
}
inline void Disable() { std::lock_guard lock(commandMutex); command.enabled = false; }
inline std::atomic<uint32_t> AppliedCount{0}, FailureCount{0}, RestoreCount{0};
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> ShutdownRestoreRequest{0}, ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged{0};
enum class Result {
    Idle, Applied, Restored, Changed, InvalidValue, UnsupportedProfile,
    IdentityMismatch, SignatureMismatch, ReadFailed, SettingMissing,
    AmbiguousSetting, InvalidTarget, TargetChanged, WriteFailed,
    WriteReadbackFailed, WriteMismatch, RestorePending, RestoreReadFailed,
    RestoreWriteFailed, RestoreReadbackFailed, RestoreMismatch
};
inline std::atomic<Result> LastResult{Result::Idle};
inline constexpr const char* ResultText(Result result) {
    switch (result) {
    case Result::Idle: return "idle";
    case Result::Applied: return "applied";
    case Result::Restored: return "restored";
    case Result::Changed: return "game value changed; ownership released";
    case Result::InvalidValue: return "invalid percentage";
    case Result::UnsupportedProfile: return "unsupported native setting profile";
    case Result::IdentityMismatch: return "native setting image identity mismatch";
    case Result::SignatureMismatch: return "native setting code/signature mismatch";
    case Result::ReadFailed: return "native setting read failed";
    case Result::SettingMissing: return "native setting key absent";
    case Result::AmbiguousSetting: return "duplicate native setting key";
    case Result::InvalidTarget: return "invalid native setting structure";
    case Result::TargetChanged: return "native setting target/session changed";
    case Result::WriteFailed: return "write reported failure; completion unknown";
    case Result::WriteReadbackFailed: return "write completed; readback failed";
    case Result::WriteMismatch: return "write readback differs";
    case Result::RestorePending: return "restore awaits the same target/session";
    case Result::RestoreReadFailed: return "restore pre-read failed";
    case Result::RestoreWriteFailed: return "restore write reported failure";
    case Result::RestoreReadbackFailed: return "restore readback failed";
    case Result::RestoreMismatch: return "restore readback differs";
    }
    return "unknown";
}
inline constexpr bool IsFailure(Result result) {
    return result != Result::Idle && result != Result::Applied && result != Result::Restored && result != Result::Changed;
}
using Target = NativeOutlineSetting::Target;
inline bool Pointer(uint64_t p) { return NativeOutlineSetting::Pointer(p); }
inline Result ToResult(NativeOutlineSetting::Status status) {
    using S = NativeOutlineSetting::Status;
    switch (status) {
    case S::Ready: return Result::Idle;
    case S::UnsupportedProfile: return Result::UnsupportedProfile;
    case S::IdentityMismatch: return Result::IdentityMismatch;
    case S::SignatureMismatch: return Result::SignatureMismatch;
    case S::ReadFailed: return Result::ReadFailed;
    case S::SettingMissing: return Result::SettingMissing;
    case S::AmbiguousSetting: return Result::AmbiguousSetting;
    case S::InvalidTarget: return Result::InvalidTarget;
    case S::TargetChanged: return Result::TargetChanged;
    }
    return Result::InvalidTarget;
}
template<class Read>
bool Resolve(uint64_t base, offset::RuntimeProfile profile, Read read, Target& target, Result* failure = nullptr) {
    const auto status = NativeOutlineSetting::Resolve(base, profile, read, target);
    if (failure) *failure = ToResult(status);
    return status == NativeOutlineSetting::Status::Ready;
}
struct State {
    Target target{};
    uint32_t original = 0, written = 0, nextAttempt = 0;
    uint64_t appliedRevision = 0, triedRevision = 0, writeRevision = 0;
    bool owned = false, restoreAttempted = false;
    Result result = Result::Idle;
    void SetResult(Result value) { result = value; LastResult.store(value); }
    // Scheduler owns connection/process identity. Call on disconnect, process
    // generation or profile change; never restore through a different link.
    // Preserve the consumed revision so a stale command cannot rewrite.
    void Abandon() {
        target = {}; owned = false; restoreAttempted = false;
        original = written = nextAttempt = 0; appliedRevision = 0;
        SetResult(Result::Idle);
    }
    bool Due(uint32_t now, bool enabled, uint64_t revision) const {
        return ((enabled && revision != writeRevision) || owned) &&
            (triedRevision != revision || int32_t(now - nextAttempt) >= 0);
    }
    // current() must prove the same connection/process generation AND a fresh
    // Resolve(base,profile) == target. Scene and entity membership are irrelevant.
    template<class Read, class Write, class Current>
    bool Restore(Read read, Write write, Current current) {
        if (!owned) return true;
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::RestorePending); return false; }
        uint32_t value = 0;
        if (!read(target.value, &value, 4)) { SetResult(Result::RestoreReadFailed); return false; }
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::RestorePending); return false; }
        // Resolve can perform many reads. Sample the payload again after that
        // proof, immediately before the conditional write, so an intervening
        // game change is not mistaken for our earlier value. DMA is not a CAS.
        if (!read(target.value, &value, 4)) { SetResult(Result::RestoreReadFailed); return false; }
        if (restoreAttempted && value == original) {
            owned = false; SetResult(Result::Restored); return true;
        }
        if (value != written) { owned = false; SetResult(Result::Changed); return true; }
        if (original == written) { owned = false; SetResult(Result::Restored); return true; }
        restoreAttempted = true;
        if (!write(target.value, &original, 4)) { SetResult(Result::RestoreWriteFailed); return false; }
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::RestorePending); return false; }
        if (!read(target.value, &value, 4)) { SetResult(Result::RestoreReadbackFailed); return false; }
        if (value != original) {
            if (value != written) owned = false;
            SetResult(Result::RestoreMismatch); return false;
        }
        owned = false; SetResult(Result::Restored); return true;
    }
    template<class Read, class Write, class Current>
    bool Apply(Target next, float percent, uint64_t revision, Read read, Write write, Current current) {
        if (!Valid(percent) || !revision) { SetResult(Result::InvalidValue); return false; }
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::TargetChanged); return false; }
        const bool moved = target != next;
        if (moved) { target = next; owned = false; restoreAttempted = false; appliedRevision = 0; }
        // Relocation never re-arms an already consumed command.
        if (moved && writeRevision == revision) { SetResult(Result::TargetChanged); return false; }
        uint32_t previous = 0;
        if (!read(target.value, &previous, 4) || !Valid(std::bit_cast<float>(previous))) {
            SetResult(Result::ReadFailed); return false;
        }
        if (writeRevision == revision) {
            if (owned && previous != written) { owned = false; SetResult(Result::Changed); }
            return result == Result::Applied;
        }
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::TargetChanged); return false; }
        if (!read(target.value, &previous, 4) || !Valid(std::bit_cast<float>(previous))) {
            SetResult(Result::ReadFailed); return false;
        }
        if (!owned || previous != written) original = previous;
        const uint32_t bits = std::bit_cast<uint32_t>(percent / 100.f);
        written = bits; owned = true; restoreAttempted = false;
        // A failed backend can still complete remotely. Consume before writing;
        // retain conditional restore but require a new Submit to retry the write.
        writeRevision = triedRevision = revision;
        if (!write(target.value, &bits, 4)) { SetResult(Result::WriteFailed); return false; }
        if (!current()) { SetResult(Result::TargetChanged); return false; }
        if (!read(target.value, &previous, 4)) { SetResult(Result::WriteReadbackFailed); return false; }
        if (previous != bits) { owned = false; SetResult(Result::WriteMismatch); return false; }
        appliedRevision = revision; SetResult(Result::Applied); return true;
    }
};
} // namespace OW::OutlineBrightness
```

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace OW::OverlayStatus {
    inline double MonotonicSeconds() {
        return std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    }
    struct Layout {
        float avatar, skill, ultimate, barWidth, barHeight, width, height;
        float skillX, ultimateX, healthY;
    };

    inline constexpr Layout Custom{72, 24, 60, 100, 14, 164, 110, 76, 104, 77};
    inline constexpr Layout Compact{54, 18, 0, 54, 5, 76, 76, 58, 0, 57};
    inline constexpr Layout GetLayout(int style) { return style == 0 ? Compact : Custom; }
    inline float Position(float fraction, float canvas, float extent) {
        return std::clamp(fraction,0.0f,1.0f) * (std::max)(0.0f,canvas-extent);
    }

    struct CooldownSample {
        float seconds = 0;
        uint32_t tick = 0;
        bool valid = false;
        bool readySentinel = false;
        bool estimated = false;
        double deadline = 0;
        float Remaining(double now = MonotonicSeconds()) const {
            return estimated ? float((std::max)(0.0, deadline - now)) : seconds;
        }
        bool Fresh(uint32_t now) const {
            return valid && tick != 0 && uint32_t(now - tick) <= 1000 &&
                std::isfinite(seconds) && seconds >= 0;
        }
    };

    // Render-only smoothing. Never feeds smoothed charge back to aiming or skill guards.
    struct ProgressAnimation {
        float value = 0;
        double lastTime = 0;
        bool initialized = false;
        float Update(float target, double now, bool reset = false) {
            target = std::clamp(target, 0.0f, 100.0f);
            if (!initialized || reset || target < value - 5.0f || now < lastTime) {
                value = target;
                initialized = true;
            } else {
                const double dt = (std::min)(now - lastTime, .25);
                value += (target - value) * float(-std::expm1(-dt / .08));
                if (std::fabs(target - value) < .005f) value = target;
            }
            lastTime = now;
            return value;
        }
    };

    // Missing/stale samples are not zero charge. Body replacement does not spend an ultimate.
    struct UltimatePresentation {
        std::array<uint64_t, 3> identity{}; // hero / connection / scene; participant is the map key
        ProgressAnimation arc;
        float percent = 0;
        bool known = false;
        float Update(const std::array<uint64_t, 3>& nextIdentity, bool readable, float target, double now) {
            if (identity != nextIdentity) {
                *this = {};
                identity = nextIdentity;
            }
            if (readable && std::isfinite(target) && target >= 0 && target <= 100) {
                percent = target;
                known = true;
            }
            return known ? arc.Update(percent, now) : 0;
        }
    };

    inline float Positive(float value) {
        return std::isfinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 0;
    }

    struct Health {
        float total = 0;
        std::array<float, 3> fractions{};
    };

    inline Health ComposeHealth(float life, float armor, float shield, float maximum, float total) {
        const std::array<float, 3> parts{Positive(life), Positive(armor), Positive(shield)};
        const float sum = parts[0] + parts[1] + parts[2];
        Health result;
        result.total = Positive(total) > 0 ? Positive(total) : sum;
        const float denominator = Positive(maximum) > 0 ? Positive(maximum) : sum;
        if (denominator <= 0) return result;
        float remaining = 1;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); ++i) {
            result.fractions[i] = std::clamp(parts[i] / denominator, 0.0f, remaining);
            remaining -= result.fractions[i];
        }
        return result;
    }
}
```

```hpp
    inline std::string HeroDisplayNameToSlug(const std::string& displayName) {
        static const std::unordered_map<std::string, std::string> specialCases = {
            { "D.Mon", "dmon" },
            { "DMon", "dmon" },
            { "Soldier 76", "soldier-76" },
            { "Soldier76", "soldier-76" },
            { "D.Va", "dva" },
            { "DVa", "dva" },
            { "Dva", "dva" },
            { "Hana", "dva" },
            { "Wrecking Ball", "wrecking-ball" },
            { "WreckingBall", "wrecking-ball" },
            { "Junker Queen", "junker-queen" },
            { "JunkerQueen", "junker-queen" },
            { "JetpackCat", "jetpack-cat" },
            { "LifeWeaver", "lifeweaver" },
            { "Lifeweaver", "lifeweaver" },
            { "McCree", "cassidy" },
        };

        const auto special = specialCases.find(displayName);
        if (special != specialCases.end())
            return special->second;

        std::string slug;
        slug.reserve(displayName.size());
        bool previousWasHyphen = false;
        for (const unsigned char value : displayName) {
            if (value == '.' || value == '\'')
                continue;

            if (std::isspace(value) || value == '-' || value == '_') {
                if (!slug.empty() && !previousWasHyphen) {
                    slug.push_back('-');
                    previousWasHyphen = true;
                }
                continue;
            }

            slug.push_back(static_cast<char>(std::tolower(value)));
            previousWasHyphen = false;
        }

        if (!slug.empty() && slug.back() == '-')
            slug.pop_back();

        return slug;
    }

    inline bool SetCriticalMatrixReadPlan(
        uint64_t cameraViewPtr,
        uint64_t projectionPtr,
        uint64_t expectedConnectionEpoch)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_viewMatrixMutex);
        if (!RuntimeWorkersRunning() || expectedConnectionEpoch == 0 ||
            !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
            ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() != expectedConnectionEpoch) {
            return false;
        }
        const uint64_t nextGeneration = criticalMatrixReadPlan.generation + 1;
        criticalMatrixReadPlan = {
            cameraViewPtr,
            projectionPtr,
            nextGeneration,
            expectedConnectionEpoch,
            cameraViewPtr != 0 && projectionPtr != 0 &&
                expectedConnectionEpoch != 0
        };
        return criticalMatrixReadPlan.valid;
    }

    inline CriticalMatrixReadPlan SnapshotCriticalMatrixReadPlan()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_viewMatrixMutex);
        return criticalMatrixReadPlan;
    }

    inline void ClearCriticalMatrixReadPlan()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_viewMatrixMutex);
        const uint64_t nextGeneration = criticalMatrixReadPlan.generation + 1;
        criticalMatrixReadPlan = {};
        criticalMatrixReadPlan.generation = nextGeneration;
    }

    inline void MergeRecentRawDiscovery(RawEntityScanSnapshot& sample) {
        const DWORD now=static_cast<DWORD>(EntityRegistryNowMs());
        // Reading the table does not give an empty player result deletion authority.
        sample.complete = sample.complete && !sample.discoveries.empty();
        entity_discoveries.SetContext(sample.connection_epoch, sample.registry.generation, sample.scene_generation);
        for (const auto& discovery : sample.discoveries) {
            entity_discoveries.Observe(discovery);RecordEntityBodyDiscovery(discovery);
        }
        entity_discoveries.Prune(now);
        for(const auto& discovery:sample.discoveries) empty_scene_watch.Observe(sample.connection_epoch,
            sample.registry.generation, sample.scene_generation, EntityRosterPolicy::SceneAudit::Present,discovery.tick);
        const bool sameRegistry=latest_raw_scan_snapshot.connection_epoch==sample.connection_epoch &&
            latest_raw_scan_snapshot.registry.generation==sample.registry.generation &&
            latest_raw_scan_snapshot.scene_generation==sample.scene_generation;
        if(!sameRegistry)raw_discovery_stamps.clear();
        if(!sample.complete && sample.source==1 && sameRegistry) {
            std::erase_if(sample.raw_entities,[&](const auto& incoming) {
                return std::find(latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities.begin(),latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities.end(),incoming)==latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities.end() &&
                    std::any_of(latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities.begin(),latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities.end(),[&](const auto& current) {
                    return current.second==incoming.second && current.first!=incoming.first;
                });
            });
            std::erase_if(sample.actual_members,[&](auto address) {
                return std::none_of(sample.raw_entities.begin(),sample.raw_entities.end(),[&](const auto& pair){return pair.first==address;});
            });
        }
        sample.membership_known=sample.complete ||
            (sameRegistry && latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_known);
        sample.membership_revision=(sameRegistry ? latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_revision : 0) +
            (sample.complete ? 1 : 0);
        sample.membership_entities=sameRegistry ? latest_raw_scan_snapshot.membership_entities :
            std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t,uint64_t>>{};
        if(sample.complete) {
            sample.membership_entities.clear();
            for(const auto& proof:sample.discoveries)sample.membership_entities.emplace_back(proof.address,proof.link);
        }
        if(!sample.complete) {
            // Fresh link resolution supersedes its former target set. Keep all
            // concurrently verified targets of that link, including legal pairs.
            if(sample.source==2 && sample.binding_complete)std::erase_if(sample.membership_entities,[&](const auto& old) {
                return std::any_of(sample.binding_entities.begin(),sample.binding_entities.end(),[&](const auto& pair){return old.second==pair.second;}) &&
                    std::find(sample.binding_entities.begin(),sample.binding_entities.end(),old)==sample.binding_entities.end();
            });
            for(const auto& pair:sample.binding_entities)
                if(std::find(sample.membership_entities.begin(),sample.membership_entities.end(),pair)==sample.membership_entities.end())
                    sample.membership_entities.push_back(pair);
            for(const auto& pair:sample.raw_entities) {
                if(std::find(sample.membership_entities.begin(),sample.membership_entities.end(),pair)==sample.membership_entities.end())
                    sample.membership_entities.push_back(pair);
            }
        }
        if(sample.membership_known) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> bodyLock(entityBodyValidityMutex);
            for(const auto& [address,evidence]:entityBodyDiscoveries) {
                const bool missing=
                    std::find(sample.membership_entities.begin(),sample.membership_entities.end(),
                        std::make_pair(address,evidence.link))==sample.membership_entities.end();
                if(missing) {
                    activeEntityBodies.erase(address);
                    if(!blockedEntityBodies.contains(address)) {
                        blockedEntityBodies[address]=now;++entityBodyAbsenceRevisions[address];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if(sample.complete)raw_discovery_stamps.clear();
        for(const auto& pair:sample.raw_entities)raw_discovery_stamps[pair.first]={pair.second,sample.connection_epoch,now};
        if(!sample.complete && sameRegistry) {
            for(const auto& pair:latest_raw_scan_snapshot.raw_entities) {
                const auto stamp=raw_discovery_stamps.find(pair.first);
                if(stamp!=raw_discovery_stamps.end() && stamp->second.epoch==sample.connection_epoch &&
                    stamp->second.link==pair.second && now-stamp->second.tick<=20000 &&
                    std::find(sample.raw_entities.begin(),sample.raw_entities.end(),pair)==sample.raw_entities.end())
                    sample.raw_entities.push_back(pair);
            }
        }
        for(auto it=raw_discovery_stamps.begin();it!=raw_discovery_stamps.end();)
            if(it->second.epoch!=sample.connection_epoch || now-it->second.tick>20000)it=raw_discovery_stamps.erase(it);else ++it;
        // Candidate retention expiring is not proof of an actor's absence.
        // Only a complete audit or a freshly verified binding removes membership.
    }

    inline DWORD EntityScanDueGuardSleepMs(DWORD now, DWORD guardMs) {
        if (guardMs == 0)
            return 0;

        const DWORD dueTick = EntityScanNextDueTick();
        if (dueTick == 0)
            return 0;

        const LONG deltaMs = static_cast<LONG>(dueTick - now);
        if (deltaMs > static_cast<LONG>(guardMs))
            return 0;
        if (deltaMs < -static_cast<LONG>(guardMs))
            return 0;

        if (deltaMs <= 0)
            return 1;

        return static_cast<DWORD>((std::min)(static_cast<unsigned long>(guardMs),
            static_cast<unsigned long>(deltaMs)));
    }

    inline void RecordViewMatrixScanBackoff() {
        viewmatrix_scan_backoff_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    inline void RecordViewMatrixScanDueGuard() {
        viewmatrix_scan_due_guard_count.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    inline uint64_t ViewMatrixScanBackoffCount() {
        return viewmatrix_scan_backoff_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    inline uint64_t ViewMatrixScanDueGuardCount() {
        return viewmatrix_scan_due_guard_count.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }

    inline Vector2 ResolveScreenSize()
    {
        if (detectedScreenWidth > 0 && detectedScreenHeight > 0) {
            return Vector2(
                static_cast<float>(detectedScreenWidth),
                static_cast<float>(detectedScreenHeight));
        }

        if (Config::manualScreenWidth > 0 && Config::manualScreenHeight > 0) {
            return Vector2(
                static_cast<float>(Config::manualScreenWidth),
                static_cast<float>(Config::manualScreenHeight));
        }

        return Vector2(
            static_cast<float>(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN)),
            static_cast<float>(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN)));
    }

    inline float ResolveScreenWidth()
    {
        return ResolveScreenSize().X;
    }

    inline float ResolveScreenHeight()
    {
        return ResolveScreenSize().Y;
    }

    inline void RefreshScreenSizeFromConfig()
    {
        const Vector2 screenSize = ResolveScreenSize();
        WX = screenSize.X;
        WY = screenSize.Y;
    }

    inline void SetDetectedScreenSize(int width, int height)
    {
        detectedScreenWidth = width > 0 ? width : 0;
        detectedScreenHeight = height > 0 ? height : 0;
        RefreshScreenSizeFromConfig();
    }

    inline void ClearDetectedScreenSize()
    {
        detectedScreenWidth = 0;
        detectedScreenHeight = 0;
        RefreshScreenSizeFromConfig();
    }

    inline bool PipelineDebugEnabled()
    {
        return Config::outputDebugLog;
    }

    inline int ReadEnvFlagState(const char* name)
    {
        char buffer[16] = {};
        const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, buffer, static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buffer)));
        if (length == 0 || length >= sizeof(buffer))
            return -1;
        return buffer[0] != '0' &&
            buffer[0] != 'n' &&
            buffer[0] != 'N' &&
            buffer[0] != 'f' &&
            buffer[0] != 'F'
            ? 1
            : 0;
    }

    inline DWORD ReadEnvDword(const char* name, DWORD fallback, DWORD minValue, DWORD maxValue)
    {
        char buffer[32] = {};
        const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, buffer, static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buffer)));
        if (length == 0 || length >= sizeof(buffer))
            return fallback;

        char* end = nullptr;
        const unsigned long parsed = std::strtoul(buffer, &end, 10);
        if (end == buffer || (end && *end != '\0'))
            return fallback;

        const DWORD value = static_cast<DWORD>(parsed);
        return std::clamp(value, minValue, maxValue);
    }

    inline bool EnvFlagEnabled(const char* name)
    {
        return ReadEnvFlagState(name) == 1;
    }

        // Chain selection is a version-profile decision. The environment flag

            offset::ViewMatrixChainMode::CameraProjectionShort;
    }
```
