```hpp
namespace OW::SkillConditions {
struct NormalThreat {
    uint16_t hero;
    unsigned slot;
    const char* label;
    float interruptWindowMs = 0;
    bool incoming = true;
};
inline constexpr std::array<NormalThreat, 6> kNormalThreats{{
    {0x13b, 0, "Ana Sleep Dart",320}, {0x040, 0, "Roadhog Chain Hook",100},
    {0x23b, 1, "Sigma Accretion",650}, {0x195, 0, "Brigitte Whip Shot",0},
    {0x004, 1, "Mercy Resurrect",1750,false}, {0x206,1,"Echo Focusing Beam",2000,false}
}};
inline bool InterruptCanArrive(const NormalThreat& threat,uint32_t elapsed,float arrivalMs) {
    return std::isfinite(arrivalMs) && arrivalMs>=0 &&
        elapsed+arrivalMs+50 < threat.interruptWindowMs;
}
inline int NormalThreatIndex(uint64_t hero) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < kNormalThreats.size(); ++i)
        if ((hero & 0xffff) == kNormalThreats[i].hero) return static_cast<int>(i);
    return -1;
}
// A held request belongs to one acquisition attempt, including failed/cancelled
// attempts. A cooldown tick must not silently turn it into a second press.
struct AimSession {
    bool active = false;
    bool blockedUntilRelease = true;
    uint64_t startedMs = 0;
    std::array<uint64_t, 6> target{};
    int boneId = -1;
    bool Advance(bool held, uint64_t now, float delayMs, float maxMs, bool available = true) {
        if (!available) { Block(); return false; }
        if (!held) { active = false; blockedUntilRelease = false; startedMs = 0; target = {}; boneId = -1; return false; }
        if (blockedUntilRelease) return false;
        if (!active) { active = true; startedMs = now; }
        const auto elapsed = now - startedMs;
        const float limit = (std::clamp)(std::isfinite(maxMs) ? maxMs : 650.f, 0.f, 5000.f);
        if (limit > 0 && elapsed > limit) { Block(); return false; }
        return elapsed >= (std::clamp)(std::isfinite(delayMs) ? delayMs : 0.f, 0.f, 1000.f);
    }
    void Block() { active = false; blockedUntilRelease = true; target = {}; boneId = -1; }
};

struct CastConfirmation {
    uint32_t submittedTick = 0;
    bool sawInactive = true;
    bool Confirmed(bool active, uint32_t sampleTick, uint32_t now) {
        if (!sampleTick || uint32_t(now - sampleTick) > 250 ||
            uint32_t(sampleTick - submittedTick) >= 700) return false;
        if (!active) sawInactive = true;
        return active && sawInactive;
    }
    bool Expired(uint32_t now) const { return uint32_t(now - submittedTick) >= 700; }
};

inline bool HealthAtOrBelow(float hp, float maximum, float threshold, bool absolute) {
    if (!std::isfinite(hp) || hp <= 0 || !std::isfinite(threshold) || threshold < 0) return false;
    if (absolute) return hp <= threshold;
    return std::isfinite(maximum) && maximum > 0 && hp / maximum * 100.f <= threshold;
}
inline bool FreshSample(uint32_t sample, uint32_t now) {
    return sample != 0 && uint32_t(now - sample) <= 250;
}
inline bool FreshHealth(float health, float maximum, uint32_t sample, uint32_t now) {
    return FreshSample(sample, now) && std::isfinite(health) && health > 0 &&
        std::isfinite(maximum) && maximum > 0;
}
inline bool FreshActive(bool active, uint32_t sample, uint32_t now) {
    return active && FreshSample(sample, now);
}
// Pure 1106 0xE5710 / 0xE59C0, conservative mode: 5% recent loss,
// expiring 450 ms after the last loss. Feed only successful health samples.
struct RecentDamage {
    float health = 0, maximum = 0, damage = 0;
    uint32_t sampled = 0, lastLoss = 0;
    void Reset() { *this = {}; }
    void ClearDamage() { damage = 0; lastLoss = 0; }
    void Observe(float hp, float max, uint32_t sample, uint32_t now) {
        if (!sample || uint32_t(now - sample) > 250 || !std::isfinite(hp) || hp <= 0 ||
            !std::isfinite(max) || max <= 0 || hp > max) { Reset(); return; }
        if (sample == sampled) return;
        if (sampled && int32_t(sample - sampled) < 0) { Reset(); return; }
        if (!sampled || uint32_t(sample - sampled) > 250 || max != maximum) {
            Reset(); health = hp; maximum = max; sampled = sample; return;
        }
        if (lastLoss && uint32_t(sample - lastLoss) > 450) ClearDamage();
        if (hp < health) { damage += health - hp; lastLoss = sample; }
        health = hp; maximum = max; sampled = sample;
    }
    bool Ready(uint32_t now) const {
        return sampled && uint32_t(now - sampled) <= 250 && lastLoss &&
            uint32_t(now - lastLoss) <= 450 && damage >= maximum * .05f;
    }
};
enum PauseMask : unsigned { NoPause = 0, Aim = 1, Trigger = 2, Skills = 4, All = 7 };
inline unsigned StatePause(uint64_t hero, bool firstActive, bool secondActive, bool secondaryHeld) {
    switch (hero & 0xffff) {
    case 0x002: // Wraith Form
    case 0x0dd: // Cryo-Freeze
    case 0x32b: // Burrow
        return firstActive ? All : NoPause;
    case 0x003: // Recall
        return secondActive ? All : NoPause;
    case 0x12f: // Rocket Punch: manual hold is independent of the assist key.
        return secondaryHeld ? All : NoPause;
    default:
        return NoPause; // An ultimate's charge is not an activation signal.
    }
}
using BodyIdentity = std::array<uint64_t, 6>;
struct AutomaticAimWindow {
    BodyIdentity target{};
    uint64_t started = 0;
    bool active = false, expired = false;
    bool Ready(const BodyIdentity& next, uint64_t now, float delay, float limit) {
        if (!active || target != next) { target=next;started=now;active=true;expired=false; }
        const auto elapsed=now-started;
        if (limit>0 && elapsed>limit) expired=true;
        return !expired && elapsed>=delay;
    }
    void Reset() { *this={}; }
};
struct ObservationNeeds {
    uint64_t localHero = 0;
    bool localSkills = false;
    bool enemyThreats = false;
    bool heroSignals = false;
    bool Fast(uint64_t hero) const {
        return (localSkills && hero == localHero) || (enemyThreats && NormalThreatIndex(hero) >= 0);
    }
};
struct ActiveEvent {
    bool observed = false;
    bool active = false;
    unsigned responses = 0;
    void Observe(bool next) {
        if (!observed) {
            observed = true;
            active = next;
            // An already-active first sample has no known start time.
            responses = next ? ~0u : 0u;
            return;
        }
        if (!next || !active) responses = 0;
        active = next;
    }
    bool CanRespond(unsigned responder) const { return active && !(responses & responder); }
    void Respond(unsigned responder) { responses |= responder; }
};
inline unsigned Role(uint64_t hero) {
    switch (hero & 0xffff) {
    case 0x007: case 0x009: case 0x040: case 0x068: case 0x07a: case 0x12f:
    case 0x13e: case 0x1ca: case 0x236: case 0x23b: case 0x28d: case 0x30a: case 0x362:
    case 0x4c4: case 0x542:
        return 2;
    case 0x004: case 0x020: case 0x079: case 0x13b: case 0x195: case 0x1a2:
    case 0x221: case 0x231: case 0x291: case 0x31c: case 0x365: case 0x3c3:
    case 0x4e3: case 0x516: case 0x570: case 0x12e:
        return 4;
    case 0x002: case 0x003: case 0x005: case 0x006: case 0x008: case 0x00a:
    case 0x015: case 0x016: case 0x029: case 0x042: case 0x065: case 0x06e: case 0x0dd:
    case 0x1ec: case 0x200: case 0x206: case 0x32a: case 0x32b:
    case 0x4d8: case 0x4dd: case 0x4d2: case 0x472: case 0x52c:
        return 1;
    default: return 0;
    }
}
inline bool RoleAllowed(uint64_t hero, unsigned mask) {
    return mask == 7 || (Role(hero) & mask) != 0;
}
struct RecastWindow {
    bool known = false, active = false, spent = false;
    uint64_t started = 0, lastObserved = 0;
    void Observe(bool readable, bool next, uint64_t now) {
        if (!readable) return;
        if (lastObserved && now-lastObserved>250) { known=false;started=0; }
        lastObserved=now;
        if (!known) { known = true; active = next; spent = next; return; }
        if (!next) { active = false; spent = false; started = 0; return; }
        if (!active) { active = true; spent = false; started = now; }
    }
    bool Ready(uint64_t now) const { return active && !spent && started && now-started >= 170 && now-started <= 5500; }
};
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/OverlayStatus.hpp"

namespace OW::CooldownTimers {
    struct Rule {
        float seconds = 0;
        bool afterEnd = false;
        uint8_t activeSlot = 0;
    };
    using Rules = std::array<Rule,2>;
    // Wiki normal 5v5 PvP baseline, retrieved 2026-11-05; NOT Stadium or 6v6 values.
    // https://wiki.counterpick.app/zh-cn/abilities/ and /zh-cn/heroes/<hero-slug>/
    // Current snapshots and per-ability source URLs: Scenario reports/timer-smooth-20261105/wiki-baselines.json.
    // Fandom's old index is stale; do not restore its older cooldown numbers.
    // HUD icon order. Zero means resource/charges/conditional reset or unverified mapping:
    // keep unknown rather than infer availability from a single recharge timer.
    // Custom room multipliers, role passives, perks and hit/kill resets can differ.
    inline Rules ForHero(uint64_t hero) {
        if ((hero & 0xffffffffffff0000ull) != 0x02e0000000000000ull) return {};
        auto pair=[](float a,float b,bool endA=false,bool endB=false)->Rules {
            return {{{a,endA,0},{b,endB,1}}};
        };
        switch(hero & 0xffff) {
        case 0x002: return pair(8,10,true,true); // Wraith / Shadow Step
        case 0x003: return pair(0,12);          // Tracer: Blink charges unknown.
        case 0x004: return pair(1.5f,0,true);   // Mercy: jump extension/perks can prolong GA; Rez success unknown.
        case 0x005: return pair(12,8);          // Hanzo
        case 0x006: return {{{0,false,1},{10,false,0}}}; // Turret combat/destroy state is not observed.
        case 0x007: return pair(7,0,true);      // Reinhardt / Fire Strike charges
        case 0x008: return pair(14,8);          // Pharah
        case 0x009: return pair(5,10);          // Winston
        case 0x00a: return pair(10,15);         // Widowmaker
        case 0x015: return pair(12,8,true);     // Bastion
        case 0x016: return pair(0,12);          // Symmetra / turret charges unknown
        case 0x020: return {};                 // Zenyatta orb assignments are not ordinary CD timers.
        case 0x029: return pair(0,8,false,true);// Genji dash resets are not observable from active alone.
        case 0x040: return pair(7,0,true);      // Hook / Breather resource
        case 0x042: return pair(5,12);         // Cassidy
        case 0x065: return pair(0,10);         // Junkrat / mine charges unknown
        case 0x068: return {};                 // Shared charged bubbles.
        case 0x06e: return pair(0,15);         // Sprint / Biotic Field
        case 0x079: return pair(0,12);         // Crossfade / Amp
        case 0x07a: return pair(4,7,true);     // D.Va
        case 0x0dd: return pair(12,12,true);   // Mei: Ice Wall starts on placement.
        case 0x12e: return pair(0,7.5f);       // Cyberspace return/reset semantics unverified.
        case 0x12f: return pair(6.5f,7);       // Doomfist
        case 0x13b: return pair(14,12);        // Ana
        case 0x13e: return pair(15.5f,8,false,true); // Orisa
        case 0x195: return pair(4,0);          // Whip Shot / charged Repair Pack
        case 0x1a2: return pair(6,8,true);      // Moira
        case 0x1ca: return pair(0,15);         // Roll / Adaptive Shield
        case 0x1ec: return pair(7,15);         // Sojourn
        case 0x200: return pair(10,12);        // Coach Gun / Dynamite
        case 0x206: return pair(6,8,true,true);// Echo Flight / Focusing Beam
        case 0x221: return pair(12,20);        // Baptiste
        case 0x231: return pair(7,14);         // Kiriko
        case 0x236: return pair(10,0,true);    // Junker Queen: Carnage hit reduction unknown.
        case 0x23b: return pair(12,10,true);   // Sigma
        case 0x28d: return pair(0,11);         // Nemesis ultimate reset unknown.
        case 0x291: return pair(12,18);        // Lifeweaver
        case 0x30a: return pair(6,12,true);    // Mauga
        case 0x31c: return pair(8,0);          // Pylon destruction/recall is not its placement-active flag.
        case 0x32a: return pair(0,10);         // Freja dash has charges.
        case 0x32b: return pair(8,8,true);     // Venture
        case 0x362: return pair(5.5f,12);     // Hazard
        case 0x365: return pair(6,14,true);   // Juno
        case 0x3c3: return pair(8,14,true);   // Wuyang
        case 0x472: return pair(10,7);       // Vendetta
        case 0x4c4: return pair(7,7);        // Domina
        case 0x4d2: return pair(11,7);       // Sierra
        case 0x4d8: return pair(11,0,true);  // Emre / Cyber Frag charges unknown
        case 0x4dd: return pair(0,8);        // Anran / Inferno Rush charges and hit reduction unknown
        case 0x4e3: return pair(0,12);       // Mizuki: return/recast edge unverified.
        case 0x516: return pair(2,12);       // Jetpack Cat
        case 0x52c: return pair(6,15,false,true); // Shion
        case 0x570: return pair(10,14);      // Doctrine; infused variants may alter behavior.
        default: return {};                  // Never invent times for unmapped/new heroes.
        }
    }

    struct State {
        bool initialized = false;
        bool active = false;
        bool known = false;
        double deadline = 0;
        uint32_t observedTick = 0;
        void Observe(bool next, bool readOk, Rule rule, double now, uint32_t tick) {
            if (!readOk) return;
            if (observedTick && uint32_t(tick-observedTick)>1000) {
                initialized = false;
                known = false; // A long observation gap may conceal casts or cooldown resets.
            }
            observedTick = tick;
            if (initialized && rule.seconds > 0 && next != active &&
                (rule.afterEnd ? active && !next : !active && next)) {
                deadline = now + rule.seconds;
                known = true;
            }
            active = next;
            initialized = true;
        }
        OverlayStatus::CooldownSample Sample(double now, uint32_t tick, Rule rule) const {
            OverlayStatus::CooldownSample result;
            if (!known || !rule.seconds || !observedTick || uint32_t(tick-observedTick)>1000 ||
                (rule.afterEnd && active)) return result;
            result.seconds = float((std::max)(0.0,deadline-now));
            result.tick = observedTick;
            result.valid = true;
            result.estimated = true;
            result.deadline = deadline;
            return result;
        }
    };
}
```

`include/Game/SkillRead.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::SkillRead {
// Pure 1106 RVA 0x136FF0: shared hash layout, reverse 64-entry chunks.
// A complete miss is different from an unreadable or changing table.
enum class Status { Found, Missing, Unreadable, Invalid };
struct Result { uint64_t address = 0; Status status = Status::Invalid; };
struct Header { uint64_t entries; uint32_t count; uint32_t reserved; };
struct Entry { uint32_t id; uint32_t reserved; uint64_t address; };
static_assert(sizeof(Header) == 16 && sizeof(Entry) == 16);
inline bool UserRange(uint64_t address, size_t bytes) {
    constexpr uint64_t last = 0x7FFFFFFFFFFEull;
    return bytes && address > 0x10000 && address <= last && bytes - 1 <= last - address;
}
template<class Reader>
Result FindInBucket(uint64_t bucket, uint16_t id, Reader&& read) {
    if (!id || !UserRange(bucket, sizeof(Header))) return {};
    Header header{};
    if (!read(bucket, &header, sizeof(header))) return {0, Status::Unreadable};
    if (header.count > 4096) return {};
    if (!header.count) return {0, Status::Missing};
    if (!UserRange(header.entries, size_t(header.count) * sizeof(Entry))) return {};
    auto stable = [&] {
        Header current{};
        return read(bucket, &current, sizeof(current)) &&
            current.entries == header.entries && current.count == header.count;
    };
    bool incomplete = false;
    std::array<Entry, 64> entries{};
    for (size_t remaining = header.count; remaining;) {
        const size_t count = (std::min)(remaining, entries.size());
        remaining -= count;
        if (!read(header.entries + remaining * sizeof(Entry), entries.data(), count * sizeof(Entry))) {
            incomplete = true;
            continue;
        }
        for (size_t i = count; i--;) {
            if (entries[i].id != id) continue;
            if (!stable()) return {0, Status::Unreadable};
            return UserRange(entries[i].address, 1)
                ? Result{entries[i].address, Status::Found} : Result{};
        }
    }
    return {0, incomplete || !stable() ? Status::Unreadable : Status::Missing};
}
}
```

```hpp
    inline constexpr uint64_t kHealthDeathOffset = 0x5C0;
    struct health_compo_t {
        union {
            OFF_MEMB(float,  health,          0xE0);
            OFF_MEMB(float,  health_max,      0xDC);
            OFF_MEMB(Vector2, health_ext,     0xF0);
            OFF_MEMB(float,  armor,           0x220);
            OFF_MEMB(float,  armor_max,       0x21C);
            OFF_MEMB(float,  barrier,         0x360);
            OFF_MEMB(float,  barrier_max,     0x35C);
            OFF_MEMB(bool,   isImmortal,      0x4A9);
            OFF_MEMB(bool,   isBarrierProjected, 0x4A8);
            OFF_MEMB(Vector2, cn154461_health_ext, 0xF4);
            OFF_MEMB(float, cn154461_armor_max, 0x25C);
            OFF_MEMB(float, cn154461_armor, 0x260);
            OFF_MEMB(float, cn154461_barrier_max, 0x3DC);
            OFF_MEMB(float, cn154461_barrier, 0x3E0);
            OFF_MEMB(bool, cn154461_isImmortal, 0x569);
            OFF_MEMB(bool, cn154461_isBarrierProjected, 0x568);
            OFF_MEMB(uint8_t, death, kHealthDeathOffset);
        };

    struct HealthPayloadSummary {
        float health = 0, health_max = 0;
        float armor = 0, armor_max = 0;
        float barrier = 0, barrier_max = 0;
        Vector2 health_ext{};
        bool isImmortal = false, isBarrierProjected = false;
        float total = 0, total_max = 0;
        bool isDead = false;
    };

    inline constexpr size_t kCnHealthPoolBytes = 0x180;
    inline constexpr size_t kCnHealthExtraStride = 0x18;
    inline constexpr size_t kCnHealthMaxExtraPools = (kCnHealthPoolBytes - 0x1C) / kCnHealthExtraStride;

    inline bool TryParseCnHealthPool(const uint8_t* bytes, float& current, float& maximum) {
        uint32_t count = 0;
        std::memcpy(&maximum, bytes + 8, 4);
        std::memcpy(&current, bytes + 12, 4);
        std::memcpy(&count, bytes + 0x18, 4);
        if (count > kCnHealthMaxExtraPools)
            return false;
        const auto valid = [](float value) { return std::isfinite(value) && value >= 0.0f; };
        if (!valid(current) || !valid(maximum))
            return false;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            float extraMax = 0, extraCurrent = 0;
            const uint8_t* extra = bytes + 0x1C + i * kCnHealthExtraStride;
            std::memcpy(&extraMax, extra + 4, 4);
            std::memcpy(&extraCurrent, extra + 8, 4);
            if (!valid(extraMax) || !valid(extraCurrent))
                return false;
            maximum += extraMax;
            current += extraCurrent;
        }
        return valid(current) && valid(maximum);
    }

    inline bool IsHealthSummaryValid(const HealthPayloadSummary& result, uint8_t death) {
        return death <= 1 && std::isfinite(result.total) && std::isfinite(result.total_max) &&
            result.total_max > 0 && result.total_max <= 10000 &&
            result.total >= 0 && result.total <= result.total_max + 2000;
    }

    inline bool TryParseCnHealthPools(const uint8_t* health, const uint8_t* armor,
                                     const uint8_t* barrier, const uint8_t* flags,
                                     uint8_t death, HealthPayloadSummary& result) {
        result = {};
        // Each resource includes every active extra pool; the third scalar is
        // current HP. The first two scalars stay at their configured maxima.
        if (!TryParseCnHealthPool(health, result.health, result.health_max) ||
            !TryParseCnHealthPool(armor, result.armor, result.armor_max) ||
            !TryParseCnHealthPool(barrier, result.barrier, result.barrier_max))
            return false;
        result.isBarrierProjected = flags[0] != 0;
        result.isImmortal = flags[1] != 0;
        result.isDead = death == 1;
        result.total = result.health + result.armor + result.barrier;
        result.total_max = result.health_max + result.armor_max + result.barrier_max;
        return IsHealthSummaryValid(result, death);
    }

    // Call only after a complete read. Invalid totals remain available for
    // diagnostics, but callers must check the result before updating state.
    inline bool TryParseHealthPayload(const health_compo_t& raw, HealthPayloadSummary& result) {
        if (offset::Active().pooledHealth) {
            const auto* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&raw);
            return TryParseCnHealthPools(bytes + 0xD8, bytes + 0x258, bytes + 0x3D8,
                bytes + 0x568, raw.death, result);
        }
        const auto& health = raw;
        result = { health.health, health.health_max, health.armor, health.armor_max,
            health.barrier, health.barrier_max, health.health_ext,
            health.isImmortal, health.isBarrierProjected,
            health.health + health.armor + health.barrier + health.health_ext.Y,
            health.health_max + health.armor_max + health.barrier_max + health.health_ext.X };
        result.isDead = health.death == 1;
        return IsHealthSummaryValid(result, health.death);
    }

    struct velocity_fields_t {
        XMFLOAT3 velocity{}, location{};
        uint64_t bonedata = 0;
    };

    struct health_fields_t {
        std::array<uint8_t, 32> vital{};
        Vector2 armor{}, barrier{}; // legacy maximum, current
        std::array<std::array<uint8_t, kCnHealthPoolBytes>, 3> cnPools{};
        std::array<uint8_t, 2> flags{};
        uint8_t death = 0;
    };

    inline bool TryParseHealthPayload(const health_fields_t& raw, HealthPayloadSummary& result) {
        if (offset::Active().pooledHealth)
            return TryParseCnHealthPools(raw.cnPools[0].data(), raw.cnPools[1].data(),
                raw.cnPools[2].data(), raw.flags.data(), raw.death, result);
        result = {};
        std::memcpy(&result.health_max, raw.vital.data(), 4);
        std::memcpy(&result.health, raw.vital.data() + 4, 4);
        std::memcpy(&result.health_ext, raw.vital.data() + 20, 8);
        result.armor_max = raw.armor.X; result.armor = raw.armor.Y;
        result.barrier_max = raw.barrier.X; result.barrier = raw.barrier.Y;
        result.isBarrierProjected = raw.flags[0] != 0; result.isImmortal = raw.flags[1] != 0;
        result.total = result.health + result.armor + result.barrier + result.health_ext.Y;
        result.total_max = result.health_max + result.armor_max + result.barrier_max + result.health_ext.X;
        result.isDead = raw.death == 1;
        return IsHealthSummaryValid(result, raw.death);
    }
```

```hpp
    inline constexpr uint64_t kPlayerControllerViewDirectionOffset = 0x1260;

    inline Vector3 DirectionToAimEuler(const Vector3& direction) {
        return Vector3(
            -asinf(direction.Y),
            atan2f(direction.X, direction.Z),
            0.0f
        );
    }

    inline Vector3 ReadPlayerControllerViewDirection(uint64_t playerControllerBase) {
        if (!playerControllerBase || !RuntimeWorkersRunning() ||
            !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() || !SDK || !SDK->IsInitialized())
            return Vector3{};
        if(consumerFrame)return consumerFrame->local.AngleBase==playerControllerBase ? consumerFrame->local.view_direction : Vector3{};
        return SDK->RPM<Vector3>(playerControllerBase + kPlayerControllerViewDirectionOffset);
    }

    // =========================================================================

    inline int ReadPresentEnvFlagState(const char* name, int defaultValue)
    {
        char buffer[32]{};
        const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, buffer, static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buffer)));
        if (length == 0)
            return defaultValue;
        if (length >= sizeof(buffer))
            return defaultValue;

        std::string value(buffer, buffer + (std::min<DWORD>)(length, sizeof(buffer) - 1));
        std::transform(value.begin(), value.end(), value.begin(), [](unsigned char c) {
            return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c));
        });

        if (value == "1" || value == "true" || value == "yes" || value == "on")
            return 1;
        if (value == "0" || value == "false" || value == "no" || value == "off")
            return 0;
        return defaultValue;
    }

    inline DWORD ReadPresentEnvDword(const char* name, DWORD fallback, DWORD minValue, DWORD maxValue)
    {
        char buffer[32]{};
        const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(name, buffer, static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buffer)));
        if (length == 0)
            return fallback;
        if (length >= sizeof(buffer))
            return fallback;

        char* end = nullptr;
        const unsigned long parsed = std::strtoul(buffer, &end, 10);
        if (end == buffer)
            return fallback;

        return std::clamp<DWORD>(static_cast<DWORD>(parsed), minValue, maxValue);
    }

    inline bool PresentInterpolationEnabled()

    // =========================================================================

    inline float ResolveCalibrationReferenceGameSensitivity(float referenceOverride = 0.0f) {
        if (std::isfinite(referenceOverride) && referenceOverride > 0.0f)
            return referenceOverride;
        if (std::isfinite(Config::gameMouseSensitivity) && Config::gameMouseSensitivity > 0.0f)
            return Config::gameMouseSensitivity;
        return Config::referenceGameSensitivity;
    }

    struct CalibrationOutputCleanup {
        bool enabled;
        ~CalibrationOutputCleanup() {
            if (enabled && V2::Output::ReleaseActiveRuntime() != success)
                Diagnostics::Warn("[CALIBRATE] Output cleanup failed; device output gate remains closed.");
        }
    };

    inline float CalibrateSensitivity(bool calibrateBothAxes = true,
                                      float referenceGameSensitivityOverride = 0.0f,
                                      CalibrationMeasurement* measurement = nullptr) {
        if (measurement)
            *measurement = {};
        CalibrationRunGuard calibrationRun(Config::calibrationInProgress);
        if (!calibrationRun || ShouldSuppressOutput("calibration_move") ||
            !SDK || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("output.calibration skipped reason=busy_or_output_suppressed");
            return 0.0f;
        }
        CalibrationOutputCleanup cleanup{calibrationRun.IsRoot()};
        if (calibrationRun.IsRoot() && V2::Output::ReleaseActiveRuntime() != success)
            return 0.0f;
        const OutputRuntimeState outputRuntime = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        const uint64_t connectionEpoch = ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        if (!SDK || connectionEpoch == 0 || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
            !outputRuntime.outputGateOpen || outputRuntime.backendGeneration == 0 ||
            Config::calibrationMovePixels <= 0 || Config::calibrationStabilityWaitMs < 0)
            return 0.0f;
        const uint64_t controller = SDK->g_player_controller;
        if (!controller)
            return 0.0f;
        const float referenceSensitivity =
            ResolveCalibrationReferenceGameSensitivity(referenceGameSensitivityOverride);
        if (!std::isfinite(referenceSensitivity) || referenceSensitivity <= 0.0f)
            return 0.0f;

        const auto sessionCurrent = [&] {
            const auto current = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
            return RuntimeWorkersRunning() && ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
                SDK && SDK->IsInitialized() && SDK->g_player_controller.load() == controller &&
                current.outputGateOpen &&
                current.backendGeneration == outputRuntime.backendGeneration &&
                !ShouldSuppressOutput("calibration_move");
        };
        const auto readAngle = [&](bool pitch, float& angle) {
            if (!sessionCurrent())
                return false;
            Vector3 direction{};
            if (!SDK->read_range(controller + kPlayerControllerViewDirectionOffset,
                                 &direction, sizeof(direction)))
                return false;
            const double lengthSquared = double(direction.X) * direction.X +
                double(direction.Y) * direction.Y + double(direction.Z) * direction.Z;
            if (!std::isfinite(lengthSquared) || lengthSquared < 0.90 || lengthSquared > 1.10 ||
                !std::isfinite(direction.Y) || std::fabs(direction.Y) > 1.0f)
                return false;
            const Vector3 euler = DirectionToAimEuler(direction);
            angle = pitch ? euler.X : euler.Y;
            return std::isfinite(angle) && sessionCurrent();
        };
        const auto waitStable = [&] {
            return RuntimeWorkerSleep(static_cast<uint32_t>(Config::calibrationStabilityWaitMs)) &&
                sessionCurrent();
        };
        const auto measure = [&](bool pitch) {
            float before = 0.0f, after = 0.0f;
            if (!waitStable() || !readAngle(pitch, before))
                return 0.0f;
            const int counts = Config::calibrationMovePixels;
            if (EnqueueOutputCountMoveForGeneration(pitch ? 0 : counts, pitch ? counts : 0,
                    0, outputRuntime.backendGeneration, connectionEpoch) != success ||
                !waitStable() || !readAngle(pitch, after))
                return 0.0f;
            return CalibrationCountsPerRadian(counts, before, after);
        };
        const float yaw = measure(false);
        const float pitch = calibrateBothAxes && yaw > 0.0f ? measure(true) : 0.0f;
        if (!CalibrationAxesReady(yaw, pitch, calibrateBothAxes) || !sessionCurrent()) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("[CALIBRATE] Incomplete sample or changed session; previous calibration retained.");
            return 0.0f;
        }
        // Commit only a complete measurement from the same device and game session.
        if (measurement)
            *measurement = {yaw, calibrateBothAxes ? pitch : yaw, referenceSensitivity};
        else {
            Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian = yaw;
            Config::calibratedPitchCountsPerRadian = calibrateBothAxes && std::fabs(pitch - yaw) / yaw > 0.05f
                ? pitch : 0.0f;
            Config::referenceGameSensitivity = referenceSensitivity;
        }
        std::printf("[CALIBRATE] Result: yaw=%.1f pitch=%.1f counts/rad refGameSens=%.3f\n",
            yaw, calibrateBothAxes ? pitch : yaw, referenceSensitivity);
        return yaw;
    }

    inline float RunCalibrationSamples(float referenceGameSensitivityOverride = 0.0f) {
        CalibrationRunGuard calibrationRun(Config::calibrationInProgress);
        if (!calibrationRun || Config::calibrationStabilityWaitMs < 0 ||
            ShouldSuppressOutput("calibration_move") || !SDK || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected())
            return 0.0f;
        CalibrationOutputCleanup cleanup{calibrationRun.IsRoot()};
        if (calibrationRun.IsRoot() && V2::Output::ReleaseActiveRuntime() != success)
            return 0.0f;
        const uint64_t connectionEpoch = ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const auto device = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        const uint64_t controller = SDK ? SDK->g_player_controller.load() : 0;
        const float referenceSensitivity =
            ResolveCalibrationReferenceGameSensitivity(referenceGameSensitivityOverride);
        const auto batchCurrent = [&] {
            const auto current = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
            return RuntimeWorkersRunning() && ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                connectionEpoch != 0 && ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
                SDK && SDK->IsInitialized() && controller != 0 &&
                SDK->g_player_controller.load() == controller && device.outputGateOpen &&
                current.outputGateOpen && current.backendGeneration == device.backendGeneration &&
                !ShouldSuppressOutput("calibration_move");
        };
        if (!batchCurrent() || !std::isfinite(referenceSensitivity) || referenceSensitivity <= 0.0f)
            return 0.0f;
        double yawTotal = 0.0, pitchTotal = 0.0;
        int validSamples = 0;
        const int numSamples = (std::max)(Config::calibrationSampleCount, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < numSamples; ++i) {
            if (!batchCurrent())
                return 0.0f;
            CalibrationMeasurement sample;
            std::printf("[CALIBRATE] Sample %d/%d starting...\n", i + 1, numSamples);
            const float result = CalibrateSensitivity(true, referenceSensitivity, &sample);
            if (!batchCurrent())
                return 0.0f;
            if (result > 0.0f && CalibrationAxesReady(sample.yaw, sample.pitch, true)) {
                yawTotal += sample.yaw;
                pitchTotal += sample.pitch;
                ++validSamples;
            }
            if (i < numSamples - 1) {
                const uint64_t pause = uint64_t(Config::calibrationStabilityWaitMs) * 2;
                if (pause > UINT32_MAX || !RuntimeWorkerSleep(static_cast<uint32_t>(pause)) || !batchCurrent())
                    return 0.0f;
            }
        }
        const auto result = CalibrationMean(yawTotal, pitchTotal, validSamples, referenceSensitivity);
        if (!CalibrationAxesReady(result.yaw, result.pitch, true) || !batchCurrent()) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("[CALIBRATE] Batch failed; previous calibration retained.");
            return 0.0f;
        }
        // No intermediate sample changed persistent settings; publish the paired mean once.
        Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian = result.yaw;
        Config::calibratedPitchCountsPerRadian = std::fabs(result.pitch - result.yaw) / result.yaw > 0.05f
            ? result.pitch : 0.0f;
        Config::referenceGameSensitivity = result.referenceSensitivity;
        std::printf("[CALIBRATE] Averaged %d valid paired samples: yaw=%.1f pitch=%.1f counts/rad refGameSens=%.3f\n",
            validSamples, result.yaw, result.pitch, result.referenceSensitivity);
        return result.yaw;
    }

    inline int get_bind_id(int setting) {
        return Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(setting);
    }

    inline unsigned int convertToHex(const ImVec4& color) {
        unsigned int red   = static_cast<unsigned int>(color.x * 255.f);
        unsigned int green = static_cast<unsigned int>(color.y * 255.f);
        unsigned int blue  = static_cast<unsigned int>(color.z * 255.f);
        unsigned int alpha = static_cast<unsigned int>(color.w * 255.f);
        return (alpha << 24) | (blue << 16) | (green << 8) | red;
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // Simple math helpers
    // =========================================================================

    inline std::pair<double, double> dd(double a, double b, double c, double d, double m, double n) {
        return std::pair<double, double>(
            (m * d - c * n) / (a * d - c * b),
            (a * n - b * m) / (a * d - c * b)
        );
    }

        inline bool IsZeroVector(const Vector3& value) {
            return value == Vector3(0, 0, 0);
        }

        inline Vector2 CrosshairCenter() {
            float width = static_cast<float>(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN));
            float height = static_cast<float>(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN));
            if (WX > 0.0f && WY > 0.0f) {
                width = WX;
                height = WY;
            } else if (Config::manualScreenWidth > 0 && Config::manualScreenHeight > 0) {
                width = static_cast<float>(Config::manualScreenWidth);
                height = static_cast<float>(Config::manualScreenHeight);
            }
            return Vector2(
                width * 0.5f,
                height * 0.5f
            );
        }

            return OW::SnapshotCameraPosition();

            return FovGeometry::IsFiniteVector(value);
        }

            return FovGeometry::NormalizeVector(value);
        }

        inline FovRuntimeContext SnapshotFovRuntimeContext() {
            Matrix view{}, viewXor{};
            SnapshotViewMatrices(view, viewXor);

            const auto camera = viewXor.get_location();
            const auto forward = viewXor.get_rotation();

            FovRuntimeContext context{};
            context.camera = Vector3(camera.x, camera.y, camera.z);
            context.forward = NormalizeVector(Vector3(forward.x, forward.y, forward.z));
            context.valid = IsFiniteVector(context.camera) &&
                            !IsZeroVector(context.camera) &&
                            !IsZeroVector(context.forward);
            return context;
        }

        template<class Tick = decltype(&::GetTickCount)>
        inline bool TryPublishEntitySnapshots(
            std::vector<c_entity>&& nextEntities,
            std::vector<hpanddy>&& nextDynamicEntities,
            uint64_t expectedConnectionEpoch,
            size_t& publishedCount,
            const EntityRegistry::Snapshot* registry=nullptr,
            uint64_t expectedScene=0, Tick tick = &::GetTickCount)
        {
            const size_t count = nextEntities.size();
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(::g_mutex);
                if (expectedScene && expectedScene != EntitySceneGeneration()) {
                    ++rejectedEntitySceneResults; return false;
                }
                std::unique_lock<std::mutex> registryLock(entityRegistryMonitor.mutex);
                if(registry && registry->generation) {
                    // Invalidation must publish even when the source is unreadable.
                    if(!entityRegistryMonitor.state.Accept(*registry) &&
                        (!nextDynamicEntities.empty() || std::any_of(nextEntities.begin(),nextEntities.end(),
                            [](const auto& value){return value.body_valid;}))) return false;
                }
                if (expectedConnectionEpoch != 0 &&
                    (!RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
                     ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() != expectedConnectionEpoch)) {
                    return false;
                }
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> bodyLock(entityBodyValidityMutex);
                if(expectedScene && expectedScene!=EntitySceneGeneration())return false;
                const auto previousFrame=SnapshotFrame();
                const auto& previousEntities=previousFrame->entities;
                for(const auto& value:nextEntities) {
                    const auto current=std::find_if(previousEntities.begin(),previousEntities.end(),[&](const auto& old) {
                        return old.address==value.address && old.connection_epoch==value.connection_epoch && old.scene_generation==value.scene_generation;
                    });
                    if(current!=previousEntities.end() && int32_t(value.anchor_sample_tick_ms-current->anchor_sample_tick_ms)<0)return false;
                    const auto authority=entityBodyAuthorities.find(value.address);
                    if(value.body_valid && (authority==entityBodyAuthorities.end() || !authority->second.alive))return false;
                    // Revoked seats may publish unavailable metadata; they cannot displace an admitted successor.
                    const bool invalidation=!value.body_valid && (authority==entityBodyAuthorities.end() ||
                        (value.body_authority_revision && !authority->second.admitted && authority->second.generation==value.actor_generation &&
                        authority->second.epoch==value.connection_epoch && authority->second.scene==value.scene_generation));
                    if((value.body_authority_revision || value.body_valid || authority!=entityBodyAuthorities.end()) && !invalidation &&
                        !EntityBodyAuthorityMatchesLocked({value.address,value.LinkParent,value.HeroID,value.match_id,value.last_discovered_tick_ms},
                            value.actor_generation,value.body_authority_revision,value.connection_epoch,value.scene_generation,value.body_absence_revision))return false;
                    if(authority!=entityBodyAuthorities.end() && registry && authority->second.registry!=registry->generation)return false;
                }
                {
                    activeEntityBodies.clear();
                    for(auto& value:nextEntities) {
                        if(value.body_valid && value.roster_state==EntityRosterState::Fresh &&
                            value.Alive && value.HasFreshLifeState(tick()) && value.scene_generation==EntitySceneGeneration() &&
                            PresentationTiming::Fresh(value.anchor_sample_tick_ms,tick())) {
                            value.body_valid=TryActivateEntityBodyLocked({value.address,value.LinkParent,value.HeroID,value.match_id,
                                value.last_discovered_tick_ms},value.actor_generation,value.scene_generation,tick(),value.body_absence_revision,
                                value.body_authority_revision,value.connection_epoch);
                        } else value.body_valid=false;
                        if(!value.body_valid && value.roster_state==EntityRosterState::Fresh) {
                            value.roster_state=EntityRosterState::Missing;value.Alive=false;value.Vis=false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                auto frame=std::make_shared<ConsumptionFrame>();
                frame->sequence=previousFrame->sequence+1;
                uint64_t sampleUs=0;
                for(const auto& entity:nextEntities)sampleUs=(std::max)(sampleUs,entity.sample_time_us);
                frame->sampledAt=sampleUs ? std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point(std::chrono::microseconds(sampleUs)) : std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                frame->local=local_entity;
                // Only verified local observations populate local_entity. Its confirmed affiliation
                // belongs to this scene, not to the current body's life/death authority revision.
                const bool localTeamKnown=local_entity.team_known && local_entity.address && local_entity.actor_generation &&
                    local_entity.connection_epoch==ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() &&
                    local_entity.scene_generation==EntitySceneGeneration();
                frame->local.team_known=localTeamKnown;
                for(auto& value:nextEntities) {
                    value.team_known=value.team_known && localTeamKnown;
                    value.Team=value.team_known && value.address!=local_entity.address &&
                        (value.team_key==(1u<<0x1B) || value.team_key!=local_entity.team_key);
                    if(GameData::IsFriendlyTrainingBotHeroId(value.HeroID))value.Team=false;
                }
                frame->entities=std::move(nextEntities);frame->dynamic=std::move(nextDynamicEntities);
                { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> cameraLock(g_viewMatrixMutex);
                    frame->view=viewMatrix;frame->camera=viewMatrix_xor;frame->cameraSample=viewMatrixSampleState; }
                PublishFrame(std::move(frame));
#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
                entities=SnapshotFrame()->entities;hp_dy_entities=SnapshotFrame()->dynamic;
#endif
                SetPublishedEntityCount(count);
                Diagnostics::SetEntityCount(count);
            }

            publishedCount = count;
            return true;
        }

        inline size_t PublishEntitySnapshots(std::vector<c_entity>&& nextEntities,
                                             std::vector<hpanddy>&& nextDynamicEntities) {
            size_t publishedCount = 0;
            TryPublishEntitySnapshots(
                std::move(nextEntities),
                std::move(nextDynamicEntities),
                0,
                publishedCount);
            return publishedCount;
        }
```
