```hpp
    inline Vector3 GetVector3forgenji(bool predit = false) {
        PublishSelectedAimPlan({});
        int TarGetIndex = -1;
        Vector3 target{};
        Vector2 CrossHair = TargetingDetail::CrosshairCenter();
        auto entities = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        auto local_entity = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        const Vector3 camera = TargetingDetail::CameraPosition();
        float origin = 100000.f;
        if (entities.size() > 0) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < entities.size(); i++) {
                if (entities[i].HeroID == 0x16dd || entities[i].HeroID == 0x16ee) continue;
                if (entities[i].HeroID == eHero::HERO_GENJI && entities[i].skill2act) continue;
                const bool teamPass = TargetingDetail::TargetTeamMatches(
                    entities[i], Config::View_aimbotTeam(), local_entity);
                if (TargetingDetail::IsRuntimeTargetValid(entities[i], false) && teamPass) {
                    const bool isBot = GameData::IsTrainingBotHeroId(entities[i].HeroID);
                    const auto targetSlot = !local_entity.skillcd1 && !isBot
                        ? SkeletonSemantics::Slot::FootRight
                        : SkeletonSemantics::Slot::Chest;
                    Vector3 PreditPos = TargetingDetail::SemanticSkeletonRawPosition(entities[i], targetSlot);
                    if (TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(PreditPos))
                        continue;
                    if (isBot) {
                        if (!local_entity.skillcd1) PreditPos.Y -= 0.4f;
                    }
                    Vector3 RootPos = PreditPos;
                    if (entities[i].HeroID == eHero::HERO_WRECKINGBALL) {
                        PreditPos.Y -= 0.7f;
                        RootPos.Y -= 0.7f;
                    }
                    float score;
                    if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 0) {
                        score = camera.DistTo(PreditPos);
                        if (entities[i].PlayerHealth > 200.f) score = entities[i].PlayerHealth;
                        if (entities[i].HeroID == eHero::HERO_ZENYATTA && entities[i].ultimate == 0.f) score = 1000.f;
                    } else if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 1) {
                        score = entities[i].PlayerHealth;
                    } else {
                        score = camera.DistTo(PreditPos);
                    }
                    if (score < origin && score <= 6000.f) {
                        target = RootPos;
                        origin = score;
                        TarGetIndex = i;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (TarGetIndex != -1) {
                Config::health = entities[TarGetIndex].PlayerHealth;
                Config::Targetenemyi = TarGetIndex;
            }
        }
        return target;
    }

    inline Vector3 GetVector3aim2(bool predit = false, bool ignoreInvisible = Config::View_aimbotIgnoreInvisible()) {
        int TarGetIndex = -1;
        Vector3 target{};
        Vector2 CrossHair = TargetingDetail::CrosshairCenter();
        const Matrix aimViewMatrix = OW::SnapshotViewMatrix();
        Config::ScopedConfigRead configRead;
        const TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext fovContext = TargetingDetail::SnapshotFovRuntimeContext();
        const Vector3 camera = TargetingDetail::CameraPosition();
        auto entities = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        auto local_entity = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        const WeaponSpec* weaponSpec = ResolveWeaponSpec(local_entity.HeroID, Config::View_aimbotAttack());
        const bool resolvedPrediction = ResolvePredictionEnabled(
            ClampPredictionOverride(Config::View_aimbotPredictionMode()),
            weaponSpec,
            predit);
        const ProjectileRuntimeSpec projectileSpec =
            TargetingDetail::ResolveProjectileRuntimeSpec(weaponSpec, local_entity, true);
        float origin = 100000.f;
        int selectedBoneId = AimBoneToSkeletonBoneId(Config::Bone2);
        bool selectedPredictedEntry = false;
        if (entities.size() > 0) {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < entities.size(); i++) {
                const bool teamPass = TargetingDetail::TargetTeamMatches(
                    entities[i], Config::View_aimbotTeam(), local_entity);
                if (TargetingDetail::IsRuntimeTargetValid(entities[i], false) && teamPass) {
                    if (ignoreInvisible && !entities[i].Vis)
                        continue;
                    const float initialDistance = camera.DistTo(entities[i].chest_pos);
                    if (!TargetingDetail::DistancePassesAimFilter(initialDistance))
                        continue;
                    int candidateBoneId = AimBoneToSkeletonBoneId(
                        entities[i].Team ? Config::Bone2 : Config::View_Bone());
                    Vector3 rootPosition = TargetingDetail::CoreBoneRawPosition(entities[i], candidateBoneId);
                    if (Config::autobone2 &&
                        entities[i].HeroID != 0x16dd &&
                        entities[i].HeroID != 0x16ee) {
                        int closestBoneId = BONE_CHEST;
                        Vector3 closestRoot{};
                        if (TargetingDetail::TrySelectClosestCoreAimPoint(
                                entities[i],
                                fovContext,
                                aimViewMatrix,
                                CrossHair,
                                closestBoneId,
                                closestRoot)) {
                            candidateBoneId = closestBoneId;
                            rootPosition = closestRoot;
                        }
                    }
                    if (TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(rootPosition))
                        continue;

                    const LeadPredictionResult lead = TargetingDetail::ResolveLeadPrediction(
                        entities[i],
                        rootPosition,
                        projectileSpec,
                        resolvedPrediction,
                        true);
                    const float fovEntryHorizonMs =
                        Config::ClampFovEntryPredictionMs(Config::View_aimbotFovEntryPredictionMs());
                    const Vector3 fovEntryAimPoint = lead.finalAimPoint +
                        lead.targetVelocity * (fovEntryHorizonMs / 1000.0f);
                    FovGeometry::PredictedEntryEvaluation fovEvaluation{};
                    if (FovGeometry::EvaluateCandidateFovWithPredictedEntry(
                             fovContext,
                             rootPosition,
                             lead.finalAimPoint,
                             fovEntryAimPoint,
                             Config::View_Fov2(),
                             &Config::ResolveDynamicAimFovForDistance,
                             Config::View_aimbotPredictFovEntry(),
                             Config::ClampFovEntryMaxOutsideDeg(Config::View_aimbotFovEntryMaxOutsideDeg()),
                             fovEvaluation)) {
                        const float distance = fovEvaluation.distance;
                        const float fovScoreDeg = fovEvaluation.acceptedByPrediction
                            ? fovEvaluation.projectedScoreDeg
                            : fovEvaluation.currentScoreDeg;
                        if (!TargetingDetail::DistancePassesAimFilter(distance))
                            continue;
                        float score;
                        if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 0) {
                            score = fovScoreDeg;
                        } else if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 1) {
                            score = entities[i].PlayerHealth;
                        } else {
                            score = distance;
                        }
                        const bool preferCurrentInside = TarGetIndex != -1 &&
                            selectedPredictedEntry &&
                            !fovEvaluation.acceptedByPrediction;
                        const bool predictedEntryLosesToCurrentInside = TarGetIndex != -1 &&
                            !selectedPredictedEntry &&
                            fovEvaluation.acceptedByPrediction;
                        if (!predictedEntryLosesToCurrentInside &&
                            (preferCurrentInside || score < origin)) {
                            target = fovEvaluation.acceptedAimPoint;
                            origin = score;
                            TarGetIndex = i;
                            selectedBoneId = candidateBoneId;
                            selectedPredictedEntry = fovEvaluation.acceptedByPrediction;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (TarGetIndex != -1) {
                Config::health = entities[TarGetIndex].PlayerHealth;
                Config::Targetenemyi = TarGetIndex;
                Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow2 = ResolveEffectiveHitWindow(
                    entities[TarGetIndex],
                    selectedBoneId,
                    weaponSpec,
                    Config::hitbox2,
                    Config::kLegacyDefaultHitboxRadius,
                    projectileSpec.projectileRadius);
            }
        } else {
            Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow2 = 0.0f;
        }
        if (TarGetIndex == -1)
            Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow2 = 0.0f;
        return target;
    }

    inline Vector3 GetVector3forfov(bool predit = false) {
        int TarGetIndex = -1;
        Vector3 target{};
        Config::ScopedConfigRead configRead;
        const TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext fovContext = TargetingDetail::SnapshotFovRuntimeContext();
        const Vector3 camera = TargetingDetail::CameraPosition();
        auto entities = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        auto local_entity = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        float origin = 100000.f;
        if (entities.size() > 0) {
            Vector3 Vel, PreditPos, RootPos;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < entities.size(); i++) {
                const bool teamPass = TargetingDetail::TargetTeamMatches(
                    entities[i], Config::View_aimbotTeam(), local_entity);
                if (TargetingDetail::IsRuntimeTargetValid(entities[i], false) && teamPass) {
                    const float distance = camera.DistTo(entities[i].chest_pos);
                    if (!TargetingDetail::DistancePassesAimFilter(distance))
                        continue;
                    RootPos = TargetingDetail::CoreBoneRawPosition(entities[i], BONE_HEAD);
                    if (TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(RootPos))
                        continue;
                    PreditPos = RootPos;
                    float score;
                    if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 0) {
                        score = TargetingDetail::FovScoreDeg(fovContext, RootPos);
                    } else if (Config::View_aimbotPriority() == 1) {
                        score = entities[i].PlayerHealth;
                    } else {
                        score = distance;
                    }
                    if (score < origin) {
                        target = RootPos;
                        origin = score;
                        TarGetIndex = i;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (TarGetIndex != -1) {
                Config::health = entities[TarGetIndex].PlayerHealth;
                Config::Targetenemyifov = TarGetIndex;
            }
        }
        return target;
    }
```

`include/Game/TargetHitWindow.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cmath>
#include <optional>

#include "Game/AimArchitecture.hpp"
#include "Game/HeroGeometrySpec.hpp"

namespace OW {

inline bool HitWindowAngleInside(const Vector3& viewAngle,
                                 const Vector3& targetAngle,
                                 const Vector3& camera,
                                 const Vector3& aimPoint,
                                 float radius)
{
    const float distance = camera.DistTo(aimPoint);
    if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.0001f || !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0.0f)
        return false;
    return viewAngle.DistTo(targetAngle) <= radius / distance;
}

inline std::optional<float> SelectedAimNativeHitScore(const TargetCandidate& candidate,
    const Vector3& viewAngle, const Vector3& camera, const Vector3& aimPoint,
    const Vector3& sampleDisplacement = {})
{
    if (!candidate.valid || candidate.nativeHitWindow.projectileRadius < 0.0f ||
        (candidate.aimPoint + sampleDisplacement).DistTo(aimPoint) > 0.0001f)
        return std::nullopt;

    const float horizontal = std::cos(viewAngle.X);
    Vector3 direction(horizontal * std::sin(viewAngle.Y), -std::sin(viewAngle.X),
                      horizontal * std::cos(viewAngle.Y));
    const float distance = camera.DistTo(aimPoint);
    if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.0001f)
        return std::nullopt;
    direction = direction * distance;
    return NativeHitWindowScore(candidate.entitySnapshot, candidate.boneId,
        GetTickCount(), camera, direction, candidate.nativeHitWindow, sampleDisplacement);
}

inline bool InSelectedAimHitWindow(const TargetCandidate& candidate,
    const Vector3& viewAngle, const Vector3& targetAngle, const Vector3& camera,
    const Vector3& aimPoint)
{
    if (const auto score = SelectedAimNativeHitScore(candidate, viewAngle, camera, aimPoint))
        return *score <= 1.0f;
    return HitWindowAngleInside(viewAngle, targetAngle, camera, aimPoint,
        candidate.effectiveHitWindow);
}

} // namespace OW
```

```inl
// Prediction orchestration is kept separate from candidate ranking and geometry.
// This file is included inside OW::TargetingDetail.
        inline Vector3 ClampMagnitude(const Vector3& value, float maxLength) {
            const float length = value.get_length();
            if (length <= maxLength) return value;
            return value * (maxLength / length);
        }

        inline Vector3 AccelerationAwareVelocity(const c_entity& entity, float distance, float projectileSpeed) {
            const Motion::EntityMotionEstimate motion = Motion::EstimateEntityMotion(entity);
            const Vector3 baseVelocity = motion.valid ? motion.effectiveVelocity : entity.velocity;
            const uint64_t key = PresentationTiming::ActorControlKey(entity.address ? entity.address : entity.LinkBase,entity.actor_generation);
            if (!key) return baseVelocity;

            const uint64_t now = entity.sample_time_us ? entity.sample_time_us : uint64_t(entity.render_sample_tick_ms)*1000;
            const float safeSpeed = (std::max)(projectileSpeed, 1.0f);
            const float leadTime = std::clamp(distance / safeSpeed, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            Vector3 adjusted = baseVelocity;

            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(velocity_history_mutex);
            if (velocity_history.size() > 256) velocity_history.clear();

            VelocitySample& sample = velocity_history[key];
            if (sample.initialized && now > sample.tick) {
                const float dt = static_cast<float>(now - sample.tick) / 1000000.0f;
                if (dt > 0.001f && dt < 0.5f) {
                    Vector3 acceleration = (baseVelocity - sample.velocity) / dt;
                    acceleration = ClampMagnitude(acceleration, 250.0f);
                    sample.acceleration = acceleration;
                }
            }

            if(!sample.initialized || now>sample.tick) {
                sample.velocity=baseVelocity;sample.tick=now;sample.initialized=true;
            }
            return adjusted + sample.acceleration * std::clamp(leadTime*0.5f,0.0f,0.25f);
        }

        inline ProjectileRuntimeSpec ResolveProjectileRuntimeSpec(const WeaponSpec* weapon,
                                                                  const c_entity& local,
                                                                  bool secondary) {
            const PredictionProfile predictionProfile = ResolvePredictionProfile(weapon);
            const int selectedAlgorithm = ClampPredictionAlgorithm(
                Config::slotTargetRules.active ? Config::slotTargetRules.predictionAlgorithm :
                    predictionProfile.algorithm);
            if (Config::hanzoautospeed &&
                local.HeroID == eHero::HERO_HANJO) {
                Config::predit_level = readult(local.SkillBase + 0x40, 0xB, 0x2A5) * 85.f + 25.f;
                if (local.skill2act) Config::predit_level = 110.f;
            }

            const float fallbackSpeed = Config::predit_level;
            const bool fallbackGravity = Config::projectile_arc ||
                local.HeroID == eHero::HERO_HANJO ||
                Config::Gravitypredit;

            if (!secondary &&
                Config::hanzoautospeed &&
                local.HeroID == eHero::HERO_HANJO &&
                fallbackSpeed > 0.0f) {
                return ProjectileRuntimeSpec{
                    fallbackSpeed,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.gravity,
                    weapon != nullptr,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.launchDirectionUpBias,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.gravityAcceleration,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.castDelayMs,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.projectileRadius,
                    selectedAlgorithm,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.directHitOnly
                };
            }

            if (weapon) {
                return ProjectileRuntimeSpec{
                    predictionProfile.projectile.projectileSpeed,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.gravity,
                    true,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.launchDirectionUpBias,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.gravityAcceleration,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.castDelayMs,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.projectileRadius,
                    selectedAlgorithm,
                    predictionProfile.projectile.directHitOnly
                };
            }

            return ProjectileRuntimeSpec{
                fallbackSpeed,
                fallbackGravity,
                false,
                0.0f,
                9.8f,
                0.0f,
                predictionProfile.projectile.projectileRadius,
                selectedAlgorithm,
                predictionProfile.projectile.directHitOnly
            };
        }

        inline Vector3 SnapshotLocalAimAngleForLeadEstimate() {
            const uint64_t playerControllerBase = SDK ? SDK->g_player_controller.load() : 0;
            if (playerControllerBase) {
                const Vector3 viewDir = ReadPlayerControllerViewDirection(playerControllerBase);
                const float dirLen = viewDir.Size();
                if (std::isfinite(viewDir.X) &&
                    std::isfinite(viewDir.Y) &&
                    std::isfinite(viewDir.Z) &&
                    dirLen > 0.5f &&
                    dirLen < 1.5f) {
                    return DirectionToAimEuler(viewDir);
                }
            }

            Matrix view{}, viewXor{};
            SnapshotViewMatrices(view, viewXor);
            const XMFLOAT3 forward = viewXor.get_rotation();
            const float forwardLen = sqrtf(
                forward.x * forward.x +
                forward.y * forward.y +
                forward.z * forward.z);
            if (std::isfinite(forward.x) &&
                std::isfinite(forward.y) &&
                std::isfinite(forward.z) &&
                forwardLen > 0.5f &&
                forwardLen < 1.5f) {
                return DirectionToAimEuler(Vector3(forward.x, forward.y, forward.z));
            }

            return Vector3{};
        }

        inline Vector3 AimAngleForWorldPoint(const Vector3& worldPoint) {
            const Vector3 camera = CameraPosition();
            const Vector3 delta = worldPoint - camera;
            const float distance = delta.Size();
            if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.0001f)
                return Vector3{};
            return DirectionToAimEuler(delta / distance);
        }

        inline int ResolveLeadAimMethod(bool secondary) {
            if (secondary) {
                return Config::SecondaryAimMethod(Config::Flick2 ? 1 : 0);
            }

            const int behavior = Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(Config::View_aimBehavior());
            return Config::AimBehaviorMethod(behavior);
        }

        inline float ResolveLeadSmoothInput(bool secondary) {
            if (secondary) {
                if (Config::Flick2)
                    return Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(Config::kAimBehaviorFlick, Config::Flick_smooth2);
                if (Config::Tracking2)
                    return Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(Config::kAimBehaviorTracking, Config::Tracking_smooth2);
                return 1.0f;
            }

            const int behavior = Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(Config::View_aimBehavior());
            const float scalePercent = Config::IsFlickBehavior(behavior)
                ? Config::View_Flick_smooth()
                : Config::View_Tracking_smooth();
            return Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(behavior, scalePercent);
        }

        inline LeadTimingEstimate EstimateLeadTimingForAimPoint(const Vector3& rawAimPoint, bool secondary) {
            const int method = ResolveLeadAimMethod(secondary);
            AimSettleEstimateInput input{};
            input.localAngle = SnapshotLocalAimAngleForLeadEstimate();
            input.targetAngle = AimAngleForWorldPoint(rawAimPoint);
            input.method = method;
            input.slotSpeedScale = ResolveLeadSmoothInput(secondary);
            input.methodSpeedScale = Config::RuntimeAimMethodAngularSpeedScale(method);
            input.constantAngularSpeedDeg = Config::RuntimeAimConstantAngularSpeedDeg();
            input.frameSeconds = kLeadDefaultFrameSeconds;

            return BuildLeadTiming(
                EstimateAimSettleTimeMs(input),
                Config::outputInputDelayMs);
        }

        inline const char* MotionVelocitySourceName(Motion::VelocitySource source) {
            switch (source) {
            case Motion::VelocitySource::Reported:
                return "reported";
            case Motion::VelocitySource::WorldDeltaFallback:
                return "world_delta";
            case Motion::VelocitySource::None:
            default:
                return "none";
            }
        }

        inline LeadPredictionResult ResolveLeadPrediction(const c_entity& entity,
                                                          Vector3 rawAimPoint,
                                                          const ProjectileRuntimeSpec& projectile,
                                                          bool predictionEnabled,
                                                          bool secondary,
                                                          float extraPreFireDelayMs = 0.0f) {
            LeadPredictionResult result{};
            result.predictionEnabled = predictionEnabled;
            result.secondary = secondary;
            result.rawAimPoint = rawAimPoint;
            result.preFireAimPoint = rawAimPoint;
            result.finalAimPoint = rawAimPoint;
            result.projectile = projectile;

            if (!predictionEnabled || IsZeroVector(rawAimPoint))
                return result;

            const Vector3 camera = CameraPosition();
            result.distance = camera.DistTo(rawAimPoint);
            const Motion::EntityMotionEstimate motion = Motion::EstimateEntityMotion(entity);
            const int algorithm = ClampPredictionAlgorithm(projectile.algorithm);
            result.relativeMotion = IsRelativeMotionPredictionAlgorithm(algorithm);
            const c_entity local = SnapshotLocalEntity();
            result.localVelocity = IsFiniteVector(local.velocity) ? local.velocity : Vector3{};
            result.targetVelocity = IsBallisticPredictionAlgorithm(algorithm)
                ? AccelerationAwareVelocity(entity, result.distance, projectile.projectileSpeed)
                : ClampVectorMagnitude(motion.valid ? motion.effectiveVelocity : entity.velocity,
                                       kLeadMaxTargetSpeed);
            result.targetVelocity = ApplyPredictionMotionModel(
                result.targetVelocity, result.localVelocity, algorithm);
            result.timing = EstimateLeadTimingForAimPoint(rawAimPoint, secondary);
            const float preFireMaxMs = (extraPreFireDelayMs > 0.0f || projectile.castDelayMs > 0.0f) ? 1000.0f : kLeadMaxPreFireDelayMs;
            result.timing.preFireDelayMs = ClampLeadDelayMs(
                result.timing.preFireDelayMs + extraPreFireDelayMs + projectile.castDelayMs,
                preFireMaxMs);
            result.preFireAimPoint = IsBallisticPredictionAlgorithm(algorithm)
                ? ApplyTargetMotionPreFireDelay(rawAimPoint, result.targetVelocity,
                                                result.timing.preFireDelayMs, preFireMaxMs)
                : ApplyLegacyLinearPrediction(rawAimPoint, result.targetVelocity,
                                              projectile, result.timing.preFireDelayMs);
            result.finalAimPoint = result.preFireAimPoint;

            if (IsBallisticPredictionAlgorithm(algorithm) &&
                projectile.projectileSpeed > 0.0f) {
                const BallisticIntercept intercept = SolveBallisticIntercept(
                    camera, result.preFireAimPoint, result.targetVelocity, projectile.projectileSpeed,
                    projectile.gravity ? projectile.gravityAcceleration : 0.0f);
                if (intercept.solved)
                    result.finalAimPoint = CompensateProjectileLaunchBias(
                        camera, intercept.aimPoint, projectile.launchDirectionUpBias);
            }

            Diagnostics::Aim("lead.solve algorithm=%s relative=%d enabled=%d secondary=%d projectile(source=%s speed=%.3f gravity=%d acceleration=%.3f upBias=%.4f castMs=%.3f) motion(source=%s confidence=%.3f targetVelocity=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f) localVelocity=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f)) timing(settleMs=%.3f inputMs=%d extraPreFireMs=%.3f preFireMs=%.3f) raw=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f) preFire=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f) final=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f)",
                PredictionAlgorithmName(algorithm),
                result.relativeMotion ? 1 : 0,
                predictionEnabled ? 1 : 0,
                secondary ? 1 : 0,
                projectile.fromWeaponSpec ? "weapon" : "legacy",
                projectile.projectileSpeed,
                projectile.gravity ? 1 : 0,
                projectile.gravity ? projectile.gravityAcceleration : 0.0f,
                projectile.launchDirectionUpBias,
                projectile.castDelayMs,
                MotionVelocitySourceName(motion.velocitySource),
                motion.confidence,
                result.targetVelocity.X,
                result.targetVelocity.Y,
                result.targetVelocity.Z,
                result.localVelocity.X,
                result.localVelocity.Y,
                result.localVelocity.Z,
                result.timing.estimatedSettleMs,
                result.timing.inputDelayMs,
                extraPreFireDelayMs,
                result.timing.preFireDelayMs,
                result.rawAimPoint.X,
                result.rawAimPoint.Y,
                result.rawAimPoint.Z,
                result.preFireAimPoint.X,
                result.preFireAimPoint.Y,
                result.preFireAimPoint.Z,
                result.finalAimPoint.X,
                result.finalAimPoint.Y,
                result.finalAimPoint.Z);

            return result;
        }

        inline Vector3 ApplyPrediction(const c_entity& entity, Vector3 position, bool predit, bool secondary) {
            if (IsZeroVector(position)) return position;

            const c_entity local = SnapshotLocalEntity();
            const WeaponSpec* weapon = ResolveWeaponSpec(local.HeroID, Config::View_aimbotAttack());
            const bool resolvedPrediction = ResolvePredictionEnabled(
                ClampPredictionOverride(Config::View_aimbotPredictionMode()),
                weapon,
                predit);
            if (!resolvedPrediction) return position;

            const ProjectileRuntimeSpec projectile = ResolveProjectileRuntimeSpec(weapon, local, secondary);
            return ResolveLeadPrediction(entity, position, projectile, true, secondary).finalAimPoint;
        }
```

```hpp
namespace OW {

enum class TargetVisibilityMode : int {

    All = 1,
```

`include/Game/TrackingContinuityPolicy.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW::TrackingContinuityPolicy {

inline constexpr std::uint32_t kTargetDropoutGraceMs = 80;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxSampleAgeLeadMs = 12;
inline constexpr std::uint32_t kMaxFreshPositionSampleAgeMs = 48;

inline float DistanceExitMargin(float configuredMaxDistance) noexcept
{
    if (configuredMaxDistance <= 0.0f)
        return 0.0f;
    return std::clamp(configuredMaxDistance * 0.05f, 0.5f, 2.0f);
}

inline float EffectiveMaxDistance(float configuredMaxDistance,
                                  bool currentTarget) noexcept
{
    if (!currentTarget || configuredMaxDistance <= 0.0f)
        return configuredMaxDistance;
    return configuredMaxDistance + DistanceExitMargin(configuredMaxDistance);
}

inline float FovExitMargin(float configuredFovDeg) noexcept
{
    if (configuredFovDeg <= 0.0f)
        return 0.0f;
    return std::clamp(configuredFovDeg * 0.10f, 0.35f, 1.5f);
}

inline float EffectiveFovDeg(float configuredFovDeg, bool currentTarget) noexcept
{
    if (!currentTarget || configuredFovDeg <= 0.0f)
        return configuredFovDeg;
    return configuredFovDeg + FovExitMargin(configuredFovDeg);
}

inline float SampleAgeSeconds(std::uint32_t nowTick,
                              std::uint32_t sampleTick,
                              std::uint32_t maxAgeMs = 16) noexcept
{
    if (sampleTick == 0 || maxAgeMs == 0)
        return 0.0f;
    const std::uint32_t ageMs = nowTick - sampleTick;
    return static_cast<float>((std::min)(ageMs, maxAgeMs)) / 1000.0f;
}

inline bool IsWithinTargetDropoutGrace(std::uint32_t nowTick,
                                       std::uint32_t lastSeenTick,
                                       std::uint32_t graceMs =
                                           kTargetDropoutGraceMs) noexcept
{
    return lastSeenTick != 0 && graceMs != 0 &&
        nowTick - lastSeenTick <= graceMs;
}

inline float FreshPositionSampleLeadSeconds(
    std::uint32_t nowTick,
    std::uint32_t sampleTick,
    std::uint32_t maxLeadMs = kMaxSampleAgeLeadMs,
    std::uint32_t maxFreshAgeMs = kMaxFreshPositionSampleAgeMs) noexcept
{
    if (sampleTick == 0 || maxLeadMs == 0 || maxFreshAgeMs == 0)
        return 0.0f;
    const std::uint32_t ageMs = nowTick - sampleTick;
    if (ageMs >= maxFreshAgeMs)
        return 0.0f;
    if (ageMs <= maxLeadMs || maxFreshAgeMs <= maxLeadMs)
        return static_cast<float>((std::min)(ageMs, maxLeadMs)) / 1000.0f;

    const float fade = static_cast<float>(maxFreshAgeMs - ageMs) /
        static_cast<float>(maxFreshAgeMs - maxLeadMs);
    return static_cast<float>(maxLeadMs) * std::clamp(fade, 0.0f, 1.0f) /
        1000.0f;
}

inline std::uint64_t ControlTargetKey(std::uint64_t stableKey,
                                      std::uint64_t actorKey) noexcept
{
    if (actorKey == 0)
        return stableKey;
    std::uint64_t combined = stableKey;
    combined ^= actorKey + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL +
        (combined << 6) + (combined >> 2);
    return combined != 0 ? combined : actorKey;
}

} // namespace OW::TrackingContinuityPolicy

```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "Game/GameData.hpp"

namespace OW {

struct TrainingBotDisplay {
    const char* name = nullptr;
    const char* avatarSlug = nullptr;
};

constexpr TrainingBotDisplay ResolveTrainingBotDisplay(uint64_t heroId, float maxHealth) noexcept {
    using GameData::MakeHeroId;
    switch (heroId) {
    case MakeHeroId(0x16C):
    case MakeHeroId(0x4E7):
        // Live CN reports the same ID for ordinary and heavy friendly bots.
        if (maxHealth >= 490.0f && maxHealth <= 510.0f)
            return {"Friendly Heavy Bot", "tank-bot"};
        return {"Friendly Bot", "friendly-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x363):
        return {"Friendly Heavy Bot", "tank-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x337):
        // This ID is also used by a 200 HP ordinary bot in the current CN range.
        if (maxHealth >= 190.0f && maxHealth <= 210.0f)
            return {"Standard Bot", "standard-bot"};
        return {"Tank Bot", "tank-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x33C):
    case MakeHeroId(0x356):
        return {"Standard Bot", "standard-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x339):
    case MakeHeroId(0x39E):
        return {"Training Bot", "standard-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x349):
        return {"Rocket Bot", "rocket-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x35A):
        return {"Sniper Bot", "sniper-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x338):
        return {"Attack Bot", "attack-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x34F):
        return {"Healing Bot", "healing-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x33B):
        return {"Explosive Bot", "explosive-bot"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x16D):
    case MakeHeroId(0x36C):
        return {"Friendly Bot", "training-bot-legacy"};
    case MakeHeroId(0x16B):
    case MakeHeroId(0x16E):
    case MakeHeroId(0x16F):
    case MakeHeroId(0x170):
    case MakeHeroId(0x171):
    case MakeHeroId(0x172):
        return {"Training Bot", "training-bot-legacy"};
    default:
        return {};
    }
}

} // namespace OW
```

`include/Game/TriggerBoneSelection.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace OW {

    // Grouped skeleton masks are shared by Trigger and Aim Slot. The trigger
    // names remain as compatibility aliases because this model was introduced
    // for Trigger first.
    using TriggerBoneMask = std::uint32_t;

    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneHead      = 1u << 0;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneNeck      = 1u << 1;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneChest     = 1u << 2;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBonePelvis    = 1u << 3;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneShoulders = 1u << 4;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneElbows    = 1u << 5;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneHands     = 1u << 6;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneKnees     = 1u << 7;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneShanks    = 1u << 8;
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneFeet      = 1u << 9;

    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kTriggerBoneAllMask =
        kTriggerBoneHead |
        kTriggerBoneNeck |
        kTriggerBoneChest |
        kTriggerBonePelvis |
        kTriggerBoneShoulders |
        kTriggerBoneElbows |
        kTriggerBoneHands |
        kTriggerBoneKnees |
        kTriggerBoneShanks |
        kTriggerBoneFeet;

    // Keep upgraded configurations conservative: the old default trigger point
    // was the configured (normally head) aim point.
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask kDefaultTriggerBoneMask = kTriggerBoneHead;

    struct TriggerBoneGroupDefinition {
        TriggerBoneMask mask = 0;
        const char* label = "";
    };

    inline constexpr std::array<TriggerBoneGroupDefinition, 10> kTriggerBoneGroups{{
        { kTriggerBoneHead, "Head" },
        { kTriggerBoneNeck, "Neck" },
        { kTriggerBoneChest, "Chest" },
        { kTriggerBonePelvis, "Pelvis" },
        { kTriggerBoneShoulders, "Shoulders" },
        { kTriggerBoneElbows, "Elbows" },
        { kTriggerBoneHands, "Hands" },
        { kTriggerBoneKnees, "Knees" },
        { kTriggerBoneShanks, "Shanks" },
        { kTriggerBoneFeet, "Feet" },
    }};

    // c_entity::skeleton_bones uses the 18-slot render layout. The last two
    // slots are intentionally unused.
    inline constexpr std::array<TriggerBoneMask, 18> kTriggerBoneGroupForRenderSlot{{
        kTriggerBoneHead,
        kTriggerBoneNeck,
        kTriggerBoneChest,
        kTriggerBonePelvis,
        kTriggerBoneShoulders,
        kTriggerBoneShoulders,
        kTriggerBoneElbows,
        kTriggerBoneElbows,
        kTriggerBoneKnees,
        kTriggerBoneKnees,
        kTriggerBoneShanks,
        kTriggerBoneShanks,
        kTriggerBoneHands,
        kTriggerBoneHands,
        kTriggerBoneFeet,
        kTriggerBoneFeet,
        0,
        0,
    }};

    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(TriggerBoneMask mask)
    {
        mask &= kTriggerBoneAllMask;
        return mask != 0 ? mask : kDefaultTriggerBoneMask;
    }

    inline constexpr bool IsAllTriggerBonesSelected(TriggerBoneMask mask)
    {
        return NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(mask) == kTriggerBoneAllMask;
    }

    inline constexpr bool TriggerBoneMaskIncludesGroup(TriggerBoneMask mask,
                                                        TriggerBoneMask group)
    {
        return (NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(mask) & group) != 0;
    }

    inline constexpr bool TriggerBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(TriggerBoneMask mask,
                                                             std::size_t slot)
    {
        return slot < kTriggerBoneGroupForRenderSlot.size() &&
            TriggerBoneMaskIncludesGroup(mask, kTriggerBoneGroupForRenderSlot[slot]);
    }

    // UI behavior: selecting a group while All is active starts a focused
    // selection; subsequent groups are freely combined. The last active group
    // cannot be removed, so persisted masks are never empty.
    inline constexpr TriggerBoneMask ToggleTriggerBoneGroup(TriggerBoneMask current,
                                                             TriggerBoneMask group)
    {
        current = NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(current);
        group &= kTriggerBoneAllMask;
        if (group == 0)
            return current;
        if (current == kTriggerBoneAllMask)
            return group;
        if ((current & group) == 0)
            return NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(current | group);

        const TriggerBoneMask reduced = current & ~group;
        return reduced != 0 ? reduced : current;
    }

    static_assert(NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(0) == kDefaultTriggerBoneMask);
    static_assert(TriggerBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(kTriggerBoneHead | kTriggerBoneFeet, 0));
    static_assert(TriggerBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(kTriggerBoneHead | kTriggerBoneFeet, 14));
    static_assert(!TriggerBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(kTriggerBoneHead | kTriggerBoneFeet, 2));

    using SkeletonBoneMask = TriggerBoneMask;
    using SkeletonBoneGroupDefinition = TriggerBoneGroupDefinition;

    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneHead = kTriggerBoneHead;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneNeck = kTriggerBoneNeck;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneChest = kTriggerBoneChest;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBonePelvis = kTriggerBonePelvis;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneShoulders = kTriggerBoneShoulders;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneElbows = kTriggerBoneElbows;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneHands = kTriggerBoneHands;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneKnees = kTriggerBoneKnees;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneShanks = kTriggerBoneShanks;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneFeet = kTriggerBoneFeet;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kSkeletonBoneAllMask = kTriggerBoneAllMask;
    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask kDefaultAimBoneMask = kSkeletonBoneHead;
    inline constexpr const auto& kSkeletonBoneGroups = kTriggerBoneGroups;
    inline constexpr const auto& kSkeletonBoneGroupForRenderSlot = kTriggerBoneGroupForRenderSlot;

    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask NormalizeSkeletonBoneMask(SkeletonBoneMask mask)
    {
        return NormalizeTriggerBoneMask(mask);
    }

    inline constexpr bool IsAllSkeletonBonesSelected(SkeletonBoneMask mask)
    {
        return IsAllTriggerBonesSelected(mask);
    }

    inline constexpr bool SkeletonBoneMaskIncludesGroup(SkeletonBoneMask mask,
                                                         SkeletonBoneMask group)
    {
        return TriggerBoneMaskIncludesGroup(mask, group);
    }

    inline constexpr bool SkeletonBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(SkeletonBoneMask mask,
                                                              std::size_t slot)
    {
        return TriggerBoneMaskIncludesRenderSlot(mask, slot);
    }

    inline constexpr SkeletonBoneMask ToggleSkeletonBoneGroup(SkeletonBoneMask current,
                                                               SkeletonBoneMask group)
    {
        return ToggleTriggerBoneGroup(current, group);
    }

    inline SkeletonBoneMask AimMaskForDistance(SkeletonBoneMask rawMask, float distance,
                                              float maxHeadDistance, bool strictSelection = false)
    {
        auto mask = NormalizeSkeletonBoneMask(rawMask);
        const float limit = std::clamp(maxHeadDistance, 0.0f, 500.0f);
        if (limit > 0.0f && std::isfinite(distance) && distance > limit && (mask & kSkeletonBoneHead)) {
            mask &= ~kSkeletonBoneHead;
            if (mask == 0)
                return strictSelection ? 0 : kSkeletonBoneNeck;
        }
        return mask;
    }

} // namespace OW
```

`include/Game/WeaponCharge.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/Decrypt.hpp"
#include "Game/Entity.hpp"

namespace OW {
inline float WeaponChargePercentFromSample(bool available,float fraction) {
    return available && std::isfinite(fraction) && fraction>=0 && fraction<=1 ? fraction*100.f : -1.f;
}
inline float ReadSojournRailChargePercent(const c_entity& local,int action) {
    if (local.HeroID != eHero::HERO_SOJOURN || action != 1 ||
        !local.hero_skill_signals.sojournRailChargeKnown ||
        !local.hero_skill_signals.sojournRailChargeTick ||
        static_cast<uint32_t>(GetTickCount() - local.hero_skill_signals.sojournRailChargeTick) > 250)
        return -1.f;
    return WeaponChargePercentFromSample(true,local.hero_skill_signals.sojournRailCharge);
}
// Weapon telemetry only. The behavior configuration decides press versus release.
inline float ReadWeaponChargePercent(const c_entity& local,int action) {
    const float sojourn = ReadSojournRailChargePercent(local,action);
    if (local.HeroID == eHero::HERO_SOJOURN) return sojourn;
    if(local.HeroID!=eHero::HERO_HANJO || action!=0 || local.skill2act || !local.SkillBase) return -1.f;
    float fraction=0;
    const bool available=TryReadUlt(local.SkillBase+0x40,0xB,0x2A5,fraction);
    return WeaponChargePercentFromSample(available,fraction);
}
}
```

```hpp
    ObjectType{"Trailblazer",0x400000000007255ull,Group::Deployable,"",""},
    ObjectType{"Kekkai Sanctuary",0x400000000006D24ull,Group::Deployable,"mizuki","kekkai-sanctuary"},
    ObjectType{"Biotic Grenade",0x400000000001426ull,Group::Projectile,"ana","biotic-grenade"},
    ObjectType{"Accretion Rock",0x4000000000018B7ull,Group::Projectile,"sigma","accretion"},
    ObjectType{"Bastion Tactical Grenade",0x400000000003F69ull,Group::Projectile,"bastion","a-36-tactical-grenade"}};
constexpr uint64_t NormalizeId(uint64_t id) {
    return id && id <= UINT32_MAX ? id | 0x400000000000000ull : id;
}
constexpr int ObjectIndex(uint64_t id) {
    id = NormalizeId(id);
    if(id==0x400000000000060ull||id==0x40000000000480Aull)return 0;
    for(int i=0;i<int(kObjects.size());++i)if(kObjects[i].id&&kObjects[i].id==id)return i;
    return -1;
}

template<class Read>
bool ReadId(uint64_t parent, Read read, uint64_t& id) {
    const auto pointer=[](uint64_t p){return p>=0x10000 && p<0x800000000000ULL;};
    id=0;
    uint64_t pool=0, poolAfter=0, candidate=0;
    if(!pointer(parent) || !read(parent+0x30,&pool,sizeof(pool)))return false;
    pool &= ~uint64_t(63);
    if(!pointer(pool) || !read(pool+0x10,&candidate,sizeof(candidate)) || ObjectIndex(candidate)<0 ||
        !read(parent+0x30,&poolAfter,sizeof(poolAfter)) || (poolAfter&~uint64_t(63))!=pool)return false;
    id=NormalizeId(candidate);
    return true;
}
}
```

`include/Game/WorldObjectRead.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>

namespace V2::WorldObjects {
struct PositionPath { uint32_t component, offset; };
// Pure 1106 RVA 0x140CCB/0x140D1D: two transform types share +0x3D0.
// Keep the existing velocity path for objects without either transform.
constexpr auto PositionPaths(uint32_t primary, uint32_t alternate) {
    return std::array{PositionPath{primary,0x3D0},PositionPath{alternate,0x3D0},PositionPath{4,0x200}};
}
constexpr bool ValidPointer(uint64_t value) {
    return value >= 0x10000 && value < 0x800000000000ull;
}
template<class Position> bool ValidPosition(const Position& value) {
    return std::isfinite(value.x) && std::isfinite(value.y) && std::isfinite(value.z) &&
        (value.x != 0 || value.y != 0 || value.z != 0);
}
template<class Decrypt, class Read, class Position>
bool ResolvePosition(const std::array<PositionPath,3>& paths, Decrypt decrypt, Read read,
                     Position& position, uint64_t& component, uint32_t& positionOffset) {
    for(const auto path:paths) {
        if(!path.component)continue;
        const uint64_t candidate=decrypt(path.component);
        Position value{};
        if(!ValidPointer(candidate) || !read(candidate+path.offset,&value,sizeof(value)) || !ValidPosition(value))continue;
        position=value;component=candidate;positionOffset=path.offset;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
}
```

`include/Memory/DeviceRecovery.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace DmaDeviceRecovery {

enum class Result { Ready, Retry, Stopping };

// Shared by the runtime and software regression. Closing is unconditional:
// even a stop received while draining must leave no old device handle alive.
template<class Operations>
Result Rebuild(Operations& operations)
{
    operations.Quarantine();
    operations.DrainWorkers();
    operations.ClearSnapshots();
    operations.CloseDevice();
    if (operations.Stopping())
        return Result::Stopping;
    const bool ready = operations.InitializeDevice();
    if (operations.Stopping()) {
        operations.CloseDevice();
        return Result::Stopping;
    }
    return ready ? Result::Ready : Result::Retry;
}

// Failure means a failed SDK process enumeration, never merely an absent
// game, failed entity-field read, or an unsupported game version.
struct HealthFailures {
    unsigned consecutive = 0;
    bool Observe(bool available) noexcept {
        consecutive = available ? 0 : consecutive + 1;
        return consecutive >= 3;
    }
    void Reset() noexcept { consecutive = 0; }
};

} // namespace DmaDeviceRecovery
```

`include/Memory/DmaDeviceConfig.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <charconv>
#include <cctype>
#include <filesystem>
#include <istream>
#include <map>
#include <string>

enum class DmaDeviceType {
    FTD3XX = 0, FTD3XXWU, RAWTCP, HVSAVEDSTATE, DRIVER, RAWUDP, FT2232H, FILE_DUMP
};

// Device strings follow LeechCore's device_fpga.c and LeechCore-plugins.
struct DmaDeviceConfig {
    DmaDeviceType type = DmaDeviceType::FTD3XX;
    std::string device = "fpga://algo=0";
    int memoryMap = -1;
    bool IsStatic() const { return type == DmaDeviceType::HVSAVEDSTATE || type == DmaDeviceType::FILE_DUMP; }
    bool IsFpga() const { return !IsStatic() && type != DmaDeviceType::RAWTCP; }
    static std::filesystem::path Utf8Path(const std::string& value) {
        return std::filesystem::path(std::u8string(value.begin(), value.end()));
    }

    static std::string Trim(std::string text) {
        const auto nonSpace = [](unsigned char c) { return !std::isspace(c); };
        text.erase(text.begin(), std::find_if(text.begin(), text.end(), nonSpace));
        text.erase(std::find_if(text.rbegin(), text.rend(), nonSpace).base(), text.end());
        return text;
    }
    static std::string Lower(std::string text) {
        std::transform(text.begin(), text.end(), text.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return char(std::tolower(c)); });
        return text;
    }
    static bool Number(const std::string& value, unsigned maximum, unsigned& number) {
        const auto result = std::from_chars(value.data(), value.data() + value.size(), number);
        return !value.empty() && result.ec == std::errc{} && result.ptr == value.data() + value.size() && number <= maximum;
    }
    static bool IPv4(const std::string& text) {
        size_t start = 0;
        for (int part = 0; part < 4; ++part) {
            const auto end = text.find('.', start);
            if ((part < 3) != (end != std::string::npos)) return false;
            const auto value = text.substr(start, end == std::string::npos ? end : end - start);
            unsigned number = 0;
            if (!Number(value, 255, number) || (value.size() > 1 && value.front() == '0')) return false;
            start = end + 1;
        }
        return text != "0.0.0.0" && text != "255.255.255.255";
    }
    static bool Parse(std::istream& input, const std::filesystem::path& base,
                      DmaDeviceConfig& output, std::string& error) {
        auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) { error = why; return false; };
        std::map<std::string, std::string> values;
        std::string line;
        unsigned lineNumber = 0;
        while (std::getline(input, line)) {
            ++lineNumber;
            if (lineNumber == 1 && line.starts_with("\xef\xbb\xbf")) line.erase(0, 3);
            line = Trim(line);
            if (line.empty() || line.front() == '#' || line.front() == ';') continue;
            bool quoted = false;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < line.size(); ++i) {
                if (line[i] == '"') quoted = !quoted;
                if (!quoted && (line[i] == '#' || line[i] == ';') && i && std::isspace((unsigned char)line[i-1])) {
                    line.resize(i); break;
                }
            }
            const auto equals = line.find('=');
            if (equals == std::string::npos) return fail("expected key=value at line " + std::to_string(lineNumber));
            auto key = Lower(Trim(line.substr(0, equals)));
            auto value = Trim(line.substr(equals + 1));
            if (value.starts_with('"')) {
                if (value.size() < 2 || value.back() != '"') return fail("unclosed quoted value");
                value = value.substr(1, value.size()-2);
            }
            if (key == "address") key = "host";
            if (!values.emplace(key, value).second) return fail("duplicate key: " + key);
        }
        if (input.bad()) return fail("configuration read failed");
        if (!values.count("device")) return fail("missing device=");
        DmaDeviceConfig candidate;
        const auto name = Lower(values["device"]);
        if (name == "fpga" || name == "ftd3xx") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::FTD3XX;
        else if (name == "ft601" || name == "ftd3xxwu") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::FTD3XXWU;
        else if (name == "driver" || name == "zdma" || name == "leechdma") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::DRIVER;
        else if (name == "rawtcp") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::RAWTCP;
        else if (name == "rawudp") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::RAWUDP;
        else if (name == "ft2232h") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::FT2232H;
        else if (name == "hvsavedstate") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::HVSAVEDSTATE;
        else if (name == "file") candidate.type = DmaDeviceType::FILE_DUMP;
        else return fail("unknown device: " + name);

        std::map<std::string, unsigned> fpgaOptions;
        for (const auto& [key, value] : values) {
            if (key == "device" || key == "host" || key == "file") continue;
            unsigned number = 0;
            if (key == "memory_map") {
                if (!Number(value, 1, number)) return fail("memory_map must be 0 or 1");
                candidate.memoryMap = int(number); continue;
            }
            if (!candidate.IsFpga()) return fail("unsupported key for this source: " + key);
            const unsigned maximum = key == "algo" ? 4 : key == "devindex" ? 15 :
                key == "pciegen" ? 2 : key == "readretry" ? 1 : key == "readsize" ? 16777216 :
                (key == "tmread" || key == "tmwrite" || key == "tmprobe") ? 1000000 : 0;
            if (!maximum || !Number(value, maximum, number)) return fail("invalid FPGA option: " + key);
            if ((key == "pciegen" && !number) || (key == "readsize" && (!number || number % 4096)))
                return fail("invalid FPGA option value: " + key);
            fpgaOptions.emplace(key, number);
        }
        if (candidate.IsStatic()) {
            if (values.count("host") || !values.count("file") || values["file"].empty()) return fail("file source requires file= and no host=");
            auto path = Utf8Path(values["file"]);
            if (path.is_relative()) path = base / path;
            path = path.lexically_normal();
            if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::HVSAVEDSTATE && Lower(path.extension().string()) != ".vmrs")
                return fail("hvsavedstate requires a .vmrs file");
            const auto utf8 = path.generic_u8string();
            candidate.device = (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::HVSAVEDSTATE ? "hvsavedstate://" : "") + std::string(utf8.begin(), utf8.end());
        } else {
            if (values.count("file")) return fail("file= only applies to file/hvsavedstate");
            if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::RAWTCP || candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::RAWUDP) {
                auto host = values["host"];
                const auto lowerHost = Lower(host);
                // Accept the old config spelling, but always select the real plugin.
                if (lowerHost.starts_with("rawtcp://")) host.erase(0, 9);
                else if (lowerHost.starts_with("tcp://")) host.erase(0, 6);
                const auto colon = host.find(':');
                const auto ip = host.substr(0, colon);
                if (!IPv4(ip)) return fail("host must be a numeric IPv4 address");
                if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::RAWTCP) {
                    unsigned port = 0;
                    if (colon != std::string::npos && (!Number(host.substr(colon+1), 65535, port) || !port)) return fail("invalid TCP port");
                    candidate.device = "rawtcp://" + host;
                } else {
                    if (colon != std::string::npos) return fail("rawudp uses the firmware's fixed port 28474; omit port");
                    candidate.device = "fpga://ip=" + ip;
                }
            } else {
                if (values.count("host")) return fail("host= only applies to rawtcp/rawudp");
                candidate.device = "fpga://";
                if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::DRIVER) candidate.device += "driver=1,";
                if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::FTD3XXWU) candidate.device += "ft601=1,";
                if (candidate.type == DmaDeviceType::FT2232H) candidate.device += "ft2232h=1,";
                candidate.device += "algo=" + std::to_string(fpgaOptions.count("algo") ? fpgaOptions["algo"] : 0);
            }
            if (candidate.IsFpga()) for (const auto& [key, value] : fpgaOptions) {
                if (key == "algo" && candidate.type != DmaDeviceType::RAWUDP) continue;
                candidate.device += "," + key + "=" + std::to_string(value);
            }
        }
        if (candidate.device.size() >= 260 || candidate.device.find('\0') != std::string::npos)
            return fail("device string exceeds LeechCore MAX_PATH or contains NUL");
        output = std::move(candidate);
        error.clear();
        return true;
    }
};
```

`include/Memory/DmaSessionAccess.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstddef>
#include <mutex>
#include <utility>

// Readers may run concurrently. Closing admission first prevents a stream of
// new calls from starving shutdown; destruction waits for existing calls only.
// Nested leases are allowed, so resolver helpers can call Memory safely.
class DmaSessionAccess {
public:
    struct Activity { std::size_t activeLeases; bool admissionOpen; };
    Activity Inspect() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return {active_,open_};
    }
    class Lease {
        friend class DmaSessionAccess;
        DmaSessionAccess* owner_ = nullptr;
        explicit Lease(DmaSessionAccess* owner) : owner_(owner) {}
    public:
        Lease(const Lease&) = delete;
        Lease& operator=(const Lease&) = delete;
        Lease(Lease&& other) noexcept : owner_(std::exchange(other.owner_, nullptr)) {}
        ~Lease() { if (owner_) owner_->Release(); }
        explicit operator bool() const noexcept { return owner_ != nullptr; }
    };

    Lease Acquire() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (!open_)
            return Lease(nullptr);
        ++active_;
        return Lease(this);
    }

    void CloseAndDrain() {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        open_ = false;
        drained_.wait(lock, [this] { return active_ == 0; });
    }

    // Only the serialized lifecycle owner may reopen, after a new SDK handle
    // is fully initialized. Failed initialization leaves admission closed.
    void Open() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        open_ = true;
    }

private:
    void Release() {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (--active_ == 0)
            drained_.notify_all();
    }
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::condition_variable drained_;
    std::size_t active_ = 0;
    bool open_ = false;
};
```

```hpp
    inline bool IsDmaKeyStateReady()
    {
        return initialized.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            gafAsyncKeyStateAddr.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != 0;
    }

    inline bool IsSampleTimestampFresh(uint64_t sampledAtMs, uint64_t nowMs)
    {
        return sampledAtMs != 0 && nowMs >= sampledAtMs &&
            nowMs - sampledAtMs <= kSampleMaxAgeMs;
    }

    {
        return IsDmaKeyStateReady() && sampleAvailable.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            IsSampleTimestampFresh(lastSuccessfulSampleMs.load(std::memory_order_acquire), nowMs);
    }

    inline void SetResolverDiagnosticText(

        resolvedModuleName = module ? module : "";
        resolvedMethod = method ? method : "unresolved";
        resolvedSlotsMethod = slotsMethod ? slotsMethod : "none";
        resolvedKeyOffsetMethod = keyOffsetMethod ? keyOffsetMethod : "none";

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(resolverDiagnosticsMutex);
        lastResolverFailureDetails = details;
    }
```
