```cpp
                !OrdinaryFlickPhase(state).movementAllowed) {
                PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                return;
            }
            if (!IsSingleShotFirePolicy() || !state.singleShotIssued)
                ProjectFireCycleShot(state, false);
        }
        ObserveReleaseFireInput(state);
        if (!ordinaryFlick) UpdateFlickShotCooldown(state);
        if (!ordinaryFlick && FlickPostFireLockoutActive(state))
            return;
        if (!IsAimKeyPressed() || FireCycleShotIssued(state) ||
            (IsSingleShotFirePolicy() && state.singleShotIssued) ||
            OW::Config::reloading)
            return;
        g_flickAttempts++;

        Diagnostics::Aim("flick.enter originSens=%.6f shooted=%d reloading=%d scale=%.6f baseSpeed=%.6f method=%d acceleration=%.6f prediction=%d",
            origin_sens,
            FireCycleShotIssued(state) ? 1 : 0,
            OW::Config::reloading ? 1 : 0,
            OW::Config::View_Flick_smooth(),
            OW::Config::AimBehaviorBaseSpeed(behavior),
            OW::Config::AimBehaviorMethod(behavior),
            OW::Config::AimBehaviorAcceleration(behavior),
            OW::Config::View_Prediction() ? 1 : 0);



        // ---- Dry-run mode: log diagnostic info, don't move cursor ----
        if (OW::Config::aimDryRun) {
            static DWORD lastDryRunLog = 0;
            DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            if (now - lastDryRunLog >= (DWORD)OW::Config::aimDryRunLogIntervalMs) {
                lastDryRunLog = now;
                const auto candidate = OW::AcquireCurrentAimTarget(OW::Config::View_Prediction());
                const Vector3 vec = candidate.valid ? candidate.aimPoint : Vector3{};
                OW::AimCandidateConfig selectedSettings5(OW::Config::selectedAimHero);
                if (!IsZeroVector(vec)) {
                    PrepareAimCharge(state);
            AimData aim = BuildAimData(
                        vec,
                        true,
                        OW::Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(behavior, OW::Config::View_Flick_smooth()),
                        OW::Config::AimBehaviorAcceleration(behavior));
                    const float hitWindow = OW::Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow;
                    const bool wouldHit = OW::InSelectedAimHitWindow(candidate, aim.local_angle, aim.target_angle, aim.local_pos, vec);
                    Diagnostics::Aim("dryrun.flick local_angle_deg=(%.4f,%.4f) target_angle_deg=(%.4f,%.4f) "
                        "delta_deg=(%.4f,%.4f) hitbox=%.4f would_hit=%d target_pos=(%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)",
                        RAD2DEG(aim.local_angle.X), RAD2DEG(aim.local_angle.Y),
                        RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.X), RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.Y),
                        RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.X - aim.local_angle.X), RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.Y - aim.local_angle.Y),
                        hitWindow, wouldHit ? 1 : 0,
                        vec.X, vec.Y, vec.Z);
                } else {
                    Diagnostics::Aim("dryrun.flick no_target_vector targetIndex=%d entities=%zu",
                        OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                        OW::TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities().size());
                }
            }
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
            return; // Don't actually move cursor
        }

        if (GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire())
            ArmDelayedShot(state);
        const DWORD sessionStartedTick = GetTickCount();

        while (AimModeStructureCurrent() && OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && IsAimKeyPressed() &&
               OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
               OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
               OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionMatches(outputTransitionEpoch) &&
               (!IsSingleShotFirePolicy() || !FireCycleShotIssued(state)) &&
               (ordinaryFlick || !FireCycleShotIssued(state)) &&
               !OW::Config::reloading &&
               !OW::ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::GlobalAim)) {
            OW::consumerFrame=OW::SnapshotFrame();
            const FlickRepeat::Phase repeatPhase = ordinaryFlick
                ? OrdinaryFlickPhase(state) : FlickRepeat::Phase{};
            if (ordinaryFlick && !repeatPhase.movementAllowed) {
                PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                break;
            }
            if (ordinaryFlick && CurrentOrdinaryFlickIdentity() != state.ordinaryFlick.identity)
                break;
            if (ordinaryFlick && !FlickRepeat::ConsumeMovementSample(
                    state.ordinaryFlick, OW::consumerFrame->sequence)) {
                OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
                continue;
            }
            if (AimSessionTimedOut(sessionStartedTick, "flick"))
                break;
            if (LocalEntity().HeroID == OW::eHero::HERO_WIDOWMAKER &&
                !IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(LocalEntity().HeroID, V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary))) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("flick no_move reason=widow_scope_not_held");
                if (ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
                continue;
            }

            const auto candidate = OW::AcquireCurrentAimTarget(OW::Config::View_Prediction());
            if (CompleteReleasedAimAtCrosshair(state, false, &candidate)) break;
            const Vector3 vec = candidate.valid ? candidate.aimPoint : Vector3{};
            OW::AimCandidateConfig selectedSettings6(OW::Config::selectedAimHero);
            const bool contourEnabled=OW::Config::View_aimbotContourEnabled();
            const auto& contourCandidate = candidate;
            const bool contourActive = contourEnabled && contourCandidate.valid &&
                !contourCandidate.entitySnapshot.Vis;
            if(contourActive) {
                if(!ContourModeSupported()) {state.contourContact.Reset();break;}
                if(contourCandidate.valid) {
                    state.contourContact.Observe(contourCandidate.contour.evidence,
                        V2::Vision::MonotonicMs(),contourCandidate.contour.touchDelayMs,contourCandidate.contour.lostGraceMs);
                    ReportContourStatus(state,contourCandidate);
                } else {state.contourContact.Reset();ReportContourStatus(state,contourCandidate);}
            } else if (contourEnabled) {
                state.contourContact.Reset();
            }
            if (IsZeroVector(vec)) {
                CompleteReleasedAimAtCrosshair(state,true);
                Diagnostics::Aim("flick break reason=no_target_vector targetIndex=%d entities=%zu",
                    OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                    OW::TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities().size());
                break;
            }

            c_entity target{};
            if (IsPrimaryTargetActionable(target)) {
                if (!TargetDelayReady(&state, true, true)) {
                    if (ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                    OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
                    continue;
                }
                if (!FlickTrajectoryWaitReady(state, target)) {
                    if (ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                    OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
                    continue;
                }
                if (GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire())
                    PrimeDelayedShot(state);

                const TwoStageAimPlan twoStagePlan =
                    ResolveTwoStageAimPlan(vec, target, OW::Config::View_Prediction());
                const Vector3 aimTarget = twoStagePlan.active ? twoStagePlan.target : vec;
                const float smoothInput = OW::Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(
                    behavior,
                    OW::Config::View_Flick_smooth(),
                    twoStagePlan.smoothScale);
                if (ordinaryFlick && FlickRepeat::PrepareTarget(state.ordinaryFlick,
                    TwoStageEntityKey(target)))
                    OW::ResetAimSmoothingState();
                PrepareAimCharge(state);
                AimData aim = BuildAimData(
                    aimTarget,
                    true,
                    smoothInput,
                    OW::Config::AimBehaviorAcceleration(behavior),
                    twoStagePlan.methodOverride,
                    -1.0f,
                    true,
                    !repeatPhase.repeat,
                    twoStagePlan.methodOverride < 0); // An explicit stage uses its Slot motion, above hero overrides.
                if (ordinaryFlick && !aim.valid) {
                    PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                    break;
                }
                const bool hitBeforeMove = OW::InSelectedAimHitWindow(
                    candidate, aim.local_angle, aim.target_angle, aim.local_pos, aimTarget);
                const bool contactBeforeMove = hitBeforeMove;
                if (ordinaryFlick && contactBeforeMove) {
                    // Once the measured crosshair is in the hit window, fire
                    // from that sample. Moving toward the centre first can
                    // pull a valid first shot out of its own firing window.
                    aim.smoothed_angle = aim.local_angle;
                } else if (repeatPhase.repeat) {
                    aim.smoothed_angle = FlickRepeat::Step(aim.local_angle, aim.target_angle,
                        OrdinaryFlickPhase(state).remainingMs,
                        OW::AimSmoothingDetail::ComputeDeltaTime(),
                        OW::Config::flickRepeatMaxSpeedDegPerSec,
                        contactBeforeMove);
                } else {
                    ApplyAiAimNoise(aim.smoothed_angle, 300.f, false);
                }
                const float hitWindow = OW::Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow;

                if (ordinaryFlick || !IsZeroVector(aim.smoothed_angle)) {
                    if (FlickRepeat::AllowsFirePath(ordinaryFlick, FlickRepeat::FirePath::DelayedTimeout) &&
                        GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire() &&
                        DelayedShotTimedOut(state)) {
                        const c_entity local = LocalEntity();
                        Diagnostics::Aim("flick delayed_shot timeout target=%d localHero=0x%llX",
                            OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(local.HeroID));
                        if(!FirePrimaryNormal()) {OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);continue;}
                        StampFlickFire(state);
                        MarkAimShot(state);
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (ordinaryFlick && CurrentOrdinaryFlickIdentity() != state.ordinaryFlick.identity)
                        break;
                    if (ordinaryFlick && aim.smoothed_angle == aim.local_angle)
                        OW::HoldAimSmoothingState();
                    else
                        MoveAimDelta(aim.local_angle, aim.smoothed_angle);
                    if (OW::Config::aimVerboseLog) {
                        const float deltaDegX = RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.X - aim.local_angle.X);
                        const float deltaDegY = RAD2DEG(aim.target_angle.Y - aim.local_angle.Y);
                        Diagnostics::Aim("flick.tick delta_deg=(%.4f,%.4f) hitbox=%.4f missbox=%.4f",
                            deltaDegX, deltaDegY, hitWindow, OW::Config::missbox);
                    }
                    const bool hitAfterMove = OW::InSelectedAimHitWindow(
                        candidate, aim.smoothed_angle, aim.target_angle, aim.local_pos, aimTarget);
                    ReportReleasedAimProgress(state,aim,aimTarget,hitWindow,hitBeforeMove);
                    if (!hitBeforeMove && hitAfterMove) {
                        Diagnostics::Aim("flick.fire predicted_post_move_hit target=%d hitbox=%.6f",
                            OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                            hitWindow);
                    }
                    const auto flickFireEvidence = OW::Config::reloading
                        ? FlickRepeat::FireStateEvidence::KnownProhibited
                        : FlickRepeat::FireStateEvidence::Missing;
                    const bool firePolicyAllows = GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire();
                    const bool stageAllows = !twoStagePlan.active || twoStagePlan.triggerOpen;
                    const bool fireSafetyAllows = OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() &&
                        OW::HasFreshViewMatrices() && IsAimKeyPressed() &&
                        LocalEntity().SkillBase != 0 &&
                        CurrentOrdinaryFlickIdentity() == state.ordinaryFlick.identity &&
                        !OW::ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::GlobalAim);
                    const bool cadenceAllows = !ordinaryFlick || FlickRepeat::AllowsFire(
                        OrdinaryFlickPhase(state), flickFireEvidence, fireSafetyAllows, hitBeforeMove);
                    const bool fireEligible = firePolicyAllows && hitBeforeMove && stageAllows && cadenceAllows;
                    if (OW::Config::aimVerboseLog && hitBeforeMove && !fireEligible) {
                        static DWORD lastNoFireLogTick = 0;
                        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
                        if (lastNoFireLogTick == 0 || now - lastNoFireLogTick >= 100) {
                            lastNoFireLogTick = now;
                            const auto phase = OrdinaryFlickPhase(state);
                            Diagnostics::Aim(
                                "flick.no_fire policy=%d hitBefore=%d stage=%d cadence=%d movement=%d time=%d remainingMs=%.1f evidence=%d safety=%d target=0x%llX body=%llu",
                                firePolicyAllows ? 1 : 0,
                                hitBeforeMove ? 1 : 0,
                                stageAllows ? 1 : 0,
                                cadenceAllows ? 1 : 0,
                                phase.movementAllowed ? 1 : 0,
                                phase.timeAllowsFire ? 1 : 0,
                                phase.remainingMs,
                                static_cast<int>(flickFireEvidence),
                                fireSafetyAllows ? 1 : 0,
                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(TwoStageEntityKey(target)),
                                static_cast<unsigned long long>(target.actor_generation));
                        }
                    }
                    if (fireEligible) {
                        if (OW::Config::aimVerboseLog) {
                            Diagnostics::Aim("flick.fire hitbox_check=passed before=%d after=%d",
                                hitBeforeMove ? 1 : 0,
                                hitAfterMove ? 1 : 0);
                        }
                        SetSensitivityLocked(true, origin_sens);
                        DWORD submittedAt = GetTickCount();
                        const bool submitted = FirePrimaryNormal(OW::OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim,
                            kGlobalAimGeneratedFireOwnerKey, ordinaryFlick, &submittedAt,
                            ordinaryFlick ? &state.ordinaryFlick.identity : nullptr);
                        SetSensitivityLocked(false, origin_sens);
                        if (!submitted) {
                            if(ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                            break;
                        }
                        if (ordinaryFlick) {
                            if(contourActive) state.contourContact.Submitted();
                            if (!FlickRepeat::RecordSubmission(state.ordinaryFlick, submitted,
                                submittedAt, ordinaryInterval)) break;
                            StampFlickFire(state, submittedAt);
                            // RecordSubmission already cleared movement; clear the just-used controller once.
                            OW::ResetAimSmoothingState();
                        } else {
                            StampFlickFire(state);
                        }
                        g_flickFires++;
                        MarkAimShot(state);
                        if (!ordinaryFlick && OW::Config::dontshot) OW::Config::shotcount++;
                        break;
                    }

                    if (FlickRepeat::AllowsFirePath(ordinaryFlick, FlickRepeat::FirePath::ForcedMiss) &&
                        GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire() &&
                        OW::Config::dontshot &&
                        OW::Config::shotcount >= OW::Config::shotmanydont &&
                        OW::in_range(aim.local_angle, aim.target_angle, aim.local_pos, aimTarget, OW::Config::missbox)) {
                        const int previousShotCount = OW::Config::shotcount;
                        OW::Config::shotcount = 0;
                        const c_entity local = LocalEntity();
                        Diagnostics::Aim("flick dontshot forced_fire target=%d previousShotCount=%d missbox=%.6f",
                            OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                            previousShotCount,
                            OW::Config::missbox);
                        if(!FirePrimaryNormal()) {OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);continue;}
                        StampFlickFire(state);
                        MarkAimShot(state);
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    Diagnostics::Aim("flick no_move reason=smoothed_angle_zero local=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) target=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f)",
                        aim.local_angle.X,
                        aim.local_angle.Y,
                        aim.local_angle.Z,
                        aim.target_angle.X,
                        aim.target_angle.Y,
                        aim.target_angle.Z);
                }
            } else {
                if(CompleteReleasedAimAtCrosshair(state,true)) break;
                if (ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
                Diagnostics::Aim("flick no_move reason=target_not_actionable targetIndex=%d vec=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f)",
                    OW::Config::Targetenemyi,
                    vec.X,
                    vec.Y,
                    vec.Z);
            }

            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
            RunAutoScaleFov();
            if (ShouldYieldToSecondaryAim()) break;
        }
        if (ordinaryFlick) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
    }

    inline void RunAutoMelee() {
        if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::HasFreshViewMatrices())
            return;
        if (!OW::Config::AutoMelee) return;

        const Vector3 vec = OW::GetVector3(false);
            OW::AimCandidateConfig selectedSettings7(OW::Config::selectedAimHero);
        c_entity target{};
        if (!IsZeroVector(vec) && CurrentTarget(target) && target.Team) {
            const float dist = CameraPosition().DistTo(vec);
            if (OW::Config::health <= OW::Config::meleehealth &&
                dist <= OW::Config::meleedistance &&
                !(target.skill1act && target.HeroID == OW::eHero::HERO_VENTURE)) {
                OW::PulseAction(OW::GameAction::Melee);
                OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
            }
        }
    }

    inline void ResetShootStateOnRelease(RuntimeState& state) {
        if (IsAimKeyPressed()) return;
        EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);

        ProjectFireCycleShot(state, false);
        OW::Config::lasttime = 0;
        if (OW::Config::reloading) {
            OW::Config::lasttime = 0;
            ProjectFireCycleShot(state, false);
        }
        OW::Config::Targetenemyi = -1;
        OW::TargetingDetail::ResetTargetLockRuntime();
        ResetTwoStageState();
        ResetTrackingSession(state);
    }

    inline void RunReaperReloadCancel() {
        if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::HasFreshViewMatrices())
            return;
        const std::uint64_t connectionEpoch =
            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const std::uint64_t outputTransitionEpoch =
            OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionEpoch();
        const c_entity local = LocalEntity();
        if (connectionEpoch != 0 &&
            OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
            local.HeroID == OW::eHero::HERO_REAPER &&
            OW::Config::reloading) {
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(300);
            if (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && OW::HasFreshViewMatrices() &&
                OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
                OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
                OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionMatches(outputTransitionEpoch)) {
                OW::PulseAction(OW::GameAction::Melee);
            }
        }
    }

    inline void RunSecondAim() {
        const std::uint64_t connectionEpoch =
            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const std::uint64_t outputTransitionEpoch =
            OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionEpoch();
        if (connectionEpoch == 0 || !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected())
            return;
        if (!OW::Config::secondaim) return;
        if (InputSequenceBlocksAim("secondaim"))
            return;

        const DWORD sessionStartedTick = GetTickCount();
        while (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && IsSecondAimKeyPressed() &&
               OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
               OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connectionEpoch &&
               OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionMatches(outputTransitionEpoch) &&
               !OW::Config::shooted2 &&
               !OW::ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::GlobalAim)) {
            OW::consumerFrame=OW::SnapshotFrame();
            if (AimSessionTimedOut(sessionStartedTick, "secondaim")) {
                break;
            }
            const Vector3 vec = OW::GetVector3aim2(ResolveCurrentAimSlotPredictionEnabled());
            c_entity target{};
            if (!IsZeroVector(vec) && CurrentTarget(target) &&
                !(target.skill2act && target.HeroID == OW::eHero::HERO_GENJI)) {
                AimData aim{};
                if (OW::Config::Tracking2) {
                    const int method = OW::Config::SecondaryAimMethod(0);
                    aim = BuildAimData(
                        vec,
                        false,
                        OW::Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(0, OW::Config::Tracking_smooth2),
                        OW::Config::RuntimeAimMethodAcceleration(method),
                        method);
                } else if (OW::Config::Flick2) {
                    const int method = OW::Config::SecondaryAimMethod(1);
                    aim = BuildAimData(
                        vec,
                        true,
                        OW::Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(1, OW::Config::Flick_smooth2),
                        OW::Config::RuntimeAimMethodAcceleration(method),
                        method);
                } else
                    aim = BuildAimData(vec, false, 1.0f, 0.0f);

                ApplyAiAimNoise(aim.smoothed_angle, 300.f, false);

                if (!IsZeroVector(aim.smoothed_angle)) {
                    RunCloseRangeActions(
                        vec,
                        OW::OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
                    MoveAimDelta(aim.local_angle, aim.smoothed_angle);
                    if (OW::Config::Flick2 &&
                        GlobalAimFirePolicyAllowsGeneratedFire() &&
                        OW::in_range(aim.local_angle, aim.target_angle, aim.local_pos, vec, OW::Config::aimbotEffectiveHitWindow2)) {
                        if (OW::Config::aimVerboseLog) {
                            const OW::c_entity local = LocalEntity();
                            const OW::WeaponSpec* weapon = OW::ResolveWeaponSpec(local.HeroID, OW::Config::View_aimbotAttack());
                            Diagnostics::Aim("secondaim.fire action=%d keyMask=0x%X",
                                OW::Config::View_aimbotAttack(),
                                OW::ResolveGeneratedFireKeyMask(weapon, OW::Config::View_aimbotAttack()));
                        }
                        const bool fireAccepted = ClickConfiguredFire();
                        OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
                        if (fireAccepted)
                            OW::Config::shooted2 = true;
                    }
                }

                if (LocalEntity().PlayerHealth < OW::Config::SkillHealth) break;
            }
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1);
        }

        if (!IsSecondAimKeyPressed())
            OW::TargetingDetail::ResetTargetLockRuntime();

        if (OW::Config::shooted2 && !IsSecondAimKeyPressed())
            OW::Config::shooted2 = false;
    }

    inline bool RefreshAimScene(RuntimeState& state) {
        const auto scene=OW::EntitySceneGeneration();
        if(state.entityScene!=scene) {
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "scene_generation_changed");
            const bool requireNewActivation=state.releaseActivationDown||state.releaseOwnedDown||state.releasePending;
            ResetTrackingSession(state);EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);
            if(!ResetAimCharge(state)) return false;
            chargedAimPreset.reset();
            // Scene/motion state can restart while the physical key is still held.
            const auto heldKeys = state.aimHoldWindows;
            const auto physicalPresses=state.releasePresses;
            state=RuntimeState{};state.entityScene=scene;
            state.aimHoldWindows = heldKeys;
            state.releasePresses=physicalPresses;
            state.releaseNeedsActivationUp=requireNewActivation;
            state.releaseActivationDown=requireNewActivation;
        }
        return true;
    }

    inline void RunConfiguredAimBehavior(RuntimeState& state, float origin_sens) {
        if(state.releaseNeedsActivationUp) return;
        const auto* tuning=OW::Config::ActiveSlotBehaviorTuning();
        if(tuning && tuning->releaseToFire && tuning->autoCharge &&
            OW::Config::View_Flick() && OW::Config::UsesFlickFireControls(OW::Config::View_aimBehavior())) {
            if(OW::Config::reloading || !AimModeStructureCurrent()) {
                CancelConfiguredAimShot(state);return;
            }
            if(!IsAimActivationKeyDown()&&!state.releasePending) {
                ResetShootStateOnRelease(state);return;
            }
            if(!PrepareAimCharge(state) && (UsesReleaseKeyUpExecution()||!state.releaseShotLatched)) return;
            if(UsesReleaseKeyUpExecution()) {
                if(!state.releasePending) return; // Holding charges anywhere without moving the view.
                const auto candidate = OW::AcquireCurrentAimTarget(OW::Config::View_Prediction());
                if (CompleteReleasedAimAtCrosshair(state, !candidate.valid, &candidate)) return;
            }
        }
        if(!HasEntitySnapshot()) return;
        if (OW::Config::View_Tracking()) RunTracking(state, origin_sens);
        else if (OW::Config::View_Flick()) {
            if (OW::Config::IsMagneticTriggerBehavior(OW::Config::View_aimBehavior()))
                RunMagneticTrigger(state, origin_sens);
            else
                RunFlick(state, origin_sens);
        }
    }

    inline void RunAimbotTick(RuntimeState& state, float& origin_sens) {
        OW::ScopedConsumptionFrame frame;
        if(!RefreshAimScene(state)) return;
        MaintainKeepFiringOutput(state);
        if(!OW::SnapshotLocalEntity().HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(),OW::EntitySceneGeneration())) {
            ResetTrackingTargetContinuity(state,"local_body_unavailable");
            EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);CancelConfiguredAimShot(state);
            OW::RuntimeOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OW::OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
            OW::RuntimeOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OW::OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "local_body_unavailable");
            return;
        }
        if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::HasFreshViewMatrices()) {
            ObserveReleaseFireInput(state);
            ResetShootStateOnRelease(state);
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "runtime_unavailable");
            return;
        }
        const std::uint64_t connectionEpoch =
            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const std::uint64_t outputTransitionEpoch =
            OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionEpoch();
        if (connectionEpoch == 0 || !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "connection_unavailable");
            return;
        }
        if (InputSequenceBlocksAim("aimbot_tick")) {
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "sequence_preempted");
            return;
        }

        if (OW::Config::AntiAFK) {
            OW::PulseAction(OW::GameAction::MoveForward);
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1000);
            if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::HasFreshViewMatrices() ||
                !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
                OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() != connectionEpoch ||
                !OW::RuntimeOutputTransitionMatches(outputTransitionEpoch)) {
                ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "runtime_transition");
                return;
            }
        }

        OW::RefreshAutoGameMouseSensitivity();

        if (!HasEntitySnapshot()) {
            if (IsAimKeyPressed()) {
                static DWORD lastNoSnapshotLogTick = 0;
                const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
                if (lastNoSnapshotLogTick == 0 || now - lastNoSnapshotLogTick >= 1000) {
                    Diagnostics::Aim("aimbot_tick target_search_skipped reason=no_entity_snapshot");
                    lastNoSnapshotLogTick = now;
                }
            }
            // Trigger still samples its own hotkey; release Aim can charge without targets.
        }

        MaintainSensitivity(origin_sens);

        {
            ScopedIndependentAimSelection independentSelection;
            ScopedHeroTriggerPresetOverride triggerPresetOverride;
            if (OW::Config::View_triggerbot()) RunTriggerbot(false, origin_sens);
            if (OW::Config::View_triggerbot2()) RunTriggerbot(true, origin_sens);
        }

        RunConfiguredAimBehavior(state, origin_sens);
        MaintainKeepFiringOutput(state);
        if(!HasEntitySnapshot()) return;

        if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::HasFreshViewMatrices()) {
            ObserveReleaseFireInput(state);
            ResetShootStateOnRelease(state);
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "runtime_unavailable_after_behavior");
            return;
        }
        {
            ScopedIndependentAimSelection independentSelection;
            RunAutoScaleFov();
            RunAutoMelee();
        }
        ResetShootStateOnRelease(state);
        MaintainKeepFiringOutput(state);
        {
            ScopedIndependentAimSelection independentSelection;
            RunReaperReloadCancel();
            RunSecondAim();
        }
    }

    inline void RunAimbotTickWithHeroPreset(RuntimeState& state, float& origin_sens) {
        if (OW::Config::configLoadGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire) & 1u) {
            EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);CancelConfiguredAimShot(state);
            ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "config_load");
            return;
        }
        if(!RefreshAimScene(state)) return;
        ScopedHeroPresetOverride heroPresetOverride(state);
        activeAimShotState=&state;
        ObserveFireCycle(state);
        if(state.contourWasEnabled!=OW::Config::View_aimbotContourEnabled()) {
            state.contourContact.Reset();OW::TargetingDetail::ResetContourSelection();
            state.contourWasEnabled=OW::Config::View_aimbotContourEnabled();
        }
        if(OW::Config::View_aimbotContourEnabled() && !ContourModeSupported()) {
            static DWORD lastUnsupportedReport=0;
            const DWORD now=GetTickCount();
            if(IsAimActivationKeyDown() && (!lastUnsupportedReport || now-lastUnsupportedReport>=1000)) {
                lastUnsupportedReport=now;
                Diagnostics::Info("[V2 leak-shot] fallback_unavailable reason=%s; native_visibility_path_remains_active",ContourUnsupportedReason());
            }
        }
        MaintainConfiguredAimShot(state);
        ObserveAimHoldWindows(state);
        if (InputSequenceBlocksAim("aimbot_preset")) {
            CancelConfiguredAimShot(state);
            EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);
            return;
        }

        // Observe the effective per-hero configuration here, after the override.
        static DWORD lastGateReport = 0;
        const DWORD gateNow = GetTickCount();
        if (lastGateReport == 0 || gateNow - lastGateReport >= 5000) {
            lastGateReport = gateNow;
            const auto observedLocal = LocalEntity();
            Diagnostics::Info("[V2 behavior gates] hero=0x%llX menu=%d tracking=%d flick=%d behavior=%d key=%d input=%d localBody=%d matrix=%d entities=%d dryRun=%d",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(observedLocal.HeroID), OW::Config::Menu ? 1 : 0,
                OW::Config::View_Tracking() ? 1 : 0, OW::Config::View_Flick() ? 1 : 0,
                OW::Config::View_aimBehavior(), OW::Config::View_aim_key(), IsAimKeyPressed() ? 1 : 0,
                observedLocal.HasUsableBody(gateNow, OW::EntitySceneGeneration()) ? 1 : 0,
                OW::HasFreshViewMatrices() ? 1 : 0, HasEntitySnapshot() ? 1 : 0,
                OW::Config::aimDryRun ? 1 : 0);
        }
        if (OW::Config::View_aimBehavior() != OW::Config::kAimBehaviorFlick || !IsAimKeyPressed() ||
            OW::Config::reloading)
            EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);
        RunAimbotTick(state, origin_sens);
        const bool activationOngoing=UsesReleaseKeyUpExecution()
            ? IsAimActivationKeyDown()||state.releasePending : IsAimKeyPressed();
        const bool unfinishedCharge=state.releaseOwnedDown||state.releasePending||chargedAimPreset.has_value();
        // Reload pauses ordinary held fire without acquiring the release-shot rearm latch.
        const bool reloadCancelsCharge=OW::Config::reloading&&(state.releaseConfigured||unfinishedCharge);
        if((!activationOngoing&&unfinishedCharge)||reloadCancelsCharge||!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning()||!OW::HasFreshViewMatrices()||
           !AimModeStructureCurrent()||
           (OW::Config::IsMagneticTriggerBehavior(OW::Config::View_aimBehavior())&&IsAimKeyPressed()&&TrackingHoldTimedOut(state))||
           OW::ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::GlobalAim)) CancelConfiguredAimShot(state);
    }
#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
#include "AimReleaseOutputSelfTest.inl"
#endif

}

void aimbot_thread() {
    Diagnostics::ScopedDmaCallsite::Push(Diagnostics::DmaCallsite::Aimbot);
    __try {
        AimbotDetail::RuntimeState state{};
        static float origin_sens = 0.f;
        static uint64_t totalTicks = 0;
        static DWORD lastSummaryTick = 0;

        while (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning()) {
            if (!OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
                AimbotDetail::EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(state);
                AimbotDetail::ObserveReleaseFireInput(state,true);
                AimbotDetail::ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "connection_unavailable");
                OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(100);
                continue;
            }

            totalTicks++;

            // Periodic diagnostic summary every 5 seconds
            DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            if (lastSummaryTick == 0 || now - lastSummaryTick >= 5000) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("aimbot.summary totalTicks=%llu trackingAttempts=%llu trackingMoves=%llu "
                    "flickAttempts=%llu flickFires=%llu dryRun=%d",
                    (unsigned long long)totalTicks,
                    (unsigned long long)g_trackingAttempts,
                    (unsigned long long)g_trackingMoves,
                    (unsigned long long)g_flickAttempts,
                    (unsigned long long)g_flickFires,
                    OW::Config::aimDryRun ? 1 : 0);
                lastSummaryTick = now;
            }

            AimbotDetail::RunAimbotTickWithHeroPreset(state, origin_sens);
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(2);
        }
        AimbotDetail::ObserveReleaseFireInput(state,true);
        AimbotDetail::ReleaseKeepFiringOutput(state, "worker_stopped");
    } __except (1) {
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
        OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(false);
        Diagnostics::Error("UN behavior worker stopped after a structured exception; reconnect required.");
    }
    Diagnostics::ScopedDmaCallsite::Pop();
}
```

`src/Features/aim/SessionState.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "BehaviorController.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
using namespace OW;
namespace AimbotDetail {
    void LogMagneticTriggerQuantizationReset(
        const char* reason,
        bool hadState) {
        static DWORD lastLogTick = 0;
        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        if (!OW::Config::aimVerboseLog &&
            lastLogTick != 0 &&
            now - lastLogTick < 250) {
            return;
        }
        Diagnostics::Aim("magnetic_trigger.quantization state_reset=1 state_reset_reason=%s had_state=%d",
            reason ? reason : "unknown",
            hadState ? 1 : 0);
        lastLogTick = now;
    }

    void ResetMagneticTriggerQuantization(
        RuntimeState& state,
        const char* reason) {
        const bool hadState = OW::HasMouseMoveQuantizationState(
            state.magneticMoveQuantization);
        OW::ResetMouseMoveQuantizationState(state.magneticMoveQuantization);
        if (hadState)
            LogMagneticTriggerQuantizationReset(reason, true);
    }

    void ResetTrackingSession(RuntimeState& state) {
        // Motion cleanup must not rearm aimHoldWindows; only physical release does.
        ResetMagneticTriggerQuantization(state, "tracking_session_reset");
        state.trackingSessionActive = false;
        state.trackingSessionHeroId = 0;
        state.trackingSessionSlotIndex = -1;
        state.trackingSessionSlotId = 0;
        state.trackingSessionAimKey = 0;
        state.trackingTargetKey = 0;
        state.trackingTargetActorKey = 0;
        state.trackingTargetMissingSinceTick = 0;
        state.trackingInDeadzone = false;
        OW::ResetAimStartLimiter(state.trackingStartLimiter);
    }

    void PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(RuntimeState& state) {
        const bool wasMoving = state.ordinaryFlick.moving;
        FlickRepeat::PauseMovement(state.ordinaryFlick);
        if (wasMoving) OW::ResetAimSmoothingState();
    }

    void EndOrdinaryFlickActivation(RuntimeState& state) {
        state.contourContact.Reset();
        OW::TargetingDetail::ResetContourSelection();
        if (state.ordinaryFlick.moving) PauseOrdinaryFlickMovement(state);
        FlickRepeat::EndActivation(state.ordinaryFlick);
    }

    FlickRepeat::Phase OrdinaryFlickPhase(const RuntimeState& state,
                                                DWORD now) {
        return FlickRepeat::Resolve(state.ordinaryFlick.timeline, now,
            OW::IsKeepFiringPolicy(OW::ClampFirePolicy(
                OW::Config::View_aimbotFirePolicy())), OW::Config::flickRepeatWindowMs,
            OW::Config::ClampFlickPostFireDelayMs(OW::Config::View_aimbotFlickPostFireDelayMs()),
            state.ordinaryFlick.shotLatched);
    }
}
```

`src/Features/aim/Smoothing.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SmoothingInternal.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include "Game/AimSmoothingTiming.hpp"
#include "Game/AimShuwu.hpp"
#include "Game/AimKoi.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
namespace OW {
    Vector3 SmoothLinear(Vector3 LocalAngle, Vector3 TargetAngle, float speed) {
        const float factor = std::isfinite(speed) ? std::clamp(speed, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.0f;
        auto& state = AimSmoothingDetail::GetLinearState();
        if (factor <= 0.0f) {
            state = {};
            return LocalAngle;
        }

        Vector3 Result;
        float deltax = (TargetAngle.X - LocalAngle.X) * factor;
        float deltay = (TargetAngle.Y - LocalAngle.Y) * factor;
        float deltaz = (TargetAngle.Z - LocalAngle.Z) * factor;

        Result.X = LocalAngle.X + deltax;
        Result.Y = LocalAngle.Y + deltay;
        Result.Z = LocalAngle.Z + deltaz;

        if (Config::trackcompensate) {
            // The first sample after a lifecycle break establishes a baseline;
            // only consecutive targets can supply a tracking compensation.
            if (state.initialized) {
                Vector3 realresult{
                    LocalAngle.X + TargetAngle.X - state.lastTarget.X,
                    LocalAngle.Y + TargetAngle.Y - state.lastTarget.Y,
                    LocalAngle.Z + TargetAngle.Z - state.lastTarget.Z
                };
                if (Result.DistTo(realresult) <= Config::comarea) {
                    if (fabsf(deltax) < fabsf(TargetAngle.X - state.lastTarget.X))
                        deltax = (TargetAngle.X - state.lastTarget.X) * Config::comspeed;
                    if (fabsf(deltaz) < fabsf(TargetAngle.Z - state.lastTarget.Z))
                        deltaz = (TargetAngle.Z - state.lastTarget.Z) * Config::comspeed;
                }
            }
            state.lastTarget = TargetAngle;
            state.initialized = true;

            Result.X = LocalAngle.X + deltax;
            Result.Y = LocalAngle.Y + deltay;
            Result.Z = LocalAngle.Z + deltaz;
        } else {
            state = {};
        }
        return Result;
    }

    Vector3 SmoothAccelerate(Vector3 LocalAngle, Vector3 TargetAngle, float Speed, float Acc) {
        Vector3 Result = LocalAngle;
        __try {
            Vector3 delta = TargetAngle - LocalAngle;
            float tmp = Acc / delta.get_length();
            tmp = tmp * tmp * 0.005f;
            float c = Speed + tmp * Speed;
            if (c >= 1.f) c = 1.f;
            Result.X += delta.X * c;
            Result.Y += delta.Y * c;
            Result.Z += delta.Z * c;
            return Result;
        } __except (1) {
            return Result;
        }
    }

        float ClampDeltaTime(float deltaTime) {
            if (!std::isfinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime <= 0.0f)
                return kDefaultDeltaTime;
            return std::clamp(deltaTime, kMinDeltaTime, kMaxDeltaTime);
        }

        std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point& LastSmoothingTick() {
            static thread_local std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point lastTick{};
            return lastTick;
        }

        void ResetDeltaTime() {
            LastSmoothingTick() = {};
        }

        float ComputeDeltaTime() {
            const auto currentTick = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            auto& lastTick = LastSmoothingTick();
            if (lastTick == std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point{}) {
                lastTick = currentTick;
                return kDefaultDeltaTime;
            }

            const float deltaTime =
                std::chrono::duration<float>(currentTick - lastTick).count();
            lastTick = currentTick;
            return ClampDeltaTime(deltaTime);
        }

        bool IsRetarget(const Vector3& target, const Vector3& lastTarget) {
            return target.DistTo(lastTarget) > kRetargetAngleThreshold;
        }

        float EstimateMoveCounts(const Vector3& angleDelta) {
            const float sensitivity = Config::OutputYawCountsPerRadian();
            const float pitchSensitivity = Config::OutputPitchCountsPerRadian();
            const float pitchScale = std::clamp(Config::View_aimbotPitchScale(), 0.1f, 3.0f);
            const float countX = -angleDelta.Y * sensitivity;
            const float countY = angleDelta.X * pitchSensitivity * pitchScale;
            return sqrtf(countX * countX + countY * countY);
        }

        Vector3 ApplyOvershootCurveTarget(const Vector3& local, const Vector3& target) {
            if (!Config::aimOvershootCurve)
                return target;

            OvershootState& state = GetOvershootState();
            if (!state.initialized || IsRetarget(target, state.lastTarget)) {
                state = OvershootState{};
                state.initialized = true;
            }

            state.lastTarget = target;
            const float resetCounts = std::clamp(Config::aimOvershootResetPixels, 1.0f, 250.0f);
            if (EstimateMoveCounts(state.offset) > resetCounts)
                state.offset = Vector3{};

            const Vector3 adjusted = target + state.offset;
            Diagnostics::Aim("smooth.overshoot apply offset=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) offset_counts=%.3f local=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) target=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) adjusted=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f)",
                state.offset.X,
                state.offset.Y,
                state.offset.Z,
                EstimateMoveCounts(state.offset),
                local.X,
                local.Y,
                local.Z,
                target.X,
                target.Y,
                target.Z,
                adjusted.X,
                adjusted.Y,
                adjusted.Z);
            return adjusted;
        }

        void CommitOvershootStep(const Vector3& outputDelta) {
            if (!Config::aimOvershootCurve) {
                ResetOvershootState();
                return;
            }

            OvershootState& state = GetOvershootState();
            const float gain = std::clamp(Config::aimOvershootGain, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            const float resetCounts = std::clamp(Config::aimOvershootResetPixels, 1.0f, 250.0f);
            state.offset = (state.offset + outputDelta * gain) * 0.82f;
            if (EstimateMoveCounts(state.offset) > resetCounts)
                state.offset = Vector3{};

            Diagnostics::Aim("smooth.overshoot commit output_delta=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) gain=%.3f offset=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) offset_counts=%.3f resetCounts=%.3f",
                outputDelta.X,
                outputDelta.Y,
                outputDelta.Z,
                gain,
                state.offset.X,
                state.offset.Y,
                state.offset.Z,
                EstimateMoveCounts(state.offset),
                resetCounts);
        }

        float ClampIntegralComponent(float value, float maxIntegral) {
            return std::clamp(value, -maxIntegral, maxIntegral);
        }

        Vector3 ClampIntegral(const Vector3& value, float maxIntegral) {
            return Vector3(
                ClampIntegralComponent(value.X, maxIntegral),
                ClampIntegralComponent(value.Y, maxIntegral),
                ClampIntegralComponent(value.Z, maxIntegral)
            );
        }

        float ClampStepComponent(float output, float error) {
            const float maxStep = std::fabs(error);
            if (maxStep <= 0.0f)
                return 0.0f;
            return std::clamp(output, -maxStep, maxStep);
        }

        Vector3 ClampStepToError(const Vector3& output, const Vector3& error) {
            return Vector3(
                ClampStepComponent(output.X, error.X),
                ClampStepComponent(output.Y, error.Y),
                ClampStepComponent(output.Z, error.Z)
            );
        }

        Vector3 Lerp(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b, float t) {
            return a * (1.0f - t) + b * t;
        }

        Vector3 PerpendicularTo(const Vector3& value) {
            Vector3 perpendicular(-value.Y, value.X, 0.0f);
            if (perpendicular.Size() <= 0.0001f)
                perpendicular = Vector3(0.0f, -value.Z, value.Y);

            const float length = perpendicular.get_length();
            return perpendicular / length;
        }

        Vector3 EvaluateBezier(const std::vector<Vector3>& controlPoints, float t) {
            if (controlPoints.empty())
                return Vector3{};

            std::vector<Vector3> points = controlPoints;
            t = std::clamp(t, 0.0f, 1.0f);

            for (size_t count = points.size(); count > 1; --count) {
                for (size_t index = 0; index + 1 < count; ++index)
                    points[index] = Lerp(points[index], points[index + 1], t);
            }

            return points.front();
        }

        void GenerateBezierControlPoints(BezierState& state,
                                                const Vector3& current,
                                                const Vector3& target,
                                                const Config::AimMethodPreset* methodPreset) {
            const int intermediateCount = std::clamp(
                methodPreset ? methodPreset->bezierControlPoints : Config::View_aimBezierControlPoints(),
                2,
                6);
            const float rawCurvature = methodPreset ? methodPreset->bezierCurvature : Config::View_aimBezierCurvature();
            const float curvature = std::isfinite(rawCurvature) ? std::clamp(rawCurvature, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0.5f;
            const Vector3 delta = target - current;
            const float distance = delta.Size();

            state.controlPoints.clear();
            state.controlPoints.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(intermediateCount) + 2);
            state.controlPoints.push_back(current);

            if (distance > 0.0001f) {
                const Vector3 perpendicular = PerpendicularTo(delta);
                const float offsetScale = distance * curvature * 0.35f;

                for (int index = 1; index <= intermediateCount; ++index) {
                    const float alpha = static_cast<float>(index) / static_cast<float>(intermediateCount + 1);
                    const float wave = sinf(alpha * M_PI_F);
                    const Vector3 base = current + delta * alpha;
                    state.controlPoints.push_back(base + perpendicular * (offsetScale * wave));
                }
            }

            state.controlPoints.push_back(target);
            state.lastTarget = target;
            state.t = 0.0f;
            state.initialized = true;
        }

    } // namespace AimSmoothingDetail

    void ResetAimSmoothingState() {
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetLinearState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetPIDState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetBezierState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetOvershootState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetHybridState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuState() = {};
        AimSmoothingDetail::KoiState() = {};
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetDeltaTime();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuDispatched() = false;
    }

    void HoldAimSmoothingState() {
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetLinearState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetPIDState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetBezierState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetOvershootState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ResetHybridState();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuState() = {};

        AimSmoothingDetail::LastSmoothingTick() =
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuDispatched() = false;
    }

    void PrimeAimSmoothingClock() {
        AimSmoothingDetail::LastSmoothingTick() =
            std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    }

    Vector3 SmoothPID(Vector3 current,
                             Vector3 target,
                             float deltaTime,
                             const Config::AimMethodPreset* methodPreset) {
        AimSmoothingDetail::PIDState& state = AimSmoothingDetail::GetPIDState();
        deltaTime = AimSmoothingDetail::ClampDeltaTime(deltaTime);

        const Vector3 error = target - current;
        const float rawDeadzone = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidDeadzone : Config::View_aimPidDeadzone();
        const float deadzone = std::clamp(
            (std::isfinite(rawDeadzone) ? rawDeadzone : 1.0f) * (M_PI_F / 180.0f),
            0.0f,
            M_PI_F / 2.0f);
        const float errorLength = error.Size();

        if (errorLength < deadzone) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("smooth.pid early_return reason=deadzone current=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) target=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) error=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) error_len=%.9f deadzone=%.9f",
                current.X,
                current.Y,
                current.Z,
                target.X,
                target.Y,
                target.Z,
                error.X,
                error.Y,
                error.Z,
                errorLength,
                deadzone);
            state.integral = Vector3{};
            state.previousError = error;
            state.filteredDerivative = Vector3{};
            state.lastTarget = target;
            state.initialized = true;
            return current;
        }

        const bool resetState = !state.initialized ||
            AimSmoothingDetail::IsRetarget(target, state.lastTarget);

        if (resetState) {
            state.integral = Vector3{};
            state.previousError = error;
            state.filteredDerivative = Vector3{};
            state.initialized = true;
        }

        state.lastTarget = target;
        state.integral += error * deltaTime;
        const float rawMaxIntegral = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidMaxIntegral : Config::View_aimPidMaxIntegral();
        state.integral = AimSmoothingDetail::ClampIntegral(
            state.integral,
            std::clamp(std::isfinite(rawMaxIntegral) ? rawMaxIntegral : 10.0f, 1.0f, 50.0f)
        );

        const Vector3 rawDerivative = resetState
            ? Vector3{}
            : (error - state.previousError) / deltaTime;
        constexpr float kDerivativeFilterTimeConstantSeconds = 0.012f;
        const float derivativeAlpha = resetState
            ? 1.0f
            : std::clamp(
                deltaTime /
                    (kDerivativeFilterTimeConstantSeconds + deltaTime),
                0.0f,
                1.0f);
        state.filteredDerivative +=
            (rawDerivative - state.filteredDerivative) * derivativeAlpha;
        state.previousError = error;

        const float rawP = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidP : Config::View_aimPidP();
        const float rawI = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidI : Config::View_aimPidI();
        const float rawD = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidD : Config::View_aimPidD();
        const Vector3 output =
            error * std::clamp(std::isfinite(rawP) ? rawP : 0.5f, 0.0f, 2.0f) +
            state.integral * std::clamp(std::isfinite(rawI) ? rawI : 0.01f, 0.0f, 0.5f) +
            state.filteredDerivative *
                std::clamp(std::isfinite(rawD) ? rawD : 0.1f, 0.0f, 1.0f);

        return current + AimSmoothingDetail::ClampStepToError(output, error);
    }

    Vector3 SmoothBezier(Vector3 current,
                                Vector3 target,
                                float deltaTime,
                                float speed,
                                const Config::AimMethodPreset* methodPreset) {
        AimSmoothingDetail::BezierState& state = AimSmoothingDetail::GetBezierState();
        deltaTime = AimSmoothingDetail::ClampDeltaTime(deltaTime);

        const bool resetState = !state.initialized ||
            state.controlPoints.empty() ||
            AimSmoothingDetail::IsRetarget(target, state.lastTarget);

        if (resetState)
            AimSmoothingDetail::GenerateBezierControlPoints(state, current, target, methodPreset);
        else {
            state.lastTarget = target;
            state.controlPoints.back() = target;
        }

        state.t = std::clamp(
            state.t + std::clamp(speed, 0.0f, 200.0f) * deltaTime,
            0.0f,
            1.0f
        );

        if (state.t >= 1.0f)
            return target;

        return AimSmoothingDetail::EvaluateBezier(state.controlPoints, state.t);
    }

    Vector3 SmoothPiecewise(Vector3 current,
                                   Vector3 target,
                                   float speed,
                                   const Config::AimMethodPreset* methodPreset) {
        const Vector3 error = target - current;
        const float errorDegrees = RAD2DEG(error.Size());
        float scale = Config::AimPiecewiseNearScale(methodPreset);
        if (errorDegrees > Config::AimPiecewiseFarDegrees(methodPreset))
            scale = 1.00f;
        else if (errorDegrees > Config::AimPiecewiseMidDegrees(methodPreset))
            scale = Config::AimPiecewiseFarScale(methodPreset);
        else if (errorDegrees > Config::AimPiecewiseNearDegrees(methodPreset))
            scale = Config::AimPiecewiseMidScale(methodPreset);

        return SmoothLinear(current, target, std::clamp(speed * scale, 0.0f, 1.0f));
    }

    Vector3 SmoothConstantAngularVelocity(Vector3 current,
                                                 Vector3 target,
                                                 float deltaTime,
                                                 float degreesPerSecond) {
        deltaTime = AimSmoothingDetail::ClampDeltaTime(deltaTime);
        const Vector3 error = target - current;
        const float errorLength = error.Size();
        const float angularSpeedRad = DEG2RAD(std::clamp(
            std::isfinite(degreesPerSecond) ? degreesPerSecond : 30.0f,
            0.0f,
            Config::kAimConstantAngularSpeedMaxDeg));
        const float maxStep = angularSpeedRad * deltaTime;

        if (errorLength <= 0.000001f || maxStep <= 0.0f)
            return current;
        if (errorLength <= maxStep)
            return target;

        return current + error * (maxStep / errorLength);
    }

    Vector3 SmoothDispatchWithMethod(Vector3 local,
                                            Vector3 target,
                                            float speed,
                                            float accel,
                                            int methodOverride,
                                            float bezierSpeedOverride,
                                            bool commitOvershootStep, float effectiveFovDeg, bool inheritTargetMotion) {
        thread_local uint64_t previousPlanTarget=0, previousActor=0, previousEpoch=0, previousScene=0;
        thread_local AimPlan::Effective previousPlan{};
        thread_local bool previousInheritTargetMotion=true;
        const bool usePlan=Config::targetAimPlanEnabled;
        const auto selectedPlan=usePlan?Config::selectedAimPlan:AimPlan::Effective{};
        const uint64_t planTarget=usePlan?Config::selectedAimPlanTarget:0;
        if(previousPlanTarget!=planTarget || previousPlan!=selectedPlan || previousActor!=Config::selectedAimActor || previousEpoch!=Config::selectedAimEpoch || previousScene!=Config::selectedAimScene || previousInheritTargetMotion!=inheritTargetMotion) {
            ResetAimSmoothingState(); previousPlanTarget=planTarget; previousPlan=selectedPlan;
            previousActor=Config::selectedAimActor; previousEpoch=Config::selectedAimEpoch; previousScene=Config::selectedAimScene;
            previousInheritTargetMotion=inheritTargetMotion;
        }
        const float deltaTime = AimSmoothingDetail::ComputeDeltaTime();
        const int method = std::clamp(methodOverride, 0, Config::kAimMethodCount - 1);
        AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuDispatched() = method == 7;
        thread_local int previousMethod = -1;

        if (method != previousMethod) {
            AimSmoothingDetail::ResetLinearState();
            AimSmoothingDetail::ResetPIDState();
            AimSmoothingDetail::ResetBezierState();
            AimSmoothingDetail::ResetOvershootState();
            AimSmoothingDetail::ResetHybridState();
            AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuState() = {};
            AimSmoothingDetail::KoiState() = {};
            previousMethod = method;
        }

        // Hybrid PID owns its braking curve and must converge on the real target.
        const Vector3 adjustedTarget = (method == 6 || method == 7 || method == 8 || method == 9)
            ? target
            : AimSmoothingDetail::ApplyOvershootCurveTarget(local, target);
        const Vector3 error = adjustedTarget - local;
        const Config::AimMethodPreset* methodPreset = Config::ActiveAimMethodPreset(method,inheritTargetMotion);
        const float methodSpeedScale = Config::RuntimeAimMethodAngularSpeedScale(method,inheritTargetMotion);
        const float slotSpeedScale = std::isfinite(speed) ? std::clamp(speed, 0.0f, 2.0f) : 0.0f;
        const float effectiveSpeed = std::clamp(slotSpeedScale * methodSpeedScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        const float effectiveStepFactor = OW::AimSmoothingTiming::NormalizePerTickFactor(
            effectiveSpeed,
            deltaTime);
        const float effectiveAccel = method == 4 ? Config::RuntimeAimMethodAcceleration(method,inheritTargetMotion) : accel;
        const float presetBezierSpeed = methodPreset ? methodPreset->bezierSpeed : Config::View_aimBezierSpeed();
        const float bezierSpeed = bezierSpeedOverride > 0.0f
            ? bezierSpeedOverride
            : presetBezierSpeed;
        const float effectiveBezierSpeed = std::clamp(bezierSpeed * slotSpeedScale * methodSpeedScale, 0.0f, 200.0f);
        // ActiveAimMethodPreset uses one thread-local slot value. Do not resolve a
        // different algorithm while methodPreset still points to the current one.
        const float constantAngularSpeedDeg = method == 5
            ? Config::RuntimeAimConstantAngularSpeedDeg(inheritTargetMotion) : 0.0f;
        const float effectiveConstantAngularSpeedDeg = std::clamp(
            constantAngularSpeedDeg * slotSpeedScale * methodSpeedScale,
            0.0f,
            Config::kAimConstantAngularSpeedMaxDeg);
        Diagnostics::Aim("smooth.dispatch method=%d speed=%.9f slotSpeedScale=%.9f speedScale=%.9f effectiveSpeed=%.9f stepFactor=%.9f accel=%.9f effectiveAccel=%.9f dt=%.9f bezierSpeed=%.9f constantDegPerSec=%.9f local=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) target=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) adjusted=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) error=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) error_len=%.9f",
            method,
            speed,
            slotSpeedScale,
            methodSpeedScale,
            effectiveSpeed,
            effectiveStepFactor,
            accel,
            effectiveAccel,
            deltaTime,
            effectiveBezierSpeed,
            effectiveConstantAngularSpeedDeg,
            local.X,
            local.Y,
            local.Z,
            target.X,
            target.Y,
            target.Z,
            adjustedTarget.X,
            adjustedTarget.Y,
            adjustedTarget.Z,
            error.X,
            error.Y,
            error.Z,
            error.Size());

        auto scaleCandidateStep = [&](const Vector3& candidate) {
            const Vector3 candidateDelta = candidate - local;
            return local + AimSmoothingDetail::ClampStepToError(candidateDelta * effectiveStepFactor, error);
        };

        auto normalizeReferenceCandidateStep = [&](const Vector3& candidate) {
            const float errorLength = error.Size();
            if (!std::isfinite(errorLength) || errorLength <= 0.000001f)
                return local;

            const Vector3 referenceDelta =
                AimSmoothingDetail::ClampStepToError(candidate - local, error);
            const float referenceFactor = std::clamp(
                referenceDelta.Size() / errorLength,
                0.0f,
                1.0f);
            if (!std::isfinite(referenceFactor) || referenceFactor <= 0.0f)
                return local;

            const float normalizedFactor =
                OW::AimSmoothingTiming::NormalizePerTickFactor(
                    referenceFactor,
                    deltaTime);
            return local + referenceDelta * (normalizedFactor / referenceFactor);
        };

        Vector3 result{};
        switch (method) {
        case 0:
            result = SmoothLinear(local, adjustedTarget, effectiveStepFactor);
            break;
        case 1:
            result = scaleCandidateStep(SmoothPID(local, adjustedTarget, deltaTime, methodPreset));
            break;
        case 2:
            result = SmoothBezier(local, adjustedTarget, deltaTime, effectiveBezierSpeed, methodPreset);
            break;
        case 3:
            result = normalizeReferenceCandidateStep(
                SmoothPiecewise(local, adjustedTarget, effectiveSpeed, methodPreset));
            break;
        case 4:
            result = normalizeReferenceCandidateStep(
                SmoothAccelerate(local, adjustedTarget, effectiveSpeed, effectiveAccel));
            break;
        case 5:
            result = SmoothConstantAngularVelocity(local, adjustedTarget, deltaTime, effectiveConstantAngularSpeedDeg);
            break;
        case 6: {
            AimHybrid::Tuning tuning{};
            tuning.p = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidP : Config::View_aimPidP();
            tuning.i = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidI : Config::View_aimPidI();
            tuning.d = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidD : Config::View_aimPidD();
            tuning.maxIntegral = methodPreset ? methodPreset->pidMaxIntegral : Config::View_aimPidMaxIntegral();
            tuning.deadzoneDeg = methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridDeadzoneDeg
                : Config::aimHybridDeadzoneDeg;
            const float hybridScale = std::clamp(slotSpeedScale * methodSpeedScale, 0.0f, 2.0f);
            tuning.constantSpeedDegPerSec = (methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridConstantSpeedDeg
                : Config::aimHybridConstantSpeedDeg) * hybridScale;
            tuning.maxSpeedDegPerSec = (methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridMaxSpeedDeg
                : Config::aimHybridMaxSpeedDeg) * hybridScale;
            tuning.accelerationDegPerSec2 = (methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridAccelerationDeg
                : Config::aimHybridAccelerationDeg) * (std::max)(0.05f, hybridScale);
            tuning.decelerationDegPerSec2 = (methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridDecelerationDeg
                : Config::aimHybridDecelerationDeg) * (std::max)(0.05f, hybridScale);
            tuning.nearRadiusDeg = methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridNearRadiusDeg
                : Config::aimHybridNearRadiusDeg;
            tuning.targetMotionGain = methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridTargetMotionGain
                : Config::aimHybridTargetMotionGain;
            tuning.suddenMotionBoost = methodPreset
                ? methodPreset->hybridSuddenMotionBoost
                : Config::aimHybridSuddenMotionBoost;
            const AimHybrid::StepResult hybrid = AimHybrid::Advance(
                local,
                adjustedTarget,
                deltaTime,
                tuning,
                AimSmoothingDetail::GetHybridState());
            Diagnostics::Aim(
                "smooth.hybrid speedDegS=%.3f targetSpeedDegS=%.3f targetAccelDegS2=%.3f accelLimitDegS2=%.3f reset=%d",
                hybrid.outputSpeedDegPerSec,
                hybrid.targetSpeedDegPerSec,
                hybrid.targetAccelerationDegPerSec2,
                hybrid.accelerationLimitDegPerSec2,
                hybrid.reset ? 1 : 0);
            result = hybrid.value;
            break;
        }
        case 7: {
            const koi::ShuwuConfig tuning=methodPreset?methodPreset->shuwu:koi::ShuwuConfig{};
            const auto move=AimShuwu::Advance(AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuState(),error.X,error.Y,
                deltaTime,slotSpeedScale*methodSpeedScale,Config::selectedAimSample,tuning);
            result=local+Vector3(float(move.pitch),float(move.yaw),0);
            break;
        }
        case 8: {
            const auto points=methodPreset?methodPreset->responseCurve:AimResponseCurve::Points{};
            const float fov=effectiveFovDeg>=0?effectiveFovDeg:Config::selectedAimFovDeg;
            const float factor=AimResponseCurve::StepFactor(error.Size(),DEG2RAD(fov),effectiveSpeed,deltaTime,points);
            result=local+error*factor;
            break;
        }
        case 9: {
            const auto move = AimKoi::Advance(AimSmoothingDetail::KoiState(),
                error.X, error.Y, deltaTime, slotSpeedScale * methodSpeedScale,
                Config::selectedAimSample);
            result = local + Vector3(static_cast<float>(move.pitch),
                static_cast<float>(move.yaw), 0.0f);
            break;
        }
        default:
            result = SmoothLinear(local, adjustedTarget, effectiveStepFactor);
            break;
        }

        const Vector3 outputDelta = result - local;
        if (commitOvershootStep && method != 6 && method != 7 && method != 8 && method != 9)
            AimSmoothingDetail::CommitOvershootStep(outputDelta);
        Diagnostics::Aim("smooth.result method=%d result=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) output_delta=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) output_len=%.9f",
            method,
            result.X,
            result.Y,
            result.Z,
            outputDelta.X,
            outputDelta.Y,
            outputDelta.Z,
            outputDelta.Size());
        return result;
    }

    void CommitAimMotionCommand(const Vector3& acceptedAngularCommand) {
        // Flick2nd and secondary aim may dispatch a different method than the Slot default.
        if(AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuDispatched())
            AimShuwu::CommitCommand(AimSmoothingDetail::ShuwuState(),acceptedAngularCommand.X,acceptedAngularCommand.Y);
    }

    void CommitAimSmoothingOutput(const Vector3& outputDelta) {
        AimSmoothingDetail::CommitOvershootStep(outputDelta);
    }

    Vector3 SmoothDispatch(Vector3 local, Vector3 target, float speed, float accel) {
        return SmoothDispatchWithMethod(
            local,
            target,
            speed,
            accel,
            Config::AimBehaviorMethod(Config::View_aimBehavior()),
            Config::View_aimBezierSpeed());
    }


}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
```

```hpp
namespace OW {
    namespace AimSmoothingDetail {

        constexpr float kDefaultDeltaTime = 1.0f / 144.0f;
        constexpr float kMinDeltaTime = 1.0f / 1000.0f;
        constexpr float kMaxDeltaTime = 0.1f;
        constexpr float kRetargetAngleThreshold = 2.0f;

        struct LinearState {
            Vector3 lastTarget{};
            bool initialized = false;
        };

            Vector3 integral{};
            Vector3 previousError{};
            Vector3 filteredDerivative{};
            Vector3 lastTarget{};
            bool initialized = false;
        };

            Vector3 lastTarget{};

            bool initialized = false;
        };

            Vector3 offset{};
            Vector3 lastTarget{};
            bool initialized = false;
        };

    }
```
