```cpp
        const float logHeight = (std::min)(260.0f, maxHeight);

        ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(
            ImVec2(viewportPos.x + viewportSize.x * 0.5f, viewportPos.y + viewportSize.y - 24.0f),
            ImGuiCond_Always,
            ImVec2(0.5f, 1.0f));
        ImGui::SetNextWindowBgAlpha(0.72f);

        const ImGuiWindowFlags flags =
            ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize |
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse |
            ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;

        if (ImGui::Begin("Diagnostic Log", nullptr, flags)) {
            ImGui::Text("Lines: %zu / %zu", lines.size(), Diagnostics::GetLogLineCapacity());
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button("Clear")) {
                Diagnostics::ClearLogLines();
                lines.clear();
            }

            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::BeginChild(
                "##DiagnosticLogLines",
                ImVec2(logWidth, logHeight),
                true,
                ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar);

            if (lines.empty()) {
                ImGui::TextDisabled("No diagnostics yet.");
            } else {
                for (const std::string& line : lines)
                    ImGui::TextUnformatted(line.c_str());
                ImGui::SetScrollHereY(1.0f);
            }

            ImGui::EndChild();
        }
        ImGui::End();
    }

    static DirectX::XMMATRIX ToDirectXMatrix(const OW::Matrix& matrix)
    {
        return DirectX::XMMATRIX(
            matrix.m11, matrix.m12, matrix.m13, matrix.m14,
            matrix.m21, matrix.m22, matrix.m23, matrix.m24,
            matrix.m31, matrix.m32, matrix.m33, matrix.m34,
            matrix.m41, matrix.m42, matrix.m43, matrix.m44);
    }

    static OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext BuildFovRuntimeContext(const OW::Matrix& viewMatrixXor)
    {
        const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 camera = viewMatrixXor.get_location();
        const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 forward = viewMatrixXor.get_rotation();

        OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext context{};
        context.camera = OW::Vector3(camera.x, camera.y, camera.z);
        context.forward = OW::TargetingDetail::NormalizeVector(
            OW::Vector3(forward.x, forward.y, forward.z));
        context.valid = OW::TargetingDetail::IsFiniteVector(context.camera) &&
                        !OW::TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(context.camera) &&
                        !OW::TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(context.forward);
        return context;
    }

    struct FovProjectionContext {
        DirectX::XMMATRIX inverseViewProjection{};
        float determinant = (std::numeric_limits<float>::quiet_NaN)();
        bool inverseFinite = false;
        bool valid = false;
    };

    static bool IsFiniteMatrix(const DirectX::XMMATRIX& matrix)
    {
        for (size_t rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < 4; ++rowIndex) {
            DirectX::XMFLOAT4 row{};
            DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(&row, matrix.r[rowIndex]);
            if (!std::isfinite(row.x) ||
                !std::isfinite(row.y) ||
                !std::isfinite(row.z) ||
                !std::isfinite(row.w)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static FovProjectionContext BuildFovProjectionContext(const OW::Matrix& viewProjection)
    {
        DirectX::XMVECTOR determinant{};
        const DirectX::XMMATRIX inverse = DirectX::XMMatrixInverse(
            &determinant,
            ToDirectXMatrix(viewProjection));
        const float det = DirectX::XMVectorGetX(determinant);

        FovProjectionContext context{};
        context.inverseViewProjection = inverse;
        context.determinant = det;
        context.inverseFinite = IsFiniteMatrix(inverse);
        context.valid = OW::FovGeometry::IsProjectionInverseUsable(
            context.determinant,
            context.inverseFinite);
        return context;
    }

    static bool ScreenWorldHomogeneousAtClipDepth(
        const FovProjectionContext& projection,
        float ndcX,
        float ndcY,
        float clipDepth,
        OW::FovGeometry::HomogeneousPoint& outPoint)
    {
        const DirectX::XMVECTOR clip = DirectX::XMVectorSet(ndcX, ndcY, clipDepth, 1.0f);
        const DirectX::XMVECTOR homogeneousWorld = DirectX::XMVector4Transform(
            clip,
            projection.inverseViewProjection);
        DirectX::XMFLOAT4 world{};
        DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(&world, homogeneousWorld);
        outPoint.xyz = OW::Vector3(world.x, world.y, world.z);
        outPoint.w = world.w;
        return OW::FovGeometry::IsFiniteHomogeneousPoint(outPoint);
    }

    static bool ScreenRayDirection(const FovProjectionContext& projection,
                                   const OW::Vector2& screen,
                                   float width,
                                   float height,
                                   const OW::Vector3& expectedForward,
                                   OW::Vector3& outDirection)
    {
        if (!projection.valid || width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
            return false;

        const float ndcX = (screen.X / width) * 2.0f - 1.0f;
        const float ndcY = 1.0f - (screen.Y / height) * 2.0f;

        OW::FovGeometry::HomogeneousPoint depthZero{};
        OW::FovGeometry::HomogeneousPoint depthOne{};
        if (!ScreenWorldHomogeneousAtClipDepth(
                projection, ndcX, ndcY, 0.0f, depthZero) ||
            !ScreenWorldHomogeneousAtClipDepth(
                projection, ndcX, ndcY, 1.0f, depthOne)) {
            return false;
        }

        return OW::FovGeometry::ResolveProjectionRay(
            depthZero,
            depthOne,
            expectedForward,
            outDirection);
    }

    static bool ScreenRayAngleDeg(const FovProjectionContext& projection,
                                  const OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext& context,
                                  const OW::Vector2& screen,
                                  float width,
                                  float height,
                                  float& outAngleDeg)
    {
        if (!context.valid)
            return false;

        OW::Vector3 direction{};
        if (!ScreenRayDirection(
                projection, screen, width, height, context.forward, direction)) {
            return false;
        }

        const float dot = std::clamp(context.forward | direction, -1.0f, 1.0f);
        outAngleDeg = RAD2DEG(std::acos(dot));
        return std::isfinite(outAngleDeg);
    }

    static OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionResult FovRadiusForViewport(
        float width,
        float height,
        float fovDeg,
        const FovProjectionContext& projection,
        const OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext& fovContext)
    {
        const float targetAngleDeg = OW::Config::FovCircleRenderAngleDeg(fovDeg);
        const float maxRadius = std::sqrt(width * width + height * height) * 0.5f;
        const OW::Vector2 center(width * 0.5f, height * 0.5f);
        return OW::FovGeometry::ResolveRingProjection(
            targetAngleDeg,
            maxRadius,
            [&](float radius, float& outAngleDeg) {
                return ScreenRayAngleDeg(
                    projection,
                    fovContext,
                    OW::Vector2(center.X + radius, center.Y),
                    width,
                    height,
                    outAngleDeg);
            });
    }

    static const char* RingProjectionStatusName(OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus status)
    {
        switch (status) {
        case OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::Drawable:
            return "drawable";
        case OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::OutsideViewport:
            return "outside_viewport";
        case OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::Unavailable:
        default:
            return "unavailable";
        }
    }

    struct FovRingProjectionDiagnosticState {
        bool observedInitialized = false;
        OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus observedStatus =
            OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::Unavailable;
        bool loggedInitialized = false;
        OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus loggedStatus =
            OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::Unavailable;
        DWORD lastLogTick = 0;
    };

    static void LogFovRingProjectionTransition(
        int diagnosticKey,
        float fovDeg,
        const FovProjectionContext& projection,
        const OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionResult& result)
    {
        constexpr int kDiagnosticStateCount = OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots + 1;
        if (diagnosticKey < 0 || diagnosticKey >= kDiagnosticStateCount)
            return;

        static FovRingProjectionDiagnosticState states[kDiagnosticStateCount]{};
        FovRingProjectionDiagnosticState& state = states[diagnosticKey];
        if (!state.observedInitialized || state.observedStatus != result.status) {
            state.observedInitialized = true;
            state.observedStatus = result.status;
        }
        if (state.loggedInitialized && state.loggedStatus == state.observedStatus)
            return;

        constexpr DWORD kMinimumLogIntervalMs = 1000;
        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        if (state.loggedInitialized && now - state.lastLogTick < kMinimumLogIntervalMs)
            return;

        state.loggedInitialized = true;
        state.loggedStatus = state.observedStatus;
        state.lastLogTick = now;
        const float targetAngleDeg = OW::Config::FovCircleRenderAngleDeg(fovDeg);
        const char* statusName = RingProjectionStatusName(result.status);
        if (result.status == OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionStatus::Unavailable) {
            Diagnostics::Warn(
                "FOV overlay projection key=%d status=%s targetDeg=%.3f radiusPx=%.2f centerDeg=%.3f edgeDeg=%.3f determinant=%.9g inverseFinite=%d.",
                diagnosticKey,
                statusName,
                targetAngleDeg,
                result.radius,
                result.centerAngleDeg,
                result.edgeAngleDeg,
                projection.determinant,
                projection.inverseFinite ? 1 : 0);
            return;
        }

        Diagnostics::Info(
            "FOV overlay projection key=%d status=%s targetDeg=%.3f radiusPx=%.2f centerDeg=%.3f edgeDeg=%.3f determinant=%.9g inverseFinite=%d.",
            diagnosticKey,
            statusName,
            targetAngleDeg,
            result.radius,
            result.centerAngleDeg,
            result.edgeAngleDeg,
            projection.determinant,
            projection.inverseFinite ? 1 : 0);
    }

    static void DrawDashedCircle(const OW::Vector2& center,
                                 float radius,
                                 const Render::Color& color,
                                 float thickness)
    {
        constexpr float kPi = 3.14159265358979323846f;
        constexpr int kSegments = 128;
        constexpr int kDashSegments = 3;
        constexpr int kGapSegments = 2;

        for (int start = 0; start < kSegments; start += kDashSegments + kGapSegments) {
            const int end = (std::min)(start + kDashSegments, kSegments);
            for (int segment = start; segment < end; ++segment) {
                const float a0 = (2.0f * kPi * static_cast<float>(segment)) / static_cast<float>(kSegments);
                const float a1 = (2.0f * kPi * static_cast<float>(segment + 1)) / static_cast<float>(kSegments);
                Render::DrawLine(
                    OW::Vector2(center.X + std::cos(a0) * radius, center.Y + std::sin(a0) * radius),
                    OW::Vector2(center.X + std::cos(a1) * radius, center.Y + std::sin(a1) * radius),
                    color,
                    thickness);
            }
        }
    }

    static bool DrawStyledFovRing(const OW::Vector2& center,
                                  float width,
                                  float height,
                                  float fovDeg,
                                  const FovProjectionContext& projection,
                                  const OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext& fovContext,
                                  const OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle& rawStyle,
                                  bool active,
                                  int diagnosticKey,
                                  const char* label)
    {
        OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle style = rawStyle;
        if (!style.visible)
            return false;

        const OW::FovGeometry::RingProjectionResult ringProjection =
            FovRadiusForViewport(width, height, fovDeg, projection, fovContext);
        LogFovRingProjectionTransition(diagnosticKey, fovDeg, projection, ringProjection);
        if (!ringProjection.IsDrawable())
            return false;
        const float radius = ringProjection.radius;

        const float thickness = active
            ? (std::max)(style.thickness + 0.8f, 2.0f)
            : style.thickness;
        const Render::Color color = ToRenderColor(style.color);
        if (style.lineStyle == 1)
            DrawDashedCircle(center, radius, color, thickness);
        else
            Render::DrawCircle(center, radius, color, 128, thickness);

        if (style.showLabel && label && *label) {
            constexpr float kPi = 3.14159265358979323846f;
            const float angle = -0.25f * kPi;
            const float labelX = std::clamp(center.X + std::cos(angle) * radius + 6.0f,
                                            4.0f,
                                            (std::max)(4.0f, width - 92.0f));
            const float labelY = std::clamp(center.Y + std::sin(angle) * radius - 7.0f,
                                            4.0f,
                                            (std::max)(4.0f, height - 18.0f));
            Render::DrawText(ImVec2(labelX, labelY), color.ToImU32(), label, active ? 14.0f : 13.0f);
        }

        return true;
    }

    static bool DrawHeroAimFovRings(uint64_t heroId,
                                    const OW::Vector2& center,
                                    float width,
                                    float height,
                                    const FovProjectionContext& projection,
                                    const OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext& fovContext,
                                    const OW::Config::RuntimeDrawFovState& activeState)
    {
        OW::Config::ScopedConfigRead configRead;
        bool drewAny = false;
        for (int slotIndex = 0; slotIndex < OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots; ++slotIndex) {
            OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset slot{};
            const bool found = OW::Config::TryGetHeroAimSlot(heroId, slotIndex, slot);
            if (!found || !slot.enabled)
                continue;

            const OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle style = OW::Config::ClampFovRingStyle(
                OW::Config::FovRingStyleFor(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim, slotIndex),
                OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim,
                slotIndex);
            const bool active = activeState.active &&
                activeState.slotKind == static_cast<int>(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim) &&
                activeState.slotIndex == slotIndex;
            const float ringFovDeg = active
                ? activeState.fovDeg
                : OW::Config::ResolveRuntimeHeroPresetFovForDistance(slot.preset, 0.0f);

            char label[32] = {};
            std::snprintf(label,
                          sizeof(label),
                          "A%d %.0f deg",
                          slotIndex + 1,
                          OW::Config::ClampFovDeg(ringFovDeg));
            drewAny |= DrawStyledFovRing(center,
                                         width,
                                         height,
                                         ringFovDeg,
                                         projection,
                                         fovContext,
                                         style,
                                         active,
                                         slotIndex,
                                         label);
        }
        return drewAny;
    }

    static bool DrawHeroTrackingDeadzoneRings(uint64_t heroId,
                                              const OW::Vector2& center)
    {
        if (!OW::Config::drawTrackingDeadzones)
            return false;

        bool drewAny = false;
        for (int slotIndex = 0; slotIndex < OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots; ++slotIndex) {
            OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset slot{};
            const bool found = OW::Config::TryGetHeroAimSlot(heroId, slotIndex, slot);
            if (!found || !slot.enabled ||
                !OW::Config::UsesTrackingDeadzone(slot.preset.aimBehavior)) {
                continue;
            }

            const float radius = OW::Config::ClampTrackingDeadzonePixels(slot.preset.trackingDeadzone);
            if (radius <= 0.0f)
                continue;

            const OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle style = OW::Config::ClampFovRingStyle(
                OW::Config::FovRingStyleFor(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim, slotIndex),
                OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim,
                slotIndex);
            DrawDashedCircle(center, radius, ToRenderColor(style.color), (std::max)(1.0f, style.thickness));
            drewAny = true;
        }
        return drewAny;
    }

    static void DrawFovCircle(const OW::c_entity& localSnapshot)
    {
        const float width = CanvasWidth();
        const float height = CanvasHeight();
        if (width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
            return;

        const OW::Vector2 center(width * 0.5f, height * 0.5f);
        OW::Matrix renderViewMatrix{}, renderViewMatrixXor{};
        OW::GetViewMatricesSnapshot(renderViewMatrix, renderViewMatrixXor);
        const FovProjectionContext projection = BuildFovProjectionContext(renderViewMatrix);
        const OW::TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext fovContext =
            BuildFovRuntimeContext(renderViewMatrixXor);

        // Skill circles have their own switch and do not enable the global Aim circle.
        int skillDiagnosticKey = 1000;
        for (const auto& definition : OW::AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
            ++skillDiagnosticKey;
            if (!OW::IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, localSnapshot.HeroID) ||
                !(definition.controls & OW::HeroSkillControls::TrackingOverlay)) continue;
            const auto settings = OW::Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(localSnapshot.HeroID, definition.skillId, definition.defaultSettings);
            if (!settings.enabled || !settings.drawSkillFov) continue;
            OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle style{};
            style.visible = true;
            style.color = settings.skillFovColor;
            style.thickness = 1.5f;
            style.showLabel = false;
            DrawStyledFovRing(center, width, height, settings.tracking.fov, projection, fovContext,
                             style, false, skillDiagnosticKey, nullptr);
        }
        if (!OW::Config::draw_fov) return;
        const OW::Config::RuntimeDrawFovState activeState = OW::Config::SnapshotRuntimeDrawFov();
        bool drewAny = false;
        if (localSnapshot.HeroID != 0) {
            drewAny |= DrawHeroAimFovRings(localSnapshot.HeroID,
                                           center,
                                           width,
                                           height,
                                           projection,
                                           fovContext,
                                           activeState);
        }
        if (drewAny)
            return;

        OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle fallbackStyle{};
        fallbackStyle.visible = true;
        fallbackStyle.color = OW::Config::fovcol;
        fallbackStyle.thickness = 1.5f;
        fallbackStyle.lineStyle = 0;
        fallbackStyle.showLabel = false;
        DrawStyledFovRing(center,
                          width,
                          height,
                          OW::Config::RuntimeDrawFovOrDefault(OW::Config::View_Fov()),
                          projection,
                          fovContext,
                          fallbackStyle,
                          false,
                          OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots,
                          nullptr);
    }

    static void DrawTrackingDeadzoneCircles(const OW::c_entity& localSnapshot)
    {
        if (!OW::Config::drawTrackingDeadzones)
            return;

        const float width = CanvasWidth();
        const float height = CanvasHeight();
        if (width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
            return;

        if (localSnapshot.HeroID == 0)
            return;

        const OW::Vector2 center(width * 0.5f, height * 0.5f);
        DrawHeroTrackingDeadzoneRings(localSnapshot.HeroID, center);
    }

    static void DrawCrosshair()
    {
        if (!OW::Config::crosscircle)
            return;

        const float width = CanvasWidth();
        const float height = CanvasHeight();
        if (width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
            return;

        const auto settings=V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot();
        const auto& crosshair=settings->display.crosshair;
        const float centerX=width*.5f+crosshair.offsetX,centerY=height*.5f+crosshair.offsetY;
        auto drawPass=[&](const ImVec4& color,float thickness,float expand){
            const Render::Color renderColor=ToRenderColor(color);
            V2::VisualSettings::ForEachCrosshairPrimitive(crosshair,centerX,centerY,[&](const V2::VisualSettings::CrosshairPrimitive& primitive){
                if(primitive.kind==V2::VisualSettings::CrosshairPrimitiveKind::Line)
                    Render::DrawLine(OW::Vector2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),OW::Vector2(primitive.x2,primitive.y2),renderColor,thickness);
                else if(primitive.filled)
                    Render::DrawFilledCircle(OW::Vector2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),primitive.radius+expand,renderColor,48);
                else
                    Render::DrawCircle(OW::Vector2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),primitive.radius,renderColor,48,thickness);
            });
        };
        if(crosshair.outline&&crosshair.outlineThickness>0)drawPass(crosshair.outlineColor,crosshair.thickness+2*crosshair.outlineThickness,crosshair.outlineThickness);
        drawPass(crosshair.color,crosshair.thickness,0);
    }

    static void DrawRadar(const std::vector<OW::c_entity>& entitySnapshot,
                          const OW::c_entity& localSnapshot)
    {
        if (!OW::Config::radar)
            return;

        if (entitySnapshot.empty() || localSnapshot.PlayerHealth <= 0.0f)
            return;

        const float width = CanvasWidth();
        const float height = CanvasHeight();
        if (width <= 0.0f || height <= 0.0f)
            return;

        const auto visual=V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot();
        const auto& radar=visual->display.radar;
        const float radius=(std::min)(radar.radius,(std::min)(width,height)*.5f-2);
        const float centerX = radius + OW::OverlayStatus::Position(OW::Config::radarPosX,width,2*radius);
        const float centerY = radius + OW::OverlayStatus::Position(OW::Config::radarPosY,height,2*radius);
        const OW::Vector2 center(centerX, centerY);
        const Render::Color border(170, 180, 192, 110);
        const Render::Color background(18,20,25,int(radar.backgroundAlpha*255));

        Render::DrawFilledCircle(center, radius, background, 72);
        Render::DrawCircle(center, radius, border, 72, 1.0f);
        Render::DrawLine(OW::Vector2(center.X - radius, center.Y), OW::Vector2(center.X + radius, center.Y), Render::Color(255, 255, 255, 55), 1.0f);
        Render::DrawLine(OW::Vector2(center.X, center.Y - radius), OW::Vector2(center.X, center.Y + radius), Render::Color(255, 255, 255, 55), 1.0f);
        Render::DrawFilledCircle(center, 3.0f, Render::Color(120, 255, 120, 220), 20);

        OW::Matrix renderViewMatrix{}, renderViewMatrixXor{};
        OW::GetViewMatricesSnapshot(renderViewMatrix, renderViewMatrixXor);
        DirectX::XMFLOAT3 forward = renderViewMatrixXor.get_rotation();
        const float yaw = static_cast<float>(radar.rotate?std::atan2(forward.x,forward.z):0.f);
        const float cosYaw = std::cos(yaw);
        const float sinYaw = std::sin(yaw);
        const float scale=radius/radar.rangeM;

        for (size_t index = 0; index < entitySnapshot.size(); ++index) {
            const OW::c_entity& entity = entitySnapshot[index];
            if (!entity.team_known || !entity.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(),OW::EntitySceneGeneration()) ||
                !localSnapshot.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(),OW::EntitySceneGeneration()) || entity.address == localSnapshot.address)
                continue;

            if(!radar.allies&&!entity.Team)continue;
            const float dx = entity.pos.X - localSnapshot.pos.X;
            const float dz = entity.pos.Z - localSnapshot.pos.Z;
            float rx = (dx * cosYaw - dz * sinYaw) * scale;
            float rz = -(dx * sinYaw + dz * cosYaw) * scale;

            const float len = std::sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz);
            const float maxLen = (std::max)(0.0f, radius-radar.markerSize*.5f-2);
            if (len > maxLen && len > 0.001f) {
                const float k = maxLen / len;
                rx *= k;
                rz *= k;
            }

            const OW::Vector2 point(center.X + rx, center.Y + rz);
            const Render::Color entityColor=ToRenderColor(entity.Team?radar.enemy:radar.ally);
            if (OW::Config::radarline)
                Render::DrawLine(center, point, Render::Color(entityColor.R, entityColor.G, entityColor.B, 90), 1.0f);
            const ImU32 markerColor=ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(entity.Team?radar.enemy:radar.ally);
            DrawHeroRadarMarker(entity, point.X, point.Y, markerColor,radar.markerSize/18.f);
        }
    }

    static void DrawWorldObjectIcon(int type, const ImVec2& center, float size, ImU32 color) {
        auto* draw=ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
        const auto& objectType=V2::WorldObjects::kObjects[type];
        if(objectType.group==V2::WorldObjects::Group::Health) {
            const float arm=size*.4f,bar=(std::max)(1.f,size*.13f);
            draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(center.x-arm,center.y-bar),ImVec2(center.x+arm,center.y+bar),color);
            draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(center.x-bar,center.y-arm),ImVec2(center.x+bar,center.y+arm),color);
            return;
        }
        if(objectType.iconHero[0] && objectType.iconName[0]) {
            if(auto* manager=Render::GetIconManager()) {
                const std::string key=std::string(objectType.iconHero)+"/"+objectType.iconName;
                auto* texture=manager->GetIcon(key);
                if(!texture) {
                    manager->LoadAbilityIcons(objectType.iconHero,{objectType.iconName});
                    texture=manager->GetIcon(key);
                }
                if(texture) {
                    Render::DrawIcon(texture,ImVec2(center.x-size*.5f,center.y-size*.5f),ImVec2(size,size),color);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        const float radius=(std::max)(3.f,size*.3f);
        const ImVec2 corners[]{ImVec2(center.x,center.y-radius),ImVec2(center.x+radius,center.y),
            ImVec2(center.x,center.y+radius),ImVec2(center.x-radius,center.y)};
        draw->AddPolyline(corners,4,color,ImDrawFlags_Closed,1.5f);
    }

    static void DrawHealthPacks(const std::vector<OW::hpanddy>& objects) {
        const auto settings=V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot();const auto& world=settings->display.world;
        if(!world.enabled)return;
        OW::Matrix view{},camera{};OW::GetViewMatricesSnapshot(view,camera);
        const auto local=OW::SnapshotLocalEntity();const uint32_t now=GetTickCount();
        for(const auto& object:objects) {
            const int type=V2::VisualSettings::ObjectIndex(object.entityid);
            if(type<0||!world.types[type]||object.scene_generation!=OW::EntitySceneGeneration()||
                !object.position_tick_ms||uint32_t(now-object.position_tick_ms)>200)continue;
            const auto& objectType=V2::WorldObjects::kObjects[type];
            using V2::WorldObjects::Group;
            if((objectType.group==Group::Deployable&&!world.deployables)||
                (objectType.group==Group::Projectile&&!world.projectiles))continue;
            const bool statusFresh=object.status_tick_ms&&uint32_t(now-object.status_tick_ms)<=200;
            if(world.hideTeam&&objectType.group!=Group::Health&&statusFresh&&object.team_known&&
                local.team_known&&object.team_key&&object.team_key!=(1u<<0x1B)&&object.team_key==local.team_key)continue;
            const OW::Vector3 position(object.POS.x,object.POS.y,object.POS.z);
            const float distance=local.pos.DistTo(position);
            if(world.maxDistance>0&&distance>world.maxDistance)continue;
            OW::Vector2 screen{};if(!view.WorldToScreen(position,&screen,OW::Vector2(CanvasWidth(),CanvasHeight())))continue;
            const auto color=ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(world.colors[type]);auto* draw=ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
            if(world.box)draw->AddRect(ImVec2(screen.X-world.iconSize*.5f,screen.Y-world.iconSize*.5f),ImVec2(screen.X+world.iconSize*.5f,screen.Y+world.iconSize*.5f),color,2,0,1.5f);
            if(world.icon)DrawWorldObjectIcon(type,ImVec2(screen.X,screen.Y),world.iconSize,color);
            std::string label=world.name?UI::UiLabel(objectType.name,OW::Config::uiLanguage==1):"";
            if(world.distance)label+=(label.empty()?"":" ")+std::to_string(int(distance))+" m";
            const bool healthFresh=statusFresh&&object.health_known&&std::isfinite(object.health)&&
                std::isfinite(object.health_max)&&object.health>=0&&object.health_max>0;
            if(world.healthText&&healthFresh) {
                char healthText[48]{};std::snprintf(healthText,sizeof(healthText),"%.0f / %.0f",object.health,object.health_max);
                label+=(label.empty()?"":" ")+std::string(healthText);
            }
            if(!label.empty())Render::DrawStrokeText(ImVec2(screen.X+(world.icon||world.box?world.iconSize*.5f+5:0),screen.Y-world.size*.5f),color,label.c_str(),world.size);
            if(world.health&&healthFresh) {
                const float width=(std::max)(24.f,world.iconSize),left=screen.X-width*.5f;
                const float top=screen.Y+(world.icon||world.box?world.iconSize*.5f:world.size*.5f)+4;
                draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(left-1,top-1),ImVec2(left+width+1,top+4),IM_COL32(0,0,0,190),1);
                draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(left,top),ImVec2(left+width*std::clamp(object.health/object.health_max,0.f,1.f),top+3),color);
            }
        }
    }



} // namespace

void V2::Visuals::DrawFrame()
{
    Diagnostics::RecordFrame();
    const bool boxPerfMode = OW::Config::boxPerfMode;
    Diagnostics::BeginRenderWorkloadFrame(boxPerfMode);

    // The menu is rendered by the separate overlay menu window. This callback
    // only draws the transparent full-screen canvas layer.
    OW::ScopedConsumptionFrame frameScope;
    const auto& frame=frameScope.Get();
    const bool entityListEmpty=frame.entities.empty();
    bool playerInfoCalled=false, skillInfoCalled=false;
    std::vector<OW::c_entity> presented;
    if(OW::PresentUseForRenderEnabled())presented=OW::TargetingDetail::SnapshotPresentRenderEntities();
    auto frameEntitySnapshot = [&]() -> const std::vector<OW::c_entity>& { return presented.empty()?frame.entities:presented; };
    auto frameDynamicEntitySnapshot = [&]() -> const std::vector<OW::hpanddy>& { return frame.dynamic; };
    auto frameLocalSnapshot = [&]() -> const OW::c_entity& { return frame.local; };

    if (boxPerfMode) {
        if (!entityListEmpty) {
            playerInfoCalled = true;
            PlayerInfoFromSnapshot(frameEntitySnapshot(), frameLocalSnapshot(), true);
        } else {
            Diagnostics::PlayerInfoStats emptyPlayerInfoStats{};
            emptyPlayerInfoStats.boxPerfMode = true;
            emptyPlayerInfoStats.fastBoxPath = OW::Config::boxPerfFastRect;
            Diagnostics::SetPlayerInfoStats(emptyPlayerInfoStats);
        }

        Diagnostics::SetRenderPipelineStatus(false, playerInfoCalled, false, entityListEmpty);
        return;
    }

    const bool viewMatricesFresh = OW::HasFreshViewMatrices();
    if (!entityListEmpty && viewMatricesFresh && OW::Config::radar)
        DrawRadar(frameEntitySnapshot(), frameLocalSnapshot());

    if (!entityListEmpty) {
        playerInfoCalled = true;
        PlayerInfoFromSnapshot(frameEntitySnapshot(), frameLocalSnapshot(), false);
        if (OW::Config::ult || (OW::Config::skillinfo && OW::Config::skillDisplayMode != 0)) {
            skillInfoCalled = true;
            skillinfo(frameEntitySnapshot());
        }
    } else {
        Diagnostics::PlayerInfoStats emptyPlayerInfoStats{};
        Diagnostics::SetPlayerInfoStats(emptyPlayerInfoStats);
    }

    DrawAimTriggerStatusPanel();
    DrawOverlayInfo(frameEntitySnapshot(), frameDynamicEntitySnapshot().size());
    if (viewMatricesFresh && V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot()->display.world.enabled)
        DrawHealthPacks(frameDynamicEntitySnapshot());
    DrawFovCircle(frameLocalSnapshot());
    if (OW::Config::drawTrackingDeadzones)
        DrawTrackingDeadzoneCircles(frameLocalSnapshot());
    DrawCrosshair();
    Diagnostics::SetRenderPipelineStatus(true, playerInfoCalled, skillInfoCalled, entityListEmpty);

    static DWORD lastRenderPipelineLogTick = 0;
    if (OW::Config::outputDebugLog) {
        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        if (lastRenderPipelineLogTick == 0 || now - lastRenderPipelineLogTick >= 1000) {
            Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 5 render callback mode=normal DrawRadar=1 PlayerInfo=%d skillinfo=%d entities_empty=%d.",
                playerInfoCalled ? 1 : 0,
                skillInfoCalled ? 1 : 0,
                entityListEmpty ? 1 : 0);
            lastRenderPipelineLogTick = now;
        }
    }
    DrawPipelineDiagnostics();
    DrawDiagnosticLogOverlay();
}
```

```inl
    std::vector<AimTriggerStatusRow> BuildAimTriggerStatusRowsForHero(uint64_t heroId) {
        OW::Config::ScopedConfigRead configRead;
        std::vector<AimTriggerStatusRow> rows{{"Slot", IM_COL32(230,235,245,245), 12.0f}};
        constexpr const char* behaviors[] = {"Tracking", "Flick", "Flick2nd", "Reacquire", "Magnetic Trigger"};
        auto keyName = [](int key) -> const char* {
            switch (OW::Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(key)) {
            case VK_LBUTTON: return "LMB";
            case VK_RBUTTON: return "RMB";
            case VK_XBUTTON1: return "M4";
            case VK_XBUTTON2: return "M5";
            default: return OW::Labels::AimActivationKeyName(key);
            }
        };
        auto append = [&](const char* behavior, int key, int index, bool enabled, bool always = false) {
            const int vk = OW::Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(key);
            const bool held = enabled && (always || (vk > 0 && KeyState::IsKeyDown(vk)));
            char line[160]{};
            std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "%s  [%s]  Slot %d", behavior,
                always ? "Always" : keyName(key), index + 1);
            rows.push_back({line, held ? IM_COL32(90,235,105,255) : enabled ?
                IM_COL32(230,235,245,235) : IM_COL32(155,162,176,160), 11.5f});
        };
        for (int i = 0; i < OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots; ++i) {
            OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset slot{};
            if (OW::Config::TryGetHeroAimSlot(heroId, i, slot)) {
                append(behaviors[OW::Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(slot.preset.aimBehavior)],
                    slot.preset.key, i, slot.enabled);
            }
            if (OW::Config::TryGetHeroTriggerSlot(heroId, i, slot)) {
                append("Trigger", slot.preset.trigger.key, i,
                    slot.enabled && slot.preset.trigger.enabled, slot.preset.trigger.mode == 2);
            }
        }
        if (OW::Config::secondaim) append(OW::Config::Flick2 ? "Flick" : "Tracking", OW::Config::aim_key2, 1, true);
        if (OW::Config::View_triggerbot2()) append("Trigger", OW::Config::triggerbotKey2, 1, true, OW::Config::triggerbotMode2 == 2);
        if (rows.size() == 1) rows.push_back({heroId ? "No configured slots" : "Waiting for local player", IM_COL32(176,184,196,200), 11.5f});
        return rows;
    }

    float AimTriggerStatusPanelHeight(const std::vector<AimTriggerStatusRow>& rows) {
        float height = 0;
        for (const auto& row : rows) height += row.fontSize + 3;
        return height;
    }

    float DrawAimTriggerStatusPanel() {
        if (!OW::Config::showSlotStatus) return 0;
        const auto rows = BuildAimTriggerStatusRowsForHero(OW::SnapshotLocalHeroIdForStatus());
        float width = 0;
        for (const auto& row : rows) width = (std::max)(width,
            ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(row.fontSize,FLT_MAX,0,row.text.c_str()).x);
        const float x = OW::OverlayStatus::Position(OW::Config::slotPosX, OW::WX, width);
        float y = OW::OverlayStatus::Position(OW::Config::slotPosY, OW::WY, AimTriggerStatusPanelHeight(rows));
        for (const auto& row : rows) {
            Render::DrawText(ImVec2(x,y), row.color, row.text.c_str(), row.fontSize);
            y += row.fontSize + 3;
        }
        return y;
    }
```

`src/Game/HeroGeometrySpec.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Game/HeroGeometrySpec.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>

constexpr HeroGeometrySpec kFallbackGeometry{
    0,
    "fallback",
    kFallbackBones.data(),

bool IsZeroOffset(const Vector3& value)
{
    return value.X == 0.0f && value.Y == 0.0f && value.Z == 0.0f;
}

bool IsFiniteVector(const Vector3& value)
{
    return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
}

bool NativeHitboxSampleUsable(const c_entity& entity, uint32_t now)
{
    const auto& sample = entity.native_hitboxes;
    return sample.Matches(entity.VelocityBase, entity.skeleton_revision) &&
        PresentationTiming::Fresh(sample.tick, now);
}

float Dot(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
{
    return a.X * b.X + a.Y * b.Y + a.Z * b.Z;
}

float RayAxisDistanceSquared(const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b, const Vector3& unitRay)
{
    const auto distanceToRay = [&](const Vector3& point) {
        const auto perpendicular = point - unitRay * (std::max)(0.0f, Dot(point, unitRay));
        return Dot(perpendicular, perpendicular);
    };
    const Vector3 axis = b - a;
    const float axisLengthSquared = Dot(axis, axis);
    if (axisLengthSquared <= 0.00000001f)
        return distanceToRay(a);

    const float closestToOrigin = std::clamp(-Dot(a, axis) / axisLengthSquared, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    float distance = (std::min)({distanceToRay(a), distanceToRay(b),
        distanceToRay(a + axis * closestToOrigin)});
    const Vector3 projectedAxis = axis - unitRay * Dot(axis, unitRay);
    const float projectedLengthSquared = Dot(projectedAxis, projectedAxis);
    if (projectedLengthSquared > 0.00000001f) {
        const float closestOnAxis = std::clamp(-Dot(a, projectedAxis) / projectedLengthSquared, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        distance = (std::min)(distance, distanceToRay(a + axis * closestOnAxis));
    }
    return distance;
}

float DistanceSquaredPointSegment(const Vector3& point, const Vector3& a, const Vector3& b)
{
    const Vector3 axis = b - a;
    const float lengthSquared = Dot(axis, axis);
    if (lengthSquared <= 0.00000001f)
        return point.DistTo(a) * point.DistTo(a);
    const float t = std::clamp(Dot(point - a, axis) / lengthSquared, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    const Vector3 closest = a + axis * t;
    const Vector3 delta = point - closest;
    return Dot(delta, delta);
}

float DistanceSquaredSegmentSegment(const Vector3& p1, const Vector3& q1,
                                    const Vector3& p2, const Vector3& q2)
{
    const Vector3 d1 = q1 - p1;
    const Vector3 d2 = q2 - p2;
    const Vector3 r = p1 - p2;
    const float a = Dot(d1, d1);
    const float e = Dot(d2, d2);
    const float f = Dot(d2, r);
    float s = 0.0f;
    float t = 0.0f;
    constexpr float epsilon = 0.00000001f;
    if (a <= epsilon && e <= epsilon)
        return Dot(r, r);
    if (a <= epsilon) {
        s = 0.0f;
        t = std::clamp(f / e, 0.0f, 1.0f);
    } else {
        const float c = Dot(d1, r);
        if (e <= epsilon) {
            t = 0.0f;
            s = std::clamp(-c / a, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        } else {
            const float b = Dot(d1, d2);
            const float denominator = a * e - b * b;
            if (denominator != 0.0f)
                s = std::clamp((b * f - c * e) / denominator, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            t = (b * s + f) / e;
            if (t < 0.0f) {
                t = 0.0f;
                s = std::clamp(-c / a, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            } else if (t > 1.0f) {
                t = 1.0f;
                s = std::clamp((b - c) / a, 0.0f, 1.0f);
            }
        }
    }
    const Vector3 delta = r + d1 * s - d2 * t;
    return Dot(delta, delta);
}

Vector3 TrajectoryPosition(const ProjectileTrajectory& trajectory, float time)
{
    return trajectory.origin + (trajectory.initialVelocity - trajectory.targetVelocity) * time +
        trajectory.acceleration * (0.5f * time * time);
}

bool ContinuousTrajectoryIntersectsHitboxInternal(const ProjectileTrajectory& trajectory,
                                          const HitboxSegment& hitbox,
                                          float projectileRadius,
                                          float* hitTimeSeconds)
{
    if (hitTimeSeconds)
        *hitTimeSeconds = 0.0f;
    if (!IsFiniteVector(trajectory.origin) || !IsFiniteVector(trajectory.initialVelocity) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(trajectory.acceleration) || !IsFiniteVector(hitbox.a) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(hitbox.b) || !std::isfinite(hitbox.radius) || hitbox.radius <= 0.0f ||
        !std::isfinite(projectileRadius) || projectileRadius < 0.0f ||
        !std::isfinite(trajectory.maxTimeSeconds) || trajectory.maxTimeSeconds <= 0.0f)
        return false;

    const float radius = hitbox.radius + projectileRadius;
    const float radiusSquared = radius * radius;
    const float accelerationMagnitude = trajectory.acceleration.Size();
    constexpr int maxDepth = 18;
    constexpr float minimumInterval = 1.0f / 4096.0f;
    const auto distanceToAxisSquared = [&](const Vector3& point) {
        return DistanceSquaredPointSegment(point, hitbox.a, hitbox.b);
    };
    const auto search = [&](const auto& self, float start, float end, int depth) -> bool {
        const Vector3 startPoint = TrajectoryPosition(trajectory, start);
        const Vector3 endPoint = TrajectoryPosition(trajectory, end);
        if (distanceToAxisSquared(startPoint) <= radiusSquared) {
            if (hitTimeSeconds) *hitTimeSeconds = start;
            return true;
        }
        if (distanceToAxisSquared(endPoint) <= radiusSquared) {
            if (hitTimeSeconds) *hitTimeSeconds = end;
            return true;
        }

        const float chordDistanceSquared = DistanceSquaredSegmentSegment(
            startPoint, endPoint, hitbox.a, hitbox.b);
        const float interval = end - start;
        const float curveDeviation = accelerationMagnitude * interval * interval * 0.125f;
        const float lowerDistance = std::sqrt((std::max)(0.0f, chordDistanceSquared)) - curveDeviation;
        if (lowerDistance > radius)
            return false;

        const float middle = (start + end) * 0.5f;
        const Vector3 middlePoint = TrajectoryPosition(trajectory, middle);
        if (distanceToAxisSquared(middlePoint) <= radiusSquared) {
            if (hitTimeSeconds) *hitTimeSeconds = middle;
            return true;
        }
        if (depth >= maxDepth || interval <= minimumInterval)
            return false;
        return self(self, start, middle, depth + 1) || self(self, middle, end, depth + 1);
    };
    return search(search, 0.0f, trajectory.maxTimeSeconds, 0);
}

Vector3 NativeShapeCenter(const c_entity& entity,
                          const ModelShapes::Shape& shape,
                          const ModelShapes::Pose& pose)
{
    const Vector3 local = shape.a + (shape.b - shape.a) * 0.5f;
    return entity.native_hitboxes.world.TransformPoint(ModelShapes::Transform(local, pose)) +
        (entity.pos - entity.native_hitboxes.world.sampleAnchor);
}

Vector3 NativeBoneReference(const c_entity& entity, int boneId)
{
    switch (boneId) {
    case BONE_HEAD: return entity.head_pos;
    case BONE_NECK: return entity.neck_pos;
    case BONE_CHEST: return entity.chest_pos;
    default: return entity.pos;
    }
}

} // namespace

bool ContinuousTrajectoryIntersectsHitbox(const ProjectileTrajectory& trajectory,
                                          const HitboxSegment& hitbox,
                                          float projectileRadius,
                                          float* hitTimeSeconds)
{
    return ContinuousTrajectoryIntersectsHitboxInternal(
        trajectory, hitbox, projectileRadius, hitTimeSeconds);
}

const HeroGeometrySpec* ResolveHeroGeometrySpec(uint64_t heroId)
{
    (void)heroId;
    return &kFallbackGeometry;
}

const BoneHitboxSpec* ResolveBoneHitboxSpec(uint64_t heroId, int boneId)
{
    const HeroGeometrySpec* geometry = ResolveHeroGeometrySpec(heroId);
    if (!geometry || !geometry->bones || geometry->boneCount <= 0)
        return nullptr;

    for (int index = 0; index < geometry->boneCount; ++index) {
        const BoneHitboxSpec& bone = geometry->bones[index];
        if (bone.boneId == boneId)
            return &bone;
    }

    return nullptr;
}

float ResolveBoneHitboxRadius(uint64_t heroId, int boneId, float fallbackRadius)
{
    const BoneHitboxSpec* spec = ResolveBoneHitboxSpec(heroId, boneId);
    if (spec && spec->radiusWorld > 0.0f)
        return spec->radiusWorld;
    return (std::max)(0.0f, fallbackRadius);
}

float ResolveEffectiveHitWindow(uint64_t heroId,
                                int boneId,
                                const WeaponSpec* weapon,
                                float hitboxScalePercent,
                                float fallbackBoneRadius,
                                float projectileRadiusOverride)
{
    const float boneRadius = ResolveBoneHitboxRadius(heroId, boneId, fallbackBoneRadius);
    const float projectileRadius = projectileRadiusOverride >= 0.0f
        ? (std::max)(0.0f, projectileRadiusOverride)
        : (weapon ? (std::max)(0.0f, weapon->projectile.projectileRadius) : 0.0f);
    const float resolvedWindow = (std::max)(0.0f, boneRadius + projectileRadius);
    return resolvedWindow * Config::HitboxScaleMultiplier(hitboxScalePercent);
}

float ResolveEffectiveHitWindow(const c_entity& entity,
                                int boneId,
                                const WeaponSpec* weapon,
                                float hitboxScalePercent,
                                float fallbackBoneRadius,
                                float projectileRadiusOverride)
{
    float boneRadius = ResolveBoneHitboxRadius(entity.HeroID, boneId, fallbackBoneRadius);
    if (NativeHitboxSampleUsable(entity, GetTickCount())) {
        const Vector3 reference = NativeBoneReference(entity, boneId);
        float nearestDistance = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        float nativeRadius = 0.0f;
        for (size_t index = 0; index < entity.native_hitboxes.shapes.size(); ++index) {
            const auto& shape = entity.native_hitboxes.shapes[index];
            if (shape.boneId != boneId || index >= entity.native_hitboxes.poses.size())
                continue;
            const Vector3 center = NativeShapeCenter(entity, shape, entity.native_hitboxes.poses[index]);
            const float distance = IsFiniteVector(reference) && IsFiniteVector(center)
                ? reference.DistTo(center) : (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
            if (distance < nearestDistance) {
                nearestDistance = distance;
                nativeRadius = shape.radius;
            }
        }
        if (nativeRadius > 0.0f && std::isfinite(nativeRadius))
            boneRadius = nativeRadius;
    }
    const float projectileRadius = projectileRadiusOverride >= 0.0f
        ? (std::max)(0.0f, projectileRadiusOverride)
        : (weapon ? (std::max)(0.0f, weapon->projectile.projectileRadius) : 0.0f);
    return (std::max)(0.0f, boneRadius + projectileRadius) *
        Config::HitboxScaleMultiplier(hitboxScalePercent);
}

int AimBoneToSkeletonBoneId(int aimBone)
{
    switch (aimBone) {
    case Config::kAimBoneHead:
        return BONE_HEAD;
    case Config::kAimBoneNeck:
        return BONE_NECK;
    case Config::kAimBoneChest:
    case Config::kAimBoneClosest:
    default:
        return BONE_CHEST;
    }
}

bool IsCoreHitboxBoneId(int boneId)
{
    return boneId == BONE_HEAD || boneId == BONE_NECK || boneId == BONE_CHEST;
}

Vector3 ResolveBoneHitboxOffsetLocal(uint64_t heroId, int boneId)
{
    const BoneHitboxSpec* spec = ResolveBoneHitboxSpec(heroId, boneId);
    return spec ? spec->centerOffsetLocal : Vector3{};
}

Vector3 ResolveBoneHitboxCenter(const c_entity& entity, int boneId, const Vector3& bonePoint)
{
    const Vector3 offset = ResolveBoneHitboxOffsetLocal(entity.HeroID, boneId);
    if (IsZeroOffset(offset) || !IsFiniteVector(bonePoint))
        return bonePoint;

    XMFLOAT3 localOffset(offset.X, offset.Y, offset.Z);
    XMFLOAT3 rotatedOffset{};
    const XMMATRIX rotMatrix = XMMatrixRotationY(entity.Rot.X);
    XMStoreFloat3(
        &rotatedOffset,
        XMVector3Transform(XMLoadFloat3(&localOffset), rotMatrix));
    return bonePoint + Vector3(rotatedOffset.x, rotatedOffset.y, rotatedOffset.z);
}

bool TryResolveNativeHitboxCenter(const c_entity& entity, int boneId, Vector3& outPoint)
{
    outPoint = {};
    if (!NativeHitboxSampleUsable(entity, GetTickCount()))
        return false;
    const Vector3 reference = NativeBoneReference(entity, boneId);
    float nearestDistance = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
    for (size_t index = 0; index < entity.native_hitboxes.shapes.size(); ++index) {
        const auto& shape = entity.native_hitboxes.shapes[index];
        if (shape.boneId != boneId || index >= entity.native_hitboxes.poses.size())
            continue;
        const auto& pose = entity.native_hitboxes.poses[index];
        const Vector3 center = NativeShapeCenter(entity, shape, pose);
        const float distance = IsFiniteVector(reference) && IsFiniteVector(center)
            ? reference.DistTo(center) : (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        if (distance < nearestDistance) {
            nearestDistance = distance;
            outPoint = center;
        }
    }
    return nearestDistance != (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)() &&
        IsFiniteVector(outPoint) && !IsZeroOffset(outPoint);
}

std::optional<float> NativeHitWindowScore(const c_entity& entity, int boneId, uint32_t now,
    const Vector3& origin, const Vector3& direction, const Vector3& predictedDisplacement,
    float projectileRadius, float hitboxScalePercent)
{
    if (!NativeHitboxSampleUsable(entity, now) || !IsFiniteVector(origin) ||
        !IsFiniteVector(direction) || !IsFiniteVector(predictedDisplacement) ||
        !std::isfinite(projectileRadius) || !std::isfinite(hitboxScalePercent))
        return std::nullopt;
    const float rayLength = direction.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(rayLength))
        return std::nullopt;

    const auto& sample = entity.native_hitboxes;
    const Vector3 unitRay = rayLength > 0.0001f ? direction / rayLength : Vector3{};
    const Vector3 relativeAnchor = entity.pos - sample.world.sampleAnchor + predictedDisplacement - origin;
    const float worldScale = (std::min)({sample.world.record.scale[0], sample.world.record.scale[1],
        sample.world.record.scale[2]});
    const float hitboxScale = Config::HitboxScaleMultiplier(hitboxScalePercent);
    std::optional<float> score;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sample.shapes.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& shape = sample.shapes[i];
        const auto& pose = sample.poses[i];
        if (shape.boneId != boneId || !std::isfinite(shape.radius) || shape.radius <= 0.0f || !pose.Valid())
            continue;
        const Vector3 a = sample.world.TransformPoint(ModelShapes::Transform(shape.a, pose)) + relativeAnchor;
        const Vector3 b = sample.world.TransformPoint(ModelShapes::Transform(shape.b, pose)) + relativeAnchor;
        // Minimum axis scale gives an inscribed radius for non-uniform transforms.
        const float poseScale = (std::min)({pose.scale[0], pose.scale[1], pose.scale[2]});
        const float radius = (shape.radius * poseScale * worldScale + (std::max)(0.0f, projectileRadius)) * hitboxScale;
        if (!IsFiniteVector(a) || !IsFiniteVector(b) || !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0.0f)
            continue;
        const float normalized = std::sqrt(RayAxisDistanceSquared(a, b, unitRay)) / radius;
        if (std::isfinite(normalized) && (!score || normalized < *score))
            score = normalized;
    }
    return score;
}

std::optional<float> NativeHitWindowScore(const c_entity& entity, int boneId, uint32_t now,
    const Vector3& origin, const Vector3& direction, const NativeHitWindowInput& input,
    const Vector3& extraDisplacement)
{
    if (input.projectileRadius < 0.0f || !IsFiniteVector(origin) || !IsFiniteVector(direction))
        return std::nullopt;
    const float directionLength = direction.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(directionLength) || directionLength <= 0.0001f)
        return std::nullopt;

    if (input.projectileSpeed <= 0.0f) {
        Vector3 launchDirection = direction + Vector3(0.0f, input.launchUpBias, 0.0f);
        const float launchLength = launchDirection.Size();
        if (!std::isfinite(launchLength) || launchLength <= 0.0001f)
            return std::nullopt;
        launchDirection = launchDirection / launchLength;
        return NativeHitWindowScore(entity, boneId, now, origin, launchDirection,
            input.displacement + extraDisplacement, input.projectileRadius, input.hitboxScalePercent);
    }

    if (!std::isfinite(input.projectileSpeed) || input.projectileSpeed <= 0.0f ||
        !std::isfinite(input.gravityAcceleration) || !IsFiniteVector(input.targetVelocity))
        return std::nullopt;
    Vector3 launchDirection = direction + Vector3(0.0f, input.launchUpBias, 0.0f);
    const float launchLength = launchDirection.Size();
    if (!std::isfinite(launchLength) || launchLength <= 0.0001f)
        return std::nullopt;
    launchDirection = launchDirection / launchLength;
    const Vector3 initialVelocity = launchDirection * input.projectileSpeed;
    const float maxTime = input.maxFlightSeconds > 0.0f
        ? input.maxFlightSeconds
        : std::clamp(directionLength / input.projectileSpeed * 1.5f + 0.05f, 0.05f, 4.0f);
    const ProjectileTrajectory trajectory{
        origin,
        initialVelocity,
        input.targetVelocity,
        input.gravity ? Vector3(0.0f, -std::fabs(input.gravityAcceleration), 0.0f) : Vector3{},
        maxTime
    };

    if (!NativeHitboxSampleUsable(entity, now))
        return std::nullopt;
    const auto& sample = entity.native_hitboxes;
    const Vector3 relativeAnchor = entity.pos - sample.world.sampleAnchor +
        input.displacement + extraDisplacement;
    const float worldScale = (std::min)({sample.world.record.scale[0], sample.world.record.scale[1],
        sample.world.record.scale[2]});
    const float hitboxScale = Config::HitboxScaleMultiplier(input.hitboxScalePercent);
    std::optional<float> bestHitTime;
    std::optional<float> bestHitScore;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sample.shapes.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& shape = sample.shapes[i];
        const auto& pose = sample.poses[i];
        if (shape.boneId != boneId || !std::isfinite(shape.radius) || shape.radius <= 0.0f || !pose.Valid())
            continue;
        const Vector3 a = sample.world.TransformPoint(ModelShapes::Transform(shape.a, pose)) + relativeAnchor;
        const Vector3 b = sample.world.TransformPoint(ModelShapes::Transform(shape.b, pose)) + relativeAnchor;
        const float poseScale = (std::min)({pose.scale[0], pose.scale[1], pose.scale[2]});
        const float radius = (shape.radius * poseScale * worldScale + input.projectileRadius) * hitboxScale;
        if (!IsFiniteVector(a) || !IsFiniteVector(b) || !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0.0f)
            continue;
        float hitTime = 0.0f;
        if (ContinuousTrajectoryIntersectsHitboxInternal(trajectory, {a, b, radius}, 0.0f, &hitTime)) {
            const Vector3 impact = TrajectoryPosition(trajectory, hitTime);
            const float score = std::sqrt(DistanceSquaredPointSegment(impact, a, b)) / radius;
            if (!bestHitTime || hitTime < *bestHitTime) {
                bestHitTime = hitTime;
                bestHitScore = score;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!bestHitTime || !bestHitScore)
        return std::nullopt;
    return std::isfinite(*bestHitScore) ? bestHitScore : std::nullopt;
}

} // namespace OW
```

`src/Game/HeroPerkRuntime.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Game/HeroPerkRuntime.hpp"

#include <Windows.h>

#include <mutex>

#include "Game/Structs.hpp"
#include "Game/RuntimeState.hpp"
#include "Memory/KeyState.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"

namespace OW::HeroPerkRuntime {
namespace {

struct RuntimeState {
    uint64_t heroId = 0;
    bool teamKnown = false;
    bool teamFlag = false;
    ManualOverrideMode manualOverride = ManualOverrideMode::None;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
RuntimeState g_state;
bool g_lastF8Down = false;

const char* VariantIdForHero(uint64_t heroId)
{
    switch (heroId) {
    case static_cast<uint64_t>(OW::eHero::HERO_MCCREE):
        return "cassidy_ads_perk";
    default:
        return "";
    }
}

void ResetUnlocked(const char* reason)
{
    if (g_state.heroId != 0 || g_state.manualOverride != ManualOverrideMode::None) {
        Diagnostics::Aim("perk.runtime reset reason=%s hero=0x%llX manual=%s",
            reason ? reason : "unknown",
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_state.heroId),
            ManualOverrideModeName(g_state.manualOverride));
    }

    g_state = RuntimeState{};
}

void ProcessHotkeysUnlocked()
{
    const KeyState::KeyStateVkSample f8Sample = KeyState::SampleVk(VK_F8);
    if (!f8Sample.available)
        return;
    const bool f8Down = f8Sample.down;
    const bool f8Pressed = f8Down && !g_lastF8Down;
    g_lastF8Down = f8Down;
    if (!f8Pressed || g_state.heroId == 0 ||
        OW::IsPerkHotkeyReservedForMenu(OW::Config::MenuToggleKey, VK_F8))
        return;

    const bool shiftDown =
        KeyState::IsKeyDown(VK_SHIFT) ||
        KeyState::IsKeyDown(VK_LSHIFT) ||
        KeyState::IsKeyDown(VK_RSHIFT);

    if (shiftDown) {
        g_state.manualOverride = ManualOverrideMode::None;
        Diagnostics::Aim("perk.runtime manual_clear hero=0x%llX",
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_state.heroId));
        return;
    }

    if (!HeroSupportsManualPerk(g_state.heroId)) {
        Diagnostics::Aim("perk.runtime hotkey_noop reason=unsupported_hero hero=0x%llX",
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_state.heroId));
        return;
    }

    g_state.manualOverride = g_state.manualOverride == ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn
        ? ManualOverrideMode::ForceOff
        : ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn;
    Diagnostics::Aim("perk.runtime manual_toggle hero=0x%llX manual=%s variant=%s",
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_state.heroId),
        ManualOverrideModeName(g_state.manualOverride),
        VariantIdForHero(g_state.heroId));
}

} // namespace

void UpdateContext(uint64_t heroId, bool connected, bool teamFlag)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);

    if (!connected) {
        ResetUnlocked("disconnect");
        g_lastF8Down = false;
        return;
    }

    if (heroId != 0) {
        if (g_state.heroId != 0 && g_state.heroId != heroId) {
            ResetUnlocked("hero_change");
        }

        if (g_state.heroId == 0) {
            g_state.heroId = heroId;
            g_state.teamKnown = true;
            g_state.teamFlag = teamFlag;
            Diagnostics::Aim("perk.runtime context hero=0x%llX supported=%d",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(g_state.heroId),
                HeroSupportsManualPerk(g_state.heroId) ? 1 : 0);
        } else if (g_state.teamKnown && g_state.teamFlag != teamFlag) {
            ResetUnlocked("team_change");
            g_state.heroId = heroId;
            g_state.teamKnown = true;
            g_state.teamFlag = teamFlag;
        } else {
            g_state.teamKnown = true;
            g_state.teamFlag = teamFlag;
        }
    }

    ProcessHotkeysUnlocked();
}

void ResetForDisconnect()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    ResetUnlocked("disconnect");
    g_lastF8Down = false;
}

bool HeroSupportsManualPerk(uint64_t heroId)
{
    return VariantIdForHero(heroId)[0] != '\0';
}

bool IsEffectivePerkOn(uint64_t heroId)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    return g_state.heroId == heroId &&
        g_state.manualOverride == ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn &&
        HeroSupportsManualPerk(heroId);
}

void ToggleCurrentHeroManualPerk()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    if (g_state.heroId == 0 || !HeroSupportsManualPerk(g_state.heroId))
        return;
    g_state.manualOverride = g_state.manualOverride == ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn
        ? ManualOverrideMode::ForceOff
        : ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn;
}

void ClearCurrentHeroManualPerk()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    g_state.manualOverride = ManualOverrideMode::None;
}

void SetManualPerkOverride(uint64_t heroId, ManualOverrideMode mode)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    g_state.heroId = heroId;
    g_state.teamKnown = false;
    g_state.manualOverride = HeroSupportsManualPerk(heroId)
        ? mode
        : ManualOverrideMode::None;
}

Snapshot CurrentSnapshot()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);

    Snapshot snapshot{};
    snapshot.heroId = g_state.heroId;
    snapshot.supported = HeroSupportsManualPerk(g_state.heroId);
    snapshot.manualOverride = g_state.manualOverride;
    snapshot.effectivePerkOn = snapshot.supported &&
        g_state.manualOverride == ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn;
    snapshot.source = g_state.manualOverride == ManualOverrideMode::None
        ? EffectiveSource::Default
        : EffectiveSource::Manual;
    snapshot.variantId = snapshot.effectivePerkOn ? VariantIdForHero(g_state.heroId) : "";
    return snapshot;
}

const char* ManualOverrideModeName(ManualOverrideMode mode)
{
    switch (mode) {
    case ManualOverrideMode::ForceOff:
        return "ForceOff";
    case ManualOverrideMode::ForceOn:
        return "ForceOn";
    case ManualOverrideMode::None:
    default:
        return "None";
    }
}

const char* EffectiveSourceName(EffectiveSource source)
{
    switch (source) {
    case EffectiveSource::Manual:
        return "Manual";
    case EffectiveSource::Default:
    default:
        return "Default";
    }
}

} // namespace OW::HeroPerkRuntime
```

```inl
    if (!g_genjiBlade.key.empty()) {
        CancelSkillMemoryPulse(g_genjiBlade.key + ":dash");
        CancelSkillMemoryPulse(g_genjiBlade.key + ":swing");
        TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(g_genjiBlade.key + ":dash");

bool EvaluateSurvivalAction(const std::string& key, const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                            const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings, const c_entity& local) {
    const auto now = GetTickCount();
    if (!local.health_sample_tick_ms || uint32_t(now-local.health_sample_tick_ms)>250) return false;
    if (definition.inputAction == HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate) {
        if (!local.display_ultimate_tick || uint32_t(now-local.display_ultimate_tick)>250 ||
            !std::isfinite(local.ultimate) || local.ultimate<100) return false;
    } else {
        const size_t slot = definition.inputAction == HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1 ? 0 : 1;
        if (!local.skill_active_tick_ms[slot] || uint32_t(now-local.skill_active_tick_ms[slot])>250 ||
            (slot == 0 ? local.skill1act : local.skill2act)) return false;
    }
    return EvaluateHealthThresholdAction(key,definition,settings,local);
}

bool EvaluateRecentDamageDeflect(const std::string& key, const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings, const c_entity& local) {
    const auto now = GetTickCount();
    if (!g_recentDamage.Ready(now) || !settings.healthTriggerEnabled ||
        !SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(local.PlayerHealth,local.PlayerHealthMax,settings.healthThreshold,false) ||
        !local.skill_active_tick_ms[1] || uint32_t(now-local.skill_active_tick_ms[1])>250 || local.skill2act ||
        IsActionDebounced(key) || !std::isfinite(settings.distance) || settings.distance<=0) return false;
    const auto source = SourcePositionForAction(local);
    if (!IsUsablePosition(source)) return false;
    for (const auto& target : TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities()) {
        if (!TargetingDetail::IsSelectableCandidate(target,0,local) || !target.Vis) continue;
        const auto point = CandidatePositionForAction(target);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(point)) continue;
        const float distance = source.DistTo(point);
        if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance>settings.distance) continue;
        if (!StartSkillOutput(key,definition,settings,local,kBriefPulse)) return false;
        MarkActionExecuted(key);
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill recent-damage deflect fired. skill=%s hp=%.1f damage=%.1f distance=%.2f",
            definition.skillId,local.PlayerHealth,g_recentDamage.damage,distance);
        g_recentDamage.ClearDamage();
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void EvaluateGenjiBlade(const std::string& key, const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                       const c_entity& local) {
    if (!SkillConditions::FreshSample(local.display_ultimate_tick, GetTickCount())) {
        CancelGenjiBlade();
        return;
    }
    const auto input = KeyState::SampleVk(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ultimate));
    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
    const bool wasActive = g_genjiBlade.window.active;
    const bool ready = g_genjiBlade.window.Advance(input.down,input.available,local.ultimate,now);
    if (!g_genjiBlade.window.active) {
        if (wasActive || !input.available) CancelGenjiBlade();
        return;
    }
    g_genjiBlade.key = key;
    g_genjiBladeOwnsAim.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    if (!wasActive) {
        ResetAimSmoothingState();
        Diagnostics::Info("Genji blade assist started from manual ultimate input.");
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
    }
    if (!ready) return;
    ScopedTrackingConfig tracking(settings.tracking);
    SkillProjectileRuntime projectile{};
    projectile.maxRange = (std::min)(20.f,settings.distance);
    auto candidate = FindBestSkillAimCandidate(settings,projectile);
    if (!candidate.valid) { g_genjiBlade.target.Reset(); return; }
    if (!g_genjiBlade.target.Ready(SkillBodyIdentity(candidate.entity),now,settings.assistanceDelayMs,0)) return;
    // Rigel turns toward a dash target or a nearby swing target. UN verifies
    // the observed camera before sending either mapped action.
    candidate.hitWindow = (std::min)(candidate.hitWindow,0.8f);
    MoveSkillAimAndCheckReady(key,settings,candidate,projectile);
    if (!IsSkillAimConfirmed(candidate)) return;
    if (candidate.distance > GenjiAssist::kSwingRange) {
        TryStartGenjiDash(key + ":dash",V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability1),local,0x8);
    } else if (!g_genjiBlade.lastSwing || now - g_genjiBlade.lastSwing >= GenjiAssist::kSwingMs) {
        if (StartTimedHotkey(key + ":swing",V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary),kBriefPulse))
            g_genjiBlade.lastSwing = now;
    }
}

    SkillConditions::AimSession request;
    int phase = 0;
    uint64_t started = 0;
    uint64_t lastTick = 0;

bool IsNormalInterruptCandidate(const std::string& key, int mask, const c_entity& entity,
    const SkillProjectileRuntime& projectile) {
    const int index = SkillConditions::NormalThreatIndex(entity.HeroID);
    if (index < 0 || !(mask & (1 << index))) return false;
    const auto& threat=SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[index];
    const auto slot = threat.slot;
    const auto state = g_defensiveThreats.find(entity.address);
    const auto source=SourcePositionForAction(TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity());
    const float travel=projectile.preFireDelayMs+(projectile.speed>0 ?
        source.DistTo(CandidatePositionForAction(entity))/projectile.speed*1000.f : 0.f);
    return state != g_defensiveThreats.end() && state->second.body == SkillBodyIdentity(entity) &&
        state->second.events[slot].CanRespond(4u) &&
        state->second.started[slot] && SkillConditions::InterruptCanArrive(threat,
            uint32_t(GetTickCount()-state->second.started[slot]),travel) &&
        !state->second.responders[slot].contains(key) &&
        SkillConditions::FreshActive(slot == 0 ? entity.skill1act : entity.skill2act,
            entity.skill_active_tick_ms[slot], GetTickCount());
}

bool IsSkillAimConfirmed(const SkillAimCandidate& candidate) {
    Vector3 current{};
    const auto source=SourcePositionForAction(TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity());
    return candidate.valid && candidate.hitWindow > 0 && TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current) &&
        SkillAimWindowContains(current,source,candidate.aimPoint,candidate.hitWindow);
}

bool EvaluateAutomaticAim(const std::string& key, const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                          const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings) {
    const auto kind = definition.automation;
    auto& window=g_automaticAimWindows[key];
    if (!FreshLocalActionReady(definition, TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity())) {
        window.Reset();
        return false;
    }
    if (kind == SkillAutomation::ShieldBash) {
        const auto input = KeyState::SampleVk(V2::HeroSettings::Key(definition.heroId,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary));
        if (!input.available || !input.down) { window.Reset(); return false; }
    }
    // A manual skill request or a running combo keeps its existing target.
    if (g_automaticOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || AnyInputSequenceActive() || g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        std::any_of(g_skillAimSessions.begin(),g_skillAimSessions.end(),[](const auto& item){return item.second.active;})) {
        window.Reset();return false;
    }
    auto projectile = ResolveSkillProjectileRuntime(settings, GetTrajectoryParams(definition));
    ScopedTrackingConfig tracking(settings.tracking);
    const bool follows = kind == SkillAutomation::FollowAim;
    const auto selectedAddress = follows ? [&]() -> uint64_t {
        if (!Config::enableAimbot || !AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(
                Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(Config::View_aim_key()))) return 0;
        const auto targets = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        const int index = Config::Targetenemyi;
        if (!TargetingDetail::IsValidIndex(index, targets.size())) return 0;
        return targets[index].address;
    }() : uint64_t(0);
    if (follows && !selectedAddress) { window.Reset();return false; }
    const bool canAim = settings.automaticAim &&
        (kind == SkillAutomation::LowEnemyHealth || kind == SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt);
    const auto candidate = FindBestSkillAimCandidate(settings, projectile, 0,
        SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::EnemyHealthAbsolute), [&](const c_entity& entity) {
            if (follows && entity.address != selectedAddress) return false;
            if (kind == SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt)
                return IsNormalInterruptCandidate(key, settings.normalThreatMask, entity,projectile);
            return true;
        },!canAim);
    if (!candidate.valid) { window.Reset();return false; }
    if (!window.Ready(SkillBodyIdentity(candidate.entity),GetTickCount64(),settings.assistanceDelayMs,settings.maxAimTimeMs))
        return false;
    if (canAim) {
        g_automaticOwnsAim.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
        if (!MoveSkillAimAndCheckReady(key, settings, candidate, projectile)) return false;
    }
    // Check observed view, not a command which is still queued on the device.
    if (!IsSkillAimConfirmed(candidate) || IsActionDebounced(key)) return false;
    const auto local = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
    const bool genjiDash = definition.heroId == eHero::HERO_GENJI && definition.inputAction == HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1;
    if (!(genjiDash ? TryStartGenjiDash(key,SkillOutputVk(settings),local,0x8)
                   : StartSkillOutput(key,definition,settings,local,kBriefPulse))) return false;
    RecordTrajectoryCast(key,definition,settings);
    window.Reset();
    if (kind == SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt) {
        const int index = SkillConditions::NormalThreatIndex(candidate.entity.HeroID);
        g_defensiveThreats[candidate.entity.address].responders[SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[index].slot].insert(key);
    }
    Diagnostics::Info("Hero automatic skill fired. skill=%s target=0x%llX mode=%d", definition.skillId,
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(candidate.entity.address), static_cast<int>(kind));
    return true;
}

bool EvaluateReturn(const std::string& key, const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings, const c_entity& local) {
    if (!FreshHealthForSkill(local) || !settings.healthTriggerEnabled ||
        !SkillConditions::FreshActive(local.skill1act,local.skill_active_tick_ms[0],GetTickCount()) ||
        !g_returnWindow.Ready(GetTickCount64()) ||
        !SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(local.PlayerHealth,local.PlayerHealthMax,settings.healthThreshold,true)) return false;
    bool sent = false;
#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
    sent = !mem.IsProcessInitialized()
        ? StartTimedHotkey(key, settings.runtimeOutputVk, kBriefPulse)
        : StartSkillMemoryPulse(key, local, 0x8, 55);
#else
    sent = StartSkillMemoryPulse(key, local, 0x8, 55);
#endif
    if (!sent) return false;
    g_returnWindow.spent = true;
    MarkActionExecuted(key);
    return true;
}

void CancelSuperJump(const std::string& key, SuperJumpRuntime& state) {
    TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(key);
    state.phase = 0;
    state.request.Block();
    g_specialOwnsAim.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
}

std::optional<OutputActionPlan> BuildEmreJumpPlan(const std::string& key,
    const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,uint64_t hero) {
    const auto action = [&](V2::HeroSettings::Action a, OutputControl& out) {
        return TryMapVkToOutputControl(V2::HeroSettings::Key(hero,a),out);
    };
    OutputControl grenade{},siphon{},forward{},jump{};
    if (!action(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability2,grenade) ||
        !action(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability1,siphon) ||
        !action(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Forward,forward) ||
        !action(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Jump,jump) ||
        grenade==siphon || grenade==forward || grenade==jump || siphon==forward ||
        siphon==jump || forward==jump) return std::nullopt;
    OutputControl activation{};
    if(TryMapVkToOutputControl(Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key),activation) &&
        (activation==grenade || activation==siphon || activation==forward || activation==jump)) return std::nullopt;
    const int moveStart=20+settings.jumpLeadMs;
    const int jumpAt=moveStart+settings.moveForwardMs;
    OutputActionPlan plan;
    plan.key=key;plan.ownerSource=OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction;plan.acquire={grenade};
    plan.steps={
        {std::chrono::milliseconds(20),{},{grenade},{},false},
        {std::chrono::milliseconds(moveStart),{siphon,forward},{},{},false},
        {std::chrono::milliseconds(moveStart+20),{},{siphon},{},false},
        {std::chrono::milliseconds(jumpAt),{jump},{forward},{},false},
        {std::chrono::milliseconds(jumpAt+40),{},{jump},{},true}};
    return plan;
}

void EvaluateSuperJump(const std::string& key, const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                       const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings, const c_entity& local) {
    auto& state = g_superJumps[key];
    const auto input = KeyState::SampleVk(Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key));
    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
    if (!state.phase) {
        if (!state.request.Advance(input.down,now,0,0,input.available)) return;
        state.request.Block();
        if (!BuildEmreJumpPlan(key,settings,local.HeroID)) return;
        if (!TryReadCurrentViewAngles(state.initialAngles)) return;
        if (IsManualCooldownActive(key,settings)) return;
        auto shiftDefinition=definition;
        shiftDefinition.inputAction=HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1;
        if (!FreshLocalActionReady(definition,local) || !FreshLocalActionReady(shiftDefinition,local)) return;
        if (IsInRechargeInterval(definition,settings,local) || IsInRechargeInterval(shiftDefinition,settings,local)) return;
        state.phase = 1;state.started = now;state.lastTick=now;
        g_specialOwnsAim.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
    }
    if (now - state.started > 2500 || !input.available) { CancelSuperJump(key,state); return; }
    const float dt=std::clamp(float(now-state.lastTick)/1000.f,0.001f,0.05f);
    state.lastTick=now;
    if (state.phase == 1) {
        const float down = ClampViewPitchTarget(settings.pitchDownTargetAngle*kDegToRad);
        if (!IsPitchWithin(down,2.f*kDegToRad)) {
            MovePitchToward(down,2000.f,dt);return;
        }
        auto plan=BuildEmreJumpPlan(key,settings,local.HeroID);
        if (!plan || !TimedOutputScheduler().Schedule(std::move(*plan))) {CancelSuperJump(key,state);return;}
        state.phase=2;MarkActionExecuted(key);
        g_lastOutputActions[V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability1)]=Clock::now();
        g_lastOutputActions[V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability2)]=Clock::now();
    }
    if (state.phase==2) {
        MovePitchToward(state.initialAngles.X,2000.f,dt);
        if (!TimedOutputScheduler().IsActive(key) && IsPitchWithin(state.initialAngles.X,2.f*kDegToRad)) {
            state.phase=0;g_specialOwnsAim.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
        }
    }
}

void CancelAutomation(const std::string& key) {
    const auto found=g_superJumps.find(key);
    if(found!=g_superJumps.end())CancelSuperJump(key,found->second);
    g_automaticAimWindows.erase(key);
}
```

```inl
void CancelBeamOutput() {
    if (!g_beamOutput.key.empty()) {
        TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(g_beamOutput.key);
        ReleasePhysicalMouseMaskLease(g_beamOutput.key+":beam-mask",
            OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction,g_beamOutput.generation);
    }
```
