    g_beamOwnsOutputs.store(false,std::memory_order_release);

const c_entity* ConnectedBeamTarget(const c_entity& local,const std::vector<c_entity>& entities,uint32_t now) {
    const auto& signal=local.hero_skill_signals;
    if (!signal.mercyBeamKnown || !signal.mercyBeamConnected || !signal.mercyTargetId ||
        !SkillConditions::FreshSample(signal.sampledTick,now)) return nullptr;
    const c_entity* found=nullptr;
    for (const auto& entity : entities) {
        if (entity.match_id != signal.mercyTargetId) continue;
        // Ambiguity or a stale/reused handle never falls back to another ally.
        if (found || entity.address==local.address || !entity.team_known || entity.Team ||
            !entity.HasUsableBody(now,EntitySceneGeneration()) || !FreshHealthForSkill(entity)) return nullptr;
        found=&entity;
    }
    return found;
}

void EvaluateMercyBeam(const std::string& key,const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,const c_entity& local) {
    const auto input=KeyState::SampleVk(Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key));
    const auto entities=TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
    const auto* target=ConnectedBeamTarget(local,entities,GetTickCount());
    OutputControl heal{},boost{};
    const int healVk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary);
    const int boostVk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary);
    if (!input.available || !input.down || !target || !local.team_known || AnyInputSequenceActive() ||
        !TryMapVkToOutputControl(healVk,heal) || !TryMapVkToOutputControl(boostVk,boost) || heal==boost ||
        heal.kind!=OutputControlKind::MouseButton || boost.kind!=OutputControlKind::MouseButton ||
        Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key)==healVk || Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key)==boostVk) {
        CancelBeamOutput(); return;
    }
    const auto selected=SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(target->PlayerHealth,target->PlayerHealthMax,
        settings.allyHealthThreshold,false) ? heal : boost;
    const auto generation=CurrentOutputRuntimeState().backendGeneration;
    if (!g_beamOutput.key.empty() && (g_beamOutput.key!=key || g_beamOutput.generation!=generation))
        CancelBeamOutput();
    g_beamOwnsOutputs.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
    if (!AcquirePhysicalMouseMaskLease(key+":beam-mask",OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction,
        (1u<<heal.code)|(1u<<boost.code),generation)) { CancelBeamOutput(); return; }
    // Record the lease before any following operation can fail.
    g_beamOutput.key=key; g_beamOutput.generation=generation;
    if (g_beamOutput.button!=int(selected.code)) {
        const auto other=selected==heal ? boost : heal;
        if (V2::Output::DispatchForceReleaseMouseButtonForGeneration(generation,other.code)!=success) {
            CancelBeamOutput(); return;
        }
    }
    if (!TimedOutputScheduler().SetManualControlsForGeneration(key,OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction,
        {selected},generation)) { CancelBeamOutput(); return; }
    g_beamOutput.button=selected.code;
}

bool EvaluateLucioSong(const std::string& key,const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                       const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,const c_entity& local) {
    const auto now=GetTickCount();
    if (!local.team_known || !SkillConditions::FreshSample(local.hero_skill_signals.sampledTick,now) ||
        local.hero_skill_signals.lucioSong<0 || !std::isfinite(settings.radius) || settings.radius<=0) {
        g_songSwitch.desired=-1; g_songSwitch.conditionSince=0; return false;
    }
    const auto source=CandidatePositionForAction(local);
    if (!IsUsablePosition(source)) { g_songSwitch.desired=-1; g_songSwitch.conditionSince=0; return false; }
    int wounded=0;
    for (const auto& ally : TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities()) {
        if (ally.address==local.address || !ally.Alive) continue;
        if (!ally.team_known) { g_songSwitch.desired=-1; g_songSwitch.conditionSince=0; return false; }
        if (ally.Team) continue;
        if (!ally.HasUsableBody(now,EntitySceneGeneration()) || !FreshHealthForSkill(ally)) {
            // Missing teammate data is not evidence that nobody needs healing.
            g_songSwitch.desired=-1; g_songSwitch.conditionSince=0; return false;
        }
        if (settings.requireVisible && !ally.Vis) continue;
        const auto point=CandidatePositionForAction(ally);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(point)) { g_songSwitch.desired=-1; g_songSwitch.conditionSince=0; return false; }
        if (source.DistTo(point)<=settings.radius && SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(
            ally.PlayerHealth,ally.PlayerHealthMax,settings.allyHealthThreshold,false)) ++wounded;
    }
    const int desired=wounded>=settings.minTargets ? 1 : 0;
    if (!g_songSwitch.Ready(local.hero_skill_signals.lucioSong,desired,
        local.hero_skill_signals.sampledTick,now,800) || IsActionDebounced(key)) return false;
    if (!StartSkillOutput(key,definition,settings,local,kBriefPulse)) return false;
    g_songSwitch.Submitted(local.hero_skill_signals.lucioSong,now);
    MarkActionExecuted(key);
    return true;
}

ProjectileThreat::Vec3 ThreatVector(const Vector3& value) { return {value.X,value.Y,value.Z}; }
void ObserveProjectileThreats(const c_entity& local) {
    const auto now=GetTickCount();
    if (!HeroSkillNeedsProjectileObservations(local.HeroID)) { g_projectileThreats.Reset(); return; }
    for (const auto& object : TargetingDetail::SnapshotDynamicEntities()) {
        if (object.scene_generation!=local.scene_generation) continue;
        g_projectileThreats.Observe({object.object_parent,object.entityid,object.scene_generation,object.MeshBase,
            object.position_tick_ms,object.status_tick_ms,object.team_key,object.team_known,
            {object.POS.x,object.POS.y,object.POS.z}},now);
    }
    g_projectileThreats.Prune(now);
}

bool EvaluateProjectileDefense(const std::string& key,const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                               const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,const c_entity& local) {
    if (definition.heroId==eHero::HERO_DVA && (!local.hero_skill_signals.dvaMechKnown ||
        !local.hero_skill_signals.dvaInMech || !SkillConditions::FreshSample(
            local.hero_skill_signals.dvaMechTick,GetTickCount()))) return false;
    if (!FreshLocalActionReady(definition,local) || IsActionDebounced(key)) return false;
    const bool health=settings.healthTriggerEnabled && FreshHealthForSkill(local) &&
        SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(local.PlayerHealth,local.PlayerHealthMax,settings.healthThreshold,
            SkillControls(definition,HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute));
    uint64_t threatParent=0;
    ProjectileThreat::Approach nearest{};
    Vector3 view{};
    if (settings.projectileThreatEnabled && settings.projectileThreatMask && local.team_known &&
        TryReadCurrentViewAngles(view)) {
        const Vector3 source=CandidatePositionForAction(local);
        const Vector3 forward(std::cos(view.X)*std::sin(view.Y),-std::sin(view.X),std::cos(view.X)*std::cos(view.Y));
        const bool turn=definition.heroId==eHero::HERO_DVA && settings.automaticAim;
        for (const auto& object : TargetingDetail::SnapshotDynamicEntities()) {
            const int bit=object.entityid==ProjectileThreat::kBioticGrenade ? 1 :
                object.entityid==ProjectileThreat::kTacticalGrenade ? 2 : 0;
            const auto* track=g_projectileThreats.Find(object.object_parent);
            if (!(bit&settings.projectileThreatMask) || !track || object.scene_generation!=local.scene_generation) continue;
            auto next=ProjectileThreat::Evaluate(*track,ThreatVector(source),ThreatVector(local.velocity),
                ThreatVector(forward),local.team_key,GetTickCount(),settings.distance,250,1.5f,turn ? -1.f : .7071f);
            if (next.valid && (!nearest.valid || next.seconds<nearest.seconds)) { nearest=next;threatParent=object.object_parent; }
        }
        if (!health && nearest.valid && turn && nearest.facingCos<.7071f) {
            if (AnyInputSequenceActive() || g_automaticOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
                std::any_of(g_skillAimSessions.begin(),g_skillAimSessions.end(),[](const auto& item){return item.second.active;})) return false;
            SkillAimCandidate candidate{}; candidate.valid=true;
            const auto* track=g_projectileThreats.Find(threatParent);
            if (!track) return false;
            candidate.motionIdentity={threatParent,0,track->sample.component,local.connection_epoch,
                local.scene_generation,track->sample.type};
            candidate.motionSampleTick=track->sample.positionTick;
            candidate.rawAimPoint=candidate.aimPoint=Vector3(nearest.position.x,nearest.position.y,nearest.position.z);
            candidate.distance=source.DistTo(candidate.aimPoint); candidate.hitWindow=.5f;
            ScopedTrackingConfig tracking(settings.tracking);
            g_automaticOwnsAim.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
            TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
            TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
            MoveSkillAimAndCheckReady(key,settings,candidate,SkillProjectileRuntime{});
            return false; // Next observation must confirm the defensive direction.
        }
    }
    if (!health && !nearest.valid) return false;
    const auto hold=definition.heroId==eHero::HERO_DVA
        ? std::chrono::milliseconds(nearest.valid ? int((std::clamp)(nearest.seconds*1000.f+80.f,100.f,400.f)) : 250)
        : kBriefPulse;
    if (!StartSkillOutput(key,definition,settings,local,hold)) return false;
    if (definition.heroId==eHero::HERO_DVA && settings.automaticAim) {
        g_matrixAimKey=key;
        g_automaticOwnsAim.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
    }
    MarkActionExecuted(key);
    if (threatParent && nearest.facingCos>=.7071f) g_projectileThreats.MarkResponded(threatParent);
    return true;
}

void CancelSignalSkill(const std::string& key) {
    if (g_beamOutput.key==key) CancelBeamOutput();
    if (g_matrixAimKey==key) g_matrixAimKey.clear();
    if (key==std::to_string(eHero::HERO_LUCIO)+":crossfade") g_songSwitch.Reset();
}
void CancelSignalActions() {
    CancelBeamOutput(); g_songSwitch.Reset(); g_projectileThreats.Reset(); g_matrixAimKey.clear();
}

    struct SkillAimMotionRuntime {
        SkillConditions::BodyIdentity target{};
        MouseMoveQuantizationState quantization{};
        Vector3 submittedFrom{}, submittedTo{};
        uint64_t submittedMs = 0;
        bool pending = false;

        static float Wrap(float value) { return std::remainder(value, 2.0f * 3.14159265358979323846f); }
        static float Along(float value, float limit) {
            return std::clamp(value, (std::min)(0.0f, limit), (std::max)(0.0f, limit));
        }
        Vector3 Outstanding(const Vector3& observed, uint64_t now) {
            // A queued relative move is not yet an observed camera correction.
            if (!pending || now - submittedMs >= 100) { pending = false; return {}; }
            return {Along(submittedTo.X - observed.X, submittedTo.X - submittedFrom.X),
                Along(Wrap(submittedTo.Y - observed.Y), Wrap(submittedTo.Y - submittedFrom.Y)), 0};
        }
        Vector3 Unsent(const Vector3& observed, const Vector3& proposed, uint64_t now) {
            const auto outstanding = Outstanding(observed, now);
            const Vector3 requested{proposed.X - observed.X, Wrap(proposed.Y - observed.Y), 0};
            return {Along(requested.X - outstanding.X, requested.X),
                Along(requested.Y - outstanding.Y, requested.Y), 0};
        }
        void Record(const Vector3& observed, const Vector3& accepted, uint64_t now) {
            submittedTo = observed + Outstanding(observed, now) + accepted;
            submittedFrom = observed;
            submittedMs = now;
            pending = true;
        }
    };

    SkillConditions::BodyIdentity SkillBodyIdentity(const c_entity& entity) {
        return {entity.address, entity.HeroID, entity.actor_generation,
            entity.connection_epoch, entity.scene_generation, entity.body_absence_revision};

    void ObserveDefensiveThreats() {
        const uint32_t now = GetTickCount();
        for (const auto& entity : TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities()) {
            if (!entity.address || !entity.HasUsableBody(now, EntitySceneGeneration())) continue;
            auto& state = g_defensiveThreats[entity.address];
            const auto body = SkillBodyIdentity(entity);
            if (state.body != body) { state = {}; state.body = body; }
            state.observed = now;
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < 2; ++slot)
                if (entity.skill_active_tick_ms[slot] && uint32_t(now - entity.skill_active_tick_ms[slot]) <= 250)
                {
                    const bool active = slot == 0 ? entity.skill1act : entity.skill2act;
                    const auto sampled=entity.skill_active_tick_ms[slot];
                    if(state.samples[slot] && uint32_t(sampled-state.samples[slot])>250) {
                        state.events[slot]={};state.responders[slot].clear();state.started[slot]=0;
                    }
                    if(state.events[slot].observed && !state.events[slot].active && active)
                        state.started[slot]=sampled;
                    if(!active)state.started[slot]=0;
                    state.samples[slot]=sampled;
                    if (!active) state.responders[slot].clear();
                    state.events[slot].Observe(active);
                }
        }
        for (auto it = g_defensiveThreats.begin(); it != g_defensiveThreats.end();) {
            if (uint32_t(now - it->second.observed) > 250) it = g_defensiveThreats.erase(it);
            else ++it;
        }
    }

    unsigned HeroStatePauseMask(const c_entity& local) {
        const uint32_t now = GetTickCount();
        if (!local.HasUsableBody(now, EntitySceneGeneration())) return SkillConditions::NoPause;
        // Keep a previously observed active pause until a successful inactive
        // sample arrives. A failed/late status read must not resume firing.
        const bool first = local.skill1act;
        const bool second = local.skill2act;
        const bool punchHeld = local.HeroID == eHero::HERO_DOOMFIST &&
            AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID, V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary));
        unsigned mask = SkillConditions::StatePause(local.HeroID, first, second, punchHeld);
        if (!mask) return mask;
        const auto settings = Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(local.HeroID, "assist-pause", MakePausePolicyDefaults());
        if (!settings.enabled) return SkillConditions::NoPause;
        if (!settings.pauseAim) mask &= ~SkillConditions::Aim;
        if (!settings.pauseTrigger) mask &= ~SkillConditions::Trigger;
        if (!settings.pauseSkills) mask &= ~SkillConditions::Skills;
        return mask;
    }

    bool FreshHealthForSkill(const c_entity& entity)
    {
        return SkillConditions::FreshHealth(entity.PlayerHealth, entity.PlayerHealthMax,
            entity.health_sample_tick_ms, GetTickCount());
    }

    bool FreshLocalActionReady(const HeroSkillDefinition& definition, const c_entity& local)
    {
        const auto now = GetTickCount();
        switch (definition.inputAction) {
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1:
            return SkillConditions::FreshSample(local.skill_active_tick_ms[0], now) && !local.skill1act;
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability2:
            return SkillConditions::FreshSample(local.skill_active_tick_ms[1], now) && !local.skill2act;
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate:
            return SkillConditions::FreshSample(local.display_ultimate_tick, now) &&
                std::isfinite(local.ultimate) && local.ultimate >= 100.f;
        default:
            return true;
        }
    }

    bool CanSubmitSkillAction(const std::string& runtimeKey, int vk)
    {
        if (std::any_of(g_pendingSkillCasts.begin(), g_pendingSkillCasts.end(), [&](const auto& item) {
                return item.first == runtimeKey || item.second.vk == vk;
            })) return false;
        const auto previous = g_lastOutputActions.find(vk);
        return previous == g_lastOutputActions.end() || Clock::now() - previous->second >= kActionPulseDebounce;
    }

    bool UpdateOwnedSkillMemoryPulse(bool keepHolding)
    {
        g_skillMemoryOwnership.releasing |= !keepHolding;
        const bool ok = V2::Output::GameActions::UpdateSkill(keepHolding && !g_skillMemoryOwnership.releasing);
        if (ok && (g_skillMemoryOwnership.releasing || GetTickCount64() >= g_skillMemoryOwnership.releaseAt))
            g_skillMemoryOwnership = {};
        return ok;
    }

    void CancelSkillMemoryPulse(const std::string& runtimeKey)
    {
        if (g_skillMemoryOwnership.key == runtimeKey)
            UpdateOwnedSkillMemoryPulse(false);
    }

    bool UseSequenceWorker()
    {
        static const bool enabled = [] {
            char value[16] = {};
            const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(
                "UNLEASHED_SEQUENCE_WORKER",
                value,
                static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(value)));
            const bool workerEnabled = length == 0 || length >= sizeof(value) || value[0] != '0';
            Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.worker_mode enabled=%d", workerEnabled ? 1 : 0);
            return workerEnabled;
        }();

        return enabled;
    }

    int PickZaryaAutoRightThreshold(const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings)
    {
        const int base = std::clamp(settings.zaryaAmmoThreshold, 1, kZaryaAmmoClipSize);
        const int jitter = std::clamp(settings.zaryaAmmoJitter, 0, kZaryaAmmoClipSize - 1);
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int> distribution(
            (std::max)(1, base - jitter),
            (std::min)(kZaryaAmmoClipSize, base + jitter));
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_randomMutex);
        return distribution(g_random);
    }

    int PickZaryaJitteredMs(int baseMs, int jitterMs, int minMs, int maxMs)
    {
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int> distribution(-jitterMs, jitterMs);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_randomMutex);
        return std::clamp(baseMs + distribution(g_random), minMs, maxMs);
    }

    ZaryaAutoRightTiming PickZaryaAutoRightTiming()
    {
        const int rightHoldMs = PickZaryaJitteredMs(
            kZaryaAutoRightHoldBaseMs,
            kZaryaAutoRightHoldJitterMs,
            1,
            1000);
        const int leftReleaseDelayMs = PickZaryaJitteredMs(
            kZaryaAutoRightLeftReleaseBaseMs,
            kZaryaAutoRightLeftReleaseJitterMs,
            0,
            rightHoldMs);
        return {
            std::chrono::milliseconds(rightHoldMs),
            std::chrono::milliseconds(leftReleaseDelayMs),
            std::chrono::milliseconds(rightHoldMs - leftReleaseDelayMs)
        };
    }

    bool AddOutputControlForVk(std::vector<OutputControl>& controls,int vk);

    std::vector<OutputControl> MouseControlsForMask(int mask)
    {
        std::vector<OutputControl> controls;
        mask &= 0x07;
        controls.reserve(3);
        for (int bit = 0; bit < 3; ++bit) {
            if ((mask & (1 << bit)) != 0) {
                const auto action=bit==0?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary:bit==1?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary:V2::HeroSettings::Action::Middle;
                if(!AddOutputControlForVk(controls,V2::HeroSettings::Key(TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID,action)))return {};

            }
        }
        return controls;
    }

    bool SetSequenceButtonMask(const std::string& skillId,
                               int prevMask,
                               int newMask,
                               std::uint64_t expectedGeneration = 0)
    {
        prevMask &= 0x07;
        newMask &= 0x07;
        if (prevMask == newMask)
            return true;

        std::vector<OutputControl> controls = MouseControlsForMask(newMask);
        if(newMask && controls.empty())return false;
        const bool accepted = expectedGeneration == 0
            ? TimedOutputScheduler().SetManualControls(
                SequenceOwnerKey(skillId),
                OutputOwnerSource::Sequence,
                std::move(controls))
            : TimedOutputScheduler().SetManualControlsForGeneration(
                SequenceOwnerKey(skillId),
                OutputOwnerSource::Sequence,
                std::move(controls),
                expectedGeneration);
        if (!accepted) {
            Diagnostics::Warn(
                "Hero skill sequence output failed. skill=%s prevMask=0x%02X newMask=0x%02X",
                skillId.c_str(),
                prevMask,
                newMask);
            return false;
        }

        if (SequenceDiagnosticsEnabled()) {
            Diagnostics::Aim(
                "sequence.button_owner skill=%s prevMask=0x%02X newMask=0x%02X",
                skillId.c_str(),
                prevMask,
                newMask);
        }
        return true;
    }

    // VK → USB HID key code for the most common game keys.
    // Unmapped VK codes return 0 (no-op).
    unsigned char VkToHidKeyCode(int vk) {return V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(vk);}

    bool AddOutputControlForVk(std::vector<OutputControl>& controls, int vk)
    {
        OutputControl control{};
        if (!TryMapVkToOutputControl(vk, control))
            return false;
        if (std::find(controls.begin(), controls.end(), control) == controls.end())
            controls.push_back(control);
        return true;
    }

    bool SetViewpointOutputs(const std::string& skillId, const ViewpointRuntime& runtime)
    {
        std::vector<OutputControl> controls;
        controls.reserve(2);
        if (runtime.secondaryDown && !AddOutputControlForVk(controls, runtime.skillVk))
            return false;
        if (runtime.jumpDown && !AddOutputControlForVk(controls, runtime.jumpVk))
            return false;
        return TimedOutputScheduler().SetManualControls(
            ViewpointOwnerKey(skillId),
            OutputOwnerSource::Viewpoint,
            std::move(controls));
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool BeginSecondaryPulse(const std::string& skillId,
                                           ViewpointRuntime& runtime,
                                           Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (runtime.secondaryDown)
            return true;

        if (runtime.skillVk <= 0) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill viewpoint skill pulse failed. skill=%s vk=%d",
                skillId.c_str(),
                runtime.skillVk);
            return false;
        }

        runtime.secondaryDown = true;
        if (!SetViewpointOutputs(skillId, runtime)) {
            runtime.secondaryDown = false;
            Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill viewpoint skill pulse failed. skill=%s vk=%d",
                skillId.c_str(),
                runtime.skillVk);
            return false;
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint skill pulse start. skill=%s vk=%d",
            skillId.c_str(),
            runtime.skillVk);
        runtime.secondaryPressedAt = now;
        return true;
    }

    [[nodiscard]] bool BeginKeyboardPulse(const std::string& skillId,
                                          ViewpointRuntime& runtime,
                                          int vk,
                                          Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (vk <= 0 || vk > 255)
            return false;
        if (runtime.jumpDown)
            return true;

        runtime.jumpDown = true;
        if (!SetViewpointOutputs(skillId, runtime)) {
            runtime.jumpDown = false;
            return false;
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint keyboard pulse start. skill=%s vk=%d",
            skillId.c_str(), vk);
        runtime.jumpPressedAt = now;
        return true;
    }

    void UpdateViewpointPulses(const std::string& skillId, ViewpointRuntime& runtime, Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (runtime.secondaryDown && now - runtime.secondaryPressedAt >= kBriefPulse) {
            runtime.secondaryDown = false;
            if (!SetViewpointOutputs(skillId, runtime)) {
                (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(ViewpointOwnerKey(skillId));
                runtime.jumpDown = false;
                runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::Cancelled;
                Diagnostics::Warn(
                    "Hero skill viewpoint secondary release failed. skill=%s",
                    skillId.c_str());
                return;
            }
            runtime.fired = true;
            runtime.fireDelayStarted = now;
            Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint secondary pulse end. skill=%s", skillId.c_str());
        }

        if (runtime.jumpDown && now - runtime.jumpPressedAt >= kBriefPulse) {
            runtime.jumpDown = false;
            if (!SetViewpointOutputs(skillId, runtime)) {
                (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(ViewpointOwnerKey(skillId));
                runtime.secondaryDown = false;
                runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::Cancelled;
                Diagnostics::Warn(
                    "Hero skill viewpoint keyboard release failed. skill=%s vk=%d",
                    skillId.c_str(),
                    runtime.jumpVk);
                return;
            }
            Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint keyboard pulse end. skill=%s vk=%d",
                skillId.c_str(), runtime.jumpVk);
        }
    }

    long long MillisecondsSince(Clock::time_point start, Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (start.time_since_epoch().count() == 0)
            return 0;
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - start).count();
    }

    void LogSequenceHitSummary(const std::string& skillId, const SequenceRuntime& runtime)
    {
        if (!runtime.hitHasSample)
            return;

        const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
        Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.hit_summary skill=%s target=0x%llX damageEvents=%d durationMs=%lld lastHealth=%.1f",
            skillId.c_str(),
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(runtime.hitTargetAddress),
            runtime.hitDamageEvents,
            MillisecondsSince(runtime.hitMonitorStarted, now),
            runtime.hitLastHealth);
    }

    bool IsSequenceHitCandidate(const c_entity& entity, const c_entity& local, bool requireEnemyTeam)
    {
        if (!entity.address || entity.address == local.address)
            return false;
        if (!entity.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(),EntitySceneGeneration()))
            return false;
        if (!std::isfinite(entity.PlayerHealth) || entity.PlayerHealth <= 0.0f)
            return false;
        if (requireEnemyTeam && !TargetingDetail::TargetTeamMatches(entity, 0, local))
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    Vector3 SequenceHitProbePosition(const c_entity& entity)
    {
        if (!TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(entity.chest_pos))
            return entity.chest_pos;
        if (!TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(entity.neck_pos))
            return entity.neck_pos;
        if (!TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(entity.head_pos))
            return entity.head_pos;
        return entity.pos;
    }

    bool TryPickSequenceHitTarget(const std::vector<c_entity>& snapshot,
                                  const c_entity& local,
                                  const SequenceRuntime& runtime,
                                  c_entity& outTarget,
                                  int& outIndex)
    {
        if (runtime.hitTargetAddress != 0) {
            for (size_t index = 0; index < snapshot.size(); ++index) {
                const c_entity& entity = snapshot[index];
                if (entity.address == runtime.hitTargetAddress &&
                    IsSequenceHitCandidate(entity, local, false)) {
                    outTarget = entity;
                    outIndex = static_cast<int>(index);
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        const int configuredIndex = Config::Targetenemyi;
        if (TargetingDetail::IsValidIndex(configuredIndex, snapshot.size())) {
            const c_entity& configured = snapshot[static_cast<size_t>(configuredIndex)];
            if (IsSequenceHitCandidate(configured, local, false)) {
                outTarget = configured;
                outIndex = configuredIndex;
                return true;
            }
        }

        const Vector2 crosshair = TargetingDetail::CrosshairCenter();
        const Matrix view = SnapshotViewMatrix();
        float bestScore = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        int bestIndex = -1;
        bool found = false;

        auto scan = [&](bool requireEnemyTeam) {
            for (size_t index = 0; index < snapshot.size(); ++index) {
                const c_entity& entity = snapshot[index];
                if (!IsSequenceHitCandidate(entity, local, requireEnemyTeam))
                    continue;

                const Vector3 position = SequenceHitProbePosition(entity);
                if (TargetingDetail::IsZeroVector(position))
                    continue;

                Vector2 projected{};
                if (!view.WorldToScreen(position, &projected, Vector2(WX, WY), false))
                    continue;

                if (!std::isfinite(projected.X) || !std::isfinite(projected.Y))
                    continue;

                const float score = crosshair.Distance(projected);
                if (score < bestScore) {
                    bestScore = score;
                    bestIndex = static_cast<int>(index);
                    found = true;
                }
            }
        };

        scan(true);
        if (!found)
            scan(false);

        if (!found || !TargetingDetail::IsValidIndex(bestIndex, snapshot.size()))
            return false;

        outTarget = snapshot[static_cast<size_t>(bestIndex)];
        outIndex = bestIndex;
        return true;
    }

    void UpdateSequenceHitTiming(const std::string& skillId, SequenceRuntime& runtime)
    {
        const std::vector<c_entity> snapshot = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        const c_entity local = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        c_entity target{};
        int targetIndex = -1;
        if (!TryPickSequenceHitTarget(snapshot, local, runtime, target, targetIndex))
            return;

        const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
        if (runtime.hitMonitorStarted.time_since_epoch().count() == 0)
            runtime.hitMonitorStarted = now;

        if (!runtime.hitHasSample || runtime.hitTargetAddress != target.address) {
            runtime.hitTargetAddress = target.address;
            runtime.hitLastHealth = target.PlayerHealth;
            runtime.hitLastChange = now;
            runtime.hitHasSample = true;
            runtime.hitDamageEvents = 0;
            Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.hit_target skill=%s index=%d target=0x%llX health=%.1f hero=0x%llX",
                skillId.c_str(),
                targetIndex,
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(target.address),
                target.PlayerHealth,
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(target.HeroID));
            return;
        }

        const float delta = target.PlayerHealth - runtime.hitLastHealth;
        if (std::fabs(delta) < 0.5f)
            return;

        if (delta < 0.0f)
            ++runtime.hitDamageEvents;

        Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.hit_timing skill=%s target=0x%llX index=%d tMs=%lld dtMs=%lld health=%.1f delta=%.1f damageEvents=%d",
            skillId.c_str(),
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(target.address),
            targetIndex,
            MillisecondsSince(runtime.hitMonitorStarted, now),
            MillisecondsSince(runtime.hitLastChange, now),
            target.PlayerHealth,
            delta,
            runtime.hitDamageEvents);

        runtime.hitLastHealth = target.PlayerHealth;
        runtime.hitLastChange = now;
    }

    void ReleaseViewpointOutputs(const std::string& skillId, ViewpointRuntime& runtime)
    {
        (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(ViewpointOwnerKey(skillId));
        runtime.secondaryDown = false;
        runtime.jumpDown = false;
    }

    void CancelSequence(const std::string& skillId, SequenceRuntime& runtime, const char* reason)
    {
        const bool hadWorker = runtime.worker.joinable();
        if (hadWorker) {
            runtime.worker.request_stop();
            runtime.worker.join();
        }

        (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(SequenceOwnerKey(skillId));
        runtime.currentMask = 0;

        LogSequenceHitSummary(skillId, runtime);

        if (runtime.active || hadWorker) {
            ResetAimSmoothingState();
            Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill sequence cancelled. skill=%s reason=%s",
                skillId.c_str(), reason ? reason : "unknown");
        }
        runtime = SequenceRuntime{};
        RefreshAnyInputSequenceActive();
    }

    void CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(const std::string& skillId,
                                            SequenceRuntime& runtime,
                                            const char* reason)
    {
        CancelSequence(skillId, runtime, reason);
        runtime.rearmBlockedUntilRelease = true;
        Diagnostics::Warn(
            "Hero skill sequence rearm blocked until activation release. skill=%s reason=%s",
            skillId.c_str(),
            reason ? reason : "unknown");
    }

    void CancelViewpoint(const std::string& skillId, ViewpointRuntime& runtime, const char* reason)
    {
        const bool wasActive = runtime.phase == ViewpointPhase::PitchDown ||
            runtime.phase == ViewpointPhase::PitchUp;
        ReleaseViewpointOutputs(skillId, runtime);
        runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::Cancelled;
        runtime.lastTick = Clock::now();
        if (wasActive) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill viewpoint controller cancelled. skill=%s reason=%s",
                skillId.c_str(), reason ? reason : "unknown");
        }
    }

    bool TryReadCurrentViewAngles(Vector3& angles)
    {
        Vector3 direction = ReadPlayerControllerViewDirection(
            SDK ? SDK->g_player_controller.load(std::memory_order_acquire) : 0);
        float length = std::sqrt(direction.X * direction.X + direction.Y * direction.Y + direction.Z * direction.Z);
        if (std::isfinite(direction.X) && std::isfinite(direction.Y) &&
            std::isfinite(direction.Z) && length > 0.5f && length < 1.5f) {
            angles = DirectionToAimEuler(direction);
            return true;
        }

        Matrix view{}, viewXor{};
        GetViewMatricesSnapshot(view, viewXor);
        (void)view;
        const DirectX::XMFLOAT3 forward = viewXor.get_rotation();
        length = std::sqrt(forward.x * forward.x + forward.y * forward.y + forward.z * forward.z);
        if (!std::isfinite(forward.x) || !std::isfinite(forward.y) ||
            !std::isfinite(forward.z) || length <= 0.5f || length >= 1.5f) {
            return false;
        }

        angles = DirectionToAimEuler(Vector3(forward.x, forward.y, forward.z));
        return true;
    }

    float NormalizeAngle(float value)
    {
        while (value > kPi)
            value -= 2.0f * kPi;
        while (value < -kPi)
            value += 2.0f * kPi;
        return value;
    }

    float ClampDelta(float delta, float maxStep)
    {
        return std::clamp(delta, -maxStep, maxStep);
    }

    float ClampViewPitchTarget(float pitchRad)
    {
        return std::clamp(pitchRad, -kViewpointPitchLimitRad, kViewpointPitchLimitRad);
    }

    const char* ViewpointPhaseName(int phase)
    {
        switch (phase) {
        case ViewpointPhase::Idle: return "idle";
        case ViewpointPhase::PitchDown: return "pitchDown";
        case ViewpointPhase::PitchUp: return "pitchUp";
        case ViewpointPhase::Completed: return "completed";
        case ViewpointPhase::Cancelled: return "cancelled";
        default: return "unknown";
        }
    }

    bool ShouldLogViewpointTick(ViewpointRuntime& runtime, Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (runtime.lastDebugLog.time_since_epoch().count() != 0 &&
            now - runtime.lastDebugLog < kViewpointDebugInterval) {
            return false;
        }

        runtime.lastDebugLog = now;
        return true;
    }

    bool IsPitchWithin(float targetPitch, float epsilonRad)
    {
        Vector3 current{};
        return TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current) &&
            std::fabs(targetPitch - current.X) <= epsilonRad;
    }

    bool IsYawWithin(float targetYaw, float epsilonRad)
    {
        Vector3 current{};
        return TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current) &&
            std::fabs(NormalizeAngle(targetYaw - current.Y)) <= epsilonRad;
    }

    void LogViewpointTick(const std::string& skillId,
                          ViewpointRuntime& runtime,
                          float targetPitch,
                          float targetYaw,
                          float speedDeg,
                          float deltaSeconds,
                          Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (!Config::aimVerboseLog)
            return;
        if (!ShouldLogViewpointTick(runtime, now))
            return;

        Vector3 current{};
        if (!TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current)) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill viewpoint tick read failed. skill=%s phase=%s",
                skillId.c_str(), ViewpointPhaseName(runtime.phase));
            return;
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint tick. skill=%s phase=%s currentPitch=%.2f targetPitch=%.2f deltaPitch=%.2f currentYaw=%.2f targetYaw=%.2f deltaYaw=%.2f speed=%.2f dt=%.4f fired=%d jumped=%d",
            skillId.c_str(),
            ViewpointPhaseName(runtime.phase),
            current.X * kRadToDeg,
            targetPitch * kRadToDeg,
            (targetPitch - current.X) * kRadToDeg,
            current.Y * kRadToDeg,
            targetYaw * kRadToDeg,
            NormalizeAngle(targetYaw - current.Y) * kRadToDeg,
            speedDeg,
            deltaSeconds,
            runtime.fired ? 1 : 0,
            runtime.jumped ? 1 : 0);
    }

    float DeltaSeconds(ViewpointRuntime& runtime, Clock::time_point now)
    {
        if (runtime.lastTick.time_since_epoch().count() == 0) {
            runtime.lastTick = now;
            return 1.0f / 144.0f;
        }

        const float dt = std::chrono::duration<float>(now - runtime.lastTick).count();
        runtime.lastTick = now;
        return std::clamp(dt, 1.0f / 1000.0f, 0.1f);
    }

    float PickPhaseSpeed(float baseSpeed, float randomRange)
    {
        baseSpeed = std::clamp(baseSpeed, 0.0f, 4000.0f);
        randomRange = std::clamp(randomRange, 0.0f, 4000.0f);
        if (randomRange <= 0.0f)
            return baseSpeed;

        const float low = (std::max)(0.0f, baseSpeed - randomRange);
        const float high = (std::min)(4000.0f, baseSpeed + randomRange);
        if (high <= low)
            return low;

        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distribution(low, high);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_randomMutex);
        return distribution(g_random);
    }

    float PickSignedJitter(float range)
    {
        range = std::clamp(range, 0.0f, 20.0f);
        if (range <= 0.0f)
            return 0.0f;

        std::uniform_real_distribution<float> distribution(-range, range);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_randomMutex);
        return distribution(g_random);
    }

    int PickSequenceDurationMs(const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step)
    {
        float speedScale = step.speedScale;
        if (!std::isfinite(speedScale))
            speedScale = 1.0f;
        speedScale = std::clamp(speedScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);

        float duration = static_cast<float>(std::clamp(step.durationMs, 0, 1000)) * speedScale;
        const int jitterMs = std::clamp(step.jitterMs, 0, 50);
        if (jitterMs > 0) {
            std::uniform_int_distribution<int> distribution(-jitterMs, jitterMs);
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_randomMutex);
            duration += static_cast<float>(distribution(g_random));
        }

        return std::clamp(static_cast<int>(std::lround(duration)), 5, 1000);
    }

    int NominalSequenceDurationMs(const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step)
    {
        float speedScale = std::isfinite(step.speedScale) ? step.speedScale : 1.0f;
        speedScale = std::clamp(speedScale, 0.5f, 2.0f);
        const float duration =
            static_cast<float>(std::clamp(step.durationMs, 0, 1000)) * speedScale;
        return std::clamp(static_cast<int>(std::lround(duration)), 5, 1000);
    }

    bool SequenceShotEdge(int previousMask, int nextMask)
    {
        return (nextMask & 0x01) != 0 && (previousMask & 0x01) == 0;
    }

    AimFirePhase::Tuning SequenceFirePhaseTuning(const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings)
    {
        AimFirePhase::Tuning tuning{};
        tuning.pauseMs = settings.sequencePostFirePauseMs;
        tuning.recoveryMs = settings.sequenceRecoveryMs;
        tuning.pauseYawScale = settings.sequencePostFireYawScale;
        tuning.pausePitchScale = settings.sequencePostFirePitchScale;
        tuning.preFireBoostWindowMs = settings.sequencePreFireBoostWindowMs;
        tuning.preFireBoostScale = settings.sequencePreFireBoostScale;
        return tuning;
    }

    float TimeUntilNextSequenceShotMs(
        const std::vector<Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep>& steps,
        size_t stepIndex,
        float elapsedInStepMs,
        int effectiveDurationMs)
    {
        if (steps.empty())
            return 0.0f;

        stepIndex %= steps.size();
        float remaining = (std::max)(
            0.0f,
            static_cast<float>(effectiveDurationMs) - (std::max)(0.0f, elapsedInStepMs));
        int previousMask = steps[stepIndex].buttonMask;
        for (size_t offset = 1; offset <= steps.size(); ++offset) {
            const size_t nextIndex = (stepIndex + offset) % steps.size();
            const int nextMask = steps[nextIndex].buttonMask;
            if (SequenceShotEdge(previousMask, nextMask))
                return remaining;

            remaining += static_cast<float>(NominalSequenceDurationMs(steps[nextIndex]));
            previousMask = nextMask;
        }

        return 2000.0f;
    }

    AimFirePhase::Phase ResolveSequenceTrackingPhase(
        const std::vector<Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep>& steps,
        const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
        size_t stepIndex,
        Clock::time_point stepStarted,
        int effectiveDurationMs,
        Clock::time_point lastShotStarted)
    {
        if (!settings.sequencePhaseAwareTracking || steps.empty() ||
            stepStarted.time_since_epoch().count() <= 0) {
            return {};
        }

        const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
        const float elapsedInStepMs = static_cast<float>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(now - stepStarted).count()) /
            1000.0f;
        const bool shotObserved = lastShotStarted.time_since_epoch().count() > 0;
        const float elapsedSinceShotMs = shotObserved
            ? static_cast<float>(
                std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(now - lastShotStarted).count()) /
                1000.0f
            : 0.0f;
        const float untilNextShotMs = TimeUntilNextSequenceShotMs(
            steps,
            stepIndex,
            elapsedInStepMs,
            effectiveDurationMs);
        return AimFirePhase::ResolveTimeline(
            elapsedSinceShotMs,
            untilNextShotMs,
            shotObserved,
            SequenceFirePhaseTuning(settings));
    }

    bool EnterSequenceStep(const std::string& skillId,
                           int& currentMask,
                           const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step,
                           std::uint64_t expectedGeneration = 0)
    {
        if (!SetSequenceButtonMask(
                skillId,
                currentMask,
                step.buttonMask,
                expectedGeneration)) {
            return false;
        }
        currentMask = step.buttonMask;
        return true;
    }

    void SleepUntilSequenceDeadline(std::stop_token stopToken, Clock::time_point deadline)
    {
        while (!stopToken.stop_requested()) {
            const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
            if (now >= deadline)
                return;

            const auto remaining = deadline - now;
            if (remaining > std::chrono::milliseconds(2))
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
            else
                std::this_thread::yield();
        }
    }

    const char* SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(SequenceWorkerExitReason reason)
    {
        switch (reason) {
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::Running:       return "running";
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::StopRequested: return "stop_requested";
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::ActivationReleased:return "activation_checkpoint";
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged:return "runtime_changed";
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::AmmoBudget:    return "ammo_guard_budget";
        case SequenceWorkerExitReason::OutputFailure: return "output_failed";
        default:                                      return "unknown";
        }
    }

    bool SequenceWorkerRuntimeStillValid(std::uint64_t startGeneration)
    {
        const OutputRuntimeState current = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        return HeroSkillDetail::SequenceWorkerRuntimeMatches(
            startGeneration,
            current.backendGeneration,
            current.outputGateOpen);
    }

    void RunSequenceWorker(std::stop_token stopToken,
                           std::string skillId,
                           std::vector<Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep> steps,
                           bool ammoGuardEnabled,
                           int ammoGuardReserve,
                           std::uint64_t startGeneration,
                           std::shared_ptr<SequenceWorkerCompletion> completion)
    {
        timeBeginPeriod(1);

        int currentMask = 0;
        size_t stepIndex = 0;
        Clock::time_point lastShotStarted{};
        SequenceWorkerExitReason exitReason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::StopRequested;
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill sequence worker started. skill=%s steps=%zu",
            skillId.c_str(), steps.size());

        while (!stopToken.stop_requested() && !steps.empty()) {
            if (!SequenceWorkerRuntimeStillValid(startGeneration)) {
                exitReason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged;
                break;
            }
            if (stepIndex >= steps.size())
                stepIndex = 0;

            const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step = steps[stepIndex];
            const int durationMs = PickSequenceDurationMs(step);
            if (ConsumeSequenceAmmoBudgetForStep(
                    skillId,
                    currentMask,
                    step.buttonMask,
                    ammoGuardEnabled,
                    ammoGuardReserve)) {
                exitReason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::AmmoBudget;
                break;
            }
            if (!SequenceWorkerRuntimeStillValid(startGeneration)) {
                exitReason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged;
                break;
            }
            const int previousMask = currentMask;
            if (!EnterSequenceStep(
                    skillId,
                    currentMask,
                    step,
                    startGeneration)) {
                exitReason = SequenceWorkerRuntimeStillValid(startGeneration)
                    ? SequenceWorkerExitReason::OutputFailure
                    : SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged;
                break;
            }

            const Clock::time_point stepStarted = Clock::now();
            if (SequenceShotEdge(previousMask, step.buttonMask))
                lastShotStarted = stepStarted;
            if (completion) {
                completion->Publish({stepIndex, stepStarted, durationMs, lastShotStarted});
            }

            if (SequenceDiagnosticsEnabled()) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.step skill=%s step=%zu mask=0x%02X durationMs=%d baseMs=%d scale=%.3f jitterMs=%d",
                    skillId.c_str(),
                    stepIndex + 1,
                    step.buttonMask,
                    durationMs,
                    step.durationMs,
                    step.speedScale,
                    step.jitterMs);
            }

            SleepUntilSequenceDeadline(
                stopToken,
                stepStarted + std::chrono::milliseconds(durationMs));
            ++stepIndex;
        }

        (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(SequenceOwnerKey(skillId));
        timeEndPeriod(1);
        if (completion) {
            completion->reason.store(exitReason, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        Diagnostics::Info(
            "Hero skill sequence worker stopped. skill=%s reason=%s",
            skillId.c_str(),
            SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(exitReason));
    }

    void RunAsheComboWorker(std::stop_token stopToken,
                            std::string skillId,
                            int activationKey,
                            bool ammoGuardEnabled,
                            int ammoGuardReserve,
                            std::uint64_t startGeneration,
                            std::shared_ptr<SequenceWorkerCompletion> completion)
    {
        timeBeginPeriod(1);
        AsheCombo::Runner runner;
        runner.Start();
        AsheCombo::AmmoGate ammoGate;
        if (ammoGuardEnabled && activationKey >= 0)
            (void)V2::Vision::RequestAsheAmmoCapture();
        int currentMask = 0;
        SequenceTimeline timeline;
        SequenceWorkerExitReason reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::StopRequested;
        const auto microseconds = [](Clock::time_point value) {
            return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
                value.time_since_epoch()).count();
        };
        const auto valid = [&] {
            if (stopToken.stop_requested()) return false;
            if (!RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !SkillLogicalOutputAllowed() ||
                Config::Menu.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
                (activationKey >= 0 && !KeyState::SampleVk(
                    Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(activationKey)).available) ||
                !SequenceWorkerRuntimeStillValid(startGeneration)) {
                reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::RuntimeChanged;
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        };
        const auto wait = [&](Clock::time_point until) {
            while (Clock::now() < until) {
                if (!valid()) return false;
                if (until - Clock::now() > std::chrono::milliseconds(2))
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
                else std::this_thread::yield();
            }
            return valid();
        };
        const auto setMask = [&](int nextMask) {
            if (!valid()) return false;
            if (!SetSequenceButtonMask(skillId, currentMask, nextMask, startGeneration)) {
                reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::OutputFailure;
                return false;
            }
            currentMask = nextMask;
            return true;
        };
        Diagnostics::Info("Ashe KOI combo started. skill=%s scopeMs=%d followupMs=%d clickMs=%d shotClock=submitted_complete_click",
            skillId.c_str(), AsheCombo::kScopeWaitMs, AsheCombo::kFollowupWaitMs, AsheCombo::kClickHoldMs);
        while (valid()) {
            const auto now = Clock::now();
            // Read the physical key at the actual checkpoint, independently of
            // main skill-tick latency. Negative keys are the offline test seam.
            const bool held = activationKey >= 0 ? KeyState::SampleVk(
                Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(activationKey)).down
                : completion->activationHeld.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const auto decision = runner.Advance(microseconds(now), held);
            if (decision.finished) {
                reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::ActivationReleased;
                break;
            }
            timeline.asheStage = decision.stage;
            timeline.asheShot = decision.shot;
            timeline.stepStarted = now;
            timeline.stepDurationMs = decision.deadlineUs > 0
                ? static_cast<int>((std::max)(std::int64_t{0}, decision.deadlineUs - microseconds(now)) / 1000) : 0;
            completion->Publish(timeline);
            if (decision.action == AsheCombo::Action::None) {
                // Poll hard cancellation independently of the ordinary skill
                // tick. Activation release is read only at runner checkpoints.
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
                continue;
            }
            if (decision.action == AsheCombo::Action::Click) {
                V2::Vision::AsheAmmoSnapshot ammo;
                bool permitted = false;
                bool waitingReported = false;
                const auto ammoWaitStarted = Clock::now();
                while (valid()) {
                    ammo = V2::Vision::ReadAsheAmmo(true);
                    const auto permit = ammoGate.Check(ammoGuardEnabled, ammo.known,
                        ammo.remaining, ammoGuardReserve, ammo.sequence, ammo.epoch);
                    if (permit == AsheCombo::ShotPermit::Allow) { permitted = true; break; }
                    if (permit == AsheCombo::ShotPermit::ReserveReached) {
                        reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::AmmoBudget;
                        break;
                    }
                    // Unknown OCR is not an empty/full clip. Wait for actual
                    // HUD evidence, with immediate release of owned controls
                    // if the user lets go while this shot is still uncommitted.
                    const bool stillHeld = activationKey >= 0 ? KeyState::SampleVk(
                        Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(activationKey)).down
                        : completion->activationHeld.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                    if (!stillHeld) { reason = SequenceWorkerExitReason::ActivationReleased; break; }
                    if (!waitingReported && Clock::now() - ammoWaitStarted >= std::chrono::milliseconds(150)) {
                        Diagnostics::Info("Ashe ammo wait. skill=%s shot=%d reason=%s sequence=%llu ageMs=%.1f",
                            skillId.c_str(), decision.shot, ammo.known ? "awaiting_new_frame" : "hud_unknown",
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(ammo.sequence), ammo.ageMs);
                        waitingReported = true;
                    }
                    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
                }
                if (!permitted) break;
                if (!setMask(currentMask | 0x01)) break;
                if (!wait(Clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(AsheCombo::kClickHoldMs))) break;
                if (!setMask(currentMask & ~0x01)) break;
                // Only the pitch pause follows submitted input. The observed
                // HUD owns ammunition; rejected game clicks never consume an
                // estimated bullet or prematurely stop the tail of a clip.
                timeline.lastShotStarted = Clock::now();
                ++timeline.submittedShots;
                ammoGate.Submitted(ammo.sequence, ammo.epoch);
                completion->Publish(timeline);
                Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.submitted_shot skill=%s shot=%d total=%llu phase=%d proxy=complete_click",
                    skillId.c_str(), decision.shot,
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(timeline.submittedShots),
                    static_cast<int>(decision.stage));
            } else if (!setMask(decision.action == AsheCombo::Action::ScopeDown ? 0x02 : 0x00)) {
                break;
            }
            runner.Complete(microseconds(Clock::now()));
        }
        (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(SequenceOwnerKey(skillId));
        runner.Cancel();
        completion->reason.store(reason, std::memory_order_release);
        timeEndPeriod(1);
        Diagnostics::Info("Ashe KOI combo stopped. skill=%s reason=%s",
            skillId.c_str(), SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(reason));
    }

    void BeginViewpoint(const std::string& skillId,
                        ViewpointRuntime& runtime,
                        const Config::HeroSkillSettings& params)
    {
        const bool prevKeyDown = runtime.prevKeyDown;
        runtime = ViewpointRuntime{};
        runtime.prevKeyDown = prevKeyDown;

        Vector3 currentAngles{};
        if (!TryReadCurrentViewAngles(currentAngles)) {
            runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::Cancelled;
            Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill viewpoint start failed: no view angle. skill=%s", skillId.c_str());
            return;
        }

        runtime.initialAngles = currentAngles;

        const float pitchDownTargetDeg = std::clamp(params.pitchDownTargetAngle, 0.0f, 180.0f);
        const float effectivePitchDownTarget = ClampViewPitchTarget(pitchDownTargetDeg * kDegToRad);
        const float effectivePitchDownTargetDeg = effectivePitchDownTarget * kRadToDeg;
        const int durationBaseMs = std::clamp(params.pitchDownDurationMs, 20, 100);
        const float durationJitterMs = std::clamp(params.pitchDownDurationJitter, 0.0f, 50.0f);
        const float pitchUpReturnJitterDeg = PickSignedJitter(params.pitchUpOffsetJitter);
        const float durationMs = (std::max)(
            1.0f,
            PickPhaseSpeed(static_cast<float>(durationBaseMs),
                           durationJitterMs));

        runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg = std::clamp((pitchDownTargetDeg / durationMs) * 1000.0f, 0.0f, 4000.0f);
        runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle = ClampViewPitchTarget(runtime.initialAngles.X + pitchUpReturnJitterDeg * kDegToRad);
        const float pitchUpTravelDeg = std::fabs(effectivePitchDownTargetDeg - runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle * kRadToDeg);
        runtime.pitchUpSpeedDeg = std::clamp((pitchUpTravelDeg / durationMs) * 1000.0f, 0.0f, 4000.0f);
        runtime.skillVk = params.runtimeOutputVk;
        runtime.jumpVk = params.runtimeJumpVk;
        runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::PitchDown;
        runtime.phaseStarted = Clock::now();
        runtime.lastTick = runtime.phaseStarted;

        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint started. skill=%s durationMs=%.2f requestedDownTarget=%.2f effectiveDownTarget=%.2f downSpeed=%.2f returnJitter=%.2f effectiveUpTarget=%.2f upSpeed=%.2f initialPitch=%.2f initialYaw=%.2f",
            skillId.c_str(),
            durationMs,
            pitchDownTargetDeg,
            effectivePitchDownTargetDeg,
            runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg,
            pitchUpReturnJitterDeg,
            runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle * kRadToDeg,
            runtime.pitchUpSpeedDeg,
            runtime.initialAngles.X * kRadToDeg,
            runtime.initialAngles.Y * kRadToDeg);
    }

    // Rough device-counts-per-degree constant for fast viewpoint moves.
    // Bypasses sensitivity calibration and move-splitting — we just want raw speed.
    constexpr float kViewpointCountsPerDegree = 18.0f;

    void FastRawMouseMove(float pitchDeg, float yawDeg)
    {
        const int px = static_cast<int>(std::lround(yawDeg * kViewpointCountsPerDegree));
        const int py = static_cast<int>(std::lround(pitchDeg * kViewpointCountsPerDegree));

        if (px == 0 && py == 0)
            return;
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput("fast_raw_mouse_move"))
            return;
        const OutputRuntimeState runtime = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        if (!runtime.outputGateOpen || runtime.backendGeneration == 0)
            return;
        (void)V2::Output::DispatchMouseMoveForGeneration(
            runtime.backendGeneration,
            px,
            py,
            0);
    }

    bool MovePitchToward(float targetPitch, float speedDeg, float deltaSeconds)
    {
        Vector3 current{};
        if (!TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current))
            return false;

        const float deltaPitch = targetPitch - current.X;
        if (std::fabs(deltaPitch) <= kPitchDoneEpsilonRad)
            return true;

        const float maxStepRad = (std::max)(0.0f, speedDeg) * kDegToRad * deltaSeconds;
        if (maxStepRad <= 0.0f)
            return false;

        const float stepRad = ClampDelta(deltaPitch, maxStepRad);
        FastRawMouseMove(stepRad * kRadToDeg, 0.0f);

        return false;
    }

    bool MoveYawToward(float targetYaw, float speedDeg, float deltaSeconds)
    {
        Vector3 current{};
        if (!TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current))
            return false;

        const float deltaYaw = NormalizeAngle(targetYaw - current.Y);
        if (std::fabs(deltaYaw) <= kYawDoneEpsilonRad)
            return true;

        const float maxStepRad = (std::max)(0.0f, speedDeg) * kDegToRad * deltaSeconds;
        if (maxStepRad <= 0.0f)
            return false;

        const float stepRad = ClampDelta(deltaYaw, maxStepRad);
        FastRawMouseMove(0.0f, stepRad * kRadToDeg);

        return false;
    }

    struct ScopedTrackingConfig {
        Config::ScopedLocalConfigOverride configOverride;
        float previousSelectedFov = Config::selectedAimFovDeg;
        bool previousAimPlanEnabled = Config::targetAimPlanEnabled;
        Config::SlotTargetRules previousTargetRules = Config::slotTargetRules;
        explicit ScopedTrackingConfig(const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& params)
        {
            Config::HeroPreset overlay=Config::MakeHeroPresetFromCurrent();
            overlay.behaviorConfigs.clear();overlay.resolvedModeId=-2;
            overlay.aimBehavior=Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(params.aimBehavior);
            overlay.aimMode=Config::IsTrackingBehavior(overlay.aimBehavior)?0:1;
            overlay.aimBehaviorPresetId=Config::ClampAimBehaviorPresetId(params.aimBehaviorPresetId);
            overlay.modeConfigVersion=overlay.aimBehaviorPresetId>=0?1:0;
            overlay.aimMethod=Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(params.method);
            overlay.aimPlan.overrideMotion=true;
            overlay.aimPlan.motion=Config::CaptureBehaviorMotion(overlay.aimBehavior);
            overlay.aimPlan.motion.method=overlay.aimMethod;
            Config::ResolveHeroBehaviorMode(overlay);
            overlay.fov=params.fov;overlay.smooth=params.speedScale;
            // Skill tracking has its own FOV and bone selection. The ordinary
            // Aim Slot's capture/contour and distance-FOV modes cannot narrow
            // this scope (or reject every predicted sequence target).
            overlay.fovMode=Config::kFovModeFixed;
            overlay.dynamicFovPresetId=-1;
            overlay.contourEnabled=false;
            overlay.predictionMode=0;
            overlay.bone=params.bone;overlay.autoBone=params.bone==Config::kAimBoneClosest;
            overlay.aimBoneMask=HeroSkillDetail::TrackingBoneMaskForSelection(params.bone);
            overlay.hitbox=params.hitbox;
            Config::StoreHeroBehaviorMode(overlay);
            Config::ApplyLocalHeroAimPreset(overlay);
            Config::targetAimPlanEnabled = false;
            Config::slotTargetRules.active = false;
            // Custom skill targeting can bypass GetVector3/PublishSelectedAimPlan.
            Config::selectedAimFovDeg = Config::View_Fov();
        }
        ~ScopedTrackingConfig() {
            Config::selectedAimFovDeg = previousSelectedFov;
            Config::targetAimPlanEnabled = previousAimPlanEnabled;
            Config::slotTargetRules = previousTargetRules;
        }
    };

    Vector3 ScaleSkillAimStep(const Vector3& current, const Vector3& command,
                             const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& tracking);

    Vector3 ScaleSequenceAimStep(const Vector3& current, const Vector3& command,
                                const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& tracking,
                                const AimFirePhase::Phase& phase)
    {
        auto axes = tracking;
        axes.yawScale *= std::clamp(phase.yawScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        axes.pitchScale *= std::clamp(phase.pitchScale, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        return ScaleSkillAimStep(current, command, axes);
    }

    void RunTrackingOverlayTick(const std::string& skillId,
                                SequenceRuntime& runtime,
                                const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& params,
                                bool prediction,
                                const AimFirePhase::Phase& phase = {})
    {
        const int behavior = Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(params.aimBehavior);
        const float trackingScale = std::clamp(phase.trackingScale, 0.0f, 3.0f);
        if (params.fov <= 0.0f || params.speedScale <= 0.0f || trackingScale <= 0.0f)
            return;

        Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams effectiveParams = params;
        effectiveParams.speedScale = std::clamp(params.speedScale * trackingScale, 0.0f, 300.0f);
        ScopedTrackingConfig trackingOverride(effectiveParams);
        const int method = Config::ActiveAimBehaviorPreset(behavior)
            ? Config::AimBehaviorMethod(behavior)
            : Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(params.method);
        const Vector3 targetVector = GetVector3(prediction);
        c_entity target{};
        if (AimbotDetail::IsZeroVector(targetVector) ||
            !AimbotDetail::IsPrimaryTargetActionable(target)) {
            if (runtime.aimTarget[0]) {
                ResetAimSmoothingState();
                runtime.aimTarget = {};
            }
            return;
        }
        const auto body = SkillBodyIdentity(target);
        if (runtime.aimTarget != body) {
            ResetAimSmoothingState();
            runtime.aimTarget = body;
        }

        const float smoothInput = Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(behavior, effectiveParams.speedScale);
        AimbotDetail::AimData aim = AimbotDetail::BuildAimData(
            targetVector,
            Config::IsFlickBehavior(behavior),
            smoothInput,
            Config::AimBehaviorAcceleration(behavior),
            method, -1.0f, true, true, false);
        if (aim.valid && !AimbotDetail::IsZeroVector(aim.smoothed_angle)) {
            const Vector3 outputAngle = ScaleSequenceAimStep(
                aim.local_angle, aim.smoothed_angle, params, phase);
            AimbotDetail::MoveAimDelta(aim.local_angle, outputAngle);
            if (Config::aimVerboseLog) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.aim_tick skill=%s behavior=%d method=%d speedScale=%.3f phaseScale=%.3f yawScale=%.3f pitchScale=%.3f paused=%d recovery=%d prefire=%d fov=%.3f prediction=%d targetIndex=%d",
                    skillId.c_str(),
                    behavior,
                    method,
                    effectiveParams.speedScale,
                    trackingScale,
                    params.yawScale / 100.0f * phase.yawScale,
                    params.pitchScale / 100.0f * phase.pitchScale,
                    phase.paused ? 1 : 0,
                    phase.recovering ? 1 : 0,
                    phase.preFireBoost ? 1 : 0,
                    params.fov,
                    prediction ? 1 : 0,
                    Config::Targetenemyi);
            }
        }
    }

    bool IsFiniteVector(const Vector3& value)
    {
        return std::isfinite(value.X) && std::isfinite(value.Y) && std::isfinite(value.Z);
    }

    bool IsUsablePosition(const Vector3& value)
    {
        return IsFiniteVector(value) && value != Vector3(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
    }

    Vector3 SourcePositionForAction(const c_entity& local)
    {
        const Vector3 camera = TargetingDetail::CameraPosition();
        if (IsUsablePosition(camera))
            return camera;
        if (IsUsablePosition(local.head_pos))
            return local.head_pos;
        return local.pos;
    }

    Vector3 CandidatePositionForAction(const c_entity& entity)
    {
        if (IsUsablePosition(entity.head_pos))
            return entity.head_pos;
        if (IsUsablePosition(entity.chest_pos))
            return entity.chest_pos;
        if (IsUsablePosition(entity.neck_pos))
            return entity.neck_pos;
        return entity.pos;
    }

    float VitalityPercent(const c_entity& entity)
    {
        if (!std::isfinite(entity.PlayerHealth) || entity.PlayerHealth <= 0.0f)
            return 100.0f;

        float maxHealth = entity.PlayerHealthMax;
        if (!std::isfinite(maxHealth) || maxHealth <= 0.0f)
            maxHealth = entity.MaxHealth;
        if (!std::isfinite(maxHealth) || maxHealth <= 0.0f)
            return 100.0f;

        return std::clamp((entity.PlayerHealth / maxHealth) * 100.0f, 0.0f, 100.0f);
    }

    TrajectoryParams GetTrajectoryParams(const HeroSkillDefinition& definition)
    {
        const auto& defaults = definition.defaultSettings;
        TrajectoryParams params{defaults.projectileSpeed, defaults.distance,
            defaults.projectileGravity ? 9.8f : 0.f, defaults.projectileRadius, defaults.preFireDelayMs};
        const std::string id = definition.skillId;
        const std::string physicsId = definition.castGroup && *definition.castGroup ? definition.castGroup : id;
        if (const auto* physics = FindProjectilePhysicsProfile(
                physicsId == "energy-javelin" ? "orisa_energy_javelin" :
                physicsId == "particle-bomb" ? "zarya_particle_cannon_alt" : physicsId)) {
            if (params.speed <= 0) params.speed = physics->referenceSpeed;
            params.gravity = physics->gravityAcceleration;
            params.launchDirectionUpBias = physics->launchDirectionUpBias;
            params.preFireDelayMs = (std::max)(params.preFireDelayMs, physics->castDelayMs);
        }
        return params;
    }

    SkillProjectileRuntime ResolveSkillProjectileRuntime(const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                                         const TrajectoryParams& params,
                                                         std::string_view profileId = {})
    {
        ProjectileSpec fallback{};
        fallback.enabledByDefault = params.speed > 0.0f;
        // Legacy skill fields are used only while creating a missing shared
        // profile. Once created, all consumers read the shared profile.
        fallback.projectileSpeed = settings.projectileSpeed > 0.0f
            ? settings.projectileSpeed : params.speed;
        fallback.gravity = settings.projectileGravity || params.gravity > 0.0f;
        fallback.projectileRadius = settings.projectileRadius > 0.0f
            ? settings.projectileRadius : params.projectileRadius;
        fallback.gravityAcceleration = params.gravity > 0.0f ? params.gravity : 9.8f;
        fallback.castDelayMs = settings.preFireDelayMs > 0.0f
            ? settings.preFireDelayMs : params.preFireDelayMs;
        const PredictionProfile profile = profileId.empty()
            ? PredictionProfile{}
            : ResolvePredictionProfile(profileId, 0, 0, fallback);
        const ProjectileSpec& shared = profileId.empty() ? fallback : profile.projectile;
        SkillProjectileRuntime runtime{};
        runtime.speed = shared.projectileSpeed;
        runtime.maxRange = params.maxRange;
        runtime.gravity = shared.gravity;
        runtime.gravityAcceleration = shared.gravityAcceleration > 0.0f
            ? shared.gravityAcceleration : (runtime.gravity ? 9.8f : 0.0f);
        runtime.launchDirectionUpBias = shared.launchDirectionUpBias;
        runtime.projectileRadius = shared.projectileRadius;
        runtime.preFireDelayMs = shared.castDelayMs;
        runtime.algorithm = OW::ClampPredictionAlgorithm(settings.predictionAlgorithm);
        return runtime;
    }



    Vector3 SkillAimPointForEntity(c_entity& entity, int boneSetting)
    {
        Vector3 aimPoint = TargetingDetail::ConfiguredBonePosition(entity, boneSetting);
        if (IsUsablePosition(aimPoint))
            return aimPoint;
        return CandidatePositionForAction(entity);
    }

    bool ResolveSkillAimPointForEntity(c_entity& entity,
                                       int boneSetting,
                                       const TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext& fovContext,
                                       int& outBoneId,
                                       Vector3& outPoint,
                                       int pinnedBoneId = -1)
    {
        if (pinnedBoneId >= 0) {
            outBoneId = pinnedBoneId;
            outPoint = TargetingDetail::CoreBoneHitboxCenter(entity, pinnedBoneId);
            return IsUsablePosition(outPoint) && outPoint != entity.pos;
        }
        if (boneSetting == Config::kAimBoneClosest) {
            const Matrix view = OW::SnapshotViewMatrix();
            const Vector2 crosshair = TargetingDetail::CrosshairCenter();
            if (TargetingDetail::TrySelectClosestCoreAimPoint(
                    entity,
                    fovContext,
                    view,
                    crosshair,
                    outBoneId,
                    outPoint)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        const int normalizedBone = Config::NormalizeAimBone(boneSetting);
        outBoneId = AimBoneToSkeletonBoneId(normalizedBone);
        outPoint = SkillAimPointForEntity(entity, normalizedBone);
        return IsUsablePosition(outPoint);
    }

    float ResolveSkillHitWindow(const c_entity& entity,
                                int boneId,
                                const SkillProjectileRuntime& projectile,
                                float hitboxScalePercent)
    {
        // Aim, Trigger and Hero Skill consumers use the same native-shape
        // resolver.  The compiled bone radius remains the documented offline
        // fallback when the current native sample is unavailable.
        return ResolveEffectiveHitWindow(
            entity,
            boneId,
            nullptr,
            hitboxScalePercent,
            Config::kLegacyDefaultHitboxRadius,
            projectile.projectileRadius);
    }

    float ResolveMeleeHitWindow(const c_entity& entity,
                                int boneId,
                                float hitboxScalePercent,
                                float expansion)
    {
        // Melee range expansion is a separate world-space trigger margin. It
        // must not be treated as projectile radius or be scaled by the
        // per-skill hitbox percentage.
        const float baseWindow = ResolveEffectiveHitWindow(
            entity,
            boneId,
            nullptr,
            hitboxScalePercent,
            Config::kLegacyDefaultHitboxRadius);
        return (std::max)(0.0f, baseWindow) + (std::max)(0.0f, expansion);
    }

    struct AutoMeleeScanStats {
        int selectable = 0;
        int healthReady = 0;
        int rangeReadyBones = 0;
    };

    SkillAimCandidate FindBestAutoMeleeCandidate(const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                                AutoMeleeScanStats& stats)
    {
        SkillAimCandidate best{};
        const float effectiveRange = settings.distance;
        if (!std::isfinite(effectiveRange) || effectiveRange <= 0.0f)
            return best;

        const c_entity local = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        const TargetingDetail::FovRuntimeContext view =
            TargetingDetail::SnapshotFovRuntimeContext();
        if (!view.valid)
            return best;

        const std::vector<c_entity> snapshot = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        const float expansion = std::clamp(settings.meleeRadius, 0.0f, 2.0f);
        float bestScore = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        float bestDistance = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();

        for (size_t index = 0; index < snapshot.size(); ++index) {
            const c_entity& entity = snapshot[index];
            if (!TargetingDetail::IsSelectableCandidate(entity, 0, local))
                continue;
            if (Config::View_aimbotIgnoreInvisible() && !entity.Vis)
                continue;
            if (entity.skill1act && entity.HeroID == eHero::HERO_VENTURE)
                continue;
            ++stats.selectable;
            if (!AutoMelee::HealthEligible(entity.PlayerHealth, entity.PlayerHealthMax, settings))
                continue;
            ++stats.healthReady;

            // Check each window before ranking: a small, closer-to-center bone
            // must not hide a wider valid hit on another part of the body.
            for (size_t slot = 0; slot < entity.skeleton_bones.size(); ++slot) {
                int boneId = 0;
                Vector3 point{};
                if (!TargetingDetail::TryResolveSkeletonBonePoint(entity, slot, boneId, point))
                    continue;
                const float distance = view.camera.DistTo(point);
                if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance > effectiveRange)
                    continue;
                ++stats.rangeReadyBones;
                const float radius = ResolveMeleeHitWindow(
                    entity,
                    boneId,
                    settings.tracking.hitbox,
                    expansion);
                if (!AutoMelee::InWindow(view, point, radius, effectiveRange))
                    continue;
                const float score = TargetingDetail::FovScoreDeg(view, point);
                if (!std::isfinite(score) ||
                    !(score < bestScore ||
                      (std::fabs(score - bestScore) <= 0.001f && distance < bestDistance)))
                    continue;

                best.valid = true;
                best.entity = entity;
                best.entityIndex = static_cast<int>(index);
                best.entityKey = entity.address ? entity.address : entity.LinkBase;
                best.boneId = boneId;
                best.distance = distance;
                best.vitalityPercent = entity.PlayerHealth;
                best.fovScore = score;
                best.hitWindow = radius;
                best.rawAimPoint = point;
                best.aimPoint = point;
                bestScore = score;
                bestDistance = distance;
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    bool SkillAimWindowContains(const Vector3& observed, const Vector3& source,
                                const Vector3& point, float radius)
    {
        if (!IsFiniteVector(observed) || !IsFiniteVector(source) || !IsFiniteVector(point) ||
            !std::isfinite(radius) || radius <= 0.f) return false;
        const auto delta = point - source;
        const float distance = delta.Size();
        if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance <= 0.0001f) return false;
        auto direction = delta / distance;
