        if (!(genjiDash ? TryStartGenjiDash(runtimeKey,SkillOutputVk(settings),local,
                                            MemoryMaskForInputAction(definition.inputAction))
                       : StartSkillOutput(runtimeKey,definition,settings,local,kBriefPulse))) return false;
        RecordTrajectoryCast(runtimeKey,definition,settings);
        session.Block();
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill aimed trajectory fired. skill=%s targetIndex=%d distance=%.2f projectileSpeed=%.1f",
            definition.skillId, candidate.entityIndex, candidate.distance, projectile.speed);
        return true;
    }

    bool UpdateMeleeMemoryPulse(bool keepHolding) {
        const auto update = V2::Output::GameActions::UpdateMelee(keepHolding);
        if (update.wasOwned && !update.owned)
            Diagnostics::Info("Auto melee memory pulse ended. cleared=%d", update.ok ? 1 : 0);
        if (!update.ok && update.owned && ShouldLogSkillGuard("melee_memory_release"))
            Diagnostics::Warn("Auto melee memory cleanup pending; retrying only on the same current body.");
        return update.ok;
    }

    uint32_t MemoryMaskForInputAction(HeroSkillInputAction action) {
        using V2::Output::GameActions::Action;
        using V2::Output::GameActions::ActionMask;
        switch (action) {
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1: return ActionMask(Action::Ability1);
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability2: return ActionMask(Action::Ability2);
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability3: return ActionMask(Action::Ability3);
        case HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate: return ActionMask(Action::Ultimate);
        case HeroSkillInputAction::QuickMelee: return ActionMask(Action::Melee);
        default: return 0;
        }
    }

    bool StartSkillMemoryPulse(const std::string& runtimeKey, const c_entity& local,
                               uint32_t actionMask, uint64_t holdMs) {
        if (!SkillLogicalOutputAllowed() || !g_skillMemoryOwnership.key.empty()) return false;
        using Action = V2::HeroSettings::Action;
        const auto action = actionMask == 0x8 ? Action::Ability1 : actionMask == 0x10 ? Action::Ability2 :
            actionMask == 0x40 ? Action::Ability3 : actionMask == 0x20 ? Action::Ultimate : Action::Melee;
        const int vk = V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID, action);
        if (!CanSubmitSkillAction(runtimeKey, vk)) return false;
        // Retain the owner even on a partial failed write until release cleanup succeeds.
        g_skillMemoryOwnership = {runtimeKey, GetTickCount64() + holdMs, false};
        if (!V2::Output::GameActions::StartSkill(local, actionMask, holdMs, Config::aimDryRun)) {
            UpdateOwnedSkillMemoryPulse(false);
            return false;
        }
        // An accepted request is a bounded attempt, not a confirmed cooldown.
        g_lastOutputActions[vk] = Clock::now();
        return true;
    }

    bool StartSkillOutput(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                          const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                          const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                          const c_entity& local,
                          std::chrono::milliseconds duration) {
        const uint32_t memoryMask = MemoryMaskForInputAction(definition.inputAction);
        if (memoryMask) {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
            if (!mem.IsProcessInitialized())
                return StartTimedHotkey(runtimeKey, SkillOutputVk(settings), duration);
#endif
            return StartSkillMemoryPulse(runtimeKey, local, memoryMask, 55);
        }
        return StartTimedHotkey(runtimeKey, SkillOutputVk(settings), duration);
    }

    bool EvaluateAutoMeleeAction(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                                 const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                 const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings)
    {
        AutoMeleeScanStats stats{};
        const SkillAimCandidate candidate = FindBestAutoMeleeCandidate(settings, stats);
        if (!candidate.valid) {
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":melee_scan")) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("melee.scan skill=%s selectable=%d healthReady=%d rangeReadyBones=%d healthMode=%d hpThreshold=%.1f percentThreshold=%.1f maxDistance=%.2f expansion=%.2f",
                    runtimeKey.c_str(), stats.selectable, stats.healthReady, stats.rangeReadyBones,
                    settings.meleeHealthMode, settings.enemyHealthThreshold, settings.meleeHealthPercent,
                    settings.distance, settings.meleeRadius);
            }
            return false;
        }
        if (IsActionDebounced(runtimeKey))
            return false;

        if (!V2::Output::GameActions::StartMelee(TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity(), Config::aimDryRun)) {
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":melee_output"))
                Diagnostics::Warn("Auto melee memory press rejected. skill=%s", runtimeKey.c_str());
            return false;
        }

        MarkActionExecuted(runtimeKey);
        Diagnostics::Info("Auto melee memory press written. skill=%s targetIndex=%d distance=%.2f hp=%.1f fovScore=%.2f bone=%d hitWindow=%.3f offset=0x121C mask=0x800 holdMs=50",
            definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "",
            candidate.entityIndex,
            candidate.distance,
            candidate.vitalityPercent,
            candidate.fovScore,
            candidate.boneId,
            candidate.hitWindow);
        return true;
    }


    void CancelRocketPunch()
    {
        if (g_rocketPunch.masked) {
            (void)ReleasePhysicalMouseMaskLease(g_rocketPunch.maskKey,
                OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction, g_rocketPunch.generation);
        }
        g_rocketPunch = {};
        g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }

    bool ReleaseRocketPunchInput(const std::string& runtimeKey, uint64_t generation)
    {
        const int secondary=MappedMouseButton(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary);
        if(secondary<0)return false;
        bool released = false;
        (void)TimedOutputScheduler().ReleaseManualControlOrExecuteIfUnownedForGeneration(
            runtimeKey, OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction,
            { OutputControlKind::MouseButton, static_cast<uint16_t>(secondary) }, generation,
            [&released,secondary](uint64_t expectedGeneration) {
                released = V2::Output::DispatchForceReleaseMouseButtonForGeneration(expectedGeneration, secondary) == success;
                return released;
            });
        return released;
    }

    SkillAimCandidate FindRocketPunchCandidate(const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                               const c_entity& local, float fraction)
    {
        SkillAimCandidate best{};
        const Vector3 source = SourcePositionForAction(local);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(source) || !IsUsablePosition(local.pos))
            return best;
        // shortcut: conservative normal-punch reach estimate; calibrate against live charge data.
        const float reach = (std::min)(settings.distance, 20.0f * fraction);
        const float speed = 15.0f + 20.0f * fraction;
        const auto fov = TargetingDetail::SnapshotFovRuntimeContext();
        const auto entities = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        float bestScore = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        for (size_t index = 0; index < entities.size(); ++index) {
            c_entity entity = entities[index];
            if (!TargetingDetail::IsSelectableCandidate(entity, 0, local) ||
                !entity.Vis || !IsUsablePosition(entity.pos) ||
                VitalityPercent(entity) > settings.enemyHealthThreshold)
                continue;
            Vector3 point = entity.pos;
            float distance = DoomfistPunch::HorizontalDistance(point.X-local.pos.X, point.Z-local.pos.Z);
            if (!DoomfistPunch::InReach(distance, point.Y-local.pos.Y, reach,
                    settings.punchMaxHeightAbove, settings.punchMaxHeightBelow))
                continue;
            // Prediction is always part of the V2 skill target pipeline.
            // Predict travel on the ground plane. Vertical velocity never
            // tilts the punch.
            if (!IsFiniteVector(entity.velocity))
                continue;
            point = point + entity.velocity * (distance / speed);
            distance = DoomfistPunch::HorizontalDistance(point.X-local.pos.X, point.Z-local.pos.Z);
            if (!DoomfistPunch::InReach(distance, point.Y-local.pos.Y, reach,
                    settings.punchMaxHeightAbove, settings.punchMaxHeightBelow))
                continue;
            point.Y = source.Y;
            float score = 0.0f;
            if (!TargetingDetail::IsWithinFovDeg(fov, point, settings.tracking.fov, &score) ||
                score >= bestScore)
                continue;
            best = {};
            best.valid = true;
            best.entity = entity;
            best.entityIndex = static_cast<int>(index);
            best.distance = distance;
            best.aimPoint = point;
            const SkillProjectileRuntime projectile{ speed, reach, false, 0.0f, 0.0f };
            best.hitWindow = ResolveSkillHitWindow(entity, BONE_CHEST, projectile, settings.tracking.hitbox);
            bestScore = score;
        }
        return best;
    }

    void EvaluateRocketPunch(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                             const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                             const c_entity& local)
    {
        const int secondary=MappedMouseButton(V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary);
        if(secondary<0){CancelRocketPunch();return;} // Physical keyboard masking is not supported by the current transport.
        const uint32_t secondaryMask=1u<<secondary;

        auto& runtime = g_rocketPunch;
        const auto applied = V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot();
        const auto connection = ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const auto scene = EntitySceneGeneration();
        if (runtime.generation != applied.generation || runtime.connection != connection ||
            runtime.scene != scene) {
            CancelRocketPunch();
            runtime.generation = applied.generation;
            runtime.connection = connection;
            runtime.scene = scene;
            runtime.maskKey = runtimeKey + ":physical_rmb_mask";
        }
        const uint64_t now = GetTickCount64();
        const auto physical = V2::Output::ActivePhysicalInput();
        const bool fresh = physical.available && physical.sampledAtMs != 0 &&
            now >= physical.sampledAtMs && now - physical.sampledAtMs <= 250;
        if (!V2::Output::SupportsMouseMask(applied.descriptor) ||
            !HasFreshViewMatrices() || local.PlayerHealth <= 0.0f || Config::aimDryRun) {
            CancelRocketPunch();
            if (IsActivationKeyHeld(settings.key) && ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":punch_input"))
                Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch blocked reason=mask_or_scene_unavailable dryRun=%d", Config::aimDryRun);
            return;
        }
        if (runtime.masked) {
            // Never use DMA KeyState here: our own mask makes the game see RMB up.
            if (DoomfistPunch::RestoreMouseAfterRelease(now - runtime.releasedAtMs,
                    fresh, (physical.buttons & secondaryMask) != 0)) {
                const bool restored = ReleasePhysicalMouseMaskLease(runtime.maskKey,
                    OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction, runtime.generation);
                if (restored) {
                    runtime.masked = false;
                    runtime.unmaskedAtMs = now;
                }
                if (restored || ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":punch_restore"))
                    Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch restore accepted=%d elapsedMs=%llu monitorFresh=%d physicalRight=%d",
                        restored, now-runtime.releasedAtMs, fresh, (physical.buttons & secondaryMask) != 0);
            }
            return;
        }
        // Allow the mask restoration and the next DMA poll to settle before accepting an up sample.
        if (runtime.unmaskedAtMs != 0 && now - runtime.unmaskedAtMs < 100)
            return;
        const auto rightSample = KeyState::SampleVk(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary));
        const auto assistSample = KeyState::SampleVk(Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key));
        if (!rightSample.available || !assistSample.available) {
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":punch_keys"))
                Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch blocked reason=dma_key_sample_unavailable");
            return;
        }
        const bool rightDown = rightSample.down;
        const auto leftSample = KeyState::SampleVk(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary));
        const unsigned cancelInputs = (leftSample.available && leftSample.down ? 1u : 0u) |
            (AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID, V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability1)) ? 2u : 0u) |
            (AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID, V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ability2)) ? 4u : 0u) |
            (AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(local.HeroID, V2::HeroSettings::Action::Ultimate)) ? 8u : 0u);
        if (rightDown && cancelInputs && !runtime.charge.blocked) {
            Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch blocked reason=cancel_input keys=0x%X elapsedMs=%llu",
                cancelInputs, runtime.charge.charging ? now-runtime.charge.startedMs : 0);
            runtime.charge.Block();
        }
        const bool assistHeld = assistSample.down;
        const bool wasBlocked = runtime.charge.blocked;
        const bool active = runtime.charge.Update(now, rightDown, assistHeld,
            settings.punchMaxHoldMs, settings.punchReleaseLeadMs);
        const bool ownsAim = (runtime.charge.released && assistHeld) ||
            (rightDown && (runtime.charge.requested || assistHeld));
        const bool previouslyOwned = g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.exchange(ownsAim, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        if (ownsAim && !previouslyOwned) {
            TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
            TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
        }
        if (!wasBlocked && runtime.charge.blocked && runtime.charge.requested)
            Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch blocked reason=%s elapsedMs=%llu",
                DoomfistPunch::BlockReasonName(runtime.charge.blockReason), now-runtime.charge.startedMs);
        if (!active) {
            if (assistHeld && ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":punch_inactive"))
                Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch inactive rightDown=%d armed=%d blocked=%d released=%d monitorFresh=%d reason=%s elapsedMs=%llu maxHoldMs=%.0f",
                    rightDown, runtime.charge.armed, runtime.charge.blocked, runtime.charge.released, fresh,
                    DoomfistPunch::BlockReasonName(runtime.charge.blockReason),
                    runtime.charge.charging ? now-runtime.charge.startedMs : 0, settings.punchMaxHoldMs);
            return;
        }
        const float elapsed = static_cast<float>(now - runtime.charge.startedMs);
        const float fraction = DoomfistPunch::ChargeFraction(elapsed, settings.punchFullChargeMs);
        ScopedTrackingConfig trackingOverride(settings.tracking);
        const auto candidate = FindRocketPunchCandidate(settings, local, fraction);
        if (!candidate.valid || settings.tracking.fov <= 0.0f || settings.tracking.speedScale <= 0.0f) {
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(runtimeKey + ":punch_target"))
                Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch waiting reason=no_eligible_target_or_aim_disabled elapsedMs=%.1f fraction=%.3f", elapsed, fraction);
            return;
        }
        const int behavior = Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(settings.tracking.aimBehavior);
        auto aim = AimbotDetail::BuildAimData(candidate.aimPoint, Config::IsFlickBehavior(behavior),
            Config::AimBehaviorSmoothInput(behavior, settings.tracking.speedScale),
            Config::AimBehaviorAcceleration(behavior), Config::AimBehaviorMethod(behavior));
        if (!IsFiniteVector(aim.local_angle) || !IsFiniteVector(aim.target_angle) ||
            !IsFiniteVector(aim.smoothed_angle) || candidate.hitWindow <= 0.0f)
            return;
        const float yawError = std::fabs(NormalizeAngle(aim.target_angle.Y - aim.local_angle.Y));
        const float tolerance = std::atan2(candidate.hitWindow, candidate.distance);
        if (yawError > tolerance) {
            aim.smoothed_angle.X = aim.local_angle.X;
            aim.smoothed_angle.Z = aim.local_angle.Z;
            AimbotDetail::MoveAimDelta(aim.local_angle, aim.smoothed_angle);
            return;
        }
        // Release only from an observed aligned view; queued motion may run after button output.
        if (TimedOutputScheduler().IsControlHeld({ OutputControlKind::MouseButton, static_cast<uint16_t>(secondary) }))
            return;
        if (!AcquirePhysicalMouseMaskLease(runtime.maskKey, OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction,
                secondaryMask, runtime.generation)) {
            runtime.charge.Block(DoomfistPunch::BlockReason::OutputFailure);
            Diagnostics::Warn("doomfist.punch blocked reason=physical_mask_failed");
            return;
        }
        runtime.masked = true;
        runtime.releasedAtMs = GetTickCount64();
        runtime.charge.Block(DoomfistPunch::BlockReason::OutputFailure);
        const bool beforeDeadline = static_cast<float>(runtime.releasedAtMs - runtime.charge.startedMs) <
            settings.punchMaxHoldMs - settings.punchReleaseLeadMs;
        const bool released = beforeDeadline && ReleaseRocketPunchInput(runtimeKey, runtime.generation);
        if (released)
            runtime.charge.MarkReleased();
        Diagnostics::Info("doomfist.punch release accepted=%d targetIndex=%d distance=%.2f chargeMs=%llu yawErrorDeg=%.3f deadline=%d",
            released, candidate.entityIndex, candidate.distance,
            runtime.releasedAtMs-runtime.charge.startedMs, yawError*kRadToDeg, beforeDeadline);
        if (!released) {
            const bool restored = ReleasePhysicalMouseMaskLease(runtime.maskKey,
                OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction, runtime.generation);
            runtime.masked = !restored;
            if (restored)
                runtime.unmaskedAtMs = GetTickCount64();
        }
    }

    bool EvaluateHealthThresholdAction(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                                       const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                       const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                       const c_entity& local)
    {
        const bool absolute = SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute);
        const float currentHealth = absolute ? local.PlayerHealth : VitalityPercent(local);
        if (!FreshHealthForSkill(local) || !FreshLocalActionReady(definition, local) ||
            !settings.healthTriggerEnabled || !SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(
                local.PlayerHealth, local.PlayerHealthMax, settings.healthThreshold, absolute) ||
            IsActionDebounced(runtimeKey))
            return false;

        const int vk = SkillOutputVk(settings);
        if (!StartSkillOutput(runtimeKey, definition, settings, local, kBriefPulse))
            return false;

        MarkActionExecuted(runtimeKey);
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill health-threshold action fired. skill=%s health=%.1f threshold=%.1f absolute=%d vk=%d",
            definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "",
            currentHealth,
            settings.healthThreshold,
            absolute ? 1 : 0,
            vk);
        return true;
    }

    bool IsThreatSkillActiveForDefensiveResponse(const std::string& skillId, const c_entity& entity)
    {
        if (skillId == "wraith-form" || skillId == "recall" || skillId == "dancing-blaze") {
            const uint32_t now = GetTickCount();
            const int index = SkillConditions::NormalThreatIndex(entity.HeroID);
            if (index < 0 || !SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[index].incoming) return false;
            const auto slot = SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[index].slot;
            return SkillConditions::FreshActive(slot == 0 ? entity.skill1act : entity.skill2act,
                entity.skill_active_tick_ms[slot], now);
        }

        if (skillId == "transcendence") {
            // EMP/Earthshatter activation is not present in the published snapshot.
            // Charge alone must not spend our ultimate; enable when that signal exists.
            return false;
        }

        return false;
    }

    bool IsEnemyFacingLocalHorizontal(const c_entity& enemy,
                                      const c_entity& local,
                                      float coneAngleDeg = 25.0f)
    {
        const Vector3 enemyPoint = CandidatePositionForAction(enemy);
        Vector3 localPoint = CandidatePositionForAction(local);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(localPoint))
            localPoint = SourcePositionForAction(local);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(enemyPoint) || !IsUsablePosition(localPoint))
            return false;

        Vector3 toLocal = localPoint - enemyPoint;
        toLocal.Y = 0.0f;
        const float toLocalLength = toLocal.Size();
        if (!std::isfinite(toLocalLength) || toLocalLength <= 0.0001f)
            return false;
        toLocal = toLocal / toLocalLength;

        Vector3 enemyForward(std::sin(enemy.Rot.X), 0.0f, std::cos(enemy.Rot.X));
        const float forwardLength = enemyForward.Size();
        if (!std::isfinite(forwardLength) || forwardLength <= 0.0001f)
            return false;
        enemyForward = enemyForward / forwardLength;

        const float dot = std::clamp(enemyForward | toLocal, -1.0f, 1.0f);
        const float threshold = std::cos(std::clamp(coneAngleDeg, 1.0f, 90.0f) * kDegToRad);
        return dot >= threshold;
    }

    bool FindDefensiveThreatCandidate(const std::string& skillId,
                                      const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                      const c_entity& local,
                                      SkillAimCandidate& outCandidate)
    {
        const float effectiveRange = settings.distance;
        if (!std::isfinite(effectiveRange) || effectiveRange <= 0.0f)
            return false;

        const Vector3 source = SourcePositionForAction(local);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(source))
            return false;

        const std::vector<c_entity> snapshot = TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities();
        float bestDistance = (std::numeric_limits<float>::max)();
        for (size_t index = 0; index < snapshot.size(); ++index) {
            c_entity entity = snapshot[index];
            if (!TargetingDetail::IsSelectableCandidate(entity, 0, local))
                continue;
            if (!entity.Vis)
                continue;
            if (!IsThreatSkillActiveForDefensiveResponse(skillId, entity))
                continue;
            const int threatIndex = SkillConditions::NormalThreatIndex(entity.HeroID);
            if (threatIndex < 0 || !(settings.normalThreatMask & (1 << threatIndex))) continue;
            const int activeSlot = SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[threatIndex].slot;
            const unsigned responder = skillId == "wraith-form" ? 1u : skillId == "recall" ? 2u : 4u;
            const auto event = g_defensiveThreats.find(entity.address);
            if (event == g_defensiveThreats.end() || event->second.body != SkillBodyIdentity(entity) ||
                !event->second.events[activeSlot].CanRespond(responder)) continue;
            if ((skillId == "wraith-form" || skillId == "recall" || skillId == "dancing-blaze") &&
                !IsEnemyFacingLocalHorizontal(entity, local)) {
                continue;
            }

            const Vector3 position = CandidatePositionForAction(entity);
            if (!IsUsablePosition(position))
                continue;

            const float distance = source.DistTo(position);
            if (!std::isfinite(distance) || distance > effectiveRange)
                continue;

            if (distance < bestDistance) {
                outCandidate = {};
                outCandidate.valid = true;
                outCandidate.threatSlot = activeSlot;
                outCandidate.entity = entity;
                outCandidate.entityIndex = static_cast<int>(index);
                outCandidate.entityKey = entity.address ? entity.address : entity.LinkBase;
                outCandidate.distance = distance;
                outCandidate.vitalityPercent = VitalityPercent(entity);
                outCandidate.rawAimPoint = position;
                outCandidate.aimPoint = position;
                bestDistance = distance;
            }
        }

        return outCandidate.valid;
    }

    bool EvaluateDefensiveResponseAction(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                                         const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                         const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                         const c_entity& local)
    {
        if (!FreshLocalActionReady(definition, local) || IsActionDebounced(runtimeKey))
            return false;

        const std::string skillId = definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "";
        bool healthTrigger = false;
        if (settings.healthTriggerEnabled && (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute) ||
            SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthThreshold))) {
            healthTrigger = FreshHealthForSkill(local) && SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(local.PlayerHealth, local.PlayerHealthMax,
                settings.healthThreshold, SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute));
        }

        SkillAimCandidate threat{};
        const bool threatTrigger = settings.threatTriggerEnabled && FindDefensiveThreatCandidate(skillId, settings, local, threat);
        if (!healthTrigger && !threatTrigger)
            return false;

        const int vk = SkillOutputVk(settings);
        if (!StartSkillOutput(runtimeKey, definition, settings, local, kBriefPulse))
            return false;

        MarkActionExecuted(runtimeKey);
        if (threatTrigger && threat.threatSlot >= 0) {
            const auto event = g_defensiveThreats.find(threat.entity.address);
            if (event != g_defensiveThreats.end()) event->second.events[threat.threatSlot].Respond(
                skillId == "wraith-form" ? 1u : skillId == "recall" ? 2u : 4u);
        }
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill defensive response fired. skill=%s reason=%s targetIndex=%d hero=0x%llX distance=%.2f localHp=%.1f threshold=%.1f vk=%d",
            skillId.c_str(),
            healthTrigger ? "health" : "threat",
            threat.valid ? threat.entityIndex : -1,
            threat.valid ? static_cast<unsigned long long>(threat.entity.HeroID) : 0ull,
            threat.valid ? threat.distance : 0.0f,
            local.PlayerHealth,
            settings.healthThreshold,
            vk);
        return true;
    }

    bool EvaluateGroupConditionAction(const std::string& runtimeKey,
                                      const HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                      const Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings,
                                      const c_entity& local)
    {
        if (!FreshLocalActionReady(definition, local) || !local.team_known || !std::isfinite(settings.radius) || settings.radius <= 0 ||
            IsActionDebounced(runtimeKey)) return false;
        const Vector3 source = SourcePositionForAction(local);
        if (!IsUsablePosition(source)) return false;
        const bool allies = SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::AllyHealthThreshold);
        int count = 0;
        for (const auto& target : TargetingDetail::SnapshotEntities()) {
            if (!target.team_known || !target.address || target.address == local.address ||
                !target.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(), EntitySceneGeneration()) ||
                !std::isfinite(target.PlayerHealth) || target.PlayerHealth <= 0 ||
                target.Team == allies || (settings.requireVisible && !target.Vis)) continue;
            if (!allies && !TargetingDetail::ProtectionFilterPasses(target)) continue;
            if (allies && (!FreshHealthForSkill(target) || !SkillConditions::HealthAtOrBelow(target.PlayerHealth, target.PlayerHealthMax,
                    settings.allyHealthThreshold, false))) continue;
            const auto position = CandidatePositionForAction(target);
            if (!IsUsablePosition(position)) continue;
            const float distance = source.DistTo(position);
            if (std::isfinite(distance) && distance <= settings.radius) ++count;
        }
        if (count < settings.minTargets || !StartSkillOutput(runtimeKey, definition, settings, local, kBriefPulse))
            return false;
        MarkActionExecuted(runtimeKey);
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill group action fired. skill=%s allies=%d count=%d radius=%.1f",
            definition.skillId, allies, count, settings.radius);
        return true;
    }

    #include "HeroSkillAutomation.inl"
    #include "HeroSkillSignalActions.inl"


    void CancelSkill(const std::string& skillId, bool cancelTimedAction)
    {
        if (cancelTimedAction) CancelSignalSkill(skillId);
        g_automaticAimWindows.erase(skillId);
        if (cancelTimedAction) {
            CancelSkillMemoryPulse(skillId);
            g_pendingSkillCasts.erase(skillId);
            g_skillAimMotions.erase(skillId);
        }
        if (cancelTimedAction) CancelAutomation(skillId);
        if (g_rocketPunch.maskKey == skillId + ":physical_rmb_mask")
            CancelRocketPunch();
        if (cancelTimedAction) {
            (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(skillId);
            (void)TimedOutputScheduler().Cancel(skillId + ":auto_right");
        }

        auto sequence = g_sequences.find(skillId);
        if (sequence != g_sequences.end())
            CancelSequence(skillId, sequence->second, "disabled_or_inactive");

        auto genjiCombo = g_genjiCombos.find(skillId);
        if (genjiCombo != g_genjiCombos.end() &&
            (genjiCombo->second.active || genjiCombo->second.rightDown ||
             genjiCombo->second.shiftDown || genjiCombo->second.meleeDown)) {
            FinishGenjiCombo(skillId, genjiCombo->second, "disabled_or_inactive", false);
        }

        auto viewpoint = g_viewpoints.find(skillId);
        if (viewpoint != g_viewpoints.end())
            CancelViewpoint(skillId, viewpoint->second, "disabled_or_inactive");

        // Temporary guards and disable/re-enable must retain the cast interval.
        g_lastSkillGuardLogs.erase(skillId);
        g_lastAmmoGuardSamples.erase(skillId);
        g_zaryaAmmoProbes.erase(skillId);
        if (cancelTimedAction) g_skillAimSessions[skillId].Block();
    }

    std::string RuntimeSkillKey(uint64_t heroId, const char* skillId)
    {
        return std::to_string(heroId) + ":" + (skillId ? skillId : "");
    }

    void ProcessAutoMeleeMemory(const c_entity& local, unsigned pause) {
        const auto settings = Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(local.HeroID, "auto-melee", MakeAutoMeleeDefaults());
        const bool allowed = settings.enabled && !Config::aimDryRun && RuntimeOutputSessionEnabled() &&
            !V2::HostInteraction::paused.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            !Config::calibrationInProgress.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && !Config::OutputSuppressedByMenu() &&
            HasFreshViewMatrices() && !(pause & SkillConditions::Skills) &&
            !g_specialOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && !g_genjiBladeOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        UpdateMeleeMemoryPulse(allowed);
        if (!allowed || V2::Output::GameActions::MeleeOwned()) return;
        const auto definition = std::find_if(AllHeroSkillDefinitions().begin(), AllHeroSkillDefinitions().end(),
            [&](const auto& item) { return IsAutoMeleeDefinition(item) && IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(item, local.HeroID); });
        const auto key = RuntimeSkillKey(local.HeroID, "auto-melee");
        if (definition != AllHeroSkillDefinitions().end() && !IsManualCooldownActive(key, settings))
            EvaluateAutoMeleeAction(key, *definition, settings);
    }



} // namespace

bool AnyInputSequenceActive()
{
    return g_anyInputSequenceActive.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

bool AnyInputSequenceActivationHeld()
{
    return g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

ExecutionToken ActiveInputSequenceToken()
{
    return MakeExecutionToken(ExecutionSource::SequenceInternal, AnyInputSequenceActive());
}

bool ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource requester)
{
    if (g_beamOwnsOutputs.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        (requester==ExecutionSource::GlobalAim || requester==ExecutionSource::Trigger)) return true;
    if (g_projectileOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        (requester==ExecutionSource::GlobalAim || requester==ExecutionSource::Trigger)) return true;
    if (g_specialOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return true;
    if (g_genjiBladeOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        (requester==ExecutionSource::GlobalAim || requester==ExecutionSource::Trigger)) return true;
    if (g_automaticOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
        (requester==ExecutionSource::GlobalAim || requester==ExecutionSource::Trigger)) return true;
    if (ShouldPauseHeroAssist(requester)) return true;
    if (requester == ExecutionSource::SequenceInternal)
        return false;
    if (g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return true;

    const bool sequenceClaimsExecution = HeroSkillDetail::SequenceClaimsExecution(
        AnyInputSequenceActive(),
        AnyInputSequenceActivationHeld(),
        requester);
    return ShouldYieldToExecution(
        MakeExecutionToken(requester),
        MakeExecutionToken(ExecutionSource::SequenceInternal, sequenceClaimsExecution));
}

bool ShouldPauseHeroAssist(ExecutionSource requester)
{
    const unsigned mask = HeroStatePauseMask(TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity());
    const unsigned bit = requester == ExecutionSource::GlobalAim ? SkillConditions::Aim
        : requester == ExecutionSource::Trigger ? SkillConditions::Trigger : SkillConditions::Skills;
    return (mask & bit) != 0;
}

bool HasEnabledDefensiveHeroSkill(uint64_t heroId)
{
    for (const auto& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (!IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, heroId)) continue;
        const std::string id = definition.skillId;
        if (!SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthAction) && id != "wraith-form" && id != "recall" &&
            definition.automation!=SkillAutomation::RecastReturn) continue;
        if (Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(heroId, id, definition.defaultSettings).enabled) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

SkillConditions::ObservationNeeds HeroSkillObservationNeeds()
{
    SkillConditions::ObservationNeeds needs{};
    needs.localHero = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID;
    for (const auto& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (!IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, needs.localHero)) continue;
        const auto settings = Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(needs.localHero, definition.skillId, definition.defaultSettings);
        if (!settings.enabled) continue;
        needs.heroSignals |= definition.automation==SkillAutomation::MercyBeam ||
            definition.automation==SkillAutomation::LucioSong ||
            (definition.automation==SkillAutomation::ProjectileDefense && definition.heroId==eHero::HERO_DVA);
        needs.localSkills |= SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::TrajectoryAction) || settings.cooldownGuard || SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PausePolicy) ||
            definition.automation==SkillAutomation::RecastReturn || definition.automation==SkillAutomation::GenjiBlade ||
            definition.automation==SkillAutomation::RecentDamageDeflect || definition.automation==SkillAutomation::HealthSurvival;
        const std::string id = definition.skillId;
        needs.enemyThreats |= settings.threatTriggerEnabled && (id == "wraith-form" || id == "recall" || id == "dancing-blaze");
        needs.enemyThreats |= definition.automation==SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt && settings.normalThreatMask!=0;
    }
    // Sojourn's secondary shot consumes the rail resource observed from the
    // local skill scalar list. It is a local read, independent of hero-skill
    // automation settings.
    if (needs.localHero == eHero::HERO_SOJOURN) needs.heroSignals = true;
    return needs;
}

bool HeroSkillNeedsProjectileObservations(uint64_t localHero)
{
    for (const auto& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (definition.heroId!=localHero || definition.automation!=SkillAutomation::ProjectileDefense) continue;
        const auto settings=Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(localHero,definition.skillId,definition.defaultSettings);
        if (settings.enabled && settings.projectileThreatEnabled && settings.projectileThreatMask) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

namespace {

AimFirePhase::Phase ResolveAsheComboTrackingPhase(
    const SequenceTimeline& timeline, Clock::time_point now = Clock::now())
{
    AimFirePhase::Phase phase;
    // Horizontal motion is wholly owned by the selected behavior. Only the
    // explicitly retained vertical hold is layered over it; old recovery and
    // pre-shot boost fields cannot silently alter the KOI sequence.
    if (timeline.lastShotStarted != Clock::time_point{} &&
        now - timeline.lastShotStarted < std::chrono::milliseconds(AsheCombo::kPostShotPitchPauseMs)) {
        phase.paused = true;
        phase.pitchScale = 0.0f;
    }
    return phase;
}

void RunAsheInputSequence(const std::string& skillId, int key,
                         const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& trackingParams,
                         bool prediction, bool ammoGuardEnabled, int ammoGuardReserve)
{
    auto& runtime = g_sequences[skillId];
    const bool held = IsActivationKeyHeld(key);
    if (runtime.workerCompletion)
        runtime.workerCompletion->activationHeld.store(held, std::memory_order_release);

    if ((runtime.active && runtime.activationKey != key) ||
        Config::Menu.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
        !SkillLogicalOutputAllowed() || !RuntimeWorkersRunning()) {
        CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(skillId, runtime, "hard_runtime_pause");
        return;
    }
    if (runtime.active && runtime.workerCompletion) {
        const auto reason = runtime.workerCompletion->reason.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (reason != SequenceWorkerExitReason::Running) {
            if (HeroSkillDetail::SequenceWorkerExitRequiresRelease(reason))
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(skillId, runtime, SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(reason));
            else CancelSequence(skillId, runtime, SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(reason));
            return;
        }
    }
    if (!HeroSkillDetail::AdvanceSequenceRearmGate(runtime.rearmBlockedUntilRelease, held)) return;
    if (!runtime.active) {
        if (!held) return;
        const auto output = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        if (!HeroSkillDetail::SequenceWorkerRuntimeMatches(
                output.backendGeneration, output.backendGeneration, output.outputGateOpen)) {
            CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(skillId, runtime, "runtime_unavailable");
            return;
        }
        runtime.active = true;
        runtime.activationKey = key;
        g_anyInputSequenceActive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
        ResetAimSmoothingState();
        MarkActionExecuted(skillId);
        runtime.workerCompletion = std::make_shared<SequenceWorkerCompletion>();
        runtime.workerCompletion->activationHeld.store(held, std::memory_order_release);
        runtime.worker = std::jthread(RunAsheComboWorker, skillId, key, ammoGuardEnabled,
            ammoGuardReserve, output.backendGeneration, runtime.workerCompletion);
    }

    // A soft release keeps the committed action/wait alive, while aim follows
    // the physical activation key immediately. The worker decides reset only
    // at KOI's original checkpoints. All outer CancelSkill paths stay hard.
    if (!held) {
        if (runtime.aimTarget[0]) {
            ResetAimSmoothingState();
            runtime.aimTarget = {};
        }
        return;
    }
    const auto timeline = runtime.workerCompletion->Snapshot();
    if (timeline.stepStarted == Clock::time_point{}) return;
    RunTrackingOverlayTick(skillId, runtime, trackingParams, prediction,
        ResolveAsheComboTrackingPhase(timeline));
    UpdateSequenceHitTiming(skillId, runtime);
}

} // namespace

void RunInputSequence(const std::string& skillId,
                      const std::vector<Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep>& steps,
                      int key,
                      const Config::HeroSkillTrackingParams& trackingParams,
                      bool prediction,
                      const Config::HeroSkillSettings& phaseSettings,
                      bool ammoGuardEnabled,
                      int ammoGuardReserve)
{
    if (UsesAsheAmmoBudgetFallback(skillId)) {
        RunAsheInputSequence(skillId, key, trackingParams, prediction,
            ammoGuardEnabled, ammoGuardReserve);
        return;
    }
    SequenceRuntime& runtime = g_sequences[skillId];
    const bool held = IsActivationKeyHeld(key);
    const bool useWorker = UseSequenceWorker();

    if (useWorker && runtime.active && runtime.workerCompletion) {
        const SequenceWorkerExitReason exitReason =
            runtime.workerCompletion->reason.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (exitReason != SequenceWorkerExitReason::Running) {
            const char* reason = SequenceWorkerExitReasonName(exitReason);
            if (HeroSkillDetail::SequenceWorkerExitRequiresRelease(exitReason)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(skillId, runtime, reason);
            } else {
                CancelSequence(skillId, runtime, reason);
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    const bool wasRearmBlocked = runtime.rearmBlockedUntilRelease;
    if (!HeroSkillDetail::AdvanceSequenceRearmGate(
            runtime.rearmBlockedUntilRelease, held)) {
        if (wasRearmBlocked && !runtime.rearmBlockedUntilRelease) {
            Diagnostics::Info(
                "Hero skill sequence rearmed after activation release. skill=%s",
                skillId.c_str());
        }
        return;
    }

    if (!held || steps.empty()) {
        if (runtime.active)
            CancelSequence(skillId, runtime, held ? "empty_steps" : "activation_released");
        return;
    }

    if (!runtime.active) {
        runtime.active = true;
        runtime.stepIndex = 0;
        runtime.currentMask = 0;
        runtime.stepStarted = Clock::now();
        runtime.effectiveDurationMs = PickSequenceDurationMs(steps.front());
        g_anyInputSequenceActive.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
        ResetAimSmoothingState();
        MarkActionExecuted(skillId);

        if (useWorker) {
            const OutputRuntimeState workerRuntime =
                CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
            if (!HeroSkillDetail::SequenceWorkerRuntimeMatches(
                    workerRuntime.backendGeneration,
                    workerRuntime.backendGeneration,
                    workerRuntime.outputGateOpen)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "runtime_unavailable");
                return;
            }
            runtime.workerCompletion = std::make_shared<SequenceWorkerCompletion>();
            runtime.worker = std::jthread(RunSequenceWorker,
                skillId,
                std::vector<Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep>(steps.begin(), steps.end()),
                ammoGuardEnabled,
                ammoGuardReserve,
                workerRuntime.backendGeneration,
                runtime.workerCompletion);
        } else {
            if (ConsumeSequenceAmmoBudgetForStep(
                    skillId, runtime.currentMask, steps.front().buttonMask, ammoGuardEnabled, ammoGuardReserve)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "ammo_guard_budget");
                return;
            }
            const int previousMask = runtime.currentMask;
            if (!EnterSequenceStep(skillId, runtime.currentMask, steps.front())) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "output_failed");
                return;
            }
            if (SequenceShotEdge(previousMask, steps.front().buttonMask))
                runtime.lastShotStarted = runtime.stepStarted;
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill sequence started. skill=%s steps=%zu activationKey=%d",
            skillId.c_str(), steps.size(), key);

        if (SequenceDiagnosticsEnabled() && !useWorker) {
            const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step = steps.front();
            Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.step skill=%s step=%zu mask=0x%02X durationMs=%d baseMs=%d scale=%.3f jitterMs=%d",
                skillId.c_str(),
                runtime.stepIndex + 1,
                step.buttonMask,
                runtime.effectiveDurationMs,
                step.durationMs,
                step.speedScale,
                step.jitterMs);
        }
    } else if (!useWorker) {
        if (runtime.stepIndex >= steps.size()) {
            runtime.stepIndex = 0;
            runtime.stepStarted = Clock::now();
            runtime.effectiveDurationMs = PickSequenceDurationMs(steps.front());
            if (ConsumeSequenceAmmoBudgetForStep(
                    skillId, runtime.currentMask, steps.front().buttonMask, ammoGuardEnabled, ammoGuardReserve)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "ammo_guard_budget");
                return;
            }
            const int previousMask = runtime.currentMask;
            if (!EnterSequenceStep(skillId, runtime.currentMask, steps.front())) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "output_failed");
                return;
            }
            if (SequenceShotEdge(previousMask, steps.front().buttonMask))
                runtime.lastShotStarted = runtime.stepStarted;
        }

        const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
        const auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - runtime.stepStarted);
        if (elapsed.count() >= runtime.effectiveDurationMs) {
            runtime.stepIndex = (runtime.stepIndex + 1) % steps.size();
            const Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& nextStep = steps[runtime.stepIndex];
            runtime.stepStarted = now;
            runtime.effectiveDurationMs = PickSequenceDurationMs(nextStep);
            if (ConsumeSequenceAmmoBudgetForStep(
                    skillId, runtime.currentMask, nextStep.buttonMask, ammoGuardEnabled, ammoGuardReserve)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "ammo_guard_budget");
                return;
            }
            const int previousMask = runtime.currentMask;
            if (!EnterSequenceStep(skillId, runtime.currentMask, nextStep)) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(
                    skillId, runtime, "output_failed");
                return;
            }
            if (SequenceShotEdge(previousMask, nextStep.buttonMask))
                runtime.lastShotStarted = runtime.stepStarted;

            if (SequenceDiagnosticsEnabled()) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("sequence.step skill=%s step=%zu mask=0x%02X durationMs=%d baseMs=%d scale=%.3f jitterMs=%d",
                    skillId.c_str(),
                    runtime.stepIndex + 1,
                    nextStep.buttonMask,
                    runtime.effectiveDurationMs,
                    nextStep.durationMs,
                    nextStep.speedScale,
                    nextStep.jitterMs);
            }
        }
    }

    size_t phaseStepIndex = runtime.stepIndex;
    Clock::time_point phaseStepStarted = runtime.stepStarted;
    int phaseStepDurationMs = runtime.effectiveDurationMs;
    Clock::time_point phaseLastShotStarted = runtime.lastShotStarted;
    if (useWorker && runtime.workerCompletion) {
        const auto timeline = runtime.workerCompletion->Snapshot();
        phaseStepIndex = timeline.stepIndex;
        phaseStepStarted = timeline.stepStarted;
        phaseStepDurationMs = timeline.stepDurationMs;
        phaseLastShotStarted = timeline.lastShotStarted;
        // Output has not committed its first step yet; do not advance aim ahead of it.
        if (phaseStepStarted == Clock::time_point{})
            return;
    }
    if (phaseStepDurationMs <= 0 && !steps.empty())
        phaseStepDurationMs = NominalSequenceDurationMs(steps[phaseStepIndex % steps.size()]);

    const AimFirePhase::Phase trackingPhase = ResolveSequenceTrackingPhase(
        steps,
        phaseSettings,
        phaseStepIndex,
        phaseStepStarted,
        phaseStepDurationMs,
        phaseLastShotStarted);
    RunTrackingOverlayTick(skillId, runtime, trackingParams, prediction, trackingPhase);
    UpdateSequenceHitTiming(skillId, runtime);
}

HeroSkillRunState RunViewpointController(const std::string& skillId,
                                         const Config::HeroSkillSettings& params)
{
    ViewpointRuntime& runtime = g_viewpoints[skillId];
    const bool keyDown = IsActivationKeyHeld(params.key);

    if (!RuntimeWorkersRunning()) {
        CancelViewpoint(skillId, runtime, "runtime_stopped");
        runtime.prevKeyDown = keyDown;
        return HeroSkillRunState::Cancelled;
    }

    const bool active = runtime.phase == ViewpointPhase::PitchDown ||
        runtime.phase == ViewpointPhase::PitchUp;
    if (!active && keyDown && !runtime.prevKeyDown)
        BeginViewpoint(skillId, runtime, params);

    runtime.prevKeyDown = keyDown;

    const Clock::time_point now = Clock::now();
    UpdateViewpointPulses(skillId, runtime, now);

    switch (runtime.phase) {
    case ViewpointPhase::Idle:
    case ViewpointPhase::Completed:
        return HeroSkillRunState::Completed;
    case ViewpointPhase::Cancelled:
        return HeroSkillRunState::Cancelled;
    case ViewpointPhase::PitchDown: {
        const float dt = DeltaSeconds(runtime, now);
        const float targetPitch = ClampViewPitchTarget(
            std::clamp(params.pitchDownTargetAngle, 0.0f, 180.0f) * kDegToRad);
        LogViewpointTick(skillId, runtime, targetPitch, runtime.initialAngles.Y, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt, now);
        const bool pitchDone = MovePitchToward(targetPitch, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt);

        Vector3 current{};
        const bool haveCurrent = TryReadCurrentViewAngles(current);
        const bool nearFloor = haveCurrent && current.X >= kViewpointFloorReadyPitchRad;
        if (nearFloor) {
            if (runtime.floorReadyStarted.time_since_epoch().count() == 0)
                runtime.floorReadyStarted = now;
        } else {
            runtime.floorReadyStarted = {};
        }

        const bool floorSettled = nearFloor && now - runtime.floorReadyStarted >= kViewpointFloorSettle;
        if (pitchDone || floorSettled) {
            Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint pitch down reached. skill=%s targetPitch=%.2f currentPitch=%.2f settled=%d",
                skillId.c_str(),
                targetPitch * kRadToDeg,
                haveCurrent ? current.X * kRadToDeg : 0.0f,
                floorSettled ? 1 : 0);
            if (!BeginSecondaryPulse(skillId, runtime, now)) {
                CancelViewpoint(skillId, runtime, "secondary_output_failed");
                return HeroSkillRunState::Cancelled;
            }
            runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::PitchUp;
            runtime.phaseStarted = now;
            runtime.lastTick = runtime.phaseStarted;
            runtime.lastDebugLog = {};
            runtime.floorReadyStarted = {};
        }
        break;
    }
    case ViewpointPhase::PitchUp: {
        const float dt = DeltaSeconds(runtime, now);
        const float downTargetPitch = ClampViewPitchTarget(
            std::clamp(params.pitchDownTargetAngle, 0.0f, 180.0f) * kDegToRad);
        if (!runtime.fired) {
            LogViewpointTick(skillId, runtime, downTargetPitch, runtime.initialAngles.Y, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt, now);
            MovePitchToward(downTargetPitch, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt);
            break;
        }

        const int fireDelayMs = std::clamp(params.fireDelayMs, 0, 100);
        const auto elapsed = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now - runtime.fireDelayStarted);
        if (!runtime.jumped && elapsed.count() < fireDelayMs) {
            LogViewpointTick(skillId, runtime, downTargetPitch, runtime.initialAngles.Y, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt, now);
            MovePitchToward(downTargetPitch, runtime.pitchDownSpeedDeg, dt);
            break;
        }

        if (!runtime.jumped) {
            Vector3 verifiedAngles{};
            if (TryReadCurrentViewAngles(verifiedAngles)) {
                if (runtime.jumpVk > 0 && !BeginKeyboardPulse(skillId, runtime, runtime.jumpVk, now)) {
                    Diagnostics::Warn("Hero skill keyboard pulse failed. skill=%s vk=%d",
                        skillId.c_str(), runtime.jumpVk);
                    CancelViewpoint(skillId, runtime, "jump_output_failed");
                    return HeroSkillRunState::Cancelled;
                }
                runtime.jumped = true;
                Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint jump gate passed. skill=%s pitch=%.2f yaw=%.2f elapsedMs=%lld",
                    skillId.c_str(),
                    verifiedAngles.X * kRadToDeg,
                    verifiedAngles.Y * kRadToDeg,
                    static_cast<long long>(elapsed.count()));
            }
            break;
        }

        LogViewpointTick(skillId, runtime, runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle, runtime.initialAngles.Y, runtime.pitchUpSpeedDeg, dt, now);
        const auto returnElapsed = now - runtime.phaseStarted;
        const bool returnTimedOut = returnElapsed >= kViewpointReturnTimeout;
        bool pitchDone = IsPitchWithin(runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle, kViewpointReturnDoneEpsilonRad);
        if (!pitchDone && !returnTimedOut)
            pitchDone = MovePitchToward(runtime.pitchUpTargetAngle, runtime.pitchUpSpeedDeg, dt);

        bool yawDone = IsYawWithin(runtime.initialAngles.Y, kViewpointYawReturnEpsilonRad);
        if (pitchDone && !yawDone && !returnTimedOut &&
            returnElapsed < kViewpointYawRestoreBudget) {
            yawDone = MoveYawToward(runtime.initialAngles.Y, runtime.pitchUpSpeedDeg, dt);
        }

        if (runtime.jumped && !runtime.jumpDown &&
            (returnTimedOut || (pitchDone && (yawDone || returnElapsed >= kViewpointYawRestoreBudget)))) {
            runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::Completed;
            Diagnostics::Info("Hero skill viewpoint completed. skill=%s timeout=%d pitchDone=%d yawDone=%d",
                skillId.c_str(),
                returnTimedOut ? 1 : 0,
                pitchDone ? 1 : 0,
                yawDone ? 1 : 0);
            return HeroSkillRunState::Completed;
        }
        break;
    }
    default:
        break;
    }

    return HeroSkillRunState::InProgress;
}

namespace {

void CancelActiveSkillStateLocked()
{
    CancelSignalActions();
    UpdateMeleeMemoryPulse(false);
    UpdateOwnedSkillMemoryPulse(false);
    CancelGenjiBlade();
    g_lastGenjiDashTry = 0;
    for(auto& [key,state]:g_superJumps)CancelSuperJump(key,state);
    g_superJumps.clear();g_returnWindow={};
    g_automaticAimWindows.clear();g_automaticOwnsAim.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
    CancelRocketPunch();
    g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.store(false, std::memory_order_release);

    for (auto& item : g_sequences)
        CancelSequence(item.first, item.second, "cancel_all");

    for (auto& item : g_genjiCombos) {
        if (item.second.active || item.second.rightDown ||
            item.second.shiftDown || item.second.meleeDown) {
            FinishGenjiCombo(item.first, item.second, "cancel_all", false);
        }
    }

    for (auto& item : g_viewpoints)
        CancelViewpoint(item.first, item.second, "cancel_all");

    // Hero cancellation must not disturb independent global aim, trigger or
    // one-shot GameAction owners that share the scheduler.
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::ZaryaPulse);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Sequence);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Viewpoint);
    TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GenjiCombo);
    g_lastActionExecutions.clear();
    g_lastOutputActions.clear();
    g_confirmedOutputActions.clear();
    g_skillOutputVks.clear();
    g_pendingSkillCasts.clear();
    g_projectileOwnsAim.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
    g_defensiveThreats.clear();
    g_recentDamage.Reset();
    g_zaryaAmmoProbes.clear();
    g_skillAimSessions.clear();
    g_skillAimMotions.clear();
    RefreshAnyInputSequenceActive();
}

} // namespace

void CancelActiveSkill()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_heroSkillRuntimeMutex);
    CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();
}

void ProcessHeroSkills()
{
    OW::Config::ScopedConfigRead configRead;
    OW::ScopedConsumptionFrame consumptionFrame;
    // A backend transaction closes the controller gate, then waits here before
    // cancelling scheduler state. This keeps one hero tick from moving on the
    // old backend and scheduling its action on the replacement generation.
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> producerTransitionLock(
        RuntimeOutputProducerTransitionMutex());
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_heroSkillRuntimeMutex);

    const OutputRuntimeState outputRuntime =
        CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
    // The game action word does not require a device connection. It still obeys
    // the same session, host interaction, menu, calibration and dry-run gates.
    const bool logicalOutputAllowed = SkillLogicalOutputAllowed();
    UpdateOwnedSkillMemoryPulse(logicalOutputAllowed && RuntimeWorkersRunning() &&
        ProcessConnection::IsConnected());
    const bool generationChanged =
        g_lastTimedOutputGeneration != 0 &&
        outputRuntime.backendGeneration != g_lastTimedOutputGeneration;
    const bool outputGateClosed =
        g_lastTimedOutputGateOpen && !outputRuntime.outputGateOpen;

    // Quiesce independent producers before SynchronizeRuntime is allowed to
    // resume a paused scheduler on a new generation. The worker also carries
    // its own expected-generation barrier; this ordering is not its only
    // protection.
    if (generationChanged || outputGateClosed)
        CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();

    const bool outputReady =
        TimedOutputScheduler().SynchronizeRuntime(outputRuntime);
    g_lastTimedOutputGeneration = outputRuntime.backendGeneration;
    g_lastTimedOutputGateOpen = outputRuntime.outputGateOpen;

    if (!RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() || !logicalOutputAllowed) {
        CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();
        (void)RetryPendingPhysicalMouseMaskLeases();
        return;
    }

    const c_entity localSnapshot = TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
    const uint64_t heroId = localSnapshot.HeroID;
    if(!localSnapshot.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(),EntitySceneGeneration()) ||
       !std::isfinite(localSnapshot.PlayerHealth) || localSnapshot.PlayerHealth <= 0) {
        CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();
        (void)RetryPendingPhysicalMouseMaskLeases();
        return;
    }
    const auto bodyIdentity = SkillBodyIdentity(localSnapshot);
    if (bodyIdentity != g_lastSkillBody) {
        // A hero/body/scene switch is an ownership boundary for all producers.
        // Stop the old hero's independent sequence worker first; otherwise it
        // can reacquire output in the gap after a global CancelAll.
        CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();
        TimedOutputScheduler().CancelAllAndJoin(
            OutputActionCancelReason::RuntimeChanged);
        g_lastSkillBody = bodyIdentity;
    }

    // Retry only after invalid producers have been cancelled. This prevents a
    // pending positive mask from being rebuilt for a disconnected or old hero;
    // generation changes clear stale leases without touching the new backend.
    (void)RetryPendingPhysicalMouseMaskLeases();

    if (heroId == 0) {
        g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        return;
    }

    ObservePendingSkillCasts(localSnapshot);
    if (heroId == eHero::HERO_GENJI)
        g_recentDamage.Observe(localSnapshot.PlayerHealth, localSnapshot.PlayerHealthMax,
            localSnapshot.health_sample_tick_ms, GetTickCount());
    bool processedAnyForHero = false;
    bool anySequenceActivationHeld = false;
    g_automaticOwnsAim.store(SignalAimHeld(),std::memory_order_release);
    ObserveDefensiveThreats();
    ObserveProjectileThreats(localSnapshot);
    if(heroId==eHero::HERO_MIZUKI) {
        const auto tick=localSnapshot.skill_active_tick_ms[0];
        const auto age=uint32_t(GetTickCount()-tick);
        g_returnWindow.Observe(tick && age<=250,localSnapshot.skill1act,GetTickCount64()-age);
    }
    const unsigned pause = HeroStatePauseMask(localSnapshot);
    // Memory melee does not require a Box keyboard or a connected device backend.
    ProcessAutoMeleeMemory(localSnapshot, pause);
    if (!outputReady)
        g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    if (pause & SkillConditions::Aim) TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim);
    if (pause & SkillConditions::Trigger) TimedOutputScheduler().CancelSource(OutputOwnerSource::Trigger);
    for (const auto& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (definition.automation != SkillAutomation::GenjiBlade || definition.heroId != heroId) continue;
        if (!outputReady) { CancelGenjiBlade(); continue; }
        const auto settings = Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(heroId,definition.skillId,definition.defaultSettings);
        if (!settings.enabled || (pause & SkillConditions::Skills) || !HasFreshViewMatrices() || Config::aimDryRun)
            CancelGenjiBlade();
        else EvaluateGenjiBlade(RuntimeSkillKey(heroId,definition.skillId),settings,localSnapshot);
    }
    for (const HeroSkillDefinition& definition : AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (!IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, heroId))
            continue;

        // Keyboard actions can use the game action word without a Box backend.
        // Mouse aim/sequence producers still require the normal output gate.
        if (!outputReady && MemoryMaskForInputAction(definition.inputAction) == 0)
            continue;

        processedAnyForHero = true;
        if (IsAutoMeleeDefinition(definition)) continue; // Already processed by the memory route.
        if (definition.automation == SkillAutomation::GenjiBlade) continue;
        const std::string skillKey = RuntimeSkillKey(heroId, definition.skillId);
        Config::HeroSkillSettings settings = Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(
            heroId,
            definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "",
            definition.defaultSettings);

        const bool aimedProjectile = SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::TrackingOverlay) &&
            SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::TrajectoryAction) &&
            !SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::SequenceSteps) &&
            !SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::ComboAction) && definition.automation==SkillAutomation::None;
        // Observe release even while a cooldown prevents execution.
        if (aimedProjectile) {
            const auto input = KeyState::SampleVk(Labels::AimActivationKeyVk(settings.key));
            if (!input.available) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Block();
            else if (!input.down) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Advance(false, GetTickCount64(), 0, settings.maxAimTimeMs);
        }

        if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PausePolicy)) continue;
        if (g_genjiBladeOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey,true);
            continue;
        }

        if ((pause & SkillConditions::Skills) && !SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PunchAssist)) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey, true);
            continue;
        }

        if (!settings.enabled) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey, true);
            continue;
        }

        using MappedAction=V2::HeroSettings::Action;
        const auto mappedAction=[&] {
            switch(definition.inputAction) {
            case HeroSkillInputAction::PrimaryFire:return MappedAction::Primary;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::SecondaryFire:return MappedAction::Secondary;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1:return MappedAction::Ability1;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability2:return MappedAction::Ability2;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Ability3:return MappedAction::Ability3;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate:return MappedAction::Ultimate;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Jump:return MappedAction::Jump;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::Crouch:return MappedAction::Crouch;
            case HeroSkillInputAction::QuickMelee:return MappedAction::Melee;
            default:return MappedAction::Primary;
            }
        }();
        settings.runtimeOutputVk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(heroId,mappedAction);
        g_skillOutputVks[skillKey]=settings.runtimeOutputVk;
        settings.runtimeJumpVk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(heroId,MappedAction::Jump);

        if (definition.automation==SkillAutomation::MercyBeam) {
            EvaluateMercyBeam(skillKey,settings,localSnapshot);continue;
        }
        if (definition.automation==SkillAutomation::LucioSong) {
            EvaluateLucioSong(skillKey,definition,settings,localSnapshot);continue;
        }

        if(g_specialOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && definition.automation!=SkillAutomation::EmreJump) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey,true);continue;
        }
        if(definition.automation==SkillAutomation::RecastReturn) {
            EvaluateReturn(skillKey,settings,localSnapshot);continue;
        }
        if(definition.automation==SkillAutomation::EmreJump) {
            EvaluateSuperJump(skillKey,definition,settings,localSnapshot);continue;
        }

        if (definition.inputAction == HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate &&
            !FreshLocalActionReady(definition, localSnapshot)) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey, false);
            continue;
        }

        if (IsZaryaReloadAmmoProbeDefinition(definition)) {
            UpdateZaryaAmmoProbe(skillKey, settings, localSnapshot);
            continue;
        }

        if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PunchAssist)) {
            EvaluateRocketPunch(skillKey, settings, localSnapshot);
            continue;
        }

        const bool sequenceSkill = SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::SequenceSteps);
        const bool genjiComboSkill = IsGenjiDashComboDefinition(definition);
        const bool sequenceActive = sequenceSkill && IsSequenceActive(skillKey);
        const bool genjiComboActive = genjiComboSkill && IsGenjiComboActive(skillKey);
        const bool sequenceActivationHeld = sequenceSkill &&
            IsActivationKeyHeld(settings.key);
        if (sequenceActivationHeld) {
            anySequenceActivationHeld = true;
            // Publish immediately on the press edge; defer clearing until the
            // whole hero pass confirms that no enabled sequence hotkey is held.
            g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        }
        if (sequenceSkill && !UsesAsheAmmoBudgetFallback(skillKey))
            UpdateSequenceAmmoBudgetReloadState(skillKey, localSnapshot, settings.ammoGuardReserve);
        if (sequenceActive && UsesAsheAmmoBudgetFallback(skillKey)) {
            bool reloading = Config::reloading;
            (void)ReadLocalReloadingFast(localSnapshot, reloading);
            if (reloading || AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(
                    V2::HeroSettings::Key(heroId,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Reload))) {
                CancelSequenceAndBlockUntilRelease(skillKey, g_sequences[skillKey], "reload_interrupted");
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (sequenceSkill && !UsesAsheAmmoBudgetFallback(skillKey) && !sequenceActive &&
            AimbotDetail::IsInputVkDown(V2::HeroSettings::Key(heroId,V2::HeroSettings::Action::Reload)))
            ResetSequenceAmmoBudget(skillKey);

        if (!sequenceActive && !genjiComboActive &&
            IsInRechargeInterval(definition, settings, localSnapshot)) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey, false);
            if (aimedProjectile && IsActivationKeyHeld(settings.key)) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Block();
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(skillKey)) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("skill.cooldown_guard block skill=%s input=%d reloading=%d skillcd1=%.3f skillcd2=%.3f ultimate=%.1f",
                    skillKey.c_str(),
                    static_cast<int>(definition.inputAction),
                    Config::reloading ? 1 : 0,
                    localSnapshot.skillcd1,
                    localSnapshot.skillcd2,
                    localSnapshot.ultimate);
            }
            continue;
        }

        if (!sequenceActive && !genjiComboActive &&
            IsManualCooldownActive(skillKey, settings)) {
            g_automaticAimWindows.erase(skillKey);
            if (aimedProjectile && IsActivationKeyHeld(settings.key)) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Block();
            if (ShouldLogSkillGuard(skillKey)) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("skill.manual_cooldown block skill=%s cooldown=%.3f",
                    skillKey.c_str(),
                    settings.cooldown);
            }
            continue;
        }

        const auto sharedCast = g_confirmedOutputActions.find(settings.runtimeOutputVk);
        if (!sequenceActive && !genjiComboActive && sharedCast != g_confirmedOutputActions.end() &&
            Clock::now() - sharedCast->second < std::chrono::duration<float>(settings.cooldown)) {
            g_automaticAimWindows.erase(skillKey);
            if (aimedProjectile && IsActivationKeyHeld(settings.key)) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Block();
            continue;
        }

        if (IsAmmoGuardBlocking(skillKey, settings, localSnapshot)) {
            CancelSkill(skillKey, false);
            if (aimedProjectile) g_skillAimSessions[skillKey].Block();
            continue;
        }

        if(definition.automation!=SkillAutomation::None) {
            if (definition.automation==SkillAutomation::ProjectileDefense) {
                EvaluateProjectileDefense(skillKey,definition,settings,localSnapshot);continue;
            }
            if (definition.automation == SkillAutomation::HealthSurvival) {
                EvaluateSurvivalAction(skillKey, definition, settings, localSnapshot);
                continue;
            }
            if (definition.automation == SkillAutomation::RecentDamageDeflect) {
                EvaluateRecentDamageDeflect(skillKey, definition, settings, localSnapshot);
                continue;
            }
            EvaluateAutomaticAim(skillKey,definition,settings);continue;
        }

        if (genjiComboSkill) {
            EvaluateGenjiDashComboAction(skillKey, settings);
            continue;
        }

        if (sequenceSkill) {
            RunInputSequence(skillKey,
                             settings.sequenceSteps,
                             settings.key,
                             settings.tracking,
                             true,
                             settings,
                             settings.ammoGuard,
                             settings.ammoGuardReserve);
        }

        if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PitchControl) ||
            SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::PhaseTiming)) {
            RunViewpointController(skillKey, settings);
        }

        if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::GroupCondition)) {
            EvaluateGroupConditionAction(skillKey, definition, settings, localSnapshot);
            continue;
        }

        if (!IsRuntimeActionDefinition(definition))
            continue;

        if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::DefensiveAction)) {
            EvaluateDefensiveResponseAction(skillKey, definition, settings, localSnapshot);
        } else if (SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthThreshold) ||
                   SkillControls(definition, HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute)) {
            EvaluateHealthThresholdAction(skillKey, definition, settings, localSnapshot);
        } else {
            EvaluateTrajectoryAction(skillKey, definition, settings, GetTrajectoryParams(definition));
        }
    }

    g_projectileOwnsAim.store(!g_pendingSkillCasts.empty() ||
        std::any_of(g_skillAimSessions.begin(),g_skillAimSessions.end(),
            [](const auto& item){return item.second.active;}),std::memory_order_release);
    if (!processedAnyForHero)
        CancelActiveSkillStateLocked();

    g_anyInputSequenceActivationHeld.store(
        processedAnyForHero && anySequenceActivationHeld,
        std::memory_order_release);
}

#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
// Seeds real ownership and calls real cancellation consumers; the caller selects Mock.
#include "SkillModeScopeSelfTest.inl"

bool RunHeroSkillRuntimeStopSelfTest()
{
    const std::string key = "f01b-stop";
    auto seed = [&] {
        auto& runtime = g_viewpoints[key];
        runtime = ViewpointRuntime{};
        runtime.phase = ViewpointPhase::PitchDown;
        runtime.secondaryDown = true;
        runtime.jumpDown = true;
        runtime.jumpVk = VK_SPACE;
        return SetViewpointOutputs(key, runtime) &&
            V2::Output::SnapshotMock().outputMouseButtons != 0 &&
            V2::Output::SnapshotMock().outputKeyboardKeys != 0;
    };
    auto released = [&] {
        const auto& runtime = g_viewpoints[key];
        const auto output = V2::Output::SnapshotMock();
        return runtime.phase == ViewpointPhase::Cancelled &&
            !runtime.secondaryDown && !runtime.jumpDown &&
            output.outputMouseButtons == 0 && output.outputKeyboardKeys == 0;
    };
    // Establish the current scheduler generation before seeding active ownership.
    ProcessHeroSkills();
    auto& request = g_skillAimSessions[key];
    request.Advance(false, 10, 0, 650);
    const bool acquisitionStarted = request.Advance(true, 20, 0, 650);
    MarkActionExecuted(key);
    CancelSkill(key, false);
    bool guardsPreserveState = acquisitionStarted && request.active && g_lastActionExecutions.contains(key);
    CancelSkill(key, true);
    guardsPreserveState &= !request.Advance(true, 30, 0, 650);
    bool ok = !RuntimeWorkersRunning() && seed();
    ok &= guardsPreserveState;
    Config::HeroSkillSettings settings{};
    settings.key = -1;
    ok &= RunViewpointController(key, settings) == HeroSkillRunState::Cancelled && released();
    ok &= seed();
    ProcessHeroSkills();
    ok &= released();
    const uint64_t generation = V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().generation;
    g_rocketPunch.generation = generation;
    g_rocketPunch.maskKey = key + ":physical_rmb_mask";
    g_rocketPunch.masked = AcquirePhysicalMouseMaskLease(g_rocketPunch.maskKey,
        OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction, 0x02u, generation);
    ok &= g_rocketPunch.masked && ReleaseRocketPunchInput(key, generation);
    ok &= V2::Output::SnapshotMock().maskedButtons == 0x02u &&
        V2::Output::SnapshotMock().outputMouseButtons == 0;
    g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    ok &= ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::GlobalAim) &&
        ShouldBlockForActiveSequence(ExecutionSource::Trigger);
    ProcessHeroSkills();
    ok &= V2::Output::SnapshotMock().maskedButtons == 0 &&
        !g_rocketPunchOwnsAim.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    #include "HeroSkillAutomationSelfTest.inl"
    #include "HeroSkillSignalActionsSelfTest.inl"
    CancelActiveSkill();
    g_viewpoints.erase(key);
    return ok;
}
#endif

} // namespace OW

static_assert([] {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kCadence.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& entry = kCadence[i];
        if (entry.weaponId.empty() || (entry.triggerCycleIntervalMs && *entry.triggerCycleIntervalMs <= 0.0f) ||
            (i > 0 && kCadence[i - 1].weaponId >= entry.weaponId))
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}(), "Cadence keys must be unique/sorted and known intervals positive");

} // namespace

const WeaponCadenceEntry* WeaponCadenceTable::Find(std::string_view weaponId) const
{
    const auto found = std::lower_bound(kCadence.begin(), kCadence.end(), weaponId,
        [](const WeaponCadenceEntry& entry, std::string_view key) { return entry.weaponId < key; });
    return found != kCadence.end() && found->weaponId == weaponId ? &*found : nullptr;
}

std::span<const WeaponCadenceEntry> WeaponCadenceTable::Entries() const noexcept { return kCadence; }
std::size_t WeaponCadenceTable::Size() const noexcept { return kCadence.size(); }
std::size_t WeaponCadenceTable::DiscreteIntervalCount() const noexcept
{
    return static_cast<std::size_t>(std::count_if(kCadence.begin(), kCadence.end(),
        [](const WeaponCadenceEntry& entry) { return entry.triggerCycleIntervalMs.has_value(); }));
}

const WeaponCadenceTable& RuntimeWeaponCadenceTable()
{
    static const WeaponCadenceTable table;
    return table;
}

const WeaponCadenceEntry* FindRuntimeWeaponCadence(std::string_view weaponId)
{
    return RuntimeWeaponCadenceTable().Find(weaponId);
}

std::optional<float> ResolveWeaponTriggerCycleIntervalMs(std::string_view weaponId)
{
    const auto* entry = FindRuntimeWeaponCadence(weaponId);
    return entry ? entry->triggerCycleIntervalMs : std::nullopt;
}
} // namespace OW
