```hpp
inline AimBehaviorTuning ReadTuning(const Value& v,
                                    AimBehaviorTuning t = {},
                                    int behavior = static_cast<int>(OW::AimBehaviorType::Tracking)) {
    Read(v,"smooth",t.smooth);
    const bool hasAutoshot = v.IsObject() && v.HasMember("autoshot");
    const bool hasKeepFiring = v.IsObject() && v.HasMember("keepFiring");
    const bool hasFirePolicy = v.IsObject() && v.HasMember("firePolicy");
    Read(v,"autoshot",t.autoshot);
    Read(v,"keepFiring",t.keepFiring);
    Read(v,"firePolicy",t.firePolicy);
    if (!hasFirePolicy && (hasKeepFiring || hasAutoshot)) {
        t.firePolicy = t.keepFiring
            ? static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring)
            : t.autoshot
                ? static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot)
                : static_cast<int>(OW::DefaultFirePolicyForBehavior(
                    OW::ClampAimBehavior(behavior)));
    } else if (!hasFirePolicy && !hasKeepFiring && !hasAutoshot &&
               t.firePolicy == static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::ManualOnly)) {
        // Old mode caches often omitted all fire fields. Their behavior still
        // supplies the documented default until the cache is saved again.
        t.firePolicy = static_cast<int>(OW::DefaultFirePolicyForBehavior(
            OW::ClampAimBehavior(behavior)));
    }
    Read(v,"pitchScale",t.pitchScale);
    Read(v,"maxAimTime",t.maxAimTime);
    Read(v,"minCharge",t.minCharge);
    Read(v,"maxCharge",t.maxCharge);
    Read(v,"trackingDeadzone",t.trackingDeadzone);
    Read(v,"flickShotClampMs",t.flickShotClampMs);
    Read(v,"flickPostFireDelayMs",t.flickPostFireDelayMs);
    Read(v,"magneticShotIntervalMs",t.magneticShotIntervalMs);
    Read(v,"magneticPostFirePauseMs",t.magneticPostFirePauseMs);
    Read(v,"magneticRecoveryMs",t.magneticRecoveryMs);
    Read(v,"magneticPostFireYawScale",t.magneticPostFireYawScale);
    Read(v,"magneticPostFirePitchScale",t.magneticPostFirePitchScale);
    Read(v,"magneticPreFireBoostWindowMs",t.magneticPreFireBoostWindowMs);
    Read(v,"magneticPreFireBoostScale",t.magneticPreFireBoostScale);
    Read(v,"flickTrajectoryWait",t.flickTrajectoryWait);
    Read(v,"flickTrajectoryWaitMs",t.flickTrajectoryWaitMs);
    Read(v,"flickTrajectoryApexWindowMs",t.flickTrajectoryApexWindowMs);
    Read(v,"flick2ndTriggerGate",t.flick2ndTriggerGate);
    Read(v,"flick2ndBoxPadding",t.flick2ndBoxPadding);
    Read(v,"flick2ndInnerRadius",t.flick2ndInnerRadius);
    Read(v,"flick2ndInnerSmoothScale",t.flick2ndInnerSmoothScale);
    Read(v,"flick2ndInnerMethod",t.flick2ndInnerMethod);
    Read(v,"baseSpeed",t.baseSpeed);
    Read(v,"moveSplitEnabled",t.moveSplitEnabled);
    Read(v,"moveSplitMaxPixels",t.moveSplitMaxPixels);
    Read(v,"moveSplitDelayUs",t.moveSplitDelayUs);
    Read(v,"releaseToFire",t.releaseToFire);
    Read(v,"autoCharge",t.autoCharge);
    Read(v,"chargeFallbackMs",t.chargeFallbackMs);
    Read(v,"releaseExecution",t.releaseExecution);
    Read(v,"releaseAimTimeoutMs",t.releaseAimTimeoutMs);
    Read(v,"startEnabled",t.startLimiter.enabled);
    Read(v,"startCap",t.startLimiter.initialCapDegPerSec);
    Read(v,"startRise",t.startLimiter.capRiseDegPerSec2);
    Read(v,"startRetarget",t.startLimiter.restartOnTargetChange);
    NormalizeBehaviorTuning(t); return t;
}
inline std::string Encode(const Value& v) {
    rapidjson::StringBuffer b; rapidjson::Writer<rapidjson::StringBuffer> w(b); v.Accept(w); return {b.GetString(),b.GetSize()};
}
inline Value ConfigsJson(const std::vector<SlotBehaviorConfig>& configs,Allocator& a) {
    Value result(rapidjson::kArrayType);
    for(const auto& c:configs) {
        Value v(rapidjson::kObjectType), behaviors(rapidjson::kArrayType), motions(rapidjson::kArrayType);
        Put(v,"presetId",c.presetId,a);
        for(const auto& b:c.behaviors) {
            Value item(rapidjson::kObjectType); Put(item,"behavior",b.behavior,a);
            item.AddMember("tuning",TuningJson(b.tuning,a),a); behaviors.PushBack(item,a);
        }
        for(const auto& m:c.motions) motions.PushBack(MotionJson(m,a),a);
        v.AddMember("behaviors",behaviors,a); v.AddMember("motions",motions,a); result.PushBack(v,a);
    } return result;
}
inline std::vector<SlotBehaviorConfig> ReadConfigs(const Value& value) {
    std::vector<SlotBehaviorConfig> result;
    if(!value.IsArray()) return result;
    for(const auto& v:value.GetArray()) {
        // Protected defaults and retained legacy caches also occupy entries.
        // ResolveHeroBehaviorMode removes unknown mode IDs after loading.
        SlotBehaviorConfig c; Read(v,"presetId",c.presetId);
        if(c.presetId< -1 || std::any_of(result.begin(),result.end(),[&](const auto& old){return old.presetId==c.presetId;})) continue;
        if(v.IsObject()&&v.HasMember("behaviors")&&v["behaviors"].IsArray()) for(const auto& b:v["behaviors"].GetArray()) {
            int type=-1; Read(b,"behavior",type);
            if(type<0||type>4||c.behaviors.size()>=5||!b.IsObject()||!b.HasMember("tuning")||
               std::any_of(c.behaviors.begin(),c.behaviors.end(),[&](const auto& old){return old.behavior==type;})) continue;
            c.behaviors.push_back({type,ReadTuning(b["tuning"], {}, type)});
        }
        if(v.IsObject()&&v.HasMember("motions")&&v["motions"].IsArray()) for(const auto& m:v["motions"].GetArray()) {
            const auto motion=ReadMotion(m);
            if(c.motions.size()<AimPlan::kMotionMethodCount&&!std::any_of(c.motions.begin(),c.motions.end(),[&](const auto& old){return old.method==motion.method;})) c.motions.push_back(motion);
        }
        result.push_back(std::move(c));
    } return result;
}
inline Value StateJson(const AimModeRuntime& state,Allocator& a) {
    Value v(rapidjson::kObjectType); Put(v,"enabled",state.enabled,a);
    v.AddMember("tuning",TuningJson(state.tuning,a),a);
    v.AddMember("motion",MotionJson(state.motion,a),a);
    v.AddMember("configs",ConfigsJson(state.configs,a),a);return v;
}
inline AimModeRuntime ReadState(const Value& v) {
    AimModeRuntime s; Read(v,"enabled",s.enabled);
    if(!v.IsObject()) return s;
    if(v.HasMember("tuning")) s.tuning=ReadTuning(v["tuning"]);
    if(v.HasMember("motion")) s.motion=ReadMotion(v["motion"]);
    if(v.HasMember("configs")) s.configs=ReadConfigs(v["configs"]);return s;
}
```

`src/config/AimPlanJson.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/AimPlan.hpp"
#include <type_traits>
#pragma push_macro("min")
#pragma push_macro("max")
#undef min
#undef max
#include <rapidjson/document.h>
#include <rapidjson/writer.h>
#include <rapidjson/stringbuffer.h>
#pragma pop_macro("max")
#pragma pop_macro("min")
namespace OW::AimPlan::Json {
using Value=rapidjson::Value;
using Allocator=rapidjson::Document::AllocatorType;
template<class T> void Read(const Value& v,const char* key,T& dst) {
    if(!v.IsObject()) return; auto i=v.FindMember(key); if(i==v.MemberEnd()) return;
    const auto& x=i->value;
    if constexpr(std::is_same_v<T,bool>) { if(x.IsBool()) dst=x.GetBool(); }
    else if constexpr(std::is_integral_v<T> && std::is_signed_v<T>) { if(x.IsInt64() && x.GetInt64()>=(std::numeric_limits<T>::min)() && x.GetInt64()<=(std::numeric_limits<T>::max)()) dst=T(x.GetInt64()); }
    else if constexpr(std::is_integral_v<T>) { if(x.IsUint64() && x.GetUint64()<=uint64_t((std::numeric_limits<T>::max)())) dst=T(x.GetUint64()); }
    else if(x.IsNumber() && std::isfinite(x.GetDouble())) dst=T(x.GetDouble());
}
template<class T> void Put(Value& v,const char* key,T x,Allocator& a) {
    Value k; k.SetString(key,a); Value b;
    if constexpr(std::is_same_v<T,bool>) b.SetBool(x);
    else if constexpr(std::is_integral_v<T> && std::is_signed_v<T>) b.SetInt64(int64_t(x));
    else if constexpr(std::is_integral_v<T>) b.SetUint64(uint64_t(x));
    else b.SetDouble(x);
    v.AddMember(k,b,a);
}
inline void Text(Value& v,const char* key,const std::string& text,Allocator& a) {
    Value k,b; k.SetString(key,a); b.SetString(text.c_str(),rapidjson::SizeType(text.size()),a); v.AddMember(k,b,a);
}
inline void ReadIds(const Value& v,const char* key,std::vector<uint64_t>& ids) {
    if(!v.IsObject()||!v.HasMember(key)||!v[key].IsArray()) return;
    ids.clear(); for(const auto& x:v[key].GetArray()) { if(ids.size()>=kMaxHeroes) break; if(x.IsUint64()&&x.GetUint64()) ids.push_back(x.GetUint64()); }
}
inline void PutIds(Value& v,const char* key,const std::vector<uint64_t>& ids,Allocator& a) {
    Value list(rapidjson::kArrayType); for(auto id:ids) list.PushBack(id,a);
    Value k; k.SetString(key,a); v.AddMember(k,list,a);
}
inline Motion ReadMotion(const Value& v,Motion m={}) {
    Read(v,"responseX1",m.responseCurve.x1); Read(v,"responseY1",m.responseCurve.y1);
    Read(v,"responseX2",m.responseCurve.x2); Read(v,"responseY2",m.responseCurve.y2);

inline Plan ReadPlan(const Value& v) {
    Plan p; if(!v.IsObject()) return p;
    auto& s=p.selection;
    Read(v,"mode",s.mode); Read(v,"predicate",s.predicate); ReadIds(v,"heroes",s.heroes);
    Read(v,"angleWeight",s.angleWeight); Read(v,"distanceWeight",s.distanceWeight); Read(v,"healthWeight",s.healthWeight);
    Read(v,"minHealth",s.minHealth); Read(v,"maxHealth",s.maxHealth);
    Read(v,"overrideMotion",p.overrideMotion); if(v.HasMember("motion")) p.motion=ReadMotion(v["motion"]);
    if(v.HasMember("groups")&&v["groups"].IsArray()) for(const auto& x:v["groups"].GetArray()) {
        if(p.groups.size()>=kMaxGroups) break; if(!x.IsObject()) continue;
        Group g; Read(x,"id",g.id); if(x.HasMember("name")&&x["name"].IsString()) g.name=x["name"].GetString();
        ReadIds(x,"heroes",g.heroes);
        Read(x,"overrideLimits",g.overrideLimits); Read(x,"overrideAimPoint",g.overrideAimPoint); Read(x,"overrideMotion",g.overrideMotion);
        Read(x,"minDistance",g.limits.minDistance); Read(x,"maxDistance",g.limits.maxDistance); Read(x,"fov",g.limits.fov);
        Read(x,"minHealth",g.limits.minHealth); Read(x,"maxHealth",g.limits.maxHealth);
        Read(x,"boneMask",g.point.boneMask); Read(x,"predictionMode",g.point.predictionMode);
        if(x.HasMember("motion")) g.motion=ReadMotion(x["motion"]);
        p.groups.push_back(std::move(g));
    }
    Normalize(p); return p;
}
inline Value PlanJson(const Plan& input,Allocator& a) {
    Plan p=input; Normalize(p); Value v(rapidjson::kObjectType); const auto& s=p.selection;
    Put(v,"version",1,a); Put(v,"mode",s.mode,a); Put(v,"predicate",s.predicate,a); PutIds(v,"heroes",s.heroes,a);
    Put(v,"angleWeight",s.angleWeight,a); Put(v,"distanceWeight",s.distanceWeight,a); Put(v,"healthWeight",s.healthWeight,a);
    Put(v,"minHealth",s.minHealth,a); Put(v,"maxHealth",s.maxHealth,a); Put(v,"overrideMotion",p.overrideMotion,a);
    v.AddMember("motion",MotionJson(p.motion,a),a);
    Value groups(rapidjson::kArrayType); for(const auto& g:p.groups) {
        Value x(rapidjson::kObjectType); Put(x,"id",g.id,a); Text(x,"name",g.name,a); PutIds(x,"heroes",g.heroes,a);
        Put(x,"overrideLimits",g.overrideLimits,a); Put(x,"overrideAimPoint",g.overrideAimPoint,a); Put(x,"overrideMotion",g.overrideMotion,a);
        Put(x,"minDistance",g.limits.minDistance,a); Put(x,"maxDistance",g.limits.maxDistance,a); Put(x,"fov",g.limits.fov,a);
        Put(x,"minHealth",g.limits.minHealth,a); Put(x,"maxHealth",g.limits.maxHealth,a);
        Put(x,"boneMask",g.point.boneMask,a); Put(x,"predictionMode",g.point.predictionMode,a);
        x.AddMember("motion",MotionJson(g.motion,a),a); groups.PushBack(x,a);
    }
    v.AddMember("groups",groups,a); return v;
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Alerts/Settings.hpp"
#include <rapidjson/document.h>
#include <rapidjson/writer.h>
#include <rapidjson/stringbuffer.h>

namespace V2::Alerts {
inline Settings DecodeSettings(const std::string& json) {
    Settings result;
    rapidjson::Document root;
    root.Parse<rapidjson::kParseValidateEncodingFlag>(json.c_str());
    if (root.HasParseError() || !root.IsObject()) return result;
    if (root.HasMember("enabled") && root["enabled"].IsBool()) result.skillEnabled = root["enabled"].GetBool();
    if (root.HasMember("skillEnabled") && root["skillEnabled"].IsBool()) result.skillEnabled = root["skillEnabled"].GetBool();
    if (root.HasMember("ultimateEnabled") && root["ultimateEnabled"].IsBool()) result.ultimateEnabled = root["ultimateEnabled"].GetBool();
    if (root.HasMember("ultimateAll") && root["ultimateAll"].IsBool()) result.ultimateAll = root["ultimateAll"].GetBool();
    if (root.HasMember("ultimateMessage") && root["ultimateMessage"].IsString())
        result.ultimateMessage.assign(root["ultimateMessage"].GetString(), root["ultimateMessage"].GetStringLength());
    if (root.HasMember("voice") && root["voice"].IsInt()) result.voice = root["voice"].GetInt();
    if (root.HasMember("volume") && root["volume"].IsInt()) result.volume = root["volume"].GetInt();
    if (root.HasMember("outputDevice") && root["outputDevice"].IsString())
        result.outputDevice.assign(root["outputDevice"].GetString(), root["outputDevice"].GetStringLength());
    if (root.HasMember("rules") && root["rules"].IsArray()) {
        result.rules.clear();
        for (const auto& entry : root["rules"].GetArray()) {
            if (!entry.IsObject() || !entry.HasMember("id") || !entry["id"].IsString()) continue;
            RuleSettings rule;
            rule.message.clear(); // Missing text inherits this rule's catalog default.
            rule.id.assign(entry["id"].GetString(), entry["id"].GetStringLength());
            for (const auto& definition : kDefinitions)
                if (definition.id == rule.id) rule.enabled = definition.enabledByDefault;
            if (entry.HasMember("enabled") && entry["enabled"].IsBool()) rule.enabled = entry["enabled"].GetBool();
            if (entry.HasMember("message") && entry["message"].IsString())
                rule.message.assign(entry["message"].GetString(), entry["message"].GetStringLength());
            result.rules.push_back(std::move(rule));
        }
    }
    if (root.HasMember("ultimates") && root["ultimates"].IsArray()) {
        for (const auto& entry : root["ultimates"].GetArray()) {
            if (!entry.IsObject() || !entry.HasMember("hero") || !entry["hero"].IsUint64()) continue;
            UltimateRule rule{entry["hero"].GetUint64()};
            if (entry.HasMember("mode") && entry["mode"].IsInt()) rule.mode = entry["mode"].GetInt();
            if (entry.HasMember("message") && entry["message"].IsString())
                rule.message.assign(entry["message"].GetString(), entry["message"].GetStringLength());
            result.ultimates.push_back(std::move(rule));
        }
    }
    return Normalize(std::move(result));
}
inline std::string EncodeSettings(const Settings& raw) {
    const auto settings = Normalize(raw);
    rapidjson::StringBuffer buffer;
    // ASCII escaping preserves Chinese text through the existing ANSI INI writer.
    rapidjson::Writer<rapidjson::StringBuffer, rapidjson::UTF8<>, rapidjson::ASCII<>> writer(buffer);
    writer.StartObject();
    writer.Key("version"); writer.Int(2);
    writer.Key("skillEnabled"); writer.Bool(settings.skillEnabled);
    writer.Key("ultimateEnabled"); writer.Bool(settings.ultimateEnabled);
    writer.Key("ultimateAll"); writer.Bool(settings.ultimateAll);
    writer.Key("ultimateMessage"); writer.String(settings.ultimateMessage.c_str());
    writer.Key("voice"); writer.Int(settings.voice);
    writer.Key("volume"); writer.Int(settings.volume);
    writer.Key("outputDevice"); writer.String(settings.outputDevice.c_str());
    writer.Key("rules"); writer.StartArray();
    for (const auto& rule : settings.rules) {
        writer.StartObject();
        writer.Key("id"); writer.String(rule.id.c_str());
        writer.Key("enabled"); writer.Bool(rule.enabled);
        writer.Key("message"); writer.String(rule.message.c_str());
        writer.EndObject();
    }
    writer.EndArray();
    writer.Key("ultimates"); writer.StartArray();
    for (const auto& rule : settings.ultimates) {
        writer.StartObject();
        writer.Key("hero"); writer.Uint64(rule.hero);
        writer.Key("mode"); writer.Int(rule.mode);
        writer.Key("message"); writer.String(rule.message.c_str());
        writer.EndObject();
    }
    writer.EndArray(); writer.EndObject();
    return {buffer.GetString(), buffer.GetSize()};
}
}
```

```cpp
std::string Utf8(const std::wstring& value) {
    if (value.empty()) return {};
    const int count=WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value.data(),static_cast<int>(value.size()),nullptr,0,nullptr,nullptr);
    if (!count) return {};
    std::string result(count,'\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8,WC_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value.data(),static_cast<int>(value.size()),result.data(),count,nullptr,nullptr);
    return result;
}
bool Wide(const rapidjson::Value& value,std::wstring& out) {
    if(!value.IsString() || value.GetStringLength()>32768) return false;
    const auto length=static_cast<int>(value.GetStringLength());
    if(!length){out.clear();return true;}
    const int count=MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8,MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value.GetString(),length,nullptr,0);
    if(!count)return false;
    out.resize(count);MultiByteToWideChar(CP_UTF8,MB_ERR_INVALID_CHARS,value.GetString(),length,out.data(),count);
    return out.find(L'\0')==std::wstring::npos;
}
Rgb FromColor(const ImVec4& color) {
    // Use the exact bytes written by the native-outline path, including its
    // truncation rule. Rounding independently breaks zero-tolerance matching.
    const auto packed=OW::EdOutline::Color(color.x,color.y,color.z);
    return {static_cast<std::uint8_t>(packed),static_cast<std::uint8_t>(packed>>8),static_cast<std::uint8_t>(packed>>16)};
}

}

bool Decode(const std::string& json,Settings& output,std::string& failure) {
    failure.clear();rapidjson::Document d;d.Parse(json.data(),json.size());
    if(d.HasParseError()||!d.IsObject()||!d.HasMember("version")||!d["version"].IsInt()||d["version"].GetInt()!=1){failure="Invalid capture settings JSON or version";return false;}
    Settings s;bool valid=true;
    auto integer=[&](const char* key,int& value){if(d.HasMember(key)){if(d[key].IsInt())value=d[key].GetInt();else valid=false;}};
    auto number=[&](const char* key,auto& value){if(d.HasMember(key)){if(d[key].IsNumber())value=static_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(value)>>(d[key].GetDouble());else valid=false;}};
    auto boolean=[&](const char* key,bool& value){if(d.HasMember(key)){if(d[key].IsBool())value=d[key].GetBool();else valid=false;}};
    if(d.HasMember("devicePath"))valid=Wide(d["devicePath"],s.capture.devicePath)&&valid;
    if(d.HasMember("deviceName"))valid=Wide(d["deviceName"],s.capture.deviceName)&&valid;
    integer("width",s.capture.width);integer("height",s.capture.height);number("fps",s.capture.fps);boolean("useOutlineColors",s.useOutlineColors);
    integer("tolerance",s.tolerance);integer("roiWidth",s.roiWidth);integer("roiHeight",s.roiHeight);number("maxFrameAgeMs",s.maxFrameAgeMs);
    number("associationRadiusPx",s.associationRadiusPx);number("contactRadiusPx",s.contactRadiusPx);integer("touchDelayMs",s.touchDelayMs);
    integer("lostGraceMs",s.lostGraceMs);integer("minComponentPixels",s.minComponentPixels);
    if(d.HasMember("colors")){
        const auto& colors=d["colors"];
        if(!colors.IsArray()||colors.Size()!=3)valid=false;
        else for(rapidjson::SizeType i=0;i<3;++i){
            const auto& c=colors[i];
            if(!c.IsArray()||c.Size()!=3){valid=false;continue;}
            std::uint8_t values[3]{};
            for(rapidjson::SizeType j=0;j<3;++j){if(!c[j].IsUint()||c[j].GetUint()>255)valid=false;else values[j]=static_cast<std::uint8_t>(c[j].GetUint());}
            s.colors[i]={values[0],values[1],values[2]};
        }
    }
    std::wstring detail;
    if(!valid||!ValidateSettings(s,&detail)){failure=detail.empty()?"Invalid capture settings value":Utf8(detail);return false;}
    s.enabled=false;output=std::move(s);return true;
}

    SyncOutlinePalette();return true;
}
```

`src/config/FileTransaction.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "FileTransaction.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
namespace V2::ConfigStorage {
        // Each caller keeps its own result so a background hero save cannot
        // overwrite the error that the menu is about to display.
        namespace { thread_local std::string gPersistenceError; }
        std::string& PersistenceError() { return gPersistenceError; }

        void BeginPersistenceOperation()
        {
            gPersistenceError.clear();
        }

        bool PersistenceFailure(const std::string& path, const char* operation,
                                DWORD error)
        {
            if (gPersistenceError.empty()) {
                char detail[256]{};
                std::snprintf(detail, sizeof(detail), "%s failed (Windows error %lu): ",
                              operation, static_cast<unsigned long>(error));
                gPersistenceError = detail + path;
            }
            return false;
        }

        bool MakeSiblingTemporaryFile(const std::string& path, std::string& temporary)
        {
            const size_t slash = path.find_last_of("\\/");
            const std::string directory = slash == std::string::npos ? "." : path.substr(0, slash);
            char name[MAX_PATH]{};
            if (!GetTempFileNameA(directory.c_str(), "unc", 0, name))
                return PersistenceFailure(path, "Create temporary file");
            temporary = name;
            return true;
        }

        bool CommitTemporaryFile(const std::string& temporary, const std::string& path)
        {
            if (MoveFileExA(temporary.c_str(), path.c_str(),
                            MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING | MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH))
                return true;
            const DWORD error = GetLastError();
            DeleteFileA(temporary.c_str());
            return PersistenceFailure(path, "Replace config", error);
        }

        bool WriteAtomicBytes(const std::string& path, const char* bytes, size_t size)
        {
            std::string temporary;
            if (!MakeSiblingTemporaryFile(path, temporary))
                return false;
            HANDLE file = CreateFileA(temporary.c_str(), GENERIC_WRITE, 0, nullptr,
                                      TRUNCATE_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
            bool ok = file != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
            DWORD error = ok ? ERROR_SUCCESS : GetLastError();
            if (ok) {
                size_t offset = 0;
                while (offset < size) {
                    const DWORD chunk = static_cast<DWORD>((std::min)(size - offset, size_t(1 << 20)));
                    DWORD written = 0;
                    if (!WriteFile(file, bytes + offset, chunk, &written, nullptr) || written != chunk) {
                        ok = false;
                        error = GetLastError();
                        if (error == ERROR_SUCCESS) error = ERROR_WRITE_FAULT;
                        break;
                    }
                    offset += written;
                }
                if (ok && !FlushFileBuffers(file)) {
                    ok = false;
                    error = GetLastError();
                }
                if (!CloseHandle(file) && ok) {
                    ok = false;
                    error = GetLastError();
                }
            }
            if (!ok) {
                DeleteFileA(temporary.c_str());
                return PersistenceFailure(path, "Write config", error);
            }
            return CommitTemporaryFile(temporary, path);
        }

}
```

```cpp
#include "HeroProfileWorker.hpp"
#include "Game/Overwatch.hpp"
#include "output/AutomaticDeviceSelection.hpp"

// =========================================================================
// Config save/load thread
// =========================================================================

namespace OW { namespace Config {
    bool SaveConfigForHero(const std::string& path, uint64_t heroId, uint64_t linkBase);
    void LoadConfigForHero(const std::string& path, uint64_t heroId, uint64_t linkBase);
}}

void configsavenloadthread() {
    OW::HeroProfileSwitchDebouncer heroSwitchDebouncer;
    uint64_t observedConnectionEpoch = 0;
    DWORD lastInvalidHeroLogTick = 0;
    while (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning()) {
        if (!OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
            heroSwitchDebouncer.Reset();
            observedConnectionEpoch = 0;
            OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(100);
            continue;
        }

        const uint64_t connectionEpoch =
            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        if (connectionEpoch != observedConnectionEpoch) {
            heroSwitchDebouncer.Reset();
            observedConnectionEpoch = connectionEpoch;
        }

        const OW::c_entity localSnapshot = OW::SnapshotLocalEntity();
        const uint64_t currentHeroId = localSnapshot.HeroID;
        const bool validHero = OW::GameData::IsKnownHeroId(currentHeroId);
        const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
        if (currentHeroId != 0 && !validHero &&
            (lastInvalidHeroLogTick == 0 || now - lastInvalidHeroLogTick >= 5000)) {
            Diagnostics::Warn(
                "Ignored unknown local hero id during profile selection. heroId=0x%llX linkBase=0x%llX.",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(currentHeroId),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(localSnapshot.LinkBase));
            lastInvalidHeroLogTick = now;
        }

        bool switchedHero = false;
        if (!OW::Config::Menu) {
            const auto profileSwitch = heroSwitchDebouncer.Observe(
                currentHeroId,
                localSnapshot.LinkBase,
                GetTickCount64(),
                validHero);
            if (profileSwitch) {
                if (profileSwitch->previousHeroId != 0) {
                    if (!OW::Config::SaveConfigForHero(
                        OW::Config::ConfigPath(),
                        profileSwitch->previousHeroId,
                        profileSwitch->previousLinkBase)) {
                        heroSwitchDebouncer.RejectSwitch(*profileSwitch);
                        Diagnostics::Warn("Hero profile switch deferred: saving previous hero failed. hero=0x%llX",
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(profileSwitch->previousHeroId));
                        OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1000);
                        continue;
                    }
                }

                OW::Config::LoadConfigForHero(
                    OW::Config::ConfigPath(),
                    profileSwitch->nextHeroId,
                    profileSwitch->nextLinkBase);
                const int outputReconcileStatus =
                    V2::Output::ApplyOutputConfiguration(std::chrono::milliseconds(500), false);
                if (outputReconcileStatus != success) {
                    Diagnostics::Warn(
                        "KMBox hero-profile reconcile failed. heroId=0x%llX status=%d",
                        static_cast<unsigned long long>(profileSwitch->nextHeroId),
                        outputReconcileStatus);
                }
                OW::Config::nowhero = "Now using: " +
                    OW::GetHeroEngNames(
                        profileSwitch->nextHeroId,
                        profileSwitch->nextLinkBase);
                switchedHero = true;
            }
        }

        if (!switchedHero && OW::Config::manualsave &&
            heroSwitchDebouncer.ConfirmedHeroId() != 0) {
            if (OW::Config::SaveConfigForHero(
                OW::Config::ConfigPath(),
                heroSwitchDebouncer.ConfirmedHeroId(),
                heroSwitchDebouncer.ConfirmedLinkBase())) {
                OW::Config::manualsave = false;
            } else {
                OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(1000);
            }
        }
        OW::RuntimeWorkerSleep(2);
    }

}
```

```cpp
unsigned char HidUsage(int vk) {
    if(vk>='A'&&vk<='Z')return static_cast<unsigned char>(4+vk-'A');
    if(vk>='1'&&vk<='9')return static_cast<unsigned char>(30+vk-'1');
    if(vk>=0x70&&vk<=0x7B)return static_cast<unsigned char>(58+vk-0x70);
    switch(vk) {

    case 0xBD:return 45;case 0xBB:return 46;case 0xDB:return 47;case 0xDD:return 48;case 0xDC:return 49;

    }

bool Decode(const std::string& json,bool commit) {
    rapidjson::Document document;document.Parse(json.c_str());
    if(document.HasParseError()||!document.IsObject()||!document.HasMember("version")||!document["version"].IsInt()||document["version"].GetInt()!=1)return false;
    auto next=std::make_shared<Store>();
    if(document.HasMember("display"))next->display=VisualSettings::Decode(document["display"]);
    if(document.HasMember("defaults"))next->defaults=Read(document["defaults"],{});
    // Unconfigured heroes always start disabled, even if a malformed default section enables them.
    next->defaults.alertsEnabled=false;
    if(document.HasMember("heroes")&&document["heroes"].IsObject())for(auto i=document["heroes"].MemberBegin();i!=document["heroes"].MemberEnd();++i) {
        char* end=nullptr;const auto hero=std::strtoull(i->name.GetString(),&end,10);
        if(hero&&end&&!*end&&next->heroes.size()<128)next->heroes.emplace(hero,Read(i->value,next->defaults));
    }
    if(commit){std::lock_guard lock(edits);current.store(std::move(next));}return true;
}

}
```

```cpp
#include "SlotStorageInternal.hpp"
#include "Utils/InputLabels.hpp"
// 所有公开读写经 Config::mutex / ScopedConfigAuthority；序列化共享相同规范化规则。
// UI 命令不返回容器引用，worker 读取配置快照中的值，删除不会留下悬空 Slot。
namespace OW::Config {
using namespace Detail;
    bool Detail::TryGetHeroPresetFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, HeroPreset& outPreset)
    {
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end())
            return false;

        for (const HeroSlotPreset& slot : item->second) {
            if (slot.present && slot.enabled) {
                outPreset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, slot.preset);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static bool HasHeroPresetInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId)
    {
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        return item != store.end() && CountHeroPresetSlots(item->second) > 0;
    }

    static HeroPreset GetHeroPresetOrDefaultFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        if (item != store.end() &&
            item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].present)
            return ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].preset);
        return kind == HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim
            ? MakeHeroAimPresetFromCurrentUnlocked()
            : MakeHeroTriggerPresetFromCurrentUnlocked();
    }

    void SetHeroPreset(uint64_t heroId, const HeroPreset& preset)

        SetHeroPreset(heroId, 0, preset);

    static std::array<HeroSlotPreset, kHeroPresetSlotCount>& EnsureHeroPresetSlotsInStore(
        HeroPresetSlotKind kind,
        uint64_t heroId)
    {
        auto& store = PresetStore(kind);
        auto [item, inserted] = store.try_emplace(heroId);
        if (inserted)
            InitializeBasicHeroPresetSlots(item->second, heroId, kind);
        else
            NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(item->second, heroId, kind);
        return item->second;
    }

    static void EnsureHeroPresetSlotRange(std::array<HeroSlotPreset, kHeroPresetSlotCount>& slots,
                                          int slotIndex)
    {
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        const int presentCount = CountHeroPresetSlots(slots);
        for (int index = presentCount; index <= clampedSlotIndex; ++index) {
            HeroSlotPreset& slot = slots[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
            ResetHeroPresetSlot(slot, index);
            slot.present = true;
            slot.enabled = true;
        }
    }

    static void SetHeroPresetInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, const HeroPreset& preset)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return;

        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        auto& slots = EnsureHeroPresetSlotsInStore(kind, heroId);
        EnsureHeroPresetSlotRange(slots, clampedSlotIndex);
        slots[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].preset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, preset);
        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(slots, heroId, kind);
    }

    void SetHeroPreset(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, const HeroPreset& preset)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroPresetInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex, preset);
    }

    void SetHeroAimPreset(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, const HeroPreset& preset)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroPresetInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex, preset);
    }

    void SetHeroTriggerPreset(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, const HeroPreset& preset)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroPresetInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex, preset);
    }

    void SetHeroAimSlotScopeRequirement(uint64_t heroId,
                                        int slotIndex,
                                        AimScopeRequirement requirement)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return;

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        auto& slots = EnsureHeroPresetSlotsInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId);
        EnsureHeroPresetSlotRange(slots, clampedSlotIndex);

        HeroSlotPreset& slot = slots[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)];
        // Kept for callers that still use the old scope setter.  Action
        // Profile is now the only runtime source, so the requested scope is
        // not allowed to mutate the selected action or persist as a second
        // independent decision.
        (void)requirement;
        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(slots, heroId, HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim);
    }

    static std::string GetHeroSlotNameFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end() ||
            !item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].present)
            return DefaultHeroSlotName(clampedSlotIndex);

        return NormalizeHeroSlotName(item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].name, clampedSlotIndex);
    }

    static bool TryGetHeroSlotFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, HeroSlotPreset& outSlot)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return false;

        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end())
            return false;

        const HeroSlotPreset& slot = item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)];
        if (!slot.present)
            return false;

        outSlot = slot;
        outSlot.name = NormalizeHeroSlotName(outSlot.name, clampedSlotIndex);
        outSlot.preset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, outSlot.preset);
        outSlot.scopeRequirement = kind == HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim
            ? DefaultAimScopeRequirementForHeroAction(
                heroId,
                outSlot.preset.trigger.action)
            : AimScopeRequirement::All;
        outSlot.present = true;
        return true;
    }

    std::string GetHeroSlotName(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return GetHeroSlotNameFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    std::string GetHeroAimSlotName(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return GetHeroSlotNameFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    std::string GetHeroTriggerSlotName(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return GetHeroSlotNameFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    bool TryGetHeroAimSlot(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, HeroSlotPreset& outSlot)
    {
        if (configView && !configAuthority) {
            const auto& store = configView->heroAimPresets.Read();
            auto item = store.find(heroId);
            if (item == store.end()) return false;
            outSlot = item->second[static_cast<size_t>(ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex))];
            if (!outSlot.present)
                return false;
            outSlot.name = NormalizeHeroSlotName(outSlot.name, ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex));
            outSlot.preset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, outSlot.preset);
            // Action Profile is the runtime source of stance.  Keep the
            // persisted scope field as a compatibility projection only.
            outSlot.scopeRequirement = DefaultAimScopeRequirementForHeroAction(
                heroId,
                outSlot.preset.trigger.action);
            return true;
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return TryGetHeroSlotFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex, outSlot);
    }

    bool TryGetHeroTriggerSlot(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, HeroSlotPreset& outSlot)
    {
        if (configView && !configAuthority) {
            const auto& store = configView->heroTriggerPresets.Read();
            auto item = store.find(heroId);
            if (item == store.end()) return false;
            outSlot = item->second[static_cast<size_t>(ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex))];
            if (!outSlot.present)
                return false;
            outSlot.name = NormalizeHeroSlotName(outSlot.name, ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex));
            outSlot.preset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, outSlot.preset);
            outSlot.scopeRequirement = AimScopeRequirement::All;
            return true;
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return TryGetHeroSlotFromStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex, outSlot);
    }

    static bool IsHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        const auto& store = PresetStoreConst(kind);
        const auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end())
            return clampedSlotIndex == 0;

        const HeroSlotPreset& slot = item->second[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)];
        return slot.present && slot.enabled;
    }

    bool IsHeroSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return IsHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    bool IsHeroAimSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return IsHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    bool IsHeroTriggerSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return IsHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    static void SetHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, bool enabled)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return;

        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        auto& slots = EnsureHeroPresetSlotsInStore(kind, heroId);
        EnsureHeroPresetSlotRange(slots, clampedSlotIndex);
        slots[static_cast<size_t>(clampedSlotIndex)].enabled = enabled;
        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(slots, heroId, kind);
    }

    void SetHeroSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, bool enabled)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex, enabled);
    }

    void SetHeroAimSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, bool enabled)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex, enabled);
    }

    void SetHeroTriggerSlotEnabled(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex, bool enabled)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        SetHeroSlotEnabledInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex, enabled);
    }

    static int GetHeroSlotCountInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return 1;

        auto& store = PresetStore(kind);
        auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end())
            return 1;

        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(item->second, heroId, kind);
        return (std::max)(1, CountHeroPresetSlots(item->second));
    }

    int GetHeroAimSlotCount(uint64_t heroId)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return GetHeroSlotCountInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId);
    }

    int GetHeroTriggerSlotCount(uint64_t heroId)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority(false);
        return GetHeroSlotCountInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId);
    }

    static int AddHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, const HeroPreset& seedPreset)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return -1;

        auto& slots = EnsureHeroPresetSlotsInStore(kind, heroId);
        const int presentCount = CountHeroPresetSlots(slots);
        if (presentCount >= kHeroPresetSlotCount)
            return -1;

        HeroSlotPreset& slot = slots[static_cast<size_t>(presentCount)];
        ResetHeroPresetSlot(slot, presentCount);
        slot.present = true;
        slot.enabled = false;
        slot.stableId = NewSlotIdentity();
        slot.name = DefaultHeroSlotName(presentCount);
        slot.preset = ValidateHeroPresetValueForHero(heroId, seedPreset);
        slot.preset.allyKey = OW::Labels::kAimActivationKeyNoneIndex;
        slot.preset.key = OW::Labels::kAimActivationKeyNoneIndex;
        slot.preset.trigger.key = OW::Labels::kAimActivationKeyNoneIndex;
        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(slots, heroId, kind);
        return presentCount;
    }

    int AddHeroAimSlot(uint64_t heroId, const HeroPreset& seedPreset)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        return AddHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, seedPreset);
    }

    int AddHeroTriggerSlot(uint64_t heroId, const HeroPreset& seedPreset)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        return AddHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, seedPreset);
    }

    static bool DeleteHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind kind, uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        if (heroId == 0)
            return false;

        auto& store = PresetStore(kind);
        auto item = store.find(heroId);
        if (item == store.end())
            return false;

        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(item->second, heroId, kind);
        const int presentCount = CountHeroPresetSlots(item->second);
        const int clampedSlotIndex = ClampHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotIndex);
        if (presentCount <= 1 || clampedSlotIndex >= presentCount)
            return false;

        for (int index = clampedSlotIndex; index < presentCount - 1; ++index) {
            HeroSlotPreset slot = item->second[static_cast<size_t>(index + 1)];
            slot.name = NormalizeHeroSlotName(slot.name, index);
            item->second[static_cast<size_t>(index)] = slot;
        }

        ResetHeroPresetSlot(item->second[static_cast<size_t>(presentCount - 1)], presentCount - 1);
        NormalizeHeroPresetSlots(item->second, heroId, kind);
        return true;
    }

    bool DeleteHeroAimSlot(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        return DeleteHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Aim, heroId, slotIndex);
    }

    bool DeleteHeroTriggerSlot(uint64_t heroId, int slotIndex)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex);
        ScopedConfigAuthority authority;
        return DeleteHeroSlotInStore(HeroPresetSlotKind::Trigger, heroId, slotIndex);
    }


}
```

```cpp
#define NOMINMAX
#define _SILENCE_CXX17_ITERATOR_BASE_CLASS_DEPRECATION_WARNING
#include "UiPreferences.hpp"
#include "FileTransaction.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#ifdef min
#undef min
#endif
#ifdef max
#undef max
#endif
#include <rapidjson/document.h>
#include <rapidjson/writer.h>
#include <rapidjson/stringbuffer.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>
#include <iterator>

namespace UI::Preferences {
Values values;
namespace {
bool loaded = false;
std::string error;
std::string Path() { return OW::Config::ConfigDirectoryPath() + "/ui-preferences.json"; }
}
bool Loaded() { return loaded; }
const std::string& Error() { return error; }
bool Load(int legacyLanguage) {
    if (loaded) return error.empty();
    loaded = true;
    values.language = std::clamp(legacyLanguage, 0, 1);
    std::ifstream file(Path(), std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
    if (!file) return true;
    const auto size = file.tellg();
    if (size < 0 || size > 65536) { error = "Invalid UI preferences file size"; return false; }
    file.seekg(0);
    const std::string data((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file)), {});
    rapidjson::Document doc;
    doc.Parse(data.data(), data.size());
    if (doc.HasParseError() || !doc.IsObject()) { error = "Invalid UI preferences JSON"; return false; }
    if(doc.HasMember("version")&&(!doc["version"].IsInt()||doc["version"].GetInt()!=1)){error="Invalid UI preferences version";return false;}
    auto number = [&](const char* name, int& value, int low, int high) {
        if (doc.HasMember(name) && doc[name].IsInt()) value = std::clamp(doc[name].GetInt(), low, high);
    };
    auto boolean = [&](const char* name, bool& value) {
        if (doc.HasMember(name) && doc[name].IsBool()) value = doc[name].GetBool();
    };
    number("language", values.language, 0, 1);
    number("skin", values.skin, 0, 2);
    number("windowWidth", values.windowWidth, 720, 3840);
    number("windowHeight", values.windowHeight, 480, 2160);
    boolean("reducedMotion", values.reducedMotion);
    boolean("loginGlass", values.loginGlass);
    boolean("consoleLayers", values.consoleLayers);
    boolean("sidebarCollapsed", values.sidebarCollapsed);
    boolean("customAccent", values.customAccent);
    if (doc.HasMember("accent") && doc["accent"].IsArray() && doc["accent"].Size() == 4) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i != 4; ++i)
            if (doc["accent"][i].IsNumber() && std::isfinite(doc["accent"][i].GetFloat()))
                (&values.accent.x)[i] = std::clamp(doc["accent"][i].GetFloat(), 0.f, 1.f);
    }
    return true;
}
bool Save() {
    if (!loaded) return true;
    // Preserve a malformed original for recovery instead of overwriting it with defaults.
    if (!error.empty() && error.rfind("Invalid UI preferences", 0) == 0) return false;
    rapidjson::StringBuffer buffer;
    rapidjson::Writer<rapidjson::StringBuffer> w(buffer);
    w.StartObject();
    w.Key("version"); w.Int(1);
    w.Key("language"); w.Int(std::clamp(values.language, 0, 1));
    w.Key("skin"); w.Int(std::clamp(values.skin, 0, 2));
    w.Key("reducedMotion"); w.Bool(values.reducedMotion);
    w.Key("loginGlass"); w.Bool(values.loginGlass);
    w.Key("consoleLayers"); w.Bool(values.consoleLayers);
    w.Key("sidebarCollapsed"); w.Bool(values.sidebarCollapsed);
    w.Key("windowWidth"); w.Int(values.windowWidth);
    w.Key("windowHeight"); w.Int(values.windowHeight);
    w.Key("customAccent"); w.Bool(values.customAccent);
    w.Key("accent"); w.StartArray();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i != 4; ++i) w.Double((&values.accent.x)[i]);
    w.EndArray(); w.EndObject();
    const bool ok = V2::ConfigStorage::WriteAtomicBytes(Path(), buffer.GetString(), buffer.GetSize());
    error = ok ? "" : V2::ConfigStorage::PersistenceError();
    return ok;
}
}
```

```hpp
    if(!hasCrosshair&&root.HasMember("elements")&&root["elements"].IsArray()&&root["elements"].Size()>unsigned(Element::Crosshair)){
        const auto& legacy=root["elements"][unsigned(Element::Crosshair)];
        if(legacy.IsObject()){color(legacy,"visible",settings.crosshair.color);number(legacy,"size",settings.crosshair.size,2,80);number(legacy,"thickness",settings.crosshair.thickness,.5f,8);number(legacy,"offsetX",settings.crosshair.offsetX,-300,300);number(legacy,"offsetY",settings.crosshair.offsetY,-300,300);}
    }
    if(root.HasMember("radar")&&root["radar"].IsObject()){const auto& v=root["radar"];auto& r=settings.radar;
        number(v,"radius",r.radius,40,600);number(v,"rangeM",r.rangeM,5,500);number(v,"markerSize",r.markerSize,3,48);number(v,"backgroundAlpha",r.backgroundAlpha,0,1);
        boolean(v,"allies",r.allies);boolean(v,"rotate",r.rotate);color(v,"enemy",r.enemy);color(v,"ally",r.ally);}
    if(root.HasMember("world")&&root["world"].IsObject()){const auto& v=root["world"];auto& w=settings.world;
        boolean(v,"enabled",w.enabled);boolean(v,"box",w.box);boolean(v,"name",w.name);boolean(v,"icon",w.icon);boolean(v,"distance",w.distance);
        boolean(v,"hideTeam",w.hideTeam);boolean(v,"health",w.health);boolean(v,"healthText",w.healthText);
        boolean(v,"deployables",w.deployables);boolean(v,"projectiles",w.projectiles);
        number(v,"maxDistance",w.maxDistance,0,1000);number(v,"size",w.size,6,80);number(v,"iconSize",w.iconSize,6,80);
        if(v.HasMember("types")&&v["types"].IsArray())for(unsigned i=0;i<v["types"].Size()&&i<w.types.size();++i)if(v["types"][i].IsBool())w.types[i]=v["types"][i].GetBool();
        if(v.HasMember("colors")&&v["colors"].IsArray())for(unsigned i=0;i<v["colors"].Size()&&i<w.colors.size();++i) {
            const auto& a=v["colors"][i];if(!a.IsArray()||a.Size()!=4)continue;
            for(unsigned c=0;c<4;++c)if(a[c].IsNumber()&&std::isfinite(a[c].GetFloat()))(&w.colors[i].x)[c]=std::clamp(a[c].GetFloat(),0.f,1.f);
        }
    }
    return settings;
}
```

```cpp
namespace {

    constexpr const char* kProductVariantName = "un-dma-v2";

    std::atomic<bool> g_DiagnosticsThreadRunning{ false };
    std::thread g_DiagnosticsThread;

    bool ProcessTimerResolutionRequested()
    {
        char buffer[16] = {};
        const DWORD length = GetEnvironmentVariableA(
            "UN_DMA_PROCESS_TIMER_RESOLUTION",
            buffer,
            static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(buffer)));
        if (length == 0 || length >= sizeof(buffer))
            return true;
        return !(std::strcmp(buffer, "0") == 0 ||
            _stricmp(buffer, "false") == 0 ||
            _stricmp(buffer, "off") == 0);
    }

    class ProcessTimerResolutionGuard {
    public:
        ProcessTimerResolutionGuard()
            : m_requested(ProcessTimerResolutionRequested())
        {
            if (!m_requested) {
                std::printf("[TIMER] Process 1 ms timer resolution disabled by experiment override.\n");
                return;
            }

            m_result = timeBeginPeriod(1);
            m_enabled = m_result == TIMERR_NOERROR;
            if (m_enabled) {
                std::printf("[TIMER] Process 1 ms timer resolution enabled.\n");
            } else {
                std::printf("[TIMER] timeBeginPeriod(1) failed. result=%u\n",
                    static_cast<unsigned int>(m_result));
            }
        }

        ~ProcessTimerResolutionGuard()
        {
            if (!m_enabled)
                return;
            const MMRESULT endResult = timeEndPeriod(1);
            std::printf("[TIMER] Process 1 ms timer resolution released. result=%u\n",
                static_cast<unsigned int>(endResult));
        }

        bool Requested() const { return m_requested; }
        bool Enabled() const { return m_enabled; }
        MMRESULT Result() const { return m_result; }

    private:
        bool m_requested = false;
        bool m_enabled = false;
        MMRESULT m_result = TIMERR_NOERROR;
    };

    std::string AbsolutePathForLog(const std::string& path)
    {
        try {
            return std::filesystem::absolute(path).string();
        } catch (...) {
            return path;
        }
    }

    bool HasCommandLineFlag(int argc, char** argv, const char* flag)
    {
        for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
            if (argv[index] && std::strcmp(argv[index], flag) == 0)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool TryGetCommandLineInt(int argc, char** argv, const char* flag, int& value)
    {
        for (int index = 1; index + 1 < argc; ++index) {
            if (!argv[index] || std::strcmp(argv[index], flag) != 0)
                continue;

            char* end = nullptr;
            errno = 0;
            const long parsed = std::strtol(argv[index + 1], &end, 10);
            if (end == argv[index + 1] ||
                *end != '\0' ||
                errno == ERANGE ||
                parsed < (std::numeric_limits<int>::min)() ||
                parsed > (std::numeric_limits<int>::max)()) {
                return false;
            }

            value = static_cast<int>(parsed);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void PreloadHeroAvatars()
    {
        IconManager* icons = Render::GetIconManager();
        if (!icons)
            return;

        static constexpr const char* kHeroAvatarNames[] = {
            "Ana", "Anran", "Ashe", "Baptiste", "Bastion", "Brigitte",
            "Cassidy", "Doctrine", "Domina", "Doomfist", "D.Va", "D.Mon", "Echo", "Emre",
            "Freja", "Genji", "Hanzo", "Hazard", "Illari", "Jetpack Cat",
            "Junker Queen", "Junkrat", "Juno", "Kiriko", "LifeWeaver",
            "Lucio", "Mauga", "Mei", "Mercy", "Mizuki", "Moira", "Orisa",
            "Pharah", "Ramattra", "Reaper", "Reinhardt", "Roadhog",
            "Shion", "Sierra", "Sigma", "Sojourn", "Soldier 76", "Sombra",
            "Symmetra", "Torbjorn", "Tracer", "Vendetta", "Venture",
            "Widowmaker", "Winston", "Wrecking Ball", "Wuyang", "Zarya",
            "Zenyatta"
        };

        int loadedCount = 0;
        int overlayLoadedCount = 0;
        for (const char* heroName : kHeroAvatarNames) {
            const std::string slug = OW::HeroDisplayNameToSlug(heroName);
            if (!slug.empty() && icons->LoadHeroAvatar(slug))
                ++loadedCount;
            if (!slug.empty() && icons->LoadHeroAvatar(slug, IconManager::AvatarUse::Overlay))
                ++overlayLoadedCount;
        }

        constexpr size_t heroCount = sizeof(kHeroAvatarNames) / sizeof(kHeroAvatarNames[0]);
        std::printf("[MAIN] Hero avatars loaded: UI %d/%zu, overlay %d/%zu.\n",
            loadedCount, heroCount, overlayLoadedCount, heroCount);
        Diagnostics::Info("Hero avatars loaded: UI %d/%zu, overlay %d/%zu.",
            loadedCount, heroCount, overlayLoadedCount, heroCount);
    }

    static void StartDiagnosticStatusThread()
    {
        g_DiagnosticsThreadRunning.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
        g_DiagnosticsThread = std::thread([]() {
            Diagnostics::Info("Diagnostic status thread started with 5s interval.");
            unsigned intervals = 0;
            while (g_DiagnosticsThreadRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
                if (!g_DiagnosticsThreadRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                    break;
                if (++intervals == 50) {
                    Diagnostics::DumpStatus();
                    intervals = 0;
                }
            }
        });
    }

    static void StopDiagnosticStatusThread()
    {
        g_DiagnosticsThreadRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        if (g_DiagnosticsThread.joinable())
            g_DiagnosticsThread.join();
    }

    static void PreloadAbilityIcons()
    {
        IconManager* iconManager = Render::GetIconManager();
        if (!iconManager) {
            Diagnostics::Warn("Ability icon preload skipped: icon manager is not ready.");
            return;
        }

        int loadedHeroes = 0;
        for (const OW::HeroAbilityIcons& icons : OW::AllHeroAbilityIcons()) {
            if (iconManager->LoadAbilityIcons(icons.heroSlug, {
                    icons.ability1Icon,
                    icons.ability2Icon,
                    icons.ultimateIcon
                })) {
                ++loadedHeroes;
            }
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Ability icon preload complete. heroes=%d/%zu.",
            loadedHeroes,
            OW::HeroAbilityIconCount());
        std::printf("[MAIN] Ability icons preloaded for %d/%zu hero entries.\n",
            loadedHeroes,
            OW::HeroAbilityIconCount());
    }

static void ShutdownHeadlessRuntime(const char* reason = "headless_shutdown")
{
    V2::Runtime::RestoreNativeOutlineBeforeShutdown();
    OW::RequestRuntimeShutdown([] {
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    });
    // Close ordinary output and signal workers before a capture driver can
    // block in Stop/join. Brightness restoration above still needs the reader.
    V2::Vision::GetService().Stop();
    mem.CancelPendingOperations();
    StopProcessConnectionThread();
    V2::Alerts::Stop();
    V2::Runtime::DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers(reason);
    TestServer::Stop();
    KeyState::Stop();
    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0, "Shutting down");
    StopDiagnosticStatusThread();
    mem.CloseDma();
    Diagnostics::SetDmaReady(false);
    Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(false);
    ShutdownOutputRuntime(reason);
    Diagnostics::ShutdownAimLog();
    Diagnostics::Shutdown();
    RuntimeTrace::Stop();
}

#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
#include "OverlayStatusSelfTest.inl"
#include "RuntimeControlSelfTest.inl"
#include "OverlayFrameRateProbe.inl"
#endif

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    V2::Launcher::enabled=HasCommandLineFlag(argc,argv,"--launcher-stdio") && GetFileType(GetStdHandle(STD_INPUT_HANDLE))==FILE_TYPE_PIPE;
    CrashDump::InstallUnhandledExceptionFilter(L"crash_dumps");

    // ---- Console ----
    SetConsoleTitleA("UNDMA V2");

    std::printf("\n");
    std::printf("  ============================================\n");
    std::printf("     UNDMA V2 -- Overwatch CN\n");
    std::printf("  ============================================\n");
    std::printf("\n");

    for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index) {
        const std::string argument = argv[index] ? argv[index] : "";
        if (argument == "--help" || argument == "-h") {
            std::printf("Usage: UNDMA_V2 [--config-check] [--test-server]\n"
                        "       [--test-server-port 1..65535] [--test-server-cors] [--box-perf-mode]\n       [--run-seconds 1..1800] [--reconnect-after 1..1799] [--canvas-only]\n       [--profile auto|cn|world|nexon] [--capture-screen] [--aim-diagnostics]\n");
            return 0;
        }
        if (argument == "--profile") {
            if (++index>=argc) { std::fprintf(stderr,"Missing --profile value.\n"); return 2; }
            const std::string value=argv[index];
            if (value == "world-candidate" || value == "nexon-candidate" || value == "kr-candidate") {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "Candidate-only profiles were retired. Use --profile world or --profile nexon for the full runtime.\n");
                return 2;
            }
            const int selected = value == "auto" ? -1 : value == "cn" ? 0 : value == "world" ? 1 : (value == "nexon" || value == "kr") ? 2 : -2;
            if (selected == -2) { std::fprintf(stderr, "Profile must be auto, cn, world or nexon.\n"); return 2; }
            V2::Profiles::requestedProfile.store(selected);
            continue;
        }
        if (argument == "--test-server-port" || argument == "--run-seconds" || argument == "--reconnect-after") {
            if (++index >= argc) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] %s requires a value.\n", argument.c_str());
                return 1;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (argument == "--config-check" || argument == "--test-server" ||
            argument == "--test-server-cors" || argument == "--box-perf-mode" || argument == "--canvas-only" || argument == "--launcher-stdio" || argument == "--capture-screen" || argument == "--aim-diagnostics")
            continue;
#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
        if (argument == "--functional-only" && HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--config-concurrency-selftest"))
            continue;
        if (argument == "--skill-mode-scope-selftest" || argument == "--aim-release-output-selftest" || argument == "--config-concurrency-selftest" || argument == "--config-persistence-selftest" ||
            argument == "--test-server-lifecycle-selftest" ||
            argument == "--overlay-status-selftest" || argument == "--runtime-control-selftest" ||
            argument == "--overlay-frame-rate-probe")
            continue;
#endif
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Unknown or retired option: %s\n", argument.c_str());
        return 1;
    }

    // ---- Config ----

#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--overlay-frame-rate-probe"))
        return RunOverlayFrameRateProbe();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--runtime-control-selftest"))
        return RunRuntimeControlSelfTest();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--overlay-status-selftest"))
        return RunOverlayStatusSelfTest();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--config-concurrency-selftest"))
        return OW::Config::RunConfigConcurrencySelfTest(HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--functional-only"));
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--skill-mode-scope-selftest"))
        return OW::RunSkillModeScopeSelfTest();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--aim-release-output-selftest"))
        return AimbotDetail::RunAimReleaseOutputSelfTest();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--config-persistence-selftest"))
        return OW::Config::RunPersistenceSelfTest();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--test-server-lifecycle-selftest"))
        return TestServer::RunLifecycleSelfTest();
#endif
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--config-check"))
        return RunConfigCheckCli();
    const bool testServerRequested = HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--test-server");
    const bool testServerCorsRequested = HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--test-server-cors");
    const bool boxPerfModeRequested = HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--box-perf-mode");
    int testServerPortValue = 19560;
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--test-server-port")) {
        if (!TryGetCommandLineInt(argc, argv, "--test-server-port", testServerPortValue) ||
            testServerPortValue <= 0 ||
            testServerPortValue > 65535) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Invalid --test-server-port. Expected 1..65535.\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }

    int runSeconds=0, reconnectAfter=0;
    for(const auto& option : {std::pair{"--run-seconds", &runSeconds},
                              std::pair{"--reconnect-after", &reconnectAfter}}) {
        if(HasCommandLineFlag(argc,argv,option.first) &&
           (!TryGetCommandLineInt(argc,argv,option.first,*option.second) ||
            *option.second<1 || *option.second>1800)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr,"[FATAL] Invalid %s; expected 1..1800.\n",option.first);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    if(reconnectAfter && (!runSeconds || reconnectAfter>=runSeconds)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr,"[FATAL] --reconnect-after must be less than --run-seconds.\n");
        return 1;
    }

    if (!RuntimeTrace::Start()) { std::fprintf(stderr,"Trace file open failed.\n"); return 2; }
    ProcessTimerResolutionGuard processTimerResolution;

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 1 -- Load settings before starting hardware connections
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    Diagnostics::Initialize(Diagnostics::LogLevel::Info, "./undma_v2_diag.log");
    Diagnostics::InitializeAimLog("./undma_v2_aim_diag.log");
    Diagnostics::SetProcessTimerResolutionStatus(
        processTimerResolution.Requested(),
        processTimerResolution.Enabled(),
        static_cast<uint32_t>(processTimerResolution.Result()));
    Diagnostics::Info(
        "Process timer resolution: requested=%d enabled=%d result=%u period_ms=1.",
        processTimerResolution.Requested() ? 1 : 0,
        processTimerResolution.Enabled() ? 1 : 0,
        static_cast<unsigned int>(processTimerResolution.Result()));
    OW::Config::InitializeActiveConfigProfile();
    const std::string configPath = OW::Config::ConfigPath();
    const std::string configPathForLog = AbsolutePathForLog(configPath);
    if (OW::Config::LoadConfig(configPath) != OW::Config::ConfigLoadResult::Loaded) {
        Diagnostics::Error("Config load failed: %s", OW::Config::LastPersistenceError().c_str());
        return EXIT_FAILURE;
    }
    const bool capturePreferencesLoaded = V2::Vision::Preferences::Load();
    if (!capturePreferencesLoaded)
        Diagnostics::Warn("Capture preferences unavailable: %s", V2::Vision::Preferences::Error().c_str());
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--aim-diagnostics")) {
        OW::Config::aimVerboseLogPersistedPreference = OW::Config::aimVerboseLog;
        OW::Config::aimVerboseLogSessionOverride = true;
        OW::Config::aimVerboseLog = true;
        Diagnostics::Info("Verbose aim diagnostics enabled for this run by --aim-diagnostics; settings were not saved.");
    }
    if (boxPerfModeRequested) {
        OW::Config::boxPerfMode = true;
        OW::Config::boxPerfFastRect = true;
    }
    OW::RefreshHostMouseDpi();
    OW::RefreshScreenSizeFromConfig();
    Diagnostics::Aim("main.config_loaded configPath=%s screen=%.0fx%.0f outputEnabled=%d deviceType=%d ip=%s commandPort=%d effectiveMonitorPort=%d monitorPortSetting=%d manualOverride=%d countsPerRadian=%.6f calibratedCountsPerRadian=%.6f gameMouseSensitivity=%.6f referenceGameSensitivity=%.6f autoScaleByGameSensitivity=%d hostMouseDpi=%.6f hostDpiDetected=%d",
        configPathForLog.c_str(),
        OW::WX,
        OW::WY,
        OW::Config::outputEnabled ? 1 : 0,
        OW::Config::outputDeviceType,
        OW::Config::outputIp,
        OW::Config::outputPort,
        OW::Config::EffectiveOutputMonitorPort(),
        OW::Config::outputMonitorPort,
        OW::Config::outputMonitorPortManualOverride ? 1 : 0,
        OW::Config::outputCountsPerRadian,
        OW::Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian,
        OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivity,
        OW::Config::referenceGameSensitivity,
        OW::Config::autoScaleByGameSensitivity ? 1 : 0,
        OW::Config::hostMouseDpi,
        OW::Config::hostMouseDpiAutoDetected ? 1 : 0);
    std::printf("[MAIN] Screen size: %.0fx%.0f\n", OW::WX, OW::WY);
    if (OW::Config::boxPerfMode) {
        std::printf("[MAIN] Box performance mode enabled (%s box path).\n",
            OW::Config::boxPerfFastRect ? "fast rect" : "corner");
    }
    Diagnostics::Info("Overlay box performance mode: enabled=%d fast_rect=%d cli=%d.",
        OW::Config::boxPerfMode ? 1 : 0,
        OW::Config::boxPerfFastRect ? 1 : 0,
        boxPerfModeRequested ? 1 : 0);
    Diagnostics::SetDmaReady(false);
    StartDiagnosticStatusThread();

    if (testServerRequested) {
        TestServer::Options testServerOptions{};
        testServerOptions.port = static_cast<uint16_t>(testServerPortValue);
        testServerOptions.allowWildcardCors = testServerCorsRequested;
        if (!TestServer::Start(testServerOptions)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Failed to start UNDMA CN test server on 127.0.0.1:%d.\n",
                testServerPortValue);
            ShutdownHeadlessRuntime();
            return 2;
        }
        std::printf("[MAIN] Test server ready on http://127.0.0.1:%d%s\n\n",
            testServerPortValue,
            testServerCorsRequested ? " (wildcard CORS enabled)" : "");
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 2 -- Start target process connector
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0, "Waiting for DMA device");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 3 -- Resolve global encryption keys (SKIP: vestigial)
    // May 2026 DecryptComponent reads key material directly from game
    // memory and does not use GlobalKey1/2.  GetGlobalKey() is kept
    // as a no-op for diagnostic probes but no longer blocks startup.
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    std::printf("[MAIN] Skipping global key resolution (not used by current decrypt).\n\n");
    Diagnostics::SetKeyStatus(Diagnostics::KeyStatus::Skipped);
    Diagnostics::Info("Global key resolution skipped; current decrypt path reads key material directly.");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 4 -- Initialise the DX11 overlay windows
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    std::printf("[MAIN] Initialising overlay...\n");
    Diagnostics::Info("Initialising overlay.");
    if (!g_Overlay.Initialize(L"UNDMA V2")) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[FATAL] Overlay initialisation failed.\n");
        Diagnostics::Error("Overlay initialisation failed.");
        ShutdownHeadlessRuntime("overlay_init_failure");
        std::printf("[INFO] Press Enter to exit.\n");
        std::getchar();
        return 1;
    }
    std::printf("[MAIN] Overlay ready.\n\n");
    Diagnostics::Info("Overlay ready.");
    PreloadHeroAvatars();
    PreloadAbilityIcons();
    V2::Alerts::Start();
    if (HasCommandLineFlag(argc, argv, "--capture-screen")) {
        // Explicit session-only capture using the same service as the UI and
        // contour consumers. Do not persist enabled state or open a second card.
        auto& capture = V2::Vision::GetService();
        auto settings = capture.GetSettings();
        settings.enabled = true;
        if (capturePreferencesLoaded && capture.Configure(settings) && capture.Start())
            Diagnostics::Info("Capture requested by --capture-screen; waiting for the first frame.");
        else
            Diagnostics::Warn("--capture-screen could not start capture; inspect capture settings and status.");
    }
    V2::Launcher::Send("{\"event\":\"ready\"}");
    StartProcessConnectionThread();
    Diagnostics::Info("Settings ready; hardware and process connection run in background.");

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 5 -- Main loop (blocks until overlay / game closes)
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    std::printf("[MAIN] Entering message loop.  Press HOME to toggle menu.\n");
    std::printf("[MAIN] Close the canvas process/window to exit.\n\n");
    Diagnostics::Info("Entering overlay message loop.");
    Diagnostics::SetRenderThread();

#ifdef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    if(std::getenv("UN_DMA_OBSERVE_SHAPES")) OW::Config::draw_hitbox=true;
    // Keep the canvas running while the observer inspects OBS on this machine.
    // This is a validation launch option; it does not alter saved settings.
    if (std::getenv("UN_DMA_OBSERVE_CANVAS_ONLY"))
        g_Overlay.HideMenu();
    if(const char* seconds=std::getenv("UN_DMA_OBSERVE_SECONDS")) {
        const auto duration=std::clamp(std::strtoul(seconds,nullptr,10),1ul,1800ul)*1000;
        SetTimer(nullptr,0,static_cast<UINT>(duration),[](HWND,UINT,UINT_PTR timer,DWORD) {
            KillTimer(nullptr,timer);g_Overlay.RequestExit();
        });
    }
#endif
    // 有界现场验证使用正式消息循环和正式停机/重连路径，不强杀、不改持久配置。
    if(HasCommandLineFlag(argc,argv,"--canvas-only"))g_Overlay.HideMenu();
    if(runSeconds)SetTimer(nullptr,0,UINT(runSeconds*1000),[](HWND,UINT,UINT_PTR timer,DWORD) {
        KillTimer(nullptr,timer);
        Diagnostics::Info("Validation duration reached; requesting normal exit.");
        g_Overlay.RequestExit();
    });
    if(reconnectAfter)SetTimer(nullptr,0,UINT(reconnectAfter*1000),[](HWND,UINT,UINT_PTR timer,DWORD) {
        KillTimer(nullptr,timer);
        Diagnostics::Info("Validation timer requesting normal reconnect.");
        OW::ProcessConnection::RequestReconnect();
    });
    g_Overlay.Run(V2::Visuals::DrawFrame);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    // Cleanup  --  Run() calls Shutdown() internally, so we just tidy up
    // ---------------------------------------------------------------
    std::printf("\n[MAIN] Display closed.  Shutting down...\n");
    Diagnostics::Info("Display closed. Shutting down.");
    Diagnostics::DumpStatus();
    ShutdownHeadlessRuntime("overlay_shutdown");

    std::printf("[MAIN] Goodbye.\n");
    return 0;
}
```

`src/output/core/Actions.cpp`:
