```cpp
#include "output/Actions.hpp"
#include "output/DeviceRegistry.hpp"
#include "Game/HeroSettings.hpp"
#include "Game/snapshots/SnapshotAccess.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdio>
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>
namespace OW {
    bool DmaKeyToMouseButton(uint32_t key, int& button) {
        switch (key) {
        case 0x1: button = 0; return true;
        case 0x2: button = 1; return true;
        case 0x4: button = 2; return true;
        default: return false;
        }
    }

    int ClampOutputAutomoveRuntimeMs(int moveTimeMs) {
        return std::clamp(moveTimeMs, 0, 20);
    }

    const char* OutputTransportName() {
        return V2::Output::OutputTransportTag(V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor);
    }

    bool ShouldSuppressOutput(
        const char* action,
        OutputIntent intent) {
        if(intent==OutputIntent::Normal && V2::HostInteraction::paused.load(std::memory_order_acquire))return true;
        if (intent == OutputIntent::Normal &&
            CalibrationBlocksNormalOutput(Config::calibrationInProgress.load(std::memory_order_acquire)))
            return true;
        if (intent == OutputIntent::Normal &&
            !RuntimeOutputSessionEnabled()) {
            static std::atomic_flag sessionLogged = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
            if (!sessionLogged.test_and_set(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
                Diagnostics::Aim(
                    "output.output suppressed action=%s reason=process_session_closed intent=%s",
                    action ? action : "unknown",
                    ToString(intent));
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (!ShouldSuppressOutputForMenu(Config::OutputSuppressedByMenu(), intent))
            return false;

        static std::atomic_flag logged = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
        if (!logged.test_and_set(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("output.output suppressed action=%s reason=menu_open intent=%s",
                action ? action : "unknown",
                ToString(intent));
        }
        return true;
    }

    int EnqueueOutputCountMoveForGeneration(
        int countX,
        int countY,
        int automoveRuntimeMs,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration,
        std::uint64_t expectedConnectionEpoch) {
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput("mouse_move"))
            return Config::kOutputSuppressedStatus;

        const OutputRuntimeState runtime = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        if (!runtime.outputGateOpen || expectedGeneration == 0 ||
            runtime.backendGeneration != expectedGeneration ||
            (expectedConnectionEpoch != 0 &&
             (!ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
              ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() != expectedConnectionEpoch))) {
            return err_queue_stopped;
        }
        if (!V2::Output::SupportsTimedMove(V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor)) automoveRuntimeMs=0;
        return V2::Output::DispatchMouseMoveForGeneration(
            expectedGeneration,
            countX,
            countY,
            automoveRuntimeMs);
    }

    int EnqueueOutputCountMove(
        int countX,
        int countY,
        int automoveRuntimeMs) {
        const OutputRuntimeState runtime = CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        return EnqueueOutputCountMoveForGeneration(
            countX,
            countY,
            automoveRuntimeMs,
            runtime.backendGeneration);
    }

    MouseMoveQuantizationState& DefaultMouseMoveQuantizationState() {
        thread_local MouseMoveQuantizationState state{};
        return state;
    }

    MouseMoveQuantizationResult SendMouseMove(
        const Vector3& delta,
        int moveTimeMs,
        const MouseMoveQuantizationOptions& quantization) {
        MouseMoveQuantizationResult result{};
        const std::uint64_t connectionEpoch =
            ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
        const OutputRuntimeState outputRuntime =
            CurrentOutputRuntimeState();
        if (connectionEpoch == 0 || !ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
            !outputRuntime.outputGateOpen ||
            outputRuntime.backendGeneration == 0) {
            Diagnostics::Aim(
                "mouse.move early_return reason=stale_or_unavailable_output_session connectionEpoch=%llu generation=%llu gate=%d",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(connectionEpoch),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(outputRuntime.backendGeneration),
                outputRuntime.outputGateOpen ? 1 : 0);
            return result;
        }
        if (moveTimeMs < 0) moveTimeMs = Config::outputInputDelayMs;
        const int automoveRuntimeMs = ClampOutputAutomoveRuntimeMs(moveTimeMs);
        Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move request delta_rad=(%.9f,%.9f,%.9f) moveTimeMs=%d automoveRuntimeMs=%d enabled=%d deviceType=%d",
            delta.X,
            delta.Y,
            delta.Z,
            moveTimeMs,
            automoveRuntimeMs,
            Config::outputEnabled ? 1 : 0,
            Config::outputDeviceType);
        const V2::Output::OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied = V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied();
        if (applied.descriptor.backend == V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
            !V2::Output::RuntimeController().CanDispatch(applied.generation)) {
            static std::atomic_flag once = ATOMIC_FLAG_INIT;
            if (!once.test_and_set(std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
                std::printf("[OUTPUT] SendMouseMove called without an active Output runtime!\n");
            }
            Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move early_return reason=no_active_runtime lastError=%d",
                V2::Output::RuntimeController().LastError());
            return result;
        }
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput("mouse_move")) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move early_return reason=menu_open_suppressed");
            return result;
        }

        {
            const float baseCountsPerRadian = Config::OutputBaseCountsPerRadian();
            const float syncScale = Config::OutputGameSensitivityScale();
            float sensitivity = Config::OutputYawCountsPerRadian();
            float pitchSensitivity = Config::OutputPitchCountsPerRadian();

            if (!std::isfinite(sensitivity) || sensitivity <= 0.0f) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.convert warning invalid_counts_per_rad computed=%.9f fallback=%.9f autoScale=%d gameSens=%.9f effectiveGameSens=%.9f refSens=%.9f pitchCountsPerRad=%.9f",
                    sensitivity,
                    baseCountsPerRadian,
                    Config::autoScaleByGameSensitivity ? 1 : 0,
                    Config::gameMouseSensitivity,
                    Config::EffectiveGameMouseSensitivity(),
                    Config::referenceGameSensitivity,
                    pitchSensitivity);
                sensitivity = baseCountsPerRadian;
                pitchSensitivity = sensitivity;
            }

            static std::atomic<int> calls{0};
            MouseMoveQuantizationState& quantizationState = quantization.state
                ? *quantization.state
                : DefaultMouseMoveQuantizationState();

            // delta.X = pitch (vertical), delta.Y = yaw (horizontal).
            // Positive KMBox X drives the measured yaw negative, so yaw correction is inverted here.
            const float scaledYaw   = -delta.Y * sensitivity;         // yaw -> horizontal X
            const float pitchScale = std::clamp(Config::View_aimbotPitchScale(), 0.1f, 3.0f);
            const float scaledPitch = delta.X * pitchSensitivity * pitchScale; // pitch -> vertical Y
            const float fallbackScaledYaw =
                -quantization.fallbackDirectionDelta.Y * sensitivity;
            const float fallbackScaledPitch =
                quantization.fallbackDirectionDelta.X * pitchSensitivity * pitchScale;
            const float accumBeforeX = quantizationState.residualX;
            const float accumBeforeY = quantizationState.residualY;
            result = QuantizeMouseMoveCounts(
                scaledYaw,
                scaledPitch,
                fallbackScaledYaw,
                fallbackScaledPitch,
                quantizationState,
                quantization.forceNonZero);
            const int countX = result.countX;
            const int countY = result.countY;

            const int callCount = calls.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
            Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.convert call=%d delta_rad_pitch=%.9f delta_rad_yaw=%.9f baseCountsPerRad=%.6f yawCountsPerRad=%.6f pitchCountsPerRad=%.6f autoScale=%d syncScale=%.6f pitchScale=%.6f scaled_counts=(yaw=%.9f,pitch=%.9f) fallback_counts=(yaw=%.9f,pitch=%.9f) accum_before=(%.9f,%.9f) counts=(%d,%d) accum_after=(%.9f,%.9f) forced_min_step=%d",
                callCount,
                delta.X,
                delta.Y,
                baseCountsPerRadian,
                sensitivity,
                pitchSensitivity,
                Config::autoScaleByGameSensitivity ? 1 : 0,
                syncScale,
                pitchScale,
                scaledYaw,
                scaledPitch,
                fallbackScaledYaw,
                fallbackScaledPitch,
                accumBeforeX,
                accumBeforeY,
                countX,
                countY,
                quantizationState.residualX,
                quantizationState.residualY,
                result.forcedMinimumStep ? 1 : 0);
            if (Config::aimVerboseLog &&
                (callCount <= 50 || countX != 0 || countY != 0)) {
                std::printf("[OUTPUT] #%d pitch=%.6f yaw=%.6f yawCountsPerRad=%.1f pitchCountsPerRad=%.1f counts=(%d,%d) accum=(%.3f,%.3f)\n",
                    callCount, delta.X, delta.Y, sensitivity, pitchSensitivity,
                    countX, countY,
                    quantizationState.residualX,
                    quantizationState.residualY);
            }

            if (countX == 0 && countY == 0) {
                Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move early_return reason=zero_counts scaled=(yaw_%.9f,pitch_%.9f) accum_after=(%.9f,%.9f) forced_min_step=%d note=%s",
                    scaledYaw,
                    scaledPitch,
                    quantizationState.residualX,
                    quantizationState.residualY,
                    result.forcedMinimumStep ? 1 : 0,
                    quantization.forceNonZero
                        ? "magnetic_no_valid_direction"
                        : "integer_truncation_waiting_for_accumulator");
                return result;
            }

            if (result.forcedMinimumStep) {
                static std::atomic<DWORD> lastForcedMinimumStepLogTick{0};
                const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
                if (Config::aimVerboseLog ||
                    lastForcedMinimumStepLogTick == 0 ||
                    now - lastForcedMinimumStepLogTick >= 250) {
                    Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move magnetic_quantize forced_min_step=1 counts=(%d,%d) raw_delta=(%.9f,%.9f) residual=(%.9f,%.9f)",
                        countX,
                        countY,
                        quantization.fallbackDirectionDelta.X,
                        quantization.fallbackDirectionDelta.Y,
                        quantizationState.residualX,
                        quantizationState.residualY);
                    lastForcedMinimumStepLogTick = now;
                }
            }

            // ---- Micro-split mouse movement ----
            const int splitBehavior = Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(Config::View_aimBehavior());
            const bool splitConfigured = Config::AimBehaviorMoveSplitEnabled(splitBehavior);
            // The device reports whether it needs caller-side movement splitting.
            // Transports that pace and coalesce movement own their scheduling.
            const bool splitEnabled = splitConfigured &&
                V2::Output::CapabilitiesFor(applied.descriptor).callerMoveSplit;
            const int maxCounts = Config::AimBehaviorMoveSplitMaxPixels(splitBehavior);
            const int delayUs = Config::AimBehaviorMoveSplitDelayUs(splitBehavior);
            const int absX = std::abs(countX);
            const int absY = std::abs(countY);
            const int maxComponent = (std::max)(absX, absY);
            const int steps = splitEnabled
                ? (std::max)(1, (maxComponent + maxCounts - 1) / maxCounts)
                : 1;

            if (steps <= 1) {
                const int status = EnqueueOutputCountMoveForGeneration(
                    countX,
                    countY,
                    automoveRuntimeMs,
                    outputRuntime.backendGeneration,
                    connectionEpoch);
                result.status = status;
                result.dispatched = status == success;
                Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.enqueue transport=%s command=%s counts=(%d,%d) runtimeMs=%d behavior=%d splitConfigured=%d splitApplied=%d status=%d",
                    OutputTransportName(),
                    automoveRuntimeMs > 0 ? "automove" : "move",
                    countX,
                    countY,
                    automoveRuntimeMs,
                    splitBehavior,
                    splitConfigured ? 1 : 0,
                    splitEnabled ? 1 : 0,
                    status);
                OutputMotionTelemetry::RecordMouseMove(
                    delta,
                    countX,
                    countY,
                    automoveRuntimeMs,
                    status,
                    false,
                    1);
            } else {
                // Split into micro-movements
                Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move.split total_counts=(%d,%d) steps=%d max_counts_per_step=%d delay_us=%d runtimeMs=%d command=%s behavior=%d",
                    countX,
                    countY,
                    steps,
                    maxCounts,
                    delayUs,
                    automoveRuntimeMs,
                    automoveRuntimeMs > 0 ? "automove" : "move",
                    splitBehavior);
                int remainingX = countX;
                int remainingY = countY;
                int lastStatus = 0;
                int completedSteps = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
                    const int curX = remainingX / (steps - i);
                    const int curY = remainingY / (steps - i);
                    remainingX -= curX;
                    remainingY -= curY;

                    const int status = EnqueueOutputCountMoveForGeneration(
                        curX,
                        curY,
                        automoveRuntimeMs,
                        outputRuntime.backendGeneration,
                        connectionEpoch);
                    lastStatus = status;
                    Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.enqueue.split transport=%s command=%s step=%d/%d cur=(%d,%d) runtimeMs=%d status=%d",
                        OutputTransportName(),
                        automoveRuntimeMs > 0 ? "automove" : "move",
                        i + 1,
                        steps,
                        curX,
                        curY,
                        automoveRuntimeMs,
                        status);

                    if (status != success) {
                        Diagnostics::Aim(
                            "mouse.move.split_abort step=%d/%d status=%d expectedGeneration=%llu connectionEpoch=%llu",
                            i + 1,
                            steps,
                            status,
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(
                                outputRuntime.backendGeneration),
                            static_cast<unsigned long long>(connectionEpoch));
                        break;
                    }
                    ++completedSteps;

                    if (i < steps - 1 && delayUs > 0) {
                        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::microseconds(delayUs));
                    }
                }
                Diagnostics::Aim("mouse.move.split_complete steps=%d total=(%d,%d)",
                    completedSteps, countX, countY);
                OutputMotionTelemetry::RecordMouseMove(
                    delta,
                    countX,
                    countY,
                    automoveRuntimeMs,
                    lastStatus,
                    true,
                    completedSteps);
                result.status = lastStatus;
                result.dispatched = completedSteps > 0;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    void SendMouseMove(const Vector3& delta, int moveTimeMs) {
        MouseMoveQuantizationOptions quantization{};
        quantization.state = &DefaultMouseMoveQuantizationState();
        (void)SendMouseMove(delta, moveTimeMs, quantization);
    }

    void SendMouseMove(float deltaX, float deltaY, int moveTimeMs) {
        SendMouseMove(Vector3(deltaX, deltaY, 0.0f), moveTimeMs);
    }

    bool ActionOutputSucceeded(ActionOutputStatus status) {
        return status == ActionOutputStatus::Sent;
    }

    ActionOutputStatus UnavailableActionOutputStatus() {
        return V2::Output::RuntimeController().Desired().backend == V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None
            ? ActionOutputStatus::Disabled
            : ActionOutputStatus::TransportError;
    }

    std::string DefaultMouseButtonOwnerKey(OutputOwnerSource ownerSource, int button) {
        return "target.mouse." +
            std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned int>(ownerSource)) + "." +
            std::to_string(button);
    }

    const char* GameActionOwnerKey(GameAction action) {
        switch (action) {
        case GameAction::PrimaryFire:   return "game_action.primary_fire";
        case GameAction::SecondaryFire: return "game_action.secondary_fire";
        case GameAction::MiddleMouse:   return "game_action.middle_mouse";
        case GameAction::Ability1:      return "game_action.ability1";
        case GameAction::Ability2:      return "game_action.ability2";
        case GameAction::Ultimate:      return "game_action.ultimate";
        case GameAction::Melee:         return "game_action.melee";
        case GameAction::MoveForward:   return "game_action.move_forward";
        default:                        return nullptr;
        }
    }

    ActionOutputStatus SetOwnedOutputControl(
        const std::string& ownerKey,
        OutputOwnerSource ownerSource,
        OutputControl control,
        bool down,
        const char* outputName,
        bool requireKeyboardOutput,
        OutputUnownedControlCallback ownerlessRelease,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration,
        bool requireNewPress) {
        if(control.kind==OutputControlKind::MouseButton&&control.code>4)return ActionOutputStatus::UnsupportedTransport;
        const V2::Output::OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied = V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied();
        if (applied.descriptor.backend == V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
            !V2::Output::RuntimeController().CanDispatch(applied.generation) ||
            (expectedGeneration != 0 &&
             applied.generation != expectedGeneration)) {
            return UnavailableActionOutputStatus();
        }
        const OutputIntent intent = OutputIntentForState(down);
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput(outputName, intent))
            return ActionOutputStatus::Suppressed;
        if (requireKeyboardOutput &&
            !V2::Output::SupportsKeyboardOutput(applied.descriptor)) {
            return ActionOutputStatus::UnsupportedTransport;
        }

        OutputScheduler& scheduler = RuntimeOutputScheduler();
        if (expectedGeneration != 0 && down &&
            !scheduler.SynchronizeRuntime(
                { expectedGeneration, true })) {
            return ActionOutputStatus::TransportError;
        }
        bool accepted = false;
        if (expectedGeneration != 0) {
            accepted = !down && ownerlessRelease
                ? scheduler.ReleaseManualControlOrExecuteIfUnownedForGeneration(
                    ownerKey,
                    ownerSource,
                    control,
                    expectedGeneration,
                    std::move(ownerlessRelease))
                : scheduler.SetManualControlsForGeneration(
                    ownerKey,
                    ownerSource,
                    down
                        ? std::vector<OutputControl>{ control }
                        : std::vector<OutputControl>{},
                    expectedGeneration,
                    requireNewPress && down);
        } else {
            accepted = !down && ownerlessRelease
                ? scheduler.ReleaseManualControlOrExecuteIfUnowned(
                    ownerKey,
                    ownerSource,
                    control,
                    std::move(ownerlessRelease))
                : scheduler.SetManualControl(
                    ownerKey,
                    ownerSource,
                    control,
                    down);
        }
        return accepted
            ? ActionOutputStatus::Sent
            : ActionOutputStatus::TransportError;
    }

    ActionOutputStatus SendMouseButtonActionState(
        int button,
        bool down,
        OutputOwnerSource ownerSource,
        const char* ownerKey,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration,
        bool requireNewPress) {
        if (button < 0 || button > 2)
            return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;

        if (Config::outputDebugLog) {
            std::printf("[OUTPUT] mouse.button button=%d down=%d transport=%s generation=%llu\n",
                button,
                down ? 1 : 0,
                OutputTransportName(),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(
                    V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied().generation));
        }

        const std::string resolvedOwnerKey = ownerKey && *ownerKey
            ? std::string(ownerKey)
            : DefaultMouseButtonOwnerKey(ownerSource, button);
        const auto action=button==0?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary:button==1?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary:V2::HeroSettings::Action::Middle;
        const int vk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID,action);
        const int mappedButton=vk==1?0:vk==2?1:vk==4?2:vk==5?3:vk==6?4:-1;
        const auto hid=V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(vk);
        if(mappedButton<0&&!hid)return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;
        const auto generation=expectedGeneration?expectedGeneration:V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().generation;
        return SetOwnedOutputControl(resolvedOwnerKey,ownerSource,
            {mappedButton>=0?OutputControlKind::MouseButton:hid>=0xE0?OutputControlKind::KeyboardModifier:OutputControlKind::KeyboardUsage,
             static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mappedButton>=0?mappedButton:hid)},
            down,"hero_action",mappedButton<0,{},generation,requireNewPress);
    }

    ActionOutputStatus ReleaseMouseButtonActionStateOrPhysicalFallback(
        int button,
        OutputOwnerSource ownerSource,
        const char* ownerKey,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration,
        bool* physicalFallbackReleased) {
        if (button < 0 || button > 2)
            return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;
        if (physicalFallbackReleased)
            *physicalFallbackReleased = false;

        const std::string resolvedOwnerKey = ownerKey && *ownerKey
            ? std::string(ownerKey)
            : DefaultMouseButtonOwnerKey(ownerSource, button);
        const V2::Output::OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied =
            V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied();
        if (expectedGeneration == 0 ||
            applied.generation != expectedGeneration ||
            applied.descriptor.backend == V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
            !V2::Output::RuntimeController().CanDispatch(applied.generation)) {
            return UnavailableActionOutputStatus();
        }
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput(
                "mouse_button",
                OutputIntent::SafetyRelease)) {
            return ActionOutputStatus::Suppressed;
        }

        const int vk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID,button==0?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary:button==1?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary:V2::HeroSettings::Action::Middle);
        const int mappedButton=vk==1?0:vk==2?1:vk==4?2:vk==5?3:vk==6?4:-1;
        const auto hid=V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(vk);
        if(mappedButton<0&&!hid)return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;
        const OutputControl mappedControl{mappedButton>=0?OutputControlKind::MouseButton:hid>=0xE0?OutputControlKind::KeyboardModifier:OutputControlKind::KeyboardUsage,static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mappedButton>=0?mappedButton:hid)};
        const bool accepted = RuntimeOutputScheduler()
            .ReleaseManualControlOrExecuteIfUnownedForGeneration(
            resolvedOwnerKey,
            ownerSource,
            mappedControl,
            expectedGeneration,
            [mappedButton, physicalFallbackReleased](
                std::uint64_t backendGeneration) {
                // Transport has no isolated physical-key release. Never emit an all-key-up report.
                if(mappedButton<0)return false;
                const bool released =
                    V2::Output::DispatchForceReleaseMouseButtonForGeneration(
                        backendGeneration,
                        mappedButton) == success;
                if (physicalFallbackReleased)
                    *physicalFallbackReleased = released;
                return released;
            });
        return accepted
            ? ActionOutputStatus::Sent
            : ActionOutputStatus::TransportError;
    }

    ActionOutputStatus ReleaseMouseButtonActionStateForGeneration(
        int button,
        OutputOwnerSource ownerSource,
        const char* ownerKey,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration) {
        if (button < 0 || button > 2)
            return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;

        const V2::Output::OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied =
            V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied();
        if (expectedGeneration == 0 ||
            applied.generation != expectedGeneration ||
            applied.descriptor.backend == V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
            !V2::Output::RuntimeController().CanDispatch(applied.generation)) {
            return UnavailableActionOutputStatus();
        }
        if (ShouldSuppressOutput(
                "mouse_button",
                OutputIntent::SafetyRelease)) {
            return ActionOutputStatus::Suppressed;
        }

        const std::string resolvedOwnerKey = ownerKey && *ownerKey
            ? std::string(ownerKey)
            : DefaultMouseButtonOwnerKey(ownerSource, button);
        const int vk=V2::HeroSettings::Key(SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID,button==0?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Primary:button==1?V2::HeroSettings::Action::Secondary:V2::HeroSettings::Action::Middle);
        const int mappedButton=vk==1?0:vk==2?1:vk==4?2:vk==5?3:vk==6?4:-1;
        const auto hid=V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(vk);
        if(mappedButton<0&&!hid)return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;
        const OutputControl mappedControl{mappedButton>=0?OutputControlKind::MouseButton:hid>=0xE0?OutputControlKind::KeyboardModifier:OutputControlKind::KeyboardUsage,static_cast<std::uint16_t>(mappedButton>=0?mappedButton:hid)};
        const bool accepted = RuntimeOutputScheduler()
            .ReleaseManualControlOrExecuteIfUnownedForGeneration(
            resolvedOwnerKey,
            ownerSource,
            mappedControl,
            expectedGeneration,
            [](std::uint64_t) { return true; });
        return accepted
            ? ActionOutputStatus::Sent
            : ActionOutputStatus::TransportError;
    }

    void SendMouseButton(
        int button,
        bool down,
        OutputOwnerSource ownerSource,
        const char* ownerKey) {
        (void)SendMouseButtonActionState(button, down, ownerSource, ownerKey);
    }

    static int MappedActionVk(GameAction action) {
        using A=V2::HeroSettings::Action;
        A mapped;
        switch(action) {
        case GameAction::PrimaryFire:mapped=A::Primary;break;
        case GameAction::SecondaryFire:mapped=A::Secondary;break;
        case GameAction::MiddleMouse:mapped=A::Middle;break;
        case GameAction::Ability1:mapped=A::Ability1;break;
        case GameAction::Ability2:mapped=A::Ability2;break;
        case GameAction::Ultimate:mapped=A::Ultimate;break;
        case GameAction::Melee:mapped=A::Melee;break;
        case GameAction::MoveForward:mapped=A::Forward;break;
        default:return 0;
        }
        return V2::HeroSettings::Key(SnapshotLocalEntity().HeroID,mapped);
    }
    unsigned char GameActionKeyboardHid(GameAction action) {return V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(MappedActionVk(action));}

    ActionOutputStatus SetActionStateForGeneration(
        GameAction action,
        bool down,
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration) {
        const char* ownerKey = GameActionOwnerKey(action);
        if (!ownerKey)
            return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;

        const int vk=MappedActionVk(action);
        int button=-1;
        if(vk==VK_LBUTTON)button=0;else if(vk==VK_RBUTTON)button=1;else if(vk==VK_MBUTTON)button=2;
        else if(vk==VK_XBUTTON1)button=3;else if(vk==VK_XBUTTON2)button=4;
        const unsigned char hid=V2::HeroSettings::HidUsage(vk);
        if(button<0&&!hid)return ActionOutputStatus::InvalidAction;
        const auto generation=expectedGeneration?expectedGeneration:V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().generation;
        return SetOwnedOutputControl(ownerKey,OutputOwnerSource::GameAction,
            {button>=0?OutputControlKind::MouseButton:hid>=0xE0?OutputControlKind::KeyboardModifier:OutputControlKind::KeyboardUsage,
             static_cast<std::uint16_t>(button>=0?button:hid)},down,button>=0?"mouse_button":"keyboard",button<0,{},generation);
    }

    ActionOutputStatus SetActionState(GameAction action, bool down) {
        return SetActionStateForGeneration(action, down, 0);
    }

    ActionOutputStatus PulseAction(GameAction action, DWORD durationMs) {
        const std::uint64_t operationGeneration =
            V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().generation;
        const ActionOutputStatus pressStatus = SetActionStateForGeneration(
            action,
            true,
            operationGeneration);
        if (!ActionOutputSucceeded(pressStatus))
            return pressStatus;

        Sleep(durationMs);
        return SetActionStateForGeneration(
            action,
            false,
            operationGeneration);
    }
```

`src/output/core/MotionTelemetry.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "output/MotionTelemetry.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <mutex>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
namespace OW::OutputMotionTelemetry {
    namespace {
    uint64_t TimestampMs() {
        const auto now = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
        return static_cast<uint64_t>(
            std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(now.time_since_epoch()).count());
    }

    std::mutex& Mutex() {
        static std::mutex mutex;
        return mutex;
    }

    std::vector<Sample>& Samples() {
        static std::vector<Sample> samples;
        return samples;
    }

    uint64_t& Sequence() {
        static uint64_t sequence = 0;
        return sequence;
    }

    }

    void RecordMouseMove(
        const Vector3& delta,
        int countX,
        int countY,
        int automoveRuntimeMs,
        int status,
        bool split,
        int steps) {
        constexpr float kRadToDeg = 57.29577951308232f;
        const uint64_t nowMs = TimestampMs();
        const float deltaMagnitudeDeg = std::sqrt(delta.X * delta.X + delta.Y * delta.Y) * kRadToDeg;

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(Mutex());
        auto& samples = Samples();
        Sample sample{};
        sample.sequence = ++Sequence();
        sample.capturedAtMs = nowMs;
        sample.deltaPitchRad = delta.X;
        sample.deltaYawRad = delta.Y;
        sample.countX = countX;
        sample.countY = countY;
        sample.automoveRuntimeMs = automoveRuntimeMs;
        sample.status = status;
        sample.split = split;
        sample.steps = (std::max)(1, steps);

        if (!samples.empty()) {
            const Sample& previous = samples.back();
            constexpr float kMinTelemetryDtS = 0.008f;
            float dt = kMinTelemetryDtS;
            if (nowMs > previous.capturedAtMs)
                dt = (std::max)(kMinTelemetryDtS, static_cast<float>(nowMs - previous.capturedAtMs) / 1000.0f);
            sample.speedDegS = deltaMagnitudeDeg / dt;
            sample.accelDegS2 = (sample.speedDegS - previous.speedDegS) / dt;
            sample.jerkDegS3 = (sample.accelDegS2 - previous.accelDegS2) / dt;
        }

        samples.push_back(sample);
        constexpr size_t kCapacity = 512;
        if (samples.size() > kCapacity) {
            samples.erase(samples.begin(),
                samples.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(samples.size() - kCapacity));
        }
    }

    std::vector<Sample> SnapshotSince(uint64_t capturedAtMs, uint64_t windowMs) {
        std::vector<Sample> snapshot;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(Mutex());
        const auto& samples = Samples();
        snapshot.reserve(samples.size());
        for (const Sample& sample : samples) {
            if (sample.capturedAtMs <= capturedAtMs && capturedAtMs - sample.capturedAtMs <= windowMs)
                snapshot.push_back(sample);
        }
        return snapshot;
    }
}
```

`src/output/core/OutputOwnership.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "output/OutputOwnership.hpp"

#include <tuple>

namespace OW
{
    bool OutputControl::operator<(const OutputControl& other) const noexcept
    {
        return std::tie(kind, code) < std::tie(other.kind, other.code);
    }

    bool OwnerToken::operator<(const OwnerToken& other) const noexcept
    {
        return std::tie(source, id, backendGeneration) <
            std::tie(other.source, other.id, other.backendGeneration);
    }

    OutputOwnership::OutputOwnership(std::uint64_t backendGeneration) noexcept
        : backendGeneration_(backendGeneration)
    {
    }

    std::uint64_t OutputOwnership::BackendGeneration() const noexcept
    {
        return backendGeneration_;
    }

    bool OutputOwnership::TrySetBackendGeneration(
        std::uint64_t backendGeneration) noexcept
    {
        if (!owners_.empty())
            return false;

        backendGeneration_ = backendGeneration;
        return true;
    }

    std::optional<OutputTransition> OutputOwnership::Acquire(
        const OutputControl& control,
        const OwnerToken& owner)
    {
        if (!IsValidControl(control) || !IsValidOwner(owner))
            return std::nullopt;

        auto& owners = owners_[control];
        const bool wasEmpty = owners.empty();
        const auto [unused, inserted] = owners.insert(owner);
        (void)unused;

        if (!inserted)
            return OutputTransition::None;
        return wasEmpty ? OutputTransition::Press : OutputTransition::None;
    }

    std::optional<OutputTransition> OutputOwnership::Release(
        const OutputControl& control,
        const OwnerToken& owner)
    {
        if (!IsValidControl(control) || !IsValidOwner(owner))
            return std::nullopt;

        const auto controlIt = owners_.find(control);
        if (controlIt == owners_.end())
            return OutputTransition::None;

        auto& owners = controlIt->second;
        if (owners.erase(owner) == 0)
            return OutputTransition::None;
        if (!owners.empty())
            return OutputTransition::None;

        owners_.erase(controlIt);
        return OutputTransition::Release;
    }

    std::optional<std::vector<OutputChange>> OutputOwnership::CancelOwner(
        const OwnerToken& owner)
    {
        if (!IsValidOwner(owner))
            return std::nullopt;

        std::vector<OutputChange> changes;
        for (auto controlIt = owners_.begin(); controlIt != owners_.end();) {
            auto& owners = controlIt->second;
            if (owners.erase(owner) == 0 || !owners.empty()) {
                ++controlIt;
                continue;
            }

            changes.push_back({ controlIt->first, OutputTransition::Release });
            controlIt = owners_.erase(controlIt);
        }
        return changes;
    }

    std::vector<OutputChange> OutputOwnership::CancelAll()
    {
        std::vector<OutputChange> changes;
        changes.reserve(owners_.size());
        for (const auto& [control, owners] : owners_) {
            if (!owners.empty())
                changes.push_back({ control, OutputTransition::Release });
        }
        owners_.clear();
        return changes;
    }

    bool OutputOwnership::IsHeld(const OutputControl& control) const
    {
        const auto it = owners_.find(control);
        return it != owners_.end() && !it->second.empty();
    }

    std::size_t OutputOwnership::OwnerCount(const OutputControl& control) const
    {
        const auto it = owners_.find(control);
        return it == owners_.end() ? 0 : it->second.size();
    }

    std::size_t OutputOwnership::HeldControlCount() const noexcept
    {
        return owners_.size();
    }

    bool OutputOwnership::Empty() const noexcept
    {
        return owners_.empty();
    }

    std::vector<OutputControl> OutputOwnership::HeldControls() const
    {
        std::vector<OutputControl> controls;
        controls.reserve(owners_.size());
        for (const auto& [control, owners] : owners_) {
            if (!owners.empty())
                controls.push_back(control);
        }
        return controls;
    }

    bool OutputOwnership::IsValidControl(
        const OutputControl& control) const noexcept
    {
        switch (control.kind) {
        case OutputControlKind::MouseButton:
            return control.code <= 4;
        case OutputControlKind::KeyboardUsage:
            return control.code >= 0x04 && control.code <= 0xDF;
        case OutputControlKind::KeyboardModifier:
            return control.code >= 0xE0 && control.code <= 0xE7;
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }

    bool OutputOwnership::IsValidOwner(const OwnerToken& owner) const noexcept
    {
        if (owner.id == 0 || owner.backendGeneration != backendGeneration_)
            return false;

        switch (owner.source) {
        case OutputOwnerSource::HeroTimedAction:
        case OutputOwnerSource::ZaryaPulse:
        case OutputOwnerSource::GlobalAim:
        case OutputOwnerSource::Trigger:
        case OutputOwnerSource::Sequence:
        case OutputOwnerSource::Viewpoint:
        case OutputOwnerSource::GenjiCombo:
        case OutputOwnerSource::GameAction:
        case OutputOwnerSource::Test:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/output/core/OutputRuntime.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "output/OutputDevice.hpp"
#include "output/DeviceRegistry.hpp"
#include "output/OutputServices.hpp"
#include "output/KeyboardReport.hpp"
#include "output/TimerResolution.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <optional>
#include <utility>

namespace V2::Output {
    namespace
    {
        std::mutex g_runtimeFacadeMutex;
        std::mutex g_preReconcileHookMutex;
        RuntimePreReconcileHook g_preReconcileHook;
        constexpr auto kMaxTransportCompletionWait =
            std::chrono::milliseconds(500);

        std::chrono::milliseconds BoundedTransportCompletionWait(
            std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
        {
            return (std::min)(timeout, kMaxTransportCompletionWait);
        }

        int WaitForTransportCompletion(
            const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& completion,
            std::chrono::milliseconds timeout,
            const char* operation)
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> completionLock(completion->mutex);
            if (!completion->cv.wait_for(
                    completionLock,
                    timeout,
                    [&completion]() { return completion->completed; })) {
                Diagnostics::Warn(
                    "[OUTPUT] Timed out waiting for %s transport completion. timeout_ms=%lld",
                    operation ? operation : "command",
                    static_cast<long long>(timeout.count()));
                return err_completion_timeout;
            }
            return completion->status;
        }

        void RecordFirstFailure(int& aggregate, int status)
        {
            if (aggregate == success && status != success)
                aggregate = status;
        }

        bool IsReconcileNoOp(
            OutputRuntimeController& controller,
            const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& desired)
        {
            const OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied = controller.Applied();
            return desired == applied.descriptor &&
                (applied.descriptor.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
                 controller.IsOutputGateOpen());
        }

        int ReconcileProductionRuntime(
            const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& desired,
            std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> transitionLock(g_runtimeFacadeMutex);
            OutputRuntimeController& controller = RuntimeController();
            if (!IsReconcileNoOp(controller, desired)) {
                // Linearize the transaction's "pause new output" step before
                // producer cancellation. Direct move/mask paths do not pass
                // through the scheduler hook and must see the closed gate too.
                controller.PauseOutputForTransition();
                RuntimePreReconcileHook hook;
                {
                    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> hookLock(
                        g_preReconcileHookMutex);
                    hook = g_preReconcileHook;
                }
                if (hook)
                    hook();
            }
            return controller.Reconcile(desired, timeout);
        }
    }


    OutputDeviceCapabilities CapabilitiesFor(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
        auto* device = ResolveOutputDevice(descriptor);
        if (device) return device->Capabilities();
        OutputDeviceCapabilities disabled{};
        disabled.move = disabled.buttons = disabled.release = false;
        disabled.maxDelta = 0;
        return disabled;
    }

    bool SupportsKeyboardOutput(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
        return CapabilitiesFor(descriptor).keyboard;
    }
    bool SupportsMouseMask(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
        return CapabilitiesFor(descriptor).mouseMask;
    }
    bool SupportsTimedMove(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
        return CapabilitiesFor(descriptor).timedMove;
    }
    PhysicalInputSnapshot ActivePhysicalInput() {
        const auto active = ActiveRuntimeSnapshot();
        auto* device = ResolveOutputDevice(active.descriptor);
        return active.generation && device ? device->PhysicalInput() : PhysicalInputSnapshot{};
    }

    void IOutputRuntimeBackendOps::OnOutputGateChanged(bool) noexcept {}

    int OutputProductionBackendOps::ReleaseAll(
        OutputRuntimeBackend backend, std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
        if (backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None) return success;
        auto* device = activeDevice_.load();
        return device ? device->ReleaseAll(timeout) : err_queue_stopped;
    }
    int OutputProductionBackendOps::Shutdown(
        OutputRuntimeBackend backend, std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
        auto* device = activeDevice_.load();
        const int status = device ? device->Shutdown(timeout) : success;
        activeDevice_.store(nullptr);
        ReleaseTimerResolution();
        return status;
    }
    bool OutputProductionBackendOps::IsTransportReady() const noexcept {
        auto* device = activeDevice_.load();
        return device && device->ConnectionState() == OutputConnectionState::Connected;
    }
    int OutputProductionBackendOps::Initialize(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
        auto* device = ResolveOutputDevice(descriptor);
        activeDevice_.store(device);
        if (descriptor.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None) return success;
        return device ? device->Initialize(descriptor) : err_net_cmd;
    }
    OutputRuntimeController::OutputRuntimeController(IOutputRuntimeBackendOps& backendOps)
        : backendOps_(backendOps)
    {
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::Reconcile(
        const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& desired,
        std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        desired_ = desired;

        if (desired == active_ &&
            (active_.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
             (outputGateOpen_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && backendOps_.IsTransportReady()))) {
            lastError_ = success;
            return success;
        }

        SetOutputGate(false);
        const OutputRuntimeDescriptor previous = active_;
        int transitionStatus = success;

        if (previous.backend != OutputRuntimeBackend::None) {
            RecordFirstFailure(
                transitionStatus,
                backendOps_.ReleaseAll(previous.backend, timeout));
            RecordFirstFailure(
                transitionStatus,
                backendOps_.Shutdown(previous.backend, timeout));
            active_ = OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();
        }

        if (transitionStatus != success) {
            lastError_ = transitionStatus;
            return transitionStatus;
        }

        if (desired.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None) {
            active_ = OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();
            generation_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            lastError_ = success;
            return success;
        }

        const int initializeStatus = backendOps_.Initialize(desired);
        if (initializeStatus != success) {
            // Initialization may have partially opened a transport. Roll it back
            // before publishing the safe, gated-off None state.
            (void)backendOps_.Shutdown(desired.backend, timeout);
            active_ = OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();
            lastError_ = initializeStatus;
            return initializeStatus;
        }

        active_ = desired;
        generation_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
        lastError_ = success;
        SetOutputGate(true);
        return success;
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::ReleaseActive(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        if (active_.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None)
            return success;

        SetOutputGate(false);
        const int status = backendOps_.ReleaseAll(active_.backend, timeout);
        lastError_ = status;
        if (status == success) {
            // A successful all-up is an output-session boundary even though
            // the transport remains initialized. Invalidate every producer
            // token captured before the cleanup before reopening dispatch.
            generation_.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
            SetOutputGate(true);
        }
        return status;
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::ShutdownActive(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        return Reconcile(OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled(), timeout);
    }

    void OutputRuntimeController::PauseOutputForTransition()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        SetOutputGate(false);
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::DispatchActive(
        const std::function<int(const OutputRuntimeAppliedState&)>& dispatch)
    {
        if (!dispatch)
            return err_net_cmd;

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        const std::uint64_t generation = generation_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (active_.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None ||
            !outputGateOpen_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
            !CanDispatch(generation)) {
            return err_queue_stopped;
        }

        return dispatch({ active_, generation });
    }

    OutputRuntimeDescriptor OutputRuntimeController::Desired() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        return desired_;
    }

    OutputRuntimeAppliedState OutputRuntimeController::Applied() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        return { active_, generation_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) };
    }

    bool OutputRuntimeController::IsOutputGateOpen() const noexcept
    {
        return outputGateOpen_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && backendOps_.IsTransportReady();
    }

    bool OutputRuntimeController::CanDispatch(std::uint64_t generation) const noexcept
    {
        return outputGateOpen_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            backendOps_.IsTransportReady() &&
            generation_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == generation;
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::LastError() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        return lastError_;
    }

    void OutputRuntimeController::SetOutputGate(bool open) noexcept
    {
        outputGateOpen_.store(open, std::memory_order_release);
        backendOps_.OnOutputGateChanged(open);
    }

    int OutputRuntimeController::DispatchCleanupForGeneration(
        std::uint64_t expectedGeneration, bool pauseOutput,
        const std::function<int(const OutputRuntimeAppliedState&)>& cleanup) {
        if (!cleanup) return err_net_cmd;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(reconcileMutex_);
        const auto generation = generation_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (expectedGeneration == 0 || generation != expectedGeneration ||
            active_.backend == OutputRuntimeBackend::None) return err_queue_stopped;
        if (pauseOutput) SetOutputGate(false);
        return cleanup({active_, generation});
    }

    namespace {
        template<class Action>
        int DispatchDevice(std::optional<std::uint64_t> expectedGeneration, Action&& action) {
            if (expectedGeneration && *expectedGeneration == 0) return err_queue_stopped;
            return RuntimeController().DispatchActive(
                [&](const OutputRuntimeAppliedState& active) -> int {
                    if (expectedGeneration && active.generation != *expectedGeneration)
                        return err_queue_stopped;
                    auto* device = ResolveOutputDevice(active.descriptor);
                    return device ? action(*device) : err_queue_stopped;
                });
        }

        int DispatchTrackedMask(std::uint64_t generation, std::uint32_t mask,
            std::chrono::milliseconds timeout, bool recoverOnTimeout) {
            if (generation == 0 || timeout < std::chrono::milliseconds::zero()) return err_net_cmd;
            timeout = BoundedTransportCompletionWait(timeout);
            auto completion = std::make_shared<OutputCommandCompletion>();
            IOutputDevice* submittedDevice = nullptr;
            bool pauseOnTimeout = false;
            const int queued = DispatchDevice(generation, [&](IOutputDevice& device) {
                submittedDevice = &device;
                pauseOnTimeout = device.Capabilities().maskTimeoutClosesGate;
                return device.Mask(mask, completion);
            });
            if (queued != success) return queued;
            // A device switch can proceed while this worker completion is pending.
            const int completed = WaitForTransportCompletion(completion, timeout, "mouse mask");
            if (completed != err_completion_timeout || !recoverOnTimeout) return completed;

            std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> cleanupCompletion;
            const int cleanupStatus = RuntimeController().DispatchCleanupForGeneration(
                generation, pauseOnTimeout, [&](const OutputRuntimeAppliedState&) {
                    return submittedDevice->RecoverMaskTimeout(completion, cleanupCompletion);
                });
            if (cleanupStatus == success && cleanupCompletion) {
                const int status = WaitForTransportCompletion(cleanupCompletion, timeout, "mask cleanup");
                if (status != success) Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT] Mask cleanup remains pending or failed. status=%d", status);
            } else if (cleanupStatus != success && cleanupStatus != err_queue_stopped) {
                Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT] Could not queue mask cleanup. status=%d", cleanupStatus);
            }
            return err_completion_timeout;
        }
    }

    int DispatchKeyboardKey(unsigned char hidCode, bool down)
    {
        const bool isModifier =
            hidCode >= KEY_LEFTCONTROL && hidCode <= KEY_RIGHT_GUI;
        const bool isUsage = hidCode >= KEY_A && hidCode < KEY_LEFTCONTROL;
        if (!isModifier && !isUsage)
            return err_net_cmd;

        if (!down)
            return DispatchKeyboardReport(0, {});
        if (isModifier) {
            const auto modifierBit = static_cast<unsigned char>(
                1u << (hidCode - KEY_LEFTCONTROL));
            return DispatchKeyboardReport(modifierBit, {});
        }
        return DispatchKeyboardReport(0, { hidCode });
    }
```

`src/output/core/OutputScheduler.cpp`:
