`src/output/devices/catbox/Backend.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include "Backend.hpp"
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include "output/OutputServices.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <bitset>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")
#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")
namespace V2::Output {
using CatBoxProtocol::Command;
static void Complete(const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& c, int result) {
    if (!c) return;
    { std::lock_guard lock(c->mutex); c->status = result; c->completed = true; }
    c->cv.notify_all();
}
struct CatBoxBackend::Impl {
    struct Job {
        enum Kind { Wire, Keys, Mask, Release } kind = Wire;
        Command command{};
        std::bitset<256> keys;
        uint32_t mask = 0;
        bool safety = false;
        std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion;
        uint64_t deadline = 0;
    };
    std::mutex lifecycle, mutex;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::deque<Job> queue;
    std::thread worker, monitor;
    std::atomic<bool> running{false}, listening{false}, accepting{false};
    std::atomic<OutputConnectionState> state{OutputConnectionState::Disconnected};
    SOCKET socket = INVALID_SOCKET, monitorSocket = INVALID_SOCKET;
    sockaddr_in endpoint{};
    CatBoxProtocol::Key key{};
    bool wsa = false;
    std::bitset<256> injected;
    mutable std::mutex snapshotMutex;
    PhysicalInputSnapshot snapshot;

    int Exchange(Command c, uint64_t deadline = 0) {
        if (socket == INVALID_SOCKET) return err_queue_stopped;
        CatBoxProtocol::Key iv{};
        if (BCryptGenRandom(nullptr, iv.data(), 16, BCRYPT_USE_SYSTEM_PREFERRED_RNG) < 0) return err_net_tx;
        auto packet = CatBoxProtocol::Encode(c, key, iv);
        if (packet.empty()) return err_net_tx;
        // The published protocol has no transaction ID. Serialize one request
        // at a time and never retry a timed-out movement or button press.
        for (unsigned i=0; i<64; ++i) {
            fd_set fds; FD_ZERO(&fds); FD_SET(socket, &fds); timeval zero{};
            if (select(0, &fds, nullptr, nullptr, &zero) <= 0) break;
            char stale[1024]; recv(socket, stale, sizeof(stale), 0);
        }
        if (sendto(socket, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(packet.data()), int(packet.size()), 0,
                reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&endpoint), sizeof(endpoint)) != int(packet.size())) return err_net_tx;
        const auto end = deadline ? (std::min)(deadline, GetTickCount64() + 300) : GetTickCount64() + 300;
        while (GetTickCount64() < end) {
            fd_set fds; FD_ZERO(&fds); FD_SET(socket, &fds);
            const auto remaining = end - GetTickCount64();
            timeval wait{0, static_cast<long>((std::min)(remaining, 25ull) * 1000)};
            const int ready = select(0, &fds, nullptr, nullptr, &wait);
            if (ready < 0) return err_net_tx;
            if (!ready) continue;
            char bytes[1024]; sockaddr_in from{}; int size = sizeof(from);
            const int n = recvfrom(socket, bytes, sizeof(bytes), 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&from), &size);
            if (n <= 0) return err_net_tx;
            if (from.sin_addr.s_addr != endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr || from.sin_port != endpoint.sin_port) continue;
            std::vector<uint8_t> plain;
            if (!CatBoxProtocol::Decode({bytes, bytes+n}, key, plain) || plain.size() != 7 || plain[0] != c.code) continue;
            return success;
        }
        return err_net_rx_timeout;
    }
    int Enqueue(Job job) {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
        if (!running || (!job.safety && (!accepting || state != OutputConnectionState::Connected))) return err_queue_stopped;
        if (queue.size() >= OutputQueueConfig::CommandQueueMaxSize) {
            if (!job.safety) return err_queue_full;
            auto it = std::find_if(queue.begin(), queue.end(), [](const Job& j){return !j.safety;});
            if (it == queue.end()) return err_queue_full;
            Complete(it->completion, err_queue_dropped); queue.erase(it);
        }
        if (job.kind == Job::Release) {
            for (auto& j : queue) Complete(j.completion, err_queue_dropped);
            queue.clear();
        }
        // FIFO preserves each accepted press/release pair. A release-all is a fence.
        queue.push_back(std::move(job)); cv.notify_one(); return success;
    }
    int ApplyKeys(const std::bitset<256>& desired, uint64_t deadline = 0, bool releaseOnly = false) {
        if(releaseOnly && (desired & ~injected).any()) return err_net_cmd;
        int first = success;
        for (int press=0; press<2; ++press) for (unsigned u=0; u<256; ++u) {
            if (desired[u] == injected[u] || desired[u] != bool(press)) continue;
            const auto code = CatBoxProtocol::HidToLinux(uint8_t(u));
            if (!code) return err_net_cmd;
            if (press) injected.set(u); // retain uncertain presses for cleanup after a partial failure
            const int result = Exchange({4, code, int16_t(press), 0}, deadline);
            if (result == success && !press) injected.reset(u);
            if (result != success && first == success) first = result;
            if (result != success) return first;
        }
        return first;
    }
    int ApplyMask(uint32_t mask, uint64_t deadline = 0) {
        int first = success;
        for (unsigned i=0; i<5; ++i) {
            const int result=Exchange({5, uint16_t(0x110+i), int16_t((mask>>i)&1), 0}, deadline);
            if (result != success && first == success) first=result;
            if (deadline && GetTickCount64() >= deadline) break;
        }
        return first;
    }
    int AllUp(uint64_t deadline) {
        int first = success;
        auto record=[&](int result){if (first==success && result!=success) first=result;};
        for (unsigned i=0;i<5 && GetTickCount64()<deadline;++i) record(Exchange({3,uint16_t(0x110+i),0,0},deadline));
        record(ApplyKeys({},deadline));
        if (GetTickCount64()<deadline) record(Exchange({6},deadline));
        if (GetTickCount64()<deadline) record(Exchange({7},deadline));
        if (GetTickCount64()>=deadline && first==success) first=err_completion_timeout;
        return first;
    }
    void Run() {
        while (running) {
            Job job;
            { std::unique_lock lock(mutex); cv.wait(lock,[&]{return !running || !queue.empty();});
              if (!running) break; job=std::move(queue.front());queue.pop_front(); }
            int result=success;
            if (!job.safety && (state!=OutputConnectionState::Connected || !accepting)) result=err_queue_stopped;
            else if (!job.safety && V2::Output::OutputSuppressed()) result=err_output_suppressed;
            else switch(job.kind) {
            case Job::Wire: result=Exchange(job.command); break;
            case Job::Keys: result=ApplyKeys(job.keys,0,job.safety); break;
            case Job::Mask: result=ApplyMask(job.mask); break;
            case Job::Release: result=AllUp(job.deadline); break;
            }
            if (result!=success && result!=err_output_suppressed) {
                accepting=false;state=OutputConnectionState::Error;
                std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);snapshot={};
            }
            Complete(job.completion,result);
        }
    }
    void Listen() {
        while (listening) {
            fd_set fds;FD_ZERO(&fds);FD_SET(monitorSocket,&fds);timeval wait{0,25000};
            const int ready=select(0,&fds,nullptr,nullptr,&wait);
            if (ready<0) {listening=false;break;}
            if (!ready) continue;
            char bytes[1024];sockaddr_in from{};int size=sizeof(from);
            const int n=recvfrom(monitorSocket,bytes,sizeof(bytes),0,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&from),&size);
            if(n<=0) continue;
            if(from.sin_addr.s_addr!=endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr) continue;
            std::vector<uint8_t> plain;
            if(!CatBoxProtocol::Decode({bytes,bytes+n},key,plain) || plain.size()!=15) continue;
            const unsigned code=plain[0] | (plain[1]<<8), value=plain[2] | (plain[3]<<8);
            const unsigned keycode=plain[10] | (plain[11]<<8), keyvalue=plain[12] | (plain[13]<<8);
            if(keycode && keyvalue<=1) {
                std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
                for(unsigned u=4;u<256;++u) if(CatBoxProtocol::HidToLinux(uint8_t(u))==keycode) {
                    snapshot.keyboard.set(u,keyvalue!=0);snapshot.keyboardAvailable=true;
                    snapshot.keyboardSampledAtMs=GetTickCount64();break;
                }
            }
            if(code>=0x110 && code<=0x114 && value<=1) {
                std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
                const auto bit=1u<<(code-0x110);
                snapshot.buttons=value ? snapshot.buttons|bit : snapshot.buttons&~bit;
                snapshot.sampledAtMs=GetTickCount64();snapshot.available=true;
            }
        }
        std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);snapshot={};
    }
    void Close() {
        accepting=false;running=false;listening=false;cv.notify_all();
        if(worker.joinable()) worker.join();
        if(monitor.joinable()) monitor.join();
        {std::lock_guard lock(mutex);for(auto& job:queue) Complete(job.completion,err_queue_stopped);queue.clear();}
        if(socket!=INVALID_SOCKET) {closesocket(socket);socket=INVALID_SOCKET;}
        if(monitorSocket!=INVALID_SOCKET) {closesocket(monitorSocket);monitorSocket=INVALID_SOCKET;}
        if(wsa) {WSACleanup();wsa=false;}
        state=OutputConnectionState::Disconnected;
        std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);snapshot={};
    }
};
CatBoxBackend::CatBoxBackend():impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()){}
CatBoxBackend::~CatBoxBackend(){Shutdown();}
int CatBoxBackend::Initialize(const std::string& ip,uint16_t port,const std::string& uuid,uint16_t monitorPort) {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->lifecycle);impl_->Close();
    if(!port || !monitorPort || monitorPort==port || !CatBoxProtocol::DeriveKey(uuid,impl_->key)) return err_net_cmd;
    impl_->endpoint={};impl_->endpoint.sin_family=AF_INET;impl_->endpoint.sin_port=htons(port);
    if(InetPtonA(AF_INET,ip.c_str(),&impl_->endpoint.sin_addr)!=1) return err_net_cmd;
    WSADATA data{};if(WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2,2),&data)) return err_creat_socket;
    impl_->wsa=true;impl_->socket=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_DGRAM,IPPROTO_UDP);
    impl_->monitorSocket=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_DGRAM,IPPROTO_UDP);
    sockaddr_in local{};local.sin_family=AF_INET;local.sin_port=htons(monitorPort);
    if(impl_->socket==INVALID_SOCKET || impl_->monitorSocket==INVALID_SOCKET ||
       bind(impl_->monitorSocket,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&local),sizeof(local))==SOCKET_ERROR) {impl_->Close();return err_creat_socket;}
    int status=impl_->Exchange({1});
    if(status==success) status=impl_->Exchange({2,monitorPort});
    if(status!=success) {impl_->Close();return status;}
    // Recover keys that may have been partially transmitted before an earlier link failure.
    if(impl_->injected.any()) {status=impl_->ApplyKeys({});if(status!=success){impl_->Close();return status;}}
    impl_->state=OutputConnectionState::Connected;impl_->accepting=true;impl_->running=true;impl_->listening=true;
    impl_->worker=std::thread([this]{impl_->Run();});impl_->monitor=std::thread([this]{impl_->Listen();});
    return success;
}
OutputConnectionState CatBoxBackend::GetConnectionState() const{return impl_->state;}
int CatBoxBackend::Move(int x,int y,int duration) {
    if(x < -32768 || x>32767 || y < -32768 || y>32767 || duration<0 || duration>32767) return err_net_cmd;
    Impl::Job j;j.command={uint8_t(duration?9:8),uint16_t(duration),int16_t(x),int16_t(y)};return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j));
}
int CatBoxBackend::Button(int button,bool down) {
    if(button<0 || button>4) return err_net_cmd;
    Impl::Job j;j.command={3,uint16_t(0x110+button),int16_t(down),0};j.safety=!down;return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j));
}
int CatBoxBackend::Keyboard(uint8_t modifiers,const std::vector<uint8_t>& usages,OutputIntent intent) {
    Impl::Job j;j.kind=Impl::Job::Keys;j.safety=intent==OutputIntent::SafetyRelease;
    for(auto u:usages) {if(!CatBoxProtocol::HidToLinux(u)) return err_net_cmd;j.keys.set(u);}
    for(unsigned i=0;i<8;++i) if(modifiers&(1u<<i)) j.keys.set(224+i);
    return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j));
}
int CatBoxBackend::Mask(uint32_t mask,std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion) {
    if(mask&~31u) return err_net_cmd;
    Impl::Job j;j.kind=Impl::Job::Mask;j.mask=mask;j.safety=!mask;j.completion=std::move(completion);return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j));
}
int CatBoxBackend::ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
    if(timeout.count()<0) return err_net_cmd;
    impl_->accepting=false;
    Impl::Job j;j.kind=Impl::Job::Release;j.safety=true;j.deadline=GetTickCount64()+timeout.count();
    auto completion=std::make_shared<OutputCommandCompletion>();j.completion=completion;
    const int status=impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j));if(status!=success) return status;
    std::unique_lock lock(completion->mutex);
    if(!completion->cv.wait_for(lock,timeout,[&]{return completion->completed;})) return err_completion_timeout;
    if(completion->status==success) impl_->accepting=true;
    return completion->status;
}
int CatBoxBackend::Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->lifecycle);
    int status=success;if(impl_->running) status=ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout);
    impl_->Close();return status;
}
PhysicalInputSnapshot CatBoxBackend::PhysicalInput() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->snapshotMutex);auto value=impl_->snapshot;
    value.available=value.available && impl_->listening && impl_->state==OutputConnectionState::Connected &&
        GetTickCount64()-value.sampledAtMs<=100;
    value.keyboardAvailable=value.keyboardAvailable && impl_->listening &&
        impl_->state==OutputConnectionState::Connected && GetTickCount64()-value.keyboardSampledAtMs<=100;
    return value;
}
}
```

```cpp
class CatDevice final : public IOutputDevice {

            endpoint->uuid, endpoint->monitorPort) : err_net_cmd;

        int result = success;
        for (int button = 0; button < 5; ++button) {
            const int status = CatBoxMgr.Button(button, (mask & (1u << button)) != 0);
            if (result == success) result = status;
        }
        return result;

        return CatBoxMgr.Mask(mask, std::move(completion));

        cleanup.reset();
```

`src/output/devices/catbox/Protocol.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <windows.h>
#include <bcrypt.h>
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#pragma comment(lib, "bcrypt.lib")
namespace V2::Output::CatBoxProtocol {
bool DeriveKey(std::string_view uuid, Key& key) {
    if (uuid.empty() || uuid.size() > 8) return false;
    std::string normalized(8 - uuid.size(), '0');
    for (char c : uuid) {
        if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') c += 'a' - 'A';
        if (!((c >= '0' && c <= '9') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f'))) return false;
        normalized += c;
    }
    normalized += "00000000";
    std::copy(normalized.begin(), normalized.end(), key.begin());
    return true;
}
static bool Crypt(bool encrypt, const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, const Key& key,
                  Key iv, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    BCRYPT_ALG_HANDLE alg = nullptr; BCRYPT_KEY_HANDLE handle = nullptr;
    bool ok = false;
    if (BCryptOpenAlgorithmProvider(&alg, BCRYPT_AES_ALGORITHM, nullptr, 0) < 0) return false;
    if (BCryptSetProperty(alg, BCRYPT_CHAINING_MODE,
            reinterpret_cast<PUCHAR>(const_cast<wchar_t*>(BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_CBC)),
            sizeof(BCRYPT_CHAIN_MODE_CBC), 0) >= 0 &&
        BCryptGenerateSymmetricKey(alg, &handle, nullptr, 0,
            const_cast<PUCHAR>(key.data()), 16, 0) >= 0) {
        out.resize(in.size() + 16); ULONG count = 0;
        const auto status = encrypt
            ? BCryptEncrypt(handle, const_cast<PUCHAR>(in.data()), static_cast<ULONG>(in.size()), nullptr,
                iv.data(), 16, out.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(out.size()), &count, BCRYPT_BLOCK_PADDING)
            : BCryptDecrypt(handle, const_cast<PUCHAR>(in.data()), static_cast<ULONG>(in.size()), nullptr,
                iv.data(), 16, out.data(), static_cast<ULONG>(out.size()), &count, BCRYPT_BLOCK_PADDING);
        ok = status >= 0;
        if (ok) out.resize(count); else out.clear();
    }
    if (handle) BCryptDestroyKey(handle);
    BCryptCloseAlgorithmProvider(alg, 0);
    return ok;
}
std::vector<uint8_t> Encode(Command c, const Key& key, const Key& iv) {
    const auto x = static_cast<uint16_t>(c.x), y = static_cast<uint16_t>(c.y);
    std::vector<uint8_t> plain = {c.code, uint8_t(c.options), uint8_t(c.options >> 8),
        uint8_t(x), uint8_t(x >> 8), uint8_t(y), uint8_t(y >> 8)}, encrypted;
    if (!Crypt(true, plain, key, iv, encrypted)) return {};
    std::vector<uint8_t> result(iv.begin(), iv.end());
    result.insert(result.end(), encrypted.begin(), encrypted.end());
    return result;
}
bool Decode(const std::vector<uint8_t>& packet, const Key& key, std::vector<uint8_t>& plain) {
    plain.clear();
    if (packet.size() < 32 || packet.size() > 1024 || packet.size() % 16) return false;
    Key iv{}; std::copy_n(packet.begin(), 16, iv.begin());
    return Crypt(false, {packet.begin() + 16, packet.end()}, key, iv, plain);
}
uint16_t HidToLinux(uint8_t u) {
    constexpr uint16_t letters[] = {30,48,46,32,18,33,34,35,23,36,37,38,50,49,24,25,16,19,31,20,22,47,17,45,21,44};
    if (u >= 4 && u <= 29) return letters[u - 4];
    if (u >= 30 && u <= 38) return u - 28;
    if (u == 39) return 11;
    if (u >= 58 && u <= 67) return u + 1;
    if (u == 68 || u == 69) return u + 19;
    constexpr uint16_t modifiers[] = {29,42,56,125,97,54,100,126};
    if (u >= 224 && u <= 231) return modifiers[u - 224];
    switch (u) {
    case 40:return 28; case 41:return 1; case 42:return 14; case 43:return 15; case 44:return 57;
    case 45:return 12; case 46:return 13; case 47:return 26; case 48:return 27; case 49:return 43;
    case 50:return 86; case 51:return 39; case 52:return 40; case 53:return 41; case 54:return 51;
    case 55:return 52; case 56:return 53; case 57:return 58; case 70:return 99; case 71:return 70;
    case 72:return 119; case 73:return 110; case 74:return 102; case 75:return 104; case 76:return 111;
    case 77:return 107; case 78:return 109; case 79:return 106; case 80:return 105; case 81:return 108;
    case 82:return 103; case 83:return 69; case 84:return 98; case 85:return 55; case 86:return 74;
    case 87:return 78; case 88:return 96; case 89:return 79; case 90:return 80; case 91:return 81;
    case 92:return 75; case 93:return 76; case 94:return 77; case 95:return 71; case 96:return 72;
    case 97:return 73; case 98:return 82; case 99:return 83; default:return 0;
    }
}
}
```

`src/output/devices/dhzbox/Backend.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "Backend.hpp"
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include "output/OutputServices.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <atomic>
#include <bitset>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#pragma comment(lib, "ws2_32.lib")

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
void Complete(const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& c, int status) { if (!c) return; { std::lock_guard lock(c->mutex); if (c->completed) return; c->status = status; c->completed = true; } c->cv.notify_all(); }
}
struct DhzBoxBackend::Impl {
    struct Job { enum Kind { Wire, Keys, Release } kind = Wire; std::string command; std::bitset<256> keys; bool safety = false; std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion; uint64_t deadline = 0; };
    mutable std::mutex lifecycle, mutex, snapshotMutex;
    std::condition_variable cv;
    std::deque<Job> queue;
    std::thread worker, monitor;
    std::atomic<bool> running{false}, listening{false}, accepting{false};
    std::atomic<OutputConnectionState> state{OutputConnectionState::Disconnected};
    SOCKET socket = INVALID_SOCKET, monitorSocket = INVALID_SOCKET;
    sockaddr_in endpoint{};
    unsigned shift = 0;
    bool wsa = false;
    std::bitset<256> injected;
    PhysicalInputSnapshot snapshot{};

    int Exchange(std::string_view command, uint64_t deadline = 0) {
        if (socket == INVALID_SOCKET) return err_queue_stopped;
        const std::string wire = DhzBoxProtocol::Shift(command, shift);
        if (sendto(socket, wire.data(), static_cast<int>(wire.size()), 0, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&endpoint), sizeof(endpoint)) != static_cast<int>(wire.size())) return err_net_tx;
        const uint64_t end = deadline ? (std::min)(deadline, GetTickCount64() + 300ull) : GetTickCount64() + 300ull;
        while (GetTickCount64() < end) {
            fd_set fds; FD_ZERO(&fds); FD_SET(socket, &fds); const auto left = end - GetTickCount64(); timeval wait{0, static_cast<long>((std::min)(left, 25ull) * 1000)};
            const int ready = select(0, &fds, nullptr, nullptr, &wait); if (ready < 0) return err_net_tx; if (!ready) continue;
            char bytes[1024]; sockaddr_in from{}; int size = sizeof(from); const int n = recvfrom(socket, bytes, sizeof(bytes), 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&from), &size);
            if (n > 0 && from.sin_addr.s_addr == endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr && from.sin_port == endpoint.sin_port) return success;
        }
        return err_net_rx_timeout;
    }
    int Enqueue(Job job) {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
        if (!running || (!job.safety && (!accepting || state != OutputConnectionState::Connected))) return err_queue_stopped;
        if (queue.size() >= OutputQueueConfig::CommandQueueMaxSize) { if (!job.safety) return err_queue_full; auto it = std::find_if(queue.begin(), queue.end(), [](const Job& j){ return !j.safety; }); if (it == queue.end()) return err_queue_full; Complete(it->completion, err_queue_dropped); queue.erase(it); }
        if (job.kind == Job::Release) { for (auto& pending : queue) Complete(pending.completion, err_queue_dropped); queue.clear(); }
        queue.push_back(std::move(job)); cv.notify_one(); return success;
    }
    int ApplyKeys(const std::bitset<256>& desired, uint64_t deadline = 0, bool releaseOnly = false) {
        if (releaseOnly && (desired & ~injected).any()) return err_net_cmd;
        for (unsigned pass = 0; pass < 2; ++pass) for (unsigned u = 4; u < 256; ++u) if (desired[u] != injected[u] && desired[u] == bool(pass)) {
            const auto command = std::string(pass ? "keydown(" : "keyup(") + std::to_string(u) + ")";
            if (pass) injected.set(u); const int result = Exchange(command, deadline); if (result != success) return result; if (!pass) injected.reset(u);
        }
        return success;
    }
    int AllUp(uint64_t deadline) { int first = success; for (int i = 0; i < 5 && GetTickCount64() < deadline; ++i) { const int s = Exchange(DhzBoxProtocol::Button(i, false), deadline); if (first == success && s != success) first = s; } const int keys = ApplyKeys({}, deadline); if (first == success) first = keys; return first; }
    void Run() {
        while (running) { Job job; { std::unique_lock lock(mutex); cv.wait(lock, [&]{ return !running || !queue.empty(); }); if (!running) break; job = std::move(queue.front()); queue.pop_front(); }
            int result = success; if (!job.safety && (state != OutputConnectionState::Connected || !accepting)) result = err_queue_stopped; else if (!job.safety && OutputSuppressed()) result = err_output_suppressed; else if (job.kind == Job::Wire) result = Exchange(job.command); else if (job.kind == Job::Keys) result = ApplyKeys(job.keys, 0, job.safety); else result = AllUp(job.deadline);
            if (result != success && result != err_output_suppressed) { accepting = false; state = OutputConnectionState::Error; } Complete(job.completion, result);
        }
    }
    void Listen() {
        while (listening) { fd_set fds; FD_ZERO(&fds); FD_SET(monitorSocket, &fds); timeval wait{0,25000}; const int ready = select(0, &fds, nullptr, nullptr, &wait); if (ready <= 0) continue; char bytes[256]; sockaddr_in from{}; int size = sizeof(from); const int n = recvfrom(monitorSocket, bytes, sizeof(bytes)-1, 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&from), &size); if (n <= 0 || from.sin_addr.s_addr != endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr) continue; bytes[n] = 0; unsigned values[5]{}; char extra = 0; if (std::sscanf(bytes, "%u|%u|%u|%u|%u%c", &values[0], &values[1], &values[2], &values[3], &values[4], &extra) >= 5) { std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex); snapshot.available = true; snapshot.buttons = 0; for (unsigned i=0;i<5;++i) if (values[i]) snapshot.buttons |= 1u << i; snapshot.sampledAtMs = GetTickCount64(); } }
        std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex); snapshot = {};
    }
    void Close() { accepting = false; running = false; listening = false; cv.notify_all(); if (worker.joinable()) worker.join(); if (monitor.joinable()) monitor.join(); { std::lock_guard lock(mutex); for (auto& job : queue) Complete(job.completion, err_queue_stopped); queue.clear(); } if (socket != INVALID_SOCKET) { closesocket(socket); socket = INVALID_SOCKET; } if (monitorSocket != INVALID_SOCKET) { closesocket(monitorSocket); monitorSocket = INVALID_SOCKET; } if (wsa) { WSACleanup(); wsa = false; } state = OutputConnectionState::Disconnected; std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex); snapshot = {}; }
};
DhzBoxBackend::DhzBoxBackend(): impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
DhzBoxBackend::~DhzBoxBackend() { Shutdown(); }
int DhzBoxBackend::Initialize(const std::string& ip, uint16_t port, uint8_t randomShift, uint16_t monitorPort) {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->lifecycle); impl_->Close(); if (!port || !InetPtonA(AF_INET, ip.c_str(), &impl_->endpoint.sin_addr)) return err_net_cmd; impl_->endpoint.sin_family = AF_INET; impl_->endpoint.sin_port = htons(port); impl_->shift = randomShift % 26;
    WSADATA data{}; if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2,2), &data)) return err_creat_socket; impl_->wsa = true; impl_->socket = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP); impl_->monitorSocket = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP); if (impl_->socket == INVALID_SOCKET || impl_->monitorSocket == INVALID_SOCKET) { impl_->Close(); return err_creat_socket; }
    if (monitorPort) { sockaddr_in local{}; local.sin_family = AF_INET; local.sin_port = htons(monitorPort); if (bind(impl_->monitorSocket, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&local), sizeof(local)) == SOCKET_ERROR) { impl_->Close(); return err_creat_socket; } }
    impl_->state = OutputConnectionState::Connected; impl_->accepting = true; impl_->running = true; impl_->listening = monitorPort != 0; impl_->worker = std::thread([p=impl_.get()]{ p->Run(); }); if (impl_->listening) { impl_->monitor = std::thread([p=impl_.get()]{ p->Listen(); }); impl_->Enqueue({Impl::Job::Wire, "monitor(" + std::to_string(monitorPort) + ")"}); } return success;
}
OutputConnectionState DhzBoxBackend::GetConnectionState() const { return impl_->state; }
int DhzBoxBackend::Move(int x, int y) { if (x < -32768 || x > 32767 || y < -32768 || y > 32767) return err_net_cmd; return impl_->Enqueue({Impl::Job::Wire, DhzBoxProtocol::Move(x,y)}); }
int DhzBoxBackend::Button(int button, bool down) { auto command = DhzBoxProtocol::Button(button, down); if (command.empty()) return err_net_cmd; Impl::Job j; j.command = std::move(command); j.safety = !down; return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j)); }
int DhzBoxBackend::Keyboard(uint8_t modifiers, const std::vector<uint8_t>& usages, OutputIntent intent) { Impl::Job j; j.kind = Impl::Job::Keys; j.safety = intent == OutputIntent::SafetyRelease; for (auto u : usages) { if (u < 4) return err_net_cmd; j.keys.set(u); } for (unsigned i=0;i<8;++i) if (modifiers & (1u<<i)) j.keys.set(224+i); return impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j)); }
int DhzBoxBackend::Mask(uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>) { return err_net_cmd; }
int DhzBoxBackend::ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) { impl_->accepting = false; auto completion = std::make_shared<OutputCommandCompletion>(); Impl::Job j; j.kind = Impl::Job::Release; j.safety = true; j.deadline = GetTickCount64() + static_cast<uint64_t>((std::max)(0ll, timeout.count())); j.completion = completion; const int status = impl_->Enqueue(std::move(j)); if (status != success) return status; std::unique_lock lock(completion->mutex); if (!completion->cv.wait_for(lock, timeout, [&]{ return completion->completed; })) return err_completion_timeout; if (completion->status == success) impl_->accepting = true; return completion->status; }
int DhzBoxBackend::Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) { std::lock_guard lock(impl_->lifecycle); int status = success; if (impl_->running) status = ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout); impl_->Close(); return status; }
PhysicalInputSnapshot DhzBoxBackend::PhysicalInput() const { std::lock_guard lock(impl_->snapshotMutex); auto value = impl_->snapshot; value.available = value.available && impl_->listening && impl_->state == OutputConnectionState::Connected && GetTickCount64() - value.sampledAtMs <= 100; return value; }
DhzBoxBackend DhzBoxMgr;
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace V2::Output::DhzBoxProtocol {
inline std::string Shift(std::string_view text, unsigned shift) {
    std::string result(text);
    shift %= 26;
    for (char& c : result) {
        if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') c = static_cast<char>('a' + (c - 'a' + shift) % 26);
        else if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') c = static_cast<char>('A' + (c - 'A' + shift) % 26);
    }
    return result;
}
inline std::string Move(int x, int y) { return "move(" + std::to_string(x) + "," + std::to_string(y) + ")"; }
inline std::string Button(int button, bool down) {
    constexpr const char* names[] = {"left", "right", "middle", "side1", "side2"};
    return button >= 0 && button < 5 ? std::string(names[button]) + "(" + (down ? "1)" : "0)") : std::string();
}
inline std::string Key(const char* name, unsigned usage, bool down) {
    return std::string(name) + "(" + std::to_string(usage) + ")";
}
inline std::string Mouse(std::uint32_t mask, int x, int y, int wheel) {
    return "mouse(" + std::to_string(mask) + "," + std::to_string(x) + "," +
        std::to_string(y) + "," + std::to_string(wheel) + ")";
}
}
```

`src/output/devices/ferrum/Protocol.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
namespace V2::Output::FerrumProtocol {
inline constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> ButtonQueries = {
    "km.left()", "km.right()", "km.middle()", "km.side1()", "km.side2()"
};

enum class ButtonReply { Other, Released, Pressed, Invalid };

// Ferrum returns a physical 0/1, including while the output button is masked.
// Do not interpret MAKCU's 0..3 ownership bitmap as a Ferrum reply.
inline ButtonReply ParseButtonReply(std::string_view response, size_t button) {
    constexpr std::string_view whitespace = " \r\n\t";
    const auto trim = [whitespace](std::string_view text) {
        const auto first = text.find_first_not_of(whitespace);
        return first == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} :
            text.substr(first, text.find_last_not_of(whitespace) - first + 1);
    };
    response = trim(response);
    if (button >= ButtonQueries.size()) return ButtonReply::Invalid;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < ButtonQueries.size(); ++i) {
        const auto echo = ButtonQueries[i];
        if (!response.starts_with(echo)) continue;
        if (i != button) return ButtonReply::Invalid;
        if (response.size() == echo.size()) return ButtonReply::Other;
        if (whitespace.find(response[echo.size()]) == std::string_view::npos)
            return ButtonReply::Invalid;
        response = trim(response.substr(echo.size()));
        break;
    }
    // A queued move, mask or key setter can echo between query replies.
    if (response.starts_with("km.")) return ButtonReply::Other;
    if (response == "0") return ButtonReply::Released;
    if (response == "1") return ButtonReply::Pressed;
    return response.empty() ? ButtonReply::Other : ButtonReply::Invalid;
}

inline bool Identity(std::string_view line) { return line == "kmbox: Ferrum"; }
inline std::string Mask(int button, bool enabled) {
    constexpr const char* names[] = {"ml", "mr", "mm", "ms1", "ms2"};
    if (button < 0 || button > 4) return {};
    return std::string("km.lock_") + names[button] + "(" + (enabled ? "1" : "0") + ")\r\n";
}
inline constexpr int physicalRestoreMaxMs = 175;
}

```

`src/output/devices/ferrum/Session.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "Session.hpp"
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include <utility>

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
constexpr uint64_t kButtonPollIntervalMs = 60;
constexpr uint64_t kButtonPollTimeoutMs = 30;
}

void FerrumSession::Reset() {
    KmTextSession::Reset();
    buttonPollPending = false;
    buttonPollNeedsSync = false;
    buttonPollStartedMs = 0;
    nextButtonPollMs = 0;
    buttonPollIndex = 0;
    buttonPollBits = 0;
}

bool FerrumSession::Identity(std::string_view response) const {
    return KmTextCommands::IdentityMatches(response, FerrumProtocol::Identity);
}

bool FerrumSession::OnConnected(SerialChannel& channel) {
    channel.Purge();
    if (!Identity(QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true))) return false;
    if (!ConfirmMousePresence(channel)) return false;
    keyboardReady = true;
    maskReady = true;
    return channel.Write("km.buttons(1)\r\n");
}

bool FerrumSession::ConfirmMousePresence(SerialChannel& channel) {
    // A virtual COM and a Ferrum identity confirm the App, not a designated mouse.
    const auto response = QueryLocked(channel, "km.has_mouse()\r\n");
    const auto trim = [](std::string_view value) {
        const auto first = value.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
        return first == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} :
            value.substr(first, value.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n") - first + 1);
    };
    auto value = trim(response);
    constexpr std::string_view echo = "km.has_mouse()";
    if (value.starts_with(echo) && value.size() > echo.size() &&
        std::string_view(" \t\r\n").find(value[echo.size()]) != std::string_view::npos)
        value = trim(value.substr(echo.size()));
    if (value == "1") return true;
    ClearPhysicalInput();
    keyboardReady = false;
    maskReady = false;
    return false;
}

void FerrumSession::RejectButtonPoll() {
    buttonPollPending = false;
    buttonPollNeedsSync = true;
    // A newer callback is already a complete physical snapshot.
    std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
    if (physical.sampledAtMs < buttonPollStartedMs) physical = {};
}

bool FerrumSession::ReadButtonReplies(SerialChannel& channel) {
    if (!ReadInputLocked(channel)) return false;
    if (buttonPollPending && GetTickCount64() - buttonPollStartedMs >= kButtonPollTimeoutMs)
        RejectButtonPoll();
    while (!responses.empty()) {
        auto body = std::move(responses.front());
        responses.pop_front();
        if (!buttonPollPending) continue;
        const auto reply = FerrumProtocol::ParseButtonReply(body, buttonPollIndex);
        if (reply == FerrumProtocol::ButtonReply::Other) continue;
        if (reply == FerrumProtocol::ButtonReply::Invalid) {
            RejectButtonPoll();
            continue;
        }
        if (reply == FerrumProtocol::ButtonReply::Pressed)
            buttonPollBits |= uint8_t(1u << buttonPollIndex);
        if (++buttonPollIndex == FerrumProtocol::ButtonQueries.size()) {
            buttonPollPending = false;
            std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
            // Preserve callbacks received during this sweep, including callbacks
            // in the same clock millisecond. The sweep began before its replies.
            if (physical.sampledAtMs < buttonPollStartedMs)
                physical = {true, buttonPollBits, buttonPollStartedMs};
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool FerrumSession::AfterWrite(SerialChannel& channel) {
    return ReadButtonReplies(channel);
}

bool FerrumSession::Poll(SerialChannel& channel, bool running) {
    if (!ReadButtonReplies(channel)) return false;
    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
    if (!running || buttonPollPending || buttonPollNeedsSync || now < nextButtonPollMs)
        return true;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
        if (physical.available && now - physical.sampledAtMs < kButtonPollIntervalMs)
            return true;
    }
    std::string commands;
    for (const auto query : FerrumProtocol::ButtonQueries) {
        commands += query;
        commands += "\r\n";
    }
    buttonPollStartedMs = now;
    nextButtonPollMs = now + kButtonPollIntervalMs;
    buttonPollIndex = 0;
    buttonPollBits = 0;
    buttonPollPending = true;
    // Do not wait here: the output worker must remain free to process releases.
    return channel.Write(commands);
}

bool FerrumSession::Heartbeat(SerialChannel& channel, bool) {
    if (!ReadButtonReplies(channel)) return false;
    if (buttonPollPending) RejectButtonPoll();
    // The serial command/reply order makes identity a barrier for late numeric
    // replies. Presence must follow it too: a late pressed-button value of 1
    // must never be mistaken for km.has_mouse(). Check even with output suppressed.
    if (QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true).empty()) return false;
    responses.clear();
    buttonPollNeedsSync = false;
    return ConfirmMousePresence(channel);
}

std::string FerrumSession::EncodeMask(int button, bool enabled) const {
    return FerrumProtocol::Mask(button, enabled);
}

int FerrumSession::FlushInterval(OutputCommandType type) const {
    if (type == OutputCommandType::MouseMove || type == OutputCommandType::MouseAutoMove)
        return OutputQueueConfig::MouseMoveFlushIntervalMs;
    return KmTextCommands::FlushInterval(type);
}

}
```
