```cpp
void KmBoxNetKeyboard::ListenThread()
{
    this->listenerThreadId.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_release);
    WORD wVersionRequested = MAKEWORD(2, 2);
    WSADATA wsaData{};
    int Status = WSAStartup(wVersionRequested, &wsaData);
    if (Status != success) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[KMBOX-NET] Monitor WSAStartup failed. status=%d", Status);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
            this->monitorStartStatus = err_creat_socket;
            this->monitorStartResolved = true;
        }
        this->monitorStartCv.notify_all();
        this->listenerThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        return;
    }

    this->s_ListenSocket = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, 0);
    if (!IsValidSocket(this->s_ListenSocket)) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[KMBOX-NET] Monitor socket creation failed. WSA=%d", WSAGetLastError());
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
            this->monitorStartStatus = err_creat_socket;
            this->monitorStartResolved = true;
        }
        this->monitorStartCv.notify_all();
        WSACleanup();
        this->listenerThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        return;
    }
    DisableUdpConnectionReset(this->s_ListenSocket, "monitor");

    sockaddr_in AddrServer{};
    AddrServer.sin_family = PF_INET;
    AddrServer.sin_addr.S_un.S_addr = INADDR_ANY;
    AddrServer.sin_port = htons(this->MonitorPort);

    Status = bind(this->s_ListenSocket, reinterpret_cast<SOCKADDR*>(&AddrServer), sizeof(SOCKADDR));
    if (Status == SOCKET_ERROR) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[KMBOX-NET] Monitor bind failed on port %u. WSA=%d",
            this->MonitorPort, WSAGetLastError());
        closesocket(this->s_ListenSocket);
        this->s_ListenSocket = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
            this->monitorStartStatus = err_net_rx_timeout;
            this->monitorStartResolved = true;
        }
        this->monitorStartCv.notify_all();
        WSACleanup();
        this->listenerThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
        return;
    }

    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
        this->monitorStartStatus = success;
        this->monitorStartResolved = true;
    }
    this->monitorStartCv.notify_all();
    Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor listener bound. port=%u", this->MonitorPort);

    SOCKADDR AddrClient{};
    char Buffer[1024]{};

    this->ListenerRuned.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    while (this->ListenerRuned.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        int FromLen = sizeof(SOCKADDR);
        const int Ret = recvfrom(this->s_ListenSocket, Buffer, sizeof(Buffer), 0, &AddrClient, &FromLen);
        if (Ret >= static_cast<int>(sizeof(this->hw_Mouse) + sizeof(this->hw_Keyboard))) {
            unsigned char previousButtons = 0;
            unsigned char currentButtons = 0;
            standard_keyboard_report_t previousKeyboard{};
            standard_keyboard_report_t currentKeyboard{};
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
            previousButtons = this->hw_Mouse.buttons;
            previousKeyboard = this->hw_Keyboard;
            memcpy(&this->hw_Mouse, Buffer, sizeof(this->hw_Mouse));
            memcpy(&this->hw_Keyboard, &Buffer[sizeof(this->hw_Mouse)], sizeof(this->hw_Keyboard));
            this->inputSampledAtMs = GetTickCount64();
            currentButtons = this->hw_Mouse.buttons;
            currentKeyboard = this->hw_Keyboard;

            const unsigned long long packetCount =
                this->inputPacketCount.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) + 1;
            if (packetCount == 1) {
                char keys[64] = {};
                FormatKeyboardKeys(currentKeyboard, keys, sizeof(keys));
                Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] first input packet received. bytes=%d mouse_buttons=0x%02X keyboard_modifiers=0x%02X keyboard_keys=%s",
                    Ret,
                    static_cast<unsigned int>(currentButtons),
                    static_cast<unsigned int>(currentKeyboard.buttons),
                    keys);
            }

            if (previousButtons != currentButtons) {
                this->lastLoggedMouseButtons.store(currentButtons, std::memory_order_release);
                LogMouseButtonChanges(previousButtons, currentButtons);
            }
            LogKeyboardReportChange(previousKeyboard, currentKeyboard);
        } else if (Ret <= 0) {
            break;
        }
    }
    this->ListenerRuned.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    if (IsValidSocket(this->s_ListenSocket))
        closesocket(this->s_ListenSocket);
    this->s_ListenSocket = 0;
    WSACleanup();
    this->listenerThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
}

int KmBoxNetKeyboard::StartMonitor(WORD Port)
{
    Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor start requested. port=%u", Port);

    if (Port == 0) {
        EndMonitor();
        Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor disabled by port 0.");
        return success;
    }

    if (!V2::Output::KmBoxNetMgr.EnsureConnected()) {
        Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor start failed. port=%u status=%d",
            Port, err_creat_socket);
        return err_creat_socket;
    }

    EndMonitor();

    this->MonitorPort = Port;
    this->ListenerRuned.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    this->inputPacketCount.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    this->lastLoggedMouseButtons.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
        this->hw_Mouse = {};
        this->hw_Keyboard = {};
        this->inputSampledAtMs = 0;
        this->monitorStartStatus = err_creat_socket;
        this->monitorStartResolved = false;
    }

    this->t_Listen = std::thread(&KmBoxNetKeyboard::ListenThread, this);

    int listenerStatus = success;
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
        if (!this->monitorStartCv.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(500),
            [this]() { return this->monitorStartResolved; })) {
            Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor start failed. port=%u status=%d",
                Port, err_net_rx_timeout);
            listenerStatus = err_net_rx_timeout;
        } else {
            listenerStatus = this->monitorStartStatus;
        }
    }

    if (listenerStatus != success) {
        Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor listener failed. port=%u status=%d",
            Port, listenerStatus);
        EndMonitor();
        return listenerStatus;
    }

    client_data packet = V2::Output::KmBoxNetMgr.BuildPacket(
        cmd_monitor,
        static_cast<unsigned int>(Port) | (0xaa55u << 16));
    const int status = V2::Output::KmBoxNetMgr.SendSynchronousCommand(cmd_monitor, packet.head.rand,
        sizeof(cmd_head_t), OutputCommandType::Monitor, &packet);
    if (status != success) {
        Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor command failed. port=%u status=%d", Port, status);
        EndMonitor();
        return status;
    }

    Diagnostics::Info("[KMBOX-NET] monitor start succeeded. port=%u", Port);
    return success;
}

void KmBoxNetKeyboard::EndMonitor()
{
    this->ListenerRuned.store(false, std::memory_order_release);

    if (IsValidSocket(this->s_ListenSocket))
        closesocket(this->s_ListenSocket);

    this->s_ListenSocket = 0;
    this->MonitorPort = 0;

    if (this->t_Listen.joinable() &&
        this->t_Listen.get_id() != std::this_thread::get_id()) {
        this->t_Listen.join();
    }
}

unsigned long long KmBoxNetKeyboard::InputPacketCount() const
{
    return this->inputPacketCount.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

V2::Output::PhysicalInputSnapshot KmBoxNetKeyboard::PhysicalInput()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(monitorMutex);
    V2::Output::PhysicalInputSnapshot result{};
    result.available = ListenerRuned.load(std::memory_order_acquire) && inputSampledAtMs != 0;
    result.buttons = hw_Mouse.buttons;
    result.sampledAtMs = inputSampledAtMs;
    return result;
}

KmBoxNetKeyboard::~KmBoxNetKeyboard()
{
    this->EndMonitor();
}

bool KmBoxNetKeyboard::GetKeyState(WORD vKey)
{
    const WORD hidKey = VirtualKeyToHidKey(vKey);
    if (hidKey == 0)
        return false;

    unsigned char KeyValue = hidKey & 0xff;
    if (!this->ListenerRuned.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    standard_keyboard_report_t keyboard{};
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
        keyboard = this->hw_Keyboard;
    }

    if (KeyValue >= KEY_LEFTCONTROL && KeyValue <= KEY_RIGHT_GUI) {
        switch (KeyValue) {
        case KEY_LEFTCONTROL: return  keyboard.buttons & BIT0 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_LEFTSHIFT:   return  keyboard.buttons & BIT1 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_LEFTALT:     return  keyboard.buttons & BIT2 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_LEFT_GUI:    return  keyboard.buttons & BIT3 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_RIGHTCONTROL:return  keyboard.buttons & BIT4 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_RIGHTSHIFT:  return  keyboard.buttons & BIT5 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_RIGHTALT:    return  keyboard.buttons & BIT6 ? 1 : 0;
        case KEY_RIGHT_GUI:   return  keyboard.buttons & BIT7 ? 1 : 0;
        default:              return false;
        }
    }

    for (auto i : keyboard.data) {
        if (i == KeyValue)
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool KmBoxNetKeyboard::IsMouseButtonPressed(int vkButton)
{
    if (!this->ListenerRuned.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return false;

    standard_mouse_report_t mouse{};
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(this->monitorMutex);
        mouse = this->hw_Mouse;
    }

    switch (vkButton) {
    case VK_LBUTTON:  return (mouse.buttons & 0x01) != 0;
    case VK_RBUTTON:  return (mouse.buttons & 0x02) != 0;
    case VK_MBUTTON:  return (mouse.buttons & 0x04) != 0;
    case VK_XBUTTON1: return (mouse.buttons & 0x08) != 0;
    case VK_XBUTTON2: return (mouse.buttons & 0x10) != 0;
    default:          return false;
    }
}
```

```hpp
public:
    soft_mouse_t MouseData{};
public:
    // Move mouse by relative offset
    int Move(int x, int y);
    // Move mouse with automatic trajectory over given runtime
    int Move_Auto(int x, int y, int Runtime);

    int Left(bool Down);

class KmBoxNetKeyboard
```

`src/output/devices/kmbox_net/Device.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Device.hpp"
#include "Backend.hpp"
#include "output/OutputDevice.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "output/TimerResolution.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
class NetDevice final : public IOutputDevice {
public:
    int Initialize(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) override {
        const auto* endpoint = std::get_if<OutputNetworkEndpoint>(&descriptor.endpoint);
        if (!endpoint || endpoint->ip.empty() || !endpoint->commandPort ||
            endpoint->mac.empty() || !endpoint->monitorPort) return err_net_cmd;
        (void)EnsureTimerResolution();
        const int status = KmBoxNetMgr.InitDevice(endpoint->ip, endpoint->commandPort, endpoint->mac);
        if (status != success) return status;
        const int recovery = KmBoxNetMgr.RecoverMousePassthrough();
        if (recovery != success)
            Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT-RUNTIME] Network passthrough recovery warning. status=%d", recovery);
        const int monitor = KmBoxNetMgr.KeyBoard.StartMonitor(endpoint->monitorPort);
        if (monitor != success)
            Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT-RUNTIME] Network monitor start warning. port=%u status=%d",
                static_cast<unsigned>(endpoint->monitorPort), monitor);
        return success;
    }
    int ReleaseAll(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) override { return KmBoxNetMgr.ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout); }
    int Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) override { return KmBoxNetMgr.Shutdown(timeout); }
    OutputConnectionState ConnectionState() const override { return KmBoxNetMgr.GetConnectionState(); }
    OutputDeviceCapabilities Capabilities() const override {
        OutputDeviceCapabilities value;
        value.keyboard = value.physicalMonitor = value.mouseMask = value.timedMove = true;
        value.callerMoveSplit = false;
        value.maskTimeoutClosesGate = false;
        return value;
    }
    PhysicalInputSnapshot PhysicalInput() override { return KmBoxNetMgr.KeyBoard.PhysicalInput(); }
    int Move(int x, int y, int duration) override {
        return duration > 0 ? KmBoxNetMgr.Mouse.Move_Auto(x, y, duration) : KmBoxNetMgr.Mouse.Move(x, y);
    }
    int Button(int button, bool down, bool force) override {
        if (force && !down) return KmBoxNetMgr.ForceReleaseMouseButton(button);
        switch (button) {
        case 0: return KmBoxNetMgr.Mouse.Left(down);
        case 1: return KmBoxNetMgr.Mouse.Right(down);
        case 2: return KmBoxNetMgr.Mouse.Middle(down);
        default: return err_net_cmd;
        }
    }
    int ButtonState(std::uint32_t mask, bool force) override { return KmBoxNetMgr.SetMouseButtonStateMask(mask, force); }
    int ReleaseButtons() override { return KmBoxNetMgr.ForceReleaseMouseButtons(); }
    int Keyboard(unsigned char modifiers, const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages, OutputIntent intent) override {
        return KmBoxNetMgr.SendKeyboardReport(modifiers, usages, intent);
    }
    int Mask(std::uint32_t mask, std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion) override {
        return mask ? KmBoxNetMgr.MaskMouseTracked(mask, completion) : KmBoxNetMgr.UnmaskAllTracked(completion);
    }
    int RecoverMaskTimeout(const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& timedOut,
        std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& cleanup) override {
        cleanup.reset();
        if (KmBoxNetMgr.CancelQueuedMouseMask(timedOut)) return success;
        cleanup = std::make_shared<OutputCommandCompletion>();
        return KmBoxNetMgr.QueueMouseUnmaskCleanup(cleanup);
    }
};
}
IOutputDevice& KmBoxNetDevice() {
    static NetDevice device;
    return device;
}
}
```

```cpp
#include "Maintenance.hpp"

namespace V2::Output::KmBoxNetConfig {
MaintenanceResult AllowMonitorFirewall(const Settings& settings)
{
    const int monitorPort = EffectiveMonitorPort(settings);
    const auto result = Platform::AllowInboundUdpForCurrentExecutable(
        monitorPort, L"UNDMA CN KMBox Monitor UDP " + std::to_wstring(monitorPort));
    if (result.ok) {
        Diagnostics::Info("KMBox monitor firewall allow requested. effectiveMonitorPort=%d commandPort=%d manualOverride=%d",
            monitorPort, settings.commandPort, settings.manualMonitorPort ? 1 : 0);
        Diagnostics::Aim("output.firewall allow_requested effectiveMonitorPort=%d commandPort=%d manualOverride=%d",
            monitorPort, settings.commandPort, settings.manualMonitorPort ? 1 : 0);
    }
    return result;
}

MaintenanceResult RestartNetworkAdapter(const Settings& settings)
{
    return Platform::RestartAdapterForTargetIp(settings.ip, "USB 2.0 Ethernet Adapter");
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "output/OutputTypes.hpp"

// Command definitions for KMbox NET communication
#define cmd_connect         0xaf3c2828
#define cmd_mouse_move      0xaede7345
#define cmd_mouse_left      0x9823AE8D
#define cmd_mouse_middle    0x97a3AE8D
#define cmd_mouse_right     0x238d8212
#define cmd_mouse_wheel     0xffeead38
#define cmd_mouse_automove  0xaede7346
#define cmd_keyboard_all    0x123c2c2f
#define cmd_reboot          0xaa8855aa
#define cmd_bazerMove       0xa238455a
#define cmd_monitor         0x27388020
#define cmd_debug           0x27382021
#define cmd_mask_mouse      0x23234343
#define cmd_unmask_all      0x23344343
#define cmd_setconfig       0x1d3d3323
#define cmd_setvidpid       0xffed3232
#define cmd_showpic         0x12334883


typedef struct
{
    unsigned int mac;        // Device MAC address
    unsigned int rand;       // Random value
    unsigned int indexpts;   // Timestamp / sequence index
    unsigned int cmd;        // Command opcode
} cmd_head_t;

typedef struct
{
    unsigned char buff[1024];
} cmd_data_t;

typedef struct
{
    unsigned short buff[512];
} cmd_u16_t;

// Software-defined mouse data
typedef struct
{
    int button;
    int x;
    int y;
    int wheel;
    int point[10];
} soft_mouse_t;

// Software-defined keyboard data
typedef struct
{
    char ctrl;
    char resvel;
    char button[10];
} soft_keyboard_t;

// Client data packet (header + payload union)
typedef struct
{
    cmd_head_t head;
    union {
        cmd_data_t      u8buff;       // Raw byte buffer
        cmd_u16_t       u16buff;      // U16 buffer
        soft_mouse_t    cmd_mouse;    // Mouse command data
        soft_keyboard_t cmd_keyboard; // Keyboard command data
    };
} client_data;

struct OutputQueuedNetCommand {
    client_data data{};
    int length = 0;
    OutputCommandType type = OutputCommandType::Unknown;
    OutputIntent outputIntent = OutputIntent::Normal;
    OutputCommandPriority priority = OutputCommandPriority::Normal;
    std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion;
    int mouseButtonStateMask = -1;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point enqueuedAt{};
};


#pragma pack(1)
typedef struct {
    unsigned char report_id;
    unsigned char buttons;
    short x;
    short y;
    short wheel;
} standard_mouse_report_t;

typedef struct {
    unsigned char report_id;
    unsigned char buttons;
    unsigned char data[10];
} standard_keyboard_report_t;
#pragma pack()
```

`src/output/devices/kmbox_net/Settings.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

namespace V2::Output::KmBoxNetConfig {

inline constexpr int kMinimumCommandPort = 1;
inline constexpr int kMaximumCommandPort = 65535;

// Public configuration model. Transport and monitor state stay in the backend.
struct Settings {
    char ip[32] = "192.168.2.188";
    int commandPort = 8808;
    int monitorPort = 8809;
    bool manualMonitorPort = false;
    char mac[32] = "12525C53";
};

inline Settings current;

inline int RecommendedMonitorPort(int commandPort) noexcept
{
    if (commandPort >= 1 && commandPort < 65535)
        return commandPort + 1;
    if (commandPort == 65535)
        return commandPort - 1;
    return Settings{}.monitorPort;
}

inline int EffectiveMonitorPort(const Settings& settings) noexcept
{
    const int recommended = RecommendedMonitorPort(settings.commandPort);
    if (!settings.manualMonitorPort || settings.monitorPort < 1 ||
        settings.monitorPort > 65535 || settings.monitorPort == settings.commandPort)
        return recommended;
    return settings.monitorPort;
}

enum class MonitorAdjustment { None, Automatic, InvalidPort, CommandPortCollision };

inline MonitorAdjustment MonitorPortAdjustment(const Settings& settings) noexcept
{
    if (!settings.manualMonitorPort)
        return MonitorAdjustment::Automatic;
    if (settings.monitorPort < 1 || settings.monitorPort > 65535)
        return MonitorAdjustment::InvalidPort;
    if (settings.monitorPort == settings.commandPort)
        return MonitorAdjustment::CommandPortCollision;
    return MonitorAdjustment::None;
}

template<class ReadText, class ReadInteger, class ReadBoolean>
void Load(Settings& settings, ReadText readText, ReadInteger readInteger, ReadBoolean readBoolean)
{
    readText("kmboxIp", settings.ip);
    settings.commandPort = readInteger("kmboxPort", settings.commandPort);
    settings.monitorPort = readInteger("kmboxMonitorPort", RecommendedMonitorPort(settings.commandPort));
    settings.manualMonitorPort = readBoolean("kmboxMonitorPortManualOverride", false);
    readText("kmboxMac", settings.mac);
}

template<class WriteText, class WriteInteger, class WriteBoolean>
void Save(const Settings& settings, WriteText writeText, WriteInteger writeInteger, WriteBoolean writeBoolean)
{
    writeText("kmboxIp", settings.ip);
    writeInteger("kmboxPort", settings.commandPort);
    writeInteger("kmboxMonitorPort", settings.monitorPort);
    writeBoolean("kmboxMonitorPortManualOverride", settings.manualMonitorPort);
    writeText("kmboxMac", settings.mac);
}

}
```

`src/output/devices/kmbox_serial/Session.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "Session.hpp"
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include <setupapi.h>
#include <devguid.h>
#include <algorithm>

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {

std::string FindPort() {
    HDEVINFO devices = SetupDiGetClassDevsA(&GUID_DEVCLASS_PORTS, nullptr, nullptr, DIGCF_PRESENT);
    if (devices == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return {};
    SP_DEVINFO_DATA info{};
    info.cbSize = sizeof(info);
    for (DWORD index = 0; SetupDiEnumDeviceInfo(devices, index, &info); ++index) {
        char name[512];
        DWORD size = 0;
        if (!SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyA(devices, &info, SPDRP_FRIENDLYNAME,
            nullptr, reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>(name), sizeof(name), &size) || size == 0)
            continue;
        name[(std::min)(size, static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(name) - 1))] = '\0';
        const std::string description = name;
        const auto port = description.find("COM");
        const auto end = description.find(')', port);
        const bool likelyKmbox = description.find("USB-SERIAL CH340") != std::string::npos ||
            description.find("KMBOX") != std::string::npos ||
            description.find("KMBox") != std::string::npos ||
            description.find("BPRO") != std::string::npos ||
            description.find("B+") != std::string::npos;
        if (port != std::string::npos && end != std::string::npos && likelyKmbox) {
            SetupDiDestroyDeviceInfoList(devices);
            return description.substr(port, end - port);
        }
    }
    SetupDiDestroyDeviceInfoList(devices);
    return {};
}

}

std::string KmBoxSerialSession::ResolvePort(const std::string& requested) const {
    return requested.empty() ? FindPort() : requested;
}

bool KmBoxSerialSession::EncodeMove(int x, int y, int duration, std::string& command) const {
    command = KmBoxSerialProtocol::Move(x, y, duration);
    return true;
}

std::string KmBoxSerialSession::EncodeButton(int button, bool down) const {
    return KmBoxSerialProtocol::Button(button, down);
}

int KmBoxSerialSession::ButtonDomain(std::string_view command) const {
    return KmTextCommands::ButtonDomain(command);
}

bool KmBoxSerialSession::IsButtonRelease(std::string_view command) const {
    return KmTextCommands::IsButtonRelease(command);
}

int KmBoxSerialSession::FlushInterval(OutputCommandType type) const {
    return KmTextCommands::FlushInterval(type);
}

}
```

`src/output/devices/makcu/Protocol.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <optional>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
namespace V2::Output::MakcuProtocol {
inline constexpr std::string_view PhysicalButtonsRequest{"\xDE\xAD\x00\x00\x55", 5};
inline constexpr std::string_view FirmwareVersionRequest{"\xDE\xAD\x00\x00\x04", 5};
inline constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> ButtonQueries = {
    "km.left()", "km.right()", "km.middle()", "km.side1()", "km.side2()"
};
enum class ButtonDialect { Side, Ms };
inline constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 5> MsButtonQueries = {
    "km.left()", "km.right()", "km.middle()", "km.ms1()", "km.ms2()"
};

inline const auto& Queries(ButtonDialect dialect) {
    return dialect == ButtonDialect::Ms ? MsButtonQueries : ButtonQueries;
}

inline std::string Button(int button, bool down, ButtonDialect dialect) {
    if (button < 0 || button >= int(ButtonQueries.size())) return {};
    const auto query = Queries(dialect)[button];
    return std::string(query.substr(0, query.size() - 1)) + (down ? "1)\r\n" : "0)\r\n");
}

inline std::optional<bool> PhysicalButton(std::string_view response, size_t button,
    ButtonDialect dialect = ButtonDialect::Side) {
    if (button >= ButtonQueries.size()) return std::nullopt;
    constexpr std::string_view whitespace = " \r\n\t";
    const auto trim = [whitespace](std::string_view text) {
        const auto first = text.find_first_not_of(whitespace);
        return first == std::string_view::npos ? std::string_view{} :
            text.substr(first, text.find_last_not_of(whitespace) - first + 1);
    };
    response = trim(response);
    const auto echo = Queries(dialect)[button];
    if (response.starts_with(echo) && response.size() > echo.size() &&
        whitespace.find(response[echo.size()]) != std::string_view::npos)
        response = trim(response.substr(echo.size()));
    if (response.size() != 1 || response.front() < '0' || response.front() > '3')
        return std::nullopt;
    return ((response.front() - '0') & 1) != 0;
}

inline bool HasLegacyPrefixedButtonStream(uint32_t version) {
    return version == 4030 || version == 4031 || version == 4033;
}

inline bool Identity(std::string_view line) {
    return line == "km.MAKCU" || line.starts_with("km.MAKCU_");
}
inline std::string Mask(int button, bool enabled) {
    constexpr const char* names[] = {"left_mask", "right_mask", "middle_mask", "side1_mask", "side2_mask"};
    if (button < 0 || button > 4) return {};
    return std::string("km.") + names[button] + "(" + (enabled ? "1" : "0") + ")\r\n";
}
}
```

`src/output/devices/makcu/Session.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "Session.hpp"
#include "Protocol.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
constexpr uint64_t kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs = 100;
constexpr uint64_t kMakcuButtonPollIntervalMs = 60;
constexpr uint64_t kMakcuTextPollTimeoutMs = 30;
constexpr unsigned kPhysicalButtonsFrame = 1;
constexpr unsigned kFirmwareVersionFrame = 2;
constexpr unsigned kFirmwareRejectedFrame = 3;
}

MakcuSession::MakcuSession()
    : KmTextSession({
        {kPhysicalButtonsFrame, std::string("\xDE\xAD\x01\x00\x55", 5), 1},
        {kFirmwareVersionFrame, std::string("\xDE\xAD\x04\x00\x04", 5), 4},
        {kFirmwareRejectedFrame, std::string("\xDE\xAD\x01\x00\x04", 5), 1}}) {}

void MakcuSession::Reset() {
    KmTextSession::Reset();
    makcuPhysicalReply.reset();
    makcuFirmwareVersion.reset();
    makcuBinaryMonitor = false;
    makcuTextNeedsSync = false;
    makcuBinaryPollStartedMs = 0;
    makcuNextButtonPollMs = 0;
    makcuButtonDialect.store(MakcuProtocol::ButtonDialect::Side);
}

bool MakcuSession::Identity(std::string_view response) const {
    return KmTextCommands::IdentityMatches(response, MakcuProtocol::Identity);
}

bool MakcuSession::OnConnected(SerialChannel& channel) {
    channel.Purge();
    if (!Identity(QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true))) return false;
    const auto route = QueryLocked(channel, "km.device()\r\n");
    const auto begin = route.find("R:");
    const auto end = route.find(';', begin);
    maskReady = begin != std::string::npos;
    keyboardReady = begin != std::string::npos &&
        route.substr(begin, end - begin).find('K') != std::string::npos;
    return ConfigureMakcuMonitorLocked(channel, begin != std::string::npos);
}

void MakcuSession::OnBinaryFrame(const SerialEvent& event) {
    if (event.frameId == kPhysicalButtonsFrame) {
        const auto buttons = static_cast<uint8_t>(event.body[0]);
        if (makcuBinaryMonitor) {
            if (makcuBinaryPollStartedMs != 0 && buttons < 32 &&
                GetTickCount64() - makcuBinaryPollStartedMs <= kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs)
                PublishPhysicalButtons(buttons, makcuBinaryPollStartedMs);
            makcuBinaryPollStartedMs = 0;
        } else {
            makcuPhysicalReply = buttons;
        }
    } else if (event.frameId == kFirmwareVersionFrame) {
        uint32_t version = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < event.body.size(); ++i)
            version |= uint32_t(static_cast<uint8_t>(event.body[i])) << (i * 8);
        makcuFirmwareVersion = version;
    } else if (event.frameId == kFirmwareRejectedFrame) {
        makcuFirmwareVersion = 0;
    }
}

bool MakcuSession::Poll(SerialChannel& channel, bool running) {
    return ReadInputLocked(channel) && (!running || RefreshMakcuButtonsLocked(channel));
}

bool MakcuSession::Heartbeat(SerialChannel& channel, bool suppressed) {
    const bool expiredBinaryPoll = makcuBinaryPollStartedMs != 0 &&
        GetTickCount64() - makcuBinaryPollStartedMs > kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs;
    if (suppressed && !makcuTextNeedsSync && !expiredBinaryPoll) return true;
    if (QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true).empty()) return false;
    makcuTextNeedsSync = false;
    if (expiredBinaryPoll) makcuBinaryPollStartedMs = 0;
    return true;
}

std::string MakcuSession::EncodeMask(int button, bool enabled) const {
    return MakcuProtocol::Mask(button, enabled);
}

std::string MakcuSession::EncodeButton(int button, bool down) const {
    return MakcuProtocol::Button(button, down, makcuButtonDialect.load());
}

int MakcuSession::ButtonDomain(std::string_view command) const {
    const auto& queries = MakcuProtocol::Queries(makcuButtonDialect.load());
    for (size_t button = 0; button < queries.size(); ++button) {
        const auto prefix = queries[button].substr(0, queries[button].size() - 1);
        if (command.starts_with(prefix)) return int(button);
    }
    return -1;
}

bool MakcuSession::IsButtonRelease(std::string_view command) const {
    const auto dialect = makcuButtonDialect.load();
    for (int button = 0; button < 5; ++button)
        if (command == MakcuProtocol::Button(button, false, dialect)) return true;
    return false;
}

bool MakcuSession::ConfigureMakcuMonitorLocked(SerialChannel& channel, bool v4Route)
{
    using namespace V2::Output::MakcuProtocol;
    makcuButtonDialect.store(ButtonDialect::Side);
    // Older firmware can send bare bytes that are ambiguous in the text stream.
    if (!channel.Write("km.buttons(0)\r\n")) return false;
    if (v4Route) {
        if (!channel.Write(PhysicalButtonsRequest)) return false;
        const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs;
        while (GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
            if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, true)) return false;
            if (makcuPhysicalReply) {
                if (*makcuPhysicalReply < 32) {
                    makcuBinaryMonitor = true;
                    PublishPhysicalButtons(*makcuPhysicalReply, GetTickCount64());
                    return channel.Write("km.buttons(1)\r\n");
                }
                break;
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
        }
    }
    if (v4Route) {
        // V4.030/031/033 already support the prefixed stream but lack the binary snapshot.
        if (!channel.Write(FirmwareVersionRequest)) return false;
        const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs;
        while (!makcuFirmwareVersion && GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
            if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, true)) return false;
            if (!makcuFirmwareVersion) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
        }
    }
    if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, true)) return false;
    bool complete = false;
    if (!QueryMakcuTextButtonsLocked(channel, ButtonDialect::Side, complete)) return false;
    if (!complete) {
        // Finish the rejected dialect's replies before sending another untagged sweep.
        if (!Identity(QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true))) return false;
        makcuTextNeedsSync = false;
        if (!QueryMakcuTextButtonsLocked(channel, ButtonDialect::Ms, complete)) return false;
        if (complete) makcuButtonDialect.store(ButtonDialect::Ms);
    }
    return !HasLegacyPrefixedButtonStream(makcuFirmwareVersion.value_or(0)) ||
        channel.Write("km.buttons(1)\r\n");
}

bool MakcuSession::QueryMakcuTextButtonsLocked(SerialChannel& channel,
    MakcuProtocol::ButtonDialect dialect, bool& complete)
{
    using namespace V2::Output::MakcuProtocol;
    complete = false;
    const auto& queries = Queries(dialect);
    std::string commands;
    for (const auto query : queries) {
        commands += query;
        commands += "\r\n";
    }
    responses.clear();
    const auto started = GetTickCount64();
    if (!channel.Write(commands)) return false;
    const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + kMakcuTextPollTimeoutMs;
    size_t button = 0;
    uint8_t buttons = 0;
    bool rejected = false;
    while (!rejected && GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
        if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, true)) return false;
        while (!responses.empty()) {
            const auto body = std::move(responses.front());
            responses.pop_front();
            if (body.find("ERR") != std::string::npos) {
                rejected = true;
                break;
            }
            const auto state = PhysicalButton(body, button, dialect);
            if (!state) continue;
            if (*state) buttons |= uint8_t(1u << button);
            if (++button == queries.size()) {
                std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
                if (physical.sampledAtMs < started) physical = {true, buttons, GetTickCount64()};
                complete = true;
                return true;
            }
        }
        if (!rejected) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }
    // Drain outstanding text replies through the next identity check before retrying.
    makcuTextNeedsSync = true;
    std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
    if (physical.sampledAtMs < started) physical = {};
    return true;
}

bool MakcuSession::RefreshMakcuButtonsLocked(SerialChannel& channel)
{
    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
    if (makcuTextNeedsSync || makcuBinaryPollStartedMs != 0 || now < makcuNextButtonPollMs)
        return true;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
        if (physical.available && now - physical.sampledAtMs < kMakcuButtonPollIntervalMs)
            return true;
    }
    makcuNextButtonPollMs = now + kMakcuButtonPollIntervalMs;
    if (!makcuBinaryMonitor) {
        bool complete = false;
        return QueryMakcuTextButtonsLocked(channel, makcuButtonDialect.load(), complete);
    }
    if (!channel.Write(V2::Output::MakcuProtocol::PhysicalButtonsRequest)) return false;
    makcuBinaryPollStartedMs = now;
    return true;
}


}
```

```cpp
#include "Backend.hpp"

#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"

#include <algorithm>

namespace V2::Output
{
    namespace
    {
        constexpr std::size_t kMaxRecentEvents = 512;

        bool BuildKeyboardState(
            unsigned char modifierMask,
            const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages,
            std::array<bool, 256>& state,
            std::array<unsigned char, 10>& usageSlots)
        {
            state.fill(false);
            usageSlots.fill(0);
            if (usages.size() > usageSlots.size())
                return false;

            for (unsigned int bit = 0; bit < 8; ++bit) {
                if ((modifierMask & (1u << bit)) != 0)
                    state[KEY_LEFTCONTROL + bit] = true;
            }

            std::array<bool, 256> seen{};
            for (std::size_t index = 0; index < usages.size(); ++index) {
                const unsigned char usage = usages[index];
                if (usage < KEY_A || usage >= KEY_LEFTCONTROL || seen[usage])
                    return false;
                seen[usage] = true;
                state[usage] = true;
                usageSlots[index] = usage;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }

    MockHardware MockHardwareMgr;

    MockHardware::~MockHardware()
    {
        (void)Shutdown();
    }

    const char* ToString(MockFaultMode mode)
    {
        switch (mode) {
        case MockFaultMode::None:          return "None";
        case MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout: return "OutputTimeout";
        case MockFaultMode::DropOutput:    return "DropOutput";
        default:                           return "Unknown";
        }
    }

    const char* ToString(MockEventType type)
    {
        switch (type) {
        case MockEventType::Move:            return "move";
        case MockEventType::AutoMove:        return "automove";
        case MockEventType::Button:          return "button";
        case MockEventType::ButtonStateMask: return "button_state_mask";
        case MockEventType::Keyboard:        return "keyboard";
        case MockEventType::MaskMouse:       return "mask_mouse";
        case MockEventType::UnmaskAll:       return "unmask_all";
        default:                             return "unknown";
        }
    }

    int MockHardware::Initialize()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(lifecycleMutex_);
        lifecycleState_.store(LifecycleState::Starting, std::memory_order_release);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        ClearStateLocked(true);
        lifecycleState_.store(LifecycleState::Running, std::memory_order_release);
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-MOCK] initialized.");
        Diagnostics::Aim("output.mock init success");
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(lifecycleMutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == LifecycleState::Stopped)
            return success;

        lifecycleState_.store(LifecycleState::Stopping, std::memory_order_release);
        const int cleanupStatus = ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            ClearStateLocked(false);
        }
        lifecycleState_.store(LifecycleState::Stopped, std::memory_order_release);
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-MOCK] shutdown.");
        return cleanupStatus;
    }

    void MockHardware::Reset()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        const bool keepInitialized = initialized_;
        ClearStateLocked(keepInitialized);
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-MOCK] state reset.");
        Diagnostics::Aim("output.mock reset initialized=%d", keepInitialized ? 1 : 0);
    }

    bool MockHardware::IsInitialized() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return initialized_;
    }

    MockHardware::LifecycleState MockHardware::GetLifecycleState() const
    {
        return lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    }

    void MockHardware::SetFaultMode(MockFaultMode mode)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);

        Diagnostics::Aim("output.mock fault_mode=%s", ToString(mode));

    MockFaultMode MockHardware::GetFaultMode() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return faultMode_;

    int MockHardware::RecordMove(int x, int y, int runtimeMs)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        MockEvent event{};
        event.type = runtimeMs > 0 ? MockEventType::AutoMove : MockEventType::Move;
        event.x = x;
        event.y = y;
        event.runtimeMs = runtimeMs;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            event.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        event.status = success;
        PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::RecordButton(int button, bool down)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        const uint32_t buttonMask = MouseMaskForButton(button);
        if (buttonMask == 0)
            return err_net_cmd;

        const uint32_t next = down
            ? (outputMouseButtons_ | buttonMask)
            : (outputMouseButtons_ & ~buttonMask);
        if (next == outputMouseButtons_)
            return success;

        MockEvent event{};
        event.type = MockEventType::Button;
        event.button = button;
        event.down = down;
        event.stateMask = next;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            event.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        outputMouseButtons_ = next;
        event.status = success;
        PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::SetMouseButtonStateMask(uint32_t stateMask, bool force)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        const uint32_t next = stateMask & 0x7u;
        if (!force && next == outputMouseButtons_)
            return success;

        MockEvent event{};
        event.type = MockEventType::ButtonStateMask;
        event.stateMask = next;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            event.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        outputMouseButtons_ = next;
        event.status = success;
        PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::ForceReleaseMouseButton(int button)
    {
        const uint32_t buttonMask = MouseMaskForButton(button);
        if (buttonMask == 0)
            return err_net_cmd;

        uint32_t next = 0;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
            next = outputMouseButtons_ & ~buttonMask;
        }
        return SetMouseButtonStateMask(next, true);
    }

    int MockHardware::ForceReleaseMouseButtons()
    {
        return SetMouseButtonStateMask(0x00, true);
    }

    int MockHardware::ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        (void)timeout;
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            MockEvent failed{};
            failed.type = MockEventType::ButtonStateMask;
            failed.stateMask = 0;
            failed.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            failed.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(failed);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        MockEvent mouseRelease{};
        mouseRelease.type = MockEventType::ButtonStateMask;
        mouseRelease.stateMask = 0;
        outputMouseButtons_ = 0;
        PushOutputEventLocked(mouseRelease);

        for (std::size_t hidCode = 0; hidCode < hidStates_.size(); ++hidCode) {
            if (!hidStates_[hidCode])
                continue;
            hidStates_[hidCode] = false;
            MockEvent keyRelease{};
            keyRelease.type = MockEventType::Keyboard;
            keyRelease.hidCode = static_cast<unsigned char>(hidCode);
            keyRelease.down = false;
            PushOutputEventLocked(keyRelease);
        }
        keyboardModifierMask_ = 0;
        keyboardUsages_.fill(0);

        MockEvent unmask{};
        unmask.type = MockEventType::UnmaskAll;
        maskedButtons_ = 0;
        PushOutputEventLocked(unmask);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::MaskMouse(uint32_t mask)
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        MockEvent event{};
        event.type = MockEventType::MaskMouse;
        event.mask = mask & 0x7Fu;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            event.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        maskedButtons_ |= event.mask;
        event.status = success;
        PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::UnmaskAll()
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        MockEvent event{};
        event.type = MockEventType::UnmaskAll;

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
            event.attempted = true;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        maskedButtons_ = 0;
        event.status = success;
        PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::RecordKeyboardReport(
        unsigned char modifierMask,
        const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages)
    {
        return RecordKeyboardReport(
            modifierMask,
            usages,
            modifierMask == 0 && usages.empty()
                ? OutputIntent::SafetyRelease
                : OutputIntent::Normal);
    }

    int MockHardware::RecordKeyboardReport(
        unsigned char modifierMask,
        const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages,
        OutputIntent intent)
    {
        std::array<bool, 256> desiredState{};
        std::array<unsigned char, 10> desiredUsages{};
        if (!BuildKeyboardState(
                modifierMask, usages, desiredState, desiredUsages)) {
            return err_net_cmd;
        }

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        if (lifecycleState_.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            return err_queue_stopped;
        if (!initialized_)
            return err_creat_socket;

        if (intent == OutputIntent::SafetyRelease) {
            for (std::size_t index = 0; index < desiredState.size(); ++index) {
                if (desiredState[index] && !hidStates_[index])
                    return err_net_cmd;
            }
        }

        std::vector<MockEvent> changes;
        changes.reserve(hidStates_.size());
        for (std::size_t hidCode = 0; hidCode < hidStates_.size(); ++hidCode) {
            if (hidStates_[hidCode] && !desiredState[hidCode]) {
                MockEvent event{};
                event.type = MockEventType::Keyboard;
                event.hidCode = static_cast<unsigned char>(hidCode);
                event.down = false;
                changes.push_back(event);
            }
        }
        for (std::size_t hidCode = 0; hidCode < hidStates_.size(); ++hidCode) {
            if (!hidStates_[hidCode] && desiredState[hidCode]) {
                MockEvent event{};
                event.type = MockEventType::Keyboard;
                event.hidCode = static_cast<unsigned char>(hidCode);
                event.down = true;
                changes.push_back(event);
            }
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::OutputTimeout) {
            for (MockEvent& event : changes) {
                event.status = err_net_rx_timeout;
                event.attempted = true;
                PushOutputEventLocked(event);
            }
            return err_net_rx_timeout;
        }

        if (faultMode_ == MockFaultMode::DropOutput)
            return success;

        hidStates_ = desiredState;
        keyboardModifierMask_ = modifierMask;
        keyboardUsages_ = desiredUsages;
        for (MockEvent& event : changes) {
            event.status = success;
            PushOutputEventLocked(event);
        }
        return success;
    }

    int MockHardware::RecordKeyboardKey(unsigned char hidCode, bool down)
    {
        const bool isModifier =
            hidCode >= KEY_LEFTCONTROL && hidCode <= KEY_RIGHT_GUI;
        const bool isUsage = hidCode >= KEY_A && hidCode < KEY_LEFTCONTROL;
        if (!isModifier && !isUsage)
            return err_net_cmd;

        if (!down)
            return RecordKeyboardReport(0, {});
        if (isModifier) {
            const auto modifierBit = static_cast<unsigned char>(
                1u << (hidCode - KEY_LEFTCONTROL));
            return RecordKeyboardReport(modifierBit, {});
        }
        return RecordKeyboardReport(0, { hidCode });
    }

    void MockHardware::SetPhysicalMouseButtons(uint32_t buttons) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);physicalButtons_=buttons&0x7fu;
    }
    PhysicalInputSnapshot MockHardware::PhysicalInput() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return {initialized_,physicalButtons_,initialized_?GetTickCount64():0};
    }

    MockHardwareSnapshot MockHardware::Snapshot() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        MockHardwareSnapshot snapshot{};
        snapshot.initialized = initialized_;
        snapshot.faultMode = faultMode_;
        snapshot.outputMouseButtons = outputMouseButtons_;
        snapshot.maskedButtons = maskedButtons_;
        snapshot.outputKeyboardKeys = static_cast<std::size_t>(std::count(
            hidStates_.begin(), hidStates_.end(), true));
        snapshot.outputKeyboardModifierMask = keyboardModifierMask_;
        snapshot.outputKeyboardUsages = keyboardUsages_;
        snapshot.totalEvents = totalEvents_;
        snapshot.moveEvents = moveEvents_;
        snapshot.buttonEvents = buttonEvents_;
        snapshot.keyboardEvents = keyboardEvents_;
        snapshot.maskEvents = maskEvents_;
        snapshot.recentEventCount = events_.size();
        return snapshot;
    }

    std::vector<MockEvent> MockHardware::RecentEvents() const
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return std::vector<MockEvent>(events_.begin(), events_.end());
    }

    uint32_t MockHardware::MouseMaskForButton(int button) const
    {
        switch (button) {
        case 0: return 0x01u;
        case 1: return 0x02u;
        case 2: return 0x04u;
        default: return 0u;
        }
    }

    bool MockHardware::PushOutputEventLocked(MockEvent event)
    {
        event.sequence = ++totalEvents_;
        events_.push_back(event);
        while (events_.size() > kMaxRecentEvents)
            events_.pop_front();

        switch (event.type) {
        case MockEventType::Move:
        case MockEventType::AutoMove:
            ++moveEvents_;
            break;
        case MockEventType::Button:
        case MockEventType::ButtonStateMask:
            ++buttonEvents_;
            break;
        case MockEventType::Keyboard:
            ++keyboardEvents_;
            break;
        case MockEventType::MaskMouse:
        case MockEventType::UnmaskAll:
            ++maskEvents_;
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }

        Diagnostics::Aim("output.mock event seq=%llu type=%s status=%d attempted=%d x=%d y=%d runtimeMs=%d button=%d down=%d stateMask=0x%02X mask=0x%02X hid=0x%02X",
            event.sequence,
            ToString(event.type),
            event.status,
            event.attempted ? 1 : 0,
            event.x,
            event.y,
            event.runtimeMs,
            event.button,
            event.down ? 1 : 0,
            event.stateMask,
            event.mask,
            static_cast<unsigned int>(event.hidCode));
        return true;
    }

    void MockHardware::ClearStateLocked(bool keepInitialized)
    {
        initialized_ = keepInitialized;
        faultMode_ = MockFaultMode::None;
        hidStates_.fill(false);
        keyboardModifierMask_ = 0;
        keyboardUsages_.fill(0);
        outputMouseButtons_ = 0;
        maskedButtons_ = 0;
        physicalButtons_ = 0;
        totalEvents_ = 0;
        moveEvents_ = 0;
        buttonEvents_ = 0;
        keyboardEvents_ = 0;
        maskEvents_ = 0;
        events_.clear();
    }
}
```

```cpp
namespace V2::Output {

class SimulatedDevice final : public IOutputDevice {
public:
    int Initialize(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) override {
        if (!std::holds_alternative<std::monostate>(descriptor.endpoint)) return err_net_cmd;
        (void)EnsureTimerResolution();
        return MockHardwareMgr.Initialize();
    }
    int ReleaseAll(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) override { return MockHardwareMgr.ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout); }
    int Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) override { return MockHardwareMgr.Shutdown(timeout); }
    OutputConnectionState ConnectionState() const override {
        return MockHardwareMgr.IsInitialized() ? OutputConnectionState::Connected : OutputConnectionState::Disconnected;
    }
    OutputDeviceCapabilities Capabilities() const override {
        OutputDeviceCapabilities value;
        value.keyboard = value.mouseMask = value.timedMove = true;
        return value;
    }
    PhysicalInputSnapshot PhysicalInput() override { return MockHardwareMgr.PhysicalInput(); }
    int Move(int x, int y, int duration) override { return MockHardwareMgr.RecordMove(x, y, duration); }
    int Button(int button, bool down, bool force) override {
        return force && !down ? MockHardwareMgr.ForceReleaseMouseButton(button) : MockHardwareMgr.RecordButton(button, down);
    }
    int ButtonState(std::uint32_t mask, bool force) override { return MockHardwareMgr.SetMouseButtonStateMask(mask, force); }
    int ReleaseButtons() override { return MockHardwareMgr.ForceReleaseMouseButtons(); }
    int Keyboard(unsigned char modifiers, const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages, OutputIntent intent) override {
        return MockHardwareMgr.RecordKeyboardReport(modifiers, usages, intent);
    }
    int Mask(std::uint32_t mask, std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion) override {
        const int status = mask ? MockHardwareMgr.MaskMouse(mask) : MockHardwareMgr.UnmaskAll();
        if (completion) {
            std::lock_guard lock(completion->mutex);
            completion->status = status;
            completion->completed = true;
            completion->cv.notify_all();
        }
        return status;
    }
    int RecoverMaskTimeout(const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>&,
        std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& cleanup) override {
        cleanup.reset();
        return MockHardwareMgr.UnmaskAll();
    }
};
}

    static SimulatedDevice device;
    return device;
}
```

```cpp
#include "output/GameMemoryActions.hpp"
#include "MemoryPulse.hpp"
#include "Game/Entity.hpp"
#include "Game/Offsets.hpp"
#include "Game/RuntimeState.hpp"
#include "Game/SDK.hpp"
#include "Game/snapshots/SnapshotAccess.hpp"
#include "Utils/ProcessConnection.hpp"
#include <mutex>

namespace V2::Output::GameActions {
namespace {

bool SameBodyIdentity(const OW::c_entity& left, const OW::c_entity& right)
{
    return left.address == right.address && left.HeroID == right.HeroID &&
        left.actor_generation == right.actor_generation &&
        left.connection_epoch == right.connection_epoch &&
        left.scene_generation == right.scene_generation &&
        left.body_absence_revision == right.body_absence_revision;
}

bool SupportedProfile(OW::offset::RuntimeProfile profile)
{
    return profile == OW::offset::RuntimeProfile::Cn ||
        profile == OW::offset::RuntimeProfile::World155284 ||
        profile == OW::offset::RuntimeProfile::Nexon155284;
}

struct PulseSession {
    MemoryPulse pulse;
    OW::c_entity body;
    int pid = 0;
    OW::offset::RuntimeProfile profile = OW::offset::kProductRuntimeProfile;

    bool TargetCurrent() const
    {
        if (!OW::SDK || !OW::SDK->IsInitialized() || !mem.IsProcessInitialized() || pid <= 0 ||
            mem.GetCurrentProcessId() != pid || !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() ||
            OW::offset::ActiveProfile() != profile ||
            OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() != body.connection_epoch ||
            OW::SDK->g_player_controller.load() != body.AngleBase)
            return false;

        const auto local = OW::SnapshotFrame()->local;
        return local.AngleBase == body.AngleBase && local.LinkParent == body.LinkParent &&
            local.match_id == body.match_id &&
            local.body_authority_revision == body.body_authority_revision &&
            SameBodyIdentity(local, body) &&
            local.HasUsableBody(GetTickCount(), OW::EntitySceneGeneration());
    }

    bool Start(const OW::c_entity& local, uint32_t mask, uint64_t holdMs, bool dryRun)
    {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
        return false;
#else
        const auto activeProfile = OW::offset::ActiveProfile();
        if (!mask || dryRun || !local.AngleBase || pulse.owned || !SupportedProfile(activeProfile))
            return false;

        body = local;
        pid = mem.GetCurrentProcessId();
        profile = activeProfile;
        return pulse.Start(local.AngleBase + kActionOffset, GetTickCount64(),
            [](uint64_t address, void* value, size_t bytes) {
                return mem.ReadFreshExact(address, value, bytes);
            },
            [this](uint64_t address, const void* value, size_t bytes) {
                return mem.Write(address, value, bytes, pid);
            },
            [this] { return TargetCurrent(); }, mask, holdMs);
#endif
    }

    bool Update(bool keepHolding)
    {
        return pulse.Update(GetTickCount64(), keepHolding,
            [](uint64_t address, void* value, size_t bytes) {
                return mem.ReadFreshExact(address, value, bytes);
            },
            [this](uint64_t address, const void* value, size_t bytes) {
                return mem.Write(address, value, bytes, pid);
            },
            [this] { return TargetCurrent(); });
    }
};

// The two producers retain independent ownership and release deadlines.
std::mutex stateMutex;
PulseSession melee;
PulseSession skill;

}

uint32_t ActionMask(Action action) noexcept
{
    switch (action) {
    case Action::Ability1: return 0x8;
    case Action::Ability2: return 0x10;
    case Action::Ability3: return 0x40; // Candidate from the legacy action-word layout.
    case Action::Ultimate: return 0x20;
    case Action::Melee: return kActionMask;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

bool StartMelee(const OW::c_entity& local, bool dryRun)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    return melee.Start(local, kActionMask, kHoldMs, dryRun);
}

PulseUpdate UpdateMelee(bool keepHolding)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    const bool wasOwned = melee.pulse.owned;
    const bool ok = melee.Update(keepHolding);
    return {ok, wasOwned, melee.pulse.owned};
}

bool MeleeOwned()
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    return melee.pulse.owned;
}

bool StartSkill(const OW::c_entity& local, uint32_t mask, uint64_t holdMs, bool dryRun)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    return skill.Start(local, mask, holdMs, dryRun);
}

bool UpdateSkill(bool keepHolding)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    return skill.Update(keepHolding);
}

#ifdef UNLEASHED_SELF_TESTS
void Testing::SeedRetiredMeleePulse(uint64_t nowMs)
{
    std::lock_guard lock(stateMutex);
    melee = {};
    melee.pulse.address = 0x10000;
    melee.pulse.startedMs = nowMs;
    melee.pulse.owned = true;
}
#endif

}
```

`src/output/game_actions/MemoryPulse.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace V2::Output::GameActions {
// All three 155284 dumps use this input word; Pure 1106 confirms the melee bit.
// Evidence: 03_DOWNP/auto-melee-input-155284-20261111/static-evidence.json.
inline constexpr uint64_t kActionOffset = 0x121C;
inline constexpr uint32_t kActionMask = 0x800;
inline constexpr uint64_t kHoldMs = 50;

struct MemoryPulse {
    uint64_t address = 0;
    uint64_t startedMs = 0;
    uint64_t holdMs = kHoldMs;
    uint32_t mask = kActionMask;
    bool owned = false;
    bool releasing = false;

    template<class Read, class Write, class Current>
    bool Start(uint64_t destination, uint64_t now, Read read, Write write, Current current,
               uint32_t requestedMask = kActionMask, uint64_t requestedHoldMs = kHoldMs)
    {
        if (owned || !destination || !current())
            return false;
        uint32_t value = 0;
        if (!read(destination, &value, sizeof(value)) || !current() || (value & requestedMask))
            return false;
        address = destination;
        startedMs = now;
        holdMs = requestedHoldMs;
        mask = requestedMask;
        owned = true;
        value |= mask;
        // A failed transport can be partial; retain release-only cleanup until checked.
        releasing = !write(address, &value, sizeof(value));
        return !releasing;
    }

    template<class Read, class Write, class Current>
    bool Update(uint64_t now, bool keepHolding, Read read, Write write, Current current)
    {
        if (!owned)
            return true;
        if (!current()) {
            *this = {};
            return false;
        }
        releasing = releasing || !keepHolding || now - startedMs >= holdMs;
        uint32_t value = 0;
        if (!read(address, &value, sizeof(value))) {
            releasing = true;
            return false;
        }
        if (!current()) {
            *this = {};
            return false;
        }
        const uint32_t next = releasing ? value & ~mask : value | mask;
        if (next != value && !write(address, &next, sizeof(next))) {
            releasing = true;
            return false;
        }
        if (releasing)
            *this = {};
        return true;
    }
};

}
```

`src/output/platform/NetworkMaintenance.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "NetworkMaintenance.hpp"
#include <Windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Output::Platform {
namespace {
    std::string Win32ErrorMessage(const char* prefix, DWORD error)
    {
        char buffer[96]{};
        std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "%s (error %lu)", prefix, static_cast<unsigned long>(error));
        return buffer;
    }

    std::wstring PowerShellSingleQuoted(const char* text)
    {
        std::wstring quoted = L"'";
        if (text != nullptr) {
            for (const char* current = text; *current != '\0'; ++current) {
                if (*current == '\'')
                    quoted += L"''";
                else
                    quoted += static_cast<unsigned char>(*current);
            }
        }
        quoted += L"'";
        return quoted;
    }

    std::wstring PowerShellSingleQuoted(const std::wstring& text)
    {
        std::wstring quoted = L"'";
        for (const wchar_t ch : text) {
            if (ch == L'\'')
                quoted += L"''";
            else
                quoted += ch;
        }
        quoted += L"'";
        return quoted;
    }

    std::wstring CurrentExecutablePath()
    {
        std::array<wchar_t, MAX_PATH> stackBuffer{};
        DWORD length = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, stackBuffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(stackBuffer.size()));
        if (length == 0)
            return {};

        if (length < static_cast<DWORD>(stackBuffer.size()))
            return std::wstring(stackBuffer.data(), length);

        std::vector<wchar_t> dynamicBuffer(32768);
        length = GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, dynamicBuffer.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(dynamicBuffer.size()));
        if (length == 0 || length >= static_cast<DWORD>(dynamicBuffer.size()))
            return {};

        return std::wstring(dynamicBuffer.data(), length);
    }

}

MaintenanceResult AllowInboundUdpForCurrentExecutable(int monitorPort, const std::wstring& ruleName) {
        if (monitorPort <= 0 || monitorPort > 65535)
            return { false, "Invalid monitor port" };

        const std::wstring executablePath = CurrentExecutablePath();
        if (executablePath.empty())
            return { false, "EXE path unavailable" };

        const std::wstring exe = PowerShellSingleQuoted(executablePath);
        const std::wstring displayName =
            PowerShellSingleQuoted(ruleName);
        const std::wstring command =
            L"-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
            L"\"$exe = " + exe + L"; "
            L"$port = " + std::to_wstring(monitorPort) + L"; "
            L"$portText = [string]$port; "
            L"$name = " + displayName + L"; "
            L"$blocks = Get-NetFirewallRule -Direction Inbound -Action Block -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | "
            L"Where-Object { "
            L"try { "
            L"$app = Get-NetFirewallApplicationFilter -AssociatedNetFirewallRule $_ -ErrorAction Stop; "
            L"$pf = Get-NetFirewallPortFilter -AssociatedNetFirewallRule $_ -ErrorAction Stop; "
            L"($app.Program -eq $exe) -and "
            L"(($pf.Protocol -eq 'UDP') -or ($pf.Protocol -eq 'Any')) -and "
            L"((@($pf.LocalPort) -contains $portText) -or (@($pf.LocalPort) -contains 'Any')) "
            L"} catch { $false } "
            L"}; "
            L"$blocks | Disable-NetFirewallRule -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "
            L"Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | "
            L"Remove-NetFirewallRule -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "
            L"New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName $name -Direction Inbound -Action Allow "
            L"-Program $exe -Protocol UDP -LocalPort $port -Profile Any -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null\"";

        HINSTANCE result = ShellExecuteW(
            nullptr,
            L"runas",
            L"powershell.exe",
            command.c_str(),
            nullptr,
            SW_HIDE);

        const auto resultCode = reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(result);
        if (resultCode <= 32)
            return { false, Win32ErrorMessage("Firewall launch failed", static_cast<DWORD>(resultCode)) };

        return { true, "Firewall rule requested" };
    }

MaintenanceResult RestartAdapterForTargetIp(const char* ip, const char* fallbackDescription) {
        const std::wstring targetIp = PowerShellSingleQuoted(ip);
        const std::wstring fallback = PowerShellSingleQuoted(fallbackDescription);
        const std::wstring command =
            L"-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
            L"\"$target = " + targetIp + L"; "
            L"$adapter = $null; "
            L"try { "
            L"$route = Find-NetRoute -RemoteIPAddress $target -ErrorAction Stop | "
            L"Sort-Object RouteMetric,InterfaceMetric | Select-Object -First 1; "
            L"if ($route) { $adapter = Get-NetAdapter -InterfaceIndex $route.InterfaceIndex -ErrorAction Stop; } "
            L"} catch {} "
            L"if (-not $adapter) { "
            L"$adapter = Get-NetAdapter -InterfaceDescription " + fallback + L" -ErrorAction Stop | "
            L"Select-Object -First 1; "
            L"} "
            L"Restart-NetAdapter -Name $adapter.Name -Confirm:$false\"";

        HINSTANCE result = ShellExecuteW(
            nullptr,
            L"runas",
            L"powershell.exe",
            command.c_str(),
            nullptr,
            SW_HIDE);

        const auto resultCode = reinterpret_cast<intptr_t>(result);
        if (resultCode <= 32)
            return { false, Win32ErrorMessage("Restart launch failed", static_cast<DWORD>(resultCode)) };

        return { true, "NIC restart requested" };
    }

}
```

`src/output/protocols/KmTextCommands.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "output/OutputTypes.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace V2::Output::KmTextCommands {

inline std::string Move(int x, int y, int duration = 0) {
    return "km.move(" + std::to_string(x) + "," + std::to_string(y) +
        (duration > 0 ? "," + std::to_string(duration) : "") + ")\r\n";
}

inline std::string Button(int button, bool down) {
    constexpr const char* names[] = {"left", "right", "middle", "side1", "side2"};
    if (button < 0 || button > 4) return {};
    return std::string("km.") + names[button] + "(" + (down ? "1" : "0") + ")\r\n";
}

inline std::string Key(unsigned usage, bool down) {
    return std::string(down ? "km.down(" : "km.up(") + std::to_string(usage) + ")\r\n";
}

inline int ButtonDomain(std::string_view command) {
    if (command.starts_with("km.left(")) return 0;
    if (command.starts_with("km.right(")) return 1;
    if (command.starts_with("km.middle(")) return 2;
    if (command.starts_with("km.side1(")) return 3;
    if (command.starts_with("km.side2(")) return 4;
    return -1;
}

inline bool IsButtonRelease(std::string_view command) {
    return command == "km.left(0)\r\n" || command == "km.right(0)\r\n" ||
        command == "km.middle(0)\r\n" || command == "km.side1(0)\r\n" ||
        command == "km.side2(0)\r\n";
}

inline int FlushInterval(OutputCommandType type) {
    return type == OutputCommandType::MouseButton
        ? OutputQueueConfig::MouseButtonFlushIntervalMs
        : OutputQueueConfig::CommandFlushIntervalMs;
}

template<class Identity>
bool IdentityMatches(std::string_view response, Identity identity) {
    while (!response.empty()) {
        const auto end = response.find_first_of("\r\n");
        auto line = response.substr(0, end);
        while (!line.empty() && line.front() == ' ') line.remove_prefix(1);
        while (!line.empty() && line.back() == ' ') line.remove_suffix(1);
        if (identity(line)) return true;
        if (end == std::string_view::npos) break;
        response.remove_prefix(end + 1);
    }
    return false;
}

}
```

`src/output/protocols/KmTextSession.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "KmTextSession.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>

namespace V2::Output {

void KmTextSession::Reset() {
    parser.Reset();
    responses.clear();
    keyboardReady = false;
    maskReady = false;
    ClearPhysicalInput();
}

bool KmTextSession::ReadInputLocked(SerialChannel& channel, bool allowDeviceError) {
    std::string bytes;
    if (!channel.Read(bytes)) return false;
    for (auto& event : parser.Feed(bytes)) {
        if (event.kind == SerialEvent::Kind::Fault) return false;
        if (event.kind == SerialEvent::Kind::Buttons) {
            PublishPhysicalButtons(event.buttons, GetTickCount64());
        } else if (event.kind == SerialEvent::Kind::BinaryFrame) {
            OnBinaryFrame(event);
        } else {
            if (!allowDeviceError && event.body.find("ERR") != std::string::npos)
                return false;
            if (responses.size() >= 32) responses.pop_front();
            responses.push_back(std::move(event.body));
        }
    }
    return true;
}

std::string KmTextSession::QueryLocked(SerialChannel& channel,
    const std::string& command, bool expectIdentity) {
    const bool drainTextPoll = expectIdentity && DrainTextPollForIdentity();
    if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, drainTextPoll)) return {};
    responses.clear();
    if (!channel.Write(command)) return {};
    const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + 500;
    while (GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
        if (!ReadInputLocked(channel, drainTextPoll)) return {};
        while (!responses.empty()) {
            auto body = std::move(responses.front());
            responses.pop_front();
            auto echo = command;
            while (!echo.empty() && (echo.back() == '\r' || echo.back() == '\n'))
                echo.pop_back();
            if (body == echo || body == echo + "\r\n") continue;
            if (expectIdentity && !Identity(body)) continue;
            return body;
        }
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    }
    return {};
}

void KmTextSession::PublishPhysicalButtons(uint8_t buttons, uint64_t sampledAtMs) {
    std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
    physical = {true, buttons, sampledAtMs};
}

PhysicalInputSnapshot KmTextSession::PhysicalInput() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
    return physical;
}

void KmTextSession::ClearPhysicalInput() {
    std::lock_guard lock(snapshotMutex);
    physical = {};
}

bool KmTextSession::AfterWrite(SerialChannel& channel) {
    return ReadInputLocked(channel);
}

bool KmTextSession::Poll(SerialChannel& channel, bool) {
    return ReadInputLocked(channel);
}

bool KmTextSession::Heartbeat(SerialChannel& channel, bool suppressed) {
    return suppressed || !QueryLocked(channel, "km.version()\r\n", true).empty();
}

bool KmTextSession::EncodeMove(int x, int y, int duration, std::string& command) const {
    if (duration > 0 || x < -32768 || x > 32767 || y < -32768 || y > 32767)
        return false;
    command = KmTextCommands::Move(x, y);
    return true;
}

std::string KmTextSession::EncodeButton(int button, bool down) const {
    return KmTextCommands::Button(button, down);
}

std::string KmTextSession::EncodeKey(unsigned usage, bool down) const {
    return KmTextCommands::Key(usage, down);
}

int KmTextSession::ButtonDomain(std::string_view command) const {
    return KmTextCommands::ButtonDomain(command);
}

bool KmTextSession::IsButtonRelease(std::string_view command) const {
    return KmTextCommands::IsButtonRelease(command);
}

int KmTextSession::FlushInterval(OutputCommandType type) const {
    return KmTextCommands::FlushInterval(type);
}

}
```

`src/output/protocols/KmTextStreamParser.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Output {

struct SerialEvent {
    enum class Kind { Response, Buttons, BinaryFrame, Fault } kind;
    std::string body;
    uint8_t buttons = 0;
    unsigned frameId = 0;
};

struct SerialBinaryFrame {
    unsigned id;
    std::string header;
    size_t payloadSize;
};

// Shared prompt/button framing. Devices register their own binary envelopes.
// A button bitmap may itself contain NUL, CR or LF.
class KmTextStreamParser {
    std::string pending_;
    std::vector<SerialBinaryFrame> binaryFrames_;
public:
    explicit KmTextStreamParser(std::vector<SerialBinaryFrame> binaryFrames = {})
        : binaryFrames_(std::move(binaryFrames)) {}

    void Reset() { pending_.clear(); }

    std::vector<SerialEvent> Feed(std::string_view bytes) {
        std::vector<SerialEvent> events;
        pending_.append(bytes);
        if (pending_.size() > 8192) {
            Reset();
            events.push_back({SerialEvent::Kind::Fault});
            return events;
        }
        for (;;) {
            size_t binary = std::string::npos;
            const SerialBinaryFrame* frame = nullptr;
            for (const auto& candidate : binaryFrames_) {
                const auto at = pending_.find(candidate.header);
                if (at < binary) {
                    binary = at;
                    frame = &candidate;
                }
            }
            bool extracted = false;
            for (size_t at = pending_.find("km."); at < binary;
                 at = pending_.find("km.", at + 3)) {
                if (at + 4 > pending_.size()) break;
                const auto mask = static_cast<uint8_t>(pending_[at + 3]);
                if (mask >= 32) continue;
                if (at + 6 > pending_.size()) return events;
                if (pending_.compare(at + 4, 2, "\r\n") != 0) {
                    Reset();
                    events.push_back({SerialEvent::Kind::Fault});
                    return events;
                }
                events.push_back({SerialEvent::Kind::Buttons, {}, mask});
                pending_.erase(at, 6);
                extracted = true;
                break;
            }
            if (extracted) continue;
            if (frame) {
                const auto payload = binary + frame->header.size();
                if (payload + frame->payloadSize > pending_.size()) break;
                events.push_back({SerialEvent::Kind::BinaryFrame,
                    pending_.substr(payload, frame->payloadSize), 0, frame->id});
                pending_.erase(binary, frame->header.size() + frame->payloadSize);
                continue;
            }
            const auto prompt = pending_.find(">>> ");
            if (prompt == std::string::npos) break;
            auto body = pending_.substr(0, prompt);
            pending_.erase(0, prompt + 4);
            if (body.find_first_not_of("\r\n ") != std::string::npos)
                events.push_back({SerialEvent::Kind::Response, std::move(body)});
        }
        return events;
    }
};

}
```

```cpp
IOutputDevice* ResolveOutputDevice(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
    switch (descriptor.backend) {
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Network: return &KmBoxNetDevice();
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Mock: return &MockDevice();
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::CatBox: return &CatBoxDevice();
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::DhzBox: return &DhzBoxDevice();
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Serial: {
        const auto* endpoint = std::get_if<OutputSerialEndpoint>(&descriptor.endpoint);
        if (!endpoint) return nullptr;
        switch (endpoint->protocol) {
        case SerialProtocol::KmBox: return &KmBoxSerialDevice();
        case SerialProtocol::Makcu: return &MakcuDevice();
        case SerialProtocol::Ferrum: return &FerrumDevice();
        }
        return nullptr;
    }
    default: return nullptr;
    }
}
const char* OutputTransportTag(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
    switch (descriptor.backend) {
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Network: return "network";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Serial: return "serial";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::CatBox: return "catbox";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::DhzBox: return "dhzbox";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Mock: return "mock";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::None: return "none";
    default: return "unknown";
    }
}
const char* OutputDeviceName(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
    switch (descriptor.backend) {
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Network: return "KMBox Net";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Mock: return "Mock / 离线";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::CatBox: return "CatBox / 社区协议 / 实机待验证";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::DhzBox: return "DHZ Box / Caesar UDP / 实机待验证";
    case OutputRuntimeBackend::Serial: {
        const auto* endpoint = std::get_if<OutputSerialEndpoint>(&descriptor.endpoint);
        if (!endpoint) return "KMBox Serial";
        switch (endpoint->protocol) {
        case SerialProtocol::KmBox: return "KMBox Serial";
        case SerialProtocol::Makcu: return "MAKCU / 实机待验证";
        case SerialProtocol::Ferrum: return "Ferrum Software API / 实机待验证";
        }
        return "关闭";
    }
    default: return "关闭";
    }
}
```
