`src/output/settings/AutomaticDeviceSelection.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "output/AutomaticDeviceSelection.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <atomic>
#include <future>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
struct Configuration {
    bool enabled = false;
    bool automatic = false;
    int deviceId = 0;
    DeviceDiscoveryRequest request;
    std::string key;
};

bool Supported(int id) {
    return id == int(DeviceId::KmBoxNet) || id == int(DeviceId::Makcu4M) ||
        id == int(DeviceId::Makcu115200) || id == int(DeviceId::Ferrum);
}

Configuration ReadConfigurationUnlocked() {
    OW::Config::SynchronizeOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked();
    Configuration value;
    value.enabled = OW::Config::outputEnabled;
    value.deviceId = OW::Config::outputDeviceType;
    value.automatic = OW::Config::outputAutoDetect && Supported(value.deviceId);
    auto& request = value.request;
    request.preferredId = static_cast<DeviceId>(value.deviceId);
    const auto makcu = OW::Config::GetOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked(int(DeviceId::Makcu115200));
    const auto ferrum = OW::Config::GetOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked(int(DeviceId::Ferrum));
    request.makcu = {makcu.port, makcu.instanceId,
        makcu.preferredDeviceId == int(DeviceId::Makcu4M) ? 4000000u : 115200u};
    request.ferrum = {ferrum.port, ferrum.instanceId, 115200};
    request.network = {OW::Config::outputIp,
        OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(OW::Config::outputPort)
            ? static_cast<uint16_t>(OW::Config::outputPort) : uint16_t{0},
        OW::Config::outputMac};
    // Length prefixes avoid collisions from arbitrary saved instance IDs.
    const auto append = [&](const std::string& part) {
        value.key += std::to_string(part.size()) + ":" + part;
    };
    append(std::to_string(value.enabled)); append(std::to_string(value.automatic));
    append(std::to_string(value.deviceId));
    append(request.makcu.port); append(request.makcu.instanceId);
    append(std::to_string(request.makcu.baud));
    append(request.ferrum.port); append(request.ferrum.instanceId);
    append(request.network.ip); append(std::to_string(request.network.commandPort));
    append(request.network.mac); append(std::to_string(OW::Config::EffectiveOutputMonitorPort()));
    return value;
}

Configuration ReadConfiguration() {
    std::lock_guard lock(OW::Config::mutex);
    return ReadConfigurationUnlocked();
}

struct DiscoveryResult {
    std::string key;
    std::vector<DeviceDiscoveryCandidate> candidates;
};
struct SelectionState {
    std::mutex mutex;
    bool started = false;
    uint64_t nextScanMs = 0;
    std::string appliedKey;
    std::string requestedKey;
    std::shared_ptr<std::atomic<bool>> cancel;
    std::future<DiscoveryResult> pending;
    AutomaticDeviceStatus status;
};
SelectionState& State() { static SelectionState state; return state; }
void CancelPending(SelectionState& state) {
    if (state.cancel) state.cancel->store(true);
}
}

int ApplyOutputConfiguration(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout, bool forceRescan) {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    return ReconcileRuntimeFromConfig(timeout);
#else
    const auto config = ReadConfiguration();
    auto& state = State();
    std::lock_guard guard(state.mutex);
    if (!forceRescan && state.started && config.enabled && config.automatic) {
        if (state.appliedKey == config.key && IsRuntimeOutputGateOpen()) return success;
        if (state.pending.valid() && state.requestedKey == config.key &&
            state.cancel && !state.cancel->load()) return success;
    }
    state.started = true;
    CancelPending(state);
    state.nextScanMs = 0;
    state.appliedKey.clear();
    if (config.enabled && config.automatic) {
        state.status = {false, false, "Waiting to identify a connected device", {}};
        // Release the current owner before a temporary identification channel opens.
        return ShutdownActiveRuntime(timeout);
    }
    if (state.pending.valid()) {
        try { (void)state.pending.get(); } catch (...) {}
    }
    state.status = {false, false, config.enabled ? "Manual device selection" : "Output disabled", {}};
    return ReconcileRuntimeFromConfig(timeout);
#endif
}

void PollAutomaticDeviceSelection() {
#ifndef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    auto& state = State();
    std::lock_guard guard(state.mutex);
    if (!state.started) return;
    const auto config = ReadConfiguration();
    if (!config.enabled || !config.automatic) {
        CancelPending(state);
        state.status.scanning = false;
        // A finished cancelled future must be consumed before a later scan.
        if (state.pending.valid() && state.pending.wait_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(0)) == std::future_status::ready) {
            try { (void)state.pending.get(); } catch (...) {}
        }
        return;
    }
    if (state.pending.valid()) {
        if (state.pending.wait_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(0)) != std::future_status::ready) return;
        DiscoveryResult result;
        try { result = state.pending.get(); }
        catch (const std::exception& error) {
            state.status = {false, false, std::string("Device detection failed: ") + error.what(), {}};
            state.nextScanMs = GetTickCount64() + 3000;
            return;
        }
        state.status.scanning = false;
        if (!state.cancel || state.cancel->load() || result.key != config.key) {
            state.nextScanMs = 0;
            return;
        }
        state.status.candidates = result.candidates;
        const auto choice = SelectDiscoveredDevice(result.candidates, config.request.preferredId);
        state.status.ambiguous = choice.ambiguous;
        state.nextScanMs = GetTickCount64() + 3000;
        if (!choice.index) {
            state.status.message = choice.ambiguous
                ? "Multiple devices are available; select the preferred device below"
                : "No ready device found; saved settings are kept";
            return;
        }
        const auto& selected = result.candidates[*choice.index];
        {
            std::lock_guard configGuard(OW::Config::mutex);
            if (ReadConfigurationUnlocked().key != result.key) return;
            auto profile = OW::Config::GetOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked(int(selected.id));
            if (!selected.port.empty()) {
                profile.port = selected.port;
                profile.instanceId = selected.instanceId;
            }
            profile.preferredDeviceId = int(selected.id);
            if (!OW::Config::SetOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked(int(selected.id), profile)) {
                state.status.message = "The identified device could not connect; retrying";
                return;
            }
            OW::Config::SelectOutputDeviceProfileUnlocked(int(selected.id));
        }
        const int status = ReconcileRuntimeFromConfig(std::chrono::milliseconds(500));
        if (status == success && IsRuntimeOutputGateOpen()) {
            state.appliedKey = ReadConfiguration().key;
            state.status.message = "The connected device is using its saved settings";
            Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-AUTO] selected id=%d port=%s baud=%u; restored saved device settings",
                int(selected.id), selected.port.c_str(), selected.baud);
        } else {
            OW::Config::SelectOutputDeviceProfile(config.deviceId);
            state.status.message = "The identified device could not connect; retrying";
            Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT-AUTO] identified device initialization failed id=%d status=%d", int(selected.id), status);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ActiveRuntimeConnectionState() == OutputConnectionState::Connected && state.appliedKey == config.key)
        return;
    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
    if (now < state.nextScanMs) return;
    // A disconnected serial worker can still own the COM handle while retrying.
    // Shut it down before probing, with the existing release/cancel transaction.
    if (ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor.backend != OutputRuntimeBackend::None) {
        const int status = ShutdownActiveRuntime(std::chrono::milliseconds(500));
        if (status != success) {
            state.status.message = "Waiting for the previous device to finish disconnecting";
            state.nextScanMs = now + 1000;
            return;
        }
    }
    state.cancel = std::make_shared<std::atomic<bool>>(false);
    auto request = config.request;
    request.cancelled = [cancel = state.cancel] { return cancel->load(); };
    state.status = {true, false, "Identifying connected devices", {}};
    state.requestedKey = config.key;
    state.pending = std::async(std::launch::async, [request, key = config.key] {
        return DiscoveryResult{key, DiscoverDevices(request)};
    });
#endif
}

void StopAutomaticDeviceSelection() {
    auto& state = State();
    std::lock_guard guard(state.mutex);
    state.started = false;
    CancelPending(state);
    if (state.pending.valid()) {
        try { (void)state.pending.get(); } catch (...) {}
    }
    state.status.scanning = false;
}

AutomaticDeviceStatus GetAutomaticDeviceStatus() {
    auto& state = State();
    std::lock_guard guard(state.mutex);
    return state.status;
}
}
```

`src/output/settings/DeviceConnection.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "output/DeviceConnection.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "output/AutomaticDeviceSelection.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
namespace V2::Output {
int InitializeOutputFromConfig()
{
#ifdef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    Diagnostics::Info("Observation build: physical output is disabled.");
    return 0;
#endif
    constexpr auto timeout = std::chrono::milliseconds(500);
    const int status = V2::Output::ApplyOutputConfiguration(timeout);
    const V2::Output::OutputRuntimeAppliedState applied = V2::Output::RuntimeController().Applied();
    if (OW::Config::outputEnabled && OW::Config::outputAutoDetect &&
        (OW::Config::outputDeviceType == 0 || OW::Config::outputDeviceType == 3 ||
         OW::Config::outputDeviceType == 4 || OW::Config::outputDeviceType == 5)) {
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-AUTO] device identification scheduled");
        return status;
    }

    if (!OW::Config::outputEnabled) {
        std::printf("[OUTPUT] Disabled by config; runtime is stopped.\n");
        Diagnostics::Info("Output disabled by config; runtime reconciled to None.");
        Diagnostics::Aim("output.init reconciled disabled status=%d generation=%llu",
            status,
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(applied.generation));
        return status;
    }

    if (status == success && applied.descriptor.backend != V2::Output::OutputRuntimeBackend::None) {
        std::printf("[OUTPUT] Runtime ready. backend=%d generation=%llu\n",
            static_cast<int>(applied.descriptor.backend),
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(applied.generation));
        Diagnostics::Info("Output runtime ready. backend=%d generation=%llu",
            static_cast<int>(applied.descriptor.backend),
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(applied.generation));
        Diagnostics::Aim("output.init reconciled success backend=%d generation=%llu",
            static_cast<int>(applied.descriptor.backend),
            static_cast<unsigned long long>(applied.generation));
        return success;
    }

    std::printf("[OUTPUT] Runtime initialisation failed. status=%d\n", status);
    Diagnostics::Error("Output runtime initialisation failed. status=%d", status);
    Diagnostics::Aim("output.init reconciled failure status=%d", status);
    return status != success ? status : err_queue_stopped;
}

int ReleaseOutputMouseStateForShutdown(
    const char* reason,
    DWORD timeoutMs)
{
    Diagnostics::Aim("output.shutdown_output_cleanup reason=%s timeoutMs=%lu",
        reason ? reason : "unknown",
        static_cast<unsigned long>(timeoutMs));
    const auto timeout = std::chrono::milliseconds(timeoutMs);
    const int status = V2::Output::ReleaseActiveRuntime(timeout);
    if (status != success) {
        Diagnostics::Warn(
            "Device output cleanup completed with status=%d reason=%s timeoutMs=%lu.",
            status,
            reason ? reason : "unknown",
            static_cast<unsigned long>(timeoutMs));
    }
    return status;
}

int ShutdownOutputRuntime(const char* reason, DWORD timeoutMs)
{
    StopAutomaticDeviceSelection();
    Diagnostics::Aim("output.lifecycle_shutdown reason=%s timeoutMs=%lu",
        reason ? reason : "unknown",
        static_cast<unsigned long>(timeoutMs));

    const int status = V2::Output::ShutdownActiveRuntime(
        std::chrono::milliseconds(timeoutMs));
    if (status != success) {
        Diagnostics::Warn("Output lifecycle shutdown completed with status=%d reason=%s.",
            status, reason ? reason : "unknown");
    }
    return status;
}


}
```

`src/output/settings/DeviceDiscovery.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <WinSock2.h>
#include <WS2tcpip.h>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <setupapi.h>
#include <devguid.h>
#include "output/DeviceDiscovery.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <string_view>
#include <thread>

namespace V2::Output {
namespace {
bool IsMakcu(DeviceId id) {
    return id == DeviceId::Makcu4M || id == DeviceId::Makcu115200;
}

bool SameFamily(DeviceId first, DeviceId second) {
    return first == second || (IsMakcu(first) && IsMakcu(second));
}

std::string Upper(std::string value) {
    for (char& character : value)
        character = static_cast<char>(std::toupper(static_cast<unsigned char>(character)));
    return value;
}

std::string Utf8(std::wstring_view value) {
    if (value.empty()) return {};
    const int length = WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()),
        nullptr, 0, nullptr, nullptr);
    if (length <= 0) return {};
    std::string result(length, '\0');
    WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, 0, value.data(), static_cast<int>(value.size()),
        result.data(), length, nullptr, nullptr);
    return result;
}

std::string NormalizePort(std::string port) {
    port = Upper(std::move(port));
    if (port.starts_with("\\\\.\\")) port.erase(0, 4);
    if (!port.starts_with("COM") || port.size() < 4 || port.size() > 15) return {};
    if (!std::all_of(port.begin() + 3, port.end(), [](char c) { return c >= '0' && c <= '9'; }))
        return {};
    return port;
}

bool Cancelled(const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    return request.cancelled && request.cancelled();
}

DWORD ReplyTimeout(const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    return std::clamp<DWORD>(request.replyTimeoutMs, 100, 2000);
}

std::string InstanceId(HDEVINFO devices, SP_DEVINFO_DATA& info) {
    std::array<wchar_t, 1024> value{};
    if (!SetupDiGetDeviceInstanceIdW(devices, &info, value.data(),
            static_cast<DWORD>(value.size()), nullptr)) return {};
    return Utf8(value.data());
}

std::string HardwareIds(HDEVINFO devices, SP_DEVINFO_DATA& info) {
    std::array<wchar_t, 2048> value{};
    DWORD bytes = 0;
    if (!SetupDiGetDeviceRegistryPropertyW(devices, &info, SPDRP_HARDWAREID, nullptr,
            reinterpret_cast<PBYTE>(value.data()), static_cast<DWORD>(sizeof(value)), &bytes)) return {};
    const auto length = (std::min)(static_cast<std::size_t>(bytes / sizeof(wchar_t)), value.size());
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < length; ++i)
        if (value[i] == L'\0') value[i] = L' ';
    return Upper(Utf8(std::wstring_view(value.data(), length)));
}

std::string PortName(HDEVINFO devices, SP_DEVINFO_DATA& info) {
    HKEY key = SetupDiOpenDevRegKey(devices, &info, DICS_FLAG_GLOBAL, 0, DIREG_DEV, KEY_QUERY_VALUE);
    if (key == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return {};
    std::array<wchar_t, 64> value{};
    DWORD bytes = sizeof(value) - sizeof(wchar_t);
    DWORD type = 0;
    const auto status = RegQueryValueExW(key, L"PortName", nullptr, &type,
        reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>(value.data()), &bytes);
    RegCloseKey(key);
    return status == ERROR_SUCCESS && type == REG_SZ ? NormalizePort(Utf8(value.data())) : std::string{};
}

bool ValidNetworkEndpoint(const NetworkDiscoveryProfile& profile, sockaddr_in& endpoint,
    std::uint32_t& identifier) {
    endpoint = {};
    endpoint.sin_family = AF_INET;
    endpoint.sin_port = htons(profile.commandPort);
    if (!profile.commandPort || InetPtonA(AF_INET, profile.ip.c_str(), &endpoint.sin_addr) != 1)
        return false;
    const auto address = ntohl(endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr);
    // A saved Ferrum loopback emulator is not a physical KMBox Net candidate.
    if ((address >> 24) == 127 || (address >> 24) == 0 || (address >> 28) >= 14 ||
        address == 0xffffffffu) return false;
    if (profile.mac.size() != 8 || !std::all_of(profile.mac.begin(), profile.mac.end(),
            [](unsigned char c) { return std::isxdigit(c) != 0; })) return false;
    identifier = 0;
    for (unsigned char c : profile.mac) {
        c = static_cast<unsigned char>(std::toupper(c));
        identifier = (identifier << 4) | (c <= '9' ? c - '0' : c - 'A' + 10);
    }
    return true;
}

class SerialProbe {
    HANDLE handle_ = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
public:
    ~SerialProbe() { if (handle_ != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) CloseHandle(handle_); }
    bool Open(const std::string& port, DWORD baud, DWORD& error) {
        handle_ = CreateFileA(("\\\\.\\" + port).c_str(), GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE,
            0, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, nullptr);
        if (handle_ == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) { error = GetLastError(); return false; }
        DCB state{};
        state.DCBlength = sizeof(state);
        if (!GetCommState(handle_, &state)) { error = GetLastError(); return false; }
        state.BaudRate = baud;
        state.ByteSize = 8;
        state.Parity = NOPARITY;
        state.StopBits = ONESTOPBIT;
        state.fBinary = TRUE;
        state.fParity = FALSE;
        state.fOutxCtsFlow = state.fOutxDsrFlow = FALSE;
        state.fDsrSensitivity = FALSE;
        state.fOutX = state.fInX = FALSE;
        state.fDtrControl = DTR_CONTROL_DISABLE;
        state.fRtsControl = RTS_CONTROL_DISABLE;
        state.fAbortOnError = FALSE;
        COMMTIMEOUTS timeouts{};
        timeouts.ReadIntervalTimeout = MAXDWORD;
        timeouts.WriteTotalTimeoutConstant = 100;
        if (!SetCommState(handle_, &state) || !SetCommTimeouts(handle_, &timeouts)) {
            error = GetLastError(); return false;
        }
        PurgeComm(handle_, PURGE_RXCLEAR | PURGE_TXCLEAR);
        return true;
    }

    bool Query(std::string_view command, std::string_view expected,
        const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
        if (Cancelled(request)) return false;
        DWORD written = 0;
        const std::string line = std::string(command) + "\r\n";
        if (!WriteFile(handle_, line.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(line.size()), &written, nullptr) ||
            written != line.size()) return false;
        const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + ReplyTimeout(request);
        std::string pending;
        while (!Cancelled(request) && GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
            std::array<char, 1024> bytes{};
            DWORD received = 0;
            if (!ReadFile(handle_, bytes.data(), static_cast<DWORD>(bytes.size()), &received, nullptr))
                return false;
            pending.append(bytes.data(), received);
            if (pending.size() > 8192) return false;
            while (true) {
                auto end = pending.find_first_of("\r\n");
                const auto prompt = pending.find(">>>");
                const bool endsWithPrompt = prompt < end;
                if (endsWithPrompt) end = prompt;
                if (end == std::string::npos) break;
                auto result = std::string_view(pending).substr(0, end);
                const auto first = result.find_first_not_of(" \t");
                if (first != std::string_view::npos) {
                    result = result.substr(first, result.find_last_not_of(" \t") - first + 1);
                    if (result == expected) return true;
                }
                pending.erase(0, end + (endsWithPrompt ? 3 : 1));
            }
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
        }
        return false;
    }
};

void ProbeSerial(DeviceDiscoveryCandidate& candidate, const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    const bool makcu = IsMakcu(candidate.id);
    const auto& profile = makcu ? request.makcu : request.ferrum;
    std::vector<DWORD> bauds;
    const auto addBaud = [&](DWORD baud) {
        if (baud && std::find(bauds.begin(), bauds.end(), baud) == bauds.end()) bauds.push_back(baud);
    };
    // The product has two MAKCU baud variants. Do not change firmware baud settings.
    if (!makcu || profile.baud == 115200 || profile.baud == 4000000) addBaud(profile.baud);
    addBaud(115200);
    if (makcu) addBaud(4000000);
    for (DWORD baud : bauds) {
        if (Cancelled(request)) break;
        SerialProbe probe;
        DWORD error = ERROR_SUCCESS;
        if (!probe.Open(candidate.port, baud, error)) {
            if (error == ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED || error == ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION) {
                candidate.state = DeviceDiscoveryState::Busy;
                candidate.reason = "串口正在被其他程序使用";
                return;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (!probe.Query("km.version()", makcu ? "km.MAKCU" : "kmbox: Ferrum", request)) continue;
        candidate.baud = baud;
        if (makcu) candidate.id = baud == 4000000 ? DeviceId::Makcu4M : DeviceId::Makcu115200;
        if (!makcu && !probe.Query("km.has_mouse()", "1", request)) {
            candidate.state = Cancelled(request) ? DeviceDiscoveryState::Cancelled : DeviceDiscoveryState::Unavailable;
            candidate.reason = Cancelled(request) ? "识别已取消" : "Ferrum 已响应，但未确认已指定鼠标";
            return;
        }
        candidate.state = DeviceDiscoveryState::Ready;
        candidate.reason = makcu ? "已确认 MAKCU 身份" : "已确认 Ferrum 和已指定的鼠标";
        return;
    }
    candidate.state = Cancelled(request) ? DeviceDiscoveryState::Cancelled : DeviceDiscoveryState::Unavailable;
    candidate.reason = Cancelled(request) ? "识别已取消" : "设备未回复对应身份";
}

void ProbeNetwork(DeviceDiscoveryCandidate& candidate, const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    sockaddr_in endpoint{};
    std::uint32_t identifier = 0;
    if (!ValidNetworkEndpoint(request.network, endpoint, identifier)) return;
    WSADATA data{};
    if (WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &data) != 0) {
        candidate.state = DeviceDiscoveryState::Unavailable;
        candidate.reason = "无法开始网络识别";
        return;
    }
    const SOCKET socket = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    bool matched = false;
    if (socket != INVALID_SOCKET) {
        // Connection is the only UDP opcode permitted here. It carries no input.
        struct Header { std::uint32_t mac, random, sequence, command; };
        static_assert(sizeof(Header) == 16);
        const Header sent{identifier, GetTickCount() ^ GetCurrentProcessId(), 0, 0xaf3c2828u};
        const int count = sendto(socket, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&sent), sizeof(sent), 0,
            reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&endpoint), sizeof(endpoint));
        const auto deadline = GetTickCount64() + ReplyTimeout(request);
        while (count == sizeof(sent) && !Cancelled(request) && GetTickCount64() < deadline) {
            fd_set readable;
            FD_ZERO(&readable);
            FD_SET(socket, &readable);
            timeval timeout{0, 10000};
            const int ready = select(0, &readable, nullptr, nullptr, &timeout);
            if (ready < 0) break;
            if (ready == 0) continue;
            std::array<char, 2048> bytes{};
            sockaddr_in source{};
            int sourceLength = sizeof(source);
            const int received = recvfrom(socket, bytes.data(), static_cast<int>(bytes.size()), 0,
                reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&source), &sourceLength);
            if (received < static_cast<int>(sizeof(Header)) || sourceLength != sizeof(source) ||
                source.sin_family != AF_INET || source.sin_addr.s_addr != endpoint.sin_addr.s_addr ||
                source.sin_port != endpoint.sin_port) continue;
            Header reply{};
            std::memcpy(&reply, bytes.data(), sizeof(reply));
            // The preserved vendor SDK guarantees command/sequence echo, not
            // random/MAC echo. Requiring undocumented echo fields rejects devices.
            if (reply.command == sent.command && reply.sequence == sent.sequence) {
                matched = true; break;
            }
        }
        closesocket(socket);
    }
    WSACleanup();
    candidate.state = matched ? DeviceDiscoveryState::Ready :
        Cancelled(request) ? DeviceDiscoveryState::Cancelled : DeviceDiscoveryState::Unavailable;
    candidate.reason = matched ? "已保存的 KMBox Net 端点握手成功" :
        Cancelled(request) ? "识别已取消" : "已保存的 KMBox Net 端点没有有效回复";
}
}

std::vector<DeviceDiscoveryCandidate> EnumerateDeviceCandidates(const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    std::vector<DeviceDiscoveryCandidate> candidates;
    const auto makcuInstance = Upper(request.makcu.instanceId);
    const auto ferrumInstance = Upper(request.ferrum.instanceId);
    HDEVINFO devices = SetupDiGetClassDevsW(&GUID_DEVCLASS_PORTS, nullptr, nullptr, DIGCF_PRESENT);
    if (devices != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        SP_DEVINFO_DATA info{};
        info.cbSize = sizeof(info);
        for (DWORD index = 0; !Cancelled(request) && SetupDiEnumDeviceInfo(devices, index, &info); ++index) {
            const auto port = PortName(devices, info);
            const auto instance = InstanceId(devices, info);
            const auto upperInstance = Upper(instance);
            if (port.empty() || instance.empty()) continue;
            const bool savedMakcu = !makcuInstance.empty() && makcuInstance == upperInstance;
            const bool savedFerrum = !ferrumInstance.empty() && ferrumInstance == upperInstance;
            const bool knownFerrum = upperInstance.starts_with("FERRUM\\VIRTUALSERIALPORT\\");
            const bool knownMakcu = upperInstance.starts_with("USB\\") &&
                HardwareIds(devices, info).find("VID_1A86&PID_55D3") != std::string::npos;
            DeviceId id;
            if (knownFerrum) id = DeviceId::Ferrum;
            else if (knownMakcu) id = DeviceId::Makcu115200;
            else if (savedMakcu != savedFerrum) id = savedMakcu ? DeviceId::Makcu115200 : DeviceId::Ferrum;
            else continue;
            const auto& profile = IsMakcu(id) ? request.makcu : request.ferrum;
            candidates.push_back({id, port, instance, profile.baud, DeviceDiscoveryState::Candidate,
                IsMakcu(id) ? savedMakcu : savedFerrum, port == NormalizePort(profile.port), "等待身份确认"});
        }
        SetupDiDestroyDeviceInfoList(devices);
    }
    sockaddr_in endpoint{};
    std::uint32_t identifier = 0;
    if (!Cancelled(request) && ValidNetworkEndpoint(request.network, endpoint, identifier))
        candidates.push_back({DeviceId::KmBoxNet, {}, {}, 0, DeviceDiscoveryState::Candidate,
            true, false, "等待已保存网络端点回复"});
    std::stable_sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end(), [&](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
        const auto rank = [&](const auto& candidate) {
            return (SameFamily(candidate.id, request.preferredId) ? 4 : 0) +
                (candidate.savedIdentity ? 2 : 0) + (candidate.savedPort ? 1 : 0);
        };
        return rank(left) > rank(right);
    });
    return candidates;
}

std::vector<DeviceDiscoveryCandidate> DiscoverDevices(const DeviceDiscoveryRequest& request) {
    auto candidates = EnumerateDeviceCandidates(request);
    for (auto& candidate : candidates) {
        if (Cancelled(request)) {
            candidate.state = DeviceDiscoveryState::Cancelled;
            candidate.reason = "识别已取消";
        } else if (candidate.id == DeviceId::KmBoxNet) ProbeNetwork(candidate, request);
        else ProbeSerial(candidate, request);
    }
    return candidates;
}

DeviceDiscoverySelection SelectDiscoveredDevice(
    const std::vector<DeviceDiscoveryCandidate>& candidates, DeviceId preferredId) {
    std::vector<std::size_t> ready, preferred, remembered;
    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < candidates.size(); ++index) {
        const auto& candidate = candidates[index];
        if (candidate.state != DeviceDiscoveryState::Ready) continue;
        ready.push_back(index);
        if (SameFamily(candidate.id, preferredId)) {
            preferred.push_back(index);
            if (candidate.savedIdentity) remembered.push_back(index);
        }
    }
    if (remembered.size() == 1) return {remembered.front(), false};
    if (preferred.size() == 1) return {preferred.front(), false};
    if (ready.size() == 1) return {ready.front(), false};
    return {std::nullopt, ready.size() > 1};
}
}
```

`src/output/settings/OutputProfiles.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "output/DeviceRegistry.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <string>
#include <utility>

namespace V2::Output::ProfileConfig {

enum class Family : std::size_t { Network, KmBoxSerial, Mock, Makcu, Ferrum, CatBox, DhzBox, Count };
inline constexpr std::size_t kFamilyCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(Family::Count);
inline constexpr std::array<const char*, kFamilyCount> kFamilyNames{
    "network", "kmboxSerial", "mock", "makcu", "ferrum", "catbox", "dhzbox" };

inline constexpr bool IsDeviceId(int id) noexcept { return id >= 0 && id <= 7; }
inline constexpr int NormalizeDeviceId(int id) noexcept { return IsDeviceId(id) ? id : 0; }
inline constexpr Family FamilyForDeviceId(int id) noexcept
{
    switch (static_cast<DeviceId>(id)) {
    case DeviceId::KmBoxSerial: return Family::KmBoxSerial;
    case DeviceId::Mock: return Family::Mock;
    case DeviceId::Makcu4M:
    case DeviceId::Makcu115200: return Family::Makcu;
    case DeviceId::Ferrum: return Family::Ferrum;
    case DeviceId::CatBox: return Family::CatBox;
    case DeviceId::DhzBox: return Family::DhzBox;
    default: return Family::Network;
    }
}
inline constexpr bool IsSerialFamily(Family family) noexcept
{
    return family == Family::KmBoxSerial || family == Family::Makcu || family == Family::Ferrum;
}
inline constexpr int DefaultDeviceId(Family family) noexcept
{
    constexpr std::array<int, kFamilyCount> ids{ 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 };
    return ids[static_cast<std::size_t>(family)];
}

struct Profile {
    std::string port;
    std::string instanceId;
    int preferredDeviceId = 0;
    bool hasSavedParameters = false;
    float countsPerRadian = 100.0f;
    float calibratedYaw = 0.0f;
    float calibratedPitch = 0.0f;
    float referenceGameSensitivity = 15.0f;
    bool autoScaleByGameSensitivity = false;
    int inputDelayMs = 0;

    bool operator==(const Profile&) const = default;
};

inline Profile DefaultProfile(Family family)
{
    Profile result;
    result.preferredDeviceId = DefaultDeviceId(family);
    return result;
}

struct Store {
    std::array<Profile, kFamilyCount> profiles;
    // Runtime only: identifies which family owns the legacy field projection.
    int projectedDeviceId = -1;

    Store()
    {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < profiles.size(); ++i)
            profiles[i] = DefaultProfile(static_cast<Family>(i));
    }
    bool operator==(const Store&) const = default;
};
inline Store current;

inline Profile& ForId(Store& store, int id) noexcept
{
    return store.profiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(FamilyForDeviceId(id))];
}
inline const Profile& ForId(const Store& store, int id) noexcept
{
    return store.profiles[static_cast<std::size_t>(FamilyForDeviceId(id))];
}

inline bool ValidText(const std::string& value, std::size_t maximum) noexcept
{
    if (value.size() > maximum) return false;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value.size();) {
        const auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(value[i++]);
        if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7f) return false;
        if (c < 0x80) continue;
        unsigned int code = 0;
        std::size_t extra = 0;
        unsigned int minimum = 0;
        if (c >= 0xc2 && c <= 0xdf) { code = c & 0x1f; extra = 1; minimum = 0x80; }
        else if (c >= 0xe0 && c <= 0xef) { code = c & 0x0f; extra = 2; minimum = 0x800; }
        else if (c >= 0xf0 && c <= 0xf4) { code = c & 0x07; extra = 3; minimum = 0x10000; }
        else return false;
        if (i + extra > value.size()) return false;
        while (extra--) {
            const auto next = static_cast<unsigned char>(value[i++]);
            if ((next & 0xc0) != 0x80) return false;
            code = (code << 6) | (next & 0x3f);
        }
        if (code < minimum || code > 0x10ffff || (code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdfff)) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
inline bool IsValidProfile(Family family, const Profile& profile) noexcept
{
    const auto inRange = [](float value, float minimum, float maximum) {
        return std::isfinite(value) && value >= minimum && value <= maximum;
    };
    return IsDeviceId(profile.preferredDeviceId) &&
        FamilyForDeviceId(profile.preferredDeviceId) == family &&
        ValidText(profile.port, 15) && ValidText(profile.instanceId, 255) &&
        inRange(profile.countsPerRadian, 0.1f, 20000.0f) &&
        inRange(profile.calibratedYaw, 0.0f, 20000.0f) &&
        inRange(profile.calibratedPitch, 0.0f, 20000.0f) &&
        inRange(profile.referenceGameSensitivity, 0.01f, 100.0f) &&
        profile.inputDelayMs >= 0 && profile.inputDelayMs <= 20;
}

inline Profile NormalizeProfile(Family family, Profile profile)
{
    const auto finiteClamp = [](float value, float minimum, float maximum, float fallback) {
        return std::isfinite(value) ? std::clamp(value, minimum, maximum) : fallback;
    };
    if (!IsDeviceId(profile.preferredDeviceId) || FamilyForDeviceId(profile.preferredDeviceId) != family)
        profile.preferredDeviceId = DefaultDeviceId(family);
    if (!ValidText(profile.port, 15)) profile.port.clear();
    if (!ValidText(profile.instanceId, 255)) profile.instanceId.clear();
    profile.countsPerRadian = finiteClamp(profile.countsPerRadian, 0.1f, 20000.0f, 100.0f);
    profile.calibratedYaw = finiteClamp(profile.calibratedYaw, 0.0f, 20000.0f, 0.0f);
    profile.calibratedPitch = finiteClamp(profile.calibratedPitch, 0.0f, 20000.0f, 0.0f);
    profile.referenceGameSensitivity = finiteClamp(profile.referenceGameSensitivity, 0.01f, 100.0f, 15.0f);
    profile.inputDelayMs = std::clamp(profile.inputDelayMs, 0, 20);
    return profile;
}

inline void MigrateLegacy(Store& store, int selectedId, const Profile& legacy)
{
    store = {};
    selectedId = NormalizeDeviceId(selectedId);
    auto migrated = legacy;
    migrated.preferredDeviceId = selectedId;
    migrated.hasSavedParameters = true;
    if (!IsSerialFamily(FamilyForDeviceId(selectedId))) {
        migrated.port.clear();
        migrated.instanceId.clear();
    }
    ForId(store, selectedId) = NormalizeProfile(FamilyForDeviceId(selectedId), std::move(migrated));
    store.projectedDeviceId = selectedId;
}

// Capture the old projection before loading another family. The two MAKCU
// baud selections share parameters, but retain the latest explicit preference.
inline Profile Synchronize(Store& store, int selectedId, const Profile& projection)
{
    selectedId = NormalizeDeviceId(selectedId);
    const int previousId = store.projectedDeviceId < 0
        ? selectedId : NormalizeDeviceId(store.projectedDeviceId);
    auto saved = NormalizeProfile(FamilyForDeviceId(previousId), projection);
    saved.preferredDeviceId = previousId;
    const auto& previous = ForId(store, previousId);
    saved.hasSavedParameters = previous.hasSavedParameters;
    if (!IsSerialFamily(FamilyForDeviceId(previousId))) {
        saved.port.clear();
        saved.instanceId.clear();
    }
    if (saved != previous) saved.hasSavedParameters = true;
    ForId(store, previousId) = std::move(saved);
    auto& selected = ForId(store, selectedId);
    if (selected.preferredDeviceId != selectedId) {
        selected.preferredDeviceId = selectedId;
        selected.hasSavedParameters = true;
    }
    store.projectedDeviceId = selectedId;
    return selected;
}

} // namespace V2::Output::ProfileConfig
```

`src/output/settings/OutputProfilesJson.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "output/settings/OutputProfiles.hpp"
#include <rapidjson/document.h>
#include <rapidjson/stringbuffer.h>
#include <rapidjson/writer.h>

namespace V2::Output::ProfileConfig {

inline bool HasUniqueMembers(const rapidjson::Value& value)
{
    if (!value.IsObject()) return false;
    for (auto it = value.MemberBegin(); it != value.MemberEnd(); ++it)
        for (auto next = it + 1; next != value.MemberEnd(); ++next)
            if (it->name == next->name) return false;
    return true;
}

// Decode transactionally: a malformed member must not partially overwrite any
// previously valid family. Unknown fields are ignored for forward extension.
inline bool Decode(const std::string& json, Store& destination)
{
    rapidjson::Document root;
    root.Parse<rapidjson::kParseValidateEncodingFlag>(json.data(), json.size());
    if (root.HasParseError() || !HasUniqueMembers(root) ||
        !root.HasMember("version") || !root["version"].IsInt() || root["version"].GetInt() != 1 ||
        !root.HasMember("profiles") || !HasUniqueMembers(root["profiles"])) return false;
    Store candidate;
    const auto& profiles = root["profiles"];
    std::array<bool, kFamilyCount> seen{};
    for (auto it = profiles.MemberBegin(); it != profiles.MemberEnd(); ++it) {
        std::size_t index = 0;
        while (index < kFamilyCount && it->name != kFamilyNames[index]) ++index;
        if (index == kFamilyCount) continue;
        if (seen[index] || !HasUniqueMembers(it->value)) return false;
        seen[index] = true;
        auto& profile = candidate.profiles[index];
        const auto& value = it->value;
        const auto text = [&](const char* key, std::string& target) {
            if (!value.HasMember(key)) return false;
            if (!value[key].IsString()) return false;
            target.assign(value[key].GetString(), value[key].GetStringLength());
            return true;
        };
        const auto integer = [&](const char* key, int& target) {
            if (!value.HasMember(key)) return false;
            if (!value[key].IsInt()) return false;
            target = value[key].GetInt(); return true;
        };
        const auto boolean = [&](const char* key, bool& target) {
            if (!value.HasMember(key)) return false;
            if (!value[key].IsBool()) return false;
            target = value[key].GetBool(); return true;
        };
        const auto number = [&](const char* key, float& target) {
            if (!value.HasMember(key)) return false;
            if (!value[key].IsNumber()) return false;
            const double number = value[key].GetDouble();
            if (!std::isfinite(number) || std::abs(number) > 20000.0) return false;
            target = static_cast<float>(number); return true;
        };
        if (!text("port", profile.port) || !text("instanceId", profile.instanceId) ||
            !integer("preferredDeviceId", profile.preferredDeviceId) ||
            !boolean("hasSavedParameters", profile.hasSavedParameters) ||
            !number("countsPerRadian", profile.countsPerRadian) ||
            !number("calibratedYaw", profile.calibratedYaw) ||
            !number("calibratedPitch", profile.calibratedPitch) ||
            !number("referenceGameSensitivity", profile.referenceGameSensitivity) ||
            !boolean("autoScaleByGameSensitivity", profile.autoScaleByGameSensitivity) ||
            !integer("inputDelayMs", profile.inputDelayMs) ||
            !IsValidProfile(static_cast<Family>(index), profile)) return false;
    }
    // Older V2 profiles predate DHZ Box. Seed that one family from defaults;
    // every previously supported family must still be present so malformed
    // or partial documents cannot erase saved settings.
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kFamilyCount; ++i)
        if (!seen[i] && static_cast<Family>(i) != Family::DhzBox) return false;
    destination = std::move(candidate);
    return true;
}

inline std::string Encode(const Store& store)
{
    rapidjson::StringBuffer buffer;
    rapidjson::Writer<rapidjson::StringBuffer, rapidjson::UTF8<>, rapidjson::ASCII<>> writer(buffer);
    writer.StartObject();
    writer.Key("version"); writer.Int(1);
    writer.Key("profiles"); writer.StartObject();
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kFamilyCount; ++i) {
        const auto& profile = store.profiles[i];
        writer.Key(kFamilyNames[i]); writer.StartObject();
        writer.Key("port"); writer.String(profile.port.c_str());
        writer.Key("instanceId"); writer.String(profile.instanceId.c_str());
        writer.Key("preferredDeviceId"); writer.Int(profile.preferredDeviceId);
        writer.Key("hasSavedParameters"); writer.Bool(profile.hasSavedParameters);
        writer.Key("countsPerRadian"); writer.Double(profile.countsPerRadian);
        writer.Key("calibratedYaw"); writer.Double(profile.calibratedYaw);
        writer.Key("calibratedPitch"); writer.Double(profile.calibratedPitch);
        writer.Key("referenceGameSensitivity"); writer.Double(profile.referenceGameSensitivity);
        writer.Key("autoScaleByGameSensitivity"); writer.Bool(profile.autoScaleByGameSensitivity);
        writer.Key("inputDelayMs"); writer.Int(profile.inputDelayMs);
        writer.EndObject();
    }
    writer.EndObject(); writer.EndObject();
    return {buffer.GetString(), buffer.GetSize()};
}

} // namespace V2::Output::ProfileConfig
```

`src/output/settings/RuntimeConfig.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "output/DeviceRegistry.hpp"

namespace V2::Output {
    OutputRuntimeDescriptor RuntimeDescriptorFromConfig()
    {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
        return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();
#endif
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::Config::mutex);
        if (!OW::Config::outputEnabled)
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();

        switch (static_cast<DeviceId>(OW::Config::outputDeviceType)) {
        case DeviceId::KmBoxNet: {
            const int commandPort = OW::Config::outputPort;
            const int monitorPort = OW::Config::EffectiveOutputMonitorPort();
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Network(
                OW::Config::outputIp,
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(commandPort)
                    ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>(commandPort)
                    : 0,
                OW::Config::outputMac,
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(monitorPort)
                    ? static_cast<std::uint16_t>(monitorPort)
                    : 0);
        }
        case DeviceId::KmBoxSerial:
            // KMBox B+ uses the fixed 2,000,000 baud ASCII transport. The
            // old 115200 default silently throttled movement and caused
            // held-trigger commands to arrive late or out of order.
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Serial(OW::Config::outputComPort, 2000000);
        case DeviceId::Mock:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Mock();
        case DeviceId::Makcu4M:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Serial(OW::Config::outputComPort,4000000,V2::Output::SerialProtocol::Makcu);
        case DeviceId::Makcu115200:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Serial(OW::Config::outputComPort,115200,V2::Output::SerialProtocol::Makcu);
        case DeviceId::CatBox:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::CatBox(OW::Config::catBoxIp,
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(OW::Config::catBoxPort) ? static_cast<uint16_t>(OW::Config::catBoxPort) : 0,
                OW::Config::catBoxUuid,
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(OW::Config::catBoxMonitorPort) ? static_cast<uint16_t>(OW::Config::catBoxMonitorPort) : 0);
        case DeviceId::DhzBox:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::DhzBox(OW::Config::dhzBoxIp,
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(OW::Config::dhzBoxPort) ? static_cast<uint16_t>(OW::Config::dhzBoxPort) : 0,
                static_cast<uint8_t>(std::clamp(OW::Config::dhzBoxRandomShift, 0, 25)),
                OW::Config::IsValidOutputUdpPort(OW::Config::dhzBoxMonitorPort) ? static_cast<uint16_t>(OW::Config::dhzBoxMonitorPort) : 0);
        case DeviceId::Ferrum:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Serial(OW::Config::outputComPort,115200,V2::Output::SerialProtocol::Ferrum);
        default:
            return OutputRuntimeDescriptor::Disabled();
        }
    }

}
```

`src/output/transport/serial/SerialDeviceProtocol.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once

#include "output/OutputTypes.hpp"
#include <string>
#include <string_view>

namespace V2::Output {

// Called only while the owning transport holds its serial I/O mutex.
class SerialChannel {
public:
    virtual ~SerialChannel() = default;
    virtual bool Write(std::string_view bytes) = 0;
    virtual bool Read(std::string& bytes) = 0;
    virtual void Purge() = 0;
};

// Each device owns one protocol instance and one transport. The transport
// schedules commands and manages the COM handle without inspecting wire bytes.
class SerialDeviceProtocol {
public:
    virtual ~SerialDeviceProtocol() = default;
    virtual std::string ResolvePort(const std::string& requested) const { return requested; }
    virtual void Reset() = 0;
    virtual bool OnConnected(SerialChannel& channel) = 0;
    virtual bool AfterWrite(SerialChannel& channel) = 0;
    virtual bool Poll(SerialChannel& channel, bool running) = 0;
    virtual bool Heartbeat(SerialChannel& channel, bool suppressed) = 0;
    virtual bool SupportsKeyboard() const = 0;
    virtual bool SupportsMask() const = 0;
    virtual bool SupportsTimedMove() const = 0;
    virtual PhysicalInputSnapshot PhysicalInput() const = 0;
    virtual void ClearPhysicalInput() = 0;
    virtual bool EncodeMove(int x, int y, int duration, std::string& command) const = 0;
    virtual std::string EncodeButton(int button, bool down) const = 0;
    virtual std::string EncodeKey(unsigned usage, bool down) const = 0;
    virtual std::string EncodeMask(int button, bool enabled) const = 0;
    virtual int ButtonDomain(std::string_view command) const = 0;
    virtual bool IsButtonRelease(std::string_view command) const = 0;
    virtual int FlushInterval(OutputCommandType type) const = 0;
};

}
```

```cpp
#include "SerialOutputDevice.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "output/TimerResolution.hpp"

namespace V2::Output {

SerialOutputDevice::SerialOutputDevice(std::unique_ptr<SerialDeviceProtocol> protocol,
    bool physicalMonitor)
    : protocol_(std::move(protocol)), transport_(*protocol_), physicalMonitor_(physicalMonitor) {}

int SerialOutputDevice::Initialize(const OutputRuntimeDescriptor& descriptor) {
    const auto* endpoint = std::get_if<OutputSerialEndpoint>(&descriptor.endpoint);
    if (!endpoint) return err_net_cmd;
    (void)EnsureTimerResolution();
    return transport_.init(endpoint->port, endpoint->baud);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::ReleaseAll(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
    return transport_.ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout) {
    return transport_.Shutdown(timeout);
}

OutputConnectionState SerialOutputDevice::ConnectionState() const {
    return transport_.GetConnectionState();
}

OutputDeviceCapabilities SerialOutputDevice::Capabilities() const {
    OutputDeviceCapabilities capabilities;
    capabilities.keyboard = transport_.SupportsKeyboard();
    capabilities.mouseMask = transport_.SupportsMask();
    capabilities.timedMove = protocol_->SupportsTimedMove();
    capabilities.physicalMonitor = physicalMonitor_;
    return capabilities;
}

PhysicalInputSnapshot SerialOutputDevice::PhysicalInput() {
    return transport_.PhysicalInput();
}

int SerialOutputDevice::Move(int x, int y, int durationMs) {
    return durationMs > 0 ? transport_.MoveTimed(x, y, durationMs) : transport_.Move(x, y);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::Button(int button, bool down, bool) {
    return transport_.Button(button, down);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::ButtonState(std::uint32_t mask, bool) {
    int result = success;
    for (int button = 0; button < transport_.MouseButtonCount(); ++button) {
        const int status = transport_.Button(button, (mask & (1u << button)) != 0);
        if (result == success) result = status;
    }
    return result;
}

int SerialOutputDevice::ReleaseButtons() {
    return ButtonState(0, true);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::Keyboard(unsigned char modifiers,
    const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages, OutputIntent intent) {
    return transport_.SendKeyboardReport(modifiers, usages, intent);
}

int SerialOutputDevice::Mask(std::uint32_t mask,
    std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion) {
    return transport_.MaskMouse(mask, std::move(completion));
}

int SerialOutputDevice::RecoverMaskTimeout(
    const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>&,
    std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& cleanup) {
    cleanup.reset();
    return Mask(0);
}
```

`src/output/transport/serial/SerialTransport.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SerialTransport.hpp"
#include "output/OutputServices.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>


namespace
{
    constexpr uint64_t kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs = 100;

    bool IsSerialOutputCommand(OutputCommandType type)
    {
        return type == OutputCommandType::MouseMove ||
            type == OutputCommandType::MouseAutoMove ||
            type == OutputCommandType::MouseButton || type==OutputCommandType::Keyboard || type==OutputCommandType::MouseMask || type==OutputCommandType::MouseUnmask;
    }

    bool IsSerialMouseMoveCommand(OutputCommandType type)
    {
        return type == OutputCommandType::MouseMove ||
            type == OutputCommandType::MouseAutoMove;
    }

    bool IsOrderedSerialSafety(const OutputQueuedSerialCommand& command)
    {
        return command.outputIntent == OutputIntent::SafetyRelease &&
            command.type != OutputCommandType::SafetyReleaseAll;
    }

    int SerialMouseButtonDomain(const OutputQueuedSerialCommand& command,
        const V2::Output::SerialDeviceProtocol& protocol)
    {
        if (command.type == OutputCommandType::Keyboard) return 256;
        if (command.type != OutputCommandType::MouseButton) return -1;
        return protocol.ButtonDomain(command.command);
    }

    bool HasDependentOrderedSerialSafety(
        const std::deque<OutputQueuedSerialCommand>& queue,
        std::deque<OutputQueuedSerialCommand>::const_iterator candidate,
        const V2::Output::SerialDeviceProtocol& protocol)
    {
        const int domain = SerialMouseButtonDomain(*candidate, protocol);
        if (domain < 0)
            return false;

        for (auto queued = std::next(candidate); queued != queue.end(); ++queued) {
            if (SerialMouseButtonDomain(*queued, protocol) != domain)
                continue;
            return IsOrderedSerialSafety(*queued);
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool IsRequiredPredecessorForIncomingSafety(
        const std::deque<OutputQueuedSerialCommand>& queue,
        std::deque<OutputQueuedSerialCommand>::const_iterator candidate,
        const OutputQueuedSerialCommand& incoming,
        const V2::Output::SerialDeviceProtocol& protocol)
    {
        const int domain = SerialMouseButtonDomain(incoming, protocol);
        if (domain < 0 || SerialMouseButtonDomain(*candidate, protocol) != domain)
            return false;

        return std::none_of(std::next(candidate), queue.end(),
            [domain, &protocol](const OutputQueuedSerialCommand& queued) {
                return SerialMouseButtonDomain(queued, protocol) == domain;
            });
    }

    void CompleteCommand(
        const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& completion,
        int status)
    {
        if (!completion)
            return;

        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(completion->mutex);
            if (completion->completed)
                return;
            completion->status = status;
            completion->completed = true;
        }
        completion->cv.notify_all();
    }

    int WaitForCommand(
        const std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>& completion,
        std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(completion->mutex);
        if (!completion->cv.wait_for(lock, timeout, [&completion]() {
                return completion->completed;
            })) {
            return err_completion_timeout;
        }
        return completion->status;
    }
}

// Open a serial port handle with the given baud rate
static bool open_port(HANDLE& hSerial, const char* portName, DWORD baudRate)
{
    hSerial = CreateFileA(portName, GENERIC_READ | GENERIC_WRITE, 0, 0, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL, 0);

    if (hSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) return false;

    DCB dcbSerialParams = { 0 };
    dcbSerialParams.DCBlength = sizeof(dcbSerialParams);

    if (!GetCommState(hSerial, &dcbSerialParams)) {
        CloseHandle(hSerial);
        return false;
    }

    dcbSerialParams.BaudRate = baudRate;
    dcbSerialParams.ByteSize = 8;
    dcbSerialParams.StopBits = ONESTOPBIT;
    dcbSerialParams.Parity = NOPARITY;
    dcbSerialParams.fOutxCtsFlow = FALSE;
    dcbSerialParams.fOutxDsrFlow = FALSE;
    dcbSerialParams.fOutX = dcbSerialParams.fInX = FALSE;
    dcbSerialParams.fDtrControl = DTR_CONTROL_DISABLE;
    dcbSerialParams.fRtsControl = RTS_CONTROL_DISABLE;

    if (!SetCommState(hSerial, &dcbSerialParams)) {
        CloseHandle(hSerial);
        return false;
    }

    COMMTIMEOUTS timeouts = { 0 };
    timeouts.ReadIntervalTimeout = OutputQueueConfig::CommandTimeoutMs;
    timeouts.ReadTotalTimeoutConstant = OutputQueueConfig::CommandTimeoutMs;
    timeouts.ReadTotalTimeoutMultiplier = 0;
    timeouts.WriteTotalTimeoutConstant = OutputQueueConfig::CommandTimeoutMs;
    timeouts.WriteTotalTimeoutMultiplier = 0;

    if (!SetCommTimeouts(hSerial, &timeouts)) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Error setting serial timeouts. GetLastError=%lu",
            static_cast<unsigned long>(GetLastError()));
        CloseHandle(hSerial);
        return false;
    }

    return true;
}

static std::string normalize_port_name(const std::string& portName)
{
    if (portName.empty() || portName.rfind("\\\\.\\", 0) == 0)
        return portName;

    if (portName.rfind("COM", 0) == 0 && portName.size() > 4)
        return "\\\\.\\" + portName;

    return portName;
}

SerialTransport::~SerialTransport()
{
    (void)Shutdown();
}

OutputConnectionState SerialTransport::GetConnectionState() const
{
    return connectionState.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

SerialTransport::LifecycleState SerialTransport::GetLifecycleState() const
{
    return lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
}

bool SerialTransport::IsConnected() const
{
    return GetConnectionState() == OutputConnectionState::Connected;
}

void SerialTransport::SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState state)
{
    const OutputConnectionState previous = connectionState.exchange(state, std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    if (previous != state) {
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] connection state %s -> %s",
            ToString(previous), ToString(state));
    }
}

bool SerialTransport::OpenConfiguredPort(bool AllowDuringStopping)
{
    const LifecycleState lifecycle = lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (lifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopping && !AllowDuringStopping)
        return false;
    if (lifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopped)
        return false;

    if (serialPortName.empty()) {
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Disconnected);
        return false;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(serialMutex);
    if (lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == LifecycleState::Stopping &&
        !AllowDuringStopping) {
        return false;
    }
    if (hSerial != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        CloseHandle(hSerial);
        hSerial = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }

    HANDLE newHandle = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    if (!open_port(newHandle, serialPortName.c_str(), serialBaud)) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Failed to open serial port %s. GetLastError=%lu",
            serialPortName.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned long>(GetLastError()));
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Error);
        return false;
    }

    hSerial = newHandle;
    protocol_.Reset();
    if (!protocol_.OnConnected(*this)) {
        CloseHandle(newHandle);
        hSerial = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Error);
        return false;
    }
    hSerial = newHandle;
    if (lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Stopping)
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Connected);
    return true;
}

void SerialTransport::ClosePort()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(serialMutex);
    if (hSerial != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE) {
        CloseHandle(hSerial);
        hSerial = INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE;
    }
    SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Disconnected);
}

bool SerialTransport::SendCommandOnce(const std::string& command)
{
    if (writeOverride)
        return writeOverride(command);

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(serialMutex);
    if (hSerial == INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && !writeChunkOverride) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!WriteLocked(command)) return false;
    if (!protocol_.AfterWrite(*this)) return false;
    return true;
}

bool SerialTransport::SendCommandOrFailSession(
    const std::string& command)
{
    if (SendCommandOnce(command)) return true;
    SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Error);
    protocol_.ClearPhysicalInput();
    CompletePendingCommands(err_queue_stopped);
    return false;
}

int SerialTransport::EnqueueCommand(
    const std::string& command,
    OutputCommandType type,
    OutputIntent outputIntent,
    OutputCommandPriority priority,
    std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion,
    std::vector<unsigned char> keyboardKeys)
{
    if (outputIntent == OutputIntent::SafetyRelease &&
        priority != OutputCommandPriority::Safety) {
        return EnqueueCommand(
            command,
            type,
            outputIntent,
            OutputCommandPriority::Safety,
            std::move(completion),std::move(keyboardKeys));
    }

    const bool releaseAllBarrier =
        type == OutputCommandType::SafetyReleaseAll;
    if (outputIntent == OutputIntent::SafetyRelease &&
        !releaseAllBarrier && type!=OutputCommandType::Keyboard && type!=OutputCommandType::MouseUnmask &&
        (type != OutputCommandType::MouseButton || !protocol_.IsButtonRelease(command))) {
        CompleteCommand(completion, err_net_cmd);
        return err_net_cmd;
    }

    OutputQueuedSerialCommand queued{};
    queued.command = command;
    queued.keyboardKeys = std::move(keyboardKeys);
    queued.type = type;
    queued.outputIntent = outputIntent;
    queued.priority = priority;
    queued.completion = std::move(completion);
    queued.enqueuedAt = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    const bool orderedSafety = IsOrderedSerialSafety(queued);

    std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> droppedCompletion;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion>> cancelledCompletions;
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queueMutex);
        const LifecycleState lifecycle = lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        const bool offlineTestSeam =
            lifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopped &&
            workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire) &&
            static_cast<bool>(writeOverride);
        if (priority == OutputCommandPriority::Normal &&
            lifecycle != LifecycleState::Running && !offlineTestSeam) {
            const auto completionToFail = queued.completion;
            lock.unlock();
            CompleteCommand(completionToFail, err_queue_stopped);
            return err_queue_stopped;
        }
        if (priority == OutputCommandPriority::Safety &&
            !workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            const auto completionToFail = queued.completion;
            lock.unlock();
            CompleteCommand(completionToFail, err_queue_stopped);
            return err_queue_stopped;
        }

        if (releaseAllBarrier) {
            for (auto pending = commandQueue.begin(); pending != commandQueue.end();) {
                if (pending->type != OutputCommandType::SafetyReleaseAll &&
                    IsSerialOutputCommand(pending->type)) {
                    cancelledCompletions.push_back(pending->completion);
                    pending = commandQueue.erase(pending);
                } else {
                    ++pending;
                }
            }
        }

        if (commandQueue.size() >= OutputQueueConfig::CommandQueueMaxSize) {
            auto droppable = commandQueue.begin();
            for (; droppable != commandQueue.end(); ++droppable) {
                if (droppable->priority != OutputCommandPriority::Normal)
                    continue;
                if (orderedSafety && IsRequiredPredecessorForIncomingSafety(
                        commandQueue, droppable, queued, protocol_)) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (HasDependentOrderedSerialSafety(commandQueue, droppable, protocol_))
                    continue;
                break;
            }
            if (droppable == commandQueue.end()) {
                Diagnostics::Error("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Command queue full; no normal command can be displaced.");
                const auto completionToFail = queued.completion;
                lock.unlock();
                CompleteCommand(completionToFail, err_queue_full);
                return err_queue_full;
            } else {
                Diagnostics::Error("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Command queue full; dropping oldest normal command.");
                droppedCompletion = droppable->completion;
                commandQueue.erase(droppable);
            }
        }

        if (releaseAllBarrier) {
            const auto firstNormal = std::find_if(
                commandQueue.begin(), commandQueue.end(),
                [](const OutputQueuedSerialCommand& pending) {
                    return pending.priority == OutputCommandPriority::Normal;
                });
            commandQueue.insert(firstNormal, std::move(queued));
        } else if (type == OutputCommandType::MouseButton) {
            auto insertAt = commandQueue.end();
            while (insertAt != commandQueue.begin()) {
                auto previous = insertAt;
                --previous;
                if (!IsSerialMouseMoveCommand(previous->type))
                    break;
                insertAt = previous;
            }
            commandQueue.insert(insertAt, std::move(queued));
        } else {
            commandQueue.push_back(std::move(queued));
        }
    }
    for (const auto& completionToCancel : cancelledCompletions)
        CompleteCommand(completionToCancel, err_queue_dropped);
    CompleteCommand(droppedCompletion, err_queue_dropped);
    queueCv.notify_one();
    return success;
}

int SerialTransport::ExecuteSafetyReleaseAll()
{
    int aggregateStatus = success;
    for (int button = 0; button < MouseButtonCount(); ++button) {
        if (!SendCommandOrFailSession(protocol_.EncodeButton(button, false)) &&
            aggregateStatus == success) {
            aggregateStatus = err_net_tx;
        }
    }
    const int keyboardStatus = ExecuteKeyboardReport({});
    if (aggregateStatus == success) aggregateStatus = keyboardStatus;
    if (SupportsMask()) {
        for (int button = 0; button < 5; ++button) {
            if (!SendCommandOnce(protocol_.EncodeMask(button, false)) &&
                aggregateStatus == success) {
                aggregateStatus = err_net_tx;
            }
        }
    }
    return aggregateStatus;
}

int SerialTransport::ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
{
    if (!workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        return err_queue_stopped;

    auto completion = std::make_shared<OutputCommandCompletion>();
    const int enqueueStatus = EnqueueCommand(
        {},
        OutputCommandType::SafetyReleaseAll,
        OutputIntent::SafetyRelease,
        OutputCommandPriority::Safety,
        completion);
    if (enqueueStatus != success)
        return enqueueStatus;
    return WaitForCommand(completion, timeout);
}

void SerialTransport::StartWorkers()
{
    if (!workerRunning.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        queueThread = std::thread(&SerialTransport::QueueWorkerLoop, this);
    }
    if (!heartbeatRunning.exchange(true, std::memory_order_acq_rel)) {
        heartbeatThread = std::thread(&SerialTransport::HeartbeatLoop, this);
    }
}

void SerialTransport::StopWorkers()
{
    workerRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    heartbeatRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    queueCv.notify_all();
    heartbeatCv.notify_all();

    const std::thread::id current = std::this_thread::get_id();
    if (queueThread.joinable() && queueThread.get_id() != current)
        queueThread.join();
    if (heartbeatThread.joinable() && heartbeatThread.get_id() != current)
        heartbeatThread.join();
}

void SerialTransport::CompletePendingCommands(int Status)
{
    std::deque<OutputQueuedSerialCommand> pending;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(queueMutex);
        pending.swap(commandQueue);
    }
    for (const auto& command : pending)
        CompleteCommand(command.completion, Status);
}

void SerialTransport::QueueWorkerLoop()
{
    queueThreadId.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_release);
    auto lastFlush = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    while (workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        PollInput();
        OutputQueuedSerialCommand command{};
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(queueMutex);
            queueCv.wait_for(lock,
                std::chrono::milliseconds(OutputQueueConfig::CommandFlushIntervalMs),
                [this]() {
                    return !workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || !commandQueue.empty();
                });

            if (!workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
                break;
            if (commandQueue.empty())
                continue;

            command = std::move(commandQueue.front());
            commandQueue.pop_front();
        }

        if (command.type == OutputCommandType::SafetyReleaseAll) {
            const int status = ExecuteSafetyReleaseAll();
            CompleteCommand(command.completion, status);
            lastFlush = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
            continue;
        }

        const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const auto elapsed = now - lastFlush;
        const auto flushInterval = std::chrono::milliseconds(
            protocol_.FlushInterval(command.type));
        if (elapsed < flushInterval)
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(flushInterval - elapsed);

        if (command.priority == OutputCommandPriority::Normal &&
            lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running) {
            CompleteCommand(command.completion, err_queue_stopped);
            continue;
        }

        if (IsSerialOutputCommand(command.type) &&
            ShouldSuppressOutputForMenu(
                V2::Output::OutputSuppressed(), command.outputIntent)) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("serial.queue drop reason=menu_open_suppressed type=%s intent=%s",
                ToString(command.type),
                ToString(command.outputIntent));
            CompleteCommand(command.completion,err_output_suppressed);
            continue;
        }

        if (connectionState.load()!=OutputConnectionState::Connected) {
            CompleteCommand(command.completion,err_queue_stopped);continue;
        }
        const auto sendStarted = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        const int status=command.type==OutputCommandType::Keyboard
            ? ExecuteKeyboardReport(command.keyboardKeys,command.outputIntent==OutputIntent::SafetyRelease)
            : (SendCommandOrFailSession(command.command) ? success : err_net_tx);
        if (V2::Output::OutputVerboseLog()) {
            Diagnostics::Aim("serial.send type=%s queue_age_us=%lld send_us=%lld status=%d command=%.*s",
                ToString(command.type),
                static_cast<long long>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
                    sendStarted - command.enqueuedAt).count()),
                static_cast<long long>(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
                    std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - sendStarted).count()),
                status,
                (std::max)(0, static_cast<int>(command.command.size()) - 2),
                command.command.c_str());
        }
        CompleteCommand(command.completion,status);

        lastFlush = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    }
    queueThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
}

void SerialTransport::HeartbeatLoop()
{
    heartbeatThreadId.store(GetCurrentThreadId(), std::memory_order_release);
    while (heartbeatRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(heartbeatMutex);
            heartbeatCv.wait_for(lock,
                std::chrono::milliseconds(OutputQueueConfig::HeartbeatIntervalMs),
                [this]() {
                    return !heartbeatRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
                });
        }
        if (!heartbeatRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
            break;
        if (lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != LifecycleState::Running)
            continue;

        if (connectionState.load() != OutputConnectionState::Connected) continue;
        std::lock_guard lock(serialMutex);
        if (!protocol_.Heartbeat(*this, V2::Output::OutputSuppressed())) {
            SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Error);
            protocol_.ClearPhysicalInput();
        }

    }
    heartbeatThreadId.store(0, std::memory_order_release);
}

bool SerialTransport::IsOwnedWorkerThread() const
{
    const DWORD current = GetCurrentThreadId();
    return current != 0 &&
        (current == queueThreadId.load(std::memory_order_acquire) ||
         current == heartbeatThreadId.load(std::memory_order_acquire));
}

int SerialTransport::Shutdown(std::chrono::milliseconds timeout)
{
    if (IsOwnedWorkerThread()) {
        lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopping, std::memory_order_release);
        workerRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        heartbeatRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        queueCv.notify_all();
        heartbeatCv.notify_all();
        Diagnostics::Warn("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Shutdown deferred from an owned worker thread.");
        return err_queue_stopped;
    }

    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(lifecycleMutex);
    if (lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == LifecycleState::Stopped)
        return success;

    lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopping, std::memory_order_release);
    heartbeatCv.notify_all();

    int cleanupStatus = success;
    if (workerRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire))
        cleanupStatus = ReleaseAllOutputAndWait(timeout);

    StopWorkers();
    CompletePendingCommands(err_queue_stopped);
    ClosePort();
    writeOverride = {};
    lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopped, std::memory_order_release);
    Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] lifecycle stopped. cleanup_status=%d", cleanupStatus);
    return cleanupStatus;
}

int SerialTransport::init(const std::string& portName, DWORD baud)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(lifecycleMutex);
    const LifecycleState previousLifecycle = lifecycleState.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    if (previousLifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopping)
        return err_queue_stopped;
    if (previousLifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopped)
        lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Starting, std::memory_order_release);

    SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Connecting);
    const auto port = normalize_port_name(protocol_.ResolvePort(portName));
    if (port.empty()) {
        Diagnostics::Error("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] Serial port not found.");
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Disconnected);
        if (previousLifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopped)
            lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopped, std::memory_order_release);
        return -1;
    }
    CompletePendingCommands(err_queue_stopped);
    serialPortName = port;
    serialBaud = baud;
    if (!OpenConfiguredPort()) {
        if (previousLifecycle == LifecycleState::Stopped)
            lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopped, std::memory_order_release);
        return -2;
    }
    if(injectedKeys.any()) {
        if(ExecuteKeyboardReport({})!=success) {ClosePort();lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Stopped);return err_net_tx;}
    }
    StartWorkers();
    lifecycleState.store(LifecycleState::Running, std::memory_order_release);
    return 0;
}

int SerialTransport::Move(int x, int y)
{
    std::string command;
    if (!protocol_.EncodeMove(x, y, 0, command)) return err_net_cmd;
    return EnqueueCommand(command, OutputCommandType::MouseMove);
}

int SerialTransport::MoveTimed(int x, int y, int runtime)
{
    if (!protocol_.SupportsTimedMove()) return runtime > 0 ? err_net_cmd : Move(x, y);
    std::string command;
    if (!protocol_.EncodeMove(x, y, runtime, command)) return err_net_cmd;
    return EnqueueCommand(command, OutputCommandType::MouseAutoMove);
}

int SerialTransport::Button(int button, bool down)
{
    if (button < 0 || button > 4) return err_net_cmd;
    const auto command = protocol_.EncodeButton(button, down);
    if (command.empty()) return err_net_cmd;
    if (V2::Output::OutputDebugLog())
        Diagnostics::Info("[OUTPUT-SERIAL] queue button=%d down=%d", button, down ? 1 : 0);
    return EnqueueCommand(command, OutputCommandType::MouseButton, OutputIntentForState(down));
}

void SerialTransport::Click()
{
    (void)Button(0, true);
    (void)Button(0, false);
}

int SerialTransport::Left(bool down) { return Button(0, down); }
int SerialTransport::Right(bool down) { return Button(1, down); }
int SerialTransport::Middle(bool down) { return Button(2, down); }

bool SerialTransport::WriteLocked(std::string_view command)
{
    if (hSerial==INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE && !writeChunkOverride) return false;
    size_t sent=0;
    const auto deadline=GetTickCount64()+OutputQueueConfig::CommandTimeoutMs;
    while(sent<command.size()) {
        if(GetTickCount64()>=deadline) return false;
        DWORD count=0;
        const bool ok=writeChunkOverride ? writeChunkOverride(command.substr(sent),count)
            : WriteFile(hSerial,command.data()+sent,DWORD(command.size()-sent),&count,nullptr)!=FALSE;
        if(!ok || !count || count>command.size()-sent) return false;
        sent+=count;
    }
    return true;
}

bool SerialTransport::Read(std::string& bytes)
{
    char buffer[512];
    DWORD count = 0;
    if (readOverride) {
        bytes = readOverride();
        return bytes.size() <= sizeof(buffer);
    }
    COMSTAT stats{};
    DWORD errors = 0;
    if (!ClearCommError(hSerial, &errors, &stats) || errors) return false;
    if (!stats.cbInQue) {
        bytes.clear();
        return true;
    }
    if (!ReadFile(hSerial, buffer, (std::min)(DWORD(sizeof(buffer)), stats.cbInQue),
        &count, nullptr)) return false;
    bytes.assign(buffer, count);
    return true;
}

void SerialTransport::Purge()
{
    if (hSerial != INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE)
        PurgeComm(hSerial, PURGE_RXCLEAR | PURGE_TXCLEAR);
}

void SerialTransport::PollInput()
{
    if (writeOverride || connectionState.load() != OutputConnectionState::Connected) return;
    std::lock_guard lock(serialMutex);
    if (!protocol_.Poll(*this, lifecycleState.load() == LifecycleState::Running)) {
        SetConnectionState(OutputConnectionState::Error);
        protocol_.ClearPhysicalInput();
    }
}

V2::Output::PhysicalInputSnapshot SerialTransport::PhysicalInput() const
{
    auto result = protocol_.PhysicalInput();
    result.available = result.available && connectionState.load() == OutputConnectionState::Connected &&
        GetTickCount64() - result.sampledAtMs <= kPhysicalSnapshotMaxAgeMs;
    return result;
}

int SerialTransport::SendKeyboardReport(unsigned char modifiers,
    const std::vector<unsigned char>& usages, OutputIntent intent)
{
    if(!SupportsKeyboard()) return err_net_cmd;
    std::vector<unsigned char> keys=usages;
    for(auto key:keys) if(key<4 || key>=224) return err_net_cmd;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<8;++i) if(modifiers&(1u<<i)) keys.push_back(static_cast<unsigned char>(224+i));
    return EnqueueCommand({},OutputCommandType::Keyboard,intent,OutputCommandPriority::Normal,{},std::move(keys));
}

int SerialTransport::ExecuteKeyboardReport(const std::vector<unsigned char>& keys, bool releaseOnly)
{
    std::bitset<256> desired;for(auto key:keys) desired.set(key);
    if(releaseOnly && (desired & ~injectedKeys).any()) return err_net_cmd;
    for(int press=0;press<2;++press) for(unsigned u=0;u<256;++u) {
        if(desired[u]==injectedKeys[u] || desired[u]!=bool(press)) continue;
        if(press) injectedKeys.set(u);
        const auto command = protocol_.EncodeKey(u, press != 0);
        if(!SendCommandOrFailSession(command)) return err_net_tx;
        if(!press) injectedKeys.reset(u);
    }
    return success;
}

int SerialTransport::MaskMouse(uint32_t mask,std::shared_ptr<OutputCommandCompletion> completion)
{
    if(!SupportsMask() || (mask&~31u)) return err_net_cmd;
    std::string command;
    for (int button = 0; button < 5; ++button)
        command += protocol_.EncodeMask(button, (mask & (1u << button)) != 0);
    return EnqueueCommand(command,mask?OutputCommandType::MouseMask:OutputCommandType::MouseUnmask,
        mask?OutputIntent::Normal:OutputIntent::SafetyRelease,OutputCommandPriority::Normal,std::move(completion));
}
```
