`src/runtime/Acquisition.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdint>
#include <Windows.h>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace V2::Acquisition {
inline constexpr int kTargetHz = 300;
inline constexpr bool kLatestWins = true;
inline constexpr bool kColdTopology = true;
using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
inline auto Period() {
    return std::chrono::duration_cast<Clock::duration>(
        std::chrono::duration<double>(1.0 / kTargetHz));
}
inline void Wait(Clock::time_point& next, Clock::duration period) {
    struct Timer {
        HANDLE value=CreateWaitableTimerExW(nullptr,nullptr,CREATE_WAITABLE_TIMER_HIGH_RESOLUTION,TIMER_ALL_ACCESS);
        Timer() { if(!value)throw std::runtime_error("Acquisition timer creation failed"); }
        ~Timer() { CloseHandle(value); }
    };
    thread_local Timer timer;
    const auto now = Clock::now();
    if (now < next) {
        LARGE_INTEGER due;
        due.QuadPart=-(std::max)(int64_t{1},std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::duration<int64_t,std::ratio<1,10000000>>>(next-now).count());
        if(!SetWaitableTimer(timer.value,&due,0,nullptr,nullptr,FALSE))
            throw std::runtime_error("Acquisition timer scheduling failed");
        WaitForSingleObject(timer.value,INFINITE);
    }
    else if (now - next >= period)
        next = now;
    next += period;
}
}
```

```cpp
    static void RunDmaPeHeaderProbe()
    {

            Diagnostics::SetDmaProbeResult(false, false);

        const uint64_t baseAddress = OW::SDK->dwGameBase;
        IMAGE_DOS_HEADER dosHeader{};

        if (baseAddress)
            readOk = mem.Read(static_cast<uintptr_t>(baseAddress), &dosHeader, sizeof(dosHeader));

        const uint16_t magic = readOk ? static_cast<uint16_t>(dosHeader.e_magic) : 0;
        const bool mzOk = readOk && dosHeader.e_magic == IMAGE_DOS_SIGNATURE;
        Diagnostics::SetDmaProbeResult(true, mzOk, baseAddress, magic);

        if (mzOk) {
            Diagnostics::Info("[PIPELINE] Stage 1 DMA PE header read OK: base=0x%llX magic=0x%04X.",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(baseAddress),
                static_cast<unsigned int>(magic));
        } else {
            Diagnostics::Error("[PIPELINE] Stage 1 DMA PE header read failed: base=0x%llX read=%d magic=0x%04X.",
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(baseAddress),
                readOk ? 1 : 0,
                static_cast<unsigned int>(magic));
        }
    }

    static void HeroSkillRuntimeThread()
    {
        bool disconnectHandled = false;

        while (OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning()) {
            const DWORD tick = GetTickCount();
            const auto policy=V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot();
            const auto host=V2::HostInteraction::published.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
            const bool paused=V2::HostInteraction::ShouldPause(*host,policy->display.pauseOnChat,policy->display.pauseOnFocusLoss,OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch(),tick);
            if(paused!=V2::HostInteraction::paused.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                std::lock_guard transition(OW::RuntimeOutputProducerTransitionMutex());
                V2::HostInteraction::paused.store(paused,std::memory_order_release);
                OW::InvalidateRuntimeOutputContinuity();
                OW::RuntimeOutputScheduler().CancelAllAndJoin(OW::OutputActionCancelReason::RuntimeChanged);
                OW::CancelActiveSkill();
            }

            if (OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
                disconnectHandled = false;
                const OW::c_entity localSnapshot = OW::TargetingDetail::SnapshotLocalEntity();
                OW::HeroPerkRuntime::UpdateContext(localSnapshot.HeroID, true, localSnapshot.Team);
                OW::ProcessHeroSkills();
            } else if (!disconnectHandled) {
                OW::HeroPerkRuntime::ResetForDisconnect();
                OW::CancelActiveSkill();
                disconnectHandled = true;
            }

            const DWORD elapsed = GetTickCount() - tick;
            if (elapsed < kHeroSkillRuntimeIntervalMs)
                Sleep(kHeroSkillRuntimeIntervalMs - elapsed);
            else
                Sleep(1);
        }

        OW::HeroPerkRuntime::ResetForDisconnect();
        OW::CancelActiveSkill();
    }


}
// =============================================================================
// Background thread launcher
// =============================================================================

bool StartBackgroundThreads()
{
    try {
        const bool committed = OW::TryCommitRuntimeOperation([] {
            if(g_Workers.Running())return;
            OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(true);
            std::vector<V2::Runtime::Worker> entries{
                {"acquisition",entity_thread},
                {"UN behaviors",aimbot_thread},{"configuration",configsavenloadthread},
                {"hero skills",HeroSkillRuntimeThread}, {"alerts",V2::Alerts::SkillWorker}
            };
            if(OW::PresentInterpolationEnabled())entries.push_back({"presentation",present_interp_thread});
            g_Workers.Start(entries, [] {
                OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
                OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(false);
            });
            KeyState::Start();
        });
        return committed && g_Workers.Running() && !g_Workers.Failed();
    } catch(const std::exception& error) {
        Diagnostics::Error("Runtime worker startup failed: %s",error.what());
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
        // TryCommit lock has unwound: stopping here cannot deadlock its gate.
        OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(false);
        g_Workers.Join();
        KeyState::Stop();
        return false;
    }
}

static void StopBackgroundThreads()
{
    OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(false);
    g_Workers.Join();
}

static void ClearProcessRuntimeSnapshots()
{
    V2::Maps::Clear();
    V2::HostInteraction::Publish({});
    V2::Profiles::Publish({});
    OW::entitySceneGeneration.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_acq_rel);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::entityBodyValidityMutex);
        OW::ClearEntityBodyAuthoritiesLocked();OW::entityBodyDiscoveries.clear();OW::blockedEntityBodies.clear();
        OW::entityBodyAbsenceRevisions.clear();
    }
    OW::SDK->Reset();
    OW::ClearCriticalMatrixReadPlan();
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
        OW::ow_entities.clear();
        OW::ow_entities_scan.clear();
        OW::local_entity = OW::c_entity{};
        OW::abletotread = 0;
        OW::entity_fast_scan_until_tick = 0;
        OW::entity_topology_rescan_completed_request_count =
            OW::entity_topology_rescan_request_count;
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(OW::raw_scan_mutex);
        OW::latest_raw_scan_snapshot = OW::RawEntityScanSnapshot{};
        OW::last_consumed_raw_scan_generation = 0;
        OW::entity_discoveries={};OW::empty_scene_watch={};OW::raw_discovery_stamps.clear();
    }

    OW::TargetingDetail::PublishEntitySnapshots({}, {});
    OW::SetViewMatrices(OW::Matrix{}, OW::Matrix{});
    Diagnostics::SetEntityCount(0);
    Diagnostics::SetEntityProcessStats(Diagnostics::EntityProcessStats{});
    Diagnostics::SetPlayerInfoStats(Diagnostics::PlayerInfoStats{});
    Diagnostics::SetLocalEntityStats(Diagnostics::LocalEntityStats{});
    Diagnostics::SetRosterStats(Diagnostics::RosterStats{});
    Diagnostics::SetViewMatrixStatus(false, false);
    Diagnostics::SetDmaProbeResult(false, false);
}

void DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers(const char* reason)
{
    OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    // Signal every producer before joining any one of them. The device remains
    // alive until all workers have returned and closed their scatter handles.
    {
        // StartBackgroundThreads owns the same lock throughout construction;
        // every newly created worker must see this stop before we join it.
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(OW::runtimeLifecycleMutex);
        OW::SetRuntimeWorkersRunning(false);
        mem.CancelPendingOperations();
    }
    OW::RuntimeOutputScheduler().CancelAllAndJoin(
        OW::OutputActionCancelReason::RuntimeChanged);
    ReleaseOutputMouseStateForShutdown(reason);
    KeyState::Stop();
    StopBackgroundThreads();
    OW::CancelActiveSkill();
}

void RestoreNativeOutlineBeforeShutdown()
{
#ifndef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    namespace Brightness = OW::OutlineBrightness;
    OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    Brightness::Disable();
    if (!OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() || !OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) return;
    const auto connection = OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch();
    const auto request = Brightness::ShutdownRestoreRequest.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_acq_rel) + 1;
    const auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(1000);
    while (Brightness::ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != request &&
           OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning() && OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() &&
           OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch() == connection && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    }
    if (Brightness::ShutdownRestoreAcknowledged.load(std::memory_order_acquire) != request)
        Diagnostics::Warn("Native outline brightness: pre-shutdown restore did not complete; continuing bounded shutdown.");
#endif
}

void ResumeConnectionOperations()
{
    // Shutdown and reset of the cancellation flag must be indivisible. A late
    // recovery may not undo the exit request while StopProcessConnection joins.
    OW::TryCommitRuntimeOperation([] { mem.ResetPendingOperations(); });
}

static DmaDeviceRecovery::Result RebuildDmaDeviceSession(bool manualRequest)
{
    struct Operations {
        bool Stopping() const {
            return OW::RuntimeShutdownRequested() ||
                !g_ProcessConnectionThreadRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        }
        void Quarantine() {
            OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
            OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, true, 0, 0,
                "Rebuilding DMA device; waiting for old calls to finish...");
            Diagnostics::SetDmaReady(false);
            Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(false);
        }
        void DrainWorkers() { DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers("dma_device_rebuild"); }
        void ClearSnapshots() {
            ClearProcessRuntimeSnapshots();
            KeyState::ResetForDmaRecovery();
        }
        void CloseDevice() { mem.CloseDma(); }
        bool InitializeDevice() {
            ResumeConnectionOperations();
            if (Stopping() || !mem.LoadDmaDeviceConfig())
                return false;
            // A replacement host/device must not inherit the physical map
            // cached against the local computer's boot time.
            return mem.InitDma(false);
        }
    } operations;
    Diagnostics::Info("%s DMA device rebuild requested.", manualRequest ? "Manual" : "Automatic");
    const auto result = DmaDeviceRecovery::Rebuild(operations);
    if (result != DmaDeviceRecovery::Result::Stopping) {
        const bool ready = result == DmaDeviceRecovery::Result::Ready;
        Diagnostics::SetDmaReady(ready);
        OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0, ready
            ? "DMA rebuilt; waiting for Overwatch.exe"
            : "DMA rebuild failed; check device/configuration; retrying");
    }
    return result;
}

static void MarkProcessDisconnected(const char* statusText)
{
    // Close the process-scoped output session before stopping producers. This
    // prevents a late scheduler call from self-synchronizing while disconnect
    // cleanup is still draining the old hardware generation.
    OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    const bool wasConnected = OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected();
    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0,
        statusText ? statusText : "Waiting for Overwatch.exe");

    if (wasConnected) {
        Diagnostics::Warn("Target process disconnected.");
        std::printf("[MAIN] Target process disconnected; waiting for %s...\n", kTargetProcessName);
    }

    if (wasConnected || g_Workers.Running())
        DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers("target_disconnect");

    ClearProcessRuntimeSnapshots();
    mem.DetachProcess();
    ResumeConnectionOperations();
    Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(false);
}

static bool TryConnectTargetProcess(bool forceReconnect, bool manualRequest)
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ProcessConnectionMutex);
    if (OW::RuntimeShutdownRequested())
        return false;

    const bool wasConnected = OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected();
    // A manual/PID-change reconnect is the same output ownership boundary as
    // a detected disconnect. Close normal output before publishing the
    // reconnecting state, then drain the old process generation completely.
    OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, true, 0, 0,
        manualRequest ? "Reconnecting UN..." : "Connecting UN...");
    if (forceReconnect || wasConnected || g_Workers.Running())
        DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers("target_reconnect");
    ResumeConnectionOperations();
    // Global process discovery is permitted only after old readers/output have
    // drained. The active session uses uncached lifetime checks instead.
    if (!mem.RefreshProcessMetadata(manualRequest ? "manual_reconnect" : "process_discovery")) {
        MarkProcessDisconnected("Process metadata unavailable; retrying");
        return false;
    }
    const DWORD livePid = mem.GetPidFromName(kTargetProcessName);
    if (livePid == 0) {
        MarkProcessDisconnected("Waiting for Overwatch.exe");
        return false;
    }
    Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(false);
    Diagnostics::Info("%s process connect attempt. target=%s pid=%lu",
        manualRequest ? "Manual" : "Automatic",
        kTargetProcessName,
        static_cast<unsigned long>(livePid));

    ClearProcessRuntimeSnapshots();
    if (forceReconnect)
        mem.DetachProcess();

    if (!OW::SDK->Initialize()) {
        mem.DetachProcess();
        Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(false);
        OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0,
            "Connect failed; waiting for Overwatch.exe");
        return false;
    }

    V2::Profiles::State profileState;
    profileState.module = OW::SDK->dwGameBase;
    profileState.pid = mem.GetCurrentProcessId();
    const int requested = V2::Profiles::requestedProfile.load();
    const auto read = [](uint64_t at, void* dst, size_t size) { return mem.ReadFreshExact(at, dst, size); };
    uint32_t timestamp = 0, imageSize = 0;
    const auto identity = OW::ProductImageIdentity::ReadHeaders(profileState.module, read, timestamp, imageSize);
    const int imageProfile = V2::Profiles::FindImageProfile(timestamp, imageSize);
    if (identity != OW::ProductImageIdentity::Result::Accepted || imageProfile < 0 ||
        (requested >= 0 && requested != imageProfile)) {
        MarkProcessDisconnected(imageProfile >= 0 ? "Selected region does not match Overwatch.exe"
            : identity == OW::ProductImageIdentity::Result::Unreadable ? "Waiting for Overwatch.exe image headers"
            : "Unsupported Overwatch.exe build");
        Diagnostics::Info("Profile identity: request=%d status=%d timestamp=0x%X size=0x%X.",
            requested, int(identity), timestamp, imageSize);
        return false;
    }
    profileState.detection = V2::Profiles::Detect(profileState.module, read,
        [&] { return !OW::RuntimeShutdownRequested() && mem.GetCurrentProcessId() == profileState.pid &&
            OW::SDK->dwGameBase == profileState.module; }, imageProfile);
    const auto* matched = V2::Profiles::MatchedProfile(profileState.detection);
    if (!matched) {
        const bool ambiguous = profileState.detection.status == V2::Profiles::DetectionStatus::Ambiguous;
        MarkProcessDisconnected(ambiguous ? "Multiple region layouts matched; select a region"
                                         : "Waiting for a matching region layout");
        V2::Profiles::Publish(profileState);
        Diagnostics::Info("Region probe: request=%d state=%d matches=%d.", requested,
            int(profileState.detection.status), profileState.detection.matches);
        return false;
    }
    const int attachedPid = mem.GetCurrentProcessId();
    // Shutdown and attach commit share a short lock; DMA resolution stays outside it.
    if (!OW::TryCommitRuntimeOperation([&] {
        OW::offset::SetActiveProfile(matched->runtime);
        V2::Profiles::Publish(profileState);
        Diagnostics::SetProcessAttached(true);
        OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(true, false, attachedPid, OW::SDK->dwGameBase,
            std::string("Connected to Overwatch.exe (") + matched->Offsets().name + ")");
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(!mem.IsStaticSource());
    }))
        return false;
    Diagnostics::Info("Process attached: %s pid=%d base=0x%llX. Region %s %s (request=%d).",
        kTargetProcessName,
        attachedPid,
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(OW::SDK->dwGameBase), matched->region, matched->build, requested);
    std::printf("[MAIN] %s attached. PID=%d base=0x%llX\n",
        kTargetProcessName,
        attachedPid,
        static_cast<unsigned long long>(OW::SDK->dwGameBase));

    RunDmaPeHeaderProbe();

    if(!StartBackgroundThreads()) {
        MarkProcessDisconnected("Worker startup failed; retrying");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void StartProcessConnectionThread()
{
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lifecycleLock(OW::runtimeLifecycleMutex);
    if (OW::RuntimeShutdownRequested() || g_ProcessConnectionThread.joinable())
        return;
    mem.ResetPendingOperations();
    g_ProcessConnectionThreadRunning.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0, "Waiting for DMA device");
    g_ProcessConnectionThread = std::thread([]() {
        Diagnostics::Info("Process connection thread started. target=%s interval_ms=%lu.",
            kTargetProcessName,
            static_cast<unsigned long>(kProcessScanIntervalMs));
        InitializeOutputFromConfig();

        DWORD lastAttemptTick = 0;
        DmaDeviceRecovery::HealthFailures healthFailures;
        while (g_ProcessConnectionThreadRunning.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            const bool cacheRefreshRequest = OW::ProcessConnection::ConsumeCacheRefreshRequest();
            const bool manualRequest = OW::ProcessConnection::ConsumeReconnectRequest() || cacheRefreshRequest;
            const bool rebuildRequest = OW::ProcessConnection::ConsumeDmaRecoveryRequest();
            if (cacheRefreshRequest)
                Diagnostics::Info("Manual cache refresh requested; drain, clear snapshots, refresh VMM caches and reconnect.");
            const DWORD now = GetTickCount();
            const bool scanDue = lastAttemptTick == 0 || now - lastAttemptTick >= kProcessScanIntervalMs;

            if (rebuildRequest || (mem.IsDmaInitialized() && scanDue &&
                    healthFailures.Observe(mem.CheckSessionHealth()))) {
                const auto result = RebuildDmaDeviceSession(rebuildRequest);
                healthFailures.Reset();
                lastAttemptTick = GetTickCount();
                if (result == DmaDeviceRecovery::Result::Stopping)
                    break;
                continue;
            }

            if (!mem.IsDmaInitialized()) {
                if (manualRequest || scanDue) {
                    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, true, 0, 0, "Connecting DMA device...");
                    const bool configReady = mem.LoadDmaDeviceConfig();
                    const bool ready = configReady && !OW::RuntimeShutdownRequested() &&
                        mem.InitDma(false);
                    Diagnostics::SetDmaReady(ready);
                    OW::ProcessConnection::SetStatus(false, false, 0, 0, ready
                        ? "DMA ready; waiting for Overwatch.exe"
                        : "DMA unavailable; check device settings or retry connection");
                    lastAttemptTick = GetTickCount();
                }
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
                continue;
            }

            if (manualRequest) {
                TryConnectTargetProcess(true, true);
                lastAttemptTick = now;
            } else if (!OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
                if (scanDue) {
                    TryConnectTargetProcess(false, false);
                    lastAttemptTick = now;
                }
            } else if (scanDue) {
                if(g_Workers.Failed() || !OW::RuntimeWorkersRunning())
                    MarkProcessDisconnected("Runtime worker failed; reconnecting");
                else if (!mem.CheckAttachedProcessAlive())
                    MarkProcessDisconnected("Target lifetime changed or unreadable; reconnecting");
                lastAttemptTick = now;
            }

            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
        }

        Diagnostics::Info("Process connection thread stopping.");
    });
}

void StopProcessConnectionThread()
{
    g_ProcessConnectionThreadRunning.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    mem.CancelPendingOperations();
    if (g_ProcessConnectionThread.joinable())
        g_ProcessConnectionThread.join();
}


bool ThreadsStopped() {
    return !g_Workers.Running() && !g_ProcessConnectionThread.joinable();
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
namespace V2::Runtime {
// 本模块独占连接/采集线程。启动提交与最终退出共享生命周期门；
// 排空完成前调用方不得关闭 DMA。重连复用同一排空路径。
void StartProcessConnectionThread();
void StopProcessConnectionThread();
void DrainProcessRuntimeWorkers(const char* reason);
// Ask the acquisition owner to restore its setting before DMA cancellation.
void RestoreNativeOutlineBeforeShutdown();
// 回归检查也走真实入口，验证最终停止不能被晚到的启动撤销。
bool StartBackgroundThreads();
void ResumeConnectionOperations();
bool ThreadsStopped(); // 只能在停止/最终退出后检查
}
```

`src/runtime/WorkerGroup.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "WorkerGroup.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <stdexcept>

namespace V2::Runtime {
WorkerGroup::~WorkerGroup() {
    // 正常停止必须由会话完成；不能静默 detach 后让线程访问已关闭的资源。
    for(const auto& thread:workers_)if(thread.joinable())std::terminate();
}
void WorkerGroup::Start(std::span<const Worker> entries, void (*onFailure)()) {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    if(running_.load())return;
    if(!workers_.empty())throw std::logic_error("Drain old workers before restarting");
    workers_.reserve(entries.size());
    failed_.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
    // 先标记，确保创建中途失败时连接层仍执行完整 drain。
    running_.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
    for(const auto entry:entries) {
        workers_.emplace_back([this,entry,onFailure] {
            Diagnostics::Info("Worker entering: %s.",entry.name);
            try { entry.entry(); }
            catch(const std::exception& e) {
                Diagnostics::Error("Worker failed: %s: %s",entry.name,e.what());
                failed_.store(true,std::memory_order_release);if(onFailure)onFailure();
            } catch(...) {
                Diagnostics::Error("Worker failed: %s",entry.name);
                failed_.store(true,std::memory_order_release);if(onFailure)onFailure();
            }
            Diagnostics::Info("Worker returned: %s.",entry.name);
        });
    }
}
void WorkerGroup::Join() {
    std::lock_guard lock(mutex_);
    for(auto& thread:workers_)if(thread.joinable())thread.join();
    workers_.clear();running_.store(false,std::memory_order_release);
}
}

```

`src/runtime/WorkerGroup.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <span>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Runtime {
struct Worker { const char* name; void (*entry)(); };
// Session owner starts/stops this group. Stop signal is separate from join:
// callers first close publication/output gates, then drain, then release DMA.
class WorkerGroup {
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;
    std::vector<std::thread> workers_;
    std::atomic<bool> running_{false}, failed_{false};
public:
    WorkerGroup()=default;
    WorkerGroup(const WorkerGroup&)=delete;
    ~WorkerGroup();
    bool Running() const noexcept {return running_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);}
    bool Failed() const noexcept {return failed_.load(std::memory_order_acquire);}
    void Start(std::span<const Worker> workers, void (*onFailure)());
    void Join();
};
}
```

```hpp
        changed|=Float("Bezier speed","##bezierSpeed",m.bezierSpeed,0,200);
    }
    if(m.method==3) {
        changed|=Float("Near angle","##nearDeg",m.piecewiseNearDegrees,0,180," deg");
        changed|=Float("Mid angle","##midDeg",m.piecewiseMidDegrees,m.piecewiseNearDegrees,180," deg");
        changed|=Float("Far angle","##farDeg",m.piecewiseFarDegrees,m.piecewiseMidDegrees,180," deg");
        changed|=Float("Near scale","##nearScale",m.piecewiseNearScale,0,1);
        changed|=Float("Mid scale","##midScale",m.piecewiseMidScale,0,1);
        changed|=Float("Far scale","##farScale",m.piecewiseFarScale,0,1);
    }
    if(m.method==4) changed|=Float("Acceleration","##accel",m.accelLimitedAcceleration,0,20);
    if(m.method==5) changed|=Float("Angular speed","##angularSpeed",m.constantAngularSpeedDeg,0,7200," deg/s");
    if(m.method==6) {
        changed|=Float("Cruise speed","##cruise",m.hybridConstantSpeedDeg,0,7200," deg/s");
        changed|=Float("Max angular speed","##maxSpeed",m.hybridMaxSpeedDeg,0,7200," deg/s");
        changed|=Float("Acceleration","##hybridAccel",m.hybridAccelerationDeg,0,100000," deg/s2");
        changed|=Float("Deceleration","##decel",m.hybridDecelerationDeg,0,100000," deg/s2");
        changed|=Float("Near angle","##hybridNear",m.hybridNearRadiusDeg,.001f,180," deg");
        changed|=Float("Motion gain","##motionGain",m.hybridTargetMotionGain,0,10);
        changed|=Float("Sudden motion boost","##boost",m.hybridSuddenMotionBoost,0,10);
        changed|=Float("Deadzone","##hybridDeadzone",m.hybridDeadzoneDeg,0,180," deg");
    }
    if(m.method==7) changed|=Shuwu(m.shuwu);
    if(m.method==8) changed|=UI::ResponseCurveEditor(m.responseCurve);
    if(m.method==9) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Follows the remaining aim error proportionally. Speed scale adjusts response."));
    return changed;
}
inline bool HealthLimits(OW::Config::HeroPreset& preset) {
    auto& s = preset.aimPlan.selection;
    bool changed = false;
    changed |= Float("Minimum HP", "##minHP", s.minHealth, 0, 2000, " HP");
    changed |= Float("Maximum HP (0 = any)", "##maxHP", s.maxHealth, 0, 2000, " HP");
    return changed;
}

inline bool Policy(OW::Config::HeroPreset& preset,
                   bool weightedRanking = true,
                   bool includeHealthLimits = true) {
    auto& p=preset.aimPlan; auto& s=p.selection; bool changed=false;
    static const char* modes[]={"Any","Prefer","Only"};
    static const char* predicates[]={"Selected heroes","Full health","Visible"};
    SettingRow("Target preference"); PushControlWidth(); changed|=UISelect("##preference",&s.mode,modes,3); ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    if(s.mode) {
        SettingRow("Preference condition"); PushControlWidth(); changed|=UISelect("##predicate",&s.predicate,predicates,3); ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if(s.predicate==0) changed|=Heroes("##policyHeroes",s.heroes);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L(s.mode==2?"Only: no match means no target. An empty hero set selects nobody.":
            "Prefer: matching valid targets rank first, otherwise use the rest. An active minimum lock expires first."));
    }
    if (includeHealthLimits)
        changed |= HealthLimits(preset);
    if(weightedRanking && preset.priority==3) {
        changed|=Float("Angle weight","##angleWeight",s.angleWeight,0,100);
        changed|=Float("Distance weight","##distanceWeight",s.distanceWeight,0,100);
        changed|=Float("Health weight","##healthWeight",s.healthWeight,0,100);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Smart compares normalized angle, distance and remaining health fraction. Zero weights use angle."));
    }
    return changed;
}
inline bool Editor(OW::Config::HeroPreset& preset) {
    bool changed=false; auto& p=preset.aimPlan;
    UIGroupBox("Default motion and target hero exceptions");
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", L("Hero exceptions change settings for the selected heroes."));
    if(ImGui::TreeNodeEx(L("Default for all target heroes"),ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen)) {
        p.overrideMotion=true;
        const auto previous=p.motion;
        if(Motion(p.motion,preset.aimBehaviorPresetId<0)) {
            const int chosen=p.motion.method;
            if(chosen!=previous.method) {
                p.motion=previous;preset.aimMethod=previous.method;Config::StoreHeroBehaviorMode(preset);
                auto& cache=Config::EnsureSlotBehaviorConfig(preset,preset.aimBehaviorPresetId);
                auto stored=std::find_if(cache.motions.begin(),cache.motions.end(),[&](const auto& m){return m.method==chosen;});
                if(stored==cache.motions.end()) {
                    auto defaults=Config::CaptureBehaviorMotion(preset.aimBehavior);defaults.method=chosen;
                    cache.motions.push_back(defaults);stored=std::prev(cache.motions.end());
                }
                p.motion=*stored;
            }
            preset.aimMethod=chosen;changed=true;
        }
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }
    int remove=-1;
    for(size_t i=0;i<p.groups.size();++i) {
        auto& g=p.groups[i]; ImGui::PushID(reinterpret_cast<void*>(uintptr_t(g.id)));
        std::string summary=g.name+" ("+std::to_string(g.heroes.size())+")";
        summary+=" / "; summary+=L(g.overrideMotion?"Motion override":"Inherited motion");
        if(g.overrideLimits) {summary+=" / ";summary+=L("Range override");}
        if(g.overrideAimPoint) {summary+=" / ";summary+=L("Aim point override");}
        const std::string groupId="##targetRule-"+std::to_string(g.id);
        if(ImGui::TreeNodeEx(groupId.c_str(),0,"%s",summary.c_str())) {
            char name[128]; std::snprintf(name,sizeof(name),"%s",g.name.c_str());
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1); if(ImGui::InputText("##name",name,sizeof(name))) {g.name=name;changed=true;}
            changed|=Heroes("##exceptionHeroes",g.heroes,&p,g.id);
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", L("Unchecked sections inherit the current default. A hero can belong to one exception."));
            if (ImGui::BeginTabBar("##heroOverrideSections")) {
                if (ImGui::BeginTabItem(L("Target Rule Overrides"))) {
                    const bool wasLimits=g.overrideLimits;
                    changed|=UICheckbox(L("Override range and health"),&g.overrideLimits);
                    if(!wasLimits && g.overrideLimits) g.limits={preset.minDistance,preset.maxDistance,preset.fov,p.selection.minHealth,p.selection.maxHealth};
                    if(g.overrideLimits) {
                        changed|=Float("FOV (deg)","##fov",g.limits.fov,0,180," deg");
                        changed|=Float("Min Distance","##minDist",g.limits.minDistance,0,500," m");
                        changed|=Float("Max Distance (0 = any)","##maxDist",g.limits.maxDistance,0,500," m");
                        changed|=Float("Minimum HP","##minHP",g.limits.minHealth,0,2000," HP");
                        changed|=Float("Maximum HP (0 = any)","##maxHP",g.limits.maxHealth,0,2000," HP");
                    }
                    const bool wasPoint=g.overrideAimPoint;
                    changed|=UICheckbox(L("Override aim point"),&g.overrideAimPoint);
                    if(!wasPoint && g.overrideAimPoint)
                        g.point={uint16_t(preset.aimBoneMask),static_cast<int>(OW::PredictionOverrideMode::Auto)};
                    if(g.overrideAimPoint) {
                        int bone=g.point.boneMask==1?1:g.point.boneMask==2?2:g.point.boneMask==4?0:3;
                        static const char* bones[]={"Chest","Head","Neck","Closest"};
                        SettingRow("Aim Bone"); PushControlWidth();
                        if(UISelect("##bone",&bone,bones,4)) {g.point.boneMask=bone==0?4:bone==1?1:bone==2?2:7;changed=true;} ImGui::PopItemWidth();
                        g.point.predictionMode = static_cast<int>(OW::PredictionOverrideMode::Auto);
                        SettingRow("Prediction");
                        ImGui::TextDisabled("Automatic");
                        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Prediction stays enabled. Edit shared weapon and skill data under Prediction Data.");
                    }
                    ImGui::EndTabItem();
                }
                if (ImGui::BeginTabItem(L("Behavior Overrides"))) {
                    const bool wasMotion=g.overrideMotion;
                    changed|=UICheckbox(L("Override motion"),&g.overrideMotion);
                    if(!wasMotion && g.overrideMotion) {
                        g.motion=p.motion;
                        if(!p.overrideMotion) {
                            if(const auto* shared=Config::AimMethodPresetForBehavior(preset.aimBehavior)) g.motion=*shared;
                            else g.motion=CaptureMethodPresetFromCurrent(Config::AimBehaviorMethod(preset.aimBehavior), "Hero motion");
                        }
                    }
                    if(g.overrideMotion) changed|=Motion(g.motion);
                    ImGui::EndTabItem();
                }
                ImGui::EndTabBar();
            }
            if(ImGui::SmallButton(L("Remove hero exception"))) remove=int(i);
            ImGui::TreePop();
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    if(remove>=0) {p.groups.erase(p.groups.begin()+remove);changed=true;}
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(p.groups.size()>=AimPlan::kMaxGroups);
    if(ImGui::Button(L("Add hero exception"))) {
        AimPlan::Group g; g.id=1;
        while(std::any_of(p.groups.begin(),p.groups.end(),[&](const auto& old){return old.id==g.id;})) ++g.id;
        g.name=L("Hero exception"); g.motion=p.motion;
        g.limits={preset.minDistance,preset.maxDistance,preset.fov,p.selection.minHealth,p.selection.maxHealth};
        g.point={uint16_t(preset.aimBoneMask),static_cast<int>(OW::PredictionOverrideMode::Auto)};
        p.groups.push_back(std::move(g));changed=true;
    }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    CloseGroupBox(); if(changed) AimPlan::Normalize(p); return changed;
}
} // namespace UI::AimPlanEditor
```

```hpp
namespace UI {
inline bool BehaviorTuningEditor(OW::Config::AimBehaviorTuning& t,int behavior,
                                 bool showFirePolicy = true) {
    using namespace AimPlanEditor;
    bool changed=false;
    changed|=Float("Speed Scale","##smooth",t.smooth,0,100," %");
    changed|=Float("Base Speed Scale","##base",t.baseSpeed,0,100," %");
    changed|=Float("Pitch Scale","##pitch",t.pitchScale,.1f,3);
    if (showFirePolicy) {
        static const char* const userFireModes[] = {
            "Keep Firing", "Single Shot", "Tracking With Hold"
        };
        const auto policy = OW::ClampFirePolicy(t.firePolicy);
        int mode = policy == OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring ? 0
            : policy == OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot ? 1
            : policy == OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold ? 2 : -1;
        if (mode < 0) {
            SettingRow("Fire Policy");
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Legacy: %s", OW::FirePolicyName(policy));
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("Select a new Fire Behavior to migrate this mode.");
            SettingRow("Migrate to");
            mode = 2;
        } else {
            SettingRow("Fire Policy");
        }
        PushControlWidth();
        if(UISelect("##policy",&mode,userFireModes,IM_ARRAYSIZE(userFireModes))) {
            t.firePolicy = mode == 0
                ? static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring)
                : mode == 1
                    ? static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot)
                    : static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold);
            t.keepFiring=t.firePolicy==static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring) ||
                t.firePolicy==static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold);
            t.autoshot=t.firePolicy==static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot);
            changed=true;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    if(behavior==1||behavior==2||behavior==4) {
        SettingRow("Release to fire");changed|=UICheckbox("##releaseToFire",&t.releaseToFire);
        if(t.releaseToFire) {
            const char* sources[]={"Hold manually","Charge automatically"};int source=t.autoCharge?1:0;
            SettingRow("Charge control");PushControlWidth();
            if(UISelect("##chargeControl",&source,sources,2)) {t.autoCharge=source==1;changed=true;}
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if(t.autoCharge) {

                SettingRow("Aim and fire timing");PushControlWidth();
                changed|=UISelect("##releaseExecution",&t.releaseExecution,timings,2);
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
                if(t.releaseExecution==1) {
                    changed|=Float("Release aim limit","##releaseAimLimit",t.releaseAimTimeoutMs,50,5000," ms");
                    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Hold to charge anywhere. Release to aim and fire once. With no target, or when the aim limit expires, fire at the current crosshair."));
                }
            }
            changed|=Float("Minimum fire charge","##chargeMin",t.minCharge,0,100," %");
            changed|=Float("Charge fallback wait","##chargeFallback",t.chargeFallbackMs,0,10000," ms");
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L(t.autoCharge
                ?"Automatic charging needs a separate aim activation key. Stopping releases the owned button."
                :"Hold the fire button. Release and press it again after each assisted shot."));
            if(!t.autoCharge && (!V2::Output::SupportsMouseMask(V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor)||!V2::Output::ActivePhysicalInput().available))
                ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Manual release is unavailable: this output device needs physical-button monitoring and masking."));
        }
        changed|=Float("Shot Clamp","##shotClamp",t.flickShotClampMs,0,1000," ms");
        changed|=Float("Post-fire Delay","##postFire",t.flickPostFireDelayMs,0,500," ms");
        SettingRow("Trajectory Wait");changed|=UICheckbox("##trajectory",&t.flickTrajectoryWait);
        if(t.flickTrajectoryWait) {
            changed|=Float("Wait Limit","##wait",t.flickTrajectoryWaitMs,0,3000," ms");
            changed|=Float("Apex Window","##apex",t.flickTrajectoryApexWindowMs,0,1000," ms");
        }

    if(behavior==0||behavior==3) {

            changed|=Float("Cap Rise","##capRise",t.startLimiter.capRiseDegPerSec2,0,100000," deg/s2");
            SettingRow("Restart On Target Change");changed|=UICheckbox("##restart",&t.startLimiter.restartOnTargetChange);

        const char* methods[]={"Inherit","Linear","PID","Bezier","Piecewise","Accel Limited","Constant","Hybrid PID","Shuwu","Error response curve","Koi proportional"};
        static_assert(std::size(methods) == OW::Config::kAimMethodCount + 1);

        changed|=Float("Box Padding","##box",t.flick2ndBoxPadding,0,80," px");
        changed|=Float("Inner Radius","##inner",t.flick2ndInnerRadius,0,250," px");

        changed|=Float("Aim Pause","##pause",t.magneticPostFirePauseMs,0,500," ms");
        changed|=Float("Aim Recovery","##recovery",t.magneticRecoveryMs,0,1000," ms");

        SettingRow("Split Delay");PushControlWidth();changed|=UISlider("##delay",&t.moveSplitDelayUs,0,10000,Number(0," us"));ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    OW::Config::NormalizeBehaviorTuning(t);return changed;
```

```hpp
namespace UI {
// Layout follows the Reloaded color card; no gradient storage is added to flat colors.
inline bool ColorPicker(const char* id, ImVec4& color, const std::function<void()>& details = {}) {
    ImGui::PushID(id);
    bool changed=false;
    const float height=(std::max)(26.f,ImGui::GetFontSize()+10.f);
    if(ImGui::ColorButton("##swatch",color,ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaPreviewHalf,ImVec2(26,height)))
        ImGui::OpenPopup("##colorCard");
#ifdef IMGUI_ENABLE_TEST_ENGINE
    ImGuiContext& g=*ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
    IMGUI_TEST_ENGINE_ITEM_INFO(ImGui::GetItemID(),"Color swatch",g.LastItemData.StatusFlags);
#endif
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(258,0),ImVec2(258,1000));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding,ImVec2(14,14));
    if(ImGui::BeginPopup("##colorCard")) {
        auto* state=ImGui::GetStateStorage();
        float hue=state->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID("hue"),0);
        float saturation=state->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID("sat"),0);
        float value=state->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID("val"),0);
        bool external=false;
        for(int i=0;i<4;++i)external|=state->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID(i==0?"lastR":i==1?"lastG":i==2?"lastB":"lastA"),-1)!=(&color.x)[i];
        if(external) {

            if(s>0&&v>0)hue=h;
            if(v>0)saturation=s;
            value=v;
        }
        const float width=ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        auto* draw=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        const auto start=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        const ImVec2 fieldSize(width,width*.82f);
        float r,g,b;ImGui::ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(hue,1,1,r,g,b);
        const auto hueColor=ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(r,g,b,1));
        draw->AddRectFilledMultiColor(start,ImVec2(start.x+width,start.y+fieldSize.y),IM_COL32_WHITE,hueColor,hueColor,IM_COL32_WHITE);
        draw->AddRectFilledMultiColor(start,ImVec2(start.x+width,start.y+fieldSize.y),0,0,IM_COL32_BLACK,IM_COL32_BLACK);
        ImGui::InvisibleButton("##sv",fieldSize);
        if(ImGui::IsItemActive() && ImGui::IsMouseDown(0)) {
            const auto mouse=ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
            saturation=std::clamp((mouse.x-start.x)/width,0.f,1.f);
            value=std::clamp(1-(mouse.y-start.y)/fieldSize.y,0.f,1.f);changed=true;
        }
        if(ImGui::IsItemFocused()) {
            const float step=ImGui::GetIO().KeyShift?.1f:.01f;
            if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow)){saturation=(std::max)(0.f,saturation-step);changed=true;}
            if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow)){saturation=(std::min)(1.f,saturation+step);changed=true;}
            if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_UpArrow)){value=(std::min)(1.f,value+step);changed=true;}
            if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_DownArrow)){value=(std::max)(0.f,value-step);changed=true;}
        }
        const ImVec2 knob(start.x+saturation*width,start.y+(1-value)*fieldSize.y);
        draw->AddCircle(knob,6.5f,IM_COL32(0,0,0,100),24,3);
        draw->AddCircle(knob,5.5f,IM_COL32_WHITE,24,1.7f);
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0,2));
        auto bar=[&](const char* name,float& channel,bool alpha) {
            const auto p=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
            const float height=10;
            if(alpha) {
                const ImVec4 rgb(r,g,b,1);
                const int cells=int(width/5)+1;
                for(int i=0;i<cells;++i)for(int row=0;row<2;++row)
                    draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(p.x+i*5,p.y+row*5),ImVec2((std::min)(p.x+width,p.x+(i+1)*5),p.y+(row+1)*5),
                        (i+row)%2?IM_COL32(140,140,146,255):IM_COL32(200,200,205,255));
                draw->AddRectFilledMultiColor(p,ImVec2(p.x+width,p.y+height),0,ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(rgb),ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(rgb),0);
            } else {
                for(int i=0;i<6;++i) {
                    ImVec4 a,b; a.w=b.w=1;
                    ImGui::ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(i/6.f,1,1,a.x,a.y,a.z);
                    ImGui::ColorConvertHSVtoRGB((i+1)/6.f,1,1,b.x,b.y,b.z);
                    const auto ca=ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(a),cb=ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(b);
                    draw->AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImVec2(p.x+width*i/6,p.y),ImVec2(p.x+width*(i+1)/6,p.y+height),ca,cb,cb,ca);
                }
            }
            ImGui::InvisibleButton(name,ImVec2(width,height));
            if(ImGui::IsItemActive()&&ImGui::IsMouseDown(0)) {channel=std::clamp((ImGui::GetIO().MousePos.x-p.x)/width,0.f,1.f);changed=true;}
            if(ImGui::IsItemFocused()) {
                if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow)){channel=(std::max)(0.f,channel-.01f);changed=true;}
                if(ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow)){channel=(std::min)(1.f,channel+.01f);changed=true;}
            }
            draw->AddRect(ImVec2(p.x+channel*width-2,p.y-2),ImVec2(p.x+channel*width+2,p.y+height+2),IM_COL32_WHITE,2,0,1.5f);
        };
        bar("##hue",hue,false);
        ImGui::ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(hue,saturation,value,r,g,b);
        bar("##alpha",color.w,true);
        if(changed) {color.x=r;color.y=g;color.z=b;}
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0,3));
        int mode=state->GetInt(ImGui::GetID("format"),0);
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(57);
        const char* formats[]={"HEX","RGB"};
        if(ImGui::Combo("##format",&mode,formats,2))state->SetInt(ImGui::GetID("format"),mode);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if(mode==0) {
            char hex[12];std::snprintf(hex,sizeof(hex),"#%02X%02X%02X%02X",int(color.x*255+.5f),int(color.y*255+.5f),int(color.z*255+.5f),int(color.w*255+.5f));
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(111);
            if(ImGui::InputText("##hex",hex,sizeof(hex),ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase)) {
                const char* digits=hex[0]=='#'?hex+1:hex;
                const auto length=std::strlen(digits);
                unsigned parsed=0;bool valid=length==6||length==8;
                for(size_t i=0;i<length;++i)valid&=(digits[i]>='0'&&digits[i]<='9')||(digits[i]>='A'&&digits[i]<='F');
                if(valid&&std::sscanf(digits,"%x",&parsed)==1) {
                    if(length==6)parsed=(parsed<<8)|unsigned(color.w*255+.5f);
                    color=ImVec4(((parsed>>24)&255)/255.f,((parsed>>16)&255)/255.f,((parsed>>8)&255)/255.f,(parsed&255)/255.f);changed=true;
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rgb[3]={int(color.x*255+.5f),int(color.y*255+.5f),int(color.z*255+.5f)};
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(111);
            if(ImGui::InputInt3("##rgb",rgb)) {
                color.x=std::clamp(rgb[0],0,255)/255.f;color.y=std::clamp(rgb[1],0,255)/255.f;color.z=std::clamp(rgb[2],0,255)/255.f;changed=true;
            }
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        int percent=int(color.w*100+.5f);ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(44);
        if(ImGui::DragInt("##opacity",&percent,1,0,100,"%d%%",ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp)) {color.w=std::clamp(percent,0,100)/100.f;changed=true;}
        if(changed) {
            float h,s,v;ImGui::ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(color.x,color.y,color.z,h,s,v);
            if(s>0&&v>0)hue=h;if(v>0)saturation=s;value=v;
        }
        state->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID("hue"),hue);state->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID("sat"),saturation);state->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID("val"),value);
        for(int i=0;i<4;++i)state->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID(i==0?"lastR":i==1?"lastG":i==2?"lastB":"lastA"),(&color.x)[i]);
        if(details){ImGui::Separator();details();}
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();ImGui::PopID();return changed;
}
}
```

`src/ui/DynamicFovEditor.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include "ui/Theme.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

namespace UI {
inline bool DynamicFovEditor(OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset& preset) {
    using namespace OW::Config;
    preset=ValidateDynamicFovPresetValue(preset);
    bool changed=false;
    ImGui::PushID(preset.id);
    auto* storage=ImGui::GetStateStorage();
    const auto selectedId=ImGui::GetID("selectedPoint");
    int selected=std::clamp(storage->GetInt(selectedId,0),0,preset.pointCount-1);
    float view=storage->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID("viewDistance"),100);
    const bool zh=uiLanguage==1;
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);
    if(ImGui::SliderFloat(zh?"距离视野 (m)":"Distance view (m)",&view,10,500,"%.0f"))
        storage->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID("viewDistance"),view);
    const ImVec2 start=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    const ImVec2 area((std::max)(150.f,ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x),220);
    const ImVec2 origin(start.x+38,start.y+12),size(area.x-50,area.y-40);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(preset.worldDiameterM > 0);
    ImGui::InvisibleButton("##dynamicFovGraph",area);
    const auto graph=ImGui::GetItemID();
    auto* draw=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    draw->AddRectFilled(start,ImVec2(start.x+area.x,start.y+area.y),Theme::kColControl,6);
    auto screen=[&](float distance,float fov) {
        return ImVec2(origin.x+distance/view*size.x,origin.y+(1-fov/kMaxFovDeg)*size.y);
    };
    for(int i=0;i<=4;++i) {
        const float fraction=i*.25f;
        draw->AddLine(screen(view*fraction,0),screen(view*fraction,kMaxFovDeg),Theme::kColStroke);
        draw->AddLine(screen(0,kMaxFovDeg*fraction),screen(view,kMaxFovDeg*fraction),Theme::kColStroke);
        char text[24];std::snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%.0f",view*fraction);
        draw->AddText(ImVec2(origin.x+size.x*fraction-8,origin.y+size.y+5),Theme::kColTextDim,text);
        std::snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%.0f",kMaxFovDeg*fraction);
        draw->AddText(ImVec2(start.x+2,screen(0,kMaxFovDeg*fraction).y-6),Theme::kColTextDim,text);
    }
    const auto mouse=ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
    auto addPoint=[&](float distance,float fov) {
        if(preset.pointCount>=kMaxDynamicFovPoints)return false;
        distance=std::clamp(distance,0.f,kMaxDynamicFovDistanceM);
        int index=0;
        while(index<preset.pointCount && preset.points[index].distanceM<distance)++index;
        if((index>0 && distance-preset.points[index-1].distanceM<.01f)||
            (index<preset.pointCount && preset.points[index].distanceM-distance<.01f))return false;
        for(int i=preset.pointCount;i>index;--i)preset.points[i]=preset.points[i-1];
        preset.points[index]={distance,ClampFovDeg(fov)};
        ++preset.pointCount;selected=index;return true;
    };
    if(ImGui::IsItemHovered() && ImGui::IsMouseDoubleClicked(0))
        changed|=addPoint((mouse.x-origin.x)/size.x*view,(1-(mouse.y-origin.y)/size.y)*kMaxFovDeg);
    else if(ImGui::IsItemClicked()) {
        float nearest=144;
        for(int i=0;i<preset.pointCount;++i) {
            const auto p=screen(preset.points[i].distanceM,preset.points[i].fovDeg);
            const float distance=(p.x-mouse.x)*(p.x-mouse.x)+(p.y-mouse.y)*(p.y-mouse.y);
            if(distance<nearest){nearest=distance;selected=i;}
        }
        storage->SetInt(graph,nearest<144?selected:-1);
    }
    const int dragging=storage->GetInt(graph,-1);
    if(ImGui::IsItemActive() && ImGui::IsMouseDragging(0,1) && dragging>=0 && dragging<preset.pointCount) {
        auto& p=preset.points[dragging];
        const float low=dragging?preset.points[dragging-1].distanceM+.01f:0;
        const float high=dragging+1<preset.pointCount?preset.points[dragging+1].distanceM-.01f:500;
        p.distanceM=std::clamp((mouse.x-origin.x)/size.x*view,low,high);
        p.fovDeg=ClampFovDeg((1-(mouse.y-origin.y)/size.y)*kMaxFovDeg);
        selected=dragging;changed=true;
    }
    draw->PushClipRect(origin,ImVec2(origin.x+size.x,origin.y+size.y),true);
    auto previous=screen(0,EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(preset,0,kDefaultFovDeg));
    for(int i=1;i<=160;++i) {
        const float distance=view*i/160;
        const auto next=screen(distance,EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(preset,distance,kDefaultFovDeg));
        draw->AddLine(previous,next,Theme::kColAccent,2);previous=next;
    }
    for(int i=0;preset.worldDiameterM<=0 && i<preset.pointCount;++i) {
        const auto p=screen(preset.points[i].distanceM,preset.points[i].fovDeg);
        draw->AddCircleFilled(p,i==selected?6.f:4.f,Theme::kColText,24);
        if(i==selected)draw->AddCircle(p,9,Theme::kColAccent,24,2);
    }
    draw->PopClipRect();
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",zh?"双击添加节点；拖动节点调整距离和 FOV":"Double-click to add; drag a point to edit distance and FOV");
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(preset.pointCount>=kMaxDynamicFovPoints);
    if(ImGui::Button(zh?"添加节点":"Add point")) {
        int gap=0;
        for(int i=1;i<preset.pointCount-1;++i)
            if(preset.points[i+1].distanceM-preset.points[i].distanceM>preset.points[gap+1].distanceM-preset.points[gap].distanceM)gap=i;
        const float distance=(preset.points[gap].distanceM+preset.points[gap+1].distanceM)*.5f;
        changed|=addPoint(distance,EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(preset,distance,kDefaultFovDeg));
    }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(preset.pointCount<=2);
    if(ImGui::Button(zh?"删除节点":"Delete point")) {
        for(int i=selected;i<preset.pointCount-1;++i)preset.points[i]=preset.points[i+1];
        --preset.pointCount;selected=(std::min)(selected,preset.pointCount-1);changed=true;
    }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    for(int i=0;i<preset.pointCount;++i) {
        ImGui::SameLine();ImGui::PushID(i);
        char label[16];std::snprintf(label,sizeof(label),"%02d",i+1);
        if(ImGui::Selectable(label,i==selected,0,ImVec2(26,ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))selected=i;
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    auto& point=preset.points[selected];
    const float low=selected?preset.points[selected-1].distanceM+.01f:0;
    const float high=selected+1<preset.pointCount?preset.points[selected+1].distanceM-.01f:500;
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);
    changed|=ImGui::DragFloat(zh?"距离 (m)":"Distance (m)",&point.distanceM,.1f,low,high,"%.2f",ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);
    changed|=ImGui::DragFloat("FOV (deg)",&point.fovDeg,.1f,kMinFovDeg,kMaxFovDeg,"%.2f",ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
    point.distanceM=std::clamp(point.distanceM,low,high);point.fovDeg=ClampFovDeg(point.fovDeg);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    float preview=storage->GetFloat(ImGui::GetID("previewDistance"),10);
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);
    if(ImGui::SliderFloat(zh?"预览距离 (m)":"Preview distance (m)",&preview,0,500,"%.1f"))storage->SetFloat(ImGui::GetID("previewDistance"),preview);
    ImGui::SameLine();ImGui::Text("FOV %.2f deg",EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(preset,preview,kDefaultFovDeg));
    storage->SetInt(selectedId,selected);
    ImGui::PopID();return changed;
}
}
```

```hpp
template <std::size_t Count>
bool UISelectMapped(const char* label,
                           int* currentValue,
                           const char* const (&items)[Count],
                           const int (&mappedValues)[Count],
                           int fallbackValue) {
    int selection = -1;
    int fallbackSelection = 0;
    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < Count; ++index) {
        if (mappedValues[index] == *currentValue)
            selection = static_cast<int>(index);
        if (mappedValues[index] == fallbackValue)
            fallbackSelection = static_cast<int>(index);
    }

    const bool repairedUnsupportedValue = selection < 0;
    if (repairedUnsupportedValue)
        selection = fallbackSelection;

    const bool selected = UISelect(
        label,
        &selection,
        items,
        static_cast<int>(Count));
    if (selected || repairedUnsupportedValue) {
        *currentValue = mappedValues[static_cast<std::size_t>(selection)];
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

`src/ui/FontFile.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
namespace UI::OverlayFonts {
inline std::string error;
inline std::vector<unsigned char> Read(const std::string& path) {
    std::ifstream file(std::filesystem::u8path(path),std::ios::binary|std::ios::ate);
    if(!file)return {};
    const auto length=file.tellg();
    if(length<12||length>32*1024*1024)return {};
    std::vector<unsigned char> bytes(static_cast<size_t>(length));file.seekg(0);
    if(!file.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(bytes.data()),bytes.size()))return {};
    auto u16=[&](size_t i){return (unsigned(bytes[i])<<8)|unsigned(bytes[i+1]);};
    auto u32=[&](size_t i){return (uint32_t(bytes[i])<<24)|(uint32_t(bytes[i+1])<<16)|(uint32_t(bytes[i+2])<<8)|bytes[i+3];};
    size_t face=0;
    if(std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"ttcf",4)==0){
        if(bytes.size()<16||u32(8)==0||u32(8)>1024||12ull+4ull*u32(8)>bytes.size())return {};
        face=u32(12);
    }
    if(face>bytes.size()-12)return {};
    const auto signature=u32(face);
    if(signature!=0x00010000&&signature!=0x4F54544F&&signature!=0x74727565)return {};
    const unsigned count=u16(face+4);
    if(!count||count>256||face+12ull+16ull*count>bytes.size())return {};
    bool cmap=false,head=false,hhea=false,hmtx=false,maxp=false,outlines=false;
    for(unsigned i=0;i<count;++i){const size_t at=face+12+i*16;
        const auto offset=u32(at+8),size=u32(at+12);
        if(offset>bytes.size()||size>bytes.size()-offset)return {};
        const auto tag=u32(at);
        cmap|=tag==0x636D6170&&size>=4;head|=tag==0x68656164&&size>=54;
        hhea|=tag==0x68686561&&size>=36;hmtx|=tag==0x686D7478&&size>=4;maxp|=tag==0x6D617870&&size>=6;
        outlines|=(tag==0x676C7966||tag==0x43464620)&&size>0;
    }
    if(!cmap||!head||!hhea||!hmtx||!maxp||!outlines)return {};
    return bytes;
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "Game/AimResponseCurve.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include <imgui.h>

namespace UI {
inline bool ResponseCurveEditor(OW::AimResponseCurve::Points& points) {
    using namespace OW::AimResponseCurve;
    bool changed=false;
    int preset=3;
    for(int i=0;i<3;++i) if(points==Preset(i)) preset=i;
    const char* labels[]={"Linear","Smooth","Responsive","Custom"};
    SettingRow("Response preset");PushControlWidth();
    if(UISelect("##responsePreset",&preset,labels,4) && preset<3) {points=Preset(preset);changed=true;}
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Error / effective FOV -> correction / effective FOV"));
    const ImVec2 origin=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    const ImVec2 size((std::max)(120.f,ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x),160.f);
    ImGui::InvisibleButton("Response curve graph",size);
    auto* draw=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    auto screen=[&](float x,float y){return ImVec2(origin.x+x*size.x,origin.y+(1-y)*size.y);};
    draw->AddRectFilled(origin,ImVec2(origin.x+size.x,origin.y+size.y),ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_FrameBg),4);
    for(int i=1;i<4;++i) {
        draw->AddLine(screen(i*.25f,0),screen(i*.25f,1),ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border));
        draw->AddLine(screen(0,i*.25f),screen(1,i*.25f),ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border));
    }
    static ImGuiID dragGraph=0;static int dragPoint=-1;
    const ImGuiID graph=ImGui::GetItemID();
    if(ImGui::IsItemClicked()) {
        const auto mouse=ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
        auto distance=[&](float x,float y){auto p=screen(x,y);return (p.x-mouse.x)*(p.x-mouse.x)+(p.y-mouse.y)*(p.y-mouse.y);};
        dragPoint=distance(points.x1,points.y1)<=distance(points.x2,points.y2)?0:1;dragGraph=graph;
    }
    if(dragGraph==graph && ImGui::IsMouseDown(0) && ImGui::IsItemActive()) {
        const auto mouse=ImGui::GetIO().MousePos;
        float& x=dragPoint==0?points.x1:points.x2;float& y=dragPoint==0?points.y1:points.y2;
        x=(std::clamp)((mouse.x-origin.x)/size.x,0.f,1.f);
        y=(std::clamp)(1-(mouse.y-origin.y)/size.y,0.f,1.f);changed=true;
    }
    auto previous=screen(0,0);
    for(int i=1;i<=128;++i) {
        const float x=i/128.f;auto next=screen(x,Evaluate(points,x));
        draw->AddLine(previous,next,ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_PlotLines),2);previous=next;
    }
    draw->AddLine(screen(0,0),screen(points.x1,points.y1),ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled));
    draw->AddLine(screen(1,1),screen(points.x2,points.y2),ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled));
    draw->AddCircleFilled(screen(points.x1,points.y1),6,ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive));
    draw->AddCircleFilled(screen(points.x2,points.y2),6,ImGui::GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive));
    // Numeric controls provide the same operation without dragging.
    float* values[]={&points.x1,&points.y1,&points.x2,&points.y2};
    const char* names[]={"Control 1 X","Control 1 Y","Control 2 X","Control 2 Y"};
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i) {
        SettingRow(names[i]);PushControlWidth();ImGui::PushID(i);
        changed|=ImGui::DragFloat("##coordinate",values[i],.005f,0,1,"%.3f",ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::PopID();ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    if(ImGui::Button(L("Reset curve"))) {points={};changed=true;}
    Normalize(points);return changed;
}
}
```

`src/ui/SlotSelector.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "SlotSelector.hpp"
#include <imgui.h>
#include <algorithm>

namespace UI::Slots {
Command Render(std::span<const Item> items, int selected, int limit, bool chinese) {
    Command command;
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(chinese ? "方案" : "Scheme");
    const float available=ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    const float buttonWidth=(std::max)(36.0f,ImGui::CalcTextSize("12 *").x+14.0f);
    const float height=(std::max)(30.0f,ImGui::GetFontSize()+8);
    const int perRow=(std::max)(1, static_cast<int>((available-76)/(buttonWidth+6)));
    for(int i=0;i<static_cast<int>(items.size());++i) {
        if(i%perRow)ImGui::SameLine(0,6);
        const auto& item=items[i];
        ImGui::PushID(std::to_string(item.id).c_str());
        if(i==selected)ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button,ImVec4(.53f,.04f,.14f,1));
        const auto label=std::to_string(i+1)+(item.enabled?" *":"");
        if(ImGui::Button(label.c_str(),ImVec2(buttonWidth,height)))command={Action::Select,i};
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s · %s",item.name.c_str(),
            chinese?(item.enabled?"已启用":"已停用"):(item.enabled?"Enabled":"Disabled"));
        if(i==selected)ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    // 极窄可用区域时另起一行，保证增删按钮仍在滚动区域内。
    if(!items.empty() && ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x>=76)ImGui::SameLine(0,8);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(static_cast<int>(items.size())>=limit);
    if(ImGui::Button("+##AddScheme",ImVec2(30,height)))command={Action::Add,selected};
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", chinese?"新增方案：复制参数，清空绑定并停用":"Add scheme: copy settings, clear bindings and disable");
    ImGui::SameLine(0,6);
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(items.size()<=1);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border,ImVec4(1.0f,.55f,.45f,1));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameBorderSize,1.0f);
    if(ImGui::Button("-##DeleteScheme",ImVec2(30,height)))command={Action::Remove,selected};
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",chinese?"删除当前方案":"Delete selected scheme");
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if(items.size()<=1)ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",chinese?"至少保留一个方案":"Keep at least one scheme");
    else if(static_cast<int>(items.size())>=limit)
        ImGui::TextDisabled(chinese?"已达到 %d 个方案上限":"Maximum of %d schemes",limit);
    ImGui::Spacing();
    return command;
}
}
```

```cpp
const char* Get(UiText id, bool chinese) {
    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(id);
    if (index >= static_cast<size_t>(IM_ARRAYSIZE(kUiText)))
        return "";

    const char* text = chinese
        ? kUiText[index].zh
        : kUiText[index].en;
    return (text && text[0] != '\0') ? text : kUiText[index].en;
}
```

```cpp
#include "Theme.hpp"
#include "config/UiPreferences.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
namespace UI::Theme {
ImFont* s_regularFont = nullptr;
ImFont* s_boldFont = nullptr;
ImFont* s_titleFont = nullptr;
bool Initialize() {
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.ConfigErrorRecoveryEnableTooltip = false;
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard;

    if (!s_regularFont && !io.Fonts->Locked) {
        ImFontConfig fontConfig;
        fontConfig.OversampleH = 3;
        fontConfig.OversampleV = 2;
        fontConfig.PixelSnapH = false;
        fontConfig.RasterizerMultiply = 1.12f;
        auto addUiFont = [&](const char* primaryPath, const char* fallbackPath, float size) {
            ImFont* font = io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(primaryPath, size, &fontConfig);
            if (font) {
                ImFontConfig fallbackConfig;
                fallbackConfig.MergeMode = true;
                fallbackConfig.OversampleH = fontConfig.OversampleH;
                fallbackConfig.OversampleV = fontConfig.OversampleV;
                fallbackConfig.PixelSnapH = fontConfig.PixelSnapH;
                fallbackConfig.RasterizerMultiply = fontConfig.RasterizerMultiply;
                io.Fonts->AddFontFromFileTTF(fallbackPath, size, &fallbackConfig,
                                             io.Fonts->GetGlyphRangesChineseFull());
            }
            return font;
        };
        s_regularFont = addUiFont("C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\segoeui.ttf",
                                  "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyh.ttc", 15.0f);
        s_boldFont = addUiFont("C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\segoeuib.ttf",
                               "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyhbd.ttc", 15.0f);
        s_titleFont = addUiFont("C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\segoeuib.ttf",
                                "C:\\Windows\\Fonts\\msyhbd.ttc", 18.0f);
        if (!s_titleFont)
            s_titleFont = s_boldFont;
        if (s_regularFont)
            io.FontDefault = s_regularFont;
    } else if (s_regularFont) {
        io.FontDefault = s_regularFont;
    }

    Preferences::Load(OW::Config::uiLanguage);
    Apply();
    return s_regularFont != nullptr || !io.Fonts->Locked;
}
void Apply() {
    const auto& preferences = Preferences::values;
    const bool graphite = preferences.skin == 1, violet = preferences.skin == 2;
    kColShell0 = graphite ? IM_COL32(21,23,25,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(15,16,19,255) : IM_COL32(16,17,21,255);
    kColShell1 = graphite ? IM_COL32(23,25,28,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(17,18,22,255) : IM_COL32(18,19,24,255);
    kColShell2 = IM_COL32(11,12,16,255);
    kColPanel = graphite ? IM_COL32(29,32,36,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(22,23,29,255) : IM_COL32(25,27,33,255);
    kColPanelSoft = (kColPanel & ~IM_COL32_A_MASK) | ((preferences.consoleLayers ? 225u : 255u) << IM_COL32_A_SHIFT);
    kColControl = graphite ? IM_COL32(40,44,49,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(32,33,43,255) : IM_COL32(34,37,45,255);
    kColControlHover = graphite ? IM_COL32(48,53,60,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(44,43,57,255) : IM_COL32(43,47,57,255);
    kColControlHot = graphite ? IM_COL32(57,62,71,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(51,47,67,255) : IM_COL32(51,55,66,255);
    kColStroke = graphite ? IM_COL32(65,70,79,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(54,54,67,255) : IM_COL32(52,56,68,255);
    kColText = IM_COL32(240,241,245,255);
    kColTextMuted = IM_COL32(218,221,230,255);
    kColTextDim = IM_COL32(169,174,187,255);
    kColAccent = preferences.customAccent ? ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(preferences.accent) :
        graphite ? IM_COL32(190,200,220,255) : violet ? IM_COL32(171,147,255,255) : IM_COL32(228,17,67,255);
    ImVec4 accent = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccent);
    kColAccentDark = ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4(accent.x*.28f,accent.y*.28f,accent.z*.28f,1));
    kColAccentSoft = (kColAccent & ~IM_COL32_A_MASK) | (56u << IM_COL32_A_SHIFT);
    kColAccentGlow = (kColAccent & ~IM_COL32_A_MASK) | (28u << IM_COL32_A_SHIFT);
    ImGuiStyle& style   = ImGui::GetStyle();
    const float scale=(std::max)(1.f,style.FontScaleDpi);
    style.AntiAliasedLines = true;
    style.AntiAliasedFill  = true;
    style.WindowRounding    = 0.0f;
    style.FrameRounding     = graphite ? 5.0f : 6.0f;
    style.ScrollbarRounding = 0.0f;
    style.GrabRounding      = 4.0f;
    style.TabRounding       = 0.0f;
    style.WindowBorderSize  = 0.0f;
    style.FrameBorderSize   = 0.0f;
    style.PopupRounding     = 8.0f;
    style.PopupBorderSize   = 1.0f;
    style.WindowPadding     = ImVec2(0, 0);
    style.FramePadding      = ImVec2(8*scale,4*scale);
    style.ItemSpacing       = ImVec2(8*scale,6*scale);
    style.ItemInnerSpacing  = ImVec2(6*scale,4*scale);
    style.ScrollbarSize     = 7.0f*scale;

    ImVec4* colors = style.Colors;
    colors[ImGuiCol_WindowBg]          = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColShell0);
    colors[ImGuiCol_FrameBg]           = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControl);
    colors[ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered]    = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControlHover);
    colors[ImGuiCol_FrameBgActive]     = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControlHot);
    colors[ImGuiCol_Button]            = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControl);
    colors[ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered]     = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControlHover);
    colors[ImGuiCol_ButtonActive]      = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControlHot);
    colors[ImGuiCol_Header]            = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColControl);
    colors[ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered]     = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccent);
    colors[ImGuiCol_HeaderActive]      = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccentDark);
    colors[ImGuiCol_CheckMark]         = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccent);
    colors[ImGuiCol_SliderGrab]        = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccent);
    colors[ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive]  = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(IM_COL32(0xf0, 0x1a, 0x49, 0xFF));
    colors[ImGuiCol_Text]              = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColText);
    colors[ImGuiCol_TextDisabled]      = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextDim);
    colors[ImGuiCol_Border]            = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColStroke);
    colors[ImGuiCol_TitleBg]           = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColPanel);
    colors[ImGuiCol_TitleBgActive]     = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColPanel);
    colors[ImGuiCol_Separator]         = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColStroke);
    colors[ImGuiCol_ScrollbarBg]       = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(IM_COL32(0x0a, 0x0b, 0x0e, 0xE0));
    colors[ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrab]     = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(IM_COL32(0x34, 0x37, 0x40, 0xD8));
    colors[ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrabHovered] = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccent);
    colors[ImGuiCol_PopupBg]           = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColPanel);
    colors[ImGuiCol_NavCursor] = ImVec4(1.0f, 0.86f, 0.40f, 1.0f);
    colors[ImGuiCol_TextSelectedBg]    = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccentSoft);
}
```
