`src/ui/WorkspaceShell.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "Search.hpp"
#include "runtime/LauncherBridge.hpp"
#include "WorkspaceShell.hpp"
#include "Theme.hpp"
#include "config/UiPreferences.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include <imgui_internal.h>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

namespace UI::Workspace {
namespace {
void StatusToast(const Model& model, float scale) {
    if (model.status.empty()) return;
    const float fadeIn = std::clamp(model.statusAge / .20f, 0.f, 1.f);
    const float fadeOut = model.saveFailed ? 1.f : std::clamp((4.f - model.statusAge) / .15f, 0.f, 1.f);
    const float alpha = (std::min)(fadeIn, fadeOut);
    if (alpha <= 0.f) return;

    const auto* viewport = ImGui::GetMainViewport();
    const float margin = 16.f * scale;
    const float width = (std::min)(300.f * scale, viewport->WorkSize.x - margin * 2);
    const float textWidth = (std::max)(1.f, width - 58.f * scale);
    const auto textSize = ImGui::CalcTextSize(model.status.c_str(), nullptr, false, textWidth);
    const float height = (std::max)(48.f * scale, textSize.y + 28.f * scale);
    const ImVec2 pos(viewport->WorkPos.x + viewport->WorkSize.x - margin - width,
                     viewport->WorkPos.y + viewport->WorkSize.y - margin - height);
    const ImVec2 end(pos.x + width, pos.y + height);
    auto color = [alpha](ImU32 value) {
        auto rgba = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(value);
        rgba.w *= alpha;
        return ImGui::GetColorU32(rgba);
    };
    // Foreground drawing keeps save feedback outside the layout and mouse hit testing.
    auto* draw = ImGui::GetForegroundDrawList();
    const ImU32 accent = model.saveFailed ? IM_COL32(255, 145, 110, 255) : Theme::kColAccent;
    draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(pos.x, pos.y + 3.f * scale), ImVec2(end.x, end.y + 3.f * scale),
                        color(IM_COL32(0, 0, 0, 55)), 8.f * scale);
    draw->AddRectFilled(pos, end, color(Theme::kColPanel), 8.f * scale);
    draw->AddRect(pos, end, color(Theme::kColStroke), 8.f * scale);
    const ImVec2 badge(pos.x + 23.f * scale, pos.y + height * .5f);
    draw->AddCircleFilled(badge, 11.f * scale, color(Theme::kColControl), 24);
    if (model.saveFailed) {
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(badge.x, badge.y - 5.f * scale), ImVec2(badge.x, badge.y + scale), color(accent), 1.5f * scale);
        draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(badge.x, badge.y + 5.f * scale), scale, color(accent));
    } else {
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(badge.x - 5.f * scale, badge.y), ImVec2(badge.x - scale, badge.y + 4.f * scale), color(accent), 1.5f * scale);
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(badge.x - scale, badge.y + 4.f * scale), ImVec2(badge.x + 6.f * scale, badge.y - 4.f * scale), color(accent), 1.5f * scale);
    }
    draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), ImGui::GetFontSize(), ImVec2(pos.x + 44.f * scale, pos.y + (height - textSize.y) * .5f),
                  color(Theme::kColTextMuted), model.status.c_str(), nullptr, textWidth);
    if (!model.saveFailed) {
        const float remaining = std::clamp(1.f - model.statusAge / 4.f, 0.f, 1.f);
        draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(pos.x + 8.f * scale, end.y - 3.f * scale),
                            ImVec2(pos.x + 8.f * scale + (width - 16.f * scale) * remaining, end.y - scale), color(accent), scale);
    }
}

void Icon(ImDrawList* draw, ImVec2 p, int index, ImU32 color) {
    const float x=p.x+9, y=p.y+9;
    if(index==0) {
        draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(x,y),6,color,20,1.3f);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x,y),1.5f,color);
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x-9,y),ImVec2(x+9,y),color,1.2f);draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x,y-9),ImVec2(x,y+9),color,1.2f);
    } else if(index==1) {
        draw->AddRect(ImVec2(x-5,y-8),ImVec2(x+5,y+8),color,5,0,1.3f);draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x,y-7),ImVec2(x,y-1),color,1.3f);
    } else if(index==2) {
        const ImVec2 points[]={{x+2,y-9},{x-6,y+1},{x,y+1},{x-2,y+9},{x+6,y-2},{x,y-2}};draw->AddPolyline(points,6,color,ImDrawFlags_Closed,1.5f);
    } else if(index==3) {
        for(int i=0;i<3;++i){const float xx=x-7+i*7;draw->AddRect(ImVec2(xx-2,y-5),ImVec2(xx+2,y+5),color,1,0,1.3f);if(i<2)draw->AddLine(ImVec2(xx+2,y),ImVec2(xx+5,y),color,1.3f);}
    } else if(index==4) {
        draw->AddBezierCubic(ImVec2(x-7,y+5),ImVec2(x-6,y-10),ImVec2(x+6,y-10),ImVec2(x+7,y+5),color,1.3f);
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x-8,y+5),ImVec2(x+8,y+5),color,1.3f);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x,y+8),1.5f,color);
    } else if(index==5) {
        draw->AddRect(ImVec2(x-8,y-5),ImVec2(x+8,y+5),color,5,0,1.3f);draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(x,y),3,color,16,1.3f);
    } else if(index==6) {
        draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(x,y),8,color,24,1.3f);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x-3,y-3),1.5f,color);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x+3,y-3),1.5f,color);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x-4,y+2),1.5f,color);
    } else if(index==7||index==10) {
        draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(x,y),8,color,24,1.3f);draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(x,y),4,color,20,1.3f);
    } else if(index==15) {
        draw->AddRect(ImVec2(x-9,y-6),ImVec2(x+9,y+6),color,2,0,1.3f);
        for(int row=0;row<2;++row)for(int col=0;col<4;++col)draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x-6+col*4,y-3+row*5),.8f,color);
    } else {
        for(int row=0;row<3;++row){const float yy=y-6+row*6;draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x-8,yy),ImVec2(x+8,yy),color,1.3f);draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(x+(row==1?4:-3),yy),2.5f,color);}
    }
}

void AccountCard(const Model& model, float width, float height, float scale, bool collapsed, bool zh) {
    const auto pos = ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    const auto& username = V2::Launcher::username;
    const char* name = username.empty() ? "—" : username.c_str();
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button, Theme::kColControl);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered, Theme::kColControlHover);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ButtonActive, Theme::kColControlHot);
    if (ImGui::Button("##AccountCard", ImVec2(width, height))) ImGui::OpenPopup("##AccountPopup");
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(3);
    const char* connection = model.connected ? (zh ? "已连接" : "Connected") : (zh ? "未连接" : "Disconnected");
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s\nTill: Lifetime\n%s%s%s", name, connection,
        model.connected && !model.region.empty() ? " · " : "", model.connected ? model.region.c_str() : "");

    auto* draw = ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    const float cx = pos.x + (collapsed ? width * .5f : 21.0f * scale);
    const float cy = pos.y + height * .5f;
    const ImU32 avatar = Theme::kColTextDim;
    draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(cx, cy - 5.5f * scale), 5.0f * scale, avatar, 20);
    draw->PathLineTo(ImVec2(cx - 10.0f * scale, cy + 8.0f * scale));
    draw->PathBezierCubicCurveTo(ImVec2(cx - 9.0f * scale, cy - 1.0f * scale),
        ImVec2(cx + 9.0f * scale, cy - 1.0f * scale), ImVec2(cx + 10.0f * scale, cy + 8.0f * scale));
    draw->PathBezierCubicCurveTo(ImVec2(cx + 5.0f * scale, cy + 11.0f * scale),
        ImVec2(cx - 5.0f * scale, cy + 11.0f * scale), ImVec2(cx - 10.0f * scale, cy + 8.0f * scale));
    draw->PathFillConvex(avatar);
    const ImU32 connectionColor = model.connected ? IM_COL32(113, 211, 151, 255) : IM_COL32(244, 87, 104, 255);
    const ImVec2 badge(cx + 8.0f * scale, cy + 7.0f * scale);
    draw->AddCircleFilled(badge, 5.0f * scale, Theme::kColControl, 20);
    draw->AddCircleFilled(badge, 3.5f * scale, connectionColor, 20);
    if (!collapsed) {
        const float fontSize = ImGui::GetFontSize();
        const float smallSize = fontSize * .82f;
        const float textY = pos.y + (height - fontSize - smallSize - 2.0f) * .5f;
        const float textX = pos.x + 40.0f * scale;
        const float textRight = pos.x + width - 22.0f * scale;
        const float regionWidth = model.connected ? ImGui::GetFont()->CalcTextSizeA(smallSize, width, 0, model.region.c_str()).x : 0;
        const float nameRight = regionWidth > 0 ? textRight - regionWidth - 8.0f * scale : textRight;
        draw->PushClipRect(ImVec2(textX, pos.y), ImVec2(nameRight, pos.y + height), true);
        draw->AddText(ImVec2(textX, textY), Theme::kColTextMuted, name);
        draw->PopClipRect();
        draw->PushClipRect(ImVec2(textX, pos.y), ImVec2(textRight, pos.y + height), true);
        draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), smallSize, ImVec2(textX, textY + fontSize + 2.0f), Theme::kColTextDim, "Till: Lifetime");
        if (regionWidth > 0)
            draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(), smallSize, ImVec2(textRight - regionWidth, textY + fontSize - smallSize), connectionColor, model.region.c_str());
        draw->PopClipRect();
        const float x = pos.x + width - 12.0f * scale;
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x - 3.0f * scale, cy - 4.0f * scale), ImVec2(x + scale, cy), Theme::kColTextDim, 1.5f * scale);
        draw->AddLine(ImVec2(x + scale, cy), ImVec2(x - 3.0f * scale, cy + 4.0f * scale), Theme::kColTextDim, 1.5f * scale);
    }

    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2(pos.x, pos.y - 6.0f * scale), ImGuiCond_Appearing, ImVec2(0, 1));
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(250.0f * scale, 0), ImGuiCond_Always);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2(14.0f * scale, 12.0f * scale));
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 6.0f * scale);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_PopupBorderSize, 1.0f);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, Theme::kColPanel);
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, Theme::kColStroke);
    if (ImGui::BeginPopup("##AccountPopup")) {
        ImGui::TextDisabled("UNLEASHED");
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::PushTextWrapPos(0);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", name);
        ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(Theme::kColAccent), "Till: Lifetime");
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(connectionColor), "%s%s%s", connection,
            model.connected && !model.region.empty() ? " · " : "", model.connected ? model.region.c_str() : "");
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::Separator();
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(username.empty());
        if (ImGui::Selectable(zh ? "复制 ID" : "Copy ID")) {
            ImGui::SetClipboardText(username.c_str());
            ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleColor(2);
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(3);
}
}
void Render(Model& model, const std::function<void()>& save,
            const std::function<void(int)>& body,
            const std::function<void(float, bool)>& header) {
    const bool zh=OW::Config::uiLanguage==1;
    const float scale=(std::max)(1.f,ImGui::GetFontSize()/15.f);
    auto& preferences=Preferences::values;
    const auto* viewport=ImGui::GetMainViewport();
    ImGui::SetNextWindowPos(viewport->Pos);
    ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(viewport->Size);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding,ImVec2(20,16));
    if(ImGui::Begin("UNDMA V2##workspace",nullptr,ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDecoration|ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove|ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings)) {
        auto* draw=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
        const auto origin=ImGui::GetWindowPos();
        const auto size=ImGui::GetWindowSize();
        if(preferences.consoleLayers) {
            draw->AddRectFilledMultiColor(origin,ImVec2(origin.x+size.x,origin.y+size.y),
                Theme::kColShell0,Theme::kColShell1,Theme::kColShell2,Theme::kColShell0);
            draw->AddLine(ImVec2(origin.x+20,origin.y+1),ImVec2(origin.x+size.x-20,origin.y+1),IM_COL32(255,255,255,26));
        }
        const float width=ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        const auto brand=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        if(model.brandIcon) draw->AddImage(model.brandIcon,brand,ImVec2(brand.x+34,brand.y+34));
        draw->AddText(Theme::s_titleFont?Theme::s_titleFont:ImGui::GetFont(),27,
            ImVec2(brand.x+46,brand.y+2),IM_COL32(239,36,89,255),"UN");
        auto* font=Theme::s_titleFont?Theme::s_titleFont:ImGui::GetFont();
        const float unWidth=font->CalcTextSizeA(27,1000,0,"UN").x;
        draw->AddText(font,27,ImVec2(brand.x+46+unWidth,brand.y+2),Theme::kColText,"LEASHED");
        const float saveWidth=(std::max)(148.f,ImGui::CalcTextSize(model.saveLabel).x+28);
        const float frameHeight=ImGui::GetFrameHeight();
        const float toolbarHeight=(std::max)(30.f,frameHeight);
        const float rowHeight=(std::max)(40.f,toolbarHeight);
        const float gap=ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x;
        const float rowGap=ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y;
        const float brandWidth=46.f+font->CalcTextSizeA(27,1000,0,"UNLEASHED").x+8.f;
        const bool stackedHeader=model.headerWidth>width;
        const float headerWidth=stackedHeader?model.headerColumnWidth:model.headerWidth;
        const float headerHeight=stackedHeader?toolbarHeight*2+rowGap:toolbarHeight;
        const float searchMin=120.f*scale, searchMax=220.f*scale;
        const float singleSearch=width-brandWidth-headerWidth-saveWidth-gap*3;
        const bool singleRow=!stackedHeader && singleSearch>=searchMin;
        float searchWidth=singleRow?(std::min)(searchMax,singleSearch):(std::min)(searchMax,(std::max)(1.f,width-brandWidth-gap));
        float searchX=0, searchY=0, headerX=0, headerY=0, saveX=0, saveY=0;
        if(singleRow) {
            searchX=width-searchWidth-headerWidth-saveWidth-gap*2;
            headerX=searchX+searchWidth+gap;
            saveX=headerX+headerWidth+gap;
        } else {
            if(searchWidth>=searchMin) searchX=width-searchWidth;
            else {searchWidth=(std::min)(searchMax,width);searchY=rowHeight+rowGap;}
            headerY=searchY+rowHeight+rowGap;
            if(headerWidth+gap+saveWidth<=width) {
                headerX=width-headerWidth-saveWidth-gap;
                saveX=headerX+headerWidth+gap;
                saveY=headerY;
            } else {
                saveX=(std::max)(0.f,width-saveWidth);
                saveY=headerY+headerHeight+rowGap;
            }
        }
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(brandWidth,rowHeight));
        static char query[128]{};
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(brand.x+searchX,brand.y+searchY+(rowHeight-frameHeight)*.5f));
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(searchWidth);
        ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##GlobalSearch",zh?"搜索页面和设置…":"Search pages and settings...",query,sizeof(query));
        if(ImGui::IsItemActivated()||ImGui::IsItemEdited())ImGui::OpenPopup("##SearchResults");
        if(ImGui::BeginPopup("##SearchResults")) {
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(300);
            ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##searchQuery",zh?"搜索设置…":"Search settings...",query,sizeof(query));
            if(ImGui::IsWindowAppearing())ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere(-1);
            bool matched=false;
            for(const auto& entry:Search::entries) {
                if(entry.page<0||entry.page>=int(model.pages.size())||!model.pages[entry.page].visible)continue;
                const auto* localized=UI::Text::Label(entry.label,zh);
                if(!query[0]||(!ImStristr(entry.label,nullptr,query,nullptr)&&!ImStristr(localized,nullptr,query,nullptr)))continue;
                matched=true;ImGui::PushID(&entry);
                const auto label=std::string(model.pages[entry.page].label)+" / "+localized;
                if(ImGui::Selectable(label.c_str())){model.selected=entry.page;Search::Go(entry.label,entry.page);query[0]=0;ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();}
                ImGui::PopID();
            }
            for(int i=0;i<int(model.pages.size());++i) {
                const auto& page=model.pages[i];
                if(!page.visible)continue;
                if(!ImStristr(page.label,nullptr,query,nullptr) && !ImStristr(page.group,nullptr,query,nullptr)) continue;
                matched=true;
                const auto label=std::string(page.group)+" / "+page.label;
                if(ImGui::Selectable(label.c_str())) {model.selected=i;query[0]=0;ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();}
            }
            if(ImStristr("Methods 运动方法",nullptr,query,nullptr)) {
                matched=true;
                if(ImGui::Selectable(zh?"共享参数 / 行为模式 / 兼容方法库":"Shared settings / Behavior modes / Legacy methods")) {
                    model.selected=8;query[0]=0;ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                }
            }
            if(!matched) ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",zh?"没有匹配项":"No matching settings");
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
        if(header) {
            ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(brand.x+headerX,brand.y+headerY+(stackedHeader?0.f:(rowHeight-toolbarHeight)*.5f)));
            header(toolbarHeight,stackedHeader);
        }
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(brand.x+saveX,brand.y+saveY+(rowHeight-toolbarHeight)*.5f));
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameRounding,6.f);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button,Theme::kColAccentDark);
        if(ImGui::Button(model.saveLabel,ImVec2(saveWidth,toolbarHeight)))save();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        const float headerBottom=headerY+(stackedHeader?headerHeight:rowHeight);
        const float bottom=(std::max)({rowHeight,searchY+rowHeight,headerBottom,saveY+rowHeight});
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(brand.x,brand.y+bottom));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0,0));
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::Separator();
        ImGui::Spacing();
        const float height=(std::max)(100.f,ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y);
        const bool collapsed=preferences.sidebarCollapsed;
        const float navWidth=collapsed?48.f*scale:(std::min)(190.f*scale,width*.27f);
        const float cardScale=collapsed?scale:(std::min)(scale,(std::max)(1.f,navWidth/190.f));
        const float cardHeight=(std::max)(52.f*cardScale,ImGui::GetFontSize()*2.f+14.f);
        ImGui::BeginGroup();
        const ImVec2 navStart=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
        const float navPadX=collapsed?5.f*scale:20.f;
        const float toggleHeight=(std::max)(28.f,ImGui::GetFrameHeight());
        const float navBodyY=navStart.y+(collapsed?6.f*scale:16.f)+toggleHeight+rowGap;
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(navStart.x+navPadX,navStart.y+(collapsed?6.f*scale:16.f)));
        if(ImGui::Button(collapsed?">##Expand":"<##Collapse",ImVec2((std::max)(1.f,navWidth-navPadX*2),toggleHeight))) {
            preferences.sidebarCollapsed=!preferences.sidebarCollapsed;
            Preferences::Save();
        }
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",collapsed?(zh?"展开导航":"Expand navigation"):(zh?"收起导航":"Collapse navigation"));
        ImGui::SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2(navStart.x,navBodyY));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg,Theme::kColShell1);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding,ImVec2(navPadX,0));
        ImGui::BeginChild("BusinessNavigation",ImVec2(navWidth,(std::max)(1.f,height-cardHeight-(navBodyY-navStart.y)-rowGap)),ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding,
            collapsed?ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar:ImGuiWindowFlags_None);
        const char* group=nullptr;
        for(int order=0;order<int(model.pages.size());++order) {
            const int i=model.pages.size()==16?(order==12?15:order>12?order-1:order):order;
            const auto& page=model.pages[i];
            if(!page.visible)continue;
            if(!group||std::strcmp(group,page.group)!=0) {
                if(group)ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0,10));
                if(!collapsed)ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",page.group);
                group=page.group;
            }
            ImGui::PushID(i);
            const bool selected=model.selected==i;
            const auto p=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
            const float rowWidth=ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
            ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button,selected?Theme::kColAccentDark:Theme::kColShell1);
            if(ImGui::Button("##Page",ImVec2(rowWidth,(std::max)(32.f,ImGui::GetFrameHeight()+4))))model.selected=i;
            ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            auto* nav=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
            const auto color=selected?Theme::kColAccent:Theme::kColTextDim;
            const float rowHeight=(std::max)(32.f,ImGui::GetFrameHeight()+4);
            Icon(nav,ImVec2(p.x+(collapsed?(rowWidth-18.f)*.5f:8.f),p.y+(rowHeight-18.f)*.5f),i,color);
            if(!collapsed)nav->AddText(ImVec2(p.x+34,p.y+(rowHeight-ImGui::GetFontSize())*.5f),selected?Theme::kColText:Theme::kColTextDim,page.label);
            if(selected)nav->AddRectFilled(p,ImVec2(p.x+2,p.y+(std::max)(32.f,ImGui::GetFrameHeight()+4)),Theme::kColAccent,1);
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s / %s",page.group,page.label);
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        AccountCard(model,navWidth,cardHeight,cardScale,collapsed,zh);
        ImGui::EndGroup();
        ImGui::SameLine(0,16);
        ImGui::BeginChild("PageBody",ImVec2(0,height));
        Search::currentPage=model.selected;
        body(model.selected);
        ImGui::EndChild();
    }
    ImGui::End();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
    StatusToast(model, scale);
}
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <functional>
#include <span>
#include <string>
#include <imgui.h>

namespace UI::Workspace {
struct Page { const char* label; const char* group; bool visible = true; };
// 壳只拥有布局；配置编辑、保存和页面业务通过回调交给各自所有者。
struct Model {
    std::span<const Page> pages;
    int selected = 0;
    const char* saveLabel = "保存全部";
    std::string status;
    bool saveFailed = false;
    ImTextureID brandIcon = 0;
    float headerWidth = 0;
    float headerColumnWidth = 0;
    float statusAge = 0;
    bool connected = false;
    std::string region;
};
void Render(Model& model, const std::function<void()>& save,
            const std::function<void(int)>& body,
            const std::function<void(float, bool)>& header = {});
}
```

`src/ui/output/DevicePanels.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "DevicePanels.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include "output/DeviceRegistry.hpp"
#include <array>
#include <vector>

namespace UI::OutputSettings {
namespace {
using V2::Output::DeviceId;

struct Panel {
    DeviceId device;
    void (*fields)(const ConfigChanged&);
    void (*notes)(bool) = nullptr;
    void (*diagnostics)() = nullptr;
    void (*maintenance)() = nullptr;
    void (*resetFeedback)() = nullptr;
};

// UI composition is the only place that binds device identity to a form.
constexpr std::array panels{
    Panel{DeviceId::KmBoxNet, KmBoxNet::DrawFields, nullptr, nullptr,
        KmBoxNet::DrawMaintenance, KmBoxNet::ResetFeedback},
    Panel{DeviceId::KmBoxSerial, KmBoxSerial::DrawFields},
    Panel{DeviceId::Mock, Mock::DrawFields, nullptr, Mock::DrawDiagnostics},
    Panel{DeviceId::Makcu4M, Makcu::DrawFields, Makcu::DrawNotes},
    Panel{DeviceId::Makcu115200, Makcu::DrawFields, Makcu::DrawNotes},
    Panel{DeviceId::Ferrum, Ferrum::DrawFields, Ferrum::DrawNotes},
    Panel{DeviceId::CatBox, CatBox::DrawFields, CatBox::DrawNotes},
    Panel{DeviceId::DhzBox, DhzBox::DrawFields, DhzBox::DrawNotes},
};

const Panel* FindPanel(int legacyDeviceId)
{
    for (const auto& panel : panels) {
        if (static_cast<int>(panel.device) == legacyDeviceId)
            return &panel;
    }
    return nullptr;
}
}

bool SelectDevice(const char* id, int& legacyDeviceId)
{
    const auto choices = V2::Output::DeviceChoices();
    static const std::vector<const char*> labels = [] {
        std::vector<const char*> result;
        for (const auto& choice : V2::Output::DeviceChoices())
            result.push_back(choice.label);
        return result;
    }();
    int selected = 0;
    for (std::size_t index = 0; index < choices.size(); ++index) {
        if (choices[index].legacyId == legacyDeviceId)
            selected = static_cast<int>(index);
    }
    if (!UISelect(id, &selected, labels.data(), static_cast<int>(labels.size())))
        return false;
    legacyDeviceId = choices[static_cast<std::size_t>(selected)].legacyId;
    return true;
}

void DrawConnectionFields(int legacyDeviceId, const ConfigChanged& changed)
{
    if (const auto* panel = FindPanel(legacyDeviceId))
        panel->fields(changed);
}

void DrawDeviceNotes(int legacyDeviceId, bool physicalAvailable)
{
    if (const auto* panel = FindPanel(legacyDeviceId); panel && panel->notes)
        panel->notes(physicalAvailable);
}

void DrawDiagnosticTools(int legacyDeviceId)
{
    if (const auto* panel = FindPanel(legacyDeviceId); panel && panel->diagnostics)
        panel->diagnostics();
}

void DrawMaintenanceTools(int legacyDeviceId)
{
    if (const auto* panel = FindPanel(legacyDeviceId); panel && panel->maintenance)
        panel->maintenance();
}

void ResetDeviceFeedback()
{
    for (const auto& panel : panels) {
        if (panel.resetFeedback)
            panel.resetFeedback();
    }
}
}
```

```cpp
#include "DevicePanels.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include "output/DeviceCapabilities.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "output/AutomaticDeviceSelection.hpp"
#include "Game/Target.hpp"
#include "features/aim/BehaviorController.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include <cstdio>

using namespace UI::Theme;

void DrawMiscOutputPage() {
    const auto device=V2::Output::Describe(V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor);
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s · 移动 %s / 鼠标 %s / 键盘 %s / 物理监测 %s",
        device.name,device.move?"可用":"不支持",device.buttons?"可用":"不支持",
        device.keyboard?"可用":"不支持",device.physicalMonitor?"可用":"不支持");
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Device rate is not measured in this build."));
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("MAKCU Controller / Medius: unavailable until their action mapping and protocol are established."));
    ImGui::Spacing();

    const auto physical=V2::Output::ActivePhysicalInput();
    UI::OutputSettings::DrawDeviceNotes(OW::Config::outputDeviceType, physical.available);
    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupOutputSettings));
    {
        bool outputRuntimeReinitRequested = false;
        static bool outputConnectionTestOk = false;
        static std::string outputConnectionTestMessage;
        static bool gameSensitivityReadOk = false;
        static std::string gameSensitivityReadMessage;
        auto markOutputRuntimeConfigChanged = [&]() {
            outputConnectionTestMessage.clear();
            UI::OutputSettings::ResetDeviceFeedback();
            if (OW::Config::outputEnabled)
                outputRuntimeReinitRequested = true;
        };
        ImGui::PushID("OutputSettings");

        SettingRow(T(UiText::EnableOutput));
        const bool wasOutputEnabled = OW::Config::outputEnabled;
        if (ImGui::Checkbox("##Enable", &OW::Config::outputEnabled)) {
            UI::OutputSettings::ResetDeviceFeedback();
            if (OW::Config::outputEnabled && !wasOutputEnabled) {
                const OutputConnectionTestResult initResult =
                    ApplyOutputRuntimeFromCurrentConfig();
                outputConnectionTestOk = initResult.ok;
                outputConnectionTestMessage = initResult.message;
            } else if (!OW::Config::outputEnabled && wasOutputEnabled) {
                const OutputConnectionTestResult disableResult =
                    ApplyOutputRuntimeFromCurrentConfig();
                outputConnectionTestOk = disableResult.ok;
                outputConnectionTestMessage = disableResult.ok
                    ? T(UiText::Disabled)
                    : disableResult.message;
            }
        }
        if (!outputConnectionTestMessage.empty()) {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(
                outputConnectionTestOk ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                                      : ImVec4(1.00f, 0.28f, 0.28f, 1.0f),
                "%s",
                outputConnectionTestMessage.c_str());
        }

        SettingRow(L("Automatically select connected device"));
        if (ImGui::Checkbox("##AutoDetectDevice", &OW::Config::outputAutoDetect))
            markOutputRuntimeConfigChanged();
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Each device keeps its connection, calibration and delay settings. A working device stays selected; after disconnecting, saved devices are checked again."));
        const auto detection = V2::Output::GetAutomaticDeviceStatus();
        if (OW::Config::outputAutoDetect && !detection.message.empty())
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L(detection.message.c_str()));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::DeviceType));
        PushControlWidth();
        int selectedDevice = OW::Config::outputDeviceType;
        if (UI::OutputSettings::SelectDevice("##DeviceType", selectedDevice)) {
            OW::Config::SelectOutputDeviceProfile(selectedDevice);
            markOutputRuntimeConfigChanged();
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        UI::OutputSettings::DrawConnectionFields(
            OW::Config::outputDeviceType, markOutputRuntimeConfigChanged);
        if (OW::Config::outputAutoDetect && UIActionButton(L("Detect again"), 104.0f))
            markOutputRuntimeConfigChanged();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::BaseCountsRad));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputFloat("##CountsPerRadian", &OW::Config::outputCountsPerRadian,
                          1.0f, 10.0f, "%.1f");
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Manual device relative mouse counts per radian. Calibration overrides this value until calibration is cleared."));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::CurrentGameSens));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputFloat("##GameSens", &OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivity,
                          0.0f, 0.0f, "%.2f");
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Manual current in-game sensitivity. Auto-read uses a separate runtime value and falls back to this when unavailable."));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::AutoReadGameSens));
        if (UICheckbox("##AutoReadGameSens", &OW::Config::autoReadGameMouseSensitivity)) {
            gameSensitivityReadMessage.clear();
            if (OW::Config::autoReadGameMouseSensitivity) {
                gameSensitivityReadOk = OW::RefreshAutoGameMouseSensitivity(true);
                char buffer[96] = {};
                std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer),
                    gameSensitivityReadOk ? "live %.2f" : "not available",
                    OW::Config::detectedGameMouseSensitivity);
                gameSensitivityReadMessage = buffer;
            } else {
                OW::Config::detectedGameMouseSensitivity = 0.0f;
                OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivityAutoDetected = false;
            }
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Reads current in-game sensitivity from the live singleton path when available, with input.MouseScaleX/Y as the World fallback. Manual sensitivity remains the final fallback."));
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::ReadGameSens), 64.0f)) {
            float detectedSensitivity = 0.0f;
            uint64_t sourceObject = 0;
            gameSensitivityReadOk = OW::TryReadGameMouseSensitivity(detectedSensitivity, &sourceObject);
            char buffer[128] = {};
            if (gameSensitivityReadOk) {
                if (OW::Config::autoReadGameMouseSensitivity) {
                    OW::Config::detectedGameMouseSensitivity = detectedSensitivity;
                    OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivityAutoDetected = true;
                } else {
                    OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivity = detectedSensitivity;
                    OW::Config::gameMouseSensitivityAutoDetected = false;
                    OW::Config::detectedGameMouseSensitivity = 0.0f;
                }
                std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "read %.2f", detectedSensitivity);
                Diagnostics::Aim("game_sens.manual_read value=%.6f object=0x%llX autoRead=%d",
                    detectedSensitivity,
                    static_cast<unsigned long long>(sourceObject),
                    OW::Config::autoReadGameMouseSensitivity ? 1 : 0);
            } else {
                std::snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "read failed");
            }
            gameSensitivityReadMessage = buffer;
        }
        if (!gameSensitivityReadMessage.empty()) {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(
                gameSensitivityReadOk ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                                      : ImVec4(1.00f, 0.28f, 0.28f, 1.0f),
                "%s",
                gameSensitivityReadMessage.c_str());
        }
        if (OW::Config::autoReadGameMouseSensitivity)
            OW::RefreshAutoGameMouseSensitivity();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::EffectiveGameSens));
        PushControlWidth();
        float effectiveGameSensitivity = OW::Config::EffectiveGameMouseSensitivity();
        ImGui::InputFloat("##EffectiveGameSens", &effectiveGameSensitivity,
                          0.0f, 0.0f, "%.2f",
                          ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("The sensitivity value currently used by Auto Sens Scale. It is DMA-read when auto-read succeeds, otherwise manual."));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::HostDpiDma));
        PushControlWidth();
        float detectedHostDpi = OW::Config::hostMouseDpiAutoDetected
            ? OW::Config::detectedHostMouseDpi
            : 0.0f;
        ImGui::InputFloat("##HostDpiDisplay", &detectedHostDpi, 0.0f, 0.0f, "%.0f",
                          ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::MouseDpi));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputFloat("##MouseDpi", &OW::Config::hostMouseDpi,
                          0.0f, 0.0f, "%.0f");
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::ReferenceGameSens));
        const float useCurrentButtonWidth = 88.0f;
        const float useCurrentSpacing = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemInnerSpacing.x;
        const float referenceWidth = MaxFloat(
            80.0f,
            ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - useCurrentButtonWidth - useCurrentSpacing);
        ImGui::PushItemWidth(referenceWidth);
        ImGui::InputFloat("##ReferenceGameSens", &OW::Config::referenceGameSensitivity,
                          0.0f, 0.0f, "%.2f");
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("The in-game sensitivity used when Base Counts/Rad or calibration was measured."));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button(T(UiText::UseCurrent), ImVec2(useCurrentButtonWidth, ControlHeight()))) {
            OW::Config::referenceGameSensitivity = OW::Config::EffectiveGameMouseSensitivity();
        }

        SettingRow(T(UiText::AutoSensScale));
        UICheckbox("##AutoScaleGameSens", &OW::Config::autoScaleByGameSensitivity);
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Scales device counts by reference game sensitivity divided by current game sensitivity."));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::InputDelayMs));
        PushControlWidth();
        UISlider("##InputDelay", &OW::Config::outputInputDelayMs,
                                       0.0f, 20.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::BlockOutputWhenMenuOpen));
        bool suppressOutputWhileMenuOpen =
            OW::Config::outputSuppressOutputWhileMenuOpen.load(
                std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (UICheckbox(
                "##SuppressOutputWhileMenuOpen",
                &suppressOutputWhileMenuOpen)) {
            OW::Config::outputSuppressOutputWhileMenuOpen.store(
                suppressOutputWhileMenuOpen,
                std::memory_order_release);
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("When enabled, device mouse and keyboard output commands are skipped while this menu is open."));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::ConnectionTest));
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Test), 72.0f)) {
            const OutputConnectionTestResult testResult = TestOutputConnection();
            outputConnectionTestOk = testResult.ok;
            outputConnectionTestMessage = testResult.message;
        }
        if (!outputConnectionTestMessage.empty()) {
            ImGui::PushTextWrapPos();
            ImGui::TextColored(
                outputConnectionTestOk ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                                      : ImVec4(1.00f, 0.28f, 0.28f, 1.0f),
                "%s",
                outputConnectionTestMessage.c_str());
            ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();
        }
        ImGui::Spacing();
        if (ImGui::CollapsingHeader(L("Advanced device tools"))) {
        SettingRow(T(UiText::DebugLogging));
        ImGui::Checkbox("##Debug", &OW::Config::outputDebugLog);

        UI::OutputSettings::DrawDiagnosticTools(OW::Config::outputDeviceType);

        // ---- Counts-per-radian auto-calibration button ----
        SettingRow(T(UiText::CountsCalibration));
        {
            static std::string calibrationStatus;
            static bool calibrationFailed = false;
            const bool wasCalibrated = OW::Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian > 0.0f;
            if (ImGui::Button(OW::Config::calibrationInProgress ? T(UiText::Calibrating) : T(UiText::Calibrate),
                              ImVec2(72.0f, ControlHeight()))) {
                if (!OW::Config::calibrationInProgress) {
                    const float result = OW::CalibrateSensitivity();
                    calibrationFailed = !(result > 0.0f);
                    calibrationStatus = L(calibrationFailed
                        ? "Calibration failed. Previous values were kept; check connection, camera, output device and output pause state."
                        : "Calibration completed. Settings will save automatically after 4 seconds.");
                }
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Sends a known device movement and measures the view angle change to compute actual counts per radian.\nRequires the game to be running and in a state where mouse movement changes view angles.\nWarning: This will move the remote machine's mouse cursor!"));
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (wasCalibrated) {
                char buf[128];
                std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Yaw: %.1f c/rad @ %.2f",
                    OW::Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian,
                    OW::Config::referenceGameSensitivity);
                if (OW::Config::calibratedPitchCountsPerRadian > 0.0f) {
                    std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), "Yaw: %.1f / Pitch: %.1f c/rad @ %.2f",
                        OW::Config::calibratedCountsPerRadian,
                        OW::Config::calibratedPitchCountsPerRadian,
                        OW::Config::referenceGameSensitivity);
                }
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f), "%s", buf);
            } else {
                ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.60f, 0.60f, 0.60f, 1.0f), "%s", T(UiText::NotCalibrated));
            }
            if (!calibrationStatus.empty())
                ImGui::TextColored(calibrationFailed ? ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.35f, 1.0f)
                                                     : ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f),
                                   "%s", calibrationStatus.c_str());
        }

        UI::OutputSettings::DrawMaintenanceTools(OW::Config::outputDeviceType);

        }

        if (outputRuntimeReinitRequested) {
            const OutputConnectionTestResult initResult =
                ApplyOutputRuntimeFromCurrentConfig();
            outputConnectionTestOk = initResult.ok;
            outputConnectionTestMessage = initResult.message;
        }


        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}
```

```cpp
#include "ui/output/DevicePanels.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
using namespace UI::Theme;

#include "output/DeviceMaintenance.hpp"

namespace UI::OutputSettings::KmBoxNet {
namespace {
bool outputNetworkRestartOk = false;
std::string outputNetworkRestartMessage;
bool outputFirewallOk = false;
std::string outputFirewallMessage;
}
void ResetFeedback()
{
    outputNetworkRestartMessage.clear();
    outputFirewallMessage.clear();
}
void DrawFields(const ConfigChanged& changed)
{
    SettingRow(T(UiText::Ip));
    PushControlWidth();
    ImGui::InputText("##Ip", OW::Config::outputIp, IM_ARRAYSIZE(OW::Config::outputIp));
    if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit())
        changed();
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();

    SettingRow(T(UiText::Port));
    PushControlWidth();
    ImGui::InputInt("##Port", &OW::Config::outputPort, 0, 0);
    if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) {
        OW::Config::NormalizeOutputPorts();
        changed();
    }
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();

    SettingRow(T(UiText::MonitorPort));
    PushControlWidth();
    int effectiveMonitorPort = OW::Config::EffectiveOutputMonitorPort();
    ImGui::InputInt(
        "##MonitorPort",
        &effectiveMonitorPort,
        0,
        0,
        ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
        ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Effective KMBox monitor UDP port. Auto mode keeps this synced to the recommended port."));

    if (ImGui::TreeNodeEx((std::string(L("Advanced")) + "###OutputMonitorPort").c_str())) {
        SettingRow("Manual Monitor Port");
        if (UICheckbox("##MonitorPortManualOverride", &OW::Config::outputMonitorPortManualOverride)) {
            OW::Config::NormalizeOutputPorts();
            changed();
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Advanced override. Auto mode uses the recommended monitor port derived from the command port."));

        if (OW::Config::outputMonitorPortManualOverride) {
            SettingRow(T(UiText::MonitorPort));
            PushControlWidth();
            ImGui::InputInt("##ManualMonitorPort", &OW::Config::outputMonitorPort, 0, 0);
            if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit()) {
                OW::Config::NormalizeOutputPorts();
                changed();
            }
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Manual monitor UDP port. It will be repaired if it matches the command port."));
        }
        ImGui::TreePop();
    }

    SettingRow(T(UiText::Mac));
    PushControlWidth();
    ImGui::InputText("##Mac", OW::Config::outputMac, IM_ARRAYSIZE(OW::Config::outputMac));
    if (ImGui::IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit())
        changed();
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
}
void DrawMaintenance()
{
    {
        SettingRow(T(UiText::RestartNic));
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::RestartNic), 104.0f)) {
            const auto restartResult = V2::Output::RestartConfiguredNetworkAdapter(OW::Config::outputDeviceType);
            outputNetworkRestartOk = restartResult.ok;
            outputNetworkRestartMessage = restartResult.message;
        }
    }
    if (!outputNetworkRestartMessage.empty()) {
        ImGui::TextColored(
            outputNetworkRestartOk ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                                  : ImVec4(1.00f, 0.28f, 0.28f, 1.0f),
            "%s",
            outputNetworkRestartMessage.c_str());
    }
    {
        SettingRow(T(UiText::MonitorFirewall));
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::FixFirewall), 112.0f)) {
            const auto firewallResult = V2::Output::AllowConfiguredMonitorFirewall(OW::Config::outputDeviceType);
            outputFirewallOk = firewallResult.ok;
            outputFirewallMessage = firewallResult.message;
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Adds an elevated inbound UDP allow rule for this executable and disables matching block rules on the KMBox monitor port."));
        if (!outputFirewallMessage.empty()) {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(
                outputFirewallOk ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                                : ImVec4(1.00f, 0.28f, 0.28f, 1.0f),
                "%s",
                outputFirewallMessage.c_str());
        }
    }
}
}
```

`src/ui/output/mock/Panel.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "ui/output/DevicePanels.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
using namespace UI::Theme;

#include "output/MockDiagnostics.hpp"

namespace UI::OutputSettings::Mock {
namespace {
constexpr const char* kMockFaultModes[] = {"None", "Output Timeout", "Drop Output"};
}
void DrawFields(const ConfigChanged&)
{
    const V2::Output::MockHardwareSnapshot snapshot = V2::Output::SnapshotMock();
    SettingRow(T(UiText::MockStatus));
    ImGui::TextColored(
        snapshot.initialized ? ImVec4(0.30f, 0.90f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
                             : ImVec4(0.85f, 0.65f, 0.25f, 1.0f),
        "%s",
        snapshot.initialized ? T(UiText::Ready) : T(UiText::NotInitialized));
}
void DrawDiagnostics()
{
    V2::Output::MockHardwareSnapshot snapshot = V2::Output::SnapshotMock();

    SettingRow(T(UiText::MockFault));
    PushControlWidth();
    int faultMode = static_cast<int>(snapshot.faultMode);
    if (UISelect("##MockFaultMode", &faultMode, kMockFaultModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kMockFaultModes))) {
        faultMode = std::clamp(faultMode, 0, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kMockFaultModes) - 1);
        V2::Output::SetMockFaultMode(static_cast<V2::Output::MockFaultMode>(faultMode));
        snapshot = V2::Output::SnapshotMock();
    }
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();

    SettingRow(T(UiText::MockReset));
    if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Reset), 72.0f))
        V2::Output::ResetMock();

    snapshot = V2::Output::SnapshotMock();
    SettingRow(T(UiText::MockStats));
    ImGui::Text("events=%llu moves=%llu buttons=%llu keys=%llu masks=%llu out=0x%02X masked=0x%02X",
        snapshot.totalEvents,
        snapshot.moveEvents,
        snapshot.buttonEvents,
        snapshot.keyboardEvents,
        snapshot.maskEvents,
        snapshot.outputMouseButtons,
        snapshot.maskedButtons);
}
}
```

`src/ui/pages/AimPage.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <Windows.h>
#include <shellapi.h>

#include "Features/UI.hpp"
#include "ui/WorkspaceShell.hpp"
#include "ui/SlotSelector.hpp"
#include "ui/Text.hpp"

#include "vision/ContourService.hpp"
using UI::Text::UiText;
using UI::Text::kUiLanguageOptions;
#include "output/DeviceCapabilities.hpp"
#include "game/profiles/ProfileState.hpp"
#include "Features/UiLabels.hpp"
#include "Features/UiValueFormat.hpp"
using namespace UI::ValueFormat;
#include "output/MockDiagnostics.hpp"
#include "output/OutputRuntime.hpp"
#include "Utils/Config.hpp"
#include "Game/HeroSkills.hpp"
#include "Game/HeroSettings.hpp"
#include "Game/Offsets.hpp"
#include "Game/Overwatch.hpp"
#include "Game/Target.hpp"
#include "Game/Structs.hpp"
#include "Game/WeaponSpec.hpp"
#include "Renderer/Overlay.hpp"
#include "Renderer/Renderer.hpp"
#include "Utils/Diagnostics.hpp"
#include "Utils/InputLabels.hpp"
#include "Utils/ProcessConnection.hpp"
#include "resource.h"
#include <imgui.h>
#include <imgui_internal.h>

#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include "ui/AimPlanEditor.hpp"
#include "ui/BehaviorTuningEditor.hpp"
using namespace UI::Theme;

namespace {

enum class AimFireMode : int {
    KeepFiring = 0,
    SingleShot = 1,
    TrackingWithHold = 2,
    Legacy = 3,
};

constexpr const char* kAimFireModes[] = {
    "Keep Firing",
    "Single Shot",
    "Tracking With Hold",
    "Legacy policy (choose a new behavior)",
};

constexpr const char* kAimFireModesZh[] = {
    "持续按住",
    "单发",
    "跟踪并持续按住",
    "旧版策略（请选择新行为）",
};

AimFireMode AimFireModeFromPolicy(int policy)
{
    switch (OW::ClampFirePolicy(policy)) {
    case OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring:
        return AimFireMode::KeepFiring;
    case OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot:
        return AimFireMode::SingleShot;
    case OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold:
        return AimFireMode::TrackingWithHold;
    default:
        return AimFireMode::Legacy;
    }
}

int AimFirePolicyFromMode(AimFireMode mode)
{
    switch (mode) {
    case AimFireMode::KeepFiring:
        return static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring);
    case AimFireMode::SingleShot:
        return static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::SingleShot);
    case AimFireMode::TrackingWithHold:
    default:
        return static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold);
    }
}

}

void UI::AimbotPage() {
    state.selectedTypeIndex = ClampHeroSelectionIndex(state.selectedTypeIndex);
    const HeroOption* selectedHero = &kHeroOptions[state.selectedTypeIndex];
    constexpr ActionSlotKind slotKind = ActionSlotKind::Aim;

    // ---- Enabled action-slot selector for the current hero ----
    const int previousSlot = state.aimHeroSegActive;
    const bool slotSelectorChanged = UIActionSlotSelector(slotKind, selectedHero->heroId);
    state.aimHeroSegActive = ActiveHeroPresetSlotIndex(slotKind);
    if (slotSelectorChanged || previousSlot != state.aimHeroSegActive)
        ApplySelectedTypePreset();

    bool presetChanged = false;
    bool slotEnabledChanged = false;
    OW::Config::HeroPreset activePreset{};
    OW::Config::AimScopeRequirement activeScopeRequirement =
        OW::Config::AimScopeRequirement::All;

    auto refreshActivePreset = [&]() {
        state.selectedTypeIndex = ClampHeroSelectionIndex(state.selectedTypeIndex);
        selectedHero = &kHeroOptions[state.selectedTypeIndex];
        const bool isGlobal = selectedHero->heroId == 0;
        activePreset = isGlobal
            ? OW::Config::GetSystemHeroPreset()
            : GetHeroActionPresetOrDefault(slotKind, selectedHero->heroId, state.aimHeroSegActive);
        activeScopeRequirement = OW::Config::AimScopeRequirement::All;
        if (!isGlobal) {
            OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset activeSlot{};
            if (OW::Config::TryGetHeroAimSlot(
                    selectedHero->heroId,
                    state.aimHeroSegActive,
                    activeSlot)) {
                activeScopeRequirement = activeSlot.scopeRequirement;
            }
        }
    };
    refreshActivePreset();
    OW::Config::ResolveHeroBehaviorMode(activePreset);
    // Prediction is now an automatic runtime capability.  Keep the legacy
    // fields readable for migration, but normalize the active Slot to the
    // single new semantic before it is saved again.
    if (activePreset.predictionMode != static_cast<int>(OW::PredictionOverrideMode::Auto) ||
        !activePreset.prediction) {
        activePreset.predictionMode = static_cast<int>(OW::PredictionOverrideMode::Auto);
        activePreset.prediction = true;
        presetChanged = true;
    }

    PushHeroActionSlotControlId(slotKind, selectedHero->heroId, state.aimHeroSegActive);

    ImGui::TextUnformatted(L("Basic Options"));
    slotEnabledChanged |= UIActionSlotEnabledCheckbox(slotKind, *selectedHero, "##aimSlotEnabled", kAimbotHeroLabelWidth);
    ImGui::Spacing();
    UITwoColumns([&]() {
        UIGroupBox(L("Target Eligibility"));
            // Target Team
            SettingRow(L("Target Team"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            const char* const kTeamLabels[] = { L("Enemies"), L("Allies"), L("All") };
            presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimTeam", &activePreset.targetTeam, kTeamLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kTeamLabels));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            // Enemy-only Slots do not need ally-specific controls.  Keep the
            // stored ally values for a later All/Ally selection, but only
            // expose them when the selected target team can include allies.
            if (activePreset.targetTeam != 0) {
                SettingRow(L("Ally key"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UIKeyBinding("##allyKey", &activePreset.allyKey,
                                              KeyBindingStorage::AimActivationIndex);
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
                SettingRow(L("Ally HP limit"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISlider("##allyHp", &activePreset.allyHealthMaxPercent,0.f,100.f,Number(0," %"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
                SettingRow(L("Ally skeleton"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISkeletonBoneMultiSelect("##allyBones",&activePreset.allyBoneMask);
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }
            SettingRow(L("Protection filter"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            presetChanged |= UICheckbox("##targetableFilter",&activePreset.requireTargetable);
            if(ImGui::IsItemHovered())ImGui::SetTooltip("%s",L("Skips targets with a fresh, explicitly known protection signal."));

            // Visibility is the user-facing form of the legacy ignoreInvisible bool.
            SettingRow(L("Visibility"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            const char* const kVisibility[] = { L("Visible Only"), L("All") };
            int visibility = activePreset.ignoreInvisible ? 0 : 1;
            if (UISelect("##aimVisibility", &visibility, kVisibility, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kVisibility))) {
                activePreset.ignoreInvisible = visibility == 0;
                presetChanged = true;
            }
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            const bool leakShotSupported = activePreset.aimBehavior == OW::Config::kAimBehaviorFlick ||
                activePreset.aimBehavior == OW::Config::kAimBehaviorMagneticTrigger;
            SettingRow(L("Leak shot"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!leakShotSupported && !activePreset.contourEnabled);
            presetChanged |= UICheckbox("##aimContour", &activePreset.contourEnabled);
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled))
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1
                    ? (leakShotSupported ? "对原生不可见的目标，用新鲜采集画面确认露出部位。" : "漏打适用于 Flick 和磁性扳机。")
                    : (leakShotSupported ? "Uses fresh capture frames to confirm exposed parts of hidden targets." : "Available with Flick and Magnetic Trigger."));
            if (activePreset.contourEnabled) {
                V2::Vision::Settings captureSettings;
                const auto captureFrame = V2::Vision::GetService().Snapshot(captureSettings);
                const auto captureStatus = V2::Vision::GetService().Status();
                const bool zh = OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1;
                const char* captureMessage = nullptr;
                if (!captureSettings.enabled || captureStatus.state == V2::Vision::ServiceState::Stopped)
                    captureMessage = zh ? "漏打采集已停止" : "Leak shot capture stopped";
                else if (captureStatus.state == V2::Vision::ServiceState::Faulted)
                    captureMessage = zh ? "漏打采集失败" : "Leak shot capture failed";
                else if (captureStatus.state == V2::Vision::ServiceState::Starting)
                    captureMessage = zh ? "漏打采集连接中" : "Leak shot capture starting";
                else if (!captureFrame)
                    captureMessage = zh ? "漏打等待新画面" : "Leak shot waiting for a fresh frame";
                if (captureMessage) {
                    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImVec4(1.0f, 0.64f, 0.25f, 1.0f));
                    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", captureMessage);
                    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
                }
                if (ImGui::SmallButton(zh ? "打开采集设置" : "Open capture settings")) {
                    state.activeTab = TAB_MISC;
                    state.miscSubTab = 7;
                }
            }

            // Max Distance
            SettingRow(L("Max Distance"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimMaxDist", &activePreset.maxDistance, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(0, " m"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            // Min Distance
            SettingRow(L("Min Distance"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimMinDist", &activePreset.minDistance, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(0, " m"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(L("Max Head Distance"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimMaxHead", &activePreset.maxHeadDistance, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(0, " m"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(L("Fast Target Limit"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimMaxTargetSpeed", &activePreset.maxTargetSpeedMps,
                                      0.0f, 100.0f, AtOrBelow("Unlimited", 0, Number(1, " m/s")));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("0 means unlimited. Faster targets stay out of the Basic candidate set.");
        presetChanged |= UI::AimPlanEditor::HealthLimits(activePreset);
        CloseGroupBox();
    }, [&]() {
        UIGroupBox(L("Activation & Action"));

            SettingRow(L("Aim Activation Key"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UIKeyBinding("##aimActivationKey", &activePreset.key,
                                          KeyBindingStorage::AimActivationIndex);
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            int scopeFilter = -1;
            if (OW::HeroUsesScopedStanceActions(selectedHero->heroId)) {
                const char* const scopeLabels[] = { L("All"), L("Scoped Only") };
                scopeFilter = static_cast<int>(activeScopeRequirement);
                SettingRow(L("Scope Requirement"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimScopeRequirement", &scopeFilter, scopeLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(scopeLabels));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }

            // Action Profile
            SettingRow(L("Action Profile"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UIAttackActionSelect("##aimAttack", &activePreset.trigger.action,
                                                  selectedHero->heroId, scopeFilter);
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        CloseGroupBox();
        UIGroupBox(L("Behavior & Fire"));
            SettingRow(L("Behavior mode"),kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
            int chosenMode=activePreset.aimBehaviorPresetId;
            if(UISelectAimBehaviorPreset("##aimBehaviorMode",&chosenMode,-1,nullptr)) {
                OW::Config::StoreHeroBehaviorMode(activePreset);
                activePreset.aimBehaviorPresetId=chosenMode;
                OW::Config::ResolveHeroBehaviorMode(activePreset);presetChanged=true;
            }
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if(ImGui::IsItemHovered())ImGui::SetTooltip("%s: %s + %s",L("Mode structure"),L(kAimBehavior[activePreset.aimBehavior]),L(kAimMethod[activePreset.aimMethod]));

            SettingRow(L("Fire behavior"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            const int storedFirePolicy = activePreset.firePolicy;
            const AimFireMode currentFireMode = AimFireModeFromPolicy(storedFirePolicy);
            const char* const* fireModeLabels = OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1
                ? kAimFireModesZh : kAimFireModes;
            const int action = activePreset.trigger.action;
            const auto* weapon = OW::ResolveWeaponSpec(selectedHero->heroId, action);
            std::array<AimFireMode, 4> choices{};
            std::array<const char*, 4> labels{};
            int fireChoiceCount = 0;
            int selectedFireChoice = -1;
            const auto addFireChoice = [&](AimFireMode mode) {
                if (mode == currentFireMode) selectedFireChoice = fireChoiceCount;
                labels[fireChoiceCount] = fireModeLabels[static_cast<int>(mode)];
                choices[fireChoiceCount++] = mode;
            };
            if (OW::ResolveGeneratedFireMouseButton(weapon, action) >= 0) {
                addFireChoice(AimFireMode::KeepFiring);
                addFireChoice(AimFireMode::SingleShot);
            }
            if (activePreset.aimBehavior == OW::Config::kAimBehaviorTracking &&
                OW::ResolveTrackingHoldMouseButton(weapon, action) >= 0)
                addFireChoice(AimFireMode::TrackingWithHold);
            if (selectedFireChoice < 0)
                addFireChoice(currentFireMode);
            if (UISelect("##aimFireMode", &selectedFireChoice, labels.data(), fireChoiceCount) &&
                choices[selectedFireChoice] != AimFireMode::Legacy) {
                const AimFireMode fireMode = choices[selectedFireChoice];
                activePreset.firePolicy = AimFirePolicyFromMode(fireMode);
                activePreset.keepFiring = fireMode != AimFireMode::SingleShot;
                activePreset.autoshot = fireMode == AimFireMode::SingleShot;
                activePreset.requireActionHeld = false;
                presetChanged = true;
            }
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) {
                if (choices[selectedFireChoice] == AimFireMode::Legacy) {
                    ImGui::SetTooltip(L("Legacy internal policy %s is still loaded. Select one of the three user-facing Fire behaviors to migrate this Slot."),
                                      OW::FirePolicyName(OW::ClampFirePolicy(storedFirePolicy)));
                } else {
                    ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1
                        ? "持续按住随激活键生效。单发每次按下最多提交一次。跟踪并持续按住随跟踪会话生效。"
                        : "Keep Firing follows the activation key. Single Shot submits at most one shot per press. Tracking With Hold follows the tracking session.");
                }
            }

            SettingRow(L("Skeleton"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISkeletonBoneMultiSelect("##aimSkeleton", &activePreset.aimBoneMask);
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Choose All or combine groups, for example Head + Feet."));
            SettingRow(L("Bone selection"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            const char* boneSelectionModes[] = { L("Only"), L("Prefer"), L("Closest") };
            activePreset.boneSelectionMode = std::clamp(activePreset.boneSelectionMode, 0, 2);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimBoneSelectionMode", &activePreset.boneSelectionMode,
                                      boneSelectionModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(boneSelectionModes));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (activePreset.boneSelectionMode == 1) {
                SettingRow(L("Preferred bone"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                const char* preferredBones[] = { L("Chest"), L("Head"), L("Neck") };
                activePreset.preferredBone = OW::Config::NormalizeAimBone(activePreset.preferredBone);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimPreferredBone", &activePreset.preferredBone,
                                          preferredBones, IM_ARRAYSIZE(preferredBones));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }

        CloseGroupBox();
    });

    ImGui::SetNextItemOpen(state.aimAdvanced, ImGuiCond_Always);
    state.aimAdvanced = ImGui::CollapsingHeader(L("Advanced Options"));
    if (state.aimAdvanced) {
        UITwoColumns([&]() {
        UIGroupBox(L("FOV & Prediction Entry"));
            const char* const kFovModeLabels[] = { L("Fixed"), L("Dynamic Preset") };
            activePreset.fovMode = OW::Config::ClampFovMode(activePreset.fovMode);
            if (activePreset.fovMode == OW::Config::kFovModeDynamicPreset &&
                !OW::Config::FindDynamicFovPreset(activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId)) {
                activePreset.fovMode = OW::Config::kFovModeFixed;
                activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId = -1;
            }

            SettingRow(L("FOV Mode"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            if (UISelect("##aimFovMode", &activePreset.fovMode, kFovModeLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kFovModeLabels))) {
                activePreset.fovMode = OW::Config::ClampFovMode(activePreset.fovMode);
                if (activePreset.fovMode == OW::Config::kFovModeFixed) {
                    activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId = -1;
                } else if (!OW::Config::Read_dynamicFovPresets().empty()) {
                    activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId = OW::Config::Read_dynamicFovPresets().front().id;
                }
                presetChanged = true;
            }
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            if (activePreset.fovMode == OW::Config::kFovModeDynamicPreset) {
                SettingRow(L("FOV Preset"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISelectDynamicFovPreset("##aimDynamicFovPreset",
                                                          &activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId,
                                                          false);
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
                if (!OW::Config::FindDynamicFovPreset(activePreset.dynamicFovPresetId)) {
                    ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1.0f, 0.64f, 0.25f, 1.0f),
                                       L("Create a Dynamic FOV preset in Misc first."));
                }
            } else {
                SettingRow(L("FOV (deg)"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimFov", &activePreset.fov,
                                          OW::Config::kMinFovDeg, OW::Config::kMaxFovDeg, Number(0, " deg"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }

            SettingRow(L("Predict FOV Entry"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            presetChanged |= UICheckbox("##aimPredictFovEntry", &activePreset.predictFovEntry);
            if (activePreset.predictFovEntry) {
                SettingRow(L("Entry Horizon"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimFovEntryHorizon", &activePreset.fovEntryPredictionMs, 0.0f, 250.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow(L("Outside Margin"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimFovEntryMargin", &activePreset.fovEntryMaxOutsideDeg, 0.0f, 15.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }

            presetChanged |= UIPredictionAlgorithmSelect("##aimPredictionAlgorithm",
                &activePreset.predictionAlgorithm, kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);

            if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Prediction Data")))
                state.activeTab = TAB_PREDICTION;

        CloseGroupBox();
        }, [&]() {
        UIGroupBox(L("Target Ranking"));
            const char* const kPriorityLabels[] = { L("Lowest FOV"), L("Lowest HP"), L("Distance"), L("Smart") };
            SettingRow(L("Target Priority"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimPriority", &activePreset.priority, kPriorityLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kPriorityLabels));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            presetChanged |= UI::AimPlanEditor::Policy(activePreset, true, false);
        CloseGroupBox();

        UIGroupBox(L("Target Switching"));
            const char* const kTraceLabels[] = { L("Strict"), L("Relaxed"), L("Off") };
            const char* const kUnlockLabels[] = { L("Anytime"), L("On Release"), L("Never") };
            SettingRow(L("Trace Condition"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimTrace", &activePreset.traceCondition, kTraceLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kTraceLabels));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            // Retarget hysteresis
            SettingRow(L("Retarget Hysteresis"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimStick", &activePreset.stickiness, 0.0f, 100.0f, AtOrAbove("Max", 100, Number(1, " %")));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            // Unlock Condition
            SettingRow(L("Unlock Condition"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISelect("##aimUnlock", &activePreset.unlockCondition, kUnlockLabels, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kUnlockLabels));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            // Lock Time
            SettingRow(L("Lock Time"), kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimLockTime", &activePreset.lockTime, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, " ms", 10));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        CloseGroupBox();
        });

        UITwoColumns([&]() {
            UIGroupBox(L("Behavior Tuning"));
            SettingRow(L("Global response scale"));
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##slotBaseSpeed", &activePreset.baseSpeed, 0, 100, Number(1, " %"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            SettingRow(L("Hitbox Scale"), kAimbotLeftLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            presetChanged |= UISlider("##aimHitbox", &activePreset.hitbox,
                                      OW::Config::kMinHitboxScalePercent,
                                      OW::Config::kMaxHitboxScalePercent, Number(0, " %"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            if (ImGui::Button(L("Edit motion...")))
                ImGui::OpenPopup("##MotionEditor");
            CloseGroupBox();
        }, [&]() {
            UIGroupBox(L("Hero Overrides"));
            if (ImGui::Button(L("Edit hero overrides...")))
                ImGui::OpenPopup("##ExceptionEditor");
            CloseGroupBox();
        });
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(300,180),ImVec2(ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkSize.x-24,ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkSize.y-24));
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(650,650),ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
        if(ImGui::BeginPopup("##MotionEditor",ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings)) {
            if(ImGui::Button(L("Restore mode defaults"))) {OW::Config::ResolveHeroBehaviorMode(activePreset,true);presetChanged=true;}
            presetChanged|=UI::BehaviorTuningEditor(activePreset,activePreset.aimBehavior,false);
            presetChanged|=UI::AimPlanEditor::Motion(activePreset.aimPlan.motion,false);
            if(activePreset.aimBehavior==OW::Config::kAimBehaviorFlick2nd && activePreset.flick2ndInnerMethod>=0 &&
                activePreset.flick2ndInnerMethod!=activePreset.aimMethod) {
                auto& motion=OW::Config::EnsureSlotMotion(activePreset,activePreset.flick2ndInnerMethod);
                if(ImGui::CollapsingHeader(L("Second stage motion parameters")))presetChanged|=UI::AimPlanEditor::Motion(motion,false);
            }
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(300,180),ImVec2(ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkSize.x-24,ImGui::GetMainViewport()->WorkSize.y-24));
        ImGui::SetNextWindowSize(ImVec2(680,650),ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver);
        if(ImGui::BeginPopup("##ExceptionEditor",ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings)) {
            presetChanged|=UI::AimPlanEditor::Editor(activePreset);
            ImGui::EndPopup();
        }
    }
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", L("Shared presets"));
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit behavior preset"))) { state.activeTab = TAB_MISC; state.miscSubTab = 2; }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit method preset"))) { state.activeTab = TAB_MISC; state.miscSubTab = 2; }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit FOV preset"))) { state.activeTab = TAB_MISC; state.miscSubTab = 4; }
    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
        ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Mode structure is shared. Slot parameters stay independent."));

    if(presetChanged) OW::Config::StoreHeroBehaviorMode(activePreset);
    if (selectedHero->heroId == 0) {
        if (presetChanged)
            OW::Config::SetSystemAimPreset(activePreset);
    } else {
        if (presetChanged) {
            SetHeroActionPreset(slotKind, selectedHero->heroId, state.aimHeroSegActive, activePreset);
            ApplyHeroActionPresetToGlobals(slotKind, activePreset);
        } else if (slotEnabledChanged &&
                   IsHeroActionSlotEnabled(slotKind, selectedHero->heroId, state.aimHeroSegActive)) {
            ApplyHeroActionPresetToGlobals(slotKind, activePreset);
        }
    }

    ImGui::PopID();
}
```
