#include "Game/HeroSettings.hpp"
#include "ui/EditorSupport.hpp"
#include "Alerts/Service.hpp"
#include "Game/AbilityIcons.hpp"
#include "features/alerts/Speech.hpp"
#include <cstring>

namespace {
using namespace V2::Alerts;

bool EditMessage(const char* id, std::string& message, const char* hint, float width = -1) {
    char buffer[kMaxMessageBytes+1]{};
    std::memcpy(buffer, message.data(), (std::min)(message.size(), kMaxMessageBytes));
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(width > 0 ? width : (std::max)(1.0f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 8.0f));
    if (!ImGui::InputTextWithHint(id, hint, buffer, sizeof(buffer))) return false;
    message = buffer;
    return true;
}

void PreviewButton(const std::string& message, std::string& preview, bool zh) {
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(zh ? "试听###preview" : "Preview###preview")) preview = message;
}

void ReservedAlert(const char* title, bool zh) {
    UIGroupBox(title);
    bool enabled = false;
    ImGui::BeginDisabled();
    UICheckbox(zh ? "开启###enabled" : "Enable###enabled", &enabled);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", zh ? "预留，等待接入检测" : "Detection pending");
    CloseGroupBox();
}
}

void UI::AlertPage() {
    using namespace V2::Alerts;
    const bool zh = OW::Config::uiLanguage == OW::Config::kUiLanguageChineseSimplified;
    const uint64_t localHero=CurrentHeroOption().heroId;
    auto heroSettings=V2::HeroSettings::Get(localHero);
    auto settings=heroSettings.alerts;
    const auto shared=GetSettings();
    settings.voice=shared.voice;settings.volume=shared.volume;settings.outputDevice=shared.outputDevice;
    bool edited = false;
    std::string preview;
    ImGui::PushID("AlertPage");
    UIGroupBox(zh ? "声音与输出" : "Voice and output");
    static auto devices = PlaybackDevices();
    SettingRow(zh ? "输出设备" : "Playback device", kDefaultLabelWidth);
    PushControlWidth();
    const auto foundDevice = std::find_if(devices.begin(), devices.end(), [&](const auto& item) { return item.id == settings.outputDevice; });
    const char* selected = settings.outputDevice.empty() ? (zh ? "系统默认播放设备" : "System playback default")
        : foundDevice != devices.end() ? foundDevice->name.c_str() : (zh ? "所选设备不可用" : "Selected device unavailable");
    if (ImGui::BeginCombo("##device", selected)) {
        for (const auto& device : devices) {
            const char* label = device.name.empty() ? (zh ? "系统默认播放设备" : "System playback default") : device.name.c_str();
            ImGui::PushID(device.id.c_str());
            if (ImGui::Selectable(label, device.id == settings.outputDevice)) {
                settings.outputDevice = device.id; edited = true;
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        ImGui::EndCombo();
    }
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    SettingRow(zh ? "播报声音" : "Voice", kDefaultLabelWidth);
    const char* voicesZh[]{"中文女声", "中文男声"};
    const char* voicesEn[]{"Chinese / Female", "Chinese / Male"};
    PushControlWidth();
    edited |= UISelect("##voice", &settings.voice, zh ? voicesZh : voicesEn, 2);
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    SettingRow(zh ? "音量" : "Volume", kDefaultLabelWidth);
    PushControlWidth();
    edited |= ImGui::SliderInt("##volume", &settings.volume, 0, 100, "%d%%");
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    if (ImGui::Button(zh ? "刷新设备与声音" : "Refresh devices and voice", ImVec2(0, ControlHeight()))) {
        devices = PlaybackDevices(); RetrySpeech();
    }
    const auto speech = GetStatus();
    const char* state = zh ? "声音未启动" : "Voice stopped";
    switch (speech.state) {
    case SpeechState::Preparing: state = zh ? "正在准备离线声音…" : "Preparing offline voice..."; break;
    case SpeechState::Ready: state = zh ? "离线声音已就绪" : "Offline voice ready"; break;
    case SpeechState::Speaking: state = zh ? "正在播报" : "Speaking"; break;
    case SpeechState::Failed:
        state = speech.error == "voice_missing"
            ? (zh ? "离线声音资源未安装，请先完成声音资源准备。" : "Offline voice files are missing. Prepare the voice resources first.")
            : speech.error == "audio_device_missing"
            ? (zh ? "所选输出设备不可用，请重新选择。" : "Selected playback device is unavailable. Choose another device.")
            : (zh ? "声音准备或播放失败，请刷新后重试。" : "Could not prepare or play the voice. Refresh and retry.");
        break;
    default: break;
    }
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", state);
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", zh ? "使用离线 Kokoro 中文声音。传给 Oopz 队友：此处选择虚拟音频线的播放端，副机 Oopz 的麦克风选择同一音频线的录音端。"
        : "Uses offline Kokoro Chinese voices. For Oopz, choose the virtual cable playback end here and its recording end as Oopz's microphone on this PC.");
    CloseGroupBox();

    ImGui::BeginDisabled(localHero==0);
    edited|=UICheckbox(zh?"启用当前英雄预警":"Enable alerts for this hero",&heroSettings.alertsEnabled);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(localHero==0||!heroSettings.alertsEnabled);
    ImGui::PushID("skillAlert");
    UIGroupBox(zh ? "技能预警" : "Skill alerts");
    edited |= UICheckbox(zh ? "开启技能预警###enabled" : "Enable skill alerts###enabled", &settings.skillEnabled);
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", zh ? "敌方英雄使用所选技能时播报一次。" : "Announces once when an enemy uses a selected skill.");
    static uint64_t skillHero = kAnaHeroId;
    UIAlertHeroSelect("skillBrowse", skillHero, [&](uint64_t hero) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < kDefinitions.size(); ++i)
            if (kDefinitions[i].hero == hero && settings.rules[i].enabled) return true;
        return false;
    });
    bool hasRules = false;
    float skillLabelWidth = 0;
    const float gap = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x;
    for (const auto& definition : kDefinitions)
        if (definition.hero == skillHero)
            skillLabelWidth = (std::max)(skillLabelWidth, ImGui::CalcTextSize(zh ? definition.skillNameZh : definition.skillName).x);
    skillLabelWidth += ControlHeight() + gap;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < kDefinitions.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& definition = kDefinitions[i];
        if (definition.hero != skillHero) continue;
        hasRules = true;
        auto& rule = settings.rules[i];
        ImGui::PushID(definition.id);
        ImGui::Spacing();
        const char* label = zh ? definition.skillNameZh : definition.skillName;
        const float width = ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        const float previewWidth = ImGui::CalcTextSize(zh ? "试听" : "Preview").x + ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.x * 2;
        const bool inlineRow = width >= skillLabelWidth + previewWidth + ImGui::GetFontSize() * 12 + gap * 2;
        edited |= UICheckbox(label, &rule.enabled);
        if (inlineRow) ImGui::SameLine(skillLabelWidth + gap + ImGui::GetCursorPosX());
        const auto inputId = std::string("##message-") + definition.id;
        edited |= EditMessage(inputId.c_str(), rule.message, definition.defaultMessage,
            inlineRow ? (std::max)(1.0f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - previewWidth - gap - 8.0f) : -1);
        if (inlineRow) ImGui::SameLine();
        PreviewButton(rule.message.empty() ? definition.defaultMessage : rule.message, preview, zh);
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    if (!hasRules) {
        for (const auto& hero : kHeroOptions) {
            if (hero.heroId != skillHero) continue;
            if (const auto* abilities = OW::GetAbilityIcons(hero.label)) {
                for (const auto* ability : {abilities->ability1Icon, abilities->ability2Icon, abilities->ability3Icon}) {
                    if (!ability) continue;
                    std::string label = ability;
                    std::replace(label.begin(), label.end(), '-', ' ');
                    if (!label.empty() && label.front() >= 'a' && label.front() <= 'z') label.front() -= 'a' - 'A';
                    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", label.c_str());
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", zh ? "该英雄还没有可用的技能预警。" : "Skill alerts are unavailable for this hero.");
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
    ImGui::PopID();

    ImGui::PushID("flankAlert");
    ReservedAlert(zh ? "绕后预警" : "Flanking warning", zh);
    ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::PushID("aimThreatAlert");
    ReservedAlert(zh ? "被瞄准预警" : "Being aimed at", zh);
    ImGui::PopID();

    ImGui::PushID("ultimateAlert");
    UIGroupBox(zh ? "大招预警" : "Ultimate alerts");
    edited |= UICheckbox(zh ? "开启大招预警###enabled" : "Enable ultimate alerts###enabled", &settings.ultimateEnabled);
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", zh ? "敌方大招充能达到 100% 时播报一次。" : "Announces once when an enemy's ultimate charge reaches 100%.");
    ImGui::PushID("global");
    edited |= UICheckbox(zh ? "全局默认开启###all" : "Enabled for all by default###all", &settings.ultimateAll);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(zh ? "全局播报文案" : "Default announcement");
    edited |= EditMessage("##ultimateDefault", settings.ultimateMessage, kDefaultUltimateMessage);
    PreviewButton(settings.ultimateMessage.empty() ? kDefaultUltimateMessage : settings.ultimateMessage, preview, zh);
    ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    static uint64_t ultimateHero = 0;
    UIAlertHeroSelect("ultimateBrowse", ultimateHero, [&](uint64_t hero) { return UltimateHeroEnabled(settings, hero); });
    if (UltimateHeroSupported(ultimateHero)) {
        const auto* existing = UltimateForHero(settings, ultimateHero);
        auto rule = existing ? *existing : UltimateRule{ultimateHero};
        const char* modesZh[]{settings.ultimateAll ? "跟随全局（开）" : "跟随全局（关）", "单独关闭", "单独开启"};
        const char* modesEn[]{settings.ultimateAll ? "Use default (on)" : "Use default (off)", "Always off", "Always on"};
        int mode = rule.mode + 1;
        ImGui::PushID("hero");
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth((std::max)(1.0f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - 8.0f));
        bool changed = UISelect("##heroMode", &mode, zh ? modesZh : modesEn, 3);
        rule.mode = mode - 1;
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(zh ? "英雄专属文案（留空使用全局）" : "Hero announcement (blank uses default)");
        changed |= EditMessage("##ultimateHeroMessage", rule.message, settings.ultimateMessage.c_str());
        PreviewButton(rule.message.empty() ? settings.ultimateMessage : rule.message, preview, zh);
        if (changed) {
            if (existing) settings.ultimates[size_t(existing - settings.ultimates.data())] = std::move(rule);
            else settings.ultimates.push_back(std::move(rule));
            edited = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
    ImGui::PopID();

    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if(edited) {
        auto global=GetSettings();global.voice=settings.voice;global.volume=settings.volume;global.outputDevice=settings.outputDevice;
        SetSettings(std::move(global));
        heroSettings.alerts=std::move(settings);V2::HeroSettings::Set(localHero,std::move(heroSettings));
    }
    if (!preview.empty()) Preview(std::move(preview));
    ImGui::PopID();
}

bool StyleDetails(Style& style,Element element) {
    const bool size=element==Element::Name||element==Element::BattleTag||element==Element::Health||element==Element::Resources||element==Element::Distance||element==Element::Avatar||element==Element::Skills||element==Element::Ultimate||element==Element::Prediction||element==Element::Offscreen||element==Element::Crosshair||element==Element::CenterArrow;
    const bool line=element==Element::Box||element==Element::Health||element==Element::Resources||element==Element::Skeleton||element==Element::Prediction||element==Element::Hitbox||element==Element::Snapline||element==Element::EyeRay||element==Element::Crosshair;
    bool changed=false;
    if(size){ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);changed|=ImGui::SliderFloat(L("Size"),&style.size,6,80,"%.1f");}
    if(element==Element::CenterArrow){ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);changed|=ImGui::SliderFloat(L("Ring Radius"),&style.radius,40,600,"%.0f px");}
    if(line){ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);changed|=ImGui::SliderFloat(L("Thickness"),&style.thickness,.5f,8,"%.1f px");}
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);changed|=ImGui::SliderFloat("X",&style.offsetX,-300,300,"%.0f px");
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(150);changed|=ImGui::SliderFloat("Y",&style.offsetY,-300,300,"%.0f px");
    return changed;
}

        SettingRow(zh?"轮廓颜色":"Outline color");changed|=UI::ColorPicker("##outlineColor",crosshair.outlineColor);
        SettingRow(zh?"显示轮廓":"Show outline");changed|=UICheckbox("##outline",&crosshair.outline);
        SettingRow(zh?"整体尺寸":"Size");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##size",&crosshair.size,2,80,Number(0," px"));
        SettingRow(zh?"线条粗细":"Thickness");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##thickness",&crosshair.thickness,.5f,8,Number(1," px"));
        SettingRow(zh?"中心间隙":"Center gap");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##gap",&crosshair.gap,0,40,Number(0," px"));
        SettingRow(zh?"点大小":"Dot size");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##dotSize",&crosshair.dotSize,1,24,Number(1," px"));
        SettingRow(zh?"轮廓粗细":"Outline thickness");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##outlineThickness",&crosshair.outlineThickness,0,6,Number(1," px"));
        SettingRow("X");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##offsetX",&crosshair.offsetX,-300,300,Number(0," px"));
        SettingRow("Y");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);changed|=UISlider("##offsetY",&crosshair.offsetY,-300,300,Number(0," px"));
        ImGui::EndPopup();
    }
    ImGui::PopID();
    return changed;
}
void DrawCrosshairPreview(ImDrawList* draw,const ImVec2& center,const CrosshairSettings& settings) {
    auto pass=[&](ImU32 color,float thickness,float expand) {
        V2::VisualSettings::ForEachCrosshairPrimitive(settings,center.x,center.y,[&](const V2::VisualSettings::CrosshairPrimitive& primitive) {
            if(primitive.kind==CrosshairPrimitiveKind::Line)draw->AddLine(ImVec2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),ImVec2(primitive.x2,primitive.y2),color,thickness);
            else if(primitive.filled)draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),primitive.radius+expand,color,48);
            else draw->AddCircle(ImVec2(primitive.x1,primitive.y1),primitive.radius,color,48,thickness);
        });
    };
    if(settings.outline&&settings.outlineThickness>0)pass(ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(settings.outlineColor),settings.thickness+2*settings.outlineThickness,settings.outlineThickness);
    pass(ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(settings.color),settings.thickness,0);
}
void OutlineControls() {
    bool paletteChanged=false;
    SettingRow("Game Outlines");UICheckbox("##gameOutlines",&OW::Config::gameOutlines);
    ImGui::SameLine();paletteChanged|=UI::ColorPicker("outlineVisible",OW::Config::enargb);
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",L("Visible"));
    ImGui::SameLine();paletteChanged|=UI::ColorPicker("outlineHidden",OW::Config::invisnenargb);
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",L("Hidden"));
    SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"选中目标改色":"Selected target color");
    UICheckbox("##outlineTargetEnabled",&OW::Config::gameOutlineTargetColor);
    ImGui::SameLine();paletteChanged|=UI::ColorPicker("outlineTarget",OW::Config::outlineTargetColor);
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",L("Target"));
    const bool contourCaptureEnabled=V2::Vision::GetService().GetSettings().enabled;
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(contourCaptureEnabled);
    SettingRow("Rainbow Color");UICheckbox("##outlineRainbow",&OW::Config::gameOutlineRainbow);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if(contourCaptureEnabled)ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"轮廓采集开启时使用固定三色，彩虹暂停。":"Capture uses three fixed colors; rainbow is paused while capture is enabled.");
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"仅更改游戏原生轮廓颜色，遮挡由游戏处理。":"Changes native outline colors only; the game handles occlusion.");
    if(paletteChanged)V2::Vision::SyncOutlinePalette();
#ifndef UNLEASHED_OBSERVATION_ONLY
    namespace Brightness = OW::OutlineBrightness;
    static float brightnessDraft = 100.f;
    const auto brightnessCommand = Brightness::Snapshot();
    SettingRow("Native Outline Brightness (%)");
    const float buttonWidth = ImGui::CalcTextSize(L("Apply")).x + ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.x * 2;
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth((std::max)(80.f, ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - buttonWidth - ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x));
    ImGui::InputFloat("##outlineBrightnessPercentDraft", &brightnessDraft, 0.f, 0.f, "%.7g");
    ImGui::SameLine();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!Brightness::Valid(brightnessDraft));
    if (ImGui::Button(L("Apply"))) Brightness::Submit(brightnessDraft);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if (!Brightness::Valid(brightnessDraft)) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Enter a finite percentage of zero or greater."));
    if (brightnessCommand.enabled || Brightness::RestoreCount.load()) {
        if (ImGui::Button(L("Restore Original Setting"))) Brightness::Disable();
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::Text(L("Submitted Brightness: %.7g%%"), brightnessCommand.value);
        ImGui::Text(L("Applied: %u / Failed: %u / Restore pending: %u"), Brightness::AppliedCount.load(),
            Brightness::FailureCount.load(), Brightness::RestoreCount.load());
    } else ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Edit the percentage, then click Apply."));
    const char* brightnessStatus = nullptr;
    switch (Brightness::LastResult.load()) {
    case Brightness::Result::Restored:
        brightnessStatus = "Original brightness setting restored."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::Changed:
        brightnessStatus = "The game changed this setting. Click Apply to use your value again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::InvalidValue:
        brightnessStatus = "Enter a finite percentage of zero or greater."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::UnsupportedProfile:
    case Brightness::Result::IdentityMismatch:
    case Brightness::Result::SignatureMismatch:
        brightnessStatus = "This game version is not supported. Use the game's brightness setting until support is available."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::ReadFailed:
        brightnessStatus = "Could not read brightness. Check the game connection, then click Apply again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::SettingMissing:
    case Brightness::Result::AmbiguousSetting:
    case Brightness::Result::InvalidTarget:
        brightnessStatus = "Could not locate the brightness setting. Reconnect to the game, then click Apply again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::TargetChanged:
        brightnessStatus = "The game setting changed while applying. Click Apply again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::WriteFailed:
        brightnessStatus = "Could not apply brightness. Check the game connection, then click Apply again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::WriteReadbackFailed:
    case Brightness::Result::WriteMismatch:
        brightnessStatus = "Brightness could not be confirmed after applying. Check the game connection before trying again."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::RestorePending:
        brightnessStatus = "Waiting to restore the original setting. Keep the game connected."; break;
    case Brightness::Result::RestoreReadFailed:
    case Brightness::Result::RestoreWriteFailed:
    case Brightness::Result::RestoreReadbackFailed:
    case Brightness::Result::RestoreMismatch:
        brightnessStatus = "Could not confirm the original setting was restored. Check the game connection, then try Restore Original Setting again."; break;
    default: break;
    }
    if (brightnessStatus) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L(brightnessStatus));
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Uses the game's original outline brightness setting, independently of Game Outlines. Values above 100% are allowed."));
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("New objects use the new brightness; existing objects may not update immediately. Reopening game settings limits the value to the game's range."));
#endif
}
void Card(const char* title,const std::function<void()>& content) {
    ImGui::PushID(title);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildRounding,10);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding,ImVec2(12,10));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg,kColPanelSoft);
    ImGui::BeginChild("Card",ImVec2(0,0),ImGuiChildFlags_Borders|ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY|ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize|ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding,
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar|ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse);
    if(UI::Search::Pending())ImGui::SetNextItemOpen(true);
    UI::Search::Anchor(title);
    if(ImGui::CollapsingHeader(L(title),ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen))content();
    ImGui::EndChild();ImGui::PopStyleColor();ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);ImGui::Spacing();ImGui::PopID();
}
void Preview(const Settings& settings) {
    static bool visible=true;
    UICheckbox(L("Visible"),&visible);ImGui::SameLine();ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",L("Example"));
    const ImVec2 p=ImGui::GetCursorScreenPos();
    const float width=ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x;
    ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(width,320));
    auto* draw=ImGui::GetWindowDrawList();
    const float cx=p.x+width*.5f,top=p.y+62,bottom=p.y+260,left=cx-48,right=cx+48;
    auto style=[&](Element e)->const Style&{return settings.elements[int(e)];};
    auto position=[&](Element e,float x,float y){return ImVec2(x+style(e).offsetX,y+style(e).offsetY);};
    auto color=[&](Element e){return ImGui::ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(V2::VisualSettings::Color(style(e),true,visible));};
    const float scale=settings.dynamicFont?1.6f:1.f;
    auto text=[&](Element e,float x,float y,const char* value){auto* font=ImGui::GetFont();const float size=style(e).size*scale;const float w=font->CalcTextSizeA(size,FLT_MAX,0,value).x;draw->AddText(font,size,position(e,x-w*.5f,y),color(e),value);};
    const ImU32 silhouette=IM_COL32(111,116,132,55);
    draw->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(cx,top+30),12,silhouette,24);
    const std::pair<ImVec2,ImVec2> bones[]={{{cx,top+46},{cx,bottom-65}},{{cx,top+65},{left+4,top+115}},{{cx,top+65},{right-4,top+115}},{{cx,bottom-65},{left+8,bottom}},{{cx,bottom-65},{right-8,bottom}}};
    for(const auto& bone:bones)draw->AddLine(bone.first,bone.second,silhouette,8);
    if(OW::Config::draw_skel){const auto c=color(Element::Skeleton);draw->AddCircle(position(Element::Skeleton,cx,top+30),12,c,24,style(Element::Skeleton).thickness);
        for(const auto& bone:bones)draw->AddLine(position(Element::Skeleton,bone.first.x,bone.first.y),position(Element::Skeleton,bone.second.x,bone.second.y),c,style(Element::Skeleton).thickness);}
    if(OW::Config::draw_info){const auto c=color(Element::Box);const float thickness=style(Element::Box).thickness;
        const auto a=position(Element::Box,left,top),b=position(Element::Box,right,bottom);
        if(settings.boxType==2)draw->AddRectFilled(a,b,(c&~IM_COL32_A_MASK)|(((((c>>IM_COL32_A_SHIFT)&255u)*45u)/255u)<<IM_COL32_A_SHIFT));
        if(settings.boxType!=0)draw->AddRect(a,b,c,0,0,thickness);
        else for(int side=0;side<2;++side)for(int row=0;row<2;++row){const auto point=position(Element::Box,side?right:left,row?bottom:top);
            draw->AddLine(point,ImVec2(point.x+(side?-20:20),point.y),c,thickness);draw->AddLine(point,ImVec2(point.x,point.y+(row?-20:20)),c,thickness);}}
    if(OW::Config::name){const char* label=settings.nameType==1?"Player":settings.nameType==2?"Ana / Player":"Ana";text(Element::Name,cx,top-22,label);}
    if(OW::Config::drawbattletag)text(Element::BattleTag,cx,top-40,"Player");
    if(OW::Config::draw_avatar){auto* icons=Render::GetIconManager();auto* image=icons?icons->LoadHeroAvatar("ana"):nullptr;const float size=style(Element::Avatar).size;
        if(image){const auto a=position(Element::Avatar,cx-size*.5f,top-size-10);draw->AddImageRounded(reinterpret_cast<ImTextureID>(image),a,ImVec2(a.x+size,a.y+size),ImVec2(0,0),ImVec2(1,1),color(Element::Avatar),4);}}
    if(OW::Config::healthbar || OW::Config::healthbar2) {
        const auto& st=style(Element::Health);
        if(settings.healthBarStyle==1) {
            const auto a=position(Element::Health,left-5,top);
            draw->AddRectFilled(a,ImVec2(a.x+st.thickness,a.y+bottom-top),kColControl);
            draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(a.x,a.y+40),ImVec2(a.x+st.thickness,a.y+bottom-top),color(Element::Health));
        } else {
            const float w=settings.healthBarStyle==2?right-left:st.size*5,h=st.thickness*(settings.healthBarStyle==2?1:3);
            const auto a=position(Element::Health,cx-w*.5f,top-h-4);
            draw->AddRectFilled(a,ImVec2(a.x+w,a.y+h),kColControl);
            if(settings.healthBarStyle==2)draw->AddRectFilled(a,ImVec2(a.x+w*.8f,a.y+h),color(Element::Health));
            else {
                draw->AddRectFilled(a,ImVec2(a.x+w*.5f,a.y+h),IM_COL32(245,245,245,255));
                draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(a.x+w*.5f,a.y),ImVec2(a.x+w*.7f,a.y+h),IM_COL32(255,150,35,255));
                draw->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(a.x+w*.7f,a.y),ImVec2(a.x+w*.8f,a.y+h),IM_COL32(70,170,255,255));
                for(int i=1;i<10;++i)draw->AddLine(ImVec2(a.x+w*i/10,a.y),ImVec2(a.x+w*i/10,a.y+h),IM_COL32(0,0,0,150));
            }
        }
    }
    if(settings.worldUltimate)text(Element::Ultimate,right+18,top,"67%");
    if(OW::Config::skillinfo){const float size=style(Element::Skills).size;for(int i=0;i<2;++i){const auto a=position(Element::Skills,right+8+i*(size+3),top+20);draw->AddRect(a,ImVec2(a.x+size,a.y+size),color(Element::Skills),3,0,style(Element::Skills).thickness);draw->AddText(ImGui::GetFont(),size*.67f,ImVec2(a.x+2,a.y+2),color(Element::Skills),i?"--":"4");}}
    if(OW::Config::dist)text(Element::Distance,cx,bottom+4,"14 m");
    if(settings.prediction)draw->AddCircle(position(Element::Prediction,cx+25,top+75),style(Element::Prediction).size*.25f,color(Element::Prediction),20,style(Element::Prediction).thickness);
    if(OW::Config::draw_hitbox)draw->AddCircle(position(Element::Hitbox,cx,top+30),16,color(Element::Hitbox),24,style(Element::Hitbox).thickness);
    if(OW::Config::drawline)draw->AddLine(ImVec2(cx,p.y+315),position(Element::Snapline,cx,bottom),color(Element::Snapline),style(Element::Snapline).thickness);
    if(OW::Config::eyeray)draw->AddLine(position(Element::EyeRay,cx,top+30),position(Element::EyeRay,right+30,top+40),color(Element::EyeRay),style(Element::EyeRay).thickness);
    if(settings.offscreen){const auto tip=position(Element::Offscreen,p.x+width-18,top+110);const float size=style(Element::Offscreen).size;draw->AddTriangleFilled(tip,ImVec2(tip.x-size,tip.y-size*.5f),ImVec2(tip.x-size,tip.y+size*.5f),color(Element::Offscreen));}
    if(settings.centerArrow){
        const auto& st=style(Element::CenterArrow);const ImVec2 center(cx+st.offsetX,top+100+st.offsetY);
        const float radius=(std::min)(st.radius,(std::min)(width*.5f-8.f,150.f));
        const float size=st.size;const ImU32 c=color(Element::CenterArrow);
        for(int i=0;i<6;++i){const float a=IM_PI*2.f*float(i)/6.f;const ImVec2 dir(std::cos(a),std::sin(a));const ImVec2 tip(center.x+dir.x*radius,center.y+dir.y*radius);const ImVec2 back(tip.x-dir.x*size,tip.y-dir.y*size);const ImVec2 side(-dir.y*size*.5f,dir.x*size*.5f);draw->AddTriangleFilled(tip,ImVec2(back.x+side.x,back.y+side.y),ImVec2(back.x-side.x,back.y-side.y),c);}
    }
    if(OW::Config::crosscircle){const auto& crosshair=settings.crosshair;DrawCrosshairPreview(draw,ImVec2(cx+crosshair.offsetX,top+100+crosshair.offsetY),crosshair);}
}

}

        SettingRow(L("Draw Enemy"));changed|=UICheckbox("##enemies",&settings.enemies);

    });
    Card("Player ESP",[&]{

        changed|=ElementRow(settings,Element::Box,OW::Config::draw_info);
        changed|=ElementRow(settings,Element::Name,OW::Config::name);
        changed|=ElementRow(settings,Element::BattleTag,OW::Config::drawbattletag);
        bool healthEnabled=OW::Config::healthbar || OW::Config::healthbar2;
        changed|=ElementRow(settings,Element::Health,healthEnabled);

        const auto group=[&](const char* title,V2::WorldObjects::Group category,bool* enabled) {
            ImGui::Spacing();

            for(int i=0;i<int(V2::VisualSettings::kObjects.size());++i) {
                const auto& objectType=V2::VisualSettings::kObjects[i];

        group("Projectiles",V2::WorldObjects::Group::Projectile,&world.projectiles);
    });

        SettingRow("Rotate with view");changed|=UICheckbox("##radarRotate",&radar.rotate);
        SettingRow("Radar Lines");UICheckbox("##radarLines",&OW::Config::radarline);
        changed|=UIColorEdit("Enemy",&radar.enemy);changed|=UIColorEdit("Ally",&radar.ally);
        slider("Horizontal position","##radarX",OW::Config::radarPosX,0,1,"");slider("Vertical position","##radarY",OW::Config::radarPosY,0,1,"");
    });
    Card("HUD",[&]{
        auto placement=[](const char* id,float& x,float& y,float* scale){ImGui::PushID(id);bool edited=false;
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(140);edited|=ImGui::SliderFloat("X",&x,0,1,"%.3f");ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(140);edited|=ImGui::SliderFloat("Y",&y,0,1,"%.3f");
            if(scale){ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(140);edited|=ImGui::SliderFloat(L("Scale"),scale,.35f,2.5f,"%.2fx");}ImGui::PopID();return edited;};
        SettingRow("Top-left Info");UICheckbox("##info",&OW::Config::showOverlayInfo);
        changed|=placement("info",settings.infoX,settings.infoY,&settings.infoScale);
        SettingRow("Hero Status");UICheckbox("##heroStatus",&OW::Config::ult);
        const char* styles[]={"ED Compact","Custom Status"};SettingRow("Style");PushControlWidth();UISelect("##heroStyle",&OW::Config::heroStatusStyle,styles,2);ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        placement("hero",OW::Config::heroStatusPosX,OW::Config::heroStatusPosY,&OW::Config::heroStatusScale);
        const char* teams[]={"All","Enemy","Ally"};SettingRow("Hero Status Team");PushControlWidth();UISelect("##roster",&OW::Config::ultimateRosterFilter,teams,3);ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        SettingRow("Behavior and Slots");UICheckbox("##slotStatus",&OW::Config::showSlotStatus);
        placement("slots",OW::Config::slotPosX,OW::Config::slotPosY,nullptr);
    });
    ImGui::EndChild();
    if(changed)V2::HeroSettings::SetDisplay(std::move(settings));
}
static void DrawFovRingCard(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind kind,
                              int slotIndex,
                              bool slotEnabled,
                              float slotFovDeg) {
    OW::Config::FovRingSlotStyle& style = OW::Config::FovRingStyleFor(kind, slotIndex);
    style = OW::Config::ClampFovRingStyle(style, kind, slotIndex);

    bool changed = false;
    ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(kind) * 100 + slotIndex);

    char slotLabel[32] = {};
    std::snprintf(slotLabel, sizeof(slotLabel), L("Slot %d"), slotIndex + 1);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildRounding,10.f);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding,ImVec2(12,12));
    ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg,kColPanelSoft);
    ImGui::BeginChild("RingCard",ImVec2(0,0),
        ImGuiChildFlags_Borders|ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY|ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize|ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding,
        ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar|ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse);
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(slotLabel);
    ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(slotEnabled ? kColTextMuted : kColTextDim),
                       "%s %.0f deg",
                       slotEnabled ? L("On") : L("Off"),
                       OW::Config::ClampFovDeg(slotFovDeg));

    ImGui::Spacing();
    changed |= UICheckbox(L("Show"), &style.visible);
    ImGui::SameLine();
    changed |= UI::ColorPicker("##color",style.color);
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",L("Color"));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",L("Thickness"));
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);
    changed |= UISlider("##thickness", &style.thickness, 0.5f, 6.0f, Number(1, " px"));

    static const char* kLineStyles[] = { "Solid", "Dashed" };
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"线型":"Line style");
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-FLT_MIN);
    changed |= UISelect("##lineStyle", &style.lineStyle, kLineStyles, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kLineStyles));

    changed |= UICheckbox(L("Label"), &style.showLabel);

    if (changed)
        style = OW::Config::ClampFovRingStyle(style, kind, slotIndex);

    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::PopStyleColor();
    ImGui::PopStyleVar(2);
    ImGui::PopID();
}

static void DrawFovRingStyleGroup(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind kind,
                                  const HeroOption& selectedHero) {
    ImGui::TextUnformatted(L("Aim Slot Rings"));
    ImGui::Spacing();
    const float scale=(std::max)(1.f,ImGui::GetFontSize()/15.f);
    const float gap=12.f*scale;
    const int columns=std::clamp(int((ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x+gap)/(190.f*scale+gap)),1,4);
    ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_CellPadding,ImVec2(gap*.5f,gap*.5f));
    if(ImGui::BeginTable("FovRingCards",columns,ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchSame|ImGuiTableFlags_NoPadOuterX)) {
        const int slotCount = selectedHero.heroId == 0
            ? OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots
            : ImClamp(OW::Config::GetHeroAimSlotCount(selectedHero.heroId),
                1,
                OW::Config::kMaxHeroPresetSlots);

        for (int slotIndex = 0; slotIndex < slotCount; ++slotIndex) {
            OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset slot{};
            const bool hasSlot = selectedHero.heroId != 0 &&
                OW::Config::TryGetHeroAimSlot(selectedHero.heroId, slotIndex, slot);
            const bool slotEnabled = hasSlot && slot.enabled;
            const float fovDeg = hasSlot ? slot.preset.fov : OW::Config::kDefaultFovDeg;

            ImGui::TableNextColumn();
            DrawFovRingCard(kind, slotIndex, selectedHero.heroId == 0 || slotEnabled, fovDeg);
        }
        ImGui::EndTable();
    }
    ImGui::PopStyleVar();
}

void DrawThemeFovRingsPage() {
    const HeroOption& selectedHero = CurrentHeroOption();
    DrawFovRingStyleGroup(OW::Config::FovRingSlotKind::Aim, selectedHero);
}

void UI::ThemePage() {
    ImGui::PushID("ThemePage");

    state.themeSubTab = ImClamp(state.themeSubTab, 0, kThemeSubTabCount - 1);
    if (state.themeSubTab == 0)
        VisualsPage();
    else
        DrawThemeFovRingsPage();

    ImGui::PopID();
}

void UI::MiscPage() {
    ImGui::PushID("MiscPage");

    state.miscSubTab = ImClamp(state.miscSubTab, 0, kMiscSubTabCount - 1);
    switch (state.miscSubTab) {
        case 0:
            DrawMiscGeneralPage();
            break;
        case 1:
            DrawMiscDiagnosticsPage();
            break;
        case 2:
            DrawMiscBehaviorPage();
            break;
        case 3:
            DrawMiscMethodPage();
            break;
        case 4:
            DrawMiscDynamicFovPage();
            break;
        case 5:
            DrawMiscOutputPage();
            break;
        case 6:
            DrawMiscScreenPage();
            break;
        case 7:
            DrawMiscCapturePage();
            break;
        default:
            DrawMiscGeneralPage();
            break;
    }

    CloseGroupBox();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", L("Shared presets"));
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit behavior preset"))) state.miscSubTab = 2;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit method preset"))) state.miscSubTab = 3;
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit FOV preset"))) state.miscSubTab = 4;

    ImGui::PopID();
}

void DrawMiscGeneralPage() {
    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupConfigProfile));
    {
        static char profileName[kConfigProfileNameBufferSize] = "";
        static char newProfileName[kConfigProfileNameBufferSize] = "";
        static bool profileNameInitialized = false;

        std::vector<std::string> profiles = EnumerateConfigProfiles();
        std::vector<const char*> profileItems;
        profileItems.reserve(profiles.size());
        for (const std::string& profile : profiles)
            profileItems.push_back(profile.c_str());

        if (!profileNameInitialized) {
            CopyConfigProfileName(profileName, OW::Config::configFileName);
            profileNameInitialized = true;
        }

        SettingRow(T(UiText::ActiveProfile));
        PushControlWidth();
        int selectedProfileIndex = FindConfigProfileIndex(profiles, OW::Config::configFileName);
        if (UISelect("##configProfile", &selectedProfileIndex,
                     profileItems.data(), static_cast<int>(profileItems.size()), false)) {
            const std::string selectedProfile = profiles[static_cast<size_t>(selectedProfileIndex)];
            if (SelectConfigProfile(selectedProfile.c_str(), profileName))
                SetPersistenceStatus(PersistLastConfigProfile(), T(UiText::SavedAllChanges));
            else
                SetPersistenceStatus(false, "");
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        ImGui::TextDisabled("(?)");
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayShort)) ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", T(UiText::SavePolicyNotice));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::Folder));
        {
            char folderBuffer[MAX_PATH] = {};
            const std::string configDirectory = OW::Config::ConfigDirectoryPath();
            std::snprintf(folderBuffer, sizeof(folderBuffer), "%s", configDirectory.c_str());
            const float openButtonWidth = (std::max)(54.0f,ImGui::CalcTextSize(T(UiText::Open)).x+20);
            const float spacing = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x + 10;
            const float folderWidth = MaxFloat(
                120.0f,
                ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - openButtonWidth - spacing);
            ImGui::PushItemWidth(folderWidth);
            ImGui::InputText("##configFolder", folderBuffer, IM_ARRAYSIZE(folderBuffer),
                             ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button(T(UiText::Open), ImVec2(openButtonWidth, ControlHeight())))
                ShellExecuteA(nullptr, "open", configDirectory.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr, SW_SHOWNORMAL);
        }

        SettingRow(T(UiText::NewProfile));
        {
            const float createButtonWidth = (std::max)(64.0f,ImGui::CalcTextSize(T(UiText::Create)).x+20);
            const float spacing = ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.x + 10;
            const float inputWidth = MaxFloat(
                90.0f,
                ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x - createButtonWidth - spacing);
            ImGui::PushItemWidth(inputWidth);
            ImGui::InputText("##newConfigProfile", newProfileName, IM_ARRAYSIZE(newProfileName));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button(T(UiText::Create), ImVec2(createButtonWidth, ControlHeight()))) {
                const std::string normalizedProfile = NormalizeProfileFileName(newProfileName);
                if (CreateConfigProfileFromCurrent(normalizedProfile) &&
                    SelectConfigProfile(normalizedProfile.c_str(), profileName, false)) {
                    const bool remembered = PersistLastConfigProfile();
                    newProfileName[0] = '\0';
                    SetPersistenceStatus(remembered, T(UiText::CreatedConfigProfile));
                } else {
                    SetPersistenceStatus(false, "");
                }
            }
        }
    }
    CloseGroupBox();

    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupMenu));
    {
        SettingRow(T(UiText::Language));
        PushControlWidth();
        int uiLanguage = OW::Config::ClampUiLanguage(OW::Config::uiLanguage);
        if (UISelect("##uiLanguage", &uiLanguage, kUiLanguageOptions, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kUiLanguageOptions)))
        {
            OW::Config::uiLanguage = OW::Config::ClampUiLanguage(uiLanguage);
            UI::Preferences::values.language=OW::Config::uiLanguage;
            UI::Preferences::Save();
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        auto& preferences=UI::Preferences::values;
        bool preferenceChanged=false;
        static const char* skins[]={"UN Crimson","Graphite","ED Violet"};
        SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"界面风格":"Menu style");PushControlWidth();
        if(UISelect("##menuSkin",&preferences.skin,skins,3)) {preferences.customAccent=false;preferenceChanged=true;}
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if(!preferences.customAccent)preferences.accent=ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(UI::Theme::kColAccent);
        if(UIColorEdit(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"强调色":"Accent color",&preferences.accent)) {preferences.customAccent=true;preferenceChanged=true;}
        SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"减少动画":"Reduce motion");
        preferenceChanged|=UICheckbox("##reduceMotion",&preferences.reducedMotion);
        SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"登录毛玻璃":"Login glass");
        preferenceChanged|=UICheckbox("##loginGlass",&preferences.loginGlass);
        SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"控制台分层":"Console layers");
        preferenceChanged|=UICheckbox("##consoleLayers",&preferences.consoleLayers);
        if(preferenceChanged)UI::Preferences::Save();
        if(!UI::Preferences::Error().empty()) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",UI::Preferences::Error().c_str());

    }
    CloseGroupBox();

    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupApplication));
    {
        SettingRow(T(UiText::Unleashed));
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::CloseUn), 96.0f))
            g_Overlay.RequestExit();
        ImGui::SameLine();
        const bool reconnectBusy = OW::ProcessConnection::IsRecoveryBusy();
        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::BeginDisabled();
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::ReconnectUn), 112.0f))
            OW::ProcessConnection::RequestReconnect();
        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", T(UiText::TooltipReconnect));

        SettingRow(L("Runtime cache"));
        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::BeginDisabled();
        if (UIActionButton(L("Refresh caches"), 144.0f)) {
            StopFirePatternRecorder();
            OW::ProcessConnection::RequestCacheRefresh();

        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::EndDisabled();

            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Stops current actions and acquisition, clears entity, camera and VMM caches, then reconnects and collects fresh data."));

        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::BeginDisabled();
        if (UIActionButton(L("Rebuild DMA connection"), 176.0f)) {
            StopFirePatternRecorder();
            OW::ProcessConnection::RequestDmaRecovery();
        }
        if (reconnectBusy)
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Stops the current session, reloads DMA device settings, and rebuilds the device connection. Old data and commands are discarded."));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::Overlay));
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::MinimizeOverlay), 144.0f))
            g_Overlay.MinimizeToTaskbar();
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", T(UiText::TooltipMinimizeOverlay));

        SettingRow(L("Overlay frame limit"));
        PushControlWidth();

                 AtOrBelow(L("Unlimited"), 0, Number(0, " FPS")));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("0 = unlimited. Changes apply immediately. Only limits canvas drawing; data acquisition stays at 300 Hz and the menu at about 60 FPS."));

        SettingRow(L("Actual overlay FPS"));
        ImGui::Text("%.0f FPS", Diagnostics::RenderFps());

        SettingRow(T(UiText::RuntimeVersion));
        const auto layout = V2::Profiles::Snapshot();
        const auto* matched = V2::Profiles::MatchedProfile(layout.detection);
        if (OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected() && matched)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s %s", matched->region, matched->build);
        else
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("No verified active layout. Open Diagnostics to choose or retry."));

        SettingRow(T(UiText::Process));
        const bool connected = OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected();
        const bool connecting = OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnecting();
        const ImVec4 statusColor = connected
            ? ImVec4(0.25f, 1.0f, 0.45f, 1.0f)
            : connecting
                ? ImVec4(1.0f, 0.75f, 0.25f, 1.0f)
                : ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.35f, 1.0f);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, statusColor);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", OW::ProcessConnection::StatusText().c_str());
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        if (connected) {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("PID %d", OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectedPid());
        }
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}

void DrawMiscDiagnosticsPage() {
    const auto profile = V2::Profiles::Snapshot();
    const auto* matched = V2::Profiles::MatchedProfile(profile.detection);
    UIGroupBox("版本与布局");
    int selected = V2::Profiles::requestedProfile.load() + 1;
    const char* choices[] = {"Auto", "CN", "World", "Nexon"};
    ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().x * 0.44f);
    if (ImGui::Combo("##RequestedProfile", &selected, choices, IM_ARRAYSIZE(choices))) {
        V2::Profiles::requestedProfile.store(selected - 1);
        OW::ProcessConnection::RequestReconnect();
    }
    ImGui::SameLine();
    if (matched)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("已识别 %s · %s", matched->region, matched->build);
    else
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", V2::Profiles::StatusText(profile.detection.status));
    if (matched && OW::ProcessConnection::IsConnected()) {
        const auto runtime = Diagnostics::Snapshot();
        ImGui::Text("已发布实体 %zu", runtime.entityCount);
        if (runtime.entityCount == 0)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("等待实体字段完成采集");
        if (!matched->Offsets().VisibilityValueOffset)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("该版本缺少可见性布局");
        if (!matched->Offsets().InputMouseScaleX_RVA)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("该版本缺少游戏鼠标缩放偏移");
    }
    CloseGroupBox();

    DrawRuntimeReadinessDetails();
    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupDiagnostics));
    {
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.45f, 0.75f, 1.0f, 1),
            "DMA KeyState reads host Windows VK state (keyboard and mouse)");
        const uint64_t keyStateAddress = KeyState::gafAsyncKeyStateAddr.load();
        const KeyState::ResolverDiagnostics resolver = KeyState::SnapshotResolverDiagnostics();
        if (KeyState::initialized.load() && keyStateAddress != 0) {
            ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.25f, 1.0f, 0.45f, 1),
                "DMA KeyState ready: build=%lu profile=%s method=%s module=%s session=%lu proxyPid=%lu addr=0x%llX size=%zu slotsRva=0x%llX slotsMethod=%s keyOffset=0x%llX keyMethod=%s",
                static_cast<unsigned long>(resolver.build),
                resolver.profile.c_str(),
                resolver.method.c_str(),
                resolver.module.c_str(),
                static_cast<unsigned long>(resolver.resolvedSessionId),
                static_cast<unsigned long>(resolver.proxyPid),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(keyStateAddress),
                KeyState::keyStateByteCount.load(),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(resolver.slotsRva),
                resolver.slotsMethod.c_str(),
                static_cast<unsigned long long>(resolver.keyStateOffset),
                resolver.keyOffsetMethod.c_str());
        } else {
            ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.35f, 0.2f, 1),
                "DMA KeyState resolver pending/failed: build=%lu profile=%s method=%s module=%s; check Diagnostic Log",
                static_cast<unsigned long>(resolver.build),
                resolver.profile.c_str(),
                resolver.method.c_str(),
                resolver.module.c_str());
            if (!resolver.lastFailureDetails.empty()) {
                ImGui::TextWrapped("Last resolver failure: %s", resolver.lastFailureDetails.c_str());
            }
        }

        DrawAimHotkeyProbe();
        ImGui::Spacing();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::FireRecorder));
        if (IsFirePatternRecorderRunning()) {
            if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Stop), 72.0f))
                StopFirePatternRecorder();
        } else {
            if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Start), 72.0f))
                StartFirePatternRecorder();
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered()) {
            ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", L("Records left/right mouse button down/up edges from DMA KeyState for up to 8 seconds.\nPerform one full fire-pattern cycle plus the first press of the next cycle, then press Stop.\nResults are written to undma_cn_aim_diag.log and the log overlay."));
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        bool recorderInterrupted = false;
        const std::string recorderStatus = GetFirePatternRecorderStatus(recorderInterrupted);
        ImGui::PushTextWrapPos();
        ImGui::TextColored(recorderInterrupted ? ImVec4(1.0f, 0.45f, 0.35f, 1.0f)
                                               : ImVec4(0.60f, 0.60f, 0.60f, 1.0f),
                           "%s", L(recorderStatus.c_str()));
        ImGui::PopTextWrapPos();

        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::Checkbox(T(UiText::DryRunLogOnly), &OW::Config::aimDryRun);
        if (OW::Config::aimDryRun) {
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1, 0.5f, 0, 1), "%s", T(UiText::NoCursorMovement));
        }
        bool showLogOverlay = Diagnostics::IsLogOverlayVisible();
        if (ImGui::Checkbox(T(UiText::ShowLogOverlay), &showLogOverlay))
            Diagnostics::SetLogOverlayVisible(showLogOverlay);
        ImGui::SameLine();
        if (ImGui::Button(T(UiText::ClearLog)))
            Diagnostics::ClearLogLines();
        ImGui::Checkbox(T(UiText::VerboseAimLogs), &OW::Config::aimVerboseLog);
        if (OW::Config::aimVerboseLog) {
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", T(UiText::VerboseLogsWarning));
        }
        SettingRow(T(UiText::LogIntervalMs));
        PushControlWidth();
        UISlider("##LogInterval", &OW::Config::aimDryRunLogIntervalMs, 50.0f, 1000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}

void DrawMiscBehaviorPage() {
    using namespace OW::Config;
    static int selectedId=View_aimBehaviorPresets().empty()?-1:View_aimBehaviorPresets().front().id,lastId=-2;
    static AimBehaviorPreset draft{};
    static char name[64]="Behavior Preset";
    bool changed=false;
    UIGroupBox("Behavior modes");
    SettingRow("Behavior mode");PushControlWidth();
    if(UISelectAimBehaviorPreset("##modeDefinition",&selectedId,-1,"New mode")) lastId=-2;
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    auto* selected=FindMutableAimBehaviorPreset(selectedId);
    if(lastId!=selectedId) {
        draft=selected?*selected:AimBehaviorPreset{};
        CopyPresetNameToBuffer(draft.name,name);lastId=selectedId;
    }
    auto& mode=selected?*selected:draft;
    SettingRow("Preset Name");PushControlWidth();
    if(ImGui::InputText("##modeName",name,IM_ARRAYSIZE(name))) {mode.name=NormalizeUiPresetName(name,"Behavior Preset",-1);changed=true;}
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    SettingRow("Aim Behavior");PushControlWidth();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(mode.defaultBehavior >= 0);
    if(UISelect("##modeBehavior",&mode.behavior,kAimBehavior,IM_ARRAYSIZE(kAimBehavior))) {
        if(!selected) {
            mode.firePolicy=static_cast<int>(OW::DefaultFirePolicyForBehavior(
                static_cast<OW::AimBehaviorType>(mode.behavior)));
            mode.keepFiring=mode.firePolicy==static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::KeepFiring) ||
                mode.firePolicy==static_cast<int>(OW::FirePolicyType::TrackingWithHold);
        }
        changed=true;
    }
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Edit mode structure and defaults here. Existing Slot parameters stay independent."));
    changed|=UI::BehaviorTuningEditor(mode,mode.behavior);
    changed|=UI::AimPlanEditor::Motion(mode.motion);
    mode.method=mode.motion.method;mode.methodPresetId=-1;
    const bool modeListFull = std::count_if(Read_aimBehaviorPresets().begin(), Read_aimBehaviorPresets().end(),
        [](const auto& p) { return p.defaultBehavior < 0; }) >= 64;
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(modeListFull);
    if(UIActionButton(L("Save as new mode"),140.f)) {
        auto created=CaptureBehaviorPresetFromCurrent(mode.behavior,mode.method,-1,mode.baseSpeed,
            mode.startLimiter,mode.moveSplitEnabled,mode.moveSplitMaxPixels,mode.moveSplitDelayUs,name);
        static_cast<AimBehaviorTuning&>(created)=mode;created.motion=mode.motion;
        View_aimBehaviorPresets().push_back(created);selectedId=created.id;lastId=-2;changed=true;
    }
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if(modeListFull) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("The mode list is full (64). Delete an unused mode to add another."));
    if(selectedId>=0) {
        const auto* deleteCandidate=FindAimBehaviorPreset(selectedId);
        const bool protectedDefault=deleteCandidate && deleteCandidate->defaultBehavior>=0;
        const bool used=AimBehaviorPresetInUse(selectedId);
        ImGui::SameLine();ImGui::BeginDisabled(used);
        if(UIActionButton(L("Delete mode"),110.f)) {
            std::erase_if(View_aimBehaviorPresets(),[&](const auto& p){return p.id==selectedId && p.defaultBehavior<0;});
            selectedId=-1;lastId=-2;changed=true;
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        if(protectedDefault) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Default modes cannot be deleted."));
        else if(used) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("This mode is in use. Choose another mode in its Slots before deleting it."));
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
    UIGroupBox("Output shaping");
    SettingRow(T(UiText::OvershootCurve));UICheckbox("##miscOvershootCurve",&aimOvershootCurve);
    if(aimOvershootCurve) {
        UI::AimPlanEditor::Float("Overshoot Gain","##overshootGain",aimOvershootGain,0,1);
        UI::AimPlanEditor::Float("Overshoot Reset","##overshootReset",aimOvershootResetPixels,1,250," counts");
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
    if(ImGui::CollapsingHeader(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"兼容方法库":"Legacy methods"))
        DrawMiscMethodPage();
    if(changed) RefreshBehaviorModeSlots();
}

void DrawMiscMethodPage() {
    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupMethod));
    {
        static int selectedMethod = 0;
        static int selectedMethodPresetId = -1;
        static int lastMethodPresetId = -2;
        static char methodPresetName[64] = "Method Preset";
        selectedMethod = OW::Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(selectedMethod);

        SettingRow(T(UiText::SubMethod));
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelect("##miscMethodSelector", &selectedMethod, kAimMethod, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kAimMethod))) {
            if (const OW::Config::AimMethodPreset* selectedPreset =
                    OW::Config::FindAimMethodPreset(selectedMethodPresetId)) {
                if (OW::Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(selectedPreset->method) != selectedMethod)
                    selectedMethodPresetId = -1;
            }
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::Preset));
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelectAimMethodPreset("##miscMethodPreset", &selectedMethodPresetId, selectedMethod)) {
            if (const OW::Config::AimMethodPreset* selectedPreset =
                    OW::Config::FindAimMethodPreset(selectedMethodPresetId)) {
                selectedMethod = OW::Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(selectedPreset->method);
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer(selectedPreset->name, methodPresetName);
            }
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        OW::Config::AimMethodPreset* selectedPreset =
            OW::Config::FindMutableAimMethodPreset(selectedMethodPresetId);
        if (selectedPreset &&
            OW::Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(selectedPreset->method) != selectedMethod) {
            selectedMethodPresetId = -1;
            selectedPreset = nullptr;
        }
        if (lastMethodPresetId != selectedMethodPresetId) {
            if (selectedPreset)
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer(selectedPreset->name, methodPresetName);
            else
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer("Method Preset", methodPresetName);
            lastMethodPresetId = selectedMethodPresetId;
        }

        SettingRow(T(UiText::PresetName));
        PushControlWidth();
        if (ImGui::InputText("##miscMethodPresetName", methodPresetName, IM_ARRAYSIZE(methodPresetName))) {
            if (selectedPreset)
                selectedPreset->name = NormalizeUiPresetName(methodPresetName, "Method Preset", -1);
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        selectedMethod = OW::Config::ClampAimMethodIndex(selectedMethod);
        float& angularSpeedScale = selectedPreset
            ? selectedPreset->angularSpeedScale
            : OW::Config::aimMethodAngularSpeedScale[static_cast<size_t>(selectedMethod)];

        auto drawAngularSpeed = [&](const char* id) {
            SettingRow(T(UiText::AngularSpeed));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider(id, &angularSpeedScale, 0.0f, 200.0f, Number(0, " %"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        };

        switch (selectedMethod) {
        case 0:
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodLinearAngularSpeed");
            break;
        case 1:
            SettingRow(T(UiText::PGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPidP", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidP : &OW::Config::View_aimPidP(), 0.0f, 2.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::IGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPidI", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidI : &OW::Config::View_aimPidI(), 0.0f, 0.5f, Number(3, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::DGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPidD", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidD : &OW::Config::View_aimPidD(), 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::MaxIntegral));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPidMaxI", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidMaxIntegral : &OW::Config::View_aimPidMaxIntegral(), 1.0f, 50.0f, Number(1, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::Deadzone));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPidDeadzone", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidDeadzone : &OW::Config::View_aimPidDeadzone(), 0.0f, 10.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        case 6:
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodHybridAngularSpeedScale");

            SettingRow(T(UiText::PGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridP", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidP : &OW::Config::View_aimPidP(), 0.0f, 2.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::IGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridI", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidI : &OW::Config::View_aimPidI(), 0.0f, 0.5f, Number(3, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::DGain));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridD", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->pidD : &OW::Config::View_aimPidD(), 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Deadzone");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridDeadzone", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridDeadzoneDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridDeadzoneDeg, 0.0f, 2.0f, Number(2, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Constant Feed");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridConstant", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridConstantSpeedDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridConstantSpeedDeg, 0.0f, 720.0f, Number(0, " deg/s"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Maximum Speed");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridMax", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridMaxSpeedDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridMaxSpeedDeg, 1.0f, OW::Config::kAimConstantAngularSpeedMaxDeg, Number(0, " deg/s"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Acceleration");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridAccel", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridAccelerationDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridAccelerationDeg, 1.0f, 10000.0f, Number(0, " deg/s2"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Braking");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridDecel", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridDecelerationDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridDecelerationDeg, 1.0f, 10000.0f, Number(0, " deg/s2"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Near Radius");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridNear", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridNearRadiusDeg : &OW::Config::aimHybridNearRadiusDeg, 0.05f, 15.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Target Motion Feed");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridMotion", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridTargetMotionGain : &OW::Config::aimHybridTargetMotionGain, 0.0f, 2.0f, Number(2, "x"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Sudden Motion Boost");
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodHybridBoost", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->hybridSuddenMotionBoost : &OW::Config::aimHybridSuddenMotionBoost, 1.0f, 8.0f, Number(1, "x"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        case 2:
            SettingRow(T(UiText::ControlPoints));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodBezierControlPoints", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->bezierControlPoints : &OW::Config::View_aimBezierControlPoints(), 2.0f, 6.0f, Number(0, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::Curvature));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodBezierCurvature", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->bezierCurvature : &OW::Config::View_aimBezierCurvature(), 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::CurveSpeed));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodBezierSpeed", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->bezierSpeed : &OW::Config::View_aimBezierSpeed(), 1.0f, 200.0f, Number(1, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        case 3: {
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodPiecewiseAngularSpeed");

            SettingRow(T(UiText::NearDegrees));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseNearDegrees", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->piecewiseNearDegrees : &OW::Config::aimPiecewiseNearDegrees, 0.0f, 30.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            float& midDegrees = selectedPreset ? selectedPreset->piecewiseMidDegrees : OW::Config::aimPiecewiseMidDegrees;
            midDegrees = (std::max)(midDegrees, OW::Config::AimPiecewiseNearDegrees(selectedPreset));
            SettingRow(T(UiText::MidDegrees));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseMidDegrees", &midDegrees,
                     OW::Config::AimPiecewiseNearDegrees(selectedPreset), 45.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            float& farDegrees = selectedPreset ? selectedPreset->piecewiseFarDegrees : OW::Config::aimPiecewiseFarDegrees;
            farDegrees = (std::max)(farDegrees, OW::Config::AimPiecewiseMidDegrees(selectedPreset));
            SettingRow(T(UiText::FarDegrees));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseFarDegrees", &farDegrees,
                     OW::Config::AimPiecewiseMidDegrees(selectedPreset), 60.0f, Number(1, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::NearScale));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseNearScale", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->piecewiseNearScale : &OW::Config::aimPiecewiseNearScale, 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::MidScale));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseMidScale", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->piecewiseMidScale : &OW::Config::aimPiecewiseMidScale, 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow(T(UiText::FarScale));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodPiecewiseFarScale", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->piecewiseFarScale : &OW::Config::aimPiecewiseFarScale, 0.0f, 1.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        }
        case 4:
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodAccelAngularSpeed");

            SettingRow(T(UiText::Acceleration));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodAccelAcceleration", selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->accelLimitedAcceleration : &OW::Config::aimAccelLimitedAcceleration, 0.0f, 20.0f, Number(2, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        case 5:
            SettingRow(T(UiText::AngularSpeed));
            PushControlWidth();
            UISlider("##methodConstantAngularSpeed",
                     selectedPreset ? &selectedPreset->constantAngularSpeedDeg : &OW::Config::aimConstantAngularSpeedDeg,
                     0.0f, OW::Config::kAimConstantAngularSpeedMaxDeg, Number(0, " deg/s"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            break;
        case 7: {
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodShuwuAngularSpeed");
            koi::ShuwuConfig defaults{};
            if (!selectedPreset)
                ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Save a new method preset to edit Shuwu parameters."));
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!selectedPreset);
            UI::AimPlanEditor::Shuwu(selectedPreset ? selectedPreset->shuwu : defaults);
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
            break;
        }
        case 8: {
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodResponseAngularSpeed");
            OW::AimResponseCurve::Points defaults;
            if(!selectedPreset) ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Save a new method preset to edit response curve parameters."));
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(!selectedPreset);
            UI::ResponseCurveEditor(selectedPreset?selectedPreset->responseCurve:defaults);
            ImGui::EndDisabled();break;
        }
        case 9:
            drawAngularSpeed("##methodKoiAngularSpeed");
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Follows the remaining aim error proportionally. Speed scale adjusts response."));
            break;
        default:
            break;
        }

        if (selectedPreset) {
            selectedPreset->method = selectedMethod;
            selectedPreset->name = NormalizeUiPresetName(methodPresetName, "Method Preset", -1);
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::SaveNew), 92.0f)) {
            OW::Config::AimMethodPreset preset =
                selectedPreset ? *selectedPreset : CaptureMethodPresetFromCurrent(selectedMethod, methodPresetName);
            preset.id = NextAimMethodPresetId();
            preset.name = NormalizeUiPresetName(methodPresetName, "Method Preset", static_cast<int>(OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().size()));
            preset.method = selectedMethod;
            OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().push_back(preset);
            selectedMethodPresetId = preset.id;
            lastMethodPresetId = -2;
            selectedPreset = nullptr;
        }
        if (selectedPreset) {
            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
            if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Delete), 72.0f)) {
                const int deletedId = selectedMethodPresetId;
                OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().erase(
                    std::remove_if(OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().begin(),
                                   OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().end(),
                                   [deletedId](const OW::Config::AimMethodPreset& preset) {
                                       return preset.id == deletedId;
                                   }),
                    OW::Config::View_aimMethodPresets().end());
                for (int& methodPresetId : OW::Config::View_aimBehaviorMethodPreset()) {
                    if (methodPresetId == deletedId)
                        methodPresetId = -1;
                }
                for (OW::Config::AimBehaviorPreset& behaviorPreset : OW::Config::View_aimBehaviorPresets()) {
                    if (behaviorPreset.methodPresetId == deletedId)
                        behaviorPreset.methodPresetId = -1;
                }
                selectedMethodPresetId = -1;
                lastMethodPresetId = -2;
            }
        }
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}

void DrawMiscDynamicFovPage() {
    UIGroupBox("Dynamic FOV Presets");
    {
        static int selectedPresetId = -1;
        static int lastPresetId = -2;
        static char presetName[64] = "Dynamic FOV";
        static OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset draft{};
        static uint64_t lastProfileGeneration = 0;
        const auto generation = OW::Config::configLoadGeneration.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
        if (generation != lastProfileGeneration) {
            lastPresetId = -2;
            lastProfileGeneration = generation;
        }

        const OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset* selectedPreset =
            OW::Config::FindDynamicFovPreset(selectedPresetId);
        if (lastPresetId != selectedPresetId) {
            if (selectedPreset) {
                draft = *selectedPreset;
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer(selectedPreset->name, presetName);
            } else {
                draft = OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset{};
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer("Dynamic FOV", presetName);
            }
            lastPresetId = selectedPresetId;
        }

        SettingRow("Preset");
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelectDynamicFovPreset("##miscDynamicFovPreset", &selectedPresetId, true)) {
            selectedPreset = OW::Config::FindDynamicFovPreset(selectedPresetId);
            if (selectedPreset) {
                draft = *selectedPreset;
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer(selectedPreset->name, presetName);
            } else {
                draft = OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset{};
                CopyPresetNameToBuffer("Dynamic FOV", presetName);
            }
            lastPresetId = selectedPresetId;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        selectedPreset = OW::Config::FindDynamicFovPreset(selectedPresetId);
        OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset& editPreset = draft;

        SettingRow("Preset Name");
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputText("##miscDynamicFovName", presetName, IM_ARRAYSIZE(presetName));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1 ? "覆盖宽度（米）" : "Coverage width (m)");
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::DragFloat("##worldDiameterM", &editPreset.worldDiameterM, 0.05f, 0.0f, 50.0f, "%.2f", ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp);
        ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1 ? "0：编辑曲线节点；大于 0：按距离保持固定的覆盖宽度。" : "0 edits curve points; a positive value keeps this world-space width at every distance.");
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        SettingRow("Smooth Curve");
        UICheckbox("##miscDynamicFovSmooth", &editPreset.smooth);

        UI::DynamicFovEditor(editPreset);

        editPreset = OW::Config::ValidateDynamicFovPresetValue(editPreset);

        const float preview5 = OW::Config::EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(editPreset, 5.0f, OW::Config::kDefaultFovDeg);
        const float preview10 = OW::Config::EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(editPreset, 10.0f, OW::Config::kDefaultFovDeg);
        const float preview20 = OW::Config::EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(editPreset, 20.0f, OW::Config::kDefaultFovDeg);
        const float preview30 = OW::Config::EvaluateDynamicFovPreset(editPreset, 30.0f, OW::Config::kDefaultFovDeg);
        char preview[128] = {};
        std::snprintf(preview,
                      sizeof(preview),
                      "5m %.0f deg   10m %.0f deg   20m %.0f deg   30m %.0f deg",
                      preview5,
                      preview10,
                      preview20,
                      preview30);
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(0.78f, 0.84f, 0.92f, 1.0f), "%s", preview);

        ImGui::Spacing();
        if (selectedPreset && UIActionButton(OW::Config::uiLanguage == 1 ? "更新预设" : "Update Preset", 112.0f)) {
            editPreset.name = NormalizeUiPresetName(presetName, "Dynamic FOV", -1);
            editPreset.id = selectedPresetId;
            if (auto* destination = OW::Config::FindMutableDynamicFovPreset(selectedPresetId))
                *destination = OW::Config::ValidateDynamicFovPresetValue(editPreset);
        }
        if (selectedPreset) ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
        if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::SaveNew), 92.0f)) {
            OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset preset = editPreset;
            preset.id = NextDynamicFovPresetId();
            preset.name = NormalizeUiPresetName(
                presetName,
                "Dynamic FOV",
                static_cast<int>(OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().size()));
            preset = OW::Config::ValidateDynamicFovPresetValue(preset);
            OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().push_back(preset);
            selectedPresetId = preset.id;
            lastPresetId = -2;
        }

        if (selectedPreset) {
            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
            if (UIActionButton(T(UiText::Delete), 72.0f)) {
                const int deletedId = selectedPresetId;
                OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().erase(
                    std::remove_if(OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().begin(),
                                   OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().end(),
                                   [deletedId](const OW::Config::DynamicFovPreset& preset) {
                                       return preset.id == deletedId;
                                   }),
                    OW::Config::View_dynamicFovPresets().end());
                if (OW::Config::View_aimbotDynamicFovPresetId() == deletedId) {
                    OW::Config::View_aimbotFovMode() = OW::Config::kFovModeFixed;
                    OW::Config::View_aimbotDynamicFovPresetId() = -1;
                }
                for (auto& heroSlots : OW::Config::View_heroAimPresets()) {
                    for (OW::Config::HeroSlotPreset& slot : heroSlots.second) {
                        if (slot.preset.dynamicFovPresetId == deletedId) {
                            slot.preset.fovMode = OW::Config::kFovModeFixed;
                            slot.preset.dynamicFovPresetId = -1;
                        }
                    }
                }
                selectedPresetId = -1;
                lastPresetId = -2;
            }
        }
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}

void DrawMiscScreenPage() {
    auto display=V2::HeroSettings::Snapshot()->display;
    bool displayChanged=false;
    UIGroupBox(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"ESP / HUD 字体":"ESP / HUD fonts");
    auto fontInput=[&](const char* label,std::string& path) {
        char text[1024]{};std::snprintf(text,sizeof(text),"%s",path.c_str());
        SettingRow(label);ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        if(ImGui::InputText("##fontPath",text,sizeof(text),ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue)){path=text;displayChanged=true;}
    };
    ImGui::PushID("latin");fontInput(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"西文字体":"Font",display.font);ImGui::PopID();
    ImGui::PushID("chinese");fontInput(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"中文回退字体":"Chinese fallback",display.chineseFont);ImGui::PopID();
    if(ImGui::Button(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"恢复默认字体":"Restore default fonts")) {
        display.font="C:/Windows/Fonts/consola.ttf";display.chineseFont="C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc";displayChanged=true;
    }
    ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"输入字体文件完整路径，按 Enter 应用；不影响菜单字体":"Enter a font file path and press Enter; menu fonts are separate");
    for(const auto& path:{display.font,display.chineseFont})if(GetFileAttributesW(std::filesystem::u8path(path).c_str())==INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES)
        ImGui::TextColored(ImVec4(1,.65f,.5f,1),"%s: %s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"字体不可用，将回退":"Font unavailable; using fallback",path.c_str());
    if(!UI::OverlayFonts::error.empty())ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",UI::OverlayFonts::error.c_str());
    CloseGroupBox();
    UIGroupBox(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"主机状态暂停":"Host state pause");
    const auto host=V2::HostInteraction::published.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
    const bool fresh=V2::HostInteraction::Fresh(*host,OW::ProcessConnection::ConnectionEpoch(),GetTickCount());
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!(fresh&&host->chatKnown)&&!display.pauseOnChat);
    SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"聊天开启时暂停":"Pause while chatting");displayChanged|=UICheckbox("##chatPause",&display.pauseOnChat);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!(fresh&&host->focusKnown)&&!display.pauseOnFocusLoss);
    SettingRow(OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"游戏失焦时暂停":"Pause when game loses focus");displayChanged|=UICheckbox("##focusPause",&display.pauseOnFocusLoss);
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",OW::Config::uiLanguage==1?"主机状态来源待接入":"Host state source pending");
    CloseGroupBox();
    if(displayChanged)V2::HeroSettings::SetDisplay(std::move(display));

    UIGroupBox(T(UiText::GroupTargetScreen));
    {
        bool screenChanged = false;
        int localWidth = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN);
        int localHeight = GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN);
        RECT canvasRect = {};
        if (HWND canvasWindow = g_Overlay.GetOverlayWindow();
            canvasWindow && GetWindowRect(canvasWindow, &canvasRect)) {
            const int canvasWidth = canvasRect.right - canvasRect.left;
            const int canvasHeight = canvasRect.bottom - canvasRect.top;
            if (canvasWidth > 0 && canvasHeight > 0) {
                localWidth = canvasWidth;
                localHeight = canvasHeight;
            }
        }
        int detectedWidth = OW::detectedScreenWidth;
        int detectedHeight = OW::detectedScreenHeight;

        SettingRow(T(UiText::LocalWidth));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputInt("##localScreenWidth", &localWidth, 0, 0,
                        ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::LocalHeight));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputInt("##localScreenHeight", &localHeight, 0, 0,
                        ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::DmaWidth));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputInt("##detectedScreenWidth", &detectedWidth, 0, 0,
                        ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::DmaHeight));
        PushControlWidth();
        ImGui::InputInt("##detectedScreenHeight", &detectedHeight, 0, 0,
                        ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::FallbackWidth));
        PushControlWidth();
        screenChanged |= ImGui::InputInt("##manualScreenWidth", &OW::Config::manualScreenWidth, 0, 0);
        if (OW::Config::manualScreenWidth < 0)
            OW::Config::manualScreenWidth = 0;
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow(T(UiText::FallbackHeight));
        PushControlWidth();
        screenChanged |= ImGui::InputInt("##manualScreenHeight", &OW::Config::manualScreenHeight, 0, 0);
        if (OW::Config::manualScreenHeight < 0)
            OW::Config::manualScreenHeight = 0;
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        if (screenChanged)
            OW::RefreshScreenSizeFromConfig();
    }
    CloseGroupBox();
}
