```cpp
void DrawHeroKeyPage() {
    using namespace V2::HeroSettings;
    const auto hero=CurrentHeroOption();
    const bool zh=OW::Config::uiLanguage==1;
    auto settings=Get(hero.heroId);
    bool changed=false;
    UIGroupBox(zh?"英雄游戏按键":"Hero action keys");
    ImGui::BeginDisabled(hero.heroId==0);
    for(int i=0;i<int(Action::Count);++i) {
        ImGui::PushID(i);SettingRow(kActionNames[i]);
        changed |= UIKeyBinding("##heroActionKey", &settings.keys[i],
                                KeyBindingStorage::VirtualKey, false);
        ImGui::PopID();
    }
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",zh?"鼠标侧键输出、键盘物理按住释放尚不支持；蓄力释放请用鼠标动作键。":"Side-button output and physical keyboard release are unavailable; use mouse action keys for charged releases.");
    if(ImGui::Button(zh?"恢复当前英雄默认键":"Reset this hero to default keys")){settings.keys=kDefaultKeys;changed=true;UIKeyBindingCancelCapture();}
    ImGui::EndDisabled();
    if(hero.heroId==0)ImGui::TextDisabled("%s",zh?"选择英雄以编辑按键":"Select a hero to edit action keys");
    CloseGroupBox();
    if(changed) {
        std::lock_guard transition(OW::RuntimeOutputProducerTransitionMutex());
        const bool wasEnabled=OW::RuntimeOutputSessionEnabled();
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(false);
        OW::InvalidateRuntimeOutputContinuity();
        OW::CancelActiveSkill();
        OW::RuntimeOutputScheduler().CancelAllAndJoin();
        Set(hero.heroId,std::move(settings));
        OW::SetRuntimeOutputSessionEnabled(wasEnabled);
    }
    UIGroupBox(zh?"全局快捷键":"Global shortcuts");
    SettingRow(T(UiText::ToggleKey));PushControlWidth();
    UIKeyBinding("##globalMenuKey", &OW::Config::MenuToggleKey,
                 KeyBindingStorage::VirtualKey);
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    SettingRow(L("Cache refresh key"));PushControlWidth();
    UIKeyBinding("##globalRefreshKey", &OW::Config::CacheRefreshKey,
                 KeyBindingStorage::VirtualKey);
    if(OW::Config::CacheRefreshKey==OW::Config::MenuToggleKey)
        OW::Config::CacheRefreshKey=0;
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();CloseGroupBox();
}

namespace {

struct PredictionActionCard {
    const PredictionProfile* profile;
    const OW::WeaponSpec* weapon = nullptr;
    const OW::HeroSkillDefinition* skill = nullptr;
};

ID3D11ShaderResourceView* PredictionWeaponIcon(const HeroOption& hero, const OW::WeaponSpec& weapon) {
    auto* icons = Render::GetIconManager();
    if (!icons) return nullptr;

    std::string iconSlug;
    for (unsigned char ch : weapon.weaponName) {
        if (std::isalnum(ch)) {
            iconSlug += static_cast<char>(std::tolower(ch));
        } else if (ch != '\'' && !iconSlug.empty() && iconSlug.back() != '-') {
            iconSlug += '-';
        }
    }
    if (!iconSlug.empty() && iconSlug.back() == '-') iconSlug.pop_back();
    if (weapon.weaponId == "cassidy_ads_perk") iconSlug = "peacekeeper";
    const std::string heroSlug = OW::HeroDisplayNameToSlug(hero.label);
    const std::string key = heroSlug + "/" + iconSlug;
    if (auto* icon = icons->GetIcon(key)) return icon;
    icons->LoadAbilityIcons(heroSlug, {iconSlug});
    return icons->GetIcon(key);
}

std::vector<PredictionActionCard> PredictionActionCards(
    const HeroOption& hero, const std::vector<PredictionProfile>& profiles) {
    const auto findProfile = [&](std::string_view id) -> const PredictionProfile* {
        const auto found = std::lower_bound(profiles.begin(), profiles.end(), id,
            [](const PredictionProfile& profile, std::string_view id) { return profile.profileId < id; });
        return found != profiles.end() && found->profileId == id ? &*found : nullptr;
    };
    std::vector<PredictionActionCard> cards;
    for (auto weapon = OW::WeaponSpecsBegin(); weapon != OW::WeaponSpecsEnd(); ++weapon) {
        if (weapon->heroId != hero.heroId || weapon->weaponId.empty()) continue;
        if (const auto* profile = findProfile(weapon->weaponId)) cards.push_back({profile, weapon});
    }
    std::stable_sort(cards.begin(), cards.end(), [](const auto& lhs, const auto& rhs) {
        return lhs.weapon->order < rhs.weapon->order;
    });
    const auto listed = [&](const PredictionProfile* profile) {
        return std::any_of(cards.begin(), cards.end(),
            [&](const auto& card) { return card.profile == profile; });
    };
    const auto skillStart = cards.size();
    for (const auto& skill : OW::AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
        if (skill.heroId != hero.heroId || !skill.skillId || !*skill.skillId) continue;
        if (const auto* profile = findProfile(std::string("skill:") + skill.skillId);
            profile && (!profile->heroId || profile->heroId == hero.heroId) && !listed(profile)) {
            cards.push_back({profile, nullptr, &skill});
        }
    }
    std::stable_sort(cards.begin() + skillStart, cards.end(), [](const auto& lhs, const auto& rhs) {
        return lhs.skill->inputAction < rhs.skill->inputAction;
    });
    for (const auto& profile : profiles) {
        if (profile.heroId == hero.heroId && !listed(&profile)) cards.push_back({&profile});
    }
    return cards;
}

const char* PredictionActionTitle(const PredictionActionCard& card) {
    if (card.weapon) return L(card.weapon->weaponName.data());
    if (card.skill && card.skill->displayName) return L(card.skill->displayName);
    return card.profile->profileId.c_str();
}

} // namespace

void UI::DrawPredictionDataPage() {
    const bool zh = OW::Config::uiLanguage == OW::Config::kUiLanguageChineseSimplified;
    const auto& hero = DrawPredictionHeroPicker();
    float defaultRadius = OW::kDefaultInstantHitRadius;
    const auto profiles = OW::SnapshotPredictionProfiles(&defaultRadius);
    const auto cards = PredictionActionCards(hero, profiles);
    UIGroupBox(zh ? "预测数据" : "Prediction Data");
    SettingRow(zh ? "即时命中公共半径" : "Default instant-hit radius");
    PushControlWidth();
    if (UISlider("##instantHitDefaultRadius", &defaultRadius, 0.0f,
                 OW::kMaxPredictionProjectileRadius, Number(3, " m")))
        OW::SetInstantHitDefaultRadius(defaultRadius);
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    ImGui::Spacing();
    if (cards.empty()) {
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", zh ? "当前英雄还没有预测数据" : "No prediction data for this hero.");
        CloseGroupBox();
        return;
    }

    static std::string selectedProfileId;
    auto selected = std::find_if(cards.begin(), cards.end(),
        [](const auto& card) { return card.profile->profileId == selectedProfileId; });
    if (selected == cards.end()) {
        selected = cards.begin();
        selectedProfileId = selected->profile->profileId;
    }

    const float iconSide = ImGui::GetFontSize() * 2.0f;
    const float rowHeight = iconSide + 2.0f * ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.y +
        ImGui::GetStyle().ScrollbarSize + 10.0f;
    ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(&hero - kHeroOptions));
    if (ImGui::BeginChild("##predictionActions", ImVec2(0.0f, rowHeight), false,
                          ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar)) {
        for (auto card = cards.begin(); card != cards.end(); ++card) {
            if (card != cards.begin()) ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::PushID(card->profile->profileId.c_str());
            const bool active = card == selected;
            if (active) ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Button,
                ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColAccentDark));
            const char* title = PredictionActionTitle(*card);
            auto* icon = card->weapon ? PredictionWeaponIcon(hero, *card->weapon)
                : card->skill ? HeroSkillIconForDefinition(*card->skill) : nullptr;
            const bool pressed = icon
                ? ImGui::ImageButton(title, reinterpret_cast<ImTextureID>(icon), ImVec2(iconSide, iconSide))
                : ImGui::Button(title, ImVec2(0.0f, iconSide + 2.0f * ImGui::GetStyle().FramePadding.y));
#ifdef IMGUI_ENABLE_TEST_ENGINE
            ImGuiContext& g = *ImGui::GetCurrentContext();
            IMGUI_TEST_ENGINE_ITEM_INFO(ImGui::GetItemID(), title, g.LastItemData.StatusFlags);
#endif
            if (active) ImGui::PopStyleColor();
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", title);
            if (pressed) {
                selected = card;
                selectedProfileId = card->profile->profileId;
            }
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
    }
    ImGui::EndChild();
    ImGui::PopID();

    PredictionProfile profile = *selected->profile;
    ImGui::PushID(profile.profileId.c_str());
    ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", PredictionActionTitle(*selected));
    ImGui::TextDisabled("%s %d", zh ? "配置版本" : "Config version", profile.configVersion);
    bool changed = false;

    SettingRow(zh ? "投射速度" : "Projectile speed");
    PushControlWidth();
    changed |= UISlider("##predictionSpeed", &profile.projectile.projectileSpeed, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(2, " m/s"));
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    if (profile.inheritInstantHitRadius.has_value()) {
        SettingRow(zh ? "半径来源" : "Radius source");
        const char* radiusSources[] = { zh ? "继承公共半径" : "Inherit default", zh ? "动作单独覆盖" : "Override for this action" };
        int source = *profile.inheritInstantHitRadius ? 0 : 1;
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelect("##predictionRadiusSource", &source, radiusSources, IM_ARRAYSIZE(radiusSources))) {
            profile.inheritInstantHitRadius = source == 0;
            profile.projectile.projectileRadius = defaultRadius;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    SettingRow(zh ? "投射物半径" : "Projectile radius");
    if (profile.inheritInstantHitRadius.value_or(false)) {
        ImGui::Text("%.3f m", defaultRadius);
    } else {
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##predictionRadius", &profile.projectile.projectileRadius, 0.0f,
                            OW::kMaxPredictionProjectileRadius, Number(3, " m"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    SettingRow(zh ? "重力" : "Gravity");
    changed |= UICheckbox("##predictionGravity", &profile.projectile.gravity);
    if (profile.projectile.gravity) {
        SettingRow(zh ? "重力加速度" : "Gravity acceleration");
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##predictionGravityAcceleration", &profile.projectile.gravityAcceleration, 0.0f, 30.0f, Number(2, " m/s²"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }
    SettingRow(zh ? "施法延迟" : "Cast delay");
    PushControlWidth();
    changed |= UISlider("##predictionCastDelay", &profile.projectile.castDelayMs, 0.0f, 1000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    SettingRow(zh ? "发射方向修正" : "Launch direction bias");
    PushControlWidth();
    changed |= UISlider("##predictionUpBias", &profile.projectile.launchDirectionUpBias, -1.0f, 1.0f, Number(3));
    ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    const bool hasChargeSpeed = profile.projectile.chargeMinSpeed > 0.0f || profile.projectile.chargeMaxSpeed > 0.0f ||
        (selected->weapon && selected->weapon->projectile.chargeMaxSpeed > 0.0f);
    if (hasChargeSpeed) {
        SettingRow(zh ? "最低蓄力速度" : "Minimum charge speed");
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##predictionChargeMin", &profile.projectile.chargeMinSpeed, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(2, " m/s"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        SettingRow(zh ? "最高蓄力速度" : "Maximum charge speed");
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##predictionChargeMax", &profile.projectile.chargeMaxSpeed, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(2, " m/s"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if (profile.projectile.chargeMaxSpeed < profile.projectile.chargeMinSpeed)
            profile.projectile.chargeMaxSpeed = profile.projectile.chargeMinSpeed;
    }
    if (changed)
        OW::UpdatePredictionProfile(profile);
    ImGui::PopID();
    CloseGroupBox();
}
```

```cpp
static bool DrawHeroSkillSequenceSteps(const OW::HeroSkillDefinition& definition,
                                       OW::Config::HeroSkillSettings& settings) {
    if (definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_ASHE &&
        std::string(definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "") == "fire-pattern") {
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s", L("Ashe combo stages"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Hip shot, scope in, scoped shot after 210 ms, scope out after 50 ms, then three follow-up hip shots, each after a 240 ms wait."));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("A brief release can continue the current stage. A release seen at a checkpoint restarts from shot one on the next press. A shot already waiting may still fire after release."));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("After every shot, vertical tracking pauses for 35 ms while horizontal tracking continues."));
        return false;
    }
    bool changed = false;

    ImGui::Spacing();
    ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s", L("Sequence Steps"));

    if (!settings.sequenceSteps.empty()) {
        float speedScale = settings.sequenceSteps.front().speedScale;
        SettingRow("Speed Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISlider("##sequenceSpeedScale", &speedScale, 0.5f, 2.0f, Number(2, "x"))) {
            for (OW::Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step : settings.sequenceSteps)
                step.speedScale = speedScale;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(settings.sequenceSteps.size()); ++index) {
        OW::Config::HeroSkillSequenceStep& step = settings.sequenceSteps[static_cast<size_t>(index)];
        ImGui::PushID(index);

        ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
        ImGui::Text("#%d", index + 1);
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);

        bool left = (step.buttonMask & 1) != 0;
        bool right = (step.buttonMask & 2) != 0;
        if (UICheckbox(L("Primary"), &left)) { step.buttonMask ^= 1; changed = true; }
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 4.0f);
        if (UICheckbox(L("Secondary"), &right)) { step.buttonMask ^= 2; changed = true; }
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);

        ImGui::PushItemWidth(150.0f);
        changed |= UISlider("##stepDur", &step.durationMs, 0.0f, 1000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);

        ImGui::TextUnformatted(L("+/-"));
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 4.0f);
        ImGui::PushItemWidth(96.0f);
        changed |= UISlider("##stepJitter", &step.jitterMs, 0.0f, 50.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);

        if (ImGui::Button(L("Remove"))) {
            settings.sequenceSteps.erase(settings.sequenceSteps.begin() + index);
            changed = true;
            ImGui::PopID();
            break;
        }

        ImGui::PopID();
    }

    if (static_cast<int>(settings.sequenceSteps.size()) < OW::Config::kMaxHeroSkillSequenceSteps) {
        if (ImGui::Button(L("Add Step"))) {
            settings.sequenceSteps.push_back({ 1, 117, 1.0f, 0 });
            changed = true;
        }
    }

    if (!definition.defaultSettings.sequenceSteps.empty()) {
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
        if (ImGui::Button(L("Reset Steps"))) {
            settings.sequenceSteps = definition.defaultSettings.sequenceSteps;
            changed = true;
        }
    }

    return changed;
}

static bool DrawHeroSkillDefinition(const OW::HeroSkillDefinition& definition, uint64_t heroId) {
    OW::Config::HeroSkillSettings settings = OW::Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(
        heroId,
        definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "",
        definition.defaultSettings);

    bool changed = false;
    auto hasControl = [&](OW::HeroSkillControlFlags control) {
        return OW::HasHeroSkillControl(definition, control);
    };
    ImGui::PushID(definition.skillId);

    if (ID3D11ShaderResourceView* icon = HeroSkillIconForDefinition(definition)) {
        ImGui::Image(reinterpret_cast<ImTextureID>(icon), ImVec2(24.0f, 24.0f));
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
    }
    if (!hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::PausePolicy)) {
      ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
      ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s / %s",
                       L(OW::HeroSkillCategoryName(definition.category)),
                       L(OW::HeroSkillInputActionName(definition.inputAction)));
      const bool directGameAction = definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1 ||
          definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ability2 ||
          definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ability3 ||
          definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate ||
          definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::QuickMelee;
      if (directGameAction)
          ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Keyboard action is written to the game action word for about 55 ms; Box keyboard output is not used."));
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Enabled)) {
        SettingRow("Enabled", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##skillEnabled", &settings.enabled);
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::LowAmmoRightClick)) {
        const char* sources[] = { "Estimate From Left Hold", "Read Ammo From Capture" };
        SettingRow("Ammo Source", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISelect("##zaryaAmmoSource", &settings.zaryaAmmoSource, sources, IM_ARRAYSIZE(sources));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow("Base Threshold (ammo)", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##zaryaAmmoThreshold", &settings.zaryaAmmoThreshold, 1.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, ""));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow("Random Range (+/- ammo)", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##zaryaAmmoJitter", &settings.zaryaAmmoJitter, 0.0f, 99.0f, Number(0, ""));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        const int minimum = (std::max)(1, settings.zaryaAmmoThreshold - settings.zaryaAmmoJitter);
        const int maximum = (std::min)(100, settings.zaryaAmmoThreshold + settings.zaryaAmmoJitter);
        if (minimum == maximum)
            ImGui::TextWrapped(L("Fixed threshold: %d ammo. Fires once per magazine while primary fire is held."), minimum);
        else
            ImGui::TextWrapped(L("Chooses one threshold from %d to %d ammo per magazine. Fires once while primary fire is held."), minimum, maximum);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Threshold changes apply to the next magazine."));
        if (settings.zaryaAmmoSource == OW::Config::kZaryaAmmoHudRecognition)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Reads current ammo from the capture card. Waits when the number is unavailable; does not switch to time estimation."));
        else
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("After a completed reload, estimates remaining ammo from how long primary fire is held."));
        if (changed) OW::Config::SetHeroSkillSettings(heroId, definition.skillId, settings);
        ImGui::PopID();
        return changed;
    }

    const bool hasSequenceControls = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::SequenceSteps);
    const bool isAsheCombo = definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_ASHE &&
        std::string(definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "") == "fire-pattern";
    if (isAsheCombo) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Hip shot, scope in, scoped shot after 210 ms, scope out after 50 ms, then three follow-up hip shots, each after a 240 ms wait."));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("A brief release can continue the current stage. A release seen at a checkpoint restarts from shot one on the next press. A shot already waiting may still fire after release."));
    }
    const bool hasTrackingOverlay = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::TrackingOverlay);
    const bool hasComboAction = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::ComboAction);
    const bool hasPitchControls = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::PitchControl);
    const bool hasPhaseTiming = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::PhaseTiming);
    const bool hasHealthThreshold = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::HealthThreshold);
    const bool hasAbsoluteHealth = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::HealthAbsolute);
    const bool hasAbsoluteEnemyHealth = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::EnemyHealthAbsolute);
    const bool hasPunchAssist = hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::PunchAssist);
    const bool isDvaMatrix = definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_DVA &&
        std::string(definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "") == "defense-matrix";
    const bool hasSkillAimDetails = hasTrackingOverlay && !hasPunchAssist && !isDvaMatrix;
    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::PausePolicy)) {
        SettingRow("Pause Aim", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##pauseAim", &settings.pauseAim);
        SettingRow("Pause Trigger", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##pauseTrigger", &settings.pauseTrigger);
        SettingRow("Pause Other Skills", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##pauseSkills", &settings.pauseSkills);
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Pauses assists during the active defensive skill. Rocket Punch pauses while the secondary-fire key is held. Your enabled settings are restored when the state ends."));
        if (changed) OW::Config::SetHeroSkillSettings(heroId, definition.skillId, settings);
        ImGui::PopID();
        return changed;
    }
    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::DefensiveConditions)) {
        SettingRow("Low Health Condition", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##healthTrigger", &settings.healthTriggerEnabled);
        SettingRow("Incoming Threat Condition", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##threatTrigger", &settings.threatTriggerEnabled);
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(L("Normal Skill Threats"));
        for (size_t i = 0; i < OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats.size(); ++i) {
            if(!OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[i].incoming) continue;
            bool selected = (settings.normalThreatMask & (1 << i)) != 0;
            if (UICheckbox(L(OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[i].label), &selected)) {
                settings.normalThreatMask ^= 1 << i;
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Ultimate threats are waiting for verified activation signals."));
    }
    if(definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Interrupts use fresh skill activation samples; hit timing still needs in-game verification. Ultimate interrupts await activation signals."));
        ImGui::TextUnformatted(L("Normal Skill Threats"));
        for(size_t i=0;i<OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats.size();++i) {
            if(OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[i].interruptWindowMs<=0) continue;
            bool selected=(settings.normalThreatMask & (1<<i))!=0;
            if(UICheckbox(L(OW::SkillConditions::kNormalThreats[i].label),&selected)) {
                settings.normalThreatMask^=1<<i;changed=true;
            }
        }
    }
    if(definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt ||
       definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::LowEnemyHealth) {
        SettingRow("Aim Before Casting",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed|=UICheckbox("##autoSkillAim",&settings.automaticAim);
    }
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::GenjiBlade) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Manually use the mapped ultimate key at full charge. After drawing the blade, assists aim, dashes beyond 5 m and swings within 5 m. Ends after 7 seconds. Does not cast Q. Timing needs in-game calibration."));
        if (ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit hero action keys..."))) UI::state.activeTab=UI::TAB_KEYS;
    }
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::MercyBeam)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Hold the activation key: heal the connected ally at or below the threshold; damage boost above it. Releasing the key returns manual control. Requires mouse primary/secondary mappings and physical-button masking. Connection reading is a candidate awaiting in-game verification."));
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::LucioSong) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Switches to healing when enough nearby allies meet the health threshold. Returns to speed after the condition stays clear for 0.8 seconds. Waits for an observed song change before toggling again. Song reading is a candidate awaiting in-game verification."));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Use toggle Crossfade in the game; hold-to-crossfade is not supported."));
    }
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::ProjectileDefense) {
        SettingRow("Low Health Condition",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##projectileLowHealth",&settings.healthTriggerEnabled);
        SettingRow("Incoming Projectile Condition",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##incomingProjectiles",&settings.projectileThreatEnabled);
        const char* names[]{"Ana Biotic Grenade","Bastion Tactical Grenade"};
        for(int i=0;i<2;++i) {
            bool checked=(settings.projectileThreatMask&(1<<i))!=0;
            if(UICheckbox(L(names[i]),&checked)) { settings.projectileThreatMask^=1<<i;changed=true; }
        }
        if(definition.heroId==OW::eHero::HERO_DVA) {
            SettingRow("Assist Turning",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            changed |= UICheckbox("##matrixTurn",&settings.automaticAim);
            if(settings.automaticAim) {
                SettingRow("Turning Speed",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider("##matrixTurnSpeed",&settings.tracking.speedScale,1.f,200.f,Number(0," %"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }
        }
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Uses enemy team and consecutive projectile positions to estimate an approach toward you within 250 ms. Unknown, stationary, friendly and already handled objects are ignored. Only the listed projectiles are supported; resources and gameplay interception still need verification."));
    }
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::RecentDamageDeflect)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Deflects at low health after recent damage reaches 5% of maximum health, with a visible enemy in range. The damage window expires 450 ms after the last hit. Does not identify incoming projectiles or turn the camera."));
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::HealthSurvival) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Uses the mapped action at low self health. Requires fresh health and ability samples. The interval limits attempts; it does not prove a charge or resource is available."));
        if (definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_ROADHOG)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Enable Toggle Take a Breather in the game before using this helper. It taps Ability 2; it does not hold the key through healing."));
        if (definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ultimate)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Requires fresh full ultimate charge and low self health. Enemy ultimate detection is a separate condition."));
    }
    if (definition.automation == OW::SkillAutomation::ShieldBash)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Hold the mapped secondary-fire key to raise the shield. Taps primary fire only while a visible enemy is under the crosshair and in range. Does not turn the camera or detect ultimate stuns; the interval limits attempts."));
    if (definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_GENJI && definition.inputAction == OW::HeroSkillInputAction::Ability1)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Dash uses fresh activation samples and a bounded retry interval; kill resets and actual recharge are not yet directly readable."));
    if(definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::RecastReturn)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Recasts the mapped Ability 1 only after a freshly observed deployment. Does not deploy a return point at low health."));
    if(definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::EmreJump) {
        SettingRow("Forward Duration",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
        changed|=UISlider("##emreMoveMs",&settings.moveForwardMs,50.f,1000.f,Number(0," ms"));ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        SettingRow("Grenade To Movement Delay",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
        changed|=UISlider("##emreLeadMs",&settings.jumpLeadMs,0.f,500.f,Number(0," ms"));ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s",L("Press once: throw E at the ground, use Shift and move forward, then jump. Timing is adjustable and needs in-game calibration."));
    }
    if (std::string(definition.skillId) == "transcendence")
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Automatic Transcendence is waiting for a verified enemy ultimate activation signal. Enemy charge alone does not trigger it."));
    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::GroupCondition) && settings.radius <= 0)
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Set the verified effect radius before enabling automatic group healing. A zero radius does not cast."));
    const bool hasSkillOutputKey = !hasSequenceControls && !hasComboAction && !hasPunchAssist &&
        (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Key) || hasPitchControls ||
         hasPhaseTiming || hasHealthThreshold || hasAbsoluteHealth);

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Key)) {
        SettingRow("Activation Key", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UIKeyBinding("##skillKey", &settings.key,
                                KeyBindingStorage::AimActivationIndex);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasSkillOutputKey && ImGui::SmallButton(L("Edit hero action keys...")))UI::state.activeTab=UI::TAB_KEYS;


    if ((hasSequenceControls || hasPitchControls || hasPhaseTiming) &&
        !hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Key)) {
        SettingRow("Activation Key", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UIKeyBinding("##skillActivationKey", &settings.key,
                                KeyBindingStorage::AimActivationIndex);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Mode)) {
        SettingRow("Mode", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISelect("##skillMode", &settings.mode, kHeroSkillModes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kHeroSkillModes));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasHealthThreshold) {
        SettingRow("Health Threshold", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillHealth", &settings.healthThreshold, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, "%"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasAbsoluteHealth) {
        SettingRow("Current HP Threshold", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillSelfMaxHealth", &settings.healthThreshold, 0.0f, 500.0f, Number(0, " HP"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MeleeRange) && settings.enabled) {
        const char* modes[] = { "Any target health", "Current health percentage", "Current health amount" };
        SettingRow("Melee Trigger", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISelect("##meleeHealthMode", &settings.meleeHealthMode, modes, IM_ARRAYSIZE(modes));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if (settings.meleeHealthMode == OW::Config::kMeleeHealthPercent) {
            SettingRow("Current HP Percentage Threshold", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##meleeHealthPercent", &settings.meleeHealthPercent, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, "%"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Uses current total HP divided by maximum total HP. Triggers at or below the selected percentage."));
        }
    }

    if (hasAbsoluteEnemyHealth && (!hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MeleeRange) ||
        (settings.enabled && settings.meleeHealthMode == OW::Config::kMeleeHealthAbsolute))) {
        SettingRow(hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MeleeRange) ? "Current HP Threshold" : "Max Health", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillEnemyMaxHealth", &settings.enemyHealthThreshold, 0.0f,
                            hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MeleeRange) ? 500.0f : 300.0f, Number(0, " HP"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::EnemyHealthThreshold)) {
        SettingRow("Enemy HP Threshold", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillEnemyHealth", &settings.enemyHealthThreshold, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, "%"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::AllyHealthThreshold)) {
        SettingRow("Ally HP Threshold", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillAllyHealth", &settings.allyHealthThreshold, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, "%"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Distance)) {
        SettingRow(hasAbsoluteEnemyHealth ? "Max Distance" : "Distance", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillDistance", &settings.distance, 0.0f, hasPunchAssist ? 20.0f : 100.0f,
                            Number(1, " m"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Radius)) {
        SettingRow("Radius", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillRadius", &settings.radius, 0.0f, 30.0f, Number(1, " m"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Prediction)) {
        changed |= UIPredictionAlgorithmSelect("##skillPredictionAlgorithm", &settings.predictionAlgorithm,
                                               kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        settings.prediction = true;
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::CooldownGuard)) {
        SettingRow("Cooldown Guard", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##skillCooldownGuard", &settings.cooldownGuard);
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Cooldown)) {
        SettingRow("Cooldown", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillCooldown", &settings.cooldown, 0.0f, 60.0f, Number(1, " s"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::AmmoGuard)) {
        SettingRow("Ammo Guard", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        changed |= UICheckbox("##skillAmmoGuard", &settings.ammoGuard);

        if (settings.ammoGuard) {
            SettingRow("Reserve Ammo", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##skillAmmoReserve", &settings.ammoGuardReserve, 0.0f, 12.0f, Number(0, ""));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MinTargets)) {
        SettingRow("Min Targets", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillMinTargets", &settings.minTargets, 1.0f, 8.0f, Number(0, ""));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Bone)) {
        SettingRow("Bone", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISelect("##skillTargetBone", &settings.tracking.bone,
                            kHeroSkillTargetBones, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kHeroSkillTargetBones));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::MeleeRange)) {
        SettingRow("Melee Range Expansion", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillMeleeRadius", &settings.meleeRadius, 0.0f, 2.0f, Number(2, " m"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Checks the whole body within Max Distance. Current total HP includes remaining health, armor, shields and extra health. Directly writes the game's melee action for 50 ms; no Box keyboard or activation key is needed."));
    }

    if (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Hitbox)) {
        SettingRow("Hitbox Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillTargetHitbox", &settings.tracking.hitbox,
                            OW::Config::kMinHitboxScalePercent,
                            OW::Config::kMaxHitboxScalePercent, Number(0, " %"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    }

    if ((hasTrackingOverlay || hasPunchAssist) && settings.enabled) {
        const bool canMoveAim=definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::None ||
            definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::GenjiBlade ||
            (isDvaMatrix && settings.automaticAim) ||
            (settings.automaticAim && (definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::LowEnemyHealth ||
                definition.automation==OW::SkillAutomation::NormalInterrupt));
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s", L("Skill Aim"));

        if(canMoveAim) {
        SettingRow("Aim Behavior", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelect("##skillTrackingBehavior", &settings.tracking.aimBehavior,
                     kAimBehavior, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kAimBehavior))) {
            settings.tracking.aimBehavior =
                OW::Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(settings.tracking.aimBehavior);
            settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId = -1;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();

        SettingRow("Behavior Preset", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        if (UISelectAimBehaviorPreset("##skillTrackingBehaviorPreset", &settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId, -1)) {
            if (const OW::Config::AimBehaviorPreset* behaviorPreset =
                    OW::Config::FindAimBehaviorPreset(settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId)) {
                settings.tracking.aimBehavior =
                    OW::Config::ClampAimBehaviorIndex(behaviorPreset->behavior);
            }
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        SettingRow("Motion method", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        const auto* selectedTrackingPreset = OW::Config::FindAimBehaviorPreset(settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId);
        int trackingMethod = selectedTrackingPreset ? selectedTrackingPreset->method : settings.tracking.method;
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId >= 0);
        if (UISelect("##skillTrackingMethod", &trackingMethod, kAimMethod, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kAimMethod))) {
            settings.tracking.method = trackingMethod;
            changed = true;
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        static bool koiPresetListFull = false;
        if (isAsheCombo && ImGui::SmallButton(L("Use Koi proportional tracking"))) {
            const int presetId = OW::Config::EnsureKoiTrackingBehaviorPreset();
            koiPresetListFull = presetId < 0;
            if (presetId >= 0) {
                settings.tracking.aimBehaviorPresetId = presetId;
                settings.tracking.aimBehavior = OW::Config::kAimBehaviorTracking;
                settings.tracking.method = 9;
                settings.tracking.smooth = 0.0f;
                settings.tracking.speedScale = 100.0f;
                changed = true;
            }
        }
        if (isAsheCombo && koiPresetListFull)
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("The mode list is full (64). Delete an unused mode to add another."));
        }
        if (hasSkillAimDetails) {
            SettingRow("Priority", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            const char* priorities[] = {L("FOV"), L("Health"), L("Distance")};
            changed |= UISelect("##skillPriority", &settings.targetPriority, priorities, IM_ARRAYSIZE(priorities));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();

            SettingRow("Assistance Delay", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##skillAssistanceDelay", &settings.assistanceDelayMs, 0.0f, 1000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            SettingRow("Require Visible", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            changed |= UICheckbox("##skillRequireVisible", &settings.requireVisible);
            SettingRow("Allow Invisible Sombra", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            changed |= UICheckbox("##skillStealth", &settings.allowInvisibleSombra);
            SettingRow("Target Roles", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            const char* roleNames[] = {L("Damage"), L("Tank"), L("Support")};
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                bool selected = (settings.targetRoleMask & (1 << i)) != 0;
                ImGui::PushID(i);
                if (UICheckbox(roleNames[i], &selected)) { settings.targetRoleMask ^= 1 << i; changed = true; }
                ImGui::PopID();
                if (i != 2) ImGui::SameLine();
            }
            SettingRow("Draw FOV", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            changed |= UICheckbox("##skillDrawFov", &settings.drawSkillFov);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            changed |= UI::ColorPicker("skillFovColor", settings.skillFovColor);
        }

        if(canMoveAim && !isDvaMatrix) {
        SettingRow("Speed Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider("##skillTrackingSpeedScale", &settings.tracking.speedScale, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, " %"));
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        if(hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::TrajectoryAction) || definition.automation!=OW::SkillAutomation::None) {
            SettingRow("Horizontal Motion Scale",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
            changed|=UISlider("##skillYawScale",&settings.tracking.yawScale,0.f,200.f,Number(0," %"));ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            SettingRow("Vertical Motion Scale",kAimbotRightLabelWidth);PushControlWidth();
            changed|=UISlider("##skillPitchScale",&settings.tracking.pitchScale,0.f,200.f,Number(0," %"));ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }
        }

        if (!isDvaMatrix) {
            SettingRow("FOV (deg)", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##skillTrackingFov", &settings.tracking.fov,
                                OW::Config::kMinFovDeg, OW::Config::kMaxFovDeg, Number(0, " deg"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }

        if (!hasPunchAssist && !isDvaMatrix) {
            SettingRow("Bone", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISelect("##skillTrackingBone", &settings.tracking.bone,
                                kHeroSkillTrackingBones, IM_ARRAYSIZE(kHeroSkillTrackingBones));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }

        if (!isDvaMatrix) {
            SettingRow("Hitbox Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##skillTrackingHitbox", &settings.tracking.hitbox,
                                OW::Config::kMinHitboxScalePercent,
                                OW::Config::kMaxHitboxScalePercent, Number(0, " %"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }

        if (hasTrackingOverlay && isAsheCombo) {
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("After every shot, vertical tracking pauses for 35 ms while horizontal tracking continues."));
        } else if (hasTrackingOverlay && hasSequenceControls) {
            ImGui::Spacing();
            ImGui::TextColored(
                ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted),
                "%s", L("Shot Phase Tracking"));

            SettingRow("Phase Aware", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            changed |= UICheckbox(
                "##sequencePhaseAwareTracking",
                &settings.sequencePhaseAwareTracking);

            if (settings.sequencePhaseAwareTracking) {
                SettingRow("Post-fire Pause", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequencePostFirePause",
                    &settings.sequencePostFirePauseMs,
                    0.0f,
                    500.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow("Recovery", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequenceRecovery",
                    &settings.sequenceRecoveryMs,
                    0.0f,
                    1000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow("Pause X Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequencePostFireYawScale",
                    &settings.sequencePostFireYawScale,
                    0.0f,
                    1.0f, Number(2, "x"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow("Pause Y Scale", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequencePostFirePitchScale",
                    &settings.sequencePostFirePitchScale,
                    0.0f,
                    1.0f, Number(2, "x"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow("Pre-shot Window", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequencePreFireBoostWindow",
                    &settings.sequencePreFireBoostWindowMs,
                    0.0f,
                    500.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();

                SettingRow("Pre-shot Boost", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
                PushControlWidth();
                changed |= UISlider(
                    "##sequencePreFireBoostScale",
                    &settings.sequencePreFireBoostScale,
                    1.0f,
                    3.0f, Number(2, "x"));
                ImGui::PopItemWidth();
            }
        }

        if (hasSkillAimDetails && hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Prediction)) {
            SettingRow("Prediction Profile", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            ImGui::TextDisabled("skill:%s", definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "unknown");
            ImGui::SetItemTooltip("%s", L("Edit projectile speed, radius, gravity and cast delay under Prediction Data."));
        }
        if (hasSkillAimDetails && (hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::Prediction) || hasControl(OW::HeroSkillControls::TrajectoryAction))) {
            SettingRow("Max Aim Time", kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
            PushControlWidth();
            changed |= UISlider("##skillMaxAimTime", &settings.maxAimTimeMs, 0.0f, 5000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
            ImGui::PopItemWidth();
        }
    }

    auto drawFloatSlider = [&](const char* rowLabel,
                               const char* id,
                               float& value,
                               float minValue,
                               float maxValue,
                               const Spec& format) {
        SettingRow(rowLabel, kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider(id, &value, minValue, maxValue, format);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    };

    auto drawIntSlider = [&](const char* rowLabel,
                             const char* id,
                             int& value,
                             float minValue,
                             float maxValue,
                             const Spec& format) {
        SettingRow(rowLabel, kAimbotRightLabelWidth);
        PushControlWidth();
        changed |= UISlider(id, &value, minValue, maxValue, format);
        ImGui::PopItemWidth();
    };

    if (hasPunchAssist) {
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Hold RMB to charge; press the activation key to aim horizontally and release. Release RMB before the next attempt."));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Charge timing is estimated from input. Height limits do not check stairs or obstacles."));
        drawFloatSlider("Max Height Above", "##punchAbove", settings.punchMaxHeightAbove, 0.0f, 5.0f, Number(1, " m"));
        drawFloatSlider("Max Height Below", "##punchBelow", settings.punchMaxHeightBelow, 0.0f, 5.0f, Number(1, " m"));
        drawFloatSlider("Full Charge Time", "##punchCharge", settings.punchFullChargeMs, 200.0f, 2000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        drawFloatSlider("Auto-release Total Time", "##punchMaxHold", settings.punchMaxHoldMs, settings.punchFullChargeMs + 100.0f, 5000.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        drawFloatSlider("Release Lead", "##punchLead", settings.punchReleaseLeadMs, 20.0f, settings.punchMaxHoldMs - 50.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Full charge sets punch strength. Total time includes charging and holding before automatic release; both times are estimates."));
        if (!V2::Output::SupportsMouseMask(V2::Output::ActiveRuntimeSnapshot().descriptor))
            ImGui::TextWrapped("%s", L("Rocket Punch assist needs mouse masking from the output device."));
    }

    if (hasPitchControls) {
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s", L("Pitch Down"));

        drawIntSlider("Duration", "##pitchDownDuration", settings.pitchDownDurationMs, 20.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, " ms"));
        drawFloatSlider("Duration Jitter", "##pitchDownDurationJitter", settings.pitchDownDurationJitter, 0.0f, 50.0f, Number(0, " ms", 1, "+/- "));
        drawFloatSlider("Target Angle", "##pitchDownTarget", settings.pitchDownTargetAngle, 0.0f, 180.0f, Number(0, " deg"));
    }

    if (hasPitchControls || hasPhaseTiming) {
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s", L("Pitch Up"));

        if (hasPitchControls) {
            drawFloatSlider("Return Jitter", "##pitchUpOffsetJitter", settings.pitchUpOffsetJitter, 0.0f, 20.0f, Number(1, " deg", 1, "+/- "));
        }

        if (hasPhaseTiming) {
            drawIntSlider("Fire Delay", "##skillFireDelay", settings.fireDelayMs, 0.0f, 100.0f, Number(0, " ms"));

        }
    }

    if (changed)
        OW::Config::SetHeroSkillSettings(heroId, definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "", settings);

    ImGui::PopID();
    return changed;
}

static bool DrawHeroSkillSequenceDefinition(const OW::HeroSkillDefinition& definition, uint64_t heroId) {
    OW::Config::HeroSkillSettings settings = OW::Config::GetHeroSkillSettings(
        heroId,
        definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "",
        definition.defaultSettings);

    ImGui::PushID(definition.skillId);
    if (ID3D11ShaderResourceView* icon = HeroSkillIconForDefinition(definition)) {
        ImGui::Image(reinterpret_cast<ImTextureID>(icon), ImVec2(24.0f, 24.0f));
        ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 8.0f);
    }
    ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
    ImGui::TextColored(ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(kColTextMuted), "%s / %s",
                       L(OW::HeroSkillCategoryName(definition.category)),
                       L(OW::HeroSkillInputActionName(definition.inputAction)));

    const bool changed = DrawHeroSkillSequenceSteps(definition, settings);
    if (changed)
        OW::Config::SetHeroSkillSettings(heroId, definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "", settings);

    ImGui::PopID();
    return changed;
}

// =====================================================================
// UI::SkillsPage
// =====================================================================
void UI::SkillsPage() {
    ImGui::PushID("SkillsPage");

    const HeroOption& selectedHero = CurrentHeroOption();
    int renderedSkillCount = 0;
    if (selectedHero.heroId != 0) {
        for (const OW::HeroSkillDefinition& definition : OW::AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
            if (!OW::IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, selectedHero.heroId))
                continue;

            std::string title = L(selectedHero.label);
            title += " / ";
            title += L(definition.displayName);
            UIGroupBox(title.c_str());
            DrawHeroSkillDefinition(definition, selectedHero.heroId);
            CloseGroupBox();
            ++renderedSkillCount;
        }
    }

    if (renderedSkillCount == 0) {
        UIGroupBox("Hero Skills");
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", L("No configurable skills"));
        }
        CloseGroupBox();
    }

    ImGui::PopID();
}

// =====================================================================
// UI::Combo page
// =====================================================================
void UI::SequencesPage() {
    ImGui::PushID("SequencesPage");

    const HeroOption& selectedHero = CurrentHeroOption();
    int renderedSequenceCount = 0;

    if (selectedHero.heroId != 0) {
        for (const OW::HeroSkillDefinition& definition : OW::AllHeroSkillDefinitions()) {
            if (!OW::IsHeroSkillDefinitionActiveForRuntime(definition, selectedHero.heroId))
                continue;

            const bool sequenceCombo =
                OW::HasHeroSkillControl(definition, OW::HeroSkillControls::SequenceSteps);
            const bool dedicatedCombo =
                OW::HasHeroSkillControl(definition, OW::HeroSkillControls::ComboAction);
            if (!sequenceCombo && !dedicatedCombo) {
                continue;
            }

            std::string title = L(selectedHero.label);
            title += " / ";
            title += L(definition.displayName);
            UIGroupBox(title.c_str());
            const bool isAsheCombo = definition.heroId == OW::eHero::HERO_ASHE &&
                std::string(definition.skillId ? definition.skillId : "") == "fire-pattern";
            if (sequenceCombo && !isAsheCombo)
                DrawHeroSkillSequenceDefinition(definition, selectedHero.heroId);
            else
                DrawHeroSkillDefinition(definition, selectedHero.heroId);
            CloseGroupBox();
            ++renderedSequenceCount;
        }
    }

    if (renderedSequenceCount == 0) {
        UIGroupBox("Combo");
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", L("No configurable combos"));
        }
        CloseGroupBox();
    }

    ImGui::PopID();
}
```

`src/vision/AsheAmmo.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vision/AsheAmmo.hpp"
#include "vision/ContourService.hpp"
#include "HudAmmoDetail.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Vision {
namespace {
using namespace HudAmmoDetail;
bool IsRifle(const HudMask& mask,const Piece& p,double& confidence) {
    const auto rows=Normalize(mask,p,64);
    confidence=0;
    for(const auto& model:AsheAmmoDetail::kTemplates)
        if(model.digit<0)confidence=(std::max)(confidence,Match(rows,p,model));
    return confidence>=0.70;
}
}

void DetectAsheAmmo(Frame& frame) {
    frame.asheAmmoRemaining=-1;
    frame.asheAmmoConfidence=0.0;
    HudMask mask;
    std::vector<Piece> pieces;
    std::vector<Candidate> digits;
    if (!Prepare(frame, mask, pieces, digits)) return;
    int recognized=-1;
    double recognizedConfidence=0;
    for(const auto& one:digits) {
        if(one.digit.value!=1)continue;
        const auto& a=pieces[one.index];const double h=Height(a);
        for(const auto& two:digits) {
            if(two.digit.value!=2)continue;
            const auto& b=pieces[two.index];
            if(b.left-a.right<h*0.12 || b.left-a.right>h*0.65 ||
                std::abs(b.bottom-a.bottom)>h*0.3 || std::abs(Height(b)-h)>h*0.3)continue;
            double rifleConfidence=0;
            for(const auto& icon:pieces) {
                if(Width(icon)<h*5.5 || Width(icon)>h*9.0 || Height(icon)<h*1.5 || Height(icon)>h*2.6 ||
                    a.left-icon.right<h*2.8 || a.left-icon.right>h*5.7 || std::abs(icon.bottom-a.bottom)>h*0.45)continue;
                double score=0;
                if(IsRifle(mask,icon,score))rifleConfidence=(std::max)(rifleConfidence,score);
            }
            if(rifleConfidence==0)continue;
            std::vector<Candidate> current;
            bool animatedOrClipped=false;
            for(const auto& digit:digits) {
                const auto& p=pieces[digit.index];
                if(p.left<a.left-h*4.1 || p.right>a.left-h*0.6 ||
                    p.bottom<a.top-h*1.5 || p.top>a.bottom+h*0.5)continue;
                // Reload digits can bounce independently. Ignoring a raised
                // leading "1" would turn a displayed "10" into a false zero.
                // Reject the whole reading until every nearby glyph settles.
                if(std::abs(p.bottom-a.bottom)>h*0.35 || std::abs(Height(p)-h)>h*0.35) {
                    animatedOrClipped=true;break;
                }
                current.push_back(digit);
            }
            if(animatedOrClipped||current.empty()||current.size()>2)continue;
            std::sort(current.begin(),current.end(),[&](const auto& x,const auto& y){return pieces[x.index].left<pieces[y.index].left;});
            const auto& last=pieces[current.back().index];
            if(a.left-last.right<h*0.75 || a.left-last.right>h*1.6)continue;
            if(current.size()==2) {
                const auto& first=pieces[current.front().index];
                if(current.front().digit.value!=1 || last.left-first.right<0 || last.left-first.right>h*0.6)continue;
            }
            int value=0;double confidence=(std::min)({one.digit.confidence,two.digit.confidence,rifleConfidence});
            for(const auto& d:current) {
                if(d.digit.value<0){value=-1;break;}
                value=value*10+d.digit.value;confidence=(std::min)(confidence,d.digit.confidence);
            }
            if(value<0||value>12)continue;
            if(recognized>=0 && recognized!=value)return;
            recognized=value;recognizedConfidence=(std::max)(recognizedConfidence,confidence);
        }
    }
    frame.asheAmmoRemaining=recognized;
    frame.asheAmmoConfidence=recognized>=0?recognizedConfidence:0;
}

AsheAmmoSnapshot ReadAsheAmmo(bool localIsAshe) {
    AsheAmmoSnapshot result;
    if(!localIsAshe)return result;
    Settings settings;
    const auto frame=GetService().Snapshot(settings);
    if(!frame)return result;
    const double nowMs=MonotonicMs();
    if(!IsFresh(*frame,settings,nowMs))return result;
    result.sequence=frame->sequence;result.epoch=frame->epoch;result.arrivalMs=frame->arrivalMs;
    result.ageMs=nowMs-frame->arrivalMs;
    if(frame->asheAmmoRemaining<0 || frame->asheAmmoRemaining>12)return result;
    result.known=true;result.remaining=frame->asheAmmoRemaining;result.confidence=frame->asheAmmoConfidence;
    return result;
}

bool RequestAsheAmmoCapture() {
    auto& service=GetService();
    const auto status=service.Status();
    if(status.state==ServiceState::Running || status.state==ServiceState::Starting)return true;
    auto settings=service.GetSettings();settings.enabled=true;
    return service.Configure(settings) && service.Start();
}
}
```

```cpp
// Adapted 2026-11-15 from KOI-V3-DualPC/src/capture_card.cpp.
// This V2-owned adapter preserves native RGB24 and latest-frame semantics.
```
