```cpp
using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;
// qedit.h is absent from current Windows SDKs. These are the published
// Sample Grabber interfaces; no external DirectShow helper library is used.
MIDL_INTERFACE("0579154A-2B53-4994-B0D0-E773148EFF85") SampleCallback : public IUnknown {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SampleCB(double sampleTime, IMediaSample* sample) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE BufferCB(double sampleTime, BYTE* buffer, long length) = 0;
};
MIDL_INTERFACE("6B652FFF-11FE-4FCE-92AD-0266B5D7C78F") SampleGrabber : public IUnknown {
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetOneShot(BOOL oneShot) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetMediaType(const AM_MEDIA_TYPE* type) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetConnectedMediaType(AM_MEDIA_TYPE* type) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetBufferSamples(BOOL bufferSamples) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetCurrentBuffer(long* size, long* buffer) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE GetCurrentSample(IMediaSample** sample) = 0;
    virtual HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SetCallback(SampleCallback* callback, long method) = 0;
};
const CLSID sampleGrabberClass = {0xc1f400a0, 0x3f08, 0x11d3, {0x9f,0x0b,0x00,0x60,0x08,0x03,0x9e,0x37}};
const CLSID nullRendererClass = {0xc1f400a4, 0x3f08, 0x11d3, {0x9f,0x0b,0x00,0x60,0x08,0x03,0x9e,0x37}};

double monotonicMs() {
    return std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}
std::wstring failure(const wchar_t* step, HRESULT result) {
    std::wostringstream out;
    out << step << L"（0x" << std::hex << static_cast<unsigned long>(result) << L"）";
    return out.str();
}
void freeMedia(AM_MEDIA_TYPE& media) {
    if (media.cbFormat != 0) CoTaskMemFree(media.pbFormat);
    if (media.pUnk) media.pUnk->Release();
    media = {};
}
struct MediaOwner {
    AM_MEDIA_TYPE value{};
    ~MediaOwner() { freeMedia(value); }
    MediaOwner() = default;
    MediaOwner(const MediaOwner&) = delete;
    MediaOwner& operator=(const MediaOwner&) = delete;
    void take(AM_MEDIA_TYPE* source) {
        freeMedia(value); value = *source; *source = {}; CoTaskMemFree(source);
    }
};
struct ComScope {
    HRESULT result = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    ~ComScope() { if (SUCCEEDED(result)) CoUninitialize(); }
};
struct ListedDevice { CaptureCardDevice device; ComPtr<IMoniker> moniker; };
std::wstring property(IPropertyBag* bag, const wchar_t* key) {
    VARIANT value; VariantInit(&value);
    std::wstring result;
    if (SUCCEEDED(bag->Read(key, &value, nullptr)) && value.vt == VT_BSTR && value.bstrVal)
        result = value.bstrVal;
    VariantClear(&value);
    return result;
}
bool listDevices(std::vector<ListedDevice>& devices, std::wstring& error) {
    devices.clear();
    ComPtr<ICreateDevEnum> creator;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_SystemDeviceEnum, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&creator));
    if (FAILED(hr)) { error = failure(L"无法创建视频设备枚举器", hr); return false; }
    ComPtr<IEnumMoniker> enumerator;
    hr = creator->CreateClassEnumerator(CLSID_VideoInputDeviceCategory, &enumerator, 0);
    if (hr == S_FALSE) return true;
    if (FAILED(hr)) { error = failure(L"无法枚举视频采集设备", hr); return false; }
    ComPtr<IMoniker> moniker;
    while (enumerator->Next(1, &moniker, nullptr) == S_OK) {
        ComPtr<IPropertyBag> bag;
        if (SUCCEEDED(moniker->BindToStorage(nullptr, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&bag)))) {
            ListedDevice listed;
            listed.device.friendlyName = property(bag.Get(), L"FriendlyName");
            listed.device.devicePath = property(bag.Get(), L"DevicePath");
            if (listed.device.devicePath.empty()) {
                LPOLESTR display = nullptr;
                if (SUCCEEDED(moniker->GetDisplayName(nullptr, nullptr, &display)) && display) {
                    listed.device.devicePath = display; CoTaskMemFree(display);
                }
            }
            if (!listed.device.devicePath.empty()) {
                listed.moniker = moniker; devices.push_back(std::move(listed));
            }
        }
        moniker.Reset();
    }
    return true;
}
std::wstring lower(std::wstring value) {
    std::transform(value.begin(), value.end(), value.begin(), [](wchar_t ch) { return static_cast<wchar_t>(std::towlower(ch)); });
    return value;
}
bool mediaInfo(const AM_MEDIA_TYPE& media, CaptureCardInfo& info) {
    if (media.majortype != MEDIATYPE_Video || media.subtype != MEDIASUBTYPE_RGB24 || !media.pbFormat) return false;
    const BITMAPINFOHEADER* bitmap = nullptr;
    REFERENCE_TIME interval = 0;
    if (media.formattype == FORMAT_VideoInfo && media.cbFormat >= sizeof(VIDEOINFOHEADER)) {
        const auto* header = reinterpret_cast<const VIDEOINFOHEADER*>(media.pbFormat);
        bitmap = &header->bmiHeader; interval = header->AvgTimePerFrame;
    } else if (media.formattype == FORMAT_VideoInfo2 && media.cbFormat >= sizeof(VIDEOINFOHEADER2)) {
        const auto* header = reinterpret_cast<const VIDEOINFOHEADER2*>(media.pbFormat);
        if ((header->dwInterlaceFlags & AMINTERLACE_IsInterlaced) != 0) return false;
        bitmap = &header->bmiHeader; interval = header->AvgTimePerFrame;
    }
    if (!bitmap || bitmap->biSize < sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER) || bitmap->biPlanes != 1 ||
        bitmap->biCompression != BI_RGB || bitmap->biBitCount != 24 || bitmap->biWidth <= 0 || bitmap->biWidth > 16384 ||
        bitmap->biHeight == 0 || bitmap->biHeight < -16384 || bitmap->biHeight > 16384 || interval <= 0) return false;
    info.width = bitmap->biWidth;
    info.height = bitmap->biHeight < 0 ? -bitmap->biHeight : bitmap->biHeight;
    info.bitsPerPixel = 24; info.bottomUp = bitmap->biHeight > 0;
    const auto minimumStride = (static_cast<std::size_t>(info.width) * 3 + 3) & ~std::size_t{3};
    std::size_t stride = minimumStride;
    if (bitmap->biSizeImage != 0) {
        if (bitmap->biSizeImage % static_cast<unsigned>(info.height) != 0) return false;
        stride = bitmap->biSizeImage / static_cast<unsigned>(info.height);
        if (stride < minimumStride || stride > minimumStride + 65536) return false;
    }
    info.rowStride = static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(stride);
    info.framesPerSecond = 10000000.0 / static_cast<double>(interval);
    info.format = L"RGB24";
    return true;
}
bool pin(IBaseFilter* filter, PIN_DIRECTION direction, ComPtr<IPin>& found) {
    ComPtr<IEnumPins> pins;
    if (FAILED(filter->EnumPins(&pins))) return false;
    ComPtr<IPin> current;
    while (pins->Next(1, &current, nullptr) == S_OK) {
        PIN_DIRECTION actual{};
        if (SUCCEEDED(current->QueryDirection(&actual)) && actual == direction) { found = current; return true; }
        current.Reset();
    }
    return false;
}
struct FrameMailbox {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable ready;
    std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
    std::size_t requiredBytes = 0;
    CaptureCardInfo format;
    std::uint64_t received = 0, consumed = 0, dropped = 0, sequence = 0;
    bool pending = false, closed = false, invalidSample = false;
    bool sampleTimeValid = false;
    double arrival = 0.0, sampleTime = 0.0;
};
class Callback final : public SampleCallback {
public:
    explicit Callback(std::shared_ptr<FrameMailbox> mailbox) : mailbox_(std::move(mailbox)) {}
    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE QueryInterface(REFIID id, void** object) override {
        if (!object) return E_POINTER;
        *object = nullptr;
        if (id == IID_IUnknown || id == __uuidof(SampleCallback)) {
            *object = static_cast<SampleCallback*>(this); AddRef(); return S_OK;
        }
        return E_NOINTERFACE;
    }
    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE AddRef() override { return ++references_; }
    ULONG STDMETHODCALLTYPE Release() override {
        const ULONG result = --references_; if (result == 0) delete this; return result;
    }
    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE SampleCB(double, IMediaSample* sample) override {
        if (!sample) return E_POINTER;
        // Driver callbacks cross a COM ABI. In particular, allocation failure
        // while interpreting a dynamic format must end capture, not unwind
        // through a driver thread and terminate the process before cleanup.
        try {
        // A source may attach a dynamic media type after an HDMI mode change.
        // Stop if it changes the bytes we interpret, even when buffer size fits.
        AM_MEDIA_TYPE* changed = nullptr;
        const HRESULT typeResult = sample->GetMediaType(&changed);
        if (typeResult == S_OK && changed) {
            MediaOwner changedMedia;
            changedMedia.take(changed);
            CaptureCardInfo actual;
            const auto& expected = mailbox_->format;
            const bool same = mediaInfo(changedMedia.value, actual) && actual.width == expected.width && actual.height == expected.height &&
                actual.rowStride == expected.rowStride && actual.bottomUp == expected.bottomUp &&
                std::abs(actual.framesPerSecond - expected.framesPerSecond) <= 0.01;
            if (!same) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
                mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return E_FAIL;
            }
        } else if (FAILED(typeResult)) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
            mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return typeResult;
        }
        BYTE* bytes = nullptr;
        const HRESULT pointerResult = sample->GetPointer(&bytes);
        if (FAILED(pointerResult)) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
            mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return pointerResult;
        }
        REFERENCE_TIME begin = 0, end = 0;
        const HRESULT timeResult = sample->GetTime(&begin, &end);
        const bool timeValid = timeResult == S_OK || timeResult == VFW_S_NO_STOP_TIME;
        return publish(timeValid ? static_cast<double>(begin) / 10000000.0 : 0.0,
            bytes, sample->GetActualDataLength(), timeValid);
        } catch (...) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
            mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        }
    }
    HRESULT STDMETHODCALLTYPE BufferCB(double sampleTime, BYTE* buffer, long length) override {
        return publish(sampleTime, buffer, length, false);
    }
    HRESULT publish(double sampleTime, BYTE* buffer, long length, bool sampleTimeValid) {
        try {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
            if (mailbox_->closed) return S_OK;
            if (!buffer || length < 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(length) < mailbox_->requiredBytes || !std::isfinite(sampleTime)) {
                mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return E_FAIL;
            }
            if (mailbox_->pending) ++mailbox_->dropped;
            mailbox_->bytes.assign(buffer, buffer + mailbox_->requiredBytes);
            ++mailbox_->received; mailbox_->sequence = mailbox_->received;
            mailbox_->arrival = monotonicMs(); mailbox_->sampleTime = sampleTime; mailbox_->pending = true;
            mailbox_->sampleTimeValid = sampleTimeValid;
            mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return S_OK;
        } catch (...) {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mailbox_->mutex);
            mailbox_->invalidSample = true; mailbox_->ready.notify_one(); return E_OUTOFMEMORY;
        }
    }
private:
    std::atomic<ULONG> references_{1};
    std::shared_ptr<FrameMailbox> mailbox_;
};
} // namespace

namespace capture_card_detail {
bool convertRgb24(const unsigned char* source, std::size_t bytes, int width, int height,
                  std::ptrdiff_t sourceStride, bool bottomUp,
                  std::vector<unsigned char>& bgra, std::wstring& error) {
    error.clear();
    if (!source || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || width > 16384 || height > 16384 || sourceStride < 0 ||
        static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceStride) < static_cast<std::size_t>(width) * 3) {
        error = L"RGB24 图像尺寸或行跨度无效。"; return false;
    }
    const auto stride = static_cast<std::size_t>(sourceStride);
    const auto lastRowBytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(width) * 3;
    if (lastRowBytes > bytes || (height > 1 && stride > (bytes - lastRowBytes) / static_cast<std::size_t>(height - 1))) {
        error = L"RGB24 图像字节不足。"; return false;
    }
    bgra.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(width) * static_cast<std::size_t>(height) * 4);
    for (int y = 0; y < height; ++y) {
        const auto inputRow = static_cast<std::size_t>(bottomUp ? height - 1 - y : y);
        const auto* input = source + inputRow * stride;
        auto* output = bgra.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * static_cast<std::size_t>(width) * 4;
        for (int x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
            output[0] = input[0]; output[1] = input[1]; output[2] = input[2]; output[3] = 255;
            input += 3; output += 4;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace capture_card_detail

struct CaptureCard::Impl {
    bool comInitialized = false, running = false;
    DWORD ownerThread = 0;
    CaptureCardInfo format;
    CaptureCardStats latest;
    std::shared_ptr<FrameMailbox> mailbox = std::make_shared<FrameMailbox>();
    ComPtr<IGraphBuilder> graph;
    ComPtr<ICaptureGraphBuilder2> builder;
    ComPtr<IBaseFilter> source, grabberFilter, sink;
    ComPtr<SampleGrabber> grabber;
    ComPtr<IMediaControl> control;
    ComPtr<IMediaEvent> events;
    ComPtr<SampleCallback> callback;
    std::vector<unsigned char> raw, bgra;
};
CaptureCard::CaptureCard() : impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
CaptureCard::~CaptureCard() { close(); }
bool CaptureCard::enumerate(std::vector<CaptureCardDevice>& devices, std::wstring& error) {
    devices.clear(); error.clear(); ComScope com;
    // Enumeration also works in an existing UI STA; do not uninitialize it.
    if (FAILED(com.result) && com.result != RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE) { error = failure(L"无法初始化 COM", com.result); return false; }
    std::vector<ListedDevice> listed;
    if (!listDevices(listed, error)) return false;
    for (const auto& item : listed) devices.push_back(item.device);
    return true;
}
bool CaptureCard::open(const CaptureCardSettings& settings, std::wstring& error) {
    close(); error.clear();
    if (settings.width <= 0 || settings.height <= 0 || settings.width > 16384 || settings.height > 16384 ||
        !std::isfinite(settings.fps) || settings.fps <= 0.0 || settings.fps > 1000.0) {
        error = L"采集尺寸或帧率无效。"; return false;
    }
    const HRESULT initialized = CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    if (FAILED(initialized)) { error = failure(L"采集必须在独立工作线程初始化 COM", initialized); return false; }
    impl_->comInitialized = true; impl_->ownerThread = GetCurrentThreadId();
    // End the attempt's local COM references before close() uninitializes COM.
    const auto attempt = [&]() -> bool {
    auto failed = [&](const wchar_t* step, HRESULT hr) { error = failure(step, hr); return false; };
    std::vector<ListedDevice> devices;
    if (!listDevices(devices, error)) return false;
    std::vector<std::size_t> matches;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < devices.size(); ++i) {
        const bool match = !settings.devicePath.empty() ? _wcsicmp(settings.devicePath.c_str(), devices[i].device.devicePath.c_str()) == 0 :
            !settings.deviceName.empty() && lower(devices[i].device.friendlyName).find(lower(settings.deviceName)) != std::wstring::npos;
        if (match) matches.push_back(i);
    }
    if (matches.size() != 1) {
        error = matches.empty() ? L"未找到指定采集卡。请检查 GC573 驱动或设备路径。" : L"有多个匹配的采集卡，请明确选择设备路径。";
        return false;
    }
    const auto& selected = devices[matches[0]];
    impl_->format.device = selected.device;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_FilterGraph, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl_->graph));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法创建采集图", hr);
    hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_CaptureGraphBuilder2, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl_->builder));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法创建采集图构建器", hr);
    hr = impl_->builder->SetFiltergraph(impl_->graph.Get());
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法绑定采集图", hr);
    hr = selected.moniker->BindToObject(nullptr, nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl_->source));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法打开采集卡，可能已被其他程序占用", hr);
    hr = impl_->graph->AddFilter(impl_->source.Get(), L"GC573 video source");
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法加入视频源", hr);
    ComPtr<IPin> sourcePin;
    hr = impl_->builder->FindPin(impl_->source.Get(), PINDIR_OUTPUT, &PIN_CATEGORY_CAPTURE, &MEDIATYPE_Video, FALSE, 0, &sourcePin);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法找到采集输出引脚", hr);
    ComPtr<IAMStreamConfig> config;
    hr = sourcePin.As(&config);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"采集卡没有格式配置接口", hr);
    int count = 0, capsSize = 0;
    hr = config->GetNumberOfCapabilities(&count, &capsSize);
    if (FAILED(hr) || count <= 0 || count > 10000 || capsSize < static_cast<int>(sizeof(VIDEO_STREAM_CONFIG_CAPS)) || capsSize > 65536)
        return failed(L"采集卡格式枚举无效", FAILED(hr) ? hr : E_UNEXPECTED);
    std::vector<unsigned char> caps(static_cast<std::size_t>(capsSize));
    MediaOwner selectedMedia;
    double bestDifference = (std::numeric_limits<double>::max)();
    for (int index = 0; index < count; ++index) {
        AM_MEDIA_TYPE* media = nullptr;
        hr = config->GetStreamCaps(index, &media, caps.data());
        if (FAILED(hr) || !media) continue;
        CaptureCardInfo candidate;
        if (mediaInfo(*media, candidate) && candidate.width == settings.width && candidate.height == settings.height) {
            const double difference = std::abs(candidate.framesPerSecond - settings.fps);
            // Preserve the driver's native interval (144.001 is a valid 144 Hz
            // mode). Do not manufacture a rate from a different advertised mode.
            if (difference <= 0.75 && difference < bestDifference) {
                selectedMedia.take(media); media = nullptr; bestDifference = difference;
            }
        }
        if (media) { freeMedia(*media); CoTaskMemFree(media); }
    }
    if (!selectedMedia.value.pbFormat) {
        error = L"采集卡未提供指定尺寸和帧率的原生 RGB24 模式；未插入 YUV 转换。";
        return false;
    }
    hr = config->SetFormat(&selectedMedia.value);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"采集卡拒绝 RGB24 采集模式", hr);
    hr = CoCreateInstance(sampleGrabberClass, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl_->grabberFilter));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"系统 Sample Grabber 不可用", hr);
    hr = impl_->grabberFilter.As(&impl_->grabber);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法取得 Sample Grabber 接口", hr);
    hr = impl_->grabber->SetMediaType(&selectedMedia.value);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法约束 RGB24 输入", hr);
    hr = impl_->graph->AddFilter(impl_->grabberFilter.Get(), L"Raw RGB24 samples");
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法加入 RGB24 接收器", hr);
    hr = CoCreateInstance(nullRendererClass, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&impl_->sink));
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法创建空渲染器", hr);
    hr = impl_->graph->AddFilter(impl_->sink.Get(), L"No video display");
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法加入空渲染器", hr);
    ComPtr<IPin> grabInput, grabOutput, sinkInput;
    if (!pin(impl_->grabberFilter.Get(), PINDIR_INPUT, grabInput) || !pin(impl_->grabberFilter.Get(), PINDIR_OUTPUT, grabOutput) ||
        !pin(impl_->sink.Get(), PINDIR_INPUT, sinkInput)) return failed(L"采集图引脚不完整", E_NOINTERFACE);
    hr = impl_->graph->ConnectDirect(sourcePin.Get(), grabInput.Get(), &selectedMedia.value);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"原生 RGB24 直连失败，未尝试颜色转换", hr);
    hr = impl_->graph->ConnectDirect(grabOutput.Get(), sinkInput.Get(), nullptr);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"RGB24 输出直连失败", hr);
    MediaOwner connected;
    hr = impl_->grabber->GetConnectedMediaType(&connected.value);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法读取实际协商格式", hr);
    CaptureCardInfo actual;
    if (!mediaInfo(connected.value, actual) || actual.width != settings.width || actual.height != settings.height ||
        std::abs(actual.framesPerSecond - settings.fps) > 0.75) return failed(L"实际协商格式不符合 RGB24 尺寸和帧率要求", VFW_E_TYPE_NOT_ACCEPTED);
    actual.device = selected.device; impl_->format = actual;
    impl_->mailbox = std::make_shared<FrameMailbox>();
    impl_->mailbox->requiredBytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(actual.rowStride) * static_cast<std::size_t>(actual.height);
    impl_->mailbox->format = actual;
    impl_->callback.Attach(new Callback(impl_->mailbox));
    hr = impl_->grabber->SetBufferSamples(FALSE);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法关闭额外采样缓存", hr);
    hr = impl_->grabber->SetOneShot(FALSE);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法启用连续采样", hr);
    hr = impl_->grabber->SetCallback(impl_->callback.Get(), 0);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法注册采集回调", hr);
    // Keep the graph's default reference clock. GC573 produces useful sample
    // timestamps with it; disabling it does not improve capture throughput.
    hr = impl_->graph.As(&impl_->control);
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"无法取得采集运行接口", hr);
    impl_->graph.As(&impl_->events);
    hr = impl_->control->Run();
    if (FAILED(hr)) return failed(L"采集卡无法开始传输", hr);
    impl_->running = true;
    return true;
    };
    const bool success = attempt();
    if (!success) close();
    return success;
}
bool CaptureCard::grab(unsigned timeoutMs, std::wstring& error) {
    error.clear();
    if (!impl_->running || GetCurrentThreadId() != impl_->ownerThread) {
        error = L"采集未运行，或读取线程与打开线程不同。"; return false;
    }
    if (timeoutMs == 0 || timeoutMs > 60000) { error = L"采集等待时间必须在 1–60000 毫秒之间。"; return false; }
    if (impl_->events) {
        long code = 0; LONG_PTR first = 0, second = 0;
        while (impl_->events->GetEvent(&code, &first, &second, 0) == S_OK) {
            impl_->events->FreeEventParams(code, first, second);
            if (code == EC_ERRORABORT || code == EC_DEVICE_LOST || code == EC_COMPLETE) {
                error = L"采集流已结束或设备连接中断。"; return false;
            }
        }
    }
    const auto mailbox = impl_->mailbox;
    {
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(mailbox->mutex);
        if (!mailbox->ready.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(timeoutMs), [&] { return mailbox->pending || mailbox->closed || mailbox->invalidSample; })) {
            error = L"等待新的采集帧超时，已停止使用旧画面。"; return false;
        }
        if (mailbox->invalidSample || mailbox->closed) { error = L"采集数据不完整或采集已经关闭。"; return false; }
        impl_->raw.swap(mailbox->bytes); mailbox->pending = false; ++mailbox->consumed;
        impl_->latest.sequence = mailbox->sequence;
        impl_->latest.arrivalMs = mailbox->arrival;
        impl_->latest.sampleTimeSeconds = mailbox->sampleTime;
        impl_->latest.sampleTimeValid = mailbox->sampleTimeValid;
    }
    return capture_card_detail::convertRgb24(impl_->raw.data(), impl_->raw.size(), impl_->format.width, impl_->format.height,
        impl_->format.rowStride, impl_->format.bottomUp, impl_->bgra, error);
}
PixelView CaptureCard::view() const {
    return {impl_->bgra.empty() ? nullptr : impl_->bgra.data(), impl_->bgra.size(), 0,
        impl_->format.width, impl_->format.height, 0, 0, static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(impl_->format.width) * 4};
}
int CaptureCard::width() const { return impl_->format.width; }
int CaptureCard::height() const { return impl_->format.height; }
CaptureCardInfo CaptureCard::info() const { return impl_->format; }
CaptureCardStats CaptureCard::stats() const {
    CaptureCardStats result = impl_->latest;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(impl_->mailbox->mutex);
    result.receivedFrames = impl_->mailbox->received;
    result.consumedFrames = impl_->mailbox->consumed;
    result.droppedFrames = impl_->mailbox->dropped;
    if (result.sequence != 0) result.frameAgeMs = (std::max)(0.0, monotonicMs() - result.arrivalMs);
    return result;
}
void CaptureCard::close() {
    if (!impl_) return;
    if (impl_->control) impl_->control->Stop();
    if (impl_->grabber) impl_->grabber->SetCallback(nullptr, 1);
    { std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(impl_->mailbox->mutex); impl_->mailbox->closed = true; }
    impl_->mailbox->ready.notify_all();
    impl_->callback.Reset(); impl_->events.Reset(); impl_->control.Reset();
    impl_->grabber.Reset(); impl_->grabberFilter.Reset(); impl_->sink.Reset(); impl_->source.Reset();
    impl_->builder.Reset(); impl_->graph.Reset();
    impl_->running = false; impl_->raw.clear(); impl_->bgra.clear();
    impl_->latest = {}; impl_->format = {};
    if (impl_->comInitialized && impl_->ownerThread == GetCurrentThreadId()) CoUninitialize();
    impl_->comInitialized = false; impl_->ownerThread = 0;
}
} // namespace V2::Vision
```

`src/vision/ContourDetection.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vision/ContourDetection.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <utility>

namespace V2::Vision {
bool PixelView::valid() const {
    if (!data || width <= 0 || height <= 0 || row0 > bytes ||
        bytes > static_cast<std::size_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::ptrdiff_t>::max)())) return false;
    const auto pitch = static_cast<std::int64_t>(rowStride);
    const auto line = static_cast<std::int64_t>(width) * 4;
    if (pitch < line && pitch > -line) return false;
    if (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(line) > bytes - row0) return false;
    if (height == 1) return true;
    if (pitch >= 0) return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(pitch) <=
        (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(bytes - row0) - line) / (height - 1);
    const auto magnitude = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(-(pitch + 1)) + 1;
    return magnitude <= row0 / (height - 1);
}
double MonotonicMs() {
    return std::chrono::duration<double, std::milli>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}
bool ValidateSettings(const Settings& s, std::wstring* error) {
    const auto fail = [&](const wchar_t* text) { if (error) *error = text; return false; };
    if (error) error->clear();
    if (s.capture.width <= 0 || s.capture.height <= 0 || s.capture.width > 8192 || s.capture.height > 8192 ||
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(s.capture.width) * s.capture.height > 33554432 ||
        !std::isfinite(s.capture.fps) || s.capture.fps < 1.0 || s.capture.fps > 1000.0)
        return fail(L"采集尺寸或帧率无效。");
    if (s.capture.devicePath.empty() && s.capture.deviceName.empty()) return fail(L"请选择采集设备。");
    if (s.capture.devicePath.size() > 32767 || s.capture.deviceName.size() > 1024 ||
        s.capture.devicePath.find(L'\0') != std::wstring::npos || s.capture.deviceName.find(L'\0') != std::wstring::npos)
        return fail(L"采集设备名称或路径无效。");
    if (s.tolerance < 0 || s.tolerance > 128 || s.roiWidth < 1 || s.roiHeight < 1 || s.roiWidth > 8192 || s.roiHeight > 8192)
        return fail(L"颜色容差或检测区域无效。");
    if (!std::isfinite(s.maxFrameAgeMs) || s.maxFrameAgeMs < 1.0 || s.maxFrameAgeMs > 1000.0 ||
        !std::isfinite(s.associationRadiusPx) || s.associationRadiusPx < 0.f || s.associationRadiusPx > 512.f ||
        !std::isfinite(s.contactRadiusPx) || s.contactRadiusPx < 0.f || s.contactRadiusPx > 64.f ||
        s.touchDelayMs < 0 || s.touchDelayMs > 1000 || s.lostGraceMs < 0 || s.lostGraceMs > 1000 ||
        s.minComponentPixels < 1 || s.minComponentPixels > 10000)
        return fail(L"帧龄、轮廓距离或确认时间无效。");
    return true;
}
bool IsFresh(const Frame& frame, const Settings& settings, double nowMs) {
    const double age = nowMs - frame.arrivalMs;
    return frame.sequence != 0 && frame.epoch != 0 && frame.width > 0 && frame.height > 0 &&
        std::isfinite(nowMs) && std::isfinite(frame.arrivalMs) &&
        std::isfinite(settings.maxFrameAgeMs) && age >= 0.0 && age <= settings.maxFrameAgeMs;
}
namespace {
std::uint8_t MatchColors(const unsigned char* pixel, const Settings& settings) {
    std::uint8_t bits = 0;
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < settings.colors.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& color = settings.colors[i];
        if (std::abs(int(pixel[2]) - color.r) <= settings.tolerance &&
            std::abs(int(pixel[1]) - color.g) <= settings.tolerance &&
            std::abs(int(pixel[0]) - color.b) <= settings.tolerance)
            bits |= static_cast<std::uint8_t>(1u << i);
    }
    return bits;
}
}
bool DetectContours(const PixelView& image, const Settings& settings, Frame& frame, std::wstring* error) {
    frame.width = frame.height = 0;
    frame.pixels.clear(); frame.mask.clear(); frame.componentIds.clear(); frame.components.clear(); frame.detectionRoi = {};
    if (!ValidateSettings(settings, error)) return false;
    if (!image.valid() || image.originX != 0 || image.originY != 0 || image.width > 8192 || image.height > 8192 ||
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(image.width) * image.height > 33554432) {
        if (error) *error = L"轮廓输入必须是完整、有效的原尺寸 BGRA 图像。";
        return false;
    }
    frame.width = image.width; frame.height = image.height;
    const auto count = static_cast<std::size_t>(image.width) * image.height;
    frame.pixels.resize(count * 4);
    for (int y = 0; y < image.height; ++y)
        std::memcpy(frame.pixels.data() + static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * image.width * 4,
            image.data + image.row0 + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(y) * image.rowStride,
            static_cast<std::size_t>(image.width) * 4);
    frame.mask.assign(count, 0);
    frame.componentIds.assign(count, 0);
    const int rw = (std::min)(settings.roiWidth, image.width);
    const int rh = (std::min)(settings.roiHeight, image.height);
    const Rect roi{(image.width-rw)/2, (image.height-rh)/2, (image.width-rw)/2+rw, (image.height-rh)/2+rh};
    frame.detectionRoi = roi;
    for (int y = roi.top; y < roi.bottom; ++y) for (int x = roi.left; x < roi.right; ++x) {
        const auto index = static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * image.width + x;
        frame.mask[index] = MatchColors(frame.pixels.data() + index * 4, settings);
    }
    // 8-connected pieces of the union of all colours. A colour change never
    // splits the identity into a different target; target ownership is external.
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> visited(static_cast<std::size_t>(rw) * rh, 0);
    std::vector<std::uint32_t> pending;
    for (int y = roi.top; y < roi.bottom; ++y) for (int x = roi.left; x < roi.right; ++x) {
        const auto index = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(y * image.width + x);
        const auto local = static_cast<std::size_t>(y-roi.top) * rw + x-roi.left;
        if (!frame.mask[index] || visited[local]) continue;
        Component component;
        component.bounds = {x,y,x+1,y+1};
        pending.clear(); pending.push_back(index); visited[local] = 1;
        for (std::size_t next = 0; next < pending.size(); ++next) {
            const auto current = pending[next];
            const int px = static_cast<int>(current % image.width), py = static_cast<int>(current / image.width);
            component.pixelIndices.push_back(current);
            component.colorBits |= frame.mask[current];
            component.bounds.left = (std::min)(component.bounds.left, px);
            component.bounds.top = (std::min)(component.bounds.top, py);
            component.bounds.right = (std::max)(component.bounds.right, px+1);
            component.bounds.bottom = (std::max)(component.bounds.bottom, py+1);
            for (int dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) for (int dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
                const int nx = px+dx, ny = py+dy;
                if (!roi.Contains(nx, ny)) continue;
                const auto ni = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(ny * image.width + nx);
                const auto nl = static_cast<std::size_t>(ny-roi.top) * rw + nx-roi.left;
                if (frame.mask[ni] && !visited[nl]) { visited[nl] = 1; pending.push_back(ni); }
            }
        }
        if (component.pixelIndices.size() < static_cast<std::size_t>(settings.minComponentPixels)) {
            for (auto pixel : component.pixelIndices) frame.mask[pixel] = 0;
        } else {
            component.id = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(frame.components.size()+1);
            for (auto pixel : component.pixelIndices) frame.componentIds[pixel] = component.id;
            frame.components.push_back(std::move(component));
        }
    }
    return true;
}
Match NearestMatch(const Frame& frame, std::span<const Point> bones, const Rect& entityRoi, float radiusPx) {
    Match best;
    if (!std::isfinite(radiusPx) || radiusPx < 0.f || frame.width <= 0 || frame.height <= 0) return best;
    const auto pixelCount = static_cast<std::size_t>(frame.width) * frame.height;
    float limit = radiusPx * radiusPx;
    for (const auto& component : frame.components) {
        if (component.bounds.right <= entityRoi.left || component.bounds.left >= entityRoi.right ||
            component.bounds.bottom <= entityRoi.top || component.bounds.top >= entityRoi.bottom) continue;
        for (auto index : component.pixelIndices) {
            if (index >= pixelCount || index >= frame.mask.size() || !frame.mask[index]) continue;
            const int x = static_cast<int>(index % frame.width), y = static_cast<int>(index / frame.width);
            if (!entityRoi.Contains(x,y)) continue;
            for (std::size_t b = 0; b < bones.size(); ++b) {
                if (!std::isfinite(bones[b].x) || !std::isfinite(bones[b].y)) continue;
                const float dx = bones[b].x-x, dy = bones[b].y-y, distance = dx*dx+dy*dy;
                if (distance > limit || (best.found && distance == limit)) continue;
                limit = distance;
                best = {true,{static_cast<float>(x),static_cast<float>(y)},b,component.id,frame.mask[index],distance};
            }
        }
    }
    return best;
}
bool SampleColor(const Frame& frame, int x, int y, Rgb& color) {
    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= frame.width || y >= frame.height) return false;
    const auto offset = (static_cast<std::size_t>(y) * frame.width + x) * 4;
    if (offset + 3 >= frame.pixels.size()) return false;
    color = {frame.pixels[offset+2],frame.pixels[offset+1],frame.pixels[offset]};
    return true;
}
} // namespace V2::Vision
```

`src/vision/ContourService.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vision/ContourService.hpp"
#include "vision/CaptureCard.hpp"
#include "vision/ContourDetection.hpp"
#include "vision/AsheAmmo.hpp"
#include "vision/ZaryaAmmo.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <exception>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>

namespace V2::Vision {
struct Service::Impl {
    mutable std::mutex mutex;
    std::mutex lifecycle;
    Settings settings;
    ServiceStatus status;
    std::uint64_t revision = 1, nextEpoch = 0;
    double lastArrivalMs = 0.0;
    std::shared_ptr<const Frame> latest;
    std::thread worker;
    std::atomic<bool> stop{false}, active{false};

    void InvalidateLocked() { latest.reset(); }
    void Fault(const std::wstring& error) {
        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
        InvalidateLocked();
        status.state = ServiceState::Faulted;
        status.error = error;
    }
    void Run() {
        // All DirectShow lifetime, including error cleanup, belongs to this
        // thread. The game/aim/UI threads only consume immutable snapshots.
        try {
            CaptureCard capture;
            bool opened = false;
            CaptureCardSettings openedSettings;
            std::uint64_t epoch = 0;
            while (!stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
                Settings current;
                std::uint64_t currentRevision = 0;
                {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
                    current = settings; currentRevision = revision;
                    if (!current.enabled) break;
                }
                if (!opened || !(openedSettings == current.capture)) {
                    {
                        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
                        InvalidateLocked(); status.state = ServiceState::Starting;
                    }
                    std::wstring error;
                    if (!capture.open(current.capture, error)) { Fault(error); break; }
                    opened = true; openedSettings = current.capture;
                    const auto info = capture.info();
                    {
                        std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
                        epoch = ++nextEpoch;
                        status.width = info.width; status.height = info.height;
                        status.fps = info.framesPerSecond;
                        status.receivedFrames = status.processedFrames = status.droppedFrames = 0;
                        status.error.clear(); lastArrivalMs = 0.0;
                    }
                }
                std::wstring error;
                if (!capture.grab(250, error)) {
                    if (!stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) Fault(error);
                    break;
                }
                if (stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) break;
                const auto stats = capture.stats();
                auto frame = std::make_shared<Frame>();
                frame->sequence = stats.sequence; frame->epoch = epoch;
                frame->settingsRevision = currentRevision;
                frame->arrivalMs = stats.arrivalMs;
                frame->sampleTimeSeconds = stats.sampleTimeSeconds;
                frame->sampleTimeValid = stats.sampleTimeValid;
                if (!DetectContours(capture.view(), current, *frame, &error)) { Fault(error); break; }
                DetectAsheAmmo(*frame);
                DetectZaryaAmmo(*frame);
                {
                    std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
                    if (stop.load(std::memory_order_acquire) || !settings.enabled) break;
                    // A frame processed with a superseded palette/ROI cannot
                    // confirm a shot under a newly applied configuration.
                    if (revision != currentRevision) continue;
                    status.state = ServiceState::Running;
                    status.receivedFrames = stats.receivedFrames;
                    status.droppedFrames = stats.droppedFrames;
                    ++status.processedFrames;
                    lastArrivalMs = stats.arrivalMs;
                    if (IsFresh(*frame, settings, MonotonicMs())) latest = std::move(frame);
                    else InvalidateLocked();
                }
            }
            // capture's destructor stops the graph before leaving its owner.
        } catch (const std::exception&) {
            Fault(L"采集或轮廓处理发生异常，已停止使用图像。");
        } catch (...) {
            Fault(L"采集线程发生异常，已停止使用图像。");
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(mutex);
            InvalidateLocked();
            if (status.state != ServiceState::Faulted) status.state = ServiceState::Stopped;
        }
        active.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    }
};
Service::Service() : impl_(std::make_unique<Impl>()) {}
Service::~Service() { Stop(); }
bool Service::Configure(const Settings& settings, std::wstring* error) {
    if (!ValidateSettings(settings, error)) return false;
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    if (impl_->settings == settings) return true;
    impl_->settings = settings; ++impl_->revision;
    impl_->InvalidateLocked();
    return true;
}
void Service::UpdateOutlinePalette(const std::array<Rgb, 3>& colors) {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    if (!impl_->settings.useOutlineColors || impl_->settings.colors == colors) return;
    impl_->settings.colors = colors; ++impl_->revision;
    impl_->InvalidateLocked();
}
Settings Service::GetSettings() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    return impl_->settings;
}
bool Service::Start() {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_ASSET_PREVIEW
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    impl_->status.error = L"离线界面预览不会启动采集设备。";
    return false;
#else
    std::lock_guard lifecycle(impl_->lifecycle);
    if (impl_->active.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return true;
    if (impl_->worker.joinable()) impl_->worker.join();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
        if (!impl_->settings.enabled) {
            impl_->status.state = ServiceState::Stopped;
            impl_->status.error = L"请先启用采集轮廓。";
            return false;
        }
        impl_->status = {};
        impl_->status.state = ServiceState::Starting;
        impl_->InvalidateLocked(); impl_->lastArrivalMs = 0.0;
    }
    impl_->stop.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    impl_->active.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    try { impl_->worker = std::thread([state=impl_.get()] { state->Run(); }); }
    catch (...) {
        impl_->active.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
        impl_->Fault(L"无法创建采集工作线程。");
        return false;
    }
    return true;
#endif
}
void Service::Stop() {
    std::lock_guard lifecycle(impl_->lifecycle);
    impl_->stop.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
        impl_->InvalidateLocked();
    }
    if (impl_->worker.joinable()) impl_->worker.join();
    impl_->active.store(false, std::memory_order_release);
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    impl_->status.state = ServiceState::Stopped;
    impl_->status.error.clear();
    impl_->InvalidateLocked();
}
std::shared_ptr<const Frame> Service::Snapshot() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    const auto frame = impl_->latest;
    if (!impl_->settings.enabled || impl_->status.state != ServiceState::Running || !frame ||
        frame->settingsRevision != impl_->revision || !IsFresh(*frame, impl_->settings, MonotonicMs())) return {};
    return frame;
}
std::shared_ptr<const Frame> Service::Snapshot(Settings& settings) const {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    settings = impl_->settings;
    const auto frame = impl_->latest;
    if (!settings.enabled || impl_->status.state != ServiceState::Running || !frame ||
        frame->settingsRevision != impl_->revision || !IsFresh(*frame, settings, MonotonicMs())) return {};
    return frame;
}
ServiceStatus Service::Status() const {
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    auto result = impl_->status;
    result.frameAgeMs = impl_->lastArrivalMs > 0.0 ? (std::max)(0.0, MonotonicMs()-impl_->lastArrivalMs) : 0.0;
    return result;
}
bool Service::EnumerateDevices(std::vector<CaptureCardDevice>& devices, std::wstring& error) {
#ifdef UNLEASHED_ASSET_PREVIEW
    devices.clear();
    error = L"离线界面预览不会访问采集设备。";
    return false;
#else
    return CaptureCard::enumerate(devices, error);
#endif
}
#ifdef UNLEASHED_ASSET_PREVIEW
bool Service::PublishPreviewFrame(std::shared_ptr<Frame> frame) {
    if (!frame || frame->width <= 0 || frame->height <= 0 || frame->width > 8192 || frame->height > 8192 ||
        frame->sequence == 0) return false;
    const auto count = static_cast<std::size_t>(frame->width) * frame->height;
    if (count > 33554432 || frame->pixels.size() != count*4 || frame->mask.size() != count ||
        frame->componentIds.size() != count) return false;
    std::lock_guard lock(impl_->mutex);
    if (!impl_->settings.enabled || (frame->settingsRevision && frame->settingsRevision != impl_->revision)) return false;
    if (impl_->nextEpoch == 0) ++impl_->nextEpoch;
    if (frame->epoch && frame->epoch != impl_->nextEpoch) return false;
    auto copy = std::make_shared<Frame>(*frame);
    copy->settingsRevision = impl_->revision; copy->epoch = impl_->nextEpoch;
    if (copy->arrivalMs == 0.0) copy->arrivalMs = MonotonicMs();
    if (!IsFresh(*copy,impl_->settings,MonotonicMs())) return false;
    impl_->status = {};
    impl_->status.state = ServiceState::Running;
    impl_->status.width = copy->width; impl_->status.height = copy->height;
    impl_->status.processedFrames = copy->sequence;
    impl_->lastArrivalMs = copy->arrivalMs;
    impl_->latest = std::move(copy);
    return true;
}
#endif
Service& GetService() {
    static Service service;
    return service;
}
} // namespace V2::Vision
```

`src/vision/HudAmmoDetail.hpp`:

```hpp
#pragma once
#include "vision/ContourTypes.hpp"
#include "AsheAmmoTemplates.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bit>
#include <cmath>
#include <span>
#include <vector>

// Shared segmentation and observed HUD digit glyphs. Extracted unchanged from
// the validated Ashe detector; hero-specific anchors remain separate.
namespace V2::Vision::HudAmmoDetail {
struct Piece { int left, top, right, bottom, pixels; };
inline int Width(const Piece& p) { return p.right-p.left; }
inline int Height(const Piece& p) { return p.bottom-p.top; }

struct HudMask {
    int left=0, top=0, width=0, height=0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> pixels;
    bool At(int x,int y) const {
        return x>=left && y>=top && x<left+width && y<top+height &&
            pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y-top)*width+x-left]!=0;
    }
};

inline std::array<std::uint64_t,24> Normalize(const HudMask& mask,const Piece& p,int width) {
    std::array<std::uint64_t,24> rows{};
    for(int y=0;y<24;++y)for(int x=0;x<width;++x) {
        const int sx=p.left+(2*x+1)*Width(p)/(2*width);
        const int sy=p.top+(2*y+1)*Height(p)/48;
        if(mask.At(sx,sy))rows[y]|=std::uint64_t{1}<<x;
    }
    return rows;
}

inline double Match(const std::array<std::uint64_t,24>& rows,const Piece& p,
    const AsheAmmoDetail::GlyphTemplate& model) {
    const double aspect=double(Width(p))/Height(p);
    if(std::abs(aspect/model.aspect-1.0)>0.28)return 0.0;
    int intersection=0,united=0;
    for(size_t y=0;y<rows.size();++y) {
        intersection+=std::popcount(rows[y]&model.rows[y]);
        united+=std::popcount(rows[y]|model.rows[y]);
    }
    return united ? double(intersection)/united : 0.0;
}

struct Digit { int value=-1; double confidence=0.0; };
inline Digit Recognize(const HudMask& mask,const Piece& p,
    std::span<const AsheAmmoDetail::GlyphTemplate> extraTemplates = {}) {
    const auto rows=Normalize(mask,p,16);
    std::array<double,10> scores{};
    for(const auto& model:AsheAmmoDetail::kTemplates)
        if(model.digit>=0)scores[model.digit]=(std::max)(scores[model.digit],Match(rows,p,model));
    for(const auto& model:extraTemplates)
        if(model.digit>=0)scores[model.digit]=(std::max)(scores[model.digit],Match(rows,p,model));
    int best=0;
    for(int i=1;i<10;++i)if(scores[i]>scores[best])best=i;
    double second=0;
    for(int i=0;i<10;++i)if(i!=best)second=(std::max)(second,scores[i]);
    // An unobserved glyph, clipped glyph, or competing interpretation is unknown.
    if(scores[best]<0.80 || scores[best]-second<0.13)return {};
    return {best,scores[best]};
}

struct Candidate { size_t index; Digit digit; };
inline bool Prepare(const Frame& frame, HudMask& mask, std::vector<Piece>& pieces,
                    std::vector<Candidate>& digits,
                    std::span<const AsheAmmoDetail::GlyphTemplate> extraTemplates = {}) {
    if(frame.width<640 || frame.height<360 || frame.width>8192 || frame.height>8192 ||
        static_cast<size_t>(frame.width)*frame.height>33554432 ||
        frame.pixels.size()!=static_cast<size_t>(frame.width)*frame.height*4)return false;
    // Search a broad lower-right region; do not assume the image's dimensions
    // equal the game viewport (window borders and taskbars may be captured).
    mask.left=frame.width*7/10;mask.top=frame.height*7/10;
    mask.width=frame.width-mask.left;mask.height=frame.height-mask.top;
    mask.pixels.resize(static_cast<size_t>(mask.width)*mask.height);
    for(int y=0;y<mask.height;++y)for(int x=0;x<mask.width;++x) {
        const auto at=(static_cast<size_t>(y+mask.top)*frame.width+x+mask.left)*4;
        const auto b=frame.pixels[at],g=frame.pixels[at+1],r=frame.pixels[at+2];
        const int low=(std::min)({b,g,r}),high=(std::max)({b,g,r});
        mask.pixels[static_cast<size_t>(y)*mask.width+x]=low>170 && high-low<45;
    }
    auto unvisited=mask.pixels;
    std::vector<int> pending;
    pending.reserve(2048);pieces.reserve(64);
    for(int y=0;y<mask.height;++y)for(int x=0;x<mask.width;++x) {
        const int at=y*mask.width+x;
        if(!unvisited[at])continue;
        pending.clear();pending.push_back(at);unvisited[at]=0;
        Piece piece{x,y,x+1,y+1,0};
        for(size_t next=0;next<pending.size();++next) {
            const int current=pending[next],cx=current%mask.width,cy=current/mask.width;
            piece.left=(std::min)(piece.left,cx);piece.top=(std::min)(piece.top,cy);
            piece.right=(std::max)(piece.right,cx+1);piece.bottom=(std::max)(piece.bottom,cy+1);
            ++piece.pixels;
            for(int dy=-1;dy<=1;++dy)for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;++dx) {
                const int nx=cx+dx,ny=cy+dy;
                if(nx<0||ny<0||nx>=mask.width||ny>=mask.height)continue;
                const int ni=ny*mask.width+nx;
                if(unvisited[ni]){unvisited[ni]=0;pending.push_back(ni);}
            }
        }
        if(piece.pixels<12)continue;
        piece.left+=mask.left;piece.right+=mask.left;
        piece.top+=mask.top;piece.bottom+=mask.top;
        pieces.push_back(piece);
        if(pieces.size()>1024)return false;
    }
    const int minimumHeight=(std::max)(7,frame.height/180);
    const int maximumHeight=(std::max)(16,frame.height/24);
    for(size_t i=0;i<pieces.size();++i) {
        const auto& p=pieces[i];
        if(Height(p)<minimumHeight || Height(p)>maximumHeight || Width(p)>Height(p)*1.2)continue;
        digits.push_back({i,Recognize(mask,p,extraTemplates)});
    }
    return true;
}
}
```

`src/vision/ZaryaAmmo.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "vision/ZaryaAmmo.hpp"
#include "vision/ContourService.hpp"
#include "HudAmmoDetail.hpp"
#include "ZaryaAmmoTemplates.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

namespace V2::Vision {
namespace {
using namespace HudAmmoDetail;

bool Adjacent(const Piece& left, const Piece& right, double height) {
    const double gap = right.left - left.right;
    // Native adjacent zero glyphs can have a one-pixel gap at 20px height.
    // Compare the lower geometric bound in whole pixels rather than rejecting
    // 1px because a fractional 1.2px bound was produced by scaling.
    return gap >= (std::max)(1.0, std::floor(height * 0.06)) && gap <= height * 0.65 &&
        std::abs(right.bottom-left.bottom) <= height * 0.30 &&
        std::abs(Height(right)-height) <= height * 0.30;
}

double CannonConfidence(const HudMask& mask, const std::vector<Piece>& pieces,
                        const Piece& maximum) {
    const double height = Height(maximum);
    double confidence = 0.0;
    for (const auto& icon : pieces) {
        if (Width(icon) < height*4.5 || Width(icon) > height*9.0 ||
            Height(icon) < height*1.5 || Height(icon) > height*2.9 ||
            maximum.left-icon.right < height*2.8 ||
            maximum.left-icon.right > height*7.2 ||
            std::abs(icon.bottom-maximum.bottom) > height*0.45) continue;
        confidence = (std::max)(confidence,
            Match(Normalize(mask, icon, 64), icon, ZaryaAmmoDetail::kCannon));
    }
    return confidence >= 0.70 ? confidence : 0.0;
}
}

void DetectZaryaAmmo(Frame& frame) {
    frame.zaryaAmmoRemaining = -1;
    frame.zaryaAmmoConfidence = 0.0;
    HudMask mask;
    std::vector<Piece> pieces;
    std::vector<Candidate> digits;
    if (!Prepare(frame, mask, pieces, digits, ZaryaAmmoDetail::kDigits)) return;

    int recognized = -1;
    double confidence = 0.0;
    // The native cannon silhouette and a complete, separate maximum "100"
    // are both required. An isolated 100 (or another hero's 100-ammo weapon)
    // is not enough to identify the ammunition display.
    for (const auto& one : digits) {
        if (one.digit.value != 1) continue;
        const auto& a = pieces[one.index];
        const double height = Height(a);
        const double cannon = CannonConfidence(mask, pieces, a);
        if (cannon == 0.0) continue;
        for (const auto& zero : digits) {
            if (zero.digit.value != 0) continue;
            const auto& b = pieces[zero.index];
            if (!Adjacent(a, b, height)) continue;
            for (const auto& lastZero : digits) {
                if (lastZero.digit.value != 0) continue;
                const auto& c = pieces[lastZero.index];
                if (!Adjacent(b, c, height)) continue;
                // A clipped/extra denominator digit must not turn a different
                // capacity into a qualifying 100-ammo anchor.
                bool extraMaximum = false;
                for (const auto& digit : digits) {
                    const auto& p = pieces[digit.index];
                    if (p.left >= c.right && p.left-c.right <= height*0.65 &&
                        std::abs(p.bottom-c.bottom) <= height*0.35) {
                        extraMaximum = true; break;
                    }
                }
                if (extraMaximum) continue;

                std::vector<Candidate> current;
                bool incomplete = false;
                for (const auto& digit : digits) {
                    const auto& p = pieces[digit.index];
                    if (p.left < a.left-height*4.8 || p.right > a.left-height*0.6 ||
                        p.bottom < a.top-height*1.5 || p.top > a.bottom+height*0.5) continue;
                    if (std::abs(p.bottom-a.bottom) > height*0.35 ||
                        std::abs(Height(p)-height) > height*0.35 ||
                        digit.digit.value < 0) {
                        incomplete = true; break;
                    }
                    current.push_back(digit);
                }
                if (incomplete || current.empty() || current.size() > 3) continue;
                std::sort(current.begin(), current.end(), [&](const auto& x, const auto& y) {
                    return pieces[x.index].left < pieces[y.index].left;
                });
                const auto& last = pieces[current.back().index];
                if (a.left-last.right < height*0.75 || a.left-last.right > height*1.6) continue;
                if (current.size() > 1 && current.front().digit.value == 0) continue;
                int value = 0;
                double score = (std::min)({cannon, one.digit.confidence,
                    zero.digit.confidence, lastZero.digit.confidence});
                for (size_t i=0; i<current.size(); ++i) {
                    const auto& digit = current[i];
                    if (i>0 && !Adjacent(pieces[current[i-1].index], pieces[digit.index], height)) {
                        incomplete = true; break;
                    }
                    value = value*10+digit.digit.value;
                    score = (std::min)(score, digit.digit.confidence);
                }
                if (incomplete || value > 100) continue;
                // Multiple qualifying HUDs are ambiguous even if their values
                // happen to match. Never select one by screen position alone.
                if (recognized >= 0) return;
                recognized = value;
                confidence = score;
            }
        }
    }
    frame.zaryaAmmoRemaining = recognized;
    frame.zaryaAmmoConfidence = recognized >= 0 ? confidence : 0.0;
}

ZaryaAmmoSnapshot ReadZaryaAmmo(bool localIsZarya) {
    ZaryaAmmoSnapshot result;
    if (!localIsZarya) return result;
    Settings settings;
    const auto frame = GetService().Snapshot(settings);
    if (!frame) return result;
    const double nowMs = MonotonicMs();
    if (!IsFresh(*frame, settings, nowMs)) return result;
    result.sequence = frame->sequence;
    result.epoch = frame->epoch;
    result.arrivalMs = frame->arrivalMs;
    result.ageMs = nowMs-frame->arrivalMs;
    if (frame->zaryaAmmoRemaining < 0 || frame->zaryaAmmoRemaining > 100) return result;
    result.known = true;
    result.remaining = frame->zaryaAmmoRemaining;
    result.confidence = frame->zaryaAmmoConfidence;
    return result;
}

bool RequestZaryaAmmoCapture() {
    auto& service = GetService();
    const auto status = service.Status();
    if (status.state == ServiceState::Running || status.state == ServiceState::Starting) return true;
    auto settings = service.GetSettings();
    settings.enabled = true;
    return service.Configure(settings) && service.Start();
}
}
```
